body: According to the published announcement, Chemical Asia Corporation Pte, Ltd sold shares of Bank Victoria International Tbk (BVIC.JK) at approximately IDR 115, decreasing holdings from 2,978,334,404 to 2,256,924,404. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Francis Lay Sioe Ho Sell Shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Francis Lay Sioe Ho sold shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk (BFIN.JK) at approximately IDR 750, decreasing holdings from 343,908,180 to 338,908,180. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Hasmoro Buy Shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Hasmoro bought shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk (HEAL.JK) at approximately IDR 1,410, increasing holdings from 747,553,489 to 748,766,889. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Iwan Buy Shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Iwan bought shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk (BFIN.JK) at approximately IDR 750, increasing holdings from 1,650,000 to 2,000,000. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Pt Fersindo Nusa Jaya Buy Shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Pt Fersindo Nusa Jaya bought shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk (ITMA.JK), increasing holdings from 101,390,800 to 107,730,000. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Pt Fersindo Nusa Jaya Buy Shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Pt Fersindo Nusa Jaya bought shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk (ITMA.JK), increasing holdings from 114,286,400 to 114,290,200. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Trukindo Persadasejahtera Buy Shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Trukindo Persadasejahtera bought shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk (ITMA.JK). This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Pt Fersindo Nusa Jaya Buy Shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Pt Fersindo Nusa Jaya bought shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk (ITMA.JK), increasing holdings from 107,730,000 to 114,286,400. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Trukindo Persadasejahtera Buy Shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Trukindo Persadasejahtera bought shares of Sumber Energi Andalan Tbk (ITMA.JK), increasing holdings from 60,043,500 to 62,593,500. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Darma Henwa Tbk’s subsidiary PT Mahadaya Imajinasi Nusantara becomes controlling shareholder of PT Gayo Mineral Resources
body: PT Mahadaya Imajinasi Nusantara (MIN) now holds 99.75% of PT Gayo Mineral Resources (GMR) after Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources approval, making GMR’s financials consolidable into PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA). DEWA’s shares rose 1.41% to IDR 430, and the company targets IDR 1.7 trillion EBITDA and IDR 490 billion net profit in 2025.

title: PT Timah Tbk seeks Danantara Indonesia investment to fund downstream expansion at PT Timah Industri
body: PT Timah Tbk is preparing a business proposal for a capital injection from Danantara Indonesia, which would be directed to its subsidiary PT Timah Industri to support downstream tin‑chemical production, including new products such as Ethylhexyl Thioglycolate and TMP Solid. The company also received seized smelter units and heavy equipment transferred through the Attorney General, the Deputy Minister of Finance, and BPI Danantara to PT Timah.

title: PT PP Presisi Tbk secures new mining service contract in Maba Village, East Halmahera
body: PT PP Presisi Tbk (PPRE) won a contract to provide integrated mining services—including clearing, topsoil and waste removal, and ore production—for PT Position's Mining Development and Operations Work in Maba Village, East Halmahera, supporting its expansion in Eastern Indonesia. The company said the award aligns with its strategy to enhance mining operations safely and sustainably.

title: Macmohan Holdingsrise shares jump 3.7% after winning AUD 36 million underground mining contract in Indonesia
body: Macmohan Holdingsrise (MAH) rose up to 3.7% to AUD 0,555, its biggest intraday gain since Nov 17, after being awarded a 12‑month underground mining contract for the Kucing Liar mine in Central Papua, Indonesia by a Freeport‑McMoRan unit. The contract, covering development of all underground fixed facilities, is valued at AUD 36 million (≈USD 23.27 million).

title: Indonesia considers raising the domestic coal supply quota as it plans to lower 2026 production targets
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources is evaluating a cut to the 2026 coal production target to below 700 million tonnes and may increase the mandatory domestic market obligation (DMO) percentage to keep domestic supply around 200‑230 million tonnes, which analysts say is needed to meet electricity, cement and fertilizer demand. Industry experts note that domestic coal consumption has been steady at roughly 220‑233 million tonnes and that any DMO adjustment must be proportional to ensure fairness and market absorption.

title: PT Kereta Api Indonesia works to restore flood‑damaged rail lines in northern Sumatra
body: PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI) is deploying teams from its North Sumatra regional division and Aceh subdivision to repair tracks washed out by severe floods and landslides, with President Director Bobby Rasyidin overseeing the operation. The damage includes multiple washouts on the Medan–Binjai line and the Krueng–Geukueh–Bungkaih stretch, while the National Disaster Mitigation Agency reports hundreds of deaths and thousands injured in the affected provinces.

title: PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk Announces 16 IDR Interim Dividend Yielding About 1.12%
body: The company will distribute an interim dividend of Rp 16 per share, totaling Rp 50.23 billion (16.18% of net profit as of 30 Sept 2025), approved by the board and scheduled for payment in December 2025. The dividend corresponds to a yield of roughly 1.12% based on the closing price of Rp 1,425 per share on 2 Dec 2025.

title: PT Archi Indonesia Tbk Announces US$30 Million Interim Dividend as Stock Surges 428% YTD
body: PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI) announced an interim dividend for 2025 of US$30 million (≈Rp 499.93 billion), which translates to roughly Rp 20.23 per share based on its 24.84 billion shares outstanding. The company's shares have risen about 428% YTD in 2025, closing at Rp 1,290 on 2 December, with the dividend payable between 10 December and 15 December 2025.

title: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk (RATU) unveils a multi‑horizon upstream acquisition strategy and receives a speculative‑buy recommendation with a Rp20,000 target price
body: RATU plans seven block acquisitions worth US$10‑150 million each over the next three years, adopting short‑, medium‑ and long‑term investment phases while new Barito Group‑linked management and a US$9.4 million (5%) stake by Chandra Daya Investasi (CDIA) bolster its capital base; analysts at Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia recommend a speculative buy with a target of Rp20,000 per share, citing MSCI Indonesia Small Cap Index inclusion and projected 2025‑2026 revenues of US$52 million and US$59 million, respectively, though lower oil prices and acquisition delays pose risks.

title: Hasmoro increases stake in Medikaloka Hermina (HEAL) by buying 1.21 million shares at a discount
body: On 25 November 2025, Hasmoro purchased 1.21 million shares of Medikaloka Hermina (HEAL) at Rp1,410 per share, a 1.74% discount to the closing price of Rp1,435, costing about Rp1.71 billion. The acquisition raised Hasmoro’s total holding to 748.76 million shares, representing 4.87% of the company.

title: Jaya Sukses Makmur (RISE) posts Q3 2025 net profit of Rp51.92 billion, up 102% YoY
body: In Q3 2025, Jaya Sukses Makmur (RISE) reported a net profit of Rp51.92 billion, a 102.49% increase from the same period last year, with earnings per share rising to Rp4.74. The company’s revenue grew 30.78% to Rp294.14 billion, while total assets reached Rp3.5 trillion and equity rose to Rp2.73 trillion.

title: BFI Finance Indonesia (BFIN) director Iwan buys 350,000 shares while commissioner Francis Lay Sioe Ho sells 5 million shares ahead of a large dividend payout
body: On 1 December 2025, BFI Finance Indonesia (BFIN) director Iwan acquired 350,000 shares at Rp750 each, spending Rp262.5 million and raising his holding to 2 million shares (0.01%). At the same time, commissioner Francis Lay Sioe Ho divested 5 million shares worth Rp3.75 billion, leaving him with 338.9 million shares (2.25%), as the company announced an interim dividend of Rp35 per share totaling Rp519.72 billion payable on 18 December 2025.

title: Mastersystem Infotama (MSTI) to Distribute Interim Dividend of Rp16 Per Share
body: Mastersystem Infotama (MSTI) will distribute an interim dividend totaling Rp50.23 billion, or Rp16 per share, representing 16.18% of its Rp310.33 billion net profit as of September 30, 2025. The cum dividend date for the regular and negotiation market is December 10, 2025, with the payment scheduled for December 29, 2025.

title: Dian Swastatika (DSSA) Reports 27.31% Decline in Net Profit and 10.26% Drop in Revenue for First Nine Months of 2025
body: Dian Swastatika (DSSA) recorded a net profit of USD177.24 million for the first nine months of 2025, marking a 27.31% decrease from the previous year, alongside a 10.26% reduction in revenue to USD2.01 billion. Despite the drop in profitability, the company's total assets increased to USD4.17 billion and total equity rose to USD2.15 billion.

title: Archi Indonesia (ARCI) to Distribute USD30 Million Interim Dividend for 2025
body: Archi Indonesia (ARCI) plans to distribute an interim dividend of USD30 million (Rp499.83 billion) for the 2025 financial year, translating to Rp20,1260 per share. The cum dividend date for regular and negotiation markets is December 10, 2025, with payment scheduled for December 16, 2025, supported by a net profit of USD70.47 million as of September 30, 2025.

title: Rukun Raharja (RAJA) Reports Mixed Q3 2025 Financials with Net Profit Decline Amidst Revenue Growth
body: Rukun Raharja (RAJA) recorded a net profit of USD17.75 million for the period ending September 30, 2025, marking an 8.31% decrease from the previous year, despite net revenue increasing by 3.36% to USD196.04 million. The company's gross profit rose 9.47% to USD56.28 million, and total assets significantly grew to USD446.1 million from USD331.35 million at the end of the previous year.

title: Chengdong Investment Corporation Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Chengdong Investment Corporation sold shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK) at approximately IDR 238, decreasing holdings from 29,703,117,930 to 25,989,764,030. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Andry Hakim Buy Shares of PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Andry Hakim bought shares of PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk (CBRE.JK) at approximately IDR 1,020, increasing holdings from 226,903,374 to 227,000,074. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Pimsf Pulogadung Buy Shares of PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Pimsf Pulogadung bought shares of PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk (GPSO.JK), increasing holdings from 323,035,900 to 326,369,600. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Indonesia considers using I‑UAE CEPA to lower food costs for Hajj and Umrah pilgrims
body: Coordinating Minister for the Economy and Trade Zulkifli Hasan said the Indonesia‑UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement could enable duty‑free shipments to the UAE and onward to Saudi Arabia, reducing logistics costs for Hajj pilgrims. He has instructed the National Food and Drug Agency (BPOM) to coordinate with Saudi authorities to remove regulatory barriers, highlighting a potential market of up to Rp60 trillion (about US$3.6 billion) for Indonesian food supplies currently dominated by foreign providers.

title: Indonesia projects IEU-CEPA will raise EU-bound exports by more than 50 percent
body: The Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs says the Indonesia–EU Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, slated for ratification in January 2026, will remove duties on 98% of Indonesian products and grant zero‑tariff treatment to key commodities such as palm oil, coffee and textiles, potentially increasing exports to the EU by over 50%. The pact is also positioned as a tool to help achieve the government's 8% economic growth target by 2029.

title: Mayora Indah (MYOR) to Issue Rp827.54 billion Sustainable Bond in Two Tranches
body: Mayora Indah (MYOR) will offer a total of Rp827.54 billion of bonds, split into a Rp363.52 billion Series A at 5.85% interest for 5 years and a Rp464.02 billion Series B at 6.15% interest for 7 years, with quarterly interest payments starting March 18 2026 and principal repayment on December 18 2030 and December 18 2032 respectively. The net proceeds will be loaned to its subsidiary Torabika Eka Semesta (TES) to fund working‑capital needs such as raw material and packaging purchases, and the public offering runs from December 12‑15 2025 with listing on the Bursa Eek Indonesia on December 19 2025.

title: Chengdong Investment Corporation raises Rp884.07 billion from Bumi Resources share divestment while retaining a 6.99% stake
body: Chengdong Investment Corporation sold a total of 3.71 billion Bumi Resources shares in two transactions on 28 November 2025, generating Rp20.4 billion from 84.76 million shares at Rp240.72 each and Rp863.67 billion from 3.62 billion shares at Rp238.02 each. After the sales, Chengdong’s holding fell to 25.98 billion shares, representing 6.99% of Bumi Resources, down from 7.99% (29.7 billion shares) before the divestment.

title: Surya Semesta Internusa executes Rp1.66 trillion in‑kind share and land contribution to consolidate its hotel units
body: Surya Semesta Internusa (SSIA) executed a Rp1.66 trillion in‑kind transaction on 1 December 2025, contributing shares of Sitiagung Makmur (SAM) (493.2 million shares, Rp366.93 billion), Surya Internusa Hotels (SIH) (823,329 shares, Rp379.05 billion) and Surya Semesta Realti (SSR) (85.42 million shares, Rp117.66 billion) as well as land from TCP Internusa (TCP) valued at Rp803.55 billion to Suryalaya Anindita International (SAI), which compensated with 17,102 new shares. The move consolidates SSIA’s hotel units under SAI to enable unified reporting, improve asset utilization and support future financing and growth of its hospitality business.

title: Adhi Karya (ADHI) Secures Rp14.1 Trillion in New Contracts, an 80.8% Increase from October 2025
body: As of 30 November 2025, Adhi Karya (ADHI) won new contracts worth Rp14.1 trillion, up 80.76% from the Rp7.8 trillion recorded in October, with 65% of the value coming from building projects and 74% of funding sourced from the government. The contracts, dominated by engineering & construction work, include major government infrastructure projects such as legislative and judicial buildings in Ibu Kota Nusantara, strengthening the company's project pipeline and financial outlook.

title: Bakrie Telecom posts a net loss of Rp3.11 billion in the first nine months of 2025
body: The company’s net loss narrowed 94% year‑on‑year to Rp3.11 billion, with earnings per share falling to Rp0.08, while operating profit rose to Rp15.18 billion and profit for the year turned positive at Rp13.01 billion. Revenue declined 12.8% to Rp85.92 billion and total assets fell to Rp57.77 billion.

title: Paradise Indonesia expects holiday-season boost to hospitality and commercial revenues, targeting double‑digit growth in FY2025
body: Paradise Indonesia (INPP) forecasts strong performance in its hospitality and commercial segments during the 2025 holiday season, citing a 5 % rise in foreign tourist arrivals to 5.3 million by September and Q3 revenues of Rp457.1 billion (+7.7 % YoY) for hotels and Rp417.8 billion (+14.4 % YoY) for its shopping centers. The company aims to achieve double‑digit growth for FY2025, leveraging flagship assets such as Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort, Beachwalk Shopping Center and the expanded 23 Paskal Shopping Center with the Skyward rooftop amusement park.

title: BTN launches Housingpreneur 2025 roadshow in Makassar to accelerate youth‑driven housing innovation
body: On 3 December 2025, BTN held the BTN Housingpreneur 2025 roadshow in Makassar, inviting students, creators and young entrepreneurs to turn housing ideas into bankable businesses, with a total prize pool of Rp1.5 billion and three‑month business incubation. The event highlighted successful alumni such as Moh. Rozaqul Anam of Paktukang and emphasized the city’s role as a “natural laboratory” for addressing Indonesia’s housing demand of over 91,000 units per year.

title: Mohamad Jusuf Hamka sells 100 million shares of Citra Marga Nusaphala, cutting his stake to 7.34%
body: On 2 December 2025, Mohamad Jusuf Hamka disposed of 100 million Citra Marga Nusaphala (CMNP) shares through Profindo Sekuritas Indonesia and Bank HSBC Indonesia, a transaction valued at roughly Rp133 billion based on the closing price of Rp1,330. After the sale, his holding fell to 491.48 million shares (7.34% of CMNP), down from 591.48 million shares (8.83%).

title: Waskita Beton Precast (WSBP) holds bondholders meeting to seek covenant waiver and outline recovery strategy for 2025‑2026
body: On 2 December 2025, Waskita Beton Precast (WSBP) convened a Rapat Umum Pemegang Obligasi (RUPO) where bondholders approved temporary suspension of financial covenants—including a minimum current ratio of 1.0×, a maximum debt‑to‑equity ratio of 2.5×, and a 100% debt service coverage ratio—for the 2025 and 2026 reporting periods, while the company presented its post‑restructuring performance, market‑share growth plans, and operational efficiency initiatives.

title: Sampoerna Agro (SGRO) posts net profit of Rp1 trillion in Q3 2025, up 178% YoY
body: Sampoerna Agro (SGRO) reported a net profit of Rp1 trillion for the quarter ended 30 September 2025, a 177.77% increase from Rp367.89 billion a year earlier. Revenue rose 36.79% to Rp4.61 trillion, gross profit to Rp1.61 trillion, operating profit to Rp1.36 trillion, while equity grew to Rp6.43 trillion and liabilities fell to Rp44.2 trillion.

title: All PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBNI) Directors Pass OJK Fit‑and‑Proper Test, Munadi Herlambang Appointed Human Capital and Compliance Director
body: The OJK confirmed that every member of PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBNI)’s board has passed its fit‑and‑proper test and approved the appointment of Munadi Herlambang as Director of Human Capital and Compliance, effective 1 December 2025. The approval is documented in OJK Letter No. SR491/PB.02/2025 dated 28 November 2025 and follows the annual shareholders’ meeting on 26 March 2025.

title: CEO Konosuke Mizuta resigns from PT Mizuho Leasing Indonesia Tbk (VRNA) ahead of extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: Konosuke Mizuta submitted his resignation as President Director of PT Mizuho Leasing Indonesia Tbk (VRNA), which was received on 1 December 2025 and will be processed according to OJK Regulation No. 33/POJK.04/2014, with the resignation to be considered at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 23 December 2025. The company, founded in 1993 and listed on the IDX since its 2008 IPO of 460 million shares at Rp100 each, had previously appointed Mizuta for the 2025‑2027 term.

title: PT MPX Logistics International Tbk. Subsidiary Changes Name and Expands Business Scope
body: PT MPX Logistics International Tbk. (MPXL) announced that its subsidiary, PT MPX Indorental Gemilang, officially changed its name to PT MPX Indo Gemilang (MIG) on November 27, 2025. This change also includes the addition of new business activities such as rental of mining and energy machinery, car repair, and wholesale trade of automotive parts, with no material impact on MPXL's operations or financial condition.

title: UNTR Forms PT Nusantara Industri Nikel Lestari (NINL) for Nickel Business Diversification
body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR), through its subsidiaries PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara (DTN) and PT Energia Prima Nusantara (EPN), established PT Nusantara Industri Nikel Lestari (NINL) on December 2, 2025. This new entity, with DTN holding 99.90% and EPN 0.10% of its shares, aims to diversify UNTR's business into non-ferrous basic metal manufacturing and metal trading, with no material impact on UNTR's current operations or financial condition.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) Reports Continued UMKM Business Expansion and Increased Optimism for Q4-2025
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) announced its UMKM Business Index at 101.9 for Q3-2025, indicating continued expansion, with the Business Expectation Index rising to 120.7 due to stable input prices, rising commodity prices, and government projects. Despite a recorded decline in business rentability impacting loan repayment ability, investment activities are increasing, and the UMKM Business Sentiment Index for Q3-2025 stood at 111.9, with expectations for Q4-2025 strengthening to 134.8 driven by holiday demand and government spending.

title: PT Infiniti Wahana Buy Shares of Steady Safe Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Infiniti Wahana bought shares of Steady Safe Tbk (SAFE.JK) at approximately IDR 280, increasing holdings from 459,170,813 to 459,570,813. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Turniady Widjaja Buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Turniady Widjaja bought shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK) at approximately IDR 11,181, increasing holdings from 50,393,300 to 50,394,600. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Bahtera Bintang Nusantara Sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Bahtera Bintang Nusantara sold shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR.JK) at approximately IDR 577, decreasing holdings from 110,300,000 to 77,709,400. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Handriyanto Sell Shares of Sidomulyo Selaras Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Handriyanto sold shares of Sidomulyo Selaras Tbk (SDMU.JK) at approximately IDR 117, decreasing holdings from 460,000 to 100,000. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Jemmy Kurniawan sold shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK) at approximately IDR 89, decreasing holdings from 1,047,500,000 to 1,046,135,300. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Arkora Bakti Indonesia Sell Shares of PT Arkora Hydro Tbk.
body: According to the published announcement, PT Arkora Bakti Indonesia sold shares of PT Arkora Hydro Tbk. (ARKO.JK) at approximately IDR 1,025, decreasing holdings from 1,391,760,000 to 1,226,692,775. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Andhesti Tungkas Pratama Sell Shares of Darma Henwa Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Andhesti Tungkas Pratama sold shares of Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA.JK) at approximately IDR 422, decreasing holdings from 4,140,782,066 to 3,805,013,366. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Indonesia seeks to broaden Turkey preferential trade pact to boost bilateral trade
body: Indonesia’s Deputy Minister of Trade Dyah Roro Esti met Turkey’s Deputy Minister of Trade Mustafa Tuzcu in Cairo to push for an expanded scope of the Indonesia‑Turkey Preferential Trade Agreement, aiming to deepen economic ties and lay groundwork for a comprehensive partnership. Bilateral trade reached $2.4 billion in 2024, with Indonesia’s exports to Turkey up 26 % to $1.9 billion, and both sides are considering broader product coverage and cooperation in sectors such as textiles, footwear, iron‑steel and construction.

title: Indonesia to declare food self-sufficiency for rice and corn on December 31, 2025
body: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman said Indonesia will announce self‑sufficiency for strategic commodities such as rice and corn at noon on December 31, citing a record 3.8 million‑ton national rice reserve stored by state‑run logistics firm Bulog and a 13.6% rise in projected 2025 rice production to 34.79 million tons. The increase is driven by higher yields across Java, Sumatra, Sulawesi, Nusa Tenggara and Kalimantan, supporting the government's food‑security target.

title: Indonesia's Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto announces measures to mitigate flood‑induced economic slowdown in Sumatra
body: Airlangga Hartarto said the government will activate credit‑restructuring and debt‑relief regulations for MSMEs, and launch infrastructure rehabilitation in North Sumatra, Aceh and West Sumatra to prevent a dip in the national growth target of 5.6 percent after floods and landslides killed 776 people, left 564 missing and affected 3.2 million residents. President Prabowo Subianto has visited the disaster zones and ordered air‑lifted aid to isolated areas.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk adds BRI credit card as a QRIS payment source in the BRImo app
body: The bank announced that BRI credit cards can now be selected as the primary funding source for QRIS transactions on BRImo, covering both merchant‑presented and online payments. New users can apply for a virtual BRI credit card through the app and may receive vouchers up to Rp150,000 along with exclusive merchant discounts.

title: Batu Investasi Indonesia raises its Bahtera Bumi Raya stake to 82.30% with a silent purchase of 161.9 million shares
body: On 3 December 2025, Batu Investasi Indonesia bought 161,899,350 shares of Bahtera Bumi Raya (PGJO) with the assistance of BCA Sekuritas, increasing its holding to 654.98 million shares (82.30%). Based on the 3 December closing price of Rp1,115, the transaction is valued at roughly Rp180.51 billion.

title: Victoria Insurance (VINS) to raise Rp13 billion through a private placement of 92.85 million shares
body: Victoria Insurance (VINS) will issue 92.85 million new shares at an exercise price of Rp140 each, totaling Rp13 billion, with the placement approved on 20 Oct 2025 and the shares to be absorbed by Victoria Investama (VICO) and listed on the Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) by 15 Dec 2025. The proceeds will be used to meet minimum equity requirements, strengthen capital structure, and fund working‑capital needs, including investments in deposits, mutual funds, and bonds.

title: Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo to acquire up to 20% of Perintis Triniti Properti
body: On 2 December 2025, a share purchase agreement was signed for Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo, niece of President Prabowo Subianto, to acquire an initial 5% and potentially up to 20% of Perintis Triniti Properti from its main shareholders Kunci Daud Indonesia (KDI) and Intan Investama Internasional (III). The transaction, overseen by Director Ishak Chandra, is stated to have no material impact on the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition, or continuity.

title: Andhesti Tungkas Pratama sells 335.76 million Darma Henwa shares at a discount, cutting its stake to 9.35%
body: Andhesti Tungkas Pratama divested 335.76 million Darma Henwa (DEWA) shares under the Grup Bakrie banner at Rp422 per share, generating approximately Rp141.69 billion in proceeds, which is below the closing price of Rp432 per share on 28 November 2025. The transaction diluted Andhesti’s holding to 3.8 billion shares, or 9.35%, down from 4.14 billion shares (10.18%) prior to the sale.

title: Raharja Energi Cepu injects USD5.1 million to support PT Petrogas Jatim Utama Cendana's cash‑call for Blok Cepu
body: Raharja Energi Cepu (RATU) will provide a USD5.1 million cash‑call financing in 2026 to PT Petrogas Jatim Utama Cendana (PJUC) to help it meet its project funding obligations under the KKS and JOA for Blok Cepu. The injection aims to secure Petrogas Jatim’s participation, sustain operations in the Cepu Working Area, and may generate consolidated interest income and economic value for Raharja Cepu, which holds a 49% stake.

title: Triniti Dinamik (TRUE) plans a 757.11‑million‑share private placement to strengthen capital and fund operations
body: Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) intends to issue 757,110,786 new shares with a Rp25 nominal value, representing up to 10% of its placed capital, and will use net proceeds for working capital, general business and project development. An extraordinary shareholders meeting is scheduled for 12 January 2026 to approve the placement, subject to OJK Regulation No. 42/2020.

title: Arkora Bakti Indonesia sells 165.06 million Arkora Hydro shares at deep discount, raising only Rp169.25 billion
body: Arkora Bakti Indonesia divested 165.06 million Arkora Hydro shares on 1‑3 December 2025 at prices ranging from Rp950 to Rp1,800 per share, generating Rp169.25 billion—about 61.7% below the market price of Rp4,700. The Bursa Efek Indonesia froze Arkora Hydro stock after a 246.86% one‑month surge, with the year‑to‑date rise reaching 410.87%.

title: Unilever Indonesia Announces Rp3.3 Trillion Interim Dividend for FY 2025
body: Unilever Indonesia (UNVR) approved an interim dividend of Rp3.3 trillion, representing 99.3 % of its net profit of Rp3.33 trillion for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, resulting in a dividend of Rp87 per share. The dividend will be paid on 30 December 2025, with the ex‑dividend date on 15 December and the record date on 16 December.

title: PT Kencana Energi Lestari Tbk wins 10 MW solar IPP tender with PLN for Tobelo project
body: PT Kencana Energi Lestari Tbk (KEEN) was selected by PLN to develop a 10 MW photovoltaic plant with an 8.4 MWh battery in Tobelo Utara, scheduled to start construction in Q2 2026 and generate about 20.4 GWh annually. The company also is bidding on additional IPP projects totaling 180 MW, aiming to expand its renewable energy footprint.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) signs addendum with PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) to expand fiber‑optic network to Sumatra
body: On 3 December 2025, PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI), operating as Surge, signed an addendum to its existing long‑term agreement with PT Kereta Api Indonesia (Persero) to build, install, operate and manage fiber‑optic cables along railway corridors in Sumatra, extending the project that previously covered Java. The expansion aims to improve high‑speed internet access, support digital services, education, logistics and the broader digital economy across the island.

title: Andry Hakim Increases Stake in PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk (CBRE) Amid Positive Corporate Developments
body: Andry Hakim acquired an additional 96,700 shares of PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk (CBRE) at Rp1,020 per share on December 1, 2025, raising his total ownership to 5.002%. This purchase, along with the impending RUPSLB for a right issue, the arrival of the Hai Long 106 vessel, and a Rp4.3 trillion contract with Guna Nusa Utama Fabricator (GUF), contributed to a 16% rise in CBRE's stock price.

title: PT Hua Yuan New Energi Indonesia Negotiates Acquisition of 51.18% Stake in PT Andalan Sakti Primaindo Tbk (ASPI)
body: PT Hua Yuan New Energi Indonesia is negotiating to acquire 51.18% of PT Andalan Sakti Primaindo Tbk (ASPI) shares, totaling 349,955,000 units, from its current controlling shareholder, PT Andalan Sakti Inti, with the transaction value still under discussion. This acquisition, intended to support the new controller's investment and business development in Indonesia, is contingent on due diligence and will trigger a mandatory tender offer.

title: PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk (TUGU) Demonstrates Robust Financial Health Exceeding Industry Averages
body: PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk (TUGU) exhibits strong financial health, with its Risk Based Capital (RBC) at 360.9% per September 2025 and Investment Adequacy Ratio (RKI) at 272.6% per July 2025, both significantly surpassing industry averages. Analyst Kharel Devin from Trimegah Sekuritas affirms TUGU's solid financial position, noting its optimal RBC level, 21% year-on-year growth in investment income to Rp509 billion by September 2025, and consistent 'a-' rating from AM Best since 2016.

title: PT Celebes Mining Resources Reduces Stake in PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk. (HOPE)
body: PT Celebes Mining Resources divested 130 million shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk. (HOPE) at Rp155 per share, totaling Rp20.15 billion, reducing its ownership from 22.1% to 16%. Following this divestment, HOPE's shares increased by 11.11% to Rp210 on Thursday.

title: PT Benteng Api Technic Tbk (BATR) Targets Significant Growth in Indonesia's Expanding Refractory Market, Supported by Strategic Investments and Share Buyback.
body: PT Benteng Api Technic Tbk (BATR) is poised for substantial growth in Indonesia's refractory market, driven by increasing demand from heavy industries, strategic investments funded by IPO proceeds, and targeting Rp 150 billion in revenue and Rp 14.8 billion in net profit for 2025. The company also completed a Rp 4 billion share buyback to strengthen ownership and investor confidence, with analysts from Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia highlighting BATR's bright prospects in a market currently dominated by imports.

title: Leyand International (LAPD) Plans Capital Strengthening for Business Alignment with PT JSI Sinergi Mas's Energy Expansion
body: Leyand International (LAPD) is planning corporate actions to strengthen its capital structure, aiming to align with its new controller, PT JSI Sinergi Mas, which is expanding into the energy and mining sectors, including silica. The company's equity stood at Rp26.7 billion as of September 30, 2025, a decrease from Rp28.3 billion at the end of 2024 due to a Rp21.1 billion capital deficiency.

title: PT Celebes Mining Resources Sell Shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Celebes Mining Resources sold shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk (HOPE.JK) at approximately IDR 155, decreasing holdings from 470,781,500 to 340,781,500. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Daya Kemilau Nusantara Investama Sell Shares of PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Daya Kemilau Nusantara Investama sold shares of PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk (TRON.JK) at approximately IDR 90, decreasing holdings from 1,851,380,000 to 1,764,046,400. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Charnic Capital Tbk Sell Shares of PT Fuji Finance Indonesia Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT Charnic Capital Tbk sold shares of PT Fuji Finance Indonesia Tbk (FUJI.JK) at approximately IDR 790, decreasing holdings from 94,863,400 to 85,532,400. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Kundy Wijaya Sell Shares of PT Kusuma Kemindo Sentosa Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, Kundy Wijaya sold shares of PT Kusuma Kemindo Sentosa Tbk (KKES.JK) at approximately IDR 31, decreasing holdings from 81,640,800 to 78,830,200. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk Sell Shares of PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk
body: According to the published announcement, PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk sold shares of PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (MORA.JK) at approximately IDR 432. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Daya Kemilau Nusantara Investama Sells Shares of PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk
body: PT Daya Kemilau Nusantara Investama, an insider, sold 53,333,400 shares of PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk, reducing its holdings from 1,817,379,800 to 1,764,046,400. The transaction was for collateral purposes.

title: PT Daya Kemilau Nusantara Investama Sells Shares of PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk
body: PT Daya Kemilau Nusantara Investama, an insider, sold 53,333,400 shares of PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk, a technology company, for collateral purposes. The transaction reduced the holder's ownership from 1,817,379,800 to 1,764,046,400 shares.

title: Indonesia confirms $3.1 billion of JETP funds available and $5.5 billion under negotiation for clean‑energy projects
body: The government said $3.1 billion of the original $20 billion Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP) pledge is now mobilised, with an additional $5.5 billion being negotiated for pipeline projects such as floating solar, geothermal, waste‑to‑energy and transmission upgrades. JETP funding has risen to $21.4 billion, split between the International Partners Group ($11 billion) and the Glasgow Financial Alliance for Net Zero ($10 billion), and the United States' withdrawal will not affect the programme.

title: Indonesia's Deputy Housing Minister calls on sharia developers to lead the 3 Million Houses Program
body: Deputy Minister of Housing and Settlement Areas Fahri Hamzah urged sharia‑based property developers to become drivers of the 3 Million Houses Program, emphasizing the need to protect social housing from speculation and ensure fairness under President Prabowo Subianto's leadership. He said collaboration with the sharia property sector would accelerate the delivery of decent homes for low‑income Indonesians and help narrow urban‑rural disparities.

title: Indonesia reviews mining permits in Aceh and North Sumatra after deadly Sumatra floods
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has sent a team to re‑evaluate mining business permits (IUP) in Aceh and North Sumatra following flash floods and landslides that killed 836 people and left 518 missing, and the minister said any permits found to be in violation will be revoked. He also confirmed that the Martabe gold mine in South Tapanuli has ceased operations and is assisting in disaster response while its future status is under review.

title: PT GTS Internasional Tbk. secures Rp1.19 trillion credit facility from PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk.
body: PT GTS Internasional Tbk. (GTSI) signed a Rp1.19 trillion credit facility with PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBNI) that includes a Rp365 billion ship‑refinancing loan at 8% interest for 60 months and a USD50 million standby L/C facility, with 20% collateral requirements. The material transaction, exceeding 20% of GTSI’s equity, is disclosed without shareholder approval and is intended to strengthen the company’s working capital and liquidity.

title: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk. declares Rp87 per‑share interim dividend for FY 2025
body: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk. announced an interim dividend of Rp87 per share, totaling roughly Rp3.3 trillion for 37.98 billion eligible shares, with a record date of 16 December 2025 and payment on 30 December 2025. The company also reported Q3 2025 net profit of Rp3.33 trillion (up 10.81% YoY) and sales of Rp27.61 trillion, a modest year‑on‑year increase.

title: PT Pulau Subur Tbk commits to continued high dividend payouts and announces a Rp43 billion palm oil mill expansion
body: The company declared two dividend payments this year totaling Rp6.5 per share, aligning with its prospectus‑mandated minimum 30% payout and forecasting a 5% profit growth in 2026 driven by higher fresh fruit bunch prices and volumes. It also disclosed that the environmental permit for a new palm oil mill is in final stages, with a Rp43 billion capex expected to generate about Rp180 billion in annual revenue and an additional Rp5‑7 billion in profit.

title: PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk sells its 18.32% stake in PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk at a deep discount
body: On 4 December 2025, PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL) divested its entire 4,331,835,710 shares (18.32%) in PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (MORA) for an average price of Rp432 per share, totaling about Rp1.87 trillion—roughly 95% below the closing price of Rp8,850. Despite the large sell‑off, MORA’s shares rose 9.89% on 5 December, reaching Rp9,725.

title: PT PP Tbk Receives Bankruptcy Petition Summons from Jakarta Commercial Court Over Subcontractor Claims
body: PT PP Tbk was summoned by the Central Jakarta Commercial Court regarding bankruptcy petitions filed by subcontractors PT Atap Perkasa (claiming Rp4.03 billion) and CV Citra Pratama (claiming Rp6 billion) related to the KCBN Museum project. The company said the filings have not materially affected its legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity and will cooperate with legal proceedings.

title: Bank Mandiri wins five Bank Indonesia Awards in 2025, highlighting strong credit growth and expanded FX and digital payment operations
body: At the Bank Indonesia Award 2025, Bank Mandiri received five honors for its macro‑prudential, monetary and payment‑system contributions, including best sustainable finance and best foreign‑exchange dealer. The bank reported 9.38% year‑on‑year credit growth to IDR 1,403.79 trillion, a 32.06% rise in interbank FX transactions and a 28% increase in BI‑FAST transactions to 564 million moves in October 2025.

title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk appoints Rahayu Saraswati Djojohadikusumo as President Commissioner after extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: On 2 December 2025, shareholders representing 76.36% of voting rights approved the appointment of Rahayu Saraswati Djojohadikusumo, the nephew of President Prabowo Subianto, as President Commissioner of PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN). The meeting also accepted the resignations of two directors, reassigned Septian Starlin to Commissioner, and appointed Gregorius Seloko Uyanto as Director, with the new board serving until the 2029 annual meeting.

title: PT PP (Persero) Tbk faces bankruptcy petitions from two subcontractors on the Museum KCBN Muarajambi project
body: The Central Commercial Court of Jakarta has summoned PT PP (Persero) Tbk after PT Atap Perkasa and CV Citra Pratama filed bankruptcy petitions over unpaid claims of Rp4.03 billion and Rp6.00 billion respectively for work on the Museum KCBN Muarajambi construction. PT PP (Persero) Tbk said it will cooperate and follow legal procedures.

title: Indonesia’s Low Interest Rate Environment Persists as BI Holds Rate and Deposit Yields Decline
body: Bank Indonesia kept the BI‑Rate at 4.75% in November 2025, prompting a gradual fall in average Rupiah deposit rates to 3.85% and foreign‑currency deposit rates to 1.82%, while credit rates also slipped, with OJK reporting a 50‑bp drop in investment loan rates. LPS projects further deposit‑rate reductions and stronger credit growth, and an OJK survey shows banking optimism with an IBP of 66 in Q4‑2025.

title: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk Sells Shares of PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk
body: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk sold 4,331,835,710 shares of PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk, reducing its holding to 0. The transaction type was a sell, with a purpose of divestment, and was completed at a price of 432.

title: Indonesia's Youth and Sports Minister pledges regulatory overhaul to boost sports industry and economic growth
body: Youth and Sports Minister Erick Thohir announced plans to revoke Regulation No. 14 of 2024, review 191 existing rules and potentially streamline them to about ten to facilitate the growth of the national sports industry. He highlighted the sector's economic potential, citing the U.S. sports market at USD 417 billion, and linked the reforms to Indonesia’s target 5‑8% GDP growth.

title: Indonesia to Sign Contracts for 50,000 Subsidized Homes on Dec. 18
body: Indonesia’s Housing and Settlement Areas Minister Maruarar Sirait announced a mass signing on Dec. 18 in Serang, Banten for 50,000 subsidized homes that must be completed before sale to protect low‑income buyers. President Prabowo Subianto praised the initiative, noting it exceeds the prior target and supports a broader plan to raise the annual subsidized‑housing allocation to 350,000 units.

title: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk (IPCM) upgrades to the Bursa Efek Indonesia main board, expands its investor base and wins CSA Awards 2025
body: As of 30 November 2025, PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk (IPCM) increased its shareholder base to 7,168 investors and reported revenue of Rp1.09 trillion (up 15.5%) and net profit of Rp140.67 billion (up 16.16%) for the period ending 30 September 2025. The company also moved from the Development Board to the Main Board of the Bursa Efek Indonesia on 21 November 2025 and received the CSA Awards 2025 for Excellence in Ports Services and Sustainability.

title: Indosterling Technomedia (TECH) plans a 502.52‑million‑share right issue to strengthen capital after leadership resignations and a director’s conviction
body: The company will seek shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 18 December 2025 for a right issue of 502,520,000 shares at a nominal value of Rp 50, with proceeds earmarked for financial recovery, new business development, debt repayment, recruitment and infrastructure. The issuance follows the simultaneous resignation of the President Director and other executives and a 10‑year prison sentence for Chairman Sean William Henley, and any unsubscribed shares will be taken up by a standby buyer, potentially altering ownership percentages.

title: Moratelindo (MORA) posts 14.2% YoY increase in Q3 net profit to IDR 231.55 billion despite lower revenue
body: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, Moratelindo (MORA) reported net profit of IDR 231.55 billion, a 14.23% rise from the same period last year, with basic earnings per share increasing to IDR 10. Revenue fell 6.35% to IDR 2.8 trillion, while operating profit declined to IDR 711.7 billion. The company’s equity grew to IDR 7.64 trillion and liabilities fell to IDR 6.82 trillion.

title: Alfamart (AMRT) plans Rp1.5 trillion share buyback to repurchase up to 650 million shares
body: Sumber Alfaria Trijaya alias Alfamart (AMRT) will allocate Rp1.5 trillion for a share buyback from 8 December 2025 to 6 March 2026, targeting a maximum of 650 million shares, which does not exceed 20% of its paid‑in capital and maintains a free‑float of at least 7.5%. The company states it has sufficient capital and cash flow to fund the program without materially affecting operations or earnings, aiming to support market stability and enhance shareholder value.

title: KB Bank launches GenKBiz Bandung 2025 and Star Festival to empower Gen Z entrepreneurs
body: KB Bank’s GenKBiz Bandung 2025 selected 20 semifinalists, later narrowing to 10 finalists who will pitch at the Star Festival, while the festival also features entertainment and a 50% cashback promo for KBStar QRIS transactions. The program, part of a five‑city rollout, aims to boost financial literacy, creativity, and startup opportunities for Indonesia’s youth.

title: Indonesian President Prabowo announces cancellation of KUR loans for flood‑hit Aceh farmers and fast‑track bridge repairs
body: President Prabowo Subianto said the government will cancel Smallholder Business Credit (KUR) debts for Aceh farmers affected by floods and landslides, treating the disaster as a force‑majeure event. He also oversaw the construction of a temporary 30‑meter Bailey bridge to restore access between Bireuen and Takengon, with repairs expected within one to two weeks.

title: Indonesia moves to accelerate KUR microcredit for Sumatra disaster‑hit MSMEs
body: The government will meet KUR‑lending banks on Dec. 8 to fast‑track disbursement of the People's Business Credit scheme for micro, small and medium enterprises affected by floods and landslides in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra. Officials will first map the damage to identify permanently affected businesses before implementing regional economic recovery measures, after the disasters that have killed 916 people and left 274 missing.

title: PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk’s RLCO IPO surges 34.5% on debut, achieving record 948‑times oversubscription
body: The company offered 625 million shares (20% of its capital) at Rp168, raising Rp105 billion, and its stock opened at Rp226, up 34.52% on the first day of trading. The IPO was oversubscribed 948.25 times, the highest in Indonesia’s history, with proceeds allocated to working capital for swiftlet‑nest raw material and to its subsidiary PT Realfood Winta Asia.

title: PT Timah (TINS) receives idA+ rating from Pefindo with stable outlook
body: PT Timah (TINS) was assigned an idA+ rating with a stable outlook by Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (Pefindo), reflecting its strong market position, relatively robust financial profile and likely support from its parent. The rating could be upgraded if the company sustains higher productivity, cost efficiency and strong EBITDA, but may be downgraded if debt rises above projections or global tin price volatility significantly impacts revenue and profitability.

title: Terang Dunia Internusa (UNTD) reports a Rp10.56 billion net loss for Q3 2025, turning basic EPS negative.
body: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, Terang Dunia Internusa (UNTD) posted a net loss of Rp10.56 billion, resulting in a basic loss per share of Rp1.58 versus a prior surplus of Rp2.90. Net sales fell 20.6% to Rp346.79 billion, gross profit dropped to Rp82.89 billion, while selling and administrative expenses rose, and total equity declined to Rp584.39 billion as liabilities increased to Rp661.93 billion.

title: Promosi Desa Digital acquires 6.10% stake in Haloni Jane through silent purchases in early December 2025
body: Promosi Desa Digital, assisted by Mirae Asset sekuritas Indonesia, bought a total of 361.43 million shares of Haloni Jane across three days (2‑4 December 2025), raising its ownership to 6.10 %. Based on the average closing price of Rp99.33, the purchases are valued at roughly Rp35.9 billion.

title: Eagle High Plantations (BWPT) to launch Rp500 billion of sustainable bonds and sukuk
body: The palm‑oil producer plans to offer a total of Rp500 billion, comprising a Rp210 billion sustainable bond (split into two series with 9.75% and 11% coupons) and a Rp290 billion sustainable sukuk Mudharabah (two series with profit‑sharing rates equivalent to 9.75% and 11%). The offering runs 22‑30 Dec 2025, with allocation on 2 Jan 2026 and listing on the IDX on 7 Jan 2026, and proceeds will be used for debt repayment and working capital.

title: Wahana Konstruksi Mandiri Pursues Controlling Stake in Asri Karya Lestari Through Pending 69.52% Share Acquisition
body: Wahana Konstruksi Mandiri is negotiating to acquire 69.52% of Asri Karya Lestari, amounting to 4.34 billion shares from current controller Sudjatmiko. The transaction, subject to a mandatory tender under OJK Regulation No. 9/POJK.04/2018, awaits final negotiation and regulatory approval, with the company anticipating improved capital structure and business growth.

title: Caraka Reksa Optima sells 35.97 million Petrosea shares, reducing its stake to 25.98%
body: Between 20 November and 4 December 2025, Caraka Reksa Optima divested a total of 35,971,500 Petrosea (PTRO) shares through brokers Minna Padi Investama sekuritas, CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia, Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia and Henan Putihrai Sekuritas, generating approximately Rp354.67 billion at an average price of Rp9,860 per share. After the sales, its holding fell to 2.62 billion shares, representing 25.98% of Petrosea, down 0.37 percentage points from 26.35%.

title: Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya and Green Power Group Say Deportation of Chairman An Shaohong Won’t Affect Operations
body: Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya (KRYA) confirmed that the deportation of its chairman An Shaohong has no impact on its operational performance or business continuity and is proceeding with a replacement in accordance with regulations. Green Power Group (LABA) made a similar statement, noting its management structure remains stable while it also prepares to replace directors and commissioners.

title: Triple B completes acquisition of 45.8% of PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA)
body: PT Bisnis Bersama Berkah and PT Triple Berkah Bersama, entities under the Triple B group, purchased 878,845,100 shares of PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA) at a discounted price of Rp20 per share, amounting to Rp17.57 billion and giving them a 45.80% stake and control of the company. Following the transaction, MEJA's shares closed 1.9% higher at Rp107 on 5 December 2025.

title: NEST’s integrated model and strong balance sheet outpace newly listed RLCO despite RLCO’s rapid revenue growth
body: PT Esta Indonesia Tbk (NEST) operates a fully vertically‑integrated bird‑nest business with 15 birdhouses, 80 ton annual capacity and a debt‑to‑equity ratio of 0.12, while PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO), which listed in early December, relies solely on purchased raw material, has a DER of 2.88, high short‑term debt and cash of only Rp4.03 billion. Nevertheless RLCO posted a 47.6 % sales increase and a 609 % net‑profit jump in the first five months of 2025, though it still faces supply‑side risk and limited downstream scale compared with NEST’s strong export link to Xiamen Yan Palace Bird’s Nest Industry Co Ltd.

title: PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO) to debut on the Indonesia Stock Exchange with a Rp105 billion IPO
body: PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk will be listed on the Development Board of BEI on 8 December at 08:00 WIB, with an IPO price of Rp168 per share for 3,125 billion shares, resulting in a market capitalization of roughly Rp525 billion. The offering aims to raise Rp105 billion.

title: PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk (NRCA) expands its order book to Rp6.23 trillion and posts 4.8% revenue growth in 2025
body: NRCA secured new contracts worth Rp2.89 trillion in January–October 2025, bringing its total order book, including the Rp3.34 trillion carry‑over from 2024, to Rp6.23 trillion. For the year to September 2025, the company reported revenue of Rp2.66 trillion (up 4.8% YoY) and net profit of Rp156 billion, up from Rp85 billion in the comparable period of 2024.

title: PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara Tbk. expands business scope after extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: PT Platinum Wahab Nusantara Tbk. (TGUK) held an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 2 December 2025, where shareholders representing 72.1% of the company's shares approved amendments to the Articles of Association to add primary activities in wholesale beef and chicken (including processed products) and supporting activities in meat processing, processed foods, and wholesale food and beverage trade. Director Maulana Hakim said the new lines are intended to drive business expansion and capture growth opportunities in the downstream food sector and government programs.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. posts solid Q3 2025 performance boosted by child‑company synergies
body: In Q3 2025, the total assets of BRI's subsidiaries grew 15.0% YoY to Rp244.5 trillion and net profit rose 27.6% YoY to Rp8.2 trillion, contributing 19.9% of consolidated profit and 11.45% of total assets. The group also launched the Pegadaian super app "Tring" to enable digital gold purchases, reflecting its diversification strategy under the "BRIVolution Reignite" program.

title: PT Sidomulyo Selaras Tbk Director Handriyanto sells 360,000 shares in two transactions, reducing stake to 0.01%
body: Handriyanto sold 250,000 shares at Rp105 and 110,000 shares at Rp122, totaling Rp39.67 million, decreasing his holding from 460,000 (0.04%) to 100,000 shares (0.01%). On Friday's close, SDMU shares edged up 0.98% to Rp103.

title: Shareholder Kundy Wijaya reduces stake in PT Kusuma Kemindo Sentosa Tbk (KKES) through December 2025 sales
body: Kundy Wijaya sold 2,810,600 shares of PT Kusuma Kemindo Sentosa Tbk at Rp31 per share (totaling Rp87.12 million) on 1 December 2025, following a 13 November sale of 631,500 shares at Rp29 each (Rp18.31 million), decreasing his holding from 81.6 million shares (5.44%) to 78.8 million shares (5.26%). On 5 December, KKES shares closed 3.23% higher at Rp32, driven by buying interest in small‑cap stocks.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk President Director Frans Kesuma Wins Transformational Industrial Leader Award at TOP CEO Indonesia Awards 2025
body: Frans Kesuma, President Director of PT United Tractors Tbk, received the Transformational Industrial Leader award from IDNFinancials and Metro TV at the TOP CEO Indonesia Awards 2025, recognizing his leadership in operational resilience, innovation, digital transformation and ESG initiatives. Since taking the role in 2019, he has expanded UT’s portfolio into minerals and renewable energy, strengthening its competitive position and sustainable growth.

title: Indonesia to decide by mid‑December 2025 on Pertamina‑Rosneft Tuban refinery project
body: Indonesia’s Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said a decision on whether state‑owned Pertamina and Russia’s Rosneft will proceed with the multi‑billion‑dollar Tuban refinery in East Java is expected by mid‑December 2025, as the partners remain in the Final Investment Decision stage. The move comes despite U.S. Treasury sanctions announced on Oct 22 against Rosneft and Lukoil, which Pertamina President Director Simon Aloysius Mantiri says does not alter its commitment to the joint project.

title: Indonesia's Ministry of Finance targets first half of 2026 to begin demutualisation of Bursa Efek Indonesia
body: The Ministry of Finance said it will draft a Government Regulation to enable the demutualisation of Bursa Efek Indonesia, targeting implementation in the first half of 2026, and is coordinating with Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK), BEI and market participants. BEI director Jeffrey Hendrik clarified that the change is a shareholder action under the Financial Sector Development and Strengthening Law, expected to broaden ownership and boost market depth and liquidity.

title: Indonesia's IHSG reaches all‑time high of 8,710.70 on Fed rate‑cut expectations and stronger China trade data
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed up 0.90% at 8,710.70 on Monday, marking a new all‑time high driven by anticipation of Federal Reserve rate cuts and better‑than‑expected export and import figures from China, while technical analysis shows the index breaking the crucial 8,600‑8,770 zone and opening a path toward 9,000. Broad‑based gains were led by stocks such as DSSA, GOTO, COIN, MORA and ENRG, with analysts recommending short‑term targets for KRAS, INDY, BUMI, DEWA and a speculative buy on ERAL.

title: Maybank Sekuritas rates PT Jasa Marga Tbk (JSMR) ESG below benchmark but retains buy recommendation with Rp 6,000 target
body: Maybank Sekuritas gave PT Jasa Marga Tbk (JSMR) an ESG score of 39, below the 50 benchmark, yet kept a buy rating with a target price of Rp 6,000 based on an EV/EBITDA valuation. The company projects 2025 revenue of Rp 19.95 trillion and net profit of Rp 3.82 trillion, rising to Rp 20.94 trillion and Rp 4.19 trillion in 2026, while noting environmental score declines, strong social pillars, and green mobility initiatives such as 52 EV charging stations.

title: Super Bank Indonesia (SUPA) Sets IPO Price at Rp635, Valued Competitively Compared to Peers
body: Super Bank Indonesia (SUPA) has set its IPO price at Rp635 per share, aiming to raise Rp2.79 trillion, with its Price to Book Value (PBV) of 2.64x making it one of the lowest-valued digital banks compared to peers like Bank Jago (ARTO), Allo Bank Indonesia (BBHI), and Bank Aladin Syariah (BANK). Supported by the Grab and Emtek Group ecosystem, 70% of the IPO funds will be used for credit disbursement, and 30% for long-term capital expenditure.

title: PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO) surges 34.5% on IPO debut, pricing at Rp168 per share and targeting up to Rp105 bn in fresh capital
body: On its first trading day, PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO) shares jumped 34.52% to Rp226, hitting the Auto Rejection Atas level, after the IPO was priced at the top of the bookbuilding range (Rp168) for up to 625 million shares, potentially raising about Rp105 billion (20% of paid‑in capital). The proceeds are earmarked for working‑capital needs, mainly raw‑material purchases, and a capital injection into PT Realfood Winta Asia.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. highlights its 1.2 million‑agent network covering over 80% of Indonesian villages and record transaction volumes
body: As of October 2025, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) supports about 1.2 million AgenBRILink agents serving 66,649 villages, facilitating 913 million transactions worth Rp1,440 trillion, while maintaining 7,405 branches and over 687,000 digital e‑channels. Digital banking now accounts for 99.4% of BRI’s total transaction volume, underscoring its focus on inclusive, reliable financial services.

title: Harapan Duta Pertiwi injects Rp66 billion into Tambang Meranti Mulia Sejahtera, raising its stake to 33.06%
body: Harapan Duta Pertiwi (HOPE) is investing Rp66 billion by purchasing 1.5 billion TMMS shares at Rp44 each, bringing its ownership in Tambang Meranti Mulia Sejahtera (TMMS) to 33.06% of the paid‑up capital. TMMS, a diversified contractor in mining, heavy‑equipment rental, commodity trading and stevedoring, stands to benefit from Indonesia's strong mining sector and growing demand for nickel used in EV batteries.

title: Adi Sarana Armada (ASSA) Boosts Rental Fleet and Targets Growth Amid Strong Q3 Performance
body: Adi Sarana Armada (ASSA) is strengthening its vehicle rental fleet with a Rp500 billion credit facility from QNB Indonesia and a Rp1.5 trillion capital expenditure allocation, targeting 5-10% growth in its rental segment this year. By Q3 2025, the company achieved Rp4.41 trillion in consolidated revenue, up 21%, with its rental and autopool business contributing Rp1.2 trillion, an increase of 4%, supported by stable B2B contracts.

title: Impack Pratama Industri (IMPC) Completes Rp100.10 Billion Private Placement with Kaddara Investments Pte Ltd
body: Impack Pratama Industri (IMPC) completed a private placement valued at Rp100.10 billion, issuing 38.5 million new shares at Rp2,600 each to Kaddara Investments Pte Ltd. This transaction, executed at a 31.57% discount from the December 8, 2025 closing price, increased the company's total outstanding shares to 54.9 billion.

title: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk. (ISSP) Prioritizes Unit 7 in Gresik and Targets 10% Profit Growth by 2026
body: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk. (ISSP) is focusing on its new Unit 7 factory in Gresik, targeting the oil and gas sector while expanding into construction markets. The company aims for a conservative 10% profit growth in 2026, supported by Unit 7's full operation which is expected to boost production capacity to 1.2 million tons annually, with Rp700 billion allocated for this year's capex, of which Rp250 billion–Rp300 billion has been realized.

title: Operational Efficiency Drives Folago Global Nusantara (IRSX) to Substantial Profit Growth in Nine Months 2025
body: Folago Global Nusantara (IRSX) recorded a spectacular financial performance for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, with net profit after proforma impact surging 1,776% to Rp34.15 billion, primarily due to massive operational efficiency and business restructuring. Despite a strategic correction in net revenue, the company also saw its gross profit jump 685% to Rp43.01 billion and EBITDA increase 1,776% to Rp35.54 billion.

title: Medco Energi (MEDC) Executes USD80 Million Guarantee Transaction for Subsidiaries' Crude Oil Advance
body: Medco Energi (MEDC) executed a USD80 million guarantee and indemnity agreement with Petco Trading Labuan Company Ltd (Petco) on December 4, 2025, related to a crude oil advance for its indirectly wholly-owned subsidiaries, Medco Energi Thailand (Bualuang) Limited (METBL) and Medco Energi Thailand (E&P) Limited (METE&PL). The company stated that this transaction will not negatively impact its operations, legal, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Pelayaran Jaya Hidup Baru (PJHB) Initiates Construction of Three New Ships Post-IPO to Expand Sea Logistics and Target Over 50% Growth
body: Pelayaran Jaya Hidup Baru (PJHB) has commenced the keel laying for LCT Cipta Jaya Harapan 99, marking the start of construction for three new 2,500 DWT ships fully funded by its Rp158.4 billion IPO capital expenditure. This expansion aims to significantly increase PJHB's sea logistics capacity, capitalize on rising industrial demand, and is projected to drive over 50% revenue growth by 2026.

title: PT Global Sukses Digital Tbk (DOSS) Appointed Exclusive Snaproll Distributor for Indonesia and Singapore, Bolstering Regional Expansion
body: PT Global Sukses Digital Tbk (DOSS) has been appointed as the Exclusive Distributor for Snaproll, a rapidly growing mini lifestyle camera, across Indonesia and Singapore. This strategic move strengthens DOSS's regional presence and paves the way for its retail and ecosystem expansion into Singapore by 2026, demonstrating international brand confidence in DOSS's market development capabilities.

title: PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk (LUCY) Stock Surge Triggers BEI UMA and Suspension, Company Reports No Material Information
body: The stock of PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk (LUCY) experienced a rapid price increase, prompting Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) to issue an Unusual Market Activity (UMA) signal and impose a cooling-down suspension; LUCY's CEO confirmed no corporate actions or undisclosed material information. Despite increased revenue to Rp41.56 billion in June 2025, LUCY reported a deeper net loss of Rp10.46 billion and decreased total assets, with PT Delta Wibawa holding 59.42% as the controlling shareholder.

title: PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA) Delays Debt Payments, Bursa Efek Indonesia Extends Share Suspension
body: PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk (WIKA) has again postponed the payment of bond interest and sukuk profit sharing due on December 8, 2025, signaling serious pressure on its business continuity. Consequently, Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) decided to continue the temporary suspension of WIKA's share trading, which has been in effect since February 18, 2025, following a prior debt payment delay.

title: PT Wise Manajemen Indonesia Secures Rp33.66 Billion Contracts, Boosting PT Logisticplus International Tbk.'s Consolidated Revenue
body: PT Wise Manajemen Indonesia (WMI), a subsidiary of PT Logisticplus International Tbk. (LOPI), secured new contracts worth Rp33.66 billion to provide and manage 441 employees for PT Pampas Electric and PT Nextron Teknologi Indonesia. Signed on December 5, 2025, these one-year contracts are expected to increase WMI's operational activities and LOPI's consolidated revenue, with LOPI's shares closing up 9.58% at Rp183 on Monday (8/12).

title: State-Owned Banks Issue Sustainable Bonds to Strengthen ESG Practices and Liquidity
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk and PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk are issuing sustainable bonds to enhance liquidity and strengthen ESG-aligned financing, following similar initiatives by PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk and PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk targets Rp10 trillion for social sustainability bonds and Rp5 trillion for subordinated bonds, while PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk plans Rp5 trillion for its sustainability bond, contributing to a robust banking sector where credit grew 7.70% year-on-year to Rp8,162.8 trillion by September 2025.

title: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA) Completes Payment Obligations for Bonds and Sukuk Mudharabah
body: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA) has fulfilled its payment obligations for bonds and sukuk mudharabah Berkelanjutan I Tahap III Tahun 2024 Seri A, which mature on December 6, 2025. The company paid Rp199.17 billion in principal and Rp3.59 billion in interest/yield for each instrument using internal cash, reporting no material impact on its operations or financial condition.

title: Bernard Widianto Sells Shares of PT Widiant Jaya Krenindo Tbk.
body: Bernard Widianto, an insider, sold 8,290,000 shares of PT Widiant Jaya Krenindo Tbk., reducing his holding from 932,690,000 to 924,400,000 shares. The transaction was conducted over three days, with prices ranging from 41 to 45, as part of an investment strategy.

title: PT Abadimukti Gunalestari Buys Shares of Perdana Gapura Prima Tbk
body: PT Abadimukti Gunalestari, an insider, bought 48,280,300 shares of Perdana Gapura Prima Tbk, increasing its holding from 2,575,989,120 to 2,624,269,420 shares. The transaction was made for investment purposes, with multiple buy and sell transactions occurring on July 29 and 30, 2025.

title: PT Abadimukti Gunalestari Sells Shares of Perdana Gapura Prima Tbk
body: PT Abadimukti Gunalestari, an insider, sold shares of Perdana Gapura Prima Tbk, reducing its holding from 2734541320 to 2548027020, due to investment strategy, with multiple transactions occurring between July 23-25, 2025

title: PT Abadimukti Gunalestari Sells Shares of Perdana Gapura Prima Tbk
body: PT Abadimukti Gunalestari, an insider, sold shares of Perdana Gapura Prima Tbk, reducing its holding from 2734541320 to 2548027020, with the transaction purpose stated as investment strategy, involving multiple bought and sold transactions between July 23-25, 2025

title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UT) Wins Analyst’s Favorite Listed Company in Industrials at CSA Awards 2025
body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UT) was awarded the Analyst’s Favorite Listed Company in the Industrials Sector at the CSA Awards 2025, recognized for shareholder openness, stock liquidity, risk management, and ESG practices. The award was presented by Corporate Communications Manager Himawan Sutanto at the ceremony in the Main Hall of the Indonesia Stock Exchange.

title: Airbus partners with Indonesia’s Bogor Agricultural University to assess biomass potential for sustainable aviation fuel production
body: Airbus’s Singapore office and Indonesia’s Bogor Agricultural University (IPB) will study the country’s biomass resources, targeting up to 100 million tons per year to supply SAF, while noting that Indonesia could produce as much as 500 million tons annually. The collaboration also highlights logistical challenges for smallholder collection and cites Pertamina’s PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional (KPI) as an early SAF producer, amid environmental concerns over forest clearing.

title: MIND ID drives digital transformation at PT Bukit Asam Tbk, boosting coal output by up to 20%
body: MIND ID is implementing an end‑to‑end digital integration for PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA) through the CISEA platform, unifying OT and IT to monitor operations in real time, with over 100 digital modules used by more than 7,000 staff and a 70% data‑capture rate. The initiative has raised coal production by up to 20% and supports a target to increase output from 41 million to 100 million tonnes while enhancing safety, cost efficiency and environmental governance.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk forms PT Nusantara Industri Nikel Lestari with PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara holding 99.90% ownership
body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) announced the establishment of PT Nusantara Industri Nikel Lestari (NINL), in which PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara (DTN) holds 9,990,000,000 shares (99.90%) and PT Energia Prima Nusantara (EPN) holds 10,000,000 shares (0.10%); NINL will manufacture basic non‑ferrous metals and trade metal ores as part of UNTR’s diversification into nickel processing, alongside recent gold‑mining acquisitions and the 2 × 3.5 MW Besai Kemu mini‑hydro plant operated by EPN and PT Uway Energi Perdana (UEP).

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk outlines three $9 billion HPAL projects to supply EV‑battery materials
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) or INCO plans to build HPAL smelters at Pomalaa, Bahodopi and Sorowako with a total investment of USD 9 billion, targeting EV‑battery nickel supply and adding ore sales from Bahodopi and Pomalaa starting in 2025. The three HPAL plants are slated for phased completion by the third quarter of 2026, pending market assessments and risk studies.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk accelerates diversification with Australian copper‑gold acquisition and new sustainable bond issuance
body: PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) aims to raise non‑thermal‑coal revenue from 5% to 10% in 2025 and to a 50:50 split by 2031, highlighted by its 100% purchase of Wolfram Limited’s copper‑gold mine and plans to acquire up to 65% of Jubilee Metals Limited and 45% of PT Laman Mining using proceeds from a IDR 780 billion Sustainable Bonds I Phase III issuance. Analyst Muhammad Wafi sees the expansion as potentially boosting non‑coal earnings but warns of capital‑expenditure and leverage risks, maintaining a buy rating with a target price of IDR 260 as the share closed at IDR 246, up 0.82%.

title: Indonesia launches nationwide transport fare discounts for the year‑end holiday period
body: From Dec 22, 2025 to Jan 10, 2026 Indonesia will apply a 30% rail fare cut, a 20% passenger‑ship discount, 13‑14% airfare reductions, 10‑20% toll road discounts and a 100% waiver of port service charges, covering up to 3.5 million air passengers, 1,509 million rail users, 405,881 ship travelers, 227,560 passengers and 491,776 vehicles. The measures aim to ease peak‑season crowding, keep prices stable and support families travelling home during the Christmas‑New Year exodus.

title: Indonesia aims to secure up to $8 million in seaweed deals at Food Ingredients Europe 2025 in Paris
body: Indonesia’s Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries will showcase six seaweed exporters—Surya Indoalgas, Hakiki Donarta, Agar Swallow, Karagen Indonesia, Agalindo Perdana, and Rote Karaginan Nusantara—at the FIE 2025 exhibition, targeting up to US$8 million in contracts while reporting US$264.6 million in seaweed exports from January to October 2025, led by China and the EU. The delegation will collect market intelligence and discuss tariff reductions under the Indonesia‑EU CEPA to strengthen carrageenan and agar sales.

title: Jasuindo (JTPE) announces Rp140 billion share buyback program
body: Jasuindo (JTPE) will allocate Rp140 billion to repurchase up to 342.6 million shares at a maximum price of Rp600 per share over a three‑month period from 15 December 2025 to 6 March 2025, with Mandiri Sekuritas acting as broker. The buyback will be funded from internal cash, is not expected to materially affect the company's operations, financial performance, capital position, or liquidity, and aims to support share price stability and enhance EPS.

title: Pelayaran Jaya Hidup Baru starts keel‑laying of its first IPO‑funded LCT, aiming to expand the fleet to eight vessels by 2027
body: The company commenced keel laying for the LCT Cipta Jaya Harapan 99 in Samarinda, using the Rp158.4 billion proceeds from its recent IPO to build three new 72‑75 m, 2,500 DWT vessels, with a target of operating eight LCTs by 2027 and achieving over 50% revenue growth in 2026. Since the IPO on 6 November, PJHB’s share price has risen more than 100%, reflecting strong market interest in the expanding maritime fleet.

title: Tjokro Group acquires controlling stake in Geoprima Solusi (GPSO) through PIMSF Pulogadung
body: Tjokro Group, via its subsidiary PIMSF Pulogadung, purchased roughly 48.95% of Geoprima Solusi (GPSO) shares, making PIMSF Pulogadung the new controlling shareholder and triggering a mandatory tender offer to public shareholders. The deal values GPSO's current assets at about Rp2 trillion, with the group aiming to expand assets to Rp5 trillion through additional capital and broader industrial‑service integration.

title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia lifts suspension on PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk shares as Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia raises target price to IDR 1,350 on strong Q3 2025 results
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) announced that the suspension on PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET) shares and INET-W warrants will be lifted effective the first session on 10 December 2025. Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia (IF) maintained a Spec‑BUY rating and increased the target price to IDR 1,350 per share, citing Q3‑25 revenue of IDR 68.6 billion (+190.5% YoY), net profit of IDR 19.4 billion (+818.9% YoY), higher margins and a planned IDR 4.2 trillion expansion funding.

title: Lim Shrimp Org Pte Ltd readies Rp64.11bn budget for mandatory tender offer of Sumber Mas Konstruksi shares
body: Lim Shrimp Org Pte Ltd announced a Rp64.11 billion budget to fund a mandatory tender offer of up to 689.42 million Sumber Mas Konstruksi (SMKM) shares at Rp93 per share, with the offer running from 10 December 2025 to 9 January 2026 under IDX crossing rules. The company, which previously acquired 313.25 million SMKM shares on 27 October 2025 for Rp11.59 billion, said it has sufficient funds and the market reacted positively, lifting SMKM’s share price 9.4% to Rp128.

title: Sampoerna Agro (SGRO) to retire Rp205.2 bn of maturing debt with internal cash by March 2026
body: Sampoerna Agro (SGRO) has Rp205.2 bn of bonds and sukuk maturing on 17 March 2026, which it intends to settle using its internal cash balance of Rp888.5 bn. At the end of September 2025 the company reported accumulated equity of Rp6.43 trillion and total assets of Rp10.63 trillion.

title: KMI Cioud Indonesia acquires a 5.04% stake in Mustika Ratu (MRAT) through a transaction valued at roughly Rp10.56 billion
body: On December 5, 2025, KMI Cioud Indonesia purchased 21.55 million shares of Mustika Ratu, bringing its ownership above five percent, with the deal facilitated by Semesta Indovvest Sekuritas, Mandiri Sekuritas, and NH Korindo Sekuritas Indonesia. Using the closing price of Rp490 per share, the transaction is estimated at about Rp10.56 billion, while the stock has risen 17.58% to Rp515 over the past five trading days.

title: Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo to Acquire 20% Stake in Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN)
body: Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo will gradually acquire a 20% stake in Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN), with the initial 5% signed on December 2, 2025. This investment will not alter the company's controlling structure, which remains with Kunci Daud Indonesia (KDI) and Intan Investama Internasional (III), nor will it merge Perintis Triniti Properti into the same group as Solusi Sinergi Digital alias WIFI.

title: PT Morris Capital Indonesia Becomes Controlling Shareholder of PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk, Planning Strategic Diversification.
body: PT Morris Capital Indonesia (MCI) has become the controlling shareholder of PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk (PIPA) by acquiring 49.92% of its shares, a move management sees as crucial for strengthening performance and expanding business. Following solid operational performance with revenue up 30.5% to Rp 25.89 billion by September 2025, PIPA plans to diversify into Oil & Gas and polyethylene products with MCI's strategic support, while MCI also intends to conduct a Mandatory Tender Offer for public shares.

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk. (BTN) Reaffirms idAAA Rating from PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (PEFINDO)
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk.
