(BTN) has again received the highest rating of idAAA with a stable outlook from PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (PEFINDO), which also assigned idAAA for its planned Social Sustainable Bonds I (up to Rp10 trillion) and idAA for Subordinated Bonds I (up to Rp5 trillion). This affirmation is primarily driven by strong government support for BTN's role in subsidized housing loans, despite noted limiting factors such as below-average asset quality and moderate profitability.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Divests Shares in PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk. (MEDS), Company Stock Falls.
body: Jemmy Kurniawan, President Commissioner of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk. (MEDS), sold 4,770,000 shares at Rp96–Rp98 per share on December 5, 2025, for a total of Rp457 million – Rp467 million for divestment purposes. Following this transaction, his ownership decreased, and MEDS shares subsequently fell 9.18% to Rp88 on December 9.

title: PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk. (IPCC) Sets Interim Cash Dividend for Fiscal Year 2025
body: PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk. (IPCC) has declared an interim cash dividend of Rp47.57 billion, or Rp26,1629 per share, for the 2025 fiscal year, supported by a net profit of Rp190.29 billion as of September 30, 2025. The dividend payment is scheduled for January 7, 2026, with the cum dividend date for regular and negotiation markets on December 16, 2025, offering an approximate yield of 1.9%.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk Sets IPO Price at Rp635 Per Share, Aiming for Rp2.79 Trillion Amidst Improved Financial Performance
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) is scheduled to list on December 17, 2025, after setting its IPO price at Rp635 per share to raise Rp2.79 trillion from 4.4 billion shares. The bank, owned by Grup Emtek and supported by investments from Grab, Singtel, and KakaoBank, achieved a net profit of Rp20.5 billion by June 30, 2025, a significant turnaround from prior losses, driven by a 32.2% increase in credit distribution to Rp8.2 trillion and a 170.7% rise in net interest income to Rp665.3 billion.

title: PT Link Net Tbk. (LINK) Clarifies Stock Volatility and Addresses Free Float Requirement
body: PT Link Net Tbk. (LINK) responded to BEI's request for clarification, stating there is no material information affecting its stock volatility or public investment decisions. The company is also considering transferring treasury shares to meet BEI's minimum free float requirement, as its current public share portion is only 6.22%.

title: PT Djasa Ubersakti Tbk Plans Private Placement to Address Financial Strain
body: PT Djasa Ubersakti Tbk (PTDU) plans a private placement of up to 3.75 billion Series B shares, equivalent to 71.43% of post-action paid-up capital, to address its critical financial condition, including negative net working capital of Rp65.81 billion and a debt-to-asset ratio of 106.35% as of September 30, 2025. The funds will be used to reduce obligations and strengthen working capital, aiming to improve the company's liquidity and financial flexibility.

title: Bank Mandiri's Livin’ Digital Platform Drives Significant Growth in Users, Transactions, and Digital Income
body: Bank Mandiri is enhancing its digital retail services via Livin’ by Mandiri, which by September 2025 recorded over 35 million users, a 25% year-on-year transaction frequency growth, and Rp3,220 trillion in transaction value. The platform's digital services also contributed Rp5.48 trillion in fee-based income, marking a 13.3% year-on-year increase and strengthening its position in the digital economy.

title: PT Batavia Prosperindo Internasional Tbk sells shares of PT Malacca Trust Wuwungan Insurance
body: PT Batavia Prosperindo Internasional Tbk, an insider, sold 28,163,200 shares of PT Malacca Trust Wuwungan Insurance, reducing its ownership from 2,540,260,813 to 2,512,097,613 shares, as part of a portfolio reduction strategy in the financials sector, specifically holding-investment-companies sub-sector

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) secures $350 million revolving credit facility and advances ADR plant commissioning ahead of first gold pour in early 2026
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and its subsidiaries PT Pani Bersama Tambang, PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera and PT Gorontalo Sejahtera Mining completed a USD 350 million revolving credit facility on 4 December 2025 to fund the final construction and commissioning of the Pani Gold Mine, with the Adsorption, Desorption & Recovery (ADR) plant on schedule for completion by end‑December and the first gold pour expected in early 2026. The facility complements the IDR 4.9 trillion (USD 280 million) raised in EMAS’s September 2025 IPO and supports capital expenditures of USD 208.7 million as of 30 September 2025, positioning the mine for a projected peak output of about 500,000 ounces of gold per year.

title: Indonesia's IHSG closes higher at 8,700.92 and is expected to trade within 8,625‑8,750 on Thursday
body: The composite index rose 0.51% to 8,700.92 on 10 December 2025, and analysts cite positive MACD histogram and MA5 support as reasons to anticipate a range of 8,625‑8,750 with resistance at 8,750 for the next session. Phintraco Sekuritas also recommended the stocks ARTO, PTPP, SMDR, ASSA and MBMA.

title: Jaya Real Property (JRPT) Injects Rp43.75 Billion into Sarana Pembangunan Jaya (SPJ) to Enhance Investment Performance
body: Jaya Real Property (JRPT) completed a Rp43.75 billion capital injection into its associate, Sarana Pembangunan Jaya (SPJ), on December 8, 2025, by acquiring 3,600 newly issued shares. This affiliated transaction aims to enhance JRPT's investment performance and increase potential dividends by enabling SPJ to maximize capital for land leasing for educational facilities.

title: PT Arkora Bakti Indonesia Divests PT Arkora Hydro Tbk (ARKO) Shares Following Significant Price Surge and BEI Suspension
body: PT Arkora Bakti Indonesia, the controlling shareholder of PT Arkora Hydro Tbk (ARKO), divested 5.64% of its ownership for IDR 169.25 billion following a 466.27% stock price surge over six months. This action reduced its stake from 47.52% to 41.88% and occurred as PT Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily suspended ARKO's trading from November 28, 2025, due to the significant cumulative price increase.

title: PT APP Purinusa Ekapersada Increases Stake in PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk for Rp349.99 Billion
body: PT APP Purinusa Ekapersada (APE), the controlling shareholder of PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk (INKP), acquired an additional 46.66 million INKP shares for Rp349.99 billion on December 8, 2025, raising its ownership from 57.46% to 58.31%. This move aims to boost investment and maintain its controlling position, despite INKP's shares weakening 4.27% to Rp7,850 on December 10.

title: Airwallex acquires majority stake in PT Skye Sab Indonesia to enable Indonesian merchants' overseas expansion
body: Airwallex has taken majority ownership of PT Skye Sab Indonesia, a Category 1 PJP license holder authorized by Indonesia’s central bank to provide payment and remittance services. The deal gives Indonesian merchants access to Airwallex’s global financial infrastructure and expands the fintech’s footprint across Asia‑Pacific markets including Australia, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, South Korea, Singapore and Vietnam.

title: S&P Global Ratings gives stable outlook to three of Indonesia’s big four banks as credit risks ease
body: S&P Global Ratings gave a stable outlook to Bank Mandiri, Bank Rakyat Indonesia and Bank Negara Indonesia, noting substantial improvements in weak loans and a drop in the loans‑at‑risk ratio to 9.7% from a 2020 peak of 23.4%. The agency cautioned about lingering vulnerabilities in sectors such as textiles, consumer loans and micro‑finance, and highlighted Indonesia’s 5% growth forecast over the next 2‑3 years.

title: Indonesia's housing ministry to boost affordable housing by integrating MSMEs into the supply chain
body: Housing and Settlement Areas Minister Maruarar Sirait and MSME Minister Maman Abdurrahman agreed to map regional MSMEs and expand the KUR Perumahan credit scheme to increase small firms' participation in public and subsidized housing projects, aiming to raise construction standards and affordability. The partnership seeks to create a competitive MSME ecosystem that strengthens Indonesia's national housing supply chain.

title: Indonesia denies rumors of stalled US tariff talks, says negotiations are ongoing
body: Spokesperson Haryo Limanseto confirmed that Indonesia's tariff negotiations with the United States are proceeding normally, despite reports of possible cancellation. Indonesia is seeking zero‑percent tariffs on commodities such as crude palm oil, rubber, tea and coffee, while pledging up to US$15 billion in energy imports, US$4.5 billion in agricultural imports, and a US$10 billion investment package that includes a blue‑ammonia facility.

title: Indonesia plans to clear 100,000 hectares for a Papua rice program with a Rp3 trillion investment
body: The government will start by clearing 20,000 hectares and supplying equipment to enable planting, aiming to boost food self‑sufficiency in Papua. An initial Rp3 trillion (about US$180 million) has been allocated, and rice reserves have risen to 3.7 million tons, allowing a halt to imports.

title: Indonesia aims for self-sufficiency in sugar, eggs and chicken meat by 2026 after targeting rice and corn by end‑2025
body: Deputy Minister Sudaryono announced that, following the expected declaration of rice and corn self‑sufficiency on Dec 31 2025, the government will prioritize achieving self‑sufficiency in sugar, eggs and chicken meat in 2026. The plan includes expanding egg and chicken farming in 13 provinces outside Java with state‑owned enterprises, Red and White Village Cooperatives and local farmers, while also promoting downstream processing of 11 horticultural and plantation commodities for export.

title: Granite Asia's Libra Hybrid strategy targets $500 million in commitments with sovereign wealth fund investors
body: The Libra Hybrid private‑credit strategy aims to raise $500 million, drawing capital from investors such as Temasek (via Aranda Principal Strategies), Malaysia's sovereign investor Khazanah and Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund INA, with about 30% already deployed across six transactions. Asia's private‑credit market is projected to grow 46% to $92 billion by 2027, fueling demand from companies reshaping supply chains and expanding into new markets.

title: Bakrie group stocks surge on optimism, analysts set short‑term targets but warn of high volatility
body: Shares of Bakrie group companies BUMI, BRMS, ENRG and DEWA rallied sharply in December 2025 on strong earnings expectations, commodity price support and improved governance sentiment, prompting analysts to issue short‑term buy recommendations with price targets of Rp 400, Rp 1,040, Rp 1,600 and Rp 600 respectively. However, analysts caution that the stocks are highly volatile, vulnerable to profit‑taking, commodity swings and corporate actions, making them suitable only for aggressive investors.

title: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk (GEMS) Facilitates Rp 900 Billion Term Loan for Indirect Subsidiary PT Borneo Indobara
body: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk (GEMS) disclosed that PT Borneo Indobara (BIB), together with Bank Mandiri, signed a term‑loan agreement on 10 December 2025 for a facility of up to Rp 900 billion with a 5‑ to 7‑year maturity. The loan, secured by assets, is intended to bridge cash‑flow gaps for business expansion and to strengthen GEMS’s operational and financial position.

title: Waskita Karya (WSKT) Accelerates Probowangi Toll Road Package 3 Construction, Nearing Completion and Set for Free Nataru Use.
body: Waskita Karya (WSKT) has achieved 90.66% completion for the 5.8 km Probolinggo-Banyuwangi (Probowangi) Toll Road Package 3, with plans for free public use during the upcoming Natal and New Year holidays to ease traffic. This strategic infrastructure project, featuring a 450m giant bridge, is expected to boost regional economy and tourism by improving connectivity and significantly reducing travel times.

title: Elang Mahkota (EMTK) to Conduct Private Placement Coinciding with Superbank (SUPA) IPO on December 17, 2025
body: Elang Mahkota alias Emtek (EMTK) plans a Rp38.06 billion private placement via its Management and Employee Stock Option Program (MESOP) on December 17, 2025, releasing 34,700,000 new shares at Rp1,097 per share. This action coincides with Superbank (SUPA)'s initial public offering (IPO) on the same date, aiming to raise a maximum of Rp2.79 trillion from 4.4 billion shares at Rp635, with funds allocated primarily for credit and capital expenditure.

title: SUPA IPO’s low valuation pressures Indonesian digital bank stocks, with mixed performance across peers
body: The IPO of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) began on 10 December 2025 at a PBV of about 2.64, the cheapest among listed digital banks, prompting a pullback in most digital‑bank shares on the IDX; PT Bank Jago Tbk (ARTO) rose 1.46% while PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk (BBYB) surged 6.48%, whereas PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk (BBHI) and PT Krom Bank Indonesia Tbk (BBSI) fell. Analysts note the cheap SUPA valuation could trigger a sector re‑rating, but still consider ARTO, PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk (AGRO) and BBHI fundamentally attractive.

title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk launches 9,000 DWT chemical tanker Novah for domestic and international routes
body: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk, through its logistics subsidiary PT Chandra Shipping International, announced the launch of a new 9,000 DWT liquid chemical tanker named Novah, slated to begin operations in March 2026. The vessel was built in partnership with Japan’s Usuki Shipyard and will enhance CDIA’s logistics capacity for its chemical production assets, including the Chlor‑Alkali and EDC plants.

title: Arsari Group joins PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk as shareholder amid sharp COIN stock movements
body: PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk (COIN) shares, after a 2,929.63% surge since their July 9, 2025 listing, closed at 4,090 on Dec 10, 2025, down 11.28%, following the entry of Arsari Group—owned by Hashim Djojohadikusumo—through PT Arsari Nusa Investama as a shareholder. The investment, explained by Aryo P.S. Djojohadikusumo, is framed as supporting Indonesia’s digital‑asset ecosystem and its rank as the world’s seventh‑largest crypto market.

title: PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk Lists Rp500 Billion Sustainability-Linked Bonds on BEI with CGIF Guarantee
body: PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk (POLI) officially listed its Rp500 billion Sustainability-Linked Bonds I Year 2025 on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, fully guaranteed by Credit Guarantee and Investment Facility (CGIF), a trust fund under Asian Development Bank (ADB). The proceeds will be used for refinancing and working capital, with POLI setting KPIs for energy efficiency, emission reduction, and water recovery, including a target to install 40 kWp solar cells to cut emissions by approximately 184,320 kgCO?e by 2029.

title: Golden Mines (GEMS) Secures Rp900 Billion Term Loan from Bank Mandiri (BMRI) for Business Development.
body: Golden Mines (GEMS) secured a Rp900 billion term loan from Bank Mandiri (BMRI) on December 10, 2025, to fulfill cashflow gaps for business development, general company, and group needs, particularly for its subsidiary Borneo Indobara. This 5 to 7-year facility, guaranteed by assets, is expected to support operational growth and strengthen the company's financial condition.

title: Astra International (ASII) Reports Declining Car Sales Through November 2025 Amid Weakening National Automotive Market
body: Astra International (ASII) recorded a 16.41% year-on-year decline in car sales to 368,426 units for January-November 2025, with November sales also falling 8.54% YoY, despite its LCGC market share increasing to 81%. Amidst a weakening national automotive industry characterized by declining purchasing power and increased competition, Astra is focusing on relevant vehicle offerings and new launches, hoping for market improvement next year.

title: PT Arsari Nusa Investama Invests in PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk, Boosting Confidence in Indonesia's Digital Asset Sector
body: PT Arsari Nusa Investama, part of Arsari Group, has officially become a shareholder in PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk (COIN), signaling strong institutional confidence in Indonesia's digital asset industry and supporting the nation's digital transformation. This strategic investment aims to strengthen COIN's governance and public trust, leveraging Indonesia's significant crypto market which recorded over 18 million users and Rp409.56 trillion in transactions by October 2025, and ranks 7th globally according to Chainalysis.

title: Chandra Daya Investasi (CDIA) Launches New Logistics Vessel Novah
body: Chandra Daya Investasi (CDIA), through its subsidiary Chandra Shipping International (CSI), launched Novah, a new 9,000 DWT liquid chemical logistics vessel, set to operate domestically and internationally starting March 2026. This addition strengthens CDI Group's integrated industrial infrastructure, supports Chandra Asri Group's downstream chemical industry agenda, and expands CSI's fleet to thirteen vessels, enhancing supply chain connectivity.

title: Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) Plans Private Placement and Management Reshuffle for Capital Strengthening and Expansion.
body: Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) is preparing for a private placement, issuing up to 394.8 million new shares, and a management reshuffle, to be decided at an EGM on December 12, 2025, aiming to strengthen capital and attract large strategic investors. These moves are part of a broader consolidation within Bong Chandra's business ecosystem, following strategic appointments at Perintis Properti (TRIN) and Triniti Dinamik (TRUE), to facilitate significant portfolio expansion.

title: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN) Promotes Green Financing Initiatives and Establishes Partnership with Universitas Udayana (Unud)
body: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN) is actively promoting green financing to foster a sustainable economy and environmental preservation, highlighting the urgency due to global climate change risks. BBTN implements various green initiatives, including financing low-emission homes and renewable energy projects, and has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Universitas Udayana (Unud) for banking services and academic collaboration.

title: Hashim Djojohadikusumo's Arsari Group Invests in PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk. (COIN) to Strengthen Digital Asset Ecosystem
body: Hashim Djojohadikusumo, through PT Arsari Nusa Investama (Arsari Group), has become a shareholder in PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk. (COIN), signaling institutional confidence in Indonesia's digital asset industry and supporting national digital transformation. This investment aims to strengthen COIN's governance and public trust, capitalizing on Indonesia's strategic position with over 18 million crypto users and Rp409.56 trillion in transactions by October 2025.

title: PT Mitra Investindo Tbk (MITI) Outlines Silica Business Expansion and Downstreaming Strategy, Bolstered by Profit Growth and Capital Raise.
body: PT Mitra Investindo Tbk (MITI) detailed its strategy to prioritize silica business expansion and downstreaming, supported by an 18.8% increase in EBITDA and 28% net profit growth to Rp10.96 billion by September 2025. The company is accelerating silica development through subsidiaries like PT Kendawangan Berkah Kersik and establishing PT Ketapang Prima Resources for an integrated industrial estate, with a recent Rp60 billion private placement fully allocated to these silica projects.

title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) Exits Special Monitoring Board Following Significant Stock Price Surge
body: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) has been removed from the Special Monitoring Board (FCA) and transferred to the Development Board, effective December 11, 2025, after no longer meeting the criteria for FCA Category 10. This move follows a remarkable stock performance, with TRIN's price soaring 91.55% in the last week, 240% in the last month, and 1,411.11% in the last quarter.

title: PT Bahtera Bintang Nusantara Divests All Shares in KETR as KETR Attracts Investors and Completes Key Project
body: PT Bahtera Bintang Nusantara sold its entire 64,425,000 shares in PT Ketrosden Triasmita Tbk (KETR) for an estimated Rp38.9 billion between December 3-8, 2025, resulting in 0% ownership. Despite this divestment, KETR's shares surged, and the company revealed interest from potential investors while also completing a vessel conversion for the Jakarta–Batam subsea cable project.

title: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk Enhances Business Liquidity with Digital Kredit Agunan Deposito via Kopra by Mandiri
body: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk is strengthening its support for productive sectors by offering digital Kredit Agunan Deposito (KAD) through Kopra by Mandiri, enabling businesses to secure loans against active deposits without liquidation for faster and more efficient financing. This initiative, part of Bank Mandiri's digital transformation, has seen Kopra by Mandiri manage over Rp22,000 trillion in transactions, growing 22% year on year, with a volume of 1.2 billion transactions, up 14% year on year, until October 2025.

title: Arsari Group, via PT Arsari Nusa Investama, Becomes Shareholder in PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk. (COIN)
body: Arsari Group, through its entity PT Arsari Nusa Investama, has officially acquired a stake in PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk. (COIN), reflecting growing institutional interest in Indonesia's digital asset sector. While the transaction's value and specific details remain undisclosed, Arsari Group expressed strong optimism for COIN's potential to develop the national digital asset industry, aligning with its vision alongside PT Central Finansial X (CFX) and PT Kustodian Koin Indonesia (ICC).

title: Indonesia’s Trade Minister launches 2025‑2045 Spice Downstream Roadmap to shift from comparative to competitive advantage
body: Trade Minister Budi Santoso unveiled the 2025–2045 Spice Downstream Roadmap, targeting nutmeg, pepper, clove, cinnamon, vanilla and temulawak to add value and improve global competitiveness. He highlighted downstream initiatives such as export‑facilitating trade agreements, village export programs, and the Rasa Rempah Indonesia culinary promotion to boost spice exports.

title: MNC Tourism Indonesia (KPIG) to Conduct Rp250 Billion Private Placement for KEK MNC Lido City Development
body: MNC Tourism Indonesia (KPIG) plans a private placement of Rp250 billion through the issuance of 1.78 billion new shares at Rp140 per share, approved on June 30, 2025, with execution scheduled for December 18, 2025. The proceeds will be allocated to finance the development and construction of projects within KEK MNC Lido City, including the Trump Golf Clubhouse & Country Club, Hyatt Regency Lido Resort, and a world-class Theme Park, aiming to strengthen the company's capital structure and improve performance.

title: Indah Kiat (INKP) Reports 44% Net Profit Surge to USD325.92 Million Despite Sales Decline by September 30, 2025
body: Indah Kiat (INKP) achieved a net profit of USD325.92 million by September 30, 2025, a 44% increase from the previous year, with earnings per share rising to USD0,05957. This growth occurred despite a 2.47% decrease in net sales to USD2.36 billion and reductions in gross and operating profits, largely bolstered by a significant USD93.81 million gain from foreign exchange differences.

title: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Faces Financial Decline and Corruption Case Ahead of Strategic RUPSLB
body: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) is holding an RUPSLB to approve the separation of its Wholesale Fiber Connectivity business, amidst a 10.7% consolidated net profit decline to Rp 15.78 trillion in Q3 2025 and an ongoing Rp 464.9 billion alleged corruption case. While Telkomsel's net profit rose 11.5% QoQ, the company also reported increased depreciation and amortization, plus an unrealized loss of Rp 380 billion from Telkomsel's investment in PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk.

title: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk Confirms Normal Operations Despite Sumatra Floods and Landslides
body: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC) reported to the Indonesia Stock Exchange that its oil, gas, and geothermal operations in Aceh, North Sumatra, and West Sumatra remain normal despite recent floods and landslides, with no material disruption to production or distribution. Corporate Secretary Siendy K Wisandana confirmed all main facilities are safe, no material financial losses are anticipated, and Medco Energi along with Medco Foundation has provided humanitarian aid to the affected regions.

title: Two Directors of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) Increase Share Ownership for Investment
body: Raymond and Baritono Prajogo Pangestu, directors of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA), collectively increased their shareholdings in the company by approximately Rp1.7 billion on December 4-5, 2025. Baritono purchased 26,000 shares at Rp7,650, while Raymond acquired 200,000 shares at an average of Rp7,625–Rp7,675, with both transactions aimed at direct investment.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk and APSAI Host PLA 2025 Award Ceremony and Child Rights Panel in Jakarta
body: PT United Tractors Tbk, together with Asosiasi Perusahaan Sahabat Anak Indonesia (APSAI), held a panel discussion and presented the 2025 Child-Friendly Company Award (PLA) in Jakarta, attended by the Minister of Women’s Empowerment and Child Protection. UT highlighted its progression from Madya to Utama status in the PLA assessment and outlined child‑rights initiatives such as lactation rooms, family‑friendly policies, education and nutrition programs.

title: Indonesia aims to leverage IEU-CEPA zero‑tariff provisions to boost marine product exports to Europe
body: Acting Director General Machmud said Indonesia has already secured $13.65 million in seaweed‑derived product contracts for Europe, exceeding the $8 million target, and plans a buyer‑visit promotion in May‑June 2026 after the Barcelona expo. Trade Minister Budi Santoso expects the Indonesia‑EU Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement to be signed in January 2026, with legal drafting and translation underway.

title: Indonesia accelerates OECD accession, focusing on environment, trade and digital economy
body: Indonesia is speeding up its accession to the Organisation for Economic Co‑operation and Development (OECD), with Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto reporting that the updated technical review now prioritises the environment, trade and the digital economy, and that a new INA OECD digital platform will coordinate inter‑ministerial work. The move, mandated by the 2025‑2029 National Medium‑Term Development Plan and Presidential Decree No. 30 of 2025, is intended to strengthen national resilience amid global uncertainty.

title: Danantara Investment Management signs MoU with Jordan Investment Fund to explore joint strategic investments
body: Danantara Investment Management (DIM) and Jordan Investment Fund (JIF) signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Amman to collaborate on strategic projects in sectors such as infrastructure, energy transition, digital and technology, with both sovereign wealth funds planning to share expertise and pursue co‑investments. The agreement was witnessed by Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani, CIO Pandu Sjahrir, and Jordan’s Minister of Investment Tareq Abu Ghazaleh, who highlighted alignment with King Abdullah II’s directives.

title: Indonesia's Environment Ministry temporarily seals West Sumatra mining sites amid flood-related erosion concerns
body: The Ministry of Environment (KLH) ordered the temporary closure and installation of monitoring boards at several West Sumatra mines after field checks revealed unreclaimed pits, inadequate runoff control and potential landslide risks that may be worsening flooding and mudflows. The seal will be lifted once companies demonstrate compliance with environmental permits, remediation plans, and erosion‑control measures, with further sanctions possible for violations.

title: Indonesia and Pakistan to upgrade their preferential trade pact to a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement by 2027
body: President Prabowo Subianto and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif agreed to form a Joint Negotiation Committee to convert the Indonesia‑Pakistan Preferential Trade Agreement into a CEPA by 2027, aiming for deeper concessions, removal of non‑tariff barriers and expanded cooperation in trade, services, fintech, defense and investment. The leaders also pledged collaboration on halal food, Islamic finance, and joint efforts to combat terrorism and illicit drug trafficking.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sells 825 million Impack Pratama Industri shares, reducing its stake to 38.6%
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sold a total of 825 million Impack Pratama Industri shares over Dec 10‑11, 2025 at Rp2,500‑Rp3,000 per share, raising about Rp2.28 trillion and cutting its holding to 21.19 billion shares (38.63%). The transaction dilutes the pre‑sale stake by 1.5 percentage points and increases the company's free float.

title: Indonesian telecom operators forecast significant data traffic spikes during Nataru holidays, with Telkomsel projecting 17.9% growth and XLSmart expecting 20‑30% rise
body: PT Telekomunikasi Selular alias Telkomsel expects a 17.9% increase in data traffic and a 13.2% rise in SMS volume during Nataru 2025, while PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL) forecasts a 20‑30% traffic surge for Nataru 2026 and is expanding 4G/5G coverage to over 5,000 5G BTS sites supported by AI Autonomous Network; analysts say average revenue per user will grow only modestly as price competition persists, with Kiwoom Sekuritas noting PT Indosat Tbk (ISAT)'s stronger upselling and Indo Premier Sekuritas giving the telecom sector an overweight rating, preferring EXCL, ISAT and TLKM.

title: Indonesia's IHSG falls 0.92% but analysts diverge on Friday's outlook amid technical signals and geopolitical risks
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed down 0.92% at 8,620.48 points on Thursday, with MNC Sekuritas' Herditya Wicaksana expecting a rebound to support 8,591‑8,669, while Phintraco Sekuritas' Alrich Paskalis warned of a continued decline toward 8,550‑8,600 due to a MACD death cross and ASEAN border tensions. He recommended stocks BBKP, NICL, WIFI, and also SMGR, INTP, RATU, PYFA, PTRO for Friday trading.

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk shares slump 22% in H2 2025 amid profit decline but analysts maintain bullish outlook
body: By December 11, 2025 the stock of PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO) fell to IDR 1,160, a 0.85% drop on the day and a 22.41% decline over the past six months, while Q3 2025 net profit fell 22.18% YoY to US$104.26 million despite a 4.20% revenue increase; analysts from BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, Maybank Sekuritas and OCBC Sekuritas still recommend a Buy rating with price targets ranging from IDR 1,250 to IDR 1,750, citing upcoming geothermal projects, long‑term PLN contracts and planned green‑bond financing.

title: Asosiasi Emiten Indonesia (AEI) Holds 37th Anniversary to Strengthen Capital Market Collaboration
body: Asosiasi Emiten Indonesia (AEI) is celebrating its 37th anniversary at the Main Hall Bursa Efek Indonesia on Friday (12/12) with the theme 'Transforming Together for a Stronger Tomorrow'. Supported by Emitennews.com, the event aims to strengthen collaboration and transformation of the Indonesian capital market, featuring speakers from regulators (including OJK), academics, and industry players such as PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and PT Infovesta Utama.

title: Ancara Logistics (ALII) Provides Rp10 Billion Capital Injection to Subsidiary Ancara Transshipment Services (ATS)
body: Ancara Logistics (ALII) has injected Rp10 billion in interest-free capital into its subsidiary, Ancara Transshipment Services (ATS), with the loan transaction patented on December 9, 2025, for a five-year term. These funds are designated for ATS's strategic needs, including capital expenditure for capacity enhancement, long-term business development, and providing essential working capital for operational continuity.

title: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua (PANI) Plans Rp15.73 Trillion Right Issue to Fund Strategic Acquisitions and Subsidiary Capital Injections.
body: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua (PANI) will conduct a Rp15.73 trillion right issue, offering 1.21 billion new shares at Rp12,975 per share, with its main shareholder Multi Artha Pratama (MAP) committing to subscribe for a significant portion and standby buyers BCA Sekuritas and Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia ready to absorb remaining shares. The funds will primarily be used for a Rp15.12 trillion acquisition of shares in Bangun Kosambi Sukses (CBDK) from Agung Sedayu and Tunas Mekar Jaya, with the remainder allocated for capital injections into subsidiaries Cahaya Inti Sentosa (CISN), Karunia Utama Selaras (KUS), and Panorama Eka Tunggal (PET).

title: Bumi Serpong Damai (BSDE) to Issue Rp1.75 Trillion in Bonds and Sukuk Ijarah for Debt Repayment and Working Capital
body: Bumi Serpong Damai (BSDE) plans to issue Rp1.75 trillion in debt, comprising Rp1.25 trillion in conventional bonds across four series and Rp500 billion in Sukuk Ijarah across two series, with varying interest/return rates and maturities up to 10 years. The bond proceeds will primarily repay term loans from Bank Tabungan Negara and Bank Permata, while the Sukuk Ijarah funds will be allocated for the company's working capital.

title: Sumber Garam Pratama Sells Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) Shares to Realize Profit
body: Sumber Garam Pratama divested 16.66 million shares of Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) on December 8, 2025, for Rp300 per share, raising Rp4.99 billion. This transaction, which reduced its stake to 26.14% from 26.56%, was undertaken to realize profit.

title: Jinlong Resources Investment Signs Conditional Agreement to Acquire Majority Stake in Hotel Fitra International (FITT)
body: Jinlong Resources Investment has signed a conditional share purchase agreement to acquire 48.07% of Hotel Fitra International (FITT) from Gloria Inti Nusantara, Hendra Sutanto, and Richard Suwandi Lie, with plans to increase its total ownership to 79.16%. Following this development, Hotel Fitra shares rose 5.22% to Rp705 on December 11, 2025.

title: Karya Pacific Investama Increases Stake in MNC Energy
body: Karya Pacific Investama acquired 1.25 billion shares of MNC Energy (IATA) for Rp125.93 billion at Rp100 per share, with the transaction confirmed on December 8, 2025. This purchase increased Karya Pacific Investama's direct ownership to 15.25 billion shares, or 48.79%, a 4.03% rise from its previous 44.76%, for investment purposes.

title: PT Puri Sentul Permai Tbk (KDTN) Inaugurates Sixth Swiss-Belexpress Hotel at Rest Area KM 379A to Enhance Toll Road User Comfort and Safety.
body: PT Puri Sentul Permai Tbk (KDTN) has inaugurated its sixth Swiss-Belexpress Hotel at Rest Area KM 379A on the Batang–Semarang Toll Road, implementing a Hospitality & Wellness concept to support safe and comfortable travel, especially during peak holiday periods. This new facility, which includes a Nursery Room and Healthy Corner, aims to provide an integrated resting experience for toll road users and contribute to local economic growth.

title: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) Enhances Digital Financing Access with New KAD Feature on Kopra by Mandiri
body: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) has introduced a digital Kredit Agunan Deposito (KAD) feature via its Kopra by Mandiri platform, offering faster, safer, and more efficient financing for institutional and UKM (SME) customers by allowing them to collateralize active deposits without cashing them out. This digital innovation, central to Bank Mandiri's commitment to strengthening the people's economy, contributes to Kopra by Mandiri's transaction value exceeding Rp22 thousand trillion, a 22% year-on-year increase until October 2025.

title: Khairuddin Simatupang Resigns as President Director of PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk.
body: Khairuddin Simatupang has officially resigned as President Director of PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk. (PGUN), with the company receiving his resignation letter on December 11, 2025. PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk. will hold a General Meeting of Shareholders within 90 calendar days to fill the vacancy, ensuring no impact on the company's operations, legal aspects, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: PT Sillomaritime Perdana Tbk Acquires VLGC to Support International Shipping Expansion
body: PT Sillomaritime Perdana Tbk (SHIP) is expanding its business into international shipping, marked by a new charter contract and the planned acquisition of a Very Large Gas Carrier (VLGC). Through its subsidiary PT Cassa Mega Lautan (CML), SHIP will purchase the VLGC from New Gas Taurus Limited for USD80,500,000, with the investment expected to contribute approximately 5% to 2026's projected revenue.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. Utilizes BRIsat to Strengthen Digital Foundation and Expand Financial Inclusion Across Indonesia.
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. leverages its BRIsat satellite, launched in 2016, to establish a robust digital foundation, extending national financial access to remote areas and fostering digital economic equality across Indonesia, ASEAN, and parts of Asia. This strategic infrastructure enhances operational resilience, accelerates services, and optimizes digital channels like AgenBRILink, reinforcing the company's long-term commitment to inclusive and sustainable financial services.

title: Bank CIMB Niaga Supports Journalism Competence While Announcing Solid 9M 2025 Financial Results
body: Bank CIMB Niaga (BNGA) consistently supports Indonesian journalists' competence through its "CIMB Niaga Jurnalisme Inspiratif: Journalist Class & Workshop" and awards, aligning with its "Advancing Customers & Society" purpose. For the first nine months of 2025, CIMB Niaga reported an unaudited consolidated pre-tax profit of Rp6.7 trillion, up 1.7% Y-o-Y, with total assets reaching Rp369.5 trillion and 24% of its financing dedicated to sustainability.

title: Indonesia sets maximum administrative mining fines, with nickel violations reaching Rp6.5 billion per hectare
body: The highest administrative penalty is Rp6.5 billion per hectare for nickel mining violations. Bauxite, tin and coal fines are set at Rp1.7 billion, Rp1.2 billion and Rp354 million per hectare respectively.

title: CGSI urges Indonesian banks to prioritize caution on auto loans amid rising NPLs, while S&P notes reduced overall credit risk but lingering consumer loan stress
body: A CGSI December 2025 report highlighted that Indonesian banks' non‑performing loans have risen since May 2023, driven by mortgages and vehicle loans, and advised greater caution on auto loans than mortgages due to expected car‑price declines. S&P Global Ratings later said credit risks for the country’s big four banks have eased thanks to a strong post‑pandemic recovery, though it flagged continued stress in consumer‑loan and micro‑finance segments.

title: Indonesia aims to double trade with the Eurasian Economic Union after FTA ratification
body: Indonesia's trade minister said the Indonesia‑EAEU Free Trade Agreement, expected to be signed at the EAEU summit in St Petersburg on Dec 20‑21, could double bilateral trade, with Indonesian goods receiving 0% tariffs in Russia, Kazakhstan, Armenia, Belarus and Kyrgyzstan. In 2024 total trade was $4.1 billion, with exports rising 36% to $1.5 billion and imports falling 4% to $2.4 billion.

title: Indonesia's Coordinating Minister Highlights Infrastructure as Crucial to Expanding the Marine Economy
body: Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Regional Development Agus Harimurti Yudhoyono (AHY) said that strong, integrated infrastructure is essential for the marine and fisheries sector, which contributed 7.9% of GDP in 2024 and is targeted to reach 12.5% by 2045, while Indonesia plans to add 69.5 GW of power capacity by 2034 with 70% from renewable sources. He also cited the Kampung Nelayan Merah Putih program as a strategic initiative to upgrade ecosystems, supply chains, shipyards and financing for fishermen.

title: Indonesia's Energy Ministry to Choose Competitive Partner for SMR Nuclear Power Projects
body: Deputy Minister Yuliot Tanjung announced that Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources will assess nuclear power proposals from Russia, Canada and South Korea to select the most efficient, competitive partner for building 500 MW of small modular reactors—250 MW in Sumatra and 250 MW in Kalimantan—by 2034. The selection will consider investment size, output and efficiency, with the aim of making PLN's electricity base price more competitive.

title: PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk (AYAM) outlines 2026 strategy to expand commercial layer and breeding capacity amid government MBG program
body: The company plans to allocate about Rp130 billion in CAPEX for 2026 to develop its commercial layer business, increase breeding capacity and build a new hatchery in Kulonprogo, leveraging the expected surge in protein demand from the Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) program. Analysts from NH Korindo Sekuritas Indonesia, Sinarmas Sekuritas, Phintraco Sekuritas and Ajaib Sekuritas highlight the integrated model, joint‑venture initiatives and a current valuation of 4.9× price‑to‑sales as supportive of AYAM’s medium‑term growth outlook.

title: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk showcases AI-driven micro‑drama production and smart advertising solutions, reporting Rp200 million GMV from a TikTok short video
body: At a Dec 12, 2025 event in CGV Grand Indonesia, PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) demonstrated its Folago AI platform, which can fully generate vertical short films and enable geo‑targeted smart ads, allowing a single TikTok video to generate about Rp200 million in GMV within a week. The company said the AI system can produce 1,000‑2,000 videos daily and highlighted a partnership with Huawei Cloud Indonesia to support enterprise‑scale AI operations.

title: Indonesia Reaffirms US Oil Import Commitment Amid Ongoing Tariff Negotiations
body: Deputy Minister of Energy Yuliot Tanjung confirmed that Indonesia will honor the agreed crude oil and fuel import volumes from the United States despite rumors of a cancellation. Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto, after meeting U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, said the tariff talks are expected to finish by year‑end, with plans to import up to $15 billion in energy products, $4.5 billion in agricultural goods, and co‑develop a $10 billion blue‑ammonia facility while seeking zero‑percent tariffs on several Indonesian commodities.

title: Indonesian government accelerates repair of flood-damaged bridges and roads in Sumatra to restore aid delivery and revive the local economy
body: Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Regional Development Agus Harimurti Yudhoyono announced that the Public Works Ministry is fast-tracking reconstruction of critical bridges and roads in flood-hit Sumatra, with budget estimates already calculated. The effort aims to improve logistics for disaster relief and stimulate economic recovery, with calls for private-sector participation.

title: Indonesia aims to finalize US tariff negotiations by year‑end, targeting lower duties and increased bilateral trade
body: President Prabowo Subianto has set a deadline for his team to conclude tariff talks with the United States before the end of 2025, following a meeting between Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto and US Trade Representative Ambassador Jamieson Greer. The negotiations seek to reduce Indonesia's export duty from 32% to 19%, secure exemptions for commodities such as palm oil and rubber, and involve US‑Indonesia trade commitments worth about $29.5 billion, including $15 billion in energy imports, $4.5 billion in agricultural imports, and $10 billion in investment projects.

title: Indonesian government prepares special KUR relief package for flood‑hit borrowers in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra
body: The Indonesian government is drafting a special policy package to help about 141,000 People's Business Credit (KUR) borrowers in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra—who hold roughly Rp7.8 trillion (US$454 million) in outstanding loans, including Rp3.57 trillion in the agricultural sector—by offering restructuring, low‑interest new KUR disbursements in 2026 and possible debt write‑offs. The Financial Services Authority (OJK) has also introduced a three‑year special treatment regime for disaster‑affected debtors and will ease reporting, insurance claims and related fines for workers.

title: Autopedia Sukses Lestari expands JBA Indonesia’s Bandung branch and launches hybrid auction, boosting market reach
body: Autopedia Sukses Lestari (ASLC) inaugurated a new 8,800‑sqm JBA Indonesia branch in Bandung, featuring hybrid on‑site and online auctions and increased capacity for over 300 cars and 350 motorcycles. By Q3 2025, ASLC reported revenue of Rp713 billion (up 15% YoY) while JBA auctioned more than 92,000 units and generated Rp201.8 billion in revenue.

title: PT Kalbe Farma Tbk announces up to Rp250 billion share buyback program to boost investor confidence
body: PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF) will allocate up to Rp250 billion for a share buyback that runs from 16 December 2025 to 15 March 2026 on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, funded entirely from internal cash. The program is expected to lift pro‑forma earnings per share to Rp70.42 (from Rp70.16 in 2024) while a projected Rp2.97 billion decline in interest income is deemed immaterial.

title: PT ABM Investama Tbk and PT Cipta Kridatama Secure Rp4.2 Trillion Syndicated Financing Facility
body: PT ABM Investama Tbk (ABMM) and its subsidiary, PT Cipta Kridatama, signed a syndicated financing facility agreement on December 12, 2025, for an equivalent of Rp4.2 trillion, with an additional Rp1 trillion accordion option. This facility, representing 36.03% of ABMM's equity as of September 2025, is expected to improve the group's financial profile, lower financing costs, strengthen the balance sheet, and enhance funding capacity for future operations and expansion.

title: Director Yessie Dianty Yosetya Increases Stake in PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk. (EXCL) for Investment
body: Yessie Dianty Yosetya, a director at PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk. (EXCL), purchased an additional 150,000 EXCL shares between December 5-10, 2025, for investment, with transactions valued between Rp478 million and Rp556 million. This latest acquisition increases her direct ownership to 1.66 million shares, or 0,0092%, continuing a pattern of consistent accumulation.

title: Direktur Utama of PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk. Increases Personal Shareholding
body: Yenny Hamidah Koean, Direktur Utama of PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk. (MAHA), purchased 163,439,100 shares of MAHA for Rp26.15 billion at Rp160 per share on December 9, 2025, for personal investment. This transaction significantly increased her direct ownership in MAHA from 8,0087% to 8,9894%, totaling 1,498,172,700 shares.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) Reports Impressive Financial Growth for Nine Months Ending September 2025
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) achieved significant financial growth for the nine months ending September 30, 2025, with net revenue increasing 100.99% to Rp 1.01 trillion and net profit for the period surging 108.13% to Rp 330.18 billion. This performance, driven by aggressive expansion in the telecommunications sector, also saw total assets jump 331.32% to Rp 12.54 trillion and equity rise 749.90% to Rp 8.18 trillion.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk. (EMAS) Approves Buyback Share Transfer and Board of Commissioners Changes
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk. (EMAS) concluded its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on December 10, 2025, approving the transfer of 1,448,866,615 buyback shares, equivalent to 8.55% of its placed and fully paid capital. The RUPSLB also sanctioned changes to the Board of Commissioners, appointing Santoso Kartono as the new President Commissioner and Heri Sunaryadi as Independent Commissioner.

title: PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WSKT) Fails to Secure Bondholder Approval for Restructuring Proposal
body: PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WSKT) failed to obtain bondholder approval for its restructuring scheme proposal in a General Meeting of Bondholders (RUPO) on December 9, 2025, regarding delayed interest and principal payments for Obligasi Berkelanjutan III Waskita Karya Tahap IV Tahun 2019. Out of 1,171,250,000,000 total votes, only 35.20% agreed, while 64.80% ultimately disagreed after including abstain votes, falling short of the required 75% quorum.

title: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk. Provides Rp250 Billion Financing to PT Intiland Sejahtera for Industrial Estate Development
body: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk. (BBKP) signed a financing cooperation agreement with PT Intiland Sejahtera, a sub-holding of PT Intiland Development Tbk. (DILD), providing a total facility ceiling of up to Rp250 billion. This collaboration aims to support PT Intiland Sejahtera's operational needs and the development of its industrial estate projects, reinforcing KB Bank's commitment to the national property sector.

title: PT Bank Amar Indonesia Tbk. (AMAR) Announces Rp27.74 Billion Interim Cash Dividend for Fiscal Year 2025
body: PT Bank Amar Indonesia Tbk. (AMAR) will distribute an interim cash dividend totaling Rp27.74 billion for fiscal year 2025, with a dividend per share (DPS) of Rp1.54, yielding 0.67% based on its stock price. The company reported a net profit of Rp174.63 billion and unrestricted retained earnings of Rp167.26 billion as of September 30, 2025, with the record date for eligible shareholders set for December 24, 2025, at 4:00 PM WIB.

title: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Achieves Fortune Best Companies to Work For Southeast Asia Recognition, Highlighting AI-Native Talent and Employee-Centric Growth.
body: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (IOH) was recognized as the sole Indonesian telecommunication company in the 2025 Fortune Best Companies to Work For Southeast Asia, attributed to its human-centered digital transformation, AI-native talent development, and inclusive workplace. These efforts, including AI integration and extensive employee well-being programs, contributed to a Q3 2025 revenue growth of 3.8% and a net profit increase of 29.1%.

title: PT Metro Realty Tbk (MTSM) Plans Share Divestment to Lift Suspension and Announces Rp2-4 Billion Business Expansion.
body: PT Metro Realty Tbk (MTSM) plans to divest 27 million existing shares to non-affiliated investors to meet free float requirements and lift its stock suspension, which is currently on the Special Monitoring Board. Concurrently, MTSM will invest approximately Rp2-4 billion for business expansion, including developing commercial properties, entering the health sector with a target of Rp1 billion annual recurring income from laboratories, and establishing a trading center for gold and precious metals.

title: PT Agung Podomoro Land Tbk sells its 100% stake in Sofitel Bali Ubud manager to PT Puri Dibya Property and PT Hartons Property Development
body: PT Agung Podomoro Land Tbk (APLN) and its subsidiary PT Kencana Unggul Sukses (KUS) transferred 100% of PT Karya Pratama Propertindo, the manager of Sofitel Bali Ubud, to PT Puri Dibya Property and PT Hartons Property Development, citing a positive impact on cash position and debt reduction. The divestment follows earlier sales of an 85% stake in Central Park Mall to Hankyu Hanshin Properties Corp. via CPM Asset Japan LLC and the disposal of Hotel Pullman Ciawi Vimala Hills Resort Spa & Convention to PT Bangun Loka Indah.

title: Indonesia’s OJK highlights the lack of recent BUMN IPOs, noting the last listing was PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk in 2023
body: No state‑owned enterprises have launched an IPO in recent years, with the most recent being PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO), listed on the IDX on 24 February 2023. OJK’s capital market supervisor, Inarno Djajadi, said the regulator is running a market‑deepening program with SROs and market participants to educate and support BUMN and subsidiaries that are ready for IPOs, while emphasizing that the decision to go public remains each company’s business choice.

title: Indonesia’s Stock Exchange records Rp204.55 trillion in bond and sukuk issuances through Dec 11 2025, highlighted by PT Lontar Papyrus Pulp & Paper Industry’s latest sustainable offerings.
body: From Jan to 11 Dec 2025, 173 bond and sukuk issues by 79 issuers totalled Rp204.55 trillion, with PT Lontar Papyrus Pulp & Paper Industry issuing a Rp500 billion Sustainable Bond IV Phase I and a Rp500 billion Sustainable Mudharabah Sukuk II Phase I, each split into two series (7.00%/3‑year and 7.50%/5‑year). Overall, the BEI lists 660 bond/sukuk issuances worth Rp540.21 trillion (USD 134.01 million), 191 SBN series worth Rp6,423.84 trillion (USD 352.10 million), and 7 EBA issuances worth Rp2.13 trillion.

title: PT Merdeka Copper and Gold Tbk confirms on‑time repayment of its 2022 Sustainable Bond IV totaling IDR 3.18 trillion
body: The company announced that the principal of IDR 3.10 trillion and the 12th interest payment of IDR 79.84 billion for the Obligasi Berkelanjutan IV Merdeka Copper Gold Tahap I 2022 will be paid as scheduled, with funds deposited to PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) on 11 December 2025 and KSEI set to distribute them to bondholders on 15 December 2025. All repayment funds come from MDKA’s internal cash, completing its liability for the bond.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) joins Rp2.2 trillion syndicated loan to fund Flyover Sitinjau Lauik project in West Sumatra
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI), together with PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BNI) and PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (PT SMI), acted as Joint Mandated Lead Arranger and Bookrunners for a Rp2.2 trillion syndicated financing of the Rp2,739 trillion Flyover Sitinjau Lauik, a 2,774‑km infrastructure project in West Sumatra slated for 2.5 years of construction and 10 years of operation. The bank also provides integrated services such as BRI One Solutions, Qlola, bank guarantees and supplier financing to support project stakeholders and enhance regional connectivity and economic growth.

title: PT Soho Global Health Tbk extends Rp750 billion loan facility with PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk for 12 months
body: PT Soho Global Health Tbk (SOHO) renewed a Rp750 billion credit facility with PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BNI), comprising a Rp600 billion indirect credit and a Rp150 billion revolving working‑capital loan, effective 12 December 2025 to 11 December 2026. The facility, unsecured and bearing a floating rate of 2.3% over Compounded IndONIA 90‑day tenor, aims to support operational needs, guarantee issuance, and maintain liquidity for SOHO and its subsidiaries PT Soho Industri Pharmasi and PT Parit Padang Global.

title: Pefindo downgrades Wijaya Karya's bond and sukuk ratings to idD after coupon payment delays
body: Pefindo lowered the ratings of Wijaya Karya's sustainable bonds and sukuk to idD (from idCCC) after the company missed coupon payments and failed to secure a 14‑day remedial extension with bondholders. The agency kept the corporate rating at idSD and noted that ratings could be reviewed if Wijaya Karya fulfills its principal and coupon obligations.

title: Venteny Fortuna International obtains a USD5 million loan from Symbiotics, with shares frozen at Rp97
body: On 12 December 2025, Venteny Fortuna International (VTNY) received a USD5 million loan from Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises Bonds S.A., Acting On Behalf Of Its Compartment Series 576 (Symbiotics) for internal use, which the company says will not adversely affect its financial condition, legal standing, or business continuity. The stock was frozen at Rp97 and has fallen 43.60 points (about 43.60%) YTD from Rp172 on 2 January 2025.

title: PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk (ALII) provides an interest‑free Rp10 billion five‑year loan to subsidiary PT Ancara Transhipment Services (ATS)
body: PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk (ALII) signed a loan agreement on 9 December 2025 to lend Rp10 billion interest‑free to its subsidiary PT Ancara Transhipment Services (ATS) for capital expenditure and working capital, with repayment due after five years. The loan is not expected to affect ALII’s financial condition, while the company’s shares have risen 26.83% this week and over 109.68% year‑to‑date.

title: Black Diamond Resources Tbk targets over 1 million tonnes of coal production in 2026 amid operational setbacks in 2025
body: The company expects 2026 coal output to exceed 1 million tonnes, improving revenue and price stability after achieving only about 60 % of its 2025 target due to extreme rainfall in Central Kalimantan. It is focusing on low‑strip ratio mines, exploring renewable‑energy‑related mineral opportunities, and sees export demand from Vietnam and China, while hoping for stable global coal prices.

title: SLJ Global (SULI) to seek approval for private placement of 632.08 million shares
body: SLJ Global (SULI) intends to issue 632,077,684 new shares with a nominal value of Rp100 each, representing up to 10% of its paid‑in capital, pending approval at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 19 December 2025. The proceeds are slated for capital‑structure strengthening, liquidity improvement, and financing of working‑capital, equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, and business growth.

title: Royalindo Investa Wijaya shifts from property to investment holding, launches PT Ratu Gula Asia and eyes AI acquisition, reporting 37% profit rise.
body: Royalindo Investa Wijaya (INDO) is converting its focus from property to a diversified investment holding, establishing PT Ratu Gula Asia (RGA) with a 71.68% stake after a Rp97 billion capital injection and targeting an AI‑based technology acquisition; for the nine months to September 2025 its net profit rose 37% YoY to Rp24.76 billion on revenue up 12% YoY to Rp22.19 billion.

title: Samuel Tumbuh Bersama expands holding in Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera to 39.16% after purchasing 525 million shares at a discounted price
body: On 12 December 2025, Samuel Tumbuh Bersama bought 525 million shares of Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera (NSSS) at Rp500 per share, spending Rp262.5 billion, a 27.53% discount to the closing price of Rp690. The transaction raised its stake to 9.31 billion shares, representing 39.16% of the company, up from 36.95% prior to the purchase.

title: Cahayasakti Investindo Sukses (CSIS) Announces Rp198.66 bn Right Issue with AUB and OKE Participation
body: CSIS plans a Rp198.66 billion right issue of 522.8 million new shares at a Rp380 exercise price, with major shareholders Andalan Utama Bintara (AUB) committing to subscribe all 299.2 million HMETD (Rp113.69 bn) and Olympic Kapital Equity (OKE) to subscribe 52.63 million HMETD (Rp19.99 bn); the issue also includes up to 52.28 million Series I warrants raising an additional Rp26.76 bn, and the proceeds will fund infrastructure projects and land‑bank expansion through its subsidiary Bogorindo Cemerlang (BC).

title: Six Archi Indonesia insiders purchase 127.6 million shares at a 56% discount, spending roughly Rp95.7 billion
body: On 12 December 2025, six members of Archi Indonesia’s board and management collectively bought 127.6 million shares at Rp750 per share, a 56.26% discount to the closing price of Rp1,715, amounting to about Rp95.7 billion. The purchases were made as direct investments, with each insider’s share count and transaction value disclosed.

title: GMF Asia launches a Rp6.21 trillion right issue, transferring Garuda Indonesia's subscription rights to Angkasa Pura Indonesia in exchange for Rp5.66 trillion of land assets
body: GMF Asia (GMFI) will issue up to 90.05 billion B‑shares at an exercise price of Rp69 per share, with Garuda Indonesia (GIAA) assigning its entitlement to Angkasa Pura Indonesia (API), which will contribute land valued at Rp5.66 trillion as non‑cash capital; API will become the largest shareholder while Garuda retains control. The remaining proceeds will support working capital and MRO expansion, and the rights issue is scheduled from 19 December 2025 to 13 January 2026.

title: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan (INET) and BNET activate a 100 Gbps IIX Karawang node to improve latency and backbone cost efficiency
body: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan (INET) partnered with BNET to launch a 100 Gbps IIX Karawang node at BNET's data center, providing a local traffic exchange point for West Java. The node is expected to shorten data paths, lower latency, reduce backbone expenses, and enhance network resilience for operators and end‑users.

title: Wahana Konstruksi Mandiri plans to acquire 69.52% of PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk, sending ASLI shares sharply higher
body: On 12 December 2025 PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk (ASLI) stock rose 9.76% to the upper price band of 540, having surged about 980% since July 2025. Wahana Konstruksi Mandiri (WKM) is preparing to purchase 4.34 billion ASLI shares, representing 69.52% ownership, positioning it as the new controlling shareholder and drawing a positive market response.

title: Indonesia's OJK implements 1:1 retail‑institution IPO allotment, and AEI says the change will have limited impact on IPO demand and pricing
body: Effective 17 November 2025, OJK's SEOJK No. 25/2025 requires a 1:1 allocation between retail and institutional investors in a pooling allotment and caps each retail investor’s order at 10% of the issue, exemplified by SUPA’s planned 4.40 billion‑share IPO. AEI chairman Armand Wahyudi Hartono says the rule will only marginally affect IPO interest and first‑day price moves, noting that IPO activity has already slowed from 79 issuances in 2023 to 41 in 2024, with only 24 completed by November 2025 against a revised target of 45.

title: PT Panca Budi Idaman Tbk (PBID) subsidiaries amend loan facilities with PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (NISP)
body: PT Panca Packindo Makmur (PPM) and PT Reka Mega Inti Pratama (RMIP) signed an amendment to their loan facilities with PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (NISP) on 11 December 2025, adjusting PPM's working‑capital facility to Rp147 billion, granting RMIP a Rp3 billion current‑account loan, and allowing RMIP to use PPM's demand loan up to Rp7 billion secured by PPM's land and building. The facilities are intended for working‑capital needs and are expected to support operational continuity and business expansion of the subsidiaries.

title: PT Cikarang Listrindo Tbk (POWR) Commercial Director Yudho Pratikto Increases Shareholding with Rp740.3 million Purchase
body: Yudho Pratikto, Commercial Director of PT Cikarang Listrindo Tbk (POWR), bought 1,057,633 shares at Rp700 each, spending roughly Rp740.3 million and raising his stake to about 0,1366% (21.5 million shares). The transaction coincided with POWR’s shares closing up 1.45% at Rp700.

title: PT Gema Grahasarana Tbk (GEMA) to Conduct Rp7 Billion Share Buyback Amidst Market Volatility
body: PT Gema Grahasarana Tbk (GEMA) plans a share buyback without RUPS approval, allocating a maximum of Rp7 billion to stabilize its share price and boost investor confidence during significant market fluctuations. The company's shares have declined 40.74% year-to-date in 2025, with the buyback scheduled for three months from December 12, 2025, to March 12, 2026, handled by PT Artha Sekuritas Indonesia.

title: Petrosea (PTRO) establishes PT Kinarya Medika Selaras (KMS) to enter health sector
body: Petrosea announced the formation of PT Kinarya Medika Selaras (KMS), jointly with its subsidiary PT Rekakarsa Karya Nusantara (RKN), under a deed dated 15 December 2025 and approved by the Indonesian Minister of Law. The new entity will focus on health services, professional, scientific, technical and retail activities, supporting Petrosea’s diversification strategy.

title: Hillcon Equity Management Sells 15 Million Hillcon (HILL) Shares for Rp2.4 Billion
body: Hillcon Equity Management divested 15 million shares of Hillcon (HILL) at Rp160 per share, generating Rp2.4 billion, a price 3.89% higher than the closing on December 10, 2025. This transaction reduced Hillcon Equity Management's direct ownership in Hillcon by 0.1% to 44.25%, while Hillcon's share price has experienced a 68.61% year-to-date correction.

title: Avian Brands (AVIA) Receives Rp49.99 Billion Dividend from Subsidiary Tirtakencana Tatawarna
body: Avian Brands (AVIA) received a Rp49.99 billion dividend from its 99,9999% owned subsidiary, Tirtakencana Tatawarna, which is set to fulfill the company's cash on December 15, 2025. Management confirmed this receipt will not affect operations, while the company's stock has seen an impressive 14.56% increase to Rp472 per share from Rp412 since January 2, 2025.

title: PT Cipta Kridatama Tbk, a subsidiary of PT ABM Investama Tbk, obtains a IDR 4.2 trillion syndicated loan with a IDR 1 trillion accordion option
body: On December 12, 2025, PT Cipta Kridatama Tbk, directly controlled by PT ABM Investama Tbk (ABMM), signed a syndicated financing facility with several domestic banks for IDR 4.2 trillion, including a IDR 1 trillion accordion option that must be exercised within two years. The facility, equal to 36.03% of the company's Q3‑2025 equity, is intended to lower margin, extend tenor, reduce financing costs and strengthen the balance sheet, and is exempt from appraisal and shareholder approval under OJK Regulation 17/2020.

title: MMS Group Indonesia's PT Mitra Murni Perkasa and Mitsui & Co., Ltd. sign MoU for strategic collaboration on high‑grade nickel matte marketing and investment
body: MMS Group Indonesia (MMSGI) entity PT Mitra Murni Perkasa (MMP) and Mitsui & Co., Ltd. (Mitsui) signed a Memorandum of Understanding to cooperate on marketing high‑grade nickel matte, explore strategic investments and long‑term business development, leveraging Mitsui’s global network and MMP’s integrated smelter capabilities. The partnership also highlights MMP’s emission‑reduction initiatives, renewable‑energy sourcing and the creation of 1,000 local jobs to support Indonesia’s downstream nickel agenda and the EV battery supply chain.

title: Indonesia targets 170 nickel smelters and $618 bn downstream investment by 2040 as part of its self‑reliance strategy
body: Deputy Minister Yuliot announced that Indonesia now operates 79 nickel smelters, with 74 under construction and 17 planned, projecting a total of 170 units and $618 bn in investment, 3 million jobs, and a significant GDP boost by 2040. He also highlighted that nickel export value rose from $3.3 bn in 2017 to $33.9 bn in 2024 following the 2020 ore export ban, emphasizing compliance with Law No. 2 of 2025 and environmental standards.

title: Indonesia plans 1%–5% coal export duty in 2026, targeting IDR 20 trillion revenue
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said the draft export duty for coal will revert to a 1%–5% rate, similar to pre‑Job Creation Law levels, and could generate about IDR 20 trillion in 2026. He argued the measure will correct tax imbalances by ensuring coal exporters contribute based on export value rather than receiving de‑facto subsidies.

title: Indonesia's Sumatra disaster budget expected to support, not hinder, economic growth, says Finance Minister
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said the disaster management budget for Sumatra will not disrupt the country's economic growth and may even provide a modest boost through reconstruction, housing development, and infrastructure projects. He noted that the National Disaster Mitigation Agency (BNPB) has allocated Rp1.6 trillion (US$93 million), with about Rp1.3 trillion (US$75.7 million) still available, and urged the use of local‑government loans from PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur for rebuilding damaged bridges and roads.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk. (SUPA) IPO oversubscribed 318.69 times ahead of Dec 17, 2025 listing
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk. (SUPA) received an IPO oversubscription of 318.69 times, with more than 1 million orders ahead of its December 17, 2025 listing on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Retail investors were allocated 3–4 lots per order under Rp100 million, while larger orders received 0.8‑1.8 % of the lot request, and six securities firms, including BQ – Korea Investment and Sekuritas Indonesia (KISI), acted as underwriters.

title: MR.D.I.Y. Indonesia Opens Its 1,200th Store in Sumbawa, Highlighting Rapid Nationwide Expansion
body: MR.D.I.Y. Indonesia inaugurated its 1,200th outlet in Sumbawa, NTB, emphasizing its strategy to extend modern retail beyond Java and support local economic growth, with the region projecting a 5.15% GDP increase by 2026. The launch is accompanied by a nationwide customer appreciation program offering prizes such as cars and motorcycles, underscoring the company’s commitment to uniform pricing and broader market reach.

title: Indonesia's Environment Ministry summons eight North Sumatra companies over alleged flood and landslide contributions
body: The ministry called PT Agincourt Resources, PT Toba Pulp Lestari, Sarulla Operations Ltd, PT Sumatera Pembangkit Mandiri, PT Teluk Nauli, PT North Sumatera Hydro Energy, PT Multi Sibolga Timber and PT Perkebunan Nusantara IV Kebun Batang Toru to explain suspected violations related to land clearing, erosion control and water runoff that may have worsened flooding and landslides in the Batang Toru and Garoga River basins. Minister Hanif Faisol Nurofiq said the hearings will verify permits, enforce compliance and may lead to legal actions for environmental restoration.

title: Indonesia's aquaculture output reaches 5.02 million tons in Q3 2025, nearing its annual target
body: The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries reported farmed fish production of 5.02 million tons in the third quarter of 2025, representing 96.95 % of the 5.17 million‑ton yearly goal, while non‑tax state revenue from the sector exceeded its target by 391.55 % and seaweed output reached 8.2 million tons (94.97 % of target). To close the gap, the ministry is pursuing pilot projects, pond revitalisation and community‑based villages, including a 315‑hectare tilapia zone in West Java expanding to 400 ha and a 2,000‑ha integrated shrimp zone in East Sumba valued at about Rp7 trillion (US$420 million) that aims to produce 75 000 tons of shrimp and create 10 000 jobs.

title: Indonesia forecasts over 5 million air travelers for the year‑end holiday season, with government measures to curb fares
body: Indonesia's Directorate General of Civil Aviation projects 5,050,194 passengers (3,899,176 domestic and 1,151,018 international) traveling during the Christmas and New Year holidays, with the busiest routes linking Jakarta, Denpasar, Surabaya, Medan, Balikpapan, Singapore and Kuala Lumpur. To manage limited operational aircraft (about 368 of 568) and keep fares down, the government introduced a 6% VAT, discounted fuel surcharges, up to 50% airport service charge cuts and lower fuel prices, expected to reduce ticket prices by roughly 12‑13%, and declared 257 airports ready after inspections.

title: PT Fuji Finance Tbk aims for 15‑20% financing growth by 2025, citing strong risk management and sustainable portfolio expansion
body: PT Fuji Finance Tbk (FUJI) management said it targets total financing growth of about 15‑20% in 2025, supported by disciplined risk management, a focus on productive financing and new sustainable projects such as renewable energy and electric‑vehicle financing. In 2024 the company’s net financing receivables rose 125% to Rp91.53 billion while the non‑performing financing ratio remained at 0%, reinforcing confidence in continued healthy expansion.

title: PT Cakra Buana Resources Tbk's Vessel Gunanusa Hailong 106 Joins Petronas Hidayah Field Development Project
body: PT Cakra Buana Resources Tbk's vessel, Gunanusa Hailong 106, is officially engaged in the Petronas-operated Proyek Hidayah Field Phase 1 Development through a time charter contract with PT Gunanusa Utama Fabricators, signed on November 5, 2025. The vessel will support offshore installation, heavy equipment, pipe, and material transport for the project's EPCIC work, ensuring vessel utilization and revenue visibility for CBRE while strengthening PT Gunanusa Utama Fabricators' offshore EPCIC portfolio.

title: Letjen Purn. Untung Budiharto Appointed President Director of PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM)
body: Letjen Purn. Untung Budiharto has been appointed as the new President Director of PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM), replacing Achmad Ardianto, a decision made during an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on December 15, 2025. Untung Budiharto, a retired three-star general with a military background, previously served as Director of Human Resources at Antam and is also the Commissioner President of PT Transportasi Jakarta.

title: Kedoya Adyaraya (RSGK) Injects Rp107.2 Billion Capital into Sinar Medika Sejahtera (SMS) to Fulfill Loan Obligations
body: Kedoya Adyaraya (RSGK) has injected Rp107.2 billion into its subsidiary Sinar Medika Sejahtera (SMS), increasing SMS's authorized capital from Rp300 billion to Rp500 billion and placed/paid-up capital from Rp281.74 billion to Rp388.94 billion. This transaction fulfills SMS's obligations from a loan facility provided by RSGK, resulting in RSGK's ownership in SMS increasing to 387,619,470 shares with a nominal value of Rp387.61 billion.

title: Resources Alam (KKGI) to Distribute Cash Dividend of Rp82.84 Billion
body: Resources Alam (KKGI) plans to distribute a cash dividend of Rp82.84 billion, equivalent to Rp17 per share, sourced from a portion of its USD40.07 million net profit for the 2024 financial year. The dividend payment is scheduled for January 14, 2026, with the recording date set for December 24, 2025, following approval from the Extraordinary GMS on December 12, 2025.

title: Hapsoro Sukomonohadi Reduces Stake in Rukun Raharja (RAJA) by Selling 7.5 Million Shares
body: Hapsoro Sukomonohadi, also known as Happy Hapsoro, divested 7.5 million shares of Rukun Raharja (RAJA) on December 11, 2025, with assistance from Trimegah Sekuritas Indonessia (TRIM) and CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia. This transaction, estimated at Rp48.93 billion, reduced his ownership to 1.16 billion shares (27.52%), representing a 0.18% dilution from his previous 27.70% stake.

title: Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) Secures Investor Approval for Private Placement to Boost Capital and Fund Growth
body: Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) received 100% investor approval for a private placement of 394.81 million shares, representing up to 10% of its issued capital, to be used for business development, working capital, and general corporate purposes. This initiative is projected to increase assets by 8.86% and equity by 10.04%, with a maximum 9.09% dilution for non-participating shareholders.

title: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk to Convene EGM for Business Transformation and Asset Pledging Following PT PIMSF Pulogadung's Control
body: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk will hold an EGM on December 19, 2025, to discuss business transformation, including changes to its Board of Directors and Commissioners following PT PIMSF Pulogadung becoming the new controlling shareholder and the resignation of four key personnel. The EGM will also address plans to pledge company assets for loan facilities to strengthen capital and fund future business expansion.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. Introduces National Promo "Belanja Bijak, Jadi Hemat, Berlimpah Promo" and Special KPR Offers for its 130th Anniversary.
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) launched a national promo program "Belanja Bijak, Jadi Hemat, Berlimpah Promo" until December 31, 2025, offering discounts up to Rp1.3 million, cashback up to Rp130 thousand, and special prices from Rp13 thousand for various transactions using BRI Debit, BRI Kartu Kredit, and QRIS BRImo. Additionally, in celebration of its 130th anniversary, BRI offers special KPR interest rates in December 2025 with a down payment starting from 1.30% for properties under Rp1 billion.

title: PT Reliance Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk. (RELI) Prepares for IPO and Bond Issuance in 2026
body: PT Reliance Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk. (RELI) is preparing a pipeline of two new securities issuances, including an Initial Public Offering (IPO) and a bond issuance, both targeted for 2026. Andrew Gunawan, Director of RELI, confirmed these projects but withheld further details on client identity, sector, or transaction value due to Non-Disclosure Agreements.

title: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. Appoints New Director and Independent Commissioner
body: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (TLKM) announced the appointment of Budi Satria Dharma Purba as Director of Wholesale & International Services and Rofikoh Rokhim as Independent Commissioner following an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on December 12, 2025. Budi Satria previously served as CEO of Telin, while Rofikoh Rokhim is a Professor at UI and was a former Commissioner at PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI).

title: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk Reports Strong Financial Performance with Double-Digit Growth in Credit and DPK by November 2025
body: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk demonstrated robust financial performance by November 2025, with credit growing 13.1% year-on-year to Rp1,452 trillion and Third-Party Funds (DPK) increasing 15.9% year-on-year to Rp1,584 trillion. This was supported by solid fundamentals, including an optimal Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR) of 91%, a low Non Performing Loan (NPL) ratio of 0.99%, and a 28.7% month-on-month rise in net profit.

title: Bank BRI (BBRI) Plans to Distribute Interim Dividend of Rp20.63 Trillion.
body: Bank BRI (BBRI) plans to distribute an interim dividend of Rp20.63 trillion, or Rp137 per share, representing 50.70% of its Rp40.77 trillion net profit as of September 30, 2025. The recording date for shareholders entitled to the dividend is January 2, 2026, with payment scheduled for January 15, 2026.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk launches HARMONIKA, an inclusive internship program for differently‑abled talent
body: The program, officially kicked off on 20 June 2025, will run from 1 August to 31 October 2025 and places 18 selected participants—including 15 individuals with autism—in 11 operational units of PT United Tractors Tbk and its AHEMCE entities. The initiative, developed with Yayasan Autisma Indonesia and local special schools, received commendation from the Komisi Nasional Disabilitas for its inclusive workplace practices.

title: CPO producers face price decline but remain optimistic on 2026 growth amid limited flood impact
body: Global crude palm oil prices fell to a six‑month low of MYR 3,958/ton, yet PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk (SSMS) and PT Sampoerna Agro Tbk (SGRO) project double‑digit revenue growth for 2026, while PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk (LSIP) and PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk (ANJT) report limited flood damage affecting less than 2% of their plantations.
