Analysts note that production costs stay well below current prices, supporting margins, and recommend a wait‑and‑see approach with selective buy ratings for SSMS, LSIP, AALI and ANJT.

title: BPOM chief inaugurates PT Global Onkolab Farma's radioisotope facility to boost Indonesia's cancer treatment capacity
body: BPOM Head Taruna Ikrar opened PT Global Onkolab Farma’s new radioisotope and radiopharmaceutical production plant in Sidoarjo, which can produce F‑18 Fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) for PET‑CT scans and aims to improve access to cancer medicines across central and eastern Indonesia. He noted the facility supports national health transformation, self‑reliance under Law No. 17 of 2023, and addresses the high cancer burden in the country.

title: Indonesia targets 15 key overseas markets for tourism growth in 2025‑2026
body: The Ministry of Tourism said it will focus on 15 priority source markets—Malaysia, Singapore, Australia, China, India, Japan, Korea, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Russia, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and the United States—for the 2025‑2026 period. Recent data show foreign arrivals from Malaysia up 15.91% to 2.18 million, Singapore up 7.66% to 1.20 million, India up 3.25% to 603,654 and Russia up 29.94% to 178,434, and the ministry aims to boost tourist spending and length of stay while aligning domestic tourism with trends such as culinary, shopping and adventure experiences.

title: Indonesia and Iraq discuss expanded oil and gas cooperation involving PT Pertamina International EP
body: Indonesia's Deputy Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources Yuliot Tanjung met with Iraq's Deputy Minister of Upstream Affairs Basim Mohammed Kudhair in Jakarta to advance a draft intergovernmental MoU covering oil and gas trade, investment, technology transfer and capacity building. The agreement would enable PT Pertamina International EP (PIEP), which holds a 20% stake in an Iraqi field, to manage existing fields and explore new "green" projects alongside Indonesian state‑owned enterprises.

title: Indonesia's rice import ban drives global price drop and creates domestic surplus
body: Coordinating Minister for Food Affairs Zulkifli Hasan said the import ban cut global rice prices from about $650 to below $400 per ton, while Indonesia shifted from importing 4.5 million tons last year to a 4.7 million‑ton surplus in 2025, with production up 13.5% to 34.77 million tons. The surge was attributed to regulatory simplification in fertilizer procurement and distribution, positioning the country for rice self‑sufficiency by early 2026.

title: Indonesia plans to introduce IP‑based financing under the KUR scheme to boost small‑business innovation
body: Law Minister Supratman Andi Agtas announced that Indonesia will consider using registered intellectual property as collateral in the Kredit Usaha Rakyat (KUR) program, joining 14 other countries that have adopted similar schemes. The cross‑ministry forum highlighted the need for strong IP protection, valuation standards, and prudential safeguards to expand credit access for SMEs and the creative economy.

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk completes Rp536.28 billion acquisition of PT Bukit Permai Properti from PT Summarecon Agung Tbk
body: On 28 November 2025, PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk (BUVA) acquired 99.99% of PT Bukit Permai Properti for Rp536.28 billion, adding a 19‑hectare land parcel adjacent to its Alila Villa Uluwatu. Analysts from Edvisor and MNC Sekuritas view the deal as a medium‑to‑long‑term catalyst, suggesting a speculative buy rating with target prices around Rp1,800 per share.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) debuts on BEI with heavily oversubscribed IPO at Rp 635 per share
body: The IPO of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) began trading on the Bursa Efek Indonesia on 17 December 2025 after being oversubscribed 318.69 times, with an offering price of Rp 635 per share and a PBV of 2.64×, lower than peers such as Bank Jago, Allo Bank and Bank Aladin Syariah. The 1.4 billion‑share issue is expected to raise about Rp 2.79 trillion, of which 70 % will fund credit‑related working capital and the remainder will support capex projects through 2030.

title: Indonesian issuers ramp up share buybacks ahead of year‑end, with KLBF, GEMA, DEWA, JTPE and AMRT announcing multi‑billion‑rupiah programs
body: PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF) announced a maximum Rp 250 billion buyback from today until 15 Mar 2026, PT Gema Grahasarana Tbk (GEMA) will repurchase up to Rp 7 billion between 12 Dec 2025 and 12 Mar 2026, PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) reduced its allocation to Rp 950 billion for the 19 Nov 2025‑19 Feb 2026 window, PT Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa Tbk (JTPE) set a Rp 140 billion program from 15 Dec 2025 to 6 Mar 2026, and PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk (AMRT) allocated Rp 1.5 trillion from 8 Dec 2025 to 6 Mar 2026. Analysts Ekky Topan and Maximilianus Nicodemus said the buybacks reflect low valuations and ample internal cash, signalling confidence and potentially supporting price gains, and they projected KLBF toward Rp 1,500‑1,600, AMRT toward Rp 2,300‑2,400, and DEWA toward Rp 800 per share.

title: Amelia Sintari Acquires 22.55 Million Siantar Top (STTP) Shares, Increasing Her Stake
body: Amelia Sintari purchased 22,553,900 shares of Siantar Top (STTP) on December 12, 2025, for Rp3,015 per share, totaling Rp68 billion. This acquisition, made at a 68.92% discount to the market price, increased her total ownership in Siantar Top from 4.93% to 6.65%.

title: Indonesia's IHSG rises 0.43% as analysts warn of potential correction and detail wave‑based stock outlooks
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 8,686.47, up 0.43%, with analysts noting it may face a corrective test of the 8,464‑8,560 range or, in a worst‑case scenario, dip toward the 8,000s. Recommendations for ADRO, PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BRIS), JPFA and TOWR were provided, highlighting their recent price moves and positions within Elliott wave patterns.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange suspends trading of five stocks after sharp price jumps
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) temporarily halted trading of PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO), PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk (NATO), PT Capitol Nusantara Indonesia Tbk (CANI), PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk (BNBR) and PT Metro Healthcare Indonesia Tbk (CARE) on Dec 16, 2025 after their prices surged 94.6%, 20.95%, 19.59%, 19.59% and 25.0% respectively in the prior five sessions. Market watchdog Yulianto Aji Sadono warned of excessive volatility, and analyst William Hartanto advised investors to monitor support‑resistance levels and consider a “sell on strength” approach when trading resumes.

title: Indonesia's IHSG rises 0.43% to 8,686.47 as analyst flags resistance at 8,742 and bearish MACD momentum
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 8,686.47 on 16 December 2025, up 0.43%, with analyst Ivan Rosanova noting potential testing of the 8,742 resistance if the index holds above 8,704, while MACD indicates bearish momentum and support sits at 8,493, 8,361 and 8,255. He also issued hold recommendations for AADI, ANTM, MBMA, MEDC and PGEO, and crude oil prices fell 3% toward a five‑year low.

title: PT Adhi Karya Tbk (ADHI) Approves Management Reshuffle and Articles of Association Amendments at RUPSLB
body: PT Adhi Karya Tbk (ADHI) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on Tuesday (16/12) where Moeharmein Zein Chaniago was appointed President Director and Amelia Tetriana joined the Board of Commissioners. The meeting also approved amendments to the Company's Articles of Association to comply with BUMN regulations and delegated authority for the 2026 Company Work Plan and Budget (RKAP).

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy (PGEO) Submits Technical Documents to PLN for Lahendong Geothermal Power Purchase and Expansion
body: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy (PGEO) submitted technical documents to PLN for the purchase of electricity from its Lahendong geothermal project, including PLTP Lahendong Unit 7 and 8 (2 x 20 MW) and a 10 MW Binary Unit. This initiative aims to increase PGEO's contribution to North Sulawesi's electricity supply from 30% to 35-40% and supports national renewable energy targets, while the geothermal sector has generated approximately Rp 21.43 trillion in Non-Tax State Revenue (2010-2024) and Rp 10.82 trillion in Revenue Sharing Funds (2019-2024).

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk. (SUPA) Shares Soar 24.41% on Strong BEI Debut
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk. (SUPA) debuted on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) on December 17, 2025, closing up 24.41% at Rp790 per share, significantly above its IPO price, and successfully raised approximately Rp2.79 trillion. Superbank plans to use 70% of the IPO funds for working capital to boost credit to underbanked, retail, and UMKM segments, while allocating 30% for capital expenditure to develop digital products, IT infrastructure, and AI, leveraging its integration with the Grab, OVO, and Emtek ecosystems.

title: Sari Kreasi Boga (RAFI) Freed from Bankruptcy Petition After ICS Direct Lending Strategic Fund Pte. Ltd. Withdrawal
body: Sari Kreasi Boga alias SKB Food (RAFI) has been declared free from bankruptcy following the withdrawal of a petition by ICS Direct Lending Strategic Fund Pte. Ltd. (ICS). The petition, involving a claim of Rp19.02 billion, stemmed from SKB Food (RAFI)'s role as a Corporate Guarantor for a Rp19.88 billion credit facility from ICS to Samudera Karunia Bersama.

title: TBS Energi Utama (TOBA) to Issue Rp500 Billion in Sustainable Bonds for Debt Refinancing and Working Capital
body: TBS Energi Utama (TOBA) plans to issue Rp500 billion in sustainable bonds across three series (A, B, C) with interest rates from 7.25% to 8.65% and tenors of 3 to 7 years. The proceeds will be used to repay Rp400.93 billion of existing debt, inject Rp46.39 billion as capital into Trisensa Mineral Utama (TMU) for coal mining working capital, and cover general corporate expenses.

title: Neobank Evaluates Corporate Actions Amid OJK's KBMI 1 Consolidation Plan, Pending Shareholder Approval
body: PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk. (BBYB) is evaluating corporate action options in response to Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK)'s proposed consolidation of KBMI 1 banks, but will only proceed after obtaining approval from its Pemegang Saham Pengendali (PSP) and awaiting clearer regulatory guidance. Concurrently, BBYB's primary focus remains on improving fundamental performance and achieving full profitability within two to three years.

title: Medco Energi (MEDC) through Medco LNG Indonesia Acquires 40% Stake in Transportasi Gas Indonesia for USD93.41 Million
body: Medco Energi (MEDC), via its affiliate Medco LNG Indonesia (MLI), completed the acquisition of 40% (542,746 shares) of Transportasi Gas Indonesia from Transasia Pipeline Company Pvt Ltd (TPC) for USD93.41 million on December 12, 2025. Management asserts this affiliated transaction is not material and will not negatively impact Medco Energi's operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Intan Investama Internasional Reduces Stake in Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) Amidst Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo's Acquisition Plan
body: Intan Investama Internasional divested 45,514,600 shares of Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) on December 15, 2025, reducing its ownership to 31.43% and valuing the transaction at approximately Rp44.14 billion. This divestment is part of Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo's plan to gradually acquire 20% of TRIN, a move that Perintis Triniti Properti confirms will not change its controlling structure or merge it with the Solusi Sinergi Digital (WIFI) group.

title: Mutuagung Lestari (MUTU) Plans Private Placement to Strengthen Capital and Fund Strategic Expansion
body: Mutuagung Lestari (MUTU) plans a private placement of 314.28 million shares, equivalent to 10% of its placed and fully paid shares with a nominal value of Rp25, pending approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on December 18, 2025. The proceeds will strengthen the capital structure, support 2026 strategic development plans focused on expanding laboratory, halal services, and inspection capacity, including the construction of a halal centre, cosmetics & herbal centre, and gold mineral lab.

title: PT DMS Propertindo Tbk (KOTA) Acquires Premium Bali Villa for Rp200 Billion to Boost Recurring Income
body: PT DMS Propertindo Tbk (KOTA) has acquired The Leaf Jimbaran, a premium villa in Bali, for Rp200 billion, which will be rebranded as The Leaf Indies Jimbaran. This strategic move, financed by group funds and bank debt, aims to strengthen recurring income by an estimated Rp25 billion annually through internal management via Accola Hotel Indonesia, capitalizing on the recovering tourism sector.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) Stock Price and Market Capitalization Show Significant Growth Over Two Decades
body: Since its 2003 IPO, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) stock has surged 48-fold, with its market capitalization consistently growing to Rp867 trillion by December 2023 and reaching Rp591.1 trillion by September 2025. This performance, bolstered by two stock splits to enhance liquidity, positions BBRI as Indonesia's largest state-owned enterprise by market capitalization and a top bank globally and in Southeast Asia.

title: Kalbe Farma (KLBF) Subsidiary Global Onkolab Farma (GOF) Operates Radioisotope and Radiopharmaceutical Production Facilities for Early Cancer Detection
body: Kalbe Farma (KLBF), through its subsidiary Global Onkolab Farma (GOF), has launched radioisotope and radiopharmaceutical production facilities, including Fluorodeoxyglucose (FGD), in Jakarta and Sidoarjo to enhance early cancer detection and support PET/CT-Scan services. This initiative aims to expand health access for cancer patients and contribute to Indonesia's health independence, with swift permit approvals from Badan POM and Bapeten.

title: BEI Announces Unusual Market Activity for PT Bali Towerindo Sentra Tbk. and PT Intermedia Capital Tbk. Stocks
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) announced Unusual Market Activity (UMA) for shares of PT Bali Towerindo Sentra Tbk. (BALI) and PT Intermedia Capital Tbk. (MDIA), effective December 16, 2025, to protect investors and monitor unusual transaction patterns. Following the announcement, BALI shares fell 14.52% to Rp1,855, while MDIA shares initially rose 9.57% to Rp80 before closing with a 4.11% gain at Rp76.

title: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk. Collaborates with PT KAI Medika Indonesia to Fund Brawijaya Hospital Tangerang Development
body: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk. (BBKP) has partnered with PT KAI Medika Indonesia (KAIMI) to provide credit facilities totaling up to Rp110 billion for the development of healthcare services at Brawijaya Hospital Tangerang. This financing will support investment in medical equipment and business expansion, aligning with KB Bank's strategy to strengthen its portfolio in the strategic healthcare sector.

title: PT Bali Towerindo Sentra Tbk Completes Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Seri B Obligations
body: PT Bali Towerindo Sentra Tbk has fully settled all obligations related to its Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Bali Towerindo Sentra Tahap I Tahun 2022 Seri B on December 16, 2025, by paying the principal of Rp21.00 miliar and the 12th installment of its yield. This timely repayment demonstrates the company's strong liquidity and disciplined financial management, reinforcing investor confidence.

title: PT Bank Jabar Banten Syariah Amends Articles of Association to Increase Minimum Sharia Supervisory Board Members
body: PT Bank Jabar Banten Syariah held a General Meeting of Shareholders on December 12, 2025, approving an amendment to its articles of association to comply with OJK Regulation No. 2 of 2024. This change mandates a minimum of three Sharia Supervisory Board members, up from two, effective January 1, 2026, while BJB Syariah currently has two members.

title: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk Begins Issuing Sustainable Bonds I, Targeting Rp20 Trillion
body: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk has commenced the issuance of its Sustainable Bonds I, targeting Rp20 trillion in total funds, with Rp5 trillion registered for the initial stage, according to Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI). This first stage comprises three series: Series A (Rp1 trillion, 4.85% due 2026), Series B (Rp2 trillion, 5.45% due 2028), and Series C (Rp2 trillion, 5.95% due 2030), with underwriters including PT BCA Sekuritas, PT BNI Sekuritas, PT BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, PT Mega Capital Sekuritas, PT Mandiri Sekuritas, and PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk.

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk Lists Two New Bonds on BEI
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk recently listed its Obligasi Berwawasan Sosial Berkelanjutan I Tahap I Tahun 2025 (Rp300 nominal, 5.30% interest, 3 years) and Obligasi Subordinasi Berkelanjutan I Tahap I Tahun 2025 (Rp2 trillion nominal, 6.65% interest, 5 years) on the Bursa Efek Indonesia. These bonds were rated idAAA and idAA respectively by PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (PEFINDO) with PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk as Trustee, adding to the 175 bond and sukuk emissions recorded in 2025.

title: PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk
body: PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk, an insider, sold 189,375,000 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk, reducing its holding to 0. The transaction, valued at 58 per share, was for share sales purposes, indicating a significant change in ownership structure.

title: PT PLN restores Aceh power grid by reconnecting 150 kV Pangkalan Brandan‑Langsa line after Sumatra floods
body: State-owned PT PLN reconnected Aceh’s grid to the Sumatra backbone by restoring the 150 kV Pangkalan Brandan‑Langsa transmission line, using emergency towers after flooding and landslides disrupted service. The utility is now re‑operating the Nagan Raya steam plant and expects full supply to resume within about 48 hours, with over 1,600 staff on standby for further restoration.

title: Merdeka Copper Gold (MDKA) Reports Mixed Q3 2025 Results with Reduced Loss and Period Profit Amidst Revenue Decline
body: Merdeka Copper Gold (MDKA) recorded a loss of USD34.75 million as of September 30, 2025, representing a 48.15% reduction from the previous year's loss, with basic loss per share decreasing to USD0,00144. Despite a 22.89% decline in revenue to USD1.28 billion, the company achieved a profit for the period of USD14.28 million, a significant turnaround from a USD19.61 million loss in the prior year.

title: Alamtri Resources Indonesia (ADRO) Plans to Distribute USD250 Million Interim Dividend
body: Alamtri Resources Indonesia (ADRO) will distribute an interim dividend of USD250 million, representing approximately 82.9% of its USD301.58 million net profit as of September 30, 2025. The cum dividend date for the regular and negotiation market is December 29, 2025, with payment scheduled for January 15, 2026.

title: Claudia Ingkiriwang Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Claudia Ingkiriwang, an insider, sold 54,218,750 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk., a technology company, on July 31, 2025, at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in her ownership decreasing to 0. The purpose of the sale was for share sales.

title: Henri Widodo Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Henri Widodo, an insider, sold 122,927,734 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk., a technology company, on July 31, 2025, at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in Henri Widodo's ownership decreasing to 0. The purpose of the transaction was share sales.

title: Merdeka Materials (MBMA) Reports Increased Net Profit for First Nine Months of 2025 Despite Revenue Decline
body: Merdeka Materials (MBMA) achieved a net profit of USD25.3 million for the first nine months of 2025, marking a 37.05 percent increase from the prior year, even as revenue fell 32.11 percent to USD934.99 million. The company's total assets grew to USD3.59 billion, up from USD3.43 billion at the end of the previous year.

title: Ellen Yanury Luassa Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk
body: Ellen Yanury Luassa, an insider, sold 46,875,000 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk, a technology company, on July 31, 2025, at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in Luassa's ownership decreasing to 0. The purpose of the sale was for share sales, significantly reducing Luassa's stake in the company.

title: PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk
body: PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk, an insider, sold 189,375,000 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk, a technology company, on July 31, 2025, at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk's ownership decreasing to 0. The purpose of the transaction was share sales.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) Achieves KBMI 2 Status After IPO Boosts Core Capital to Rp8 Trillion
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) secured Rp2.79 trillion from its IPO, increasing its core capital to Rp8 trillion by December 17, 2025, which qualifies it for KBMI 2 status. This development aligns with OJK's ongoing efforts to strengthen national banking, including a wacana to potentially remove the KBMI 1 category and encourage capital reinforcement among smaller banks.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk raises IDR2.79 trillion in IPO, allocating proceeds to working capital and capex
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (Superbank) listed on the IDX, issuing 4.4 billion shares at IDR635 each and raising IDR2.79 trillion (~$167 million). It will use 70% of the proceeds for working capital to expand lending to underbanked retail and MSMEs, and 30% for capital expenditures including digital payments, IT infrastructure, AI and cybersecurity.

title: Indonesia's Transport Minister declares East Java land transport ready for the 2025‑2026 year‑end holidays
body: Minister Dudy Purwagandhi inspected the Surabaya‑Banyuwangi corridor, confirming partial operation of the Probolinggo–Situbondo–Banyuwangi toll road, readiness of the Piton toll road rest area, and coordinated safety measures at Ketapang Port. PT ASDP reported peak travel periods and established buffer zones at key terminals to manage congestion during the Christmas and New Year rush.

title: Indonesia draws 3.5 million visitors and secures $28.3 billion of investment at Osaka Expo 2025
body: At Expo 2025 in Osaka, the Indonesia Pavilion attracted more than 3.5 million visitors, surpassing its 2.8 million target, and the country secured US$28.3 billion in investment commitments across 104 business sessions, resulting in multiple MoUs, letters of intent and joint ventures. The outcomes were credited to coordinated efforts of the Ministry of National Development Planning, President Prabowo Subianto, and participating ministries, state institutions, regional governments and businesses.

title: Indonesia's Manpower Minister orders governors to set minimum wages by Dec 24 2025 with a higher adjustment factor
body: The Ministry of Manpower instructed regional leaders to finalize provincial and local minimum wages by 24 December 2025, keeping the inflation‑plus‑growth formula but raising the alpha coefficient range from 0.1‑0.3 to 0.5‑0.9. The change aims to better match inflation and economic growth while the ministry provides technical support to ensure timely implementation.

title: PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk. (CBDK) Forms New Subsidiary PT Samudra Mega Utama (SMU) for Real Estate Expansion
body: PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk. (CBDK) and its subsidiary PT Agung Surya Gemerlap (ASGE) officially established PT Samudra Mega Utama (SMU) on December 12, 2025, with an issued and paid-up capital of Rp600 million. CBDK holds a 99.9% stake in SMU, which will operate in real estate and other related activities to support CBDK's expansion, particularly in the PIK 2 area.

title: PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk (BJB) Issues NCDs for Short-Term Funding
body: PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk (BJB) is issuing Negotiable Certificate of Deposit (NCD) totaling Rp10.59 billion with a 1.49% annual discount rate, set for electronic distribution on December 30, 2025, and maturing on December 30, 2026, to raise short-term funds. As of Q3-2025, BJB reported a 3.5% increase in credit disbursement to Rp142.9 trillion, consolidated Third Party Funds (DPK) of Rp160.2 trillion, and maintained liquidity with an 85.3% Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR).

title: Indonesia aims to achieve food self‑sufficiency in Papua within three years by expanding rice cultivation and reviving the sago industry
body: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman announced that Indonesia will reach food self‑sufficiency in Papua within two to three years by developing about 100,000 hectares of new rice fields to close a 500,000‑ton annual deficit and by reactivating the sago factory in Sorong. The initiative supports a nationwide goal of supply stability and inflation control, with other regions already self‑sufficient.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) Plans Interim Dividend Distribution for Fiscal Year 2025.
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) announced plans to distribute an interim dividend totaling Rp20.63 trillion, or Rp137 per share, for Fiscal Year 2025, with payment scheduled for January 15, 2026. This distribution reflects the company's solid financial performance, which recorded a consolidated net profit of Rp41.2 trillion by September 30, 2025, and its commitment to shareholders and national economic support.

title: PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk announces shift to an energy-focused investment holding after PT Morris Capital Indonesia becomes controlling shareholder
body: PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk (PIPA) disclosed that PT Morris Capital Indonesia (MCI) has become its new controlling shareholder with a 49.92% stake, and the company is transitioning from PVC manufacturing to a holding that will invest in an integrated oil-and-gas ecosystem. The 2026 strategic plan includes up to Rp300 billion for oil‑gas processing assets, bond issuances of roughly Rp460 billion for logistics and Rp200 billion for acquisitions, and an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting in February 2026 to approve board changes and a right‑issue slated for Q3 2026.

title: Petrosea's subsidiary Scan‑Bilt secures $29.07 million EPC and IFM contract for Aster’s Singapore chemical complexes
body: Scan-Bilt Pte. Ltd., a subsidiary of Petrosea (PTRO), signed a USD 29.07 million (Rp485.4 billion) 24‑month EPC civil works and Integrated Facilities Management contract with Aster Chemicals & Energy Pte. Ltd. (Aster) for its Bukom and Jurong Island chemical complexes in Singapore on 17 December 2025. The agreement is presented as a positive driver for Petrosea's business expansion and diversification strategy.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sells 180 million Impack Pratama Industri shares at discounted price, raising IDR 538.5 billion
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa disposed of 180 million shares of Impack Pratama Industri (IMPC) on 15‑16 December 2025 at an average price of IDR 2,975 per share, representing an 18.93 % discount to the closing price and generating IDR 538.5 billion in proceeds. This follows an earlier sale of 825 million shares on 10‑11 December 2025 at a 20.42 % discount to the closing price.

title: Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa (JTPE) Allocates Rp140 Billion for Stock Buyback Amid Strong Q3 Performance
body: Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa (JTPE) plans a Rp140 billion stock buyback, targeting up to 342.6 million shares at a maximum price of Rp600 per share, from December 15, 2025, to March 6, 2026, to strengthen shareholder value and signal market optimism. This move is supported by JTPE's robust Q3 performance, which saw a 29% increase in net profit to Rp167.92 billion and a 12% rise in total sales to Rp1.26 trillion, primarily from its security segment.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Increases Shareholding in Sentul City to 5.26%
body: Samuel Sekuritas acquired 2.16 billion shares of Sentul City (BKSL) on December 16, 2025, at Rp142 per share, totaling Rp307.14 billion. This transaction raised Samuel Sekuritas's ownership in Sentul City from 3.97% to 5.26%, with management clarifying it as a reverse repo.

title: PT Global Sukses Digital Tbk (DOSS) Transforms into Integrated Creative Ecosystem Driven by Film Production Success
body: PT Global Sukses Digital Tbk (DOSS) is strategically transforming from a retail company into an integrated creative ecosystem driver, demonstrated by its involvement in the film "Pelangi di Mars," produced using Doss Guava XR Studio where DOSS holds a majority stake. The film's positive reception validates DOSS's long-term strategy to build an end-to-end creative ecosystem leveraging Extended Reality (XR) technology for efficient and innovative content production.

title: PT Ricky Putra Globalindo Tbk (RICY) Enters Recovery Phase After Commercial Court Approves PKPU Homologation
body: PT Ricky Putra Globalindo Tbk (RICY) has officially entered a recovery phase following the Commercial Court's approval of its Peace Agreement (homologation) on December 15, 2025, effectively ending the Suspension of Debt Payment Obligations (PKPU) process initiated by PT Asuransi Kredit Indonesia (Askrindo). The company, which reported a total short-term debt of Rp1,052 trillion as of Q3 2025, can now resume independent business operations while committed to fulfilling its agreed obligations to creditors.

title: Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia (TUGU) Shares Strengthen on Robust Financials and Undervalued Position
body: Shares of Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia (TUGU) have strengthened by approximately 18.85% over the last three months, driven by consistent operational growth including a 5.6% increase in gross premiums and a 5.9% rise in net profit for Q3-2025. Despite this gain, the stock remains undervalued with a Price-to-Book Value (PBV) below 0.4x, supported by strong capital (RBC 360.9%) and consistent dividend payouts, suggesting further re-rating potential.

title: Sight Investment Company Pte Ltd Increases Stake in PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk.
body: Sight Investment Company Pte Ltd, the controlling shareholder of PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk. (SILO), purchased 66,500,000 SILO shares for Rp2,400 per share on December 15, 2025, totaling approximately Rp159.6 billion for investment purposes. This transaction increased its ownership in SILO from 63.46% to 63.97%, representing 8.31 billion shares.

title: PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk (BTPN) Realizes Rp24 Billion Interest Payment for Continuous Bonds V Phase II 2024
body: PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk (BTPN) has paid a total of Rp24 billion in interest for its Continuous Bonds V Phase II 2024, as disclosed by Corporate Secretary Bank SMBC Eneng Yulie Andriani. This payment includes Rp7.2 billion for Series A bonds (6.7% interest, maturing Dec 2027) and Rp16.79 billion for Series B bonds (6.95% interest, maturing Dec 2029), both marking their 4th interest payment stage.

title: PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA) Secures Rp16 Billion Contract from PT PGAS Solution for Pipeline Inspection
body: PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA) has secured a new Rp16 billion contract from PT PGAS Solution, a subsidiary of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk, for underwater gas pipeline inspection. This project, covering a 369 km segment and targeted for completion by January 2026, is expected to positively impact ATLA's operational performance, revenue, and strengthen its subsea inspection portfolio.

title: Claudia Ingkiriwang, Ellen Yanury Luassa, Ing-Ing Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk
body: Claudia Ingkiriwang, Ellen Yanury Luassa, and Ing-Ing, insiders of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia, sold 493,088,500 shares at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in a change of ownership, with the holders' stake decreasing to 0. The purpose of the sale was for share sales, indicating a significant change in the company's shareholder structure.

title: Ing-Ing Cindy Eva Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Ing-Ing Cindy Eva, an insider, sold 56,291,016 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk., a technology company, on July 31, 2025, at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in her ownership decreasing to 0. The purpose of the sale was for share sales, significantly reducing her stake in the company.

title: Adi Putera Widjaja Sells Shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Adi Putera Widjaja, an insider, sold 23,401,000 shares of PT Tourindo Guide Indonesia Tbk., a technology company, on July 31, 2025, at a price of 58. The transaction resulted in Adi Putera Widjaja's ownership decreasing to 0. The purpose of the transaction was share sales.

title: PT KAI ramps up security and staffing for year‑end holiday travel across Java and Sumatra
body: PT KAI will operate 392 trains (including 52 additional services) from December 18, 2025 to January 4, 2026 and has deployed a total of 2,392 security personnel, with 1,800 assigned to the Daop 2 Bandung area to monitor 53 vulnerable points. The effort aims to protect an estimated 15,962 daily seats in Bandung (287,316 seats over the holiday period) and ensure safe mobility during the peak travel season.

title: VKTR Teknologi injects IDR 150 billion into subsidiary VKTR Sakti Industries, keeping its 60% stake
body: On 17 December 2025, VKTR Teknologi capitalised VKTR Sakti Industries with IDR 150 billion, raising the subsidiary’s paid‑in capital to a total of IDR 251 billion. The injection maintains VKTR Teknologi’s 60% ownership (150.6 billion nominal) while Widodo holds the remaining 40% (100.4 billion nominal) and is part of the IPO fund utilisation plan.

title: Indonesia formalises 14.7 million micro enterprises in 2025 through expanded certification, financing and market‑access programmes
body: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises reported that 14.7 million informal micro businesses entered the formal sector in 2025, supported by halal and SNI certifications, the People's Business Credit (KUR) scheme delivering Rp257.9 trillion to 4.38 million borrowers, and new market‑access partnerships. The government expects the financing to create 7.7–11.6 million jobs and plans further reforms for 2026 to boost legal status, productive financing, digital marketing and supply‑chain integration.

title: Indonesian government purchases 40 tons of Aceh chilies to support flood‑hit farmers
body: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman bought 40 tons of chilies from Aceh farmers, using an Indonesian Air Force Hercules aircraft and transport to Jakarta and Medan, to ensure market absorption and protect farmer incomes after recent floods and landslides. The move follows President Prabowo Subianto’s directive to use aid‑flight capacity for harvest transport and aims to stabilise farm‑level prices.

title: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison boosts network capacity by 20% for the holiday season
body: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison is increasing its network capacity by up to 20% using more than 210,000 4G, 5G and mobile BTS sites, AI‑driven Digital Intelligence Operation Center, Digital Twin and AI Agent technologies, and enhanced anti‑spam protection to handle the expected double‑digit surge in data traffic during the Christmas and New Year period. The company will also operate joint command posts with Komdigi from 19 December 2025 to 4 January 2026 to ensure real‑time monitoring and rapid response across key locations nationwide.

title: PT Cakra Buana Resources Tbk. secures up to Rp4 trillion eight‑year offshore contract with partners Gunanusa and Hailong
body: PT Cakra Buana Resources Tbk. (CBRE) announced a long‑term offshore contract valued at roughly Rp4 trillion over an eight‑year period, with daily rental rates of USD 90,000 when operational and USD 50,000 on standby. The deal, executed with strategic oil‑and‑gas partners Gunanusa and Hailong, is positioned as a catalyst for CBRE’s business transformation and revenue diversification into the offshore sector.

title: Bank BTN (BBTN) and PT Danareksa (Persero) sign strategic financing alliance with up to Rp4.5 trillion facility
body: Bank BTN (BBTN) and PT Danareksa (Persero) signed a strategic alliance on 18 December 2025 to provide a financing facility of up to Rp4.5 trillion, comprising committed and uncommitted corporate line facilities. The agreement also includes integrated banking services, cash‑management and digital banking solutions via Bale Korpora to support Danareksa’s holding ecosystem and strengthen BTN’s role as a primary banking partner for large corporate groups.

title: Superbank (SUPA) Achieves KBMI II Status and Reports Improved Financial Performance Post-IPO.
body: Superbank (SUPA) has achieved KBMI II status with a core capital of Rp7.61 trillion, combining its existing capital and Rp2.73 trillion net proceeds from its initial public offering on December 17, 2025. As of June 30, 2025, the bank reported a net profit of Rp20.5 billion, a 115% increase from the previous year's loss, and a 170.70% rise in net interest income to Rp665.29 billion.

title: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) Announces Rp9.3 Trillion Interim Dividend for FY 2025
body: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) will distribute an interim dividend of Rp9.3 trillion, representing about 24.7% of its September 30, 2025 profit of Rp37.73 trillion, equating to a dividend of Rp100 per share for at least 93.33 billion shares after accounting for treasury stock. The dividend was approved by the board of commissioners on December 18, 2025 and is not expected to have a material impact on the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition, or continuity.

title: Bumi Resources completes Rp346.93 billion purchase of Jubilee Metals Limted, increasing its stake to 64.98%
body: On 18 December 2025, Bumi Resources bought 3.31 million shares of Jubilee Metals Limted for Rp346.93 billion (≈AUD31.47 million), raising its ownership to 64.98% as part of a diversification strategy beyond coal. Over the preceding five trading days, Bumi Resources' share price fell about 6.6% to around Rp340, down from Rp364 on 12 December 2025.

title: Multitrend (BABY) to acquire Emway Globalindo (EGI) via a Rp269.98 billion transaction funded by a rights issue and in‑kind contribution from Blooming Years Pte Ltd
body: Multitrend (BABY) will acquire Emway Globalindo (EGI) for Rp139.99 billion and receive an in‑kind contribution of Rp129.98 billion from Blooming Years Pte Ltd, financing the deal with a Rp140.75 billion rights issue of 238,571,825 new shares at Rp590 each. The acquisition, pending shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 26 January 2026, is expected to boost scale, stable revenue, EBITDA growth and strategic positioning.

title: Kimia Farma (KAEF) Executes Rp3.49 Trillion Asset Guarantee Transaction with Multiple Banks
body: Kimia Farma (KAEF) completed a Rp3.49 trillion transaction covering fixed assets, inventory and receivables, structured as a guarantee agreement with banks including Bank BNI (BBNI), Bank BJB (BJBR), Bank Maybank Indonesia (BNII), Bank Syariah Indonesia (BRIS), Bank BRI (BBRI), Bank Jakarta, Bank Jakarta Unit Syariah, Bank Permata (BNLI), Bank QNB Indonesia and Bank Muamalat Indonesia. The transaction, approved by an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 17 December 2024, is excluded from material transaction thresholds and is not expected to negatively affect the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition or business continuity.

title: Chandra Asri (TPIA) to Issue Rp1.5 Trillion Bonds as First Phase of Rp6 Trillion Sustainable Program
body: Chandra Asri (TPIA) plans to issue Rp1.5 trillion in bonds, the initial stage of a Rp6 trillion sustainable bond program, with the proceeds designated for working capital, including raw material purchases. These bonds, rated idAA- by Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (Pefindo) and offered in three series (3, 5, and 7 years), involve 7 underwriters including BCA Sekuritas, BNI Sekuritas, and Mandiri Sekuritas.

title: Pelabuhan Semayang Balikpapan's Ro-Ro Terminal Becomes a Significant Revenue Driver for PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk (IPCC) Amidst IKN Development
body: The Ro-Ro terminal at Pelabuhan Semayang Balikpapan, operated by PT Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal Tbk (IPCC), has become a significant revenue source and a vital logistics gateway for the Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) project, handling an average of 80 ships monthly. From January to November 2025, the terminal recorded high productivity, including 97,458 units of cars, 50,673 units of trucks/buses, 22,276 units of motorcycles, 5,584 units of heavy equipment, and 40,667 M3 of general cargo.

title: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Targets Over 25% Wholesale Fiber Market Share Post-Spin-off to InfraNexia
body: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) aims to increase its wholesale fiber connectivity market share from 16% to above 25% by transferring business and assets to PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF) or InfraNexia, expecting to boost efficiency and competitiveness and target a valuation above Rp 100 trillion. While InfraNexia's assets currently stand at Rp 35 trillion and are targeted to reach Rp 90 trillion post-spin-off, PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk has not yet decided on an Initial Public Offering for InfraNexia, keeping options open for IPO or strategic partnership after the spin-off process is complete.

title: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Officially Transfers Wholesale Fiber Connectivity Assets to Subsidiary PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF) or InfraNexia
body: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) has formally signed the deed to separate a portion of its wholesale fiber connectivity business and assets, valued at approximately Rp35 trillion in the first stage, to its subsidiary PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF) or InfraNexia. This move is part of Telkom's transformation into a strategic holding company, with InfraNexia's total asset value projected to reach Rp90 trillion upon full completion of the spin-off.

title: PT PP (Persero) Tbk Updates on Merger Progress with PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk, Targeting 2026 Completion and Core Business Focus
body: PT PP (Persero) Tbk (PTPP) reports that its merger with PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) is ongoing and coordinated with Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (BPI Danantara), targeting completion by 2026, with current readiness at 40-50%. PTPP will focus on construction as its core business, aiming for Rp16 trillion in revenue and Rp23.5 trillion in new contracts by 2026, and recently secured a Rp501.99 billion project for the Bengkulu Provincial People's School Development.

title: PT Baramulti Suksessarana Tbk. (BSSR) announces USD20 million interim dividend II for FY 2025 with a 3.19% yield
body: The board approved a USD20 million interim dividend II for FY 2025, equal to Rp127,41448 per share (based on the BI mid‑rate of Rp16,669/USD) representing a 32.5% payout of the nine‑month net profit of USD61,578 million. The dividend will be payable on 6 January 2026 (cum) with an ex‑date of 7 January 2026, implying a dividend yield of about 3.19% at the Friday closing price of Rp3,990.

title: Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources Socializes Government Regulation No. 39/2025 to Boost Legal Certainty and Mining Inclusivity
body: The Directorate General of Minerals and Coal held a socialization of Government Regulation No. 39/2025, amending PP No. 96/2021 and introducing Ministerial Regulation No. 18/2025, to address legal dynamics and resource management challenges. The regulation is built on four pillars: constitutional alignment, adaptive legal frameworks, accelerated SME and community mining participation, and strengthened investment climate for the mineral and coal sectors.

title: Alliex expands daily transaction‑based credit profiling for MSMEs to Indonesia
body: Alliex, a Vietnam‑based payment infrastructure and financial data provider, is extending its daily‑transaction credit profiling model—already used in Vietnam—to Indonesia’s more than 65 million MSMEs, aiming to improve financing access without collateral. The company also announced plans for revenue‑based financing products, AI‑driven credit assessments, and regional partnerships, appointing Yudai Ishikawa as financial strategy adviser and Tovic Rustam of the Sakuranesia Foundation as a strategic connector.

title: Indonesia's Agriculture Minister warns against food price manipulation as stock levels rise
body: Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman said the government will sanction any actors selling food commodities above the highest retail price (HET) amid ample national stocks of chicken, eggs, rice and cooking oil, and announced tighter supervision during the upcoming holiday period. He emphasized the goal of keeping farmers profitable, merchants viable, and consumers satisfied while maintaining price stability.

title: PT Asuransi Maximus Graha Persada Tbk reports strong premium growth and improved claim performance in Q3 2025
body: In the first nine months of 2025, PT Asuransi Maximus Graha Persada Tbk (ASMI) achieved a 45% year‑on‑year increase in gross premiums while gross claims improved by about 15%, supported by higher solvency (162.74%) and liquidity (150.83%) ratios. Management highlighted prudent underwriting, IFRS 17 implementation, product revamps, and a strategic focus on the conventional business, with no dividend or corporate actions planned in the near term.

title: PT Bank UOB Indonesia launches Rp500 billion Subordinated Sustainable Bond IV Phase II 2026 with 6.5% annual coupon
body: The bank will issue a Rp500 billion subordinated bond, part of a Rp2 trillion sustainable series, bearing a 6.5% annual interest payable quarterly and maturing with a bullet payment on 9 January 2033; proceeds will be used to expand credit and meet POJK No.5/2024 capital requirements. The offering runs 5‑6 January 2026, with allocation on 7 January, listing on the IDX on 12 January, and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, Indo Premier Sekuritas and Kay Hian Sekuritas as underwriters, while PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk acts as trustee.

title: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk announces 2025 interim dividend of Rp4.40 per share amid strong financial results
body: The company declared an interim dividend of Rp4.40 per share (≈Rp23.25 billion) payable on 15 January 2026, with record dates in early January. For Q3 2025, revenue rose 15.5% year‑on‑year to Rp1.09 trillion and net profit increased 16.16% to Rp140.67 billion, driven by its ship‑service operations and sustainability initiatives.

title: PT Bank Oke Indonesia Tbk (OK Bank) Responds to OJK Capital Requirement Request
body: The bank confirmed it is reviewing options such as a rights issue, strategic investors, or M&A to meet OJK’s call for small banks to increase core Tier 1 capital, which currently stands at Rp3.73 trillion, below the Rp6 trillion threshold. No detailed plan or timeline has been set pending OJK’s guidance.

title: PT Zyrexindo Mandiri Buana Tbk responds to allegations of involvement in the Ministry of Education Chromebook procurement corruption case
body: The company, through Director Timothy Siddik, said its Chromebook supply to Kemendikbudristek was priced at market rates and complied with relevant procurement regulations, and prosecutors have listed PT Zyrexindo Mandiri Buana among firms allegedly enriched with Rp41.18 billion. Other firms cited include PT Supertone (SPC), PT Asus Technology Indonesia (ASUS), PT Tera Data Indonesia (AXIOO), PT Lenovo Indonesia, PT Hewlett‑Packard Indonesia (Hp), PT Gyra Inti Jaya (Libera), PT Evercoss Technology Indonesia (Evercross), PT Dell Indonesia, PT Bangga Teknologi Indonesia (Advan), PT Acer Indonesia and PT Bhinneka Mentari Dimensi.

title: PT Permodalan Nasional Madani announces Phase II sustainable bond and Phase III sustainable sukuk offerings targeting Rp2 trillion in 2026
body: The company will issue the Orange Sustainable Social Vision Bond I Phase II (Rp500 billion split into two series with 5.5% and 5.98% coupons maturing in 2029 and 2031) and the Orange Sustainable Social Vision Sukuk Mudharabah I Phase III (Rp1.5 trillion across three floating profit‑sharing series maturing in 2027, 2029 and 2031), with the public offering set for 5‑9 January 2026 and a BEI listing on 15 January 2026. The issuance is underwritten by PT Bahana Sekuritas, PT BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, PT Indo Premier Sekuritas, PT Mandiri Sekuritas and PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk.

title: Mayora Indah postpones its 2025 bond issuance schedule and adjusts maturity dates for Series A and B
body: Mayora Indah (MYOR) announced that the public offering, allocation, distribution, and listing of its Rp827.54 billion bond issue are shifted to mid‑December 2025, moving the Series A maturity to 23 December 2030 and Series B to 23 December 2032. The bonds comprise a Rp363.52 billion Series A at a fixed 5.85% annual coupon for five years and a Rp464.02 billion Series B at 6.15% for seven years, with all net proceeds to be loaned to its subsidiary Torabika Eka Semesta (TES) for working‑capital purposes.

title: Bank Banten (Perseroda) becomes part of the Kelompok Usaha Bank (KUB) BPD Jatim (Bank Jatim) effective 15 December 2025
body: Bank Banten (Perseroda) officially joined the Kelompok Usaha Bank (KUB) BPD Jatim, with Bank Jatim becoming its second controlling shareholder as of 15 December 2025. The partnership is expected to provide capital, liquidity, risk‑management, service quality, product synergies and digitalisation support to strengthen Bank Banten’s growth and sustainability.

title: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk Holds Extraordinary General Meeting, Approves New Board and Asset Pledge after PT PIMSF Pulogadung Becomes Majority Shareholder
body: On December 19, 2025, PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk (GPSO) held an extraordinary shareholders' meeting where PT PIMSF Pulogadung was confirmed as the majority shareholder with 48.95% (326,369,600 shares) and the board was reshuffled, appointing five new directors and commissioners. The meeting also approved remuneration limits (no more than a 5% increase) and authorized pledging over half of the company's assets to secure a 12‑month loan facility.

title: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk. (IPCM) announces interim cash dividend of Rp4.4 per share for FY2025
body: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk. (IPCM) will pay an interim cash dividend of Rp4.4 per share, totaling Rp23.25 billion, representing a 16.53% payout ratio and about a 1.22% dividend yield based on the closing price of Rp360. The dividend dates are set for early January 2026, with the record date on 6 January 2026.

title: PT Darma Henwa Tbk secures a Rp1 trillion loan facility from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk
body: On 19 December 2025, PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) signed a Rp1 trillion credit facility with PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BCA) comprising an Rp850 billion working‑capital loan (2‑year, 7% p.a.) and an Rp150 billion investment loan (5‑year, 7% p.a.) to fund new heavy‑equipment purchases, subcontractor takeover at PT Kaltim Prima Coal, and expansion of projects such as PT Arutmin Indonesia. The same day DEWA’s shares closed at Rp535, down 25 points, after trading between Rp565 and Rp525 with a volume of 570,817 million shares.

title: PT Logindo Samudramakmur Tbk (LEAD) sells two support vessels to non‑affiliated buyers, using proceeds to repay debt and strengthen its balance sheet
body: LEAD disposed of the Logindo Progress vessel for USD2.5 million to Clare Finance Corp on 24 Nov 2025 and the Logindo Stature vessel for USD5.85 million to PT Oceanindo Prima Sarana on 21 Nov 2025, with the cash earmarked for partial loan repayment. At the end of Q3 2025 the company reported assets of USD106.44 million, liabilities of USD60.85 million, a net profit decline to USD879.36 k and a share price increase of 20 points to Rp109.

title: BEI ends special monitoring and FCA status for PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET) and PT Pudjiadi Prestige Tbk (PUDP), shares drop sharply
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) lifted the special monitoring and Full Call Auction (FCA) status of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET) and PT Pudjiadi Prestige Tbk (PUDP) effective 18 December 2025. Following the change, INET fell 14.71% to Rp725 and PUDP slipped 7.69% to Rp1,020, while Samuel Sekuritas had previously maintained a Spec‑BUY recommendation for INET with a target price of Rp1,350.

title: President Prabowo oversees mass signing of 50,030 subsidized home loans and symbolic key handovers in Banten
body: On December 20, 2025, President Prabowo Subianto attended a nationwide event in Banten where 50,030 People’s Housing Credit (KPR) loans were signed across 33 provinces, accompanied by the handover of house keys to ten low‑income beneficiaries. The Ministry of Public Works and Housing reported that the Housing Financing Liquidity Facility has now funded 263,017 subsidized housing units worth Rp32.67 trillion, involving 39 banks, 22 developer associations and nearly 8,000 housing developments.

title: Indonesia to auction eight new oil and gas blocks next week to boost upstream exploration
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources will hold a third-round auction of eight oil and gas blocks, part of a broader offering of 75 blocks aimed at attracting investment and offsetting declining production from existing fields. The blocks are mainly in central and eastern Indonesia, and the government expects bidders with prior joint study data to dominate the auction.

title: Indonesia plans seven new PT Pupuk Indonesia fertilizer plants to cut prices by 20%
body: Coordinating Minister for Food Zulkifli Hasan announced that PT Pupuk Indonesia will build seven new fertilizer plants over the next five years, aiming to lower retail fertilizer prices by 20% for farmers. The fertilizer subsidy budget will stay near Rp45‑46 trillion (about US$2.6‑2.7 billion), and early subsidy distribution is expected to reduce financing costs while allowing the new factories without increasing state subsidies.

title: Indonesia's capital market raised Rp255.62 trillion through IPOs, bonds, sukuk and rights issues up to Dec 2025
body: Up to 19 December 2025, the Indonesian stock exchange recorded total fundraising of Rp255.62 trillion, comprising Rp18.11 trillion from 26 IPOs, Rp209.4 trillion from 178 bond and sukuk issuances by 79 issuers, and Rp28.11 trillion from 14 rights issues. The most recent transactions were the IPO of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA), a bond/sukuk issuance by BSD, and a rights issue by PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk (PANI).

title: PT GTS Internasional Tbk outlines $200 million capex plan to expand midstream and downstream LNG operations and monetize stranded gas
body: The company announced a transformation program called “Rising the New GTSI, Driving Energy as One,” targeting growth in midstream and downstream segments, including fleet optimization, LNG logistics, and mini‑LNG plants to monetize stranded gas, with projected capex of up to US$200 million. It also highlighted the role of natural gas in Indonesia’s energy transition and its contribution to net‑zero emission goals.

title: Bank Mandiri appoints veteran banker Zulkifli Zaini as new independent commissioner after 12-year hiatus
body: At its extraordinary shareholders meeting on 19 December, Bank Mandiri announced the return of former CEO Zulkifli Zaini as an independent commissioner, pending OJK approval, alongside the appointment of M. Rudy Salahuddin Ramto as Vice Commissioner, Luky Alfirman as Commissioner, and B. Bintoro Kunto Pardewo as Independent Commissioner. Zulkifli’s career includes prior leadership roles at Bank Mandiri, PLN, BNI, Bank Permata, and PT Perkebunan Nasional III (Persero).

title: Only 26 IPOs recorded on the Indonesia Stock Exchange in 2025, with PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk the latest new listing
body: By Dec 19, 2025, the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) has logged just 26 IPOs, far below the 40 new listings recorded by the same date in 2024, and the most recent debut was PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) on Dec 17. BEI reports nine additional companies in its pipeline across various sectors, but no further listing ceremony is anticipated at present.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa divests 316.5 million Impack Pratama shares for approximately Rp945 billion
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa completed the sale of 316.5 million Impack Pratama shares on 17‑18 December 2025 at an average price of Rp2,975 per share, raising about Rp944.7 billion, which is roughly 24.2 % below the stock’s average closing price of Rp3,695. The transaction lowered Harimas’s stake to 20.69 billion shares (37.70 % of Impack Pratama), a dilution of about 0.57 %, and management said it realizes the investment and increases free float.

title: Avian Brands (AVIA) to permanently cease operations of Multipro Paint Indonesia (MPI) from Dec 20, 2025
body: Avian Brands (AVIA) announced the permanent shutdown of its 67%-owned subsidiary Multipro Paint Indonesia (MPI) effective Dec 20, 2025, after sustained operating losses and a revenue contribution of just 0.55% in 2024. The company says the closure will not adversely affect its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity and will allow it to focus on its core businesses.

title: Energi Mega Persada secures $15 million credit facility for Energi Mega Pratama
body: Energi Mega Persada (ENRG) arranged a USD 15 million loan from Indies Special Opportunities IV Ltd (ISO IV) to fund its subsidiary Energi Mega Pratama (EMPI), with guarantors including Energy Mega Persada Pte Ltd (EMPPL), Kangean Energy Indonesia Ltd (KEIL), EMP Exploration (Kangean) Limited (EEKL) and GLAS Agency (Singapore) Pte Limited and GLAS Trust (Singapore) Ltd. The transaction, deemed immaterial, will not negatively affect the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition or business continuity, according to Vice President Edoardus Ardianto.

title: Bumi Resources completes 64.98% acquisition of Jubilee Metals, targeting gold production from 2026 as part of its 50:50 coal‑non‑coal EBITDA diversification plan.
body: Bumi Resources (BUMI) finalized the purchase of a 64.98% stake in Jubilee Metals Limited (JML), an Australian gold miner slated to begin operations in July 2026 and produce about 9,890 ounces of gold that year. The deal supports BUMI’s strategy to achieve a 50:50 split between thermal coal and non‑coal assets by 2031, complementing its earlier full acquisition of Wolfram Limited, which is expected to restart copper production in June 2026 with an estimated 9,334 ton output.

title: Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa (RISE) targets growth in 2026 with new hospitality projects and rising revenues
body: RISE plans to launch Solaris Villa Bali Bites and Solaris Villa (Extension) Malang in Q1 2026 to expand its hospitality and lifestyle asset portfolio, while emphasizing disciplined financial management and project execution. For the quarter ended Q3‑2025, the company reported revenue of Rp294 billion, a 31% year‑on‑year increase.

title: Indonesian Ministry of Transportation imposes traffic controls at Merak Ferry Port during holiday surge
body: To ease congestion caused by Christmas and New Year travel and strong winds in the Sunda Strait, the ministry activated delaying systems, buffer zones and vehicle screening, deploying larger‑capacity vessels at Merak Port and coordinating with PT ASDP Indonesia Ferry, regional transport agencies and the police. Tickets remain valid for passengers affected by the delays.

title: BUMA Australia extends AUD740 million Blackwater contract with Whitehaven until 2030
body: BUMA Australia Pty Ltd, a subsidiary of Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama (BUMA) under BUMA Internasional Grup (DOID), has renewed its multi‑year contract with Blackwater Operations Pty Ltd (Blackwater) and Whitehaven Coal Mining Limited (Whitehaven) for AUD740 million, extending operations at the Blackwater mine in Queensland through June 2030. The extension secures long‑term revenue, supports around 390 permanent staff, and enhances local employment and community programs, including initiatives for First Nations peoples.

title: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) announces a Rp9.32 trillion interim dividend representing 24.7% of Q3 2025 profit
body: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) will distribute an interim dividend of Rp9.32 trillion, equivalent to a per‑share payout of Rp100 and covering at least 93.33 billion shares, based on a Q3 2025 net profit of Rp37.73 trillion. The dividend schedule runs from the record date on 7 January 2026 to payment on 14 January 2026, following board approval on 18 December 2025.

title: Elang Mahkota alias Emtek (EMTK) executives absorb Rp34.22 billion of MESOP shares in private placement
body: Six directors of Elang Mahkota alias Emtek (EMTK) exercised the Management and Employee Stock Option Program (MESOP) to acquire a total of 31.2 million shares worth Rp34.22 billion at Rp1,097 per share, part of a private placement of 34.7 million shares that raised fresh capital of Rp38.06 billion. After the transaction, the company's total outstanding shares increased to 61.42 billion.

title: Merdeka Battery Materials (MBMA) provides a USD9 million loan facility to its 60%‑owned subsidiary Huaneng Metal Industry
body: On 15 December 2025, Merdeka Battery Materials (MBMA) signed a USD9 million loan facility for its subsidiary Huaneng Metal Industry, which will be used for general corporate purposes, capital expenditures, operations and working capital. The affiliate transaction follows internal pricing procedures comparable to non‑affiliated deals and is expected to generate indirect value for Merdeka Battery Materials shareholders.

title: Super Bank Indonesia (SUPA) reports strong financial growth and achieves KBMI 2 capital standards after its IPO
body: Through November 2025, Super Bank Indonesia (SUPA) posted pre‑tax profit of Rp122.4 billion, with net interest income rising 165% YoY to Rp1.4 trillion and total assets expanding 69% YoY to Rp18.0 trillion; its digital platform served over 5 million customers and more than 1 million daily transactions. The bank’s core capital exceeded Rp6 trillion, allowing it to meet the KBMI 2 criteria and position itself for further expansion as a public company.

title: Softbank Ventura Indonesia sells 100 million Nanotech Indonesia Global shares, cutting its stake to 5.95%
body: Softbank Ventura Indonesia divested 100 million Nanotech Indonesia Global shares on 18 December 2025, a transaction facilitated by Mandiri Sekuritas (Mansek) with an undisclosed price (estimated at Rp4.7 billion using the Rp47 per share level). After the sale, Softbank’s holding fell to 255 million shares (5.95% of total), down from 355 million (8.28%), while Nanotech Investama holds 59.51% and the public holds 32.21%.

title: Perintis Triniti Properti’s controllers shift 227.6 million shares to President Prabowo’s niece, advancing a staged 20% acquisition plan
body: The controlling shareholders of Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) transferred a total of 227.57 million shares to Rahayu Saraswati D Djojohadikusumo, the niece of President Prabowo Subianto, with Kunci Daud Indonesia selling 150.19 million shares and Intan Investama Internasional selling 77.37 million shares through Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia. The divestments reduce Kunci Daud Indonesia’s stake to 36.34% (1.65 billion shares) and Intan Investama Internasional’s to 29.73% (1.35 billion shares) as part of Rahayu’s staged plan to acquire up to 20% of the company, beginning with a 5% purchase signed on 2 December 2025.

title: Mutuagung Lestari approves 10% private placement to fund 2026 expansion plans
body: The company will issue 314.28 million new shares at a nominal Rp25 each, representing 10% of total shares, after shareholder approval on Dec 18 2025. Proceeds will be allocated to capital expenditures such as halal, cosmetics, herbal, and gold‑mineral laboratories to strengthen its TIC position.

title: PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk secures strategic Patimban Access Toll Road Package I contract with ADHI–NRC KSO
body: The ADHI–NRC KSO consortium signed a construction agreement with PT Jasamarga Akses Patimban on 18 December 2025 to build the 7.10‑km Package I of the Patimban Access Toll Road, slated to start in Q1 2026 with a 16‑month schedule. The project, part of the National Strategic Projects, will include the Cipeundeuy interchange linking the Subang Smartpolitan industrial zone and will be operated and maintained by BUJT PT Jasamarga Akses Patimban after completion.

title: PT Boston Furniture Industries Tbk. renames to PT Solusi Environment Asia Tbk. and appoints new directors and commissioners following Asia Investment Capital's takeover
body: Shareholders approved at the AGM on 18 December the change of name from PT Boston Furniture Industries Tbk. to PT Solusi Environment Asia Tbk. (SOFA) and the appointment of Denny Rizal as President Director, Ezra Mohammed Dhanagun as Director, Romario Beckenbauer as President Commissioner and Djoko Hendratto as Commissioner. The changes will take effect after receiving all required regulator approvals.

title: PT Multi Artha Pratama exercises part of its rights issue in PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk, causing dilution and prompting insider share purchases in PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk
body: PT Multi Artha Pratama (MAP) subscribed approximately 385.35 million new shares of PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk (PANI) at Rp12,975 per share, a transaction worth about Rp5 trillion that reduced MAP’s direct ownership from 87.78% to 84.08% while PANI aims to raise up to Rp15.73 trillion. In a related insider transaction, PANI bought 225.53 million shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk (CBDK), raising its stake to 18.14% and decreasing PT Agung Sedayu’s holding to 17.61%.

title: PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk Secures Rp4.85 Trillion Credit Facility from PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
body: PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk (ANJT) obtained a Rp4.85 trillion term loan facility from PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) on December 19, with a 7.5% annual interest rate and tenor until March 2037, to support the financial management and operational needs of its four subsidiaries. This transaction is deemed material as its value exceeds 50% of the company's equity per December 2024, following ANJT's acquisition by First Resources Limited (FRL), owned by Keluarga Fangiono, in May 2025.

title: PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industri Tbk. (IKAI) Strengthens Ownership in Subsidiary PT Internusa Keramik Alamasri Through Debt-to-Equity Conversion
body: PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industri Tbk. (IKAI) increased its ownership in subsidiary PT Internusa Keramik Alamasri by converting debt into 13,085,533 new shares, valued at Rp130.86 billion, on December 18, 2025. This action raised IKAI's stake to 90.75% of PT Internusa Keramik Alamasri, aiming to strengthen the subsidiary's capital structure without material impact on the parent company.

title: PT Garuda Multi Investama Increases Stake in PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk. (BOLT) Through Rp45 Billion Crossing Transaction
body: PT Garuda Multi Investama, the controlling shareholder of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk. (BOLT), acquired 45 million BOLT shares for Rp45 billion at Rp1,000 per share on December 12, 2025, increasing its direct ownership to 59.52%. This transaction, which saw UOB Kay Hian reduce its stake by the same amount, occurred as BOLT's shares closed down 2.45% on December 19, 2025.

title: PT Jasa Marga Tbk. (JSMR) Holds RUPSLB to Approve Management Changes and Appointments
body: PT Jasa Marga Tbk. (JSMR) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on December 17, 2025, with a quorum representing 86.87% of valid voting shares. The RUPSLB approved the dismissal of Mohammad Agus Setiawan, changes in director nomenclature, and appointed Ari Respati as Director of Business Development, Yaya Ruhiya as Director of Services, and Tedi Kurniawan as Independent Commissioner.

title: Dedie Suherlan Boosts Stake in Trisula International Tbk
body: Dedie Suherlan acquired 350,000,000 shares of Trisula International Tbk (TRIS.JK) on December 23, 2025, at a price of IDR 200 per share. This transaction increased his total holdings from 157,072,000 shares to 507,072,000 shares.

title: Trisula Insan Tiara Sells 200 Million TRIS Shares
body: Trisula Insan Tiara has sold 200,000,000 shares of Trisula International Tbk (TRIS.JK) at a price of IDR 200.0 per share. This transaction, dated December 22, 2025, amounted to a total value of IDR 40,000,000,000. Following the sale, Trisula Insan Tiara's holdings in Trisula International Tbk decreased from 711,666,800 shares to 511,666,800 shares.

title: Buana Graha Utama Buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama bought shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk (MICE.JK) at approximately IDR 589, increasing holdings from 287,017,218 to 287,146,518. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Henry Liem Sells AKPI.JK Shares
body: Henry Liem sold 5,600 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) on December 23, 2025, at a price of IDR 575 per share. Following this transaction, his holdings in the company decreased from 15,506,059 shares to 15,500,459 shares.

title: Buana Graha Utama Boosts Multi Indocitra Tbk Holdings
body: Buana Graha Utama has increased its stake in Multi Indocitra Tbk (MICE.JK) by purchasing 129,300 shares. The transaction, executed on December 22, 2025, was priced at an average of IDR 588,867 per share. This acquisition raises Buana Graha Utama's total holdings from 287,017,218 shares to 287,146,518 shares.

title: Sudjono Boosts BFI Finance Indonesia (BFIN.JK) Holdings
body: Sudjono acquired 5,000,000 shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk (BFIN.JK) on December 22, 2025, at a price of IDR 702.0 per share. This transaction increased Sudjono's total ownership from 30,000,000 shares to 35,000,000 shares. The total value of the shares purchased amounted to IDR 3,510,000,000.

title: Karya Dwimanunggal Sejahtera Sells 500 Million Shares of Trisula International
body: Karya Dwimanunggal Sejahtera sold 500,000,000 shares of Trisula International Tbk (TRIS.JK) at IDR 200 per share, valuing the transaction at IDR 100,000,000,000. This sale reduced their holdings from 980,120,000 shares to 480,120,000 shares, marking a decrease of 500,000,000 shares in their stake.

title: Endang Tardiana Buy Shares of PT Garuda Maintenance Facility Aero Asia Tbk
body: Endang Tardiana bought shares of PT Garuda Maintenance Facility Aero Asia Tbk (GMFI.JK) at approximately IDR 148. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Yessie Dianty Yosetya Increases Stake in PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: Yessie Dianty Yosetya, a key figure at PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL.JK), acquired 30,000 shares of the company on December 23, 2025. The transaction was executed at a price of IDR 3,790 per share. This purchase increased her total holdings from 1,839,700 shares to 1,869,700 shares.

title: Dedie Suherlan Increases Stake in Trisula International Tbk
body: Dedie Suherlan acquired 350,000,000 shares of Trisula International Tbk (TRIS.JK) on December 23, 2025, at a price of IDR 200 per share. This transaction significantly increased his holdings from 157,072,000 shares to 507,072,000 shares.

title: Henry Liem Sells 5,600 AKPI Shares
body: Henry Liem sold 5,600 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 575 per share. Following this transaction, his total holdings in the company decreased from 15,506,059 shares to 15,500,459 shares.

title: Andreas Utomo Sells 6.9 Million Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK)
body: Andreas Utomo sold 6,916,700 shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK) on December 23, 2025. The transaction was executed at a price of IDR 279.39 per share. Following this sale, Utomo's holdings decreased from 117,793,100 shares to 110,876,400 shares.

title: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra Increases Stake in PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
body: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra acquired 200,000 shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk (ISSP.JK) on December 23, 2025. The transaction was executed at a price of IDR 442 per share. This purchase increased Cakra Bhakti Para Putra's total holdings from 4,138,367,530 shares to 4,138,567,530 shares.

title: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia Establishes IDR 736,843,000 Holding in DGWG.JK
body: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia has established a holding of IDR 736,843,000 in PT Delta Giri Wacana Tbk (DGWG.JK). This transaction, categorized as "others," involved an equivalent amount of IDR 736,843,000. The holding was recorded on December 23, 2025.

title: Kiky Suherlan Increases Stake in Trisula International with IDR 70 Billion Share Purchase
body: Kiky Suherlan acquired 350,000,000 shares of Trisula International Tbk (TRIS.JK) at a price of IDR 200 per share. This transaction, valued at IDR 70,000,000,000, increased his total holdings from 157,072,000 shares to 507,072,000 shares. The purchase significantly expanded Kiky Suherlan's stake in the company.

title: Kiky Suherlan Boosts Stake in Trisula International Tbk
body: On December 22, 2025, Kiky Suherlan acquired 350,000,000 shares of Trisula International Tbk (TRIS.JK) at a price of IDR 200 per share. This transaction increased Suherlan's total holdings from 157,072,000 shares to 507,072,000 shares.

title: Rudy Susanto Wijaya Buys Shares of PT Prima Multi Usaha Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudy Susanto Wijaya acquired 148,314,200 shares of PT Prima Multi Usaha Indonesia Tbk (PMUI.JK) at IDR 180 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases his total holding from 4,640,000,000 to 4,788,314,200 shares. The purchase signifies continued investment in the company.

title: Trimegah Sumber Mas Sell Shares of PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk
body: Trimegah Sumber Mas sold 37,500,000 shares of PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk (UVCR.JK) at IDR 113 per share. This transaction, totaling IDR 4,237,500,000, was for company investment and internal requirements. The sale reduces Trimegah Sumber Mas's holding from 862,057,467 to 824,557,467 shares, representing a decrease of 37,500,000 shares.

title: SLJ Global (SULI) Secures Unanimous Investor Approval for Private Placement of 632.07 Million Shares
body: SLJ Global (SULI) will proceed with a private placement of 632,077,684 shares, representing a maximum of 10% of its placed and fully paid capital, at a nominal value of Rp100 per share, which was unanimously approved by investors on December 19, 2025. This corporate action aims to strengthen the company's capital structure, enhance stock liquidity on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, diversify funding, and finance working capital, machine improvements, and business expansion.

title: Edwin Cheah Yew Hong Buy Shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk
body: Edwin Cheah Yew Hong acquired 200,000 shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (MDIY.JK) at IDR 1,010 per share for personal investment. This transaction increased his total holdings from 98,448,600 shares to 98,648,600 shares.

title: Rika Juniaty Tanzil Buy Shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk
body: Rika Juniaty Tanzil acquired 210,000 shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (MDIY.JK) for personal investment purposes. The transaction occurred at IDR 1,010 per share. Following this purchase, her total holdings increased from 645,500 to 855,500 shares, representing a net increase of 210,000 shares.

title: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk (PANI) Increases Stake in PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk (CBDK) to 85.95% for Rp14.6 Trillion
body: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk (PANI) acquired approximately 2.3 billion shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk (CBDK) from PT Agung Sedayu and PT Tunas Mekar Jaya for Rp14.6 trillion, increasing its direct ownership from 45.9% to 85.95%. This transaction, confirming the use of rights issue funds, saw PANI's shares drop 9.85% while CBDK's shares rose 1.69% on December 22.

title: Sudjono Bought Shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk
body: Sudjono acquired 5,000,000 shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk (BFIN.JK) at IDR 702.0 per share, totaling IDR 3,510,000,000. This 'buy' transaction, classified as an investment, increases his total holdings from 30,000,000 to 35,000,000 shares. The transaction occurred on December 19, 2025, with the filing dated December 23, 2025.

title: Sujaka Lays Sell Shares of PT Black Diamond Resources Tbk
body: Sujaka Lays sold 55,000,000 shares of PT Black Diamond Resources Tbk (COAL.JK) at IDR 96.0 per share due to personal considerations. This transaction reduced his total holdings from 2,305,863,300 shares to 2,250,863,300 shares, a decrease of 55,000,000 shares. The transaction occurred on December 22, 2025.

title: PT Bank IBK Indonesia Tbk Addresses BEI Inquiry on KBMI 1 Abolition, Targets KBMI 2 with Organic Capital Growth
body: PT Bank IBK Indonesia Tbk (IBK Bank) responded to Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) regarding Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK)'s KBMI 1 abolition plan, stating it will comply with OJK regulations. With core capital at Rp5.7 trillion as of September 30, 2025, IBK Bank aims to reach the KBMI 2 requirement of Rp6 trillion after 2026 through organic capital, leveraging estimated profits of Rp210 billion in 2025 and Rp210 billion in 2026.

title: Andy Totong Buy Shares of Catur Sentosa Adiprana Tbk
body: Andy Totong acquired 12,633,575 shares of Catur Sentosa Adiprana Tbk (CSAP.JK) at IDR 300 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increased his total holdings from 3,124,725 shares to 15,758,300 shares, indicating a significant increase in his stake in the company.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan divested 15,805,300 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). The transactions occurred on December 4, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 89 to IDR 100 per share. Following this divestment, Jemmy Kurniawan's holding decreased from 1,037,305,300 shares to 1,021,500,000 shares.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan divested 4,770,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). The transactions occurred on December 5, 2025, with sales prices ranging from IDR 96.0 to IDR 98.0 per share. Following the divestment, Jemmy Kurniawan's holding decreased from 1,021,500,000 shares to 1,016,730,000 shares, representing a net reduction of 4,770,000 shares. This transaction signifies a reduction in Jemmy Kurniawan's stake in the company.

title: Budi Aditya Erna Mulyanto buys Shares of PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk
body: Budi Aditya Erna Mulyanto acquired 500,000 shares of PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk (PPRI.JK) for long-term investment. The transaction, executed at IDR 279.0 per share, increased holdings from 146,671,500 to 147,171,500 shares, a net increase of 500,000 shares. This purchase signifies continued confidence in the company's long-term prospects by a significant shareholder.

title: Indonesian Shrimp Industry Faces Crisis Following Cesium 137 Contamination of PT Bahari Makmur Sejati Exports
body: A shrimp consignment from PT Bahari Makmur Sejati (BMS), doing business as BMS Foods, was found contaminated with Cesium 137, prompting the US FDA to red-list the company and issue an advisory, leading to a 30-35% decrease in shrimp absorption from farmers and prices falling by up to 35%.
