This incident jeopardizes Indonesia's $1.7 billion shrimp export industry, which is the world's fifth-largest and heavily reliant on the US market, putting millions of households at risk.

title: Indonesia's Unexpected Rate Cut Raises Investor Concerns Over Central Bank Independence and Rupiah Stability Amid Growth Push
body: Global investors are increasingly nervous about Indonesian assets following Bank Indonesia's unexpected interest rate cut, which raises concerns about the central bank's independence amid President Prabowo's push for ambitious growth targets. This decision, coupled with a "burden sharing" deal and proposed bill amendments, has led to the rupiah slipping 3% in 2025 and widening bond yield spreads, fueling doubts about Indonesia's fiscal prudence and currency stability.

title: Asian Equities Rally on US Rate Cut Hopes and Indonesia's Economic Stimulus
body: Asian equities mostly rose, building on a rally fueled by US economic data indicating slowing jobs creation and a fall in the producer price index, which ramped up expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts. Jakarta notably jumped after Indonesia's government announced plans to inject around $12 billion into the economy, contributing to broader gains across most Asian markets and the S&P 500, though some markets like Hong Kong experienced losses.

title: Satria Mega Kencana (SOTS) Plans Rights Issue of Up to 1.37 Billion Shares at Rp100 Nominal Value
body: Satria Mega Kencana (SOTS) is preparing a rights issue of up to 1,375,000,000 shares at a nominal value of Rp100 per share, pending investor approval on January 28, 2026, and an effective statement from Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK). The proceeds will be used to strengthen the capital structure and develop the company's business, aiming to improve profitability, competitiveness, and shareholder investment returns.

title: Sujaka Lays Reduces Stake in Black Diamond Resources for Rp72.84 Billion
body: Sujaka Lays sold 694.7 million shares of Black Diamond Resources between December 18-19, 2025, raising Rp72.84 billion. This transaction reduced his stake by 11.12% to 36.89%, with Black Diamond Resources noting the sale was for personal considerations.

title: Eastparc Hotel (EAST) to Distribute Rp23.1 Billion Interim Dividend
body: Eastparc Hotel (EAST) plans to distribute an interim dividend of Rp23.1 billion, equivalent to Rp5.6 per share, sourced from its Rp20.98 billion net profit and Rp23.16 billion in retained earnings as of September 30, 2025. The payment is scheduled for January 22, 2026, with the cum dividend date for the regular market on January 6, 2026, ex-dividend on January 7, 2025, and the recording date on January 8, 2026.

title: SINERGY Networks (INET) Secures OJK Approval for Rp3.2 Trillion Rights Issue to Fund FTTH and Submarine Cable Projects
body: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET) received OJK approval on December 23, 2025, for a Rights Issue (PM-HMETD I) and Waran Seri II issuance, targeting up to Rp3.2 trillion from 12.8 billion new shares at Rp250 per share. The proceeds will primarily fund large-scale digital infrastructure expansion, including FTTH development by PT Garuda Prima Internetindo (GPI) and submarine cable payments to PT JMP via PT Pusat Fiber Indonesia (PFI).

title: Buana Lintas Lautan (BULL) Expands LNG Fleet and Diversifies Business with New Tanker and 4-Pillar Strategy.
body: Buana Lintas Lautan (BULL) has welcomed its first LNG tanker, MT Gas Garuda, which will contribute to revenue from 2026 as part of its second strategic pillar for LNG transportation. The company is actively expanding its LNG fleet and diversifying its business through a 4-pillar strategy encompassing oil and gas transportation, FSRU, and FPSO/FSO, anticipating continued strong demand and charter rates in the LNG market.

title: Sumber Mas Konstruksi (SMKM) to Acquire 100% Stake in Panasia Aquaculture Pte. Ltd.
body: Sumber Mas Konstruksi (SMKM) signed a Conditional Sale and Purchase Agreement (CSPA) with Lim Shrimp Org Pte Ltd (LSO) on December 22, 2025, to acquire 100% of Panasia Aquaculture Pte. Ltd. The transaction, estimated up to USD100 million and set for completion by June 30, 2026, aims to support SMKM's business development in construction and aquaculture.

title: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd to Become New Controlling Shareholder of Agung Menjangan Mas by Acquiring 51% Stake
body: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd (Radiant) is set to become the new controlling shareholder of Agung Menjangan Mas (AMMS) by acquiring 51% of its shares, totaling 630,001,369 shares. This acquisition, expected to be completed by December 29, 2025, involves taking over shares from Mandara Mas Semesta and Hartono Limmantoro.

title: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra Buy Shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
body: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra acquired 3,556,300 shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk (ISSP.JK) at IDR 450 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increased their holding from 4,130,389,330 to 4,133,945,630 shares. The purchase reflects continued investment in the company.

title: Tan Rudy Eddywidjaja Buy Shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk
body: Tan Rudy Eddywidjaja acquired 800,000 shares of BFI Finance Indonesia Tbk (BFIN.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on December 4-5, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 755 to IDR 760 per share. Following these purchases, Tan Rudy Eddywidjaja's total holding increased from 206,000 shares to 1,006,000 shares, representing a significant increase in his stake in the company.

title: Charnic Capital Tbk Sell Shares of PT Fuji Finance Indonesia Tbk
body: Charnic Capital Tbk has sold 21,543,200 shares of PT Fuji Finance Indonesia Tbk for IDR 805 per share, totaling IDR 17,342,276,000. This transaction reduces Charnic Capital's holding from 85,532,400 shares to 63,989,200 shares. The stated purpose is 'Investment'. This represents a significant reduction in their stake in Fuji Finance Indonesia.

title: Cakra Buana Resources (CBRE) to Launch Right Issue for Capital Strengthening and Debt Conversion
body: Cakra Buana Resources (CBRE) plans a right issue of up to 48 billion shares at a nominal value of Rp25, approved on December 18, 2025, to bolster capital structure and attract investors. The funds will be allocated for working capital, fleet expansion (Capex), and partially for debt repayment, including the conversion of USD55 million in promissory notes from Hilong Shipping Holding Limited, Yafin Tandiono Tan, Saga Investama Sedaya, and Superkrane Mitra Utama into shares.

title: MNC Tourism Indonesia (KPIG) Completes Rp250 Billion Private Placement for KEK MNC Lido City Development
body: MNC Tourism Indonesia (KPIG) successfully completed a private placement on December 18, 2025, raising Rp250 billion through the issuance of 1.78 billion shares at Rp140 per share. These funds are primarily allocated for the development and construction of KEK MNC Lido City, including projects such as Trump Golf Clubhouse & Country Club and Hyatt Regency Lido Resort, aiming to strengthen the company's capital structure and enhance performance.

title: Galasco Investments Limited Sell Shares of PT Bank Mayapada Internasional Tbk
body: Galasco Investments Limited divested 639,253,600 shares of PT Bank Mayapada Internasional Tbk (MAYA.JK) at IDR 235 per share. This transaction reduces Galasco's stake from 1,499,488,261 shares to 860,234,661 shares, marking a significant divestment. The purpose stated is divestment, indicating a reduction in the entity's holding in the bank.

title: Nusantara Fmcg Limited Sell Shares of PT Kino Indonesia Tbk
body: Nusantara Fmcg Limited divested 128,534,700 shares of PT Kino Indonesia Tbk (KINO.JK) on December 9, 2025, at IDR 1,556 per share. This transaction reduced their holding from 160,371,700 shares to 31,837,000 shares, marking a significant divestment. The purpose is stated as divestment, impacting the company's ownership structure.

title: Yenny Hamidah Koean Buy Shares of PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk
body: Yenny Hamidah Koean acquired 1,634,391,000 shares of PT Mandiri Herindo Adiperkasa Tbk (MAHA.JK) through multiple buy transactions on December 9, 2025, at IDR 146 per share. The total transaction value was IDR 1,634,391,000. Her direct holding increased from 1,334,733,600 shares to 1,498,172,700 shares, representing a net increase of 163,439,100 shares. The stated purpose is investment.

title: PT Morris Capital Indonesia Launches Mandatory Tender Offer for PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk Shares Amidst Plans for Energy Sector Transformation
body: PT Morris Capital Indonesia (MCI) will conduct a Mandatory Tender Offer for PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk (PIPA) shares from December 23, 2025, to January 22, 2026, offering Rp 54.47 per share for up to 1,715,765,790 shares, totaling a maximum of Rp 93,457,762,581. Following its acquisition of 43.78% of PIPA, MCI plans to transform the company from a PVC building material producer into an integrated national energy distribution and logistics player.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sells shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan has divested 3,500,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). The transactions occurred on December 8, 2025, with sale prices of IDR 96.0 and IDR 97.0 per share. Following this divestment, Jemmy Kurniawan's holdings decreased from 1,016,730,000 shares to 1,013,230,000 shares. This action represents a reduction in ownership for the shareholder.

title: Ir. Gafur Sulistyo Umar Mba Sell Shares of PT Maharaksa Biru Energi Tbk
body: Ir. Gafur Sulistyo Umar Mba divested 300,000,000 shares of PT Maharaksa Biru Energi Tbk. The transaction occurred on December 5, 2025, at a price of IDR 200 per share. Following this sale, Mr. Umar's holdings decreased from 2,537,506,593 shares to 2,237,506,593 shares, representing a reduction of 300,000,000 shares. This divestment marks a decrease in his ownership stake in the company.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) Reports Strong Financial and Operational Growth Following Impressive Post-IPO Performance.
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) officially listed on the IDX on December 17, 2025, with its shares showing significant appreciation post-IPO, though experiencing a recent correction. By November 2025, the bank recorded a pre-tax profit of Rp122.4 billion, a 165% YoY increase in net interest income to Rp1.4 trillion, and substantial growth in DPK, credit, and total assets, while serving over 5 million customers.

title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) Plans Strategic Diversification into High-Value Property and Infrastructure Sectors from 2026.
body: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) is set to strategically expand into high-value-added property and infrastructure sectors, including logistic parks, data centers, and ultra-luxury hospitality, starting in Q1 2026. This diversification aims to strengthen long-term growth and increase recurring income, with Rahayu Saraswati Djojohadikusumo joining as President Commissioner to support the transformation.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com Buy Shares of PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk
body: 1 Inti Dot Com acquired 200,000 shares of PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk (MCAS.JK) at IDR 605 per share, totaling IDR 121,000,000. This investment increases their holding from 115,966,000 to 116,166,000 shares. The transaction signifies a minor increase in ownership by 1 Inti Dot Com.

title: Kino Investindo Buy Shares of PT Kino Indonesia Tbk
body: Kino Investindo acquired 128,534,700 shares of PT Kino Indonesia Tbk for approximately IDR 1556 per share. This transaction increases Kino Investindo's holding from 1,000,050,100 shares to 1,128,584,800 shares. The stated purpose is investment, indicating a continued strategic interest in the company.

title: PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk. (HEAL) Commissioner Hasmoro Increases Share Ownership for Investment
body: Hasmoro, President Commissioner of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk. (HEAL), acquired 2,816,000 shares in two stages on December 16 and 18, 2025, for approximately Rp3.90 billion, increasing his direct ownership to 4.90%. This investment coincided with HEAL's shares strengthening 2.19% to Rp1,400 per share on December 22.

title: Bank Of Singapore Limited Buy Shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk
body: Bank Of Singapore Limited acquired 2,800,000,000 shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk through a bought transaction at IDR 168 per share. This purchase increases Bank Of Singapore Limited's stake from 0 to 2,800,000,000 shares, representing a significant new holding in the company.

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk Prepares Rp19.67 Trillion Cash and Ensures Operational Readiness for Nataru 2025/2026.
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk (BTN) has allocated Rp19.67 trillion in cash for the Natal and Tahun Baru 2025/2026 holiday period, ensuring sufficient funds for customers and maintaining operational readiness across its extensive network of branches, ATMs, and digital platforms. This allocation is lower than the previous year due to Bank Indonesia's lower cash projection and BTN's increasing focus on non-cash and digital transactions, particularly through its "bale by BTN" super app.

title: Ascendia Capital Indonesia Acquires Shares in PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk from PT Lintas Benua
body: Ascendia Capital Indonesia acquired 144.6 million shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR) from PT Lintas Benua for Rp300 per share, totaling Rp43.4 billion, a price 75% lower than KETR's closing price. This transaction, conducted by PT Lintas Benua for cash needs, resulted in Ascendia Capital Indonesia holding a 5.09% stake, with KETR shares later strengthening by 12.83%.

title: Sentra Investa Maksima Sell Shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk
body: Sentra Investa Maksima sold 900,000 shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk (BMBL.JK) between November 27 and December 1, 2025. The transactions occurred at prices ranging from IDR 70 to IDR 84 per share. This sale reduced Sentra Investa Maksima's holding from 101,270,600 shares to 100,370,600 shares, a decrease of 900,000 shares. The stated purpose for this transaction is liquidity.

title: Dr Hasmoro Buy Shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk
body: Dr. Hasmoro acquired 1,429,000 shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk (HEAL.JK) for investment purposes. This transaction increased his holdings from 748,766,889 to 750,195,889 shares. The acquisition involved purchases at IDR 1,400 per share on November 28, 2025, and an additional 1,385,100 shares on December 9, 2025, with the price not specified for the latter. This move indicates continued confidence and increased stake by a significant shareholder.

title: App Purinusa Ekapersada Buy Shares of Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk
body: App Purinusa Ekapersada acquired 46,666,600 shares of Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk (INKP.JK) at IDR 7,500 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increased their total holdings from 3,143,477,898 to 3,190,144,498 shares. The purchase represents a strategic move to bolster their investment in the company.

title: Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk Sells 30 Million Shares at IDR 150
body: Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk (PANR.JK) sold 30,000,000 of its own shares on December 23, 2025, at a price of IDR 150 per share. This transaction reduced the company's total holdings from 796,517,000 shares to 766,517,000 shares.

title: Ronald Winardi sell Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Ronald Winardi sold 600,000 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk (BELI.JK) for investment purposes related to the MESOP Program. The transactions occurred between December 18 and December 22, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 436 to IDR 472 per share. Following the sales, Ronald Winardi's holding decreased from 46,870,000 shares to 46,270,000 shares.

title: Imron Hendrata Sell Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Imron Hendrata divested 43,911,534 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk (BELI.JK), reducing his holdings from 261,606,454 to 217,694,920 shares. The transactions occurred on December 18, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 470 to IDR 478 per share. This divestment signifies a reduction in his direct stake in the company.

title: Kusumo Martanto Sell Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Kusumo Martanto divested 12,000,000 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk (BELI.JK). The transactions occurred on December 18, 2025, at prices of IDR 470 and IDR 436 per share. Following the divestment, Kusumo Martanto's holding increased from 170,339,761 shares to 182,339,761 shares. The total value of the sold shares is approximately IDR 5.4 billion.

title: Martin Suharlie Buy Shares of PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk
body: Martin Suharlie acquired 101,300 shares of PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk (MCAS.JK) at IDR 589.0 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increased his holdings from 70,676,200 to 70,777,500 shares, representing a net increase of 101,300 shares.

title: George Oetomo Sell Shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk
body: George Oetomo sold 100,000 shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG.JK) for IDR 1,525 per share. This transaction reduces his total holdings from 53,475,900 shares to 53,375,900 shares. The stated purpose is investment. The sale represents a minor adjustment to his stake in the company.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher Buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher acquired 1,610,700 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) through multiple buy transactions between December 16, 2025, and December 23, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 1,335 to IDR 1,420 per share. This 'Investment' purpose transaction increased his total holdings from 198,672,422 shares to 200,283,122 shares, representing a net increase of 1,610,700 shares.

title: Esta Utama Corpora Sell Shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk
body: Esta Utama Corpora sold 130,000,000 shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk (ESTA.JK) for IDR 346 per share, totaling IDR 44,980,000,000. This transaction, described as Investment Realization, reduces Esta Utama Corpora's holding from 1,675,970,799 shares to 1,545,970,799 shares. The sale occurred on December 22, 2025.

title: Poedji Harixon Buy Shares of PT Damai Sejahtera Abadi Tbk
body: Poedji Harixon acquired 100,000 shares of PT Damai Sejahtera Abadi Tbk for IDR 185 per share, totaling IDR 18,500,000. This transaction increases his holdings from 152,293,400 to 152,393,400 shares. The stated purpose is investment. This represents a minor increase in his stake in the company.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk acquires 64.98% of Jubilee Metals Limited for IDR 346.93 billion
body: On 18 December 2025, PT Bumi Resources Tbk purchased 5,734,770 shares of Jubilee Metals Limited, representing 64.98% ownership, for IDR 346.93 billion (≈AUD 31.47 million) using bond funds and prior holdings. The acquisition aligns with BUMI’s diversification plan beyond coal, adding potential gold reserves of about 2 million ounces from JML’s exploration projects.

title: Indonesia sets higher coal benchmark prices for all grades in the second period of December 2025
body: Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources Bahlil Lahadalia signed Decree No. 420.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2025 on December 15, 2025, setting higher Coal Benchmark Prices (HBA) for all four grades in the second period of December 2025. The new HBA rates are USD 100.81/ton for 6,322 GAR coal, USD 69.93/ton for 5,300 GAR, USD 45.44/ton for 4,100 GAR, and USD 35.02/ton for 3,400 GAR, each up from the first‑period rates.

title: Indonesia to break ground on 5–6 downstream projects in early 2026, including alumina refinery, bio‑aviation fuel and bioethanol plants
body: The CEO of the Investment Management Agency (BPI) Danantara, Rosan Roeslani, said that groundbreaking for 5–6 downstream projects will start in January 2026, including a IDR 60 trillion Smelter Grade Alumina Refinery in Mempawah, a bio‑aviation fuel plant in Cilacap slated for 2027, and a bioethanol plant in Banyuwangi slated for 2026. The broader Danantara programme comprises 18 downstream projects with a total required investment of IDR 618 trillion and an estimated 270,000 jobs, with locations spread beyond Java.

title: Indonesia's ESDM launches IDR‑200 billion bauxite stockpile auction in Riau Islands
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM), via Ditjen Gakkum, is auctioning over 629,000 MT of state‑controlled bauxite in the Riau Islands from 16–22 December 2025, expecting to raise more than IDR 200 billion for non‑tax state revenue and help meet its 2025 PNBP target of IDR 254 trillion. The auction coincides with a decline in national bauxite output and ongoing development of six integrated bauxite smelters—including PT Dinamika Sejahtera Mandiri, PT Laman Mining, PT Kalbar Bumi Perkasa, PT Parenggean Makmur Sejahtera, PT Persada Pratama Cemerlang, PT Quality Sukses Sejahtera, and PT Sumber Bumi Marau—totaling USD 2.18 billion of investment within the sector’s broader USD 8.69 billion smelter portfolio.

title: Indonesia’s FLPP housing financing hits record distribution of 270,985 units in 2025
body: In 2025, the Housing Financing Liquidity Facility (FLPP) distributed 270,985 housing units worth Rp33.66 trillion, the highest level since the program’s 2010 launch. The allocation was led by Bank BTN with 128,608 units, followed by BTN Syariah, and involved 39 banks, 8,058 developers across 13,118 projects in 33 provinces.

title: Indonesia's Ministry of Tourism urges shift to quality tourism for sustainable growth
body: The Ministry of Tourism called on tourism stakeholders to adopt a quality‑tourism framework that emphasizes visitor experience and balanced economic, social, and environmental impacts, noting that mere growth is insufficient for long‑term challenges. Bank Indonesia pledged support through MSME stimulus programs, macro‑prudential liquidity incentives for tourism financing, and promotion of tourism investment both domestically and abroad.

title: Tourism Minister confirms Soekarno‑Hatta Airport ready for 2026 Christmas‑New Year travel surge
body: During a site visit, Tourism Minister Widiyanti Putri Wardhana affirmed that Soekarno‑Hatta International Airport, including the newly revamped Terminal 1C by InJourney Airports, is fully prepared for the holiday period, with projected traffic of 1.45 million international visitors, 128 million domestic trips and about 3.4 million air passengers. She also highlighted a government program offering a 13‑14% discount on domestic economy‑class fares between Dec 22, 2025 and Jan 10, 2026.

title: Indonesia establishes a Debottlenecking Task Force and advances US‑Indonesia reciprocal trade negotiations
body: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto announced a new Debottlenecking Task Force to remove business obstacles and discussed deregulation, foreign‑exchange reforms, and market‑access commitments with US investors, including GE Healthcare, Chubb, Visa, PepsiCo, Lockheed Martin, Cargill, Freeport, Citi, McLarty Associates, Vriens & Partners, DGA Group‑ASG and Dow Chemical. The meeting also set the stage for the Agreements on Reciprocal Trade (ART) to be signed by President Prabowo Subianto and President Donald Trump by the end of January 2026, with the US offering tariff exemptions on key Indonesian exports such as palm oil, cocoa, coffee and tea.

title: Indonesia earmarks Rp2 trillion for low‑interest export financing to boost textile and furniture sectors
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa approved a Rp2 trillion (US$119 million) financing ceiling through Indonesia Eximbank at a 6% rate to support textile and furniture exporters, noting current LPEI disbursements total only Rp200 billion. Industry groups highlighted the sector’s modest US$2.5 billion export share versus a global market of US$300 billion and urged diversification beyond the United States.

title: Indonesia to provide 1.35 million free halal certificates to micro and small enterprises in 2026
body: The Indonesian government, following President Prabowo Subianto’s directive, will issue 1.35 million free halal certificates to micro and small enterprises in 2026, adding to the 1.14 million free certificates allocated for 2025. To date, BPJPH has certified 10.9 million products, and Decree No. 146/2025 expands free certification to 25,002 food kiosks through the digital Sihalal system, with audits conducted by LPH and the MUI Fatwa Commission.

title: Indonesia's Agriculture Minister targets 70,000 hectares of sugarcane expansion in East Java to achieve sugar self‑sufficiency
body: Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman announced a plan to develop 70,000 hectares of sugarcane in East Java, backed by a Rp1.6 trillion (US$92 million) budget and up to 200 tractors worth about Rp100 billion, with implementation slated for late 2025 through March 2026 and coordinated with the military, police and prosecutor's office. The expansion aims to boost domestic sugar production, reduce the near‑Rp100 trillion import bill of the past two years, and help the nation reach its 100,000‑hectare national target for self‑sufficiency.

title: Indonesian ministries sign MoUs to boost Red and White Village Cooperatives as MSME market hubs
body: The Ministry of Cooperatives, together with the ministries of MSMEs, Forestry, Higher Education, Science and Technology, Transmigration and BPJS Kesehatan, signed memorandums of understanding to strengthen Red and White Village Cooperatives, targeting 80,000 outlets as primary marketplaces for MSME products and supporting social‑forestry groups, transmigration areas and health‑insurance participation. The agreements also aim to leverage research, student cooperatives and capacity‑building for forestry‑related cooperatives, with the government’s broader goal of establishing 80,000 village cooperatives by March 2026.

title: Indonesia supports livestock investment in Aceh to aid post-flood economic recovery
body: Minister of Agriculture Andi Amran Sulaiman announced government backing for private-sector investment in chicken feed and dairy farming in Aceh, including upstream-downstream development and milk processing plants, as part of a broader livestock program funded by Rp20 trillion (US$1.1 billion) from the Danantara sovereign wealth fund and slated to begin in January 2026 across 13 regions. The plan aims to boost local animal‑protein supply, create jobs, and reduce reliance on external imports after the recent floods.

title: Indonesia and US Target Late January 2026 for Reciprocal Trade Agreement
body: Indonesia and the US aim to sign a reciprocal trade agreement by late January 2026, following technical and legal reviews scheduled for early next month. This pact seeks to establish equal market access, with the US granting tariff exceptions for Indonesian agricultural exports, including palm oil, and Indonesia facilitating US access to critical minerals.

title: BEI Monitors PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk. (BULL) and PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk. (AYAM) Due to Unusual Market Activity
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) is monitoring the share movements of PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk. (BULL) and PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk. (AYAM) due to indications of Unusual Market Activity (UMA). Following the UMA announcement, PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk. (AYAM) shares contracted 7.75% to Rp792, and PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk. (BULL) dropped 4.62% to Rp372, with BEI advising investors to consider future possibilities before making investment decisions.

title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) Lifts Suspension on PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO) Shares
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) officially lifted the second suspension on PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (RLCO) shares, allowing trading to resume on December 24, 2025, after a 'cooling down' period. Following the lifting, RLCO shares immediately hit Auto Rejection Atas (ARA) at Rp1,460, marking a surge of over 769.05% from its IPO price of Rp226 on December 8, 2025.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) and FiberHome Partner for World-First 5G FWA SURGE Commercial Launch in Indonesia
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with FiberHome to accelerate the deployment of 5G Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) SURGE services based on the 1.4 GHz spectrum in Indonesia, marking the world's first commercial launch of this innovative technology. This partnership aims to provide affordable, high-quality fixed broadband to millions of Indonesian households, starting with Java, Maluku, and Papua, with commercial services offering up to 100 Mbps unlimited internet for Rp100,000 planned for Q1 2026.

title: PT Bank Aladin Syariah Tbk. Approves Changes to Sharia Supervisory Board and Board of Commissioners
body: PT Bank Aladin Syariah Tbk. (BANK) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on December 18, 2025, which approved changes to its Sharia Supervisory Board and Board of Commissioners. During the meeting, Muhamad Rofiq, Lc., MA was appointed as a member of the Sharia Supervisory Board, and Nurhasanah was appointed as an Independent Commissioner.

title: Lippo Group Entities Execute Rp1.25 Trillion Transaction Involving Multipolar Technology Shares
body: Lippo Group entities, including Star Pacific (LPLI), SP Corporate Fund, and Lenox Pasifik (LPPS), completed a Rp1.25 trillion transaction on December 23, 2025, by acquiring shares of Multipolar Technology (MLPT) from JGAsia Capital Group. Star Pacific and SP Corporate Fund purchased 0.787% of Multipolar Technology shares for Rp903.26 billion, while Lenox Pasifik acquired 0.301%, with these transactions representing 40.47% and 35.69% of their respective equities.

title: Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) Plans Private Placement to Strengthen Capital and Boost Financial Position
body: Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) is planning a private placement of 757,110,786 shares, representing up to 10% of its paid-up capital, to strengthen its capital structure, improve its financial position, and fund working capital and business development. This corporate action is projected to increase assets by 8.86% and equity by 10.04%, though it will result in a 9.09% dilution for non-participating investors, with an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for January 12, 2026, for approval.

title: Personel Alih Daya (PADA) Achieves Significant Profit Turnaround and Revenue Growth by Q3 2025
body: Personel Alih Daya (PADA) recorded a net profit of Rp779.48 million by September 30, 2025, a substantial rebound from a Rp7.94 billion loss in the prior year, with revenue increasing 17.1% to Rp794.7 billion. This positive performance, also marked by a 14.6% rise in gross profit, was driven by business expansion, efficient operational cost management, and strategic partnerships, including with Solusi Sinergi (WIFI) Group.

title: Buana Finance (BBLD) Secures Rp950 Billion Loan from Bank Danamon Indonesia (BDMN)
body: Buana Finance (BBLD) obtained new credit facilities totaling Rp950 billion from Bank Danamon Indonesia (BDMN) on December 23, 2025, for working capital in consumer finance and financial lease. This transaction increases their total loan facilities from Bank Danamon to Rp2.45 trillion, representing 172.40% of their equity as of December 31, 2024.

title: Raharja Cepu (RATU) Executes Rp127.5 Billion Capital Injection for PT REM Establishment
body: Raharja Cepu (RATU) executed a Rp127.5 billion capital injection through its subsidiary Raharja Energi Indonesia (REI) to Raharja Energi Madura (REM) for the establishment of PT REM, a transaction signed on December 23, 2025. This affiliated transaction, compliant with POJK No 42/2020, is expected to strengthen capital structure and support sustainable business development without negative impact on RATU.

title: Bank of Singapore Limited Acquires 14.03% Stake in Bank Capital Indonesia (BACA) from Capital Global Investama
body: Bank of Singapore Limited acquired 2.8 billion shares of Bank Capital Indonesia (BACA) from controlling shareholder Capital Global Investama on December 19, 2025, establishing a 14.03% ownership. This Rp492.8 billion transaction, assisted by Pacific Sekuritas Indonesia, Victoria Sekuritas Indonesia, and Citibank, NA, reduced Capital Global Investama's stake to 49.66%.

title: Soho Global Health (SOHO) Plans to Distribute Interim Dividend of Rp420.09 Billion
body: Soho Global Health (SOHO) will distribute an interim dividend of Rp420.09 billion, representing 95.45% of its Rp440.09 billion net profit as of September 30, 2025, resulting in Rp33.1 per share for investors. The cum dividend date for regular and negotiation markets is January 7, 2026, with the recording date on January 9, 2026, and payment scheduled for January 22, 2026.

title: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN) Leads National Subsidized Housing Loan Distribution and Commits to 2026 Targets
body: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN) is the largest national distributor of KPR Sejahtera FLPP, realizing 128,608 subsidized housing units, or 46.7% of the national total, by December 22, 2025, with its subsidiary Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) as the second largest. Minister Maruarar Sirait of PKP appreciated BTN's commitment to supporting the 2026 national target of 350,000 units, with BTN planning proactive measures to strengthen its KPR FLPP distribution.

title: Danantara Aset Management Injects Rp4.93 Trillion Shareholder Loan into Krakatau Steel (KRAS)
body: Danantara Aset Management provided Krakatau Steel (KRAS) with a Rp4.93 trillion (USD295 million) shareholder loan, signed on December 19, 2025, to support business continuity and operational stability. The funds are earmarked for Rp4.18 trillion in working capital for raw materials and Rp752.8 billion for a voluntary resignation program and pension fund health.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk to Expand Coal Business via Rp1.6 Trillion Acquisition of PT Trimata Coal Perkasa Stake
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA) is set to expand its coal business as its controlling shareholder, PT Triple Berkah Bersama (PSP), will acquire a 45% controlling stake in PT Trimata Coal Perkasa (PT TCP) for Rp1.6 Trillion. This acquisition, formalized on December 22, 2025, grants MEJA access to PT TCP's 11,640-hectare coal concession in South Sumatra with estimated mineable resources of approximately 693.7 million tons, transforming MEJA's position in the energy sector.

title: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk. and PT Aplikanusa Lintasarta Sign Initial Investment Agreement for Dark Fiber Infrastructure.
body: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk. (ISAT), PT Aplikanusa Lintasarta, and PT Ainfrastruktur Indonesia Raya signed an initial investment agreement for the development and management of dark fiber infrastructure. This agreement outlines a plan to transfer ISAT and Lintasarta's fiber optic assets to a private company, which will then be indirectly acquired by an undisclosed public company listed on the BEI through a combination of debt and capital injection, including a rights issue.

title: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk Bought Shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk
body: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk acquired 74,802,272 shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk at IDR 6,450 per share. This transaction increases its stake from 4,872,208,968 to 4,947,011,240 shares, signifying a strategic move to boost ownership in the company.

title: Ir Thio Eng Hok Buy Shares of PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk
body: Ir. Thio Eng Hok acquired 17,100 shares of PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk (MSTI.JK) at IDR 1,400 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases his total holding from 62,000 to 79,100 shares. The purchase, valued at IDR 23,940,000, was executed on December 17, 2025.

title: Ir Pudji Harianto buy Shares of PT Damai Sejahtera Abadi Tbk
body: Ir Pudji Harianto acquired 200,000 shares of PT Damai Sejahtera Abadi Tbk for investment purposes. The transaction, executed at IDR 185 per share on December 23, 2025, increased his total holdings from 209,352,457 to 209,552,457 shares.

title: President Prabowo proposes adding Papua to Indonesia’s oil‑palm map to boost regional bio‑fuel production and energy self‑sufficiency
body: At a meeting on accelerating Papua’s development, President Prabowo Subianto announced plans to include Papua in the national oil‑palm plantation map and to develop sugarcane and cassava for bio‑ethanol, alongside solar and hydropower, to achieve regional energy self‑sufficiency. He said the strategy could cut imported oil‑fuel costs and save the state budget by “hundreds of trillions of rupiah” annually.

title: Indonesia's Tourism and Youth & Sports Ministries Sign MoU to Expand Sports Tourism
body: The Tourism and Youth and Sports ministries signed a memorandum of understanding to coordinate sports tourism programs, infrastructure use and marketing, aiming to boost visitor numbers and economic impact. Government data shows the sector was worth about Rp18.79 trillion ($1.12 billion) in 2024, representing roughly 25‑30% of the national event tourism market, with events like the 2025 Pocari Sweat Run generating Rp85.5 billion.

title: Indonesia's Tourism and Environment Ministries Sign Cooperation Agreement to Strengthen Sustainable Tourism
body: The Tourism and Environment ministries signed a cooperation agreement in Jakarta to improve environmental management in the tourism sector, creating a joint task force to draft guidelines, adjust assessment criteria, and provide technical support. The agreement follows a May 2025 MoU and leverages data showing that 95% of Indonesian tourists are willing to pay more for eco‑friendly accommodations, highlighting the economic potential of sustainable practices.

title: Indonesia‑EAEU Free Trade Agreement Aimed at Boosting MSMEs, Says Trade Minister
body: Trade Minister Budi Santoso said the Indonesia–Eurasian Economic Union FTA is intended to support micro, small and medium enterprises by providing legal certainty, transparent implementation and easier market access, and urged exporters to seize the new facilities. Officials from both sides expect the agreement to double bilateral trade and highlighted cooperation across sectors such as agriculture, industry, energy, logistics and the digital economy.

title: Indonesia signs free trade agreement with Eurasian Economic Union to expand market access
body: Indonesia’s Trade Minister Budi Santoso signed a free‑trade agreement with the Eurasian Economic Union on Dec 21, 2025, granting preferential tariffs on 90.5% of Indonesian product lines and targeting markets of 180 million people with a $2.56 trillion GDP. The pact aims to lift exports of palm oil, footwear, textiles, fishery products, rubber, furniture and electronics, while offering EAEU members access to Indonesia’s 281.6 million consumers and $1.4 trillion economy.

title: Batu Investasi Indonesia Buy Shares of PT Bahtera Bumi Raya Tbk
body: Batu Investasi Indonesia acquired 161,899,350 shares of PT Bahtera Bumi Raya Tbk for IDR 122 per share as part of a Mandatory Tender Offer. This transaction increases Batu Investasi Indonesia's holding from 493,088,500 to 654,987,850 shares. The total transaction value is IDR 19,751,720,700.

title: Granite Asia raises $500 million for Libra Hybrid strategy with investments from Temasek, Khazanah, INA and others
body: The Libra Hybrid private‑credit strategy, led by Granite Asia, targets $500 million in commitments and has already deployed about 30 % of capital across six transactions, drawing investors such as Singapore’s Temasek (via Aranda Principal Strategies), Malaysia’s sovereign fund Khazanah and Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund INA. Asia’s private‑credit market is projected to reach $92 billion by 2027, and Granite Asia, which manages roughly $6 billion across venture, growth and credit, recently partnered with INA on a $1.2 billion tech fund and with Japan’s Integral on a $100 million joint venture.

title: PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk atau BJB Ensures Operational Readiness and Rp8.3 Trillion Cash Availability for Nataru 2025-2026.
body: PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk atau BJB projects a cash need of Rp8.3 trillion for December 2025 to ensure optimal service and meet customer financial requirements during the Christmas 2025 and New Year 2026 (Nataru) holidays. BJB will maintain operational readiness, provide limited operational services and weekend banking for various transactions, and urges customers to be vigilant against fraud.

title: Buana Finance (BBLD) Secures Rp100 Billion from PT Bank OCBC NISP Indonesia Tbk Amidst Ongoing Bank Funding
body: Buana Finance (BBLD) recently secured Rp100 billion in a 48-month term loan from PT Bank OCBC NISP Indonesia Tbk, intended for working capital to support consumer finance and financial lease activities. This latest facility adds to substantial funds previously obtained from Bank Danamon (Rp950 billion), KEB Hana Indonesia (Rp200 billion), and Bank Victoria (Rp515 billion), with management stating no material impact on the company's financial condition or operations.

title: Fadhl Muhammad Firdaus Buys Shares of PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk.
body: Fadhl Muhammad Firdaus acquired 35,266,000 shares of PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk. (AYAM.JK) at IDR 390 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases his total holdings from 32,000,000 to 67,266,000 shares, representing a significant increase in his stake in the company.

title: Sumber Garam Pratama Buy Shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk
body: Sumber Garam Pratama acquired 116,404,195 shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk at IDR 490 per share. This transaction increases Sumber Garam Pratama's holding from 1,032,106,745 to 1,148,510,940 shares. The stated purpose is investment, indicating a strategic interest in the company.

title: Era Media (DOOH) reports a 30.7% rise in net profit to Rp6.77 billion for the quarter ended 30 September 2025
body: Net profit reached Rp6.77 billion, up 30.69% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share increasing to Rp0.88 and revenue growing 4.68% to Rp123.16 billion. The company’s total assets rose to Rp326.28 billion and liabilities to Rp100.18 billion, while equity increased to Rp226.1 billion.

title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) Changes Status to State-Owned Enterprise (Persero) Following RUPSLB Decision.
body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BRIS), or BSI, officially changed its status to PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, becoming a state-owned enterprise (BUMN) after an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on December 22. Despite this change, the BRIS stock price fell 0.45% to Rp2,230, marking an 18.31% decline from its year-end 2024 position of Rp2,730.

title: Infiniti Wahana Buy Shares of Steady Safe Tbk
body: Infiniti Wahana acquired 30,500 shares of Steady Safe Tbk (SAFE.JK) at IDR 400 per share. This transaction increases their holding from 464,009,113 to 464,039,613 shares. The purchase was made for investment purposes, slightly altering their stake in the company.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk Sell Shares of Energi Mega Persada Tbk
body: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sold 632,606,400 shares of Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG.JK) for IDR 917 per share, totaling IDR 580,101,060,800. The transaction, described as a Reverse REPO, reduces Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia's holding from 3,784,728,522 shares to 3,152,122,122 shares.

title: Hendry Sell Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Hendry divested 6,030,700 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk (BELI.JK). The transaction involved selling shares at an average price of approximately IDR 452.50 per share. Following the divestment, Hendry's holdings increased from 34,976,391 to 41,007,091 shares. This indicates a strategic shift in Hendry's investment in the company.

title: Promosi Desa Digital Sell Shares of PT Haloni Jane Tbk
body: Promosi Desa Digital sold 1,859,400 shares of PT Haloni Jane Tbk (HALO.JK) on December 4, 2025. The transactions involved multiple buy and sell orders, with the average selling price around IDR 96.0 per share. Following these transactions, Promosi Desa Digital's holdings decreased from 363,296,200 shares to 361,436,800 shares. The stated purpose of the transactions was investment.

title: Henry Budiono,Se Buy Shares of PT Damai Sejahtera Abadi Tbk
body: Henry Budiono,Se acquired 150,000 shares of PT Damai Sejahtera Abadi Tbk for investment purposes at IDR 185 per share. This transaction increases his total holdings from 25,251,472 to 25,401,472 shares, representing a net increase of 150,000 shares.

title: Lisa Widodo Sell Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Lisa Widodo sold 4,322,200 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk (BELI.JK) for divestment purposes. The transaction occurred on December 19, 2025. The average selling price was approximately IDR 452.5 per share, based on the listed transaction prices. Following the sale, Lisa Widodo's holdings increased from 35,237,591 to 39,559,791 shares, indicating the acquisition of shares from other sources concurrently with the divestment. The total value of shares transacted was IDR 198,783,160.

title: Promosi Desa Digital Buy Shares of PT Haloni Jane Tbk
body: Promosi Desa Digital acquired 26,632,000 shares of PT Haloni Jane Tbk (HALO.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction increased their holdings from 334,804,800 to 361,436,800 shares. The average purchase price was approximately IDR 102.9 per share, reflecting a strategic investment in the company.

title: Promosi Desa Digital Others Shares of PT Haloni Jane Tbk
body: Promosi Desa Digital acquired 40,000,000 shares of PT Haloni Jane Tbk for an investment purpose, with a Dec-2025 target. This transaction increased their holding from 258,162,000 to 298,162,000 shares. The total transaction value was IDR 40,000,000. No specific price per share was disclosed for this 'others' type transaction.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa Sell Shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sold 742,000,000 shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (IMPC.JK) between December 19-23, 2025, for an average price of approximately IDR 3,035 per share. The total transaction value was IDR 2,250,000,000. This divestment aimed at investment realization and increasing the company's free float. Harimas Tunggal Perkasa's ownership decreased from 20,698,895,000 shares to 19,956,895,000 shares, representing a reduction of 742,000,000 shares.

title: Garam Ventura Indonesia Sell Shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk
body: Garam Ventura Indonesia divested 116,404,195 shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk at IDR 490 per share. This transaction reduces Garam Ventura Indonesia's holding from 1,782,035,913 to 1,665,631,718 shares, representing a decrease of 116,404,195 shares. The divestment is part of the company's strategic divestment plan.

title: Capital Global Investama Sell Shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk
body: Capital Global Investama has sold 2,600,469,751 shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk (BACA.JK) for IDR 168 per share. This transaction reduces its holding from 12,709,647,262 shares to 10,109,177,511 shares, a decrease of 2,600,469,751 shares. The stated purpose is 'Share Sales'.

title: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono Sell Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono sold 2,000,000 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk for IDR 52 per share. This transaction reduces his total holdings from 26,793,400 shares to 24,793,400 shares, a decrease of 2,000,000 shares. The purpose of the sale is for investment. The total transaction value was IDR 104,000,000.

title: Infiniti Wahana buy Shares of Steady Safe Tbk
body: Infiniti Wahana acquired 120,000 shares of Steady Safe Tbk at IDR 380 per share on December 22, 2025, for a total transaction value of IDR 45,600,000. This purchase increases Infiniti Wahana's holding in Steady Safe Tbk from 464,039,613 shares to 464,159,613 shares, representing a marginal increase in their stake. The transaction was disclosed on December 24, 2025.

title: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia Others Shares of Darma Henwa Tbk
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia executed a Repurchase Agreement transaction involving 680,340,377 shares of Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA.JK). The transaction occurred on December 11, 2025, at a price of IDR 264.0 per share. Following this, CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia's holdings increased from 1,569,200,000 shares to 2,249,540,377 shares, indicating a net increase of 680,340,377 shares.

title: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia others Shares of Darma Henwa Tbk
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia engaged in a repurchase agreement transaction involving 680,340,377 shares of Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA.JK). The transaction occurred on December 11, 2025, at a price of IDR 264.0 per share, for a total amount of IDR 179,609,000,000. This transaction increased CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia's holdings in DEWA.JK from 1,569,200,000 shares to 2,249,540,377 shares, a net increase of 680,340,377 shares.

title: PT Suprabakti Mandiri delivers 51,539 Technoroll idlers and related equipment for PT Bukit Asam’s TLS 6 & 7 project within seven months
body: PT Suprabakti Mandiri supplied 51,539 Technoroll idlers, 156 pulleys, 100 belt cleaners from Martin Supra Engineering and 16 belt scale units for PT Bukit Asam’s TLS 6 & 7 project, completing the integrated conveyor system in just seven months from drawing approval. The delivery coincided with the inauguration of the Graha Suprabakti factory office, the company’s 38th anniversary, and underscores its focus on innovation, digital inspections, and technician training through the Summa Learning Center/LSP Suprabakti.

title: Indonesia vows zero tolerance for illegal food imports after 72‑ton onion smuggling incident
body: Minister of Agriculture Andi Amran Sulaiman announced a crackdown on illegal imports after authorities uncovered 72 tons of onions from the Netherlands, routed through Malaysia, that were contaminated with plant pests. He called for a full investigation of the smuggling network and strict legal action to protect national food security.

title: Indonesia's Housing Minister aims to exceed 2026 FLPP subsidized housing target of 350,000 units
body: Minister Maruarar Sirait pledged to meet and surpass the 2026 goal of delivering 350,000 FLPP subsidized homes, urging swift, coordinated action and thanking BPS for data support. He highlighted new cooperation agreements among BP Tapera, banks and developer groups to boost affordable, targeted housing.

title: Indonesia's Transmigration Zones Attract Up to Rp240 trillion ($14.3 bn) in Investment Over Four Years
body: Transmigration Minister M. Iftitah Suryanagara announced that 50 companies have expressed interest in investing a combined Rp240 trillion, which could create around 200,000 jobs in the country's transmigration zones. Major commitments include Rp1.2 trillion from LX International Corp. for a port in East Kalimantan and sizable allocations for projects in East Sumba, South Papua and other regions.

title: PT Star Pacific Tbk. and PT Lennox Pasific Investama Tbk. acquire a total of 1.09% of PT Multipolar Technology Tbk. shares from PT JGAsia Capital Group for about IDR 1.24 trillion
body: On 23 December 2025, PT Star Pacific Tbk. together with its subsidiary SP Corporate Fund bought 14,759,200 shares (0.787%) of PT Multipolar Technology Tbk. from PT JGAsia Capital Group for IDR 903.2 billion, while PT Lennox Pasific Investama Tbk. purchased 5,645,200 shares (0.301%) for IDR 345.48 billion, bringing the total transferred shares to 20,404,400 (≈1.09%) at an aggregate value of roughly IDR 1.24 trillion. Both companies consider the transactions material, representing 40.47% and 35.9% of their respective equity, and the MLPT share price closed down 1.16% at IDR 59,500 on 24 December 2025.

title: PT Soho Global Health Tbk. Reports Significant Profit and Sales Growth, Alongside Dividend Announcement
body: PT Soho Global Health Tbk. (SOHO) recorded a net profit of Rp440.09 billion, a 28.89% increase, and net sales of Rp7.92 trillion, up 6.02%, for the period ending September 30, 2025. The company announced a cash dividend of Rp33.1 per share, which initially boosted SOHO's stock by 24.81% before it closed down 5.04% at Rp1,225 per share.

title: Singapore's GIA Ventures PTE Ltd Acquires 14.03% Stake in PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk
body: GIA Ventures PTE Ltd, a Singapore-based company, has acquired 2.8 billion shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk (BACA) via SID Bank of Singapore Limited for approximately Rp470.4 billion, securing a 14.03% stake. This makes GIA Ventures a new shareholder, as BACA shares have recently climbed 41.9% from their year-end position of Rp131.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. Strengthens Services and Digital Infrastructure for Nataru 2025/2026 Holiday Period
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) is committed to ensuring seamless transaction services during the Christmas 2025 and New Year 2026 holidays, anticipating 119 million people movements. To support this, BBRI has strengthened its integrated financial ecosystem, including 1.2 million AgenBRILink, 19,657 ATM/CRM networks, 284,670 EDC machines, over 4.6 million QRIS BRI merchants, the super app BRImo, and will operate 159 Nataru operational offices and 67 Weekend Banking locations.

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk and PT PLN Indonesia Power Secure Tariff Agreement for 30 MW Ulubelu Bottoming Unit Project
body: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO) and PT PLN Indonesia Power have finalized a tariff agreement with PT PLN (Persero) for the 30 MW Ulubelu Bottoming Unit Geothermal Power Plant project, a binary technology initiative utilizing waste heat, which is a crucial step towards PGE's 1 GW capacity target. This agreement, expected to lead to a joint venture and PPA signing by January 2026 for a 2027 COD, is part of a broader collaboration between PT Pertamina (Persero) and PT PLN (Persero) that could add up to 1,130 MW of geothermal capacity with an estimated investment of US$5.4 billion.

title: PT Capitol Nusantara Indonesia Tbk reports a net loss for the quarter ended 30 September 2025 and outlines strategic steps to restore growth
body: The company posted revenue of USD 658,000 but recorded an operating loss of USD 323,000 and a net loss of USD 328,000, with cash and cash equivalents of USD 746,000 and very low liquidity ratios (cash ratio 0.02, current ratio 0.06). Corporate Secretary Ridwan Kosasih said the firm is focusing on vessel maintenance, cost efficiency, customer retention and expanding into sea‑logistics and infrastructure projects in 2026 to regain profitability.

title: Esta Utama Corpora sells 130 million shares of Esta Multi Usaha at a discount, raising Rp44.98 billion
body: On 22 December 2025, Esta Utama Corpora divested 130 million Esta Multi Usaha shares at an execution price of Rp346 per share, a 14.35% discount to the prior‑day closing of Rp404. The transaction generated Rp44.98 billion and reduced Esta Corpora’s stake to 63.74% of Esta Multi Usaha, a dilution of about 5.36 percentage points.

title: PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk and PT Eka Mas Republik merge to create a larger integrated telecom and broadband player in Indonesia
body: The merger combines Moratelindo’s 57,000‑km fiber backbone and six data centers with MyRepublic Indonesia’s FTTH network serving over 1.5 million retail customers, resulting in a joint entity with more than 116,000 km of fiber and over 1.8 million retail subscribers. Analyst Rizal Rafly of Stockbit Sekuritas expects cost synergies, expanded service offerings and a stronger role in national digital infrastructure, while noting integration challenges.

title: PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk (PSAB) Postpones Sale of PT Arafura Surya Alam (ARA) Shares for Doup Gold Mine Project
body: PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk (PSAB) has delayed the sale of its subsidiary PT J Resources Nusantara (JRN)'s shares in PT Arafura Surya Alam (ARA), the manager of the Doup gold mine project, to PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara (DTN) for three months until March 23, 2026, due to ongoing fulfillment of conditions precedents. This transaction, valued at USD 540 million or Rp 8.8 trillion, is intended to strengthen capital for other mining prospects, with PSAB asserting no material impact on its operations despite a slight dip in its share price.

title: PT MD Entertainment Tbk (FILM) Designated as Unsecured Securities by BEI and KPEI for January 2026
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) and PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) have designated shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk (FILM) as Efek Tidak Dijamin (Unsecured Securities) from January 2 to January 30, 2026, restricting its trading to the Pasar Negosiasi. This policy, part of market risk management, comes as FILM shares dropped 9.84% to Rp9,625 on December 24, despite a 149.35% year-to-date increase from Rp3,680 at the end of 2024.

title: PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk (BJB) Expands Strategic Collaboration with PT Indomarco Prismatama (Indomaret)
body: PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk (BJB) signed a Memorandum of Understanding with PT Indomarco Prismatama (Indomaret) to utilize banking products and services, aiming to leverage Indomaret's extensive network for broader service penetration. This partnership will explore opportunities in funding, investment and working capital financing, transactional facilities including digital banking, and enhanced support for UMKM through various financing schemes.

title: Sudjono, Director of PT BFI Finance Tbk., Increases Share Ownership Through Market Purchase
body: Sudjono, a Director of PT BFI Finance Tbk. (BFIN), acquired 5,000,000 shares of BFIN on December 19, 2025, at Rp702 per share, totaling approximately Rp3.51 billion for investment purposes. This transaction raised his direct ownership in BFIN from 0.20% (30 million shares) to 0.23% (35 million shares).

title: PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Reduces Stake in PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) Through Reverse Repo
body: PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia released 632,606,400 shares of PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) at Rp917 per share on December 23, 2025, as a reverse repo transaction. This transaction decreased PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia's ownership in ENRG from 14.37% (3.78 billion shares) to 11.96% (3.15 billion shares).

title: An Shaohong and Two Other Executives Resign from PT Green Power Group Tbk (LABA) Amid Legal Issues
body: An Shaohong, Hu Yanqing, and Chen Xiao Xiao officially resigned from PT Green Power Group Tbk (LABA) on December 23, 2025, with their approvals pending a shareholder meeting by January 2026. This follows An Shaohong's alleged legal troubles, including an arrest linked to immigration violations and being a DPO in China, which also impacted PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk (KRYA) and PT Oscar Mitra Sukses Tbk (OLIV).

title: Hadi Suhermin Buy Shares of PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk
body: Hadi Suhermin acquired 138,500,000 shares of PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk (SMIL.JK) through multiple purchases on December 24, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 350 to IDR 370 per share. This investment increased his total holdings from 4,403,524,900 shares to 4,542,024,900 shares. The transaction signifies an increase in Hadi Suhermin's stake in the company.

title: Commissioner Henry Liem sells 276,700 shares of PT Argha Karya Prima Tbk. (AKPI) around the extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: Commissioner Henry Liem sold 101,700 shares at Rp565 on Dec 16 and 175,000 shares at Rp570 on Dec 19, totaling 276,700 shares worth roughly Rp157.21 million and lowering his holding to 15.5 million shares (2.53%). The transactions occurred just before and after the Dec 17 extraordinary shareholders meeting that approved changes to the board, after which AKPI’s stock closed at Rp555, down 2.63%.

title: Indonesia plans new film financing mechanism and Creative Content Fund to leverage IP as collateral and draw investors
body: The Ministry of Creative Economy will study incentives for priority creative subsectors and create the Indonesia Creative Content Fund (ICCF) to support film, gaming and digital projects, aiming to protect intellectual property and broaden market access. State‑owned producer Produksi Film Negara (PFN) is also preparing a dedicated venture‑capital fund and the Indonesia Film Facilitation (IFF) initiative to boost production capacity and film exports.

title: Indonesia and France sign Annex V to update their civil aviation technical cooperation framework
body: The two countries signed Annex V, replacing Annex IV, to strengthen aviation safety oversight, personnel training, and knowledge exchange, with the agreement effective for six months and extendable. The cooperation aligns with ICAO standards and aims to boost Indonesia’s aviation sector performance and competitiveness.

title: Mitrabahtera (MBSS) approves Rp450 billion of affiliated loans to Anaga Group Indonesia and Galley Adhika Arnawama
body: On 23 December 2025, Mitrabahtera (MBSS) executed affiliated transactions worth Rp450 billion, comprising a five‑year, 8.5 % loan of Rp340 billion to Anaga Group Indonesia, which equals 9.58 % of its equity as of 31 December 2024. Additionally, its subsidiary Mitra Galley Segara Sejati granted a five‑year, 8.5 % loan of Rp110 billion to Galley Adhika Arnawama, the company’s principal shareholder.

title: Agro Jaya Mandiri sells 736.84 million Delta Giri Wacana shares at a 63.44% discount, cutting its stake to 0.22%
body: On 22 December 2025, Agro Jaya Mandiri completed a divestiture of 736.84 million Delta Giri Wacana (DGWG) shares at Rp136 per share, a 63.44% discount to the closing price of Rp372, generating Rp100.21 billion in proceeds. The transaction reduced Agro Jaya's Delta Giri holdings to 13.15 million shares (0.22% of the company), down from 750 million shares (12.75%).

title: TBS Energi Utama (TOBA) announces a Rp586.27 billion share buyback program
body: The company allocated Rp586.27 billion (≈USD34.91 million) to repurchase up to 825.74 million shares at a maximum price of Rp710 per share, to be executed between 24 December 2025 and 24 March 2026. It states the buyback will not materially affect operations or financing, citing sufficient working capital and cash flow.

title: PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA) CEO Andreas Utomo sells over 12.5 million shares, cutting stake to 10.36%
body: Andreas Utomo sold a total of 12,516,700 PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA) shares in two transactions on 17 and 19 December 2025, generating an estimated proceeds of IDR 3.45‑3.61 billion. The sales reduced his holding to 110.8 million shares (10.36% of the company), and the stock closed down 6.25% at IDR 270 on 24 December 2025.

title: PT Argha Karya Prima Industry Tbk. appoints new independent commissioner following extraordinary shareholders’ meeting
body: At the extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on 17 December 2025, shareholders representing 87.44% of voting rights approved the resignation of Johan Paulus Yoranouw and the appointment of Folmer Adolf Hutapea as an independent commissioner of PT Argha Karya Prima Industry Tbk. The board of directors remains unchanged.

title: PT Lotte Chemical Titan Tbk (FPNI) CEO Choi Kyoungyoon resigns, shares fall 5.41%
body: PT Lotte Chemical Titan Tbk (FPNI) announced the resignation of its Chief Executive Officer, Choi Kyoungyoon, after receiving his letter on 19 December 2025. The resignation will be put to a shareholder vote at an extraordinary general meeting within 90 days, and the stock dropped 5.41% to Rp875 on 24 December.

title: PT Summarecon Agung Tbk launches a Rp3 trillion sustainable bond program, starting with a Rp500 billion Phase I issue.
body: The company announced a sustainable bond offering of up to Rp3 trillion, with Phase I comprising Rp500 billion split into Series A (Rp84.53 billion, 5.85% coupon, 3‑year tenor) and Series B (Rp266.23 billion, 6.5% coupon, 5‑year tenor). The bonds become effective on 23 December 2025, with issuance scheduled for 29‑30 December 2025 and listing on the IDX on 7 January 2026, under the coordination of Indo Premier Sekuritas and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas.

title: Energi Mega Persada (ENRG) to Issue Rp500 Billion Sustainable Bond in Three Tranches
body: Energi Mega Persada (ENRG) announced a Rp500 billion sustainable bond issuance, part of a Rp4 trillion program, divided into three series (A: Rp75 bn at 6.75% maturing 17 January 2027; B: Rp125 bn at 7.75% maturing 7 January 2029; C: Rp300 bn at 8.95% maturing 7 January 2031). The bonds will be offered from 29 December 2025 to 2 January 2026, listed on the Bursa Efek Indonesia on 8 January 2026, with PT Mandiri Sekuritas, PT Sucor Sekuritas and PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk as underwriters.

title: PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk secures $5 million from Symbiotics to fund 2026 B2B financial services expansion
body: The company announced a USD 5 million strategic investment from Symbiotics, which will be allocated to enhance operational and technology capabilities, broaden market reach and expand its product portfolio for MSMEs and corporate clients as part of its 2026 growth plan. Management highlighted the focus on inclusive digital finance, prudent governance and job creation.

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk secures Rp2 trillion shareholder loan from PT Danantara Asset Management (Persero) to boost AT1 capital for housing loan growth
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk received a Rp2 trillion shareholder loan from PT Danantara Asset Management (Persero), classified as Additional Tier 1 capital, to maintain a healthy Capital Adequacy Ratio of 18‑19% while expanding its housing‑finance portfolio. By Q3‑2025, the bank’s total loan disbursement reached Rp381.03 trillion, with Rp322.53 trillion in the housing sector, and the perpetual, non‑dilutive loan is designed to support further credit growth without pressuring liquidity.

title: Bank Tabungan Negara provides Rp13.17 billion disaster relief to Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra
body: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN) allocated a total of Rp13.17 billion through its TJSL program to deliver food, medical supplies, baby items and other aid to flood and landslide victims in Aceh, Sumatera Utara and Sumatera Barat. The bank coordinated directly with local authorities, universities and partners such as Bank Syariah Nasional and Danantara Indonesia to distribute the assistance and support recovery operations.

title: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk signs USD100 million loan guarantee agreement with Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Limited (ANZ) for subsidiaries PT Medco E&P Tomori Sulawesi and PT Medco E&P Malaka
body: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk agreed with Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Limited (ANZ) to provide guarantees and defer obligations for a USD 100 million loan taken by its subsidiaries PT Medco E&P Tomori Sulawesi (MEPTS) and PT Medco E&P Malaka (MEPM). The company stated the arrangement has no material impact on its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Erajaya injects Rp370.27 billion into three subsidiaries to strengthen capital
body: On 23 December 2025, Erajaya (ERAA) injected a total of Rp370.27 billion into its subsidiaries Era Sukses Abadi (ESA), Era Boga Nusantara (EBN) and Era Boga Pretzel (EB Pretz), increasing their paid‑in capital to Rp663.5 billion, Rp510.17 billion and Rp17.8 billion respectively. The capital injections, described by Amelia Allen as a tactical move to enhance the subsidiaries' contributions to the parent company, involved the issuance of 187,500 ESA shares, 174,275 EBN shares and 170,000 EB Pretz shares.

title: PT Gowa Makasar Tourism Tbk. (GMTD) reports Q3 2025 profit plunges 63% amid revenue drop, while assets and liabilities rise modestly
body: PT Gowa Makasar Tourism Tbk. (GMTD) posted a 63.45% decline in net profit to Rp36.97 billion for the quarter ended 30 September 2025, driven by a 31.53% fall in net revenue to Rp219.45 billion and a 41.47% contraction in gross profit. Total assets grew 4.65% to Rp1.35 trillion and liabilities rose 6.53% to Rp493.42 billion, and the shares closed 1.35% higher at Rp3,010 on 24 December.

title: PT Gunawan Dianjaya Steel Tbk (GDST) to Distribute Interim Dividend of Rp2.5 Per Share for Fiscal Year 2025.
body: PT Gunawan Dianjaya Steel Tbk (GDST) will distribute an interim dividend for the 2025 fiscal year, totaling Rp23.11 billion or Rp2.5 per share, a decision approved on December 23, 2025. The dividend yield is approximately 2.08 percent, with the cum dividend date for the cash market set for January 9, 2026, and the ex-dividend date for January 12, 2026.

title: Hsbc-Fund Svs A/C Chengdong Investment Corp-Self Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Hsbc-Fund Svs A/C Chengdong Investment Corp-Self divested a total of 3,713,353,900 shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK) between December 1, 2025, and December 22, 2025. The transactions occurred at prices ranging from IDR 238 to IDR 388 per share. This divestment reduced the entity's holdings from 25,989,764,030 shares to 22,276,410,130 shares, indicating a significant reduction in its stake in the company.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa Sell Shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sold 41,150,000 shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk for IDR 3160 per share. This transaction reduces their holding from 19,956,895,000 shares to 19,545,395,000 shares. The stated purpose is investment realization and increasing the company's free float. The transaction date was December 24, 2025.

title: Metrodata Electronics launches Megarock AI platform in partnership with AWS, reporting 9% revenue growth in Q3 2025
body: Metrodata Electronics (MTDL), through its subsidiary Mitra Integrasi Informatika (MII) and in collaboration with AWS, introduced the Megarock end-to-end AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, aimed at multiple industries. The company posted Q3 2025 sales of Rp18.8 trillion, up 9% year‑on‑year, with its solutions and consulting unit revenue rising 20.5%.

title: Indonesia launches BINA Indonesia Great Sale 2025 to spur holiday consumer spending and hit Rp110 trillion public‑spending target
body: Indonesia’s Tourism Ministry launched the BINA Indonesia Great Sale 2025, a nationwide discount campaign running Dec 18 2025–Jan 4 2026 across more than 400 malls in 24 provinces, aiming to generate Rp30 trillion in sales and support the government’s Rp110 trillion public‑spending target for 2025. The program offers up to 80 % discounts, VAT refunds of up to 11 % for foreign shoppers, and encourages “work‑from‑anywhere” in malls to boost household consumption and shopping tourism, especially from Malaysia.

title: Indonesia targets $6.6 billion in consumer spending by end‑2025 via discount campaigns
body: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said the government aims to reach Rp110 trillion (about US$6.56 billion) in consumer spending by the end of 2025, supported by the National Online Shopping Day (which generated Rp35 trillion in transactions) and the Shop Locally in Indonesia campaign targeting Rp30 trillion. The initiatives offer discounts of up to 50%, additional cuts of up to 25% and cash‑back of up to 10%, and are expected to boost domestic consumption and attract shopping tourism, especially from Malaysian visitors.

title: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara begins talks with the United States on access to critical minerals and reciprocal tariff exemptions
body: Danantara is negotiating with US firms to secure access to Indonesia's nickel, bauxite and rare earth elements and to obtain tariff exemptions for commodities such as palm oil, cocoa and coffee, while legal drafting for a reciprocal trade agreement between President Prabowo Subianto and President Donald Trump is slated for January 2026. The government highlighted existing US involvement through Freeport-McMoRan, Vale Indonesia and state‑owned Timah, noting the talks operate under a business‑to‑business scheme.

title: Kalbe Farma completes Rp55.95 billion affiliate transaction involving Hale International and Forsta Kalmedic Global
body: Kalbe Farma executed a Rp55.95 billion sale‑and‑purchase of two adjacent land parcels and a building (total 25,100 sqm) with its subsidiary Hale International (99% owned) and Forsta Kalmedic Global (indirectly 91.98% owned through Enseval Putera Megatrading and Enseval Medika Prima). The company stated the deal follows standard business practices and will not materially affect its financial, operational or continuity outlook.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sells 411.5 million Impack Pratama shares at a discount, reducing its stake to 35.6%
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa divested 411.5 million Impack Pratama shares at Rp3,160 each, 17.49% below the closing price, raising roughly Rp1.3 trillion. The transaction lowered Harimas' holding to 19.54 billion shares (35.60% of Impack Pratama), down from 19.95 billion shares (36.35%).

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange expects six bond issuances to be listed in January 2026
body: Six issuers—Energi Mega Persada, Summarecon Agung, PNM, Bank UOB, TBS Energi Utama and Chandra Asri Pacific—have slated bond or sukuk listings on the Bursa Efek Indonesia in January 2026, each with a nominal size of around Rp500 billion (PNM also plans a Rp1.5 trillion sukuk). As of 19 December 2025, the exchange had recorded 178 bond and sukuk issuances from 79 issuers totalling Rp209.39 trillion.

title: PT Krakatau Steel Tbk obtains Rp4.93 trillion loan from PT Danantara Asset Management to finance golden‑handshake retirements and working‑capital, reporting Q3 profit
body: The company received a Rp4.93 trillion loan from PT Danantara Asset Management, of which Rp752.80 billion will fund a voluntary early‑retirement (golden‑handshake) scheme and pension clean‑up, while Rp4.18 trillion supports working‑capital for raw‑material purchases. In Q3 2025, PT Krakatau Steel Tbk posted a net profit of USD 22.17 million (≈Rp370 million) after a USD 185.22 million loss the previous year.

title: Chengdong Investment Corporation reduces its stake in PT Bumi Resources Tbk by 1% after selling 3.71 billion shares in December 2025
body: Between 1 and 22 December 2025, Chengdong Investment Corporation sold 3,713,353,900 shares of PT Bumi Resources Tbk in 21 transactions at prices ranging from IDR 238 to IDR 388 per share, lowering its holding from 6.99% (25,989,764,030 shares) to 5.99% (22,276,410,130 shares). The company now holds 26,781,807,730 shares (7.21%) of the total 371,335,392,068 shares outstanding, with Mach Energy (Hongkong) Limited and Treasure Global Investments Limited remaining the largest shareholders.

title: PT Kobexindo Tractors Tbk delivers first batch of 10 Tonly DTH145 hybrid dump trucks to a mining customer.
body: On 26 December 2025, PT Kobexindo Tractors Tbk (KOBX) shipped 10 units of the 91‑ton Tonly DTH145 hybrid dump truck, which claims up to 20% better fuel efficiency than comparable diesel models. The company highlighted the technology’s lower emissions, higher durability and stable productivity as strategic benefits for mining operators.

title: PT Indomobil Multi Jasa Tbk completes a Rp499.285 billion capital injection into PT CSM Corporatama via a rights issue
body: On October 24, 2025, PT Indomobil Multi Jasa Tbk (IMJS) deposited Rp499,285 billion as capital into its 99.99% owned subsidiary PT CSM Corporatama, using the net proceeds from its limited public offering that issued 2,194,937,500 new shares at an exercise price of Rp230 per share. The rights issue had a ratio of 138 existing shares to 35 HMETD, and the funds are intended to support CSM’s vehicle‑rental operations under the Indorent brand.

title: PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk. (OMED) Ends Share Buyback Program After Near‑Full Utilization of Rp5 bn Allocation
body: The company announced that the buyback, which began in mid‑2025, was terminated effective 11 December 2025 after repurchasing 24,993,800 shares for Rp4.88 billion, representing 97.5% of the approved Rp5 billion limit. Management said the early cessation has no material impact on operations, finances, legal matters, or business continuity.

title: Commissioner Budi Aditya Erna Mulyanto purchases 500,000 shares of PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk., raising his stake to 13.69%
body: On 19 December 2025, Budi Aditya Erna Mulyanto bought 500,000 shares of PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk. (PPRI) at Rp279 each, a transaction worth about Rp139.5 million executed through KB Valbury Sekuritas and recorded by KSEI, increasing his holding to 147.1 million shares (13.69%). The stock closed unchanged at Rp276 on 24 December 2025.

title: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk. signs share purchase agreement to acquire 100% of SMS Development Limited
body: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk. (RATU), through its subsidiary PT Raharja Energi Madura (REM), signed a Share Sale Purchase Agreement on 25 December 2025 to buy all shares of SMS Development Limited, which holds a 20% stake in Husky‑CNOOC Madura Limited (HCML). The transaction, classified as material under OJK regulations, awaits shareholder approval and currently has no material impact on RATU’s operations or financial condition.

title: PT Modern Internasional Tbk reports negative equity and outlines debt‑to‑equity swap, asset sales, and partnership with Genertec International to improve capital structure
body: As of 30 September 2025, PT Modern Internasional Tbk recorded a negative equity of Rp279.5 billion and remains on the IDX Special Monitoring Board, prompting management to pursue a debt‑to‑equity swap, asset disposals and a 7‑12‑year debt restructuring. The company also announced a partnership with Genertec International to grow revenue, with its subsidiary generating about Rp32 billion in recurring income while the parent posted roughly Rp1.5 billion.

title: Bank Mandiri provides credit relief for over 30,000 disaster‑affected borrowers in Sumatra
body: Bank Mandiri is implementing a special credit treatment, in line with OJK Regulation No. 19/2022, for more than 30,000 borrowers in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra, categorising them by impact severity and offering measures such as quality‑assessment focus for loans up to Rp10 billion and restructuring for up to three years. The initiative aims to ease repayment burdens and support economic recovery after the recent Sumatra disasters.

title: PLN restores electricity to 184 villages in Central Aceh after floods and landslides
body: PLN has re‑energized the distribution network in 184 villages of Central Aceh District, part of its effort to normalize 323 substations after flash floods and landslides. The company continues repairing 139 affected substations and airlifted an emergency generator to Takengon Regional Hospital despite damaged roads and unpredictable weather.

title: Indonesia aims to boost sugar production to 3 million tons by 2026 to achieve self‑sufficiency
body: The government plans to raise national output from 2.68 million to 3 million tons by expanding sugarcane plantations to 100,000 ha, with 70,000 ha in East Java, and to distribute at least 100 tractors to farmers. If successful, Indonesia expects to stop importing white sugar and improve food security and farmer welfare.

title: PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk CEO Hadi Suhermin increases stake to 51.89% after buying 138.5 million shares
