body: On 24 December 2025, Hadi Suhermin purchased 138.5 million PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk shares in five transactions at prices between Rp350 and Rp370, raising his ownership to 5,542,024,900 shares (51.89%). The purchases were disclosed via the company's information disclosure channel on 26 December 2025.

title: PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk clarifies Sinarmas investment rumors and signals openness to future collaborations
body: The company’s secretary confirmed a long‑standing relationship with Grup Sinarmas through Bank Sinarmas since 2018 but said no immediate strategic investment is planned, while leaving the door open for future collaboration and funding for LNG tanker expansion. Additionally, the firm noted that Fortune Street Limited is a Hong Kong‑based investor but did not disclose the group behind it.

title: PT Enseval Putera Megatrading Tbk. (EPMT) strengthens its asset base with a Rp55.9 billion land purchase in Bogor via subsidiary Forsta
body: PT Enseval Putera Megatrading Tbk. (EPMT), through its subsidiary Forsta, acquired a 25,100‑square‑meter plot in Bogor, West Java for Rp55.9 billion on 22 December 2025. The land, previously owned by Hale (linked to PT Kalbe Farma Tbk), is not material to EPMT’s financial or operational condition and aligns with its long‑term asset‑strengthening strategy.

title: PT Era Digital Media Tbk (AWAN) outlines cloud‑centric strategy to compete with global hyperscalers and shift focus from declining digital content business
body: In a public expose on 23 December 2025, PT Era Digital Media Tbk (AWAN) positioned itself as a local high‑performance cloud provider, highlighting innovations such as AMD‑based servers, NVMe storage since 2020, and NVIDIA A30 GPU‑as‑a‑Service, while targeting the 20 % market segment not dominated by global hyperscalers. The company acknowledged the stagnation of its Digital Content segment, treating it as a sunset business and reallocating capital toward cloud operations, which it expects to drive growth over the next five years.

title: Wintermar Offshore Marine provides USD3.2 million corporate guarantee to Bank Mandiri for Pulau Kelapa Perkasa credit facility
body: On 23 December 2025, Wintermar Offshore Marine (WINS) issued a USD3.2 million corporate and deficit cash‑flow guarantee to Bank Mandiri (BMRI) as a condition for a USD7.12 million credit facility to its joint‑venture Pulau Kelapa Perkasa. The company stated the guarantee is proportional to its shareholding and will not adversely affect its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Madurasi Murni reports Q3 2025 net profit of Rp44.81 billion, up 92.81% YoY
body: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, Madurasi Murni posted net profit of Rp44.81 billion, nearly double the Rp23.24 billion a year earlier, with earnings per share rising to Rp16.45 from Rp8.53. Net revenue reached Rp1.08 trillion, a 3.84% increase, while total assets fell to Rp1.7 trillion and liabilities decreased to Rp293.6 billion.

title: Chengdong Investment Corp sells 3.7 billion Bumi Resources shares, cutting its stake to 5.99%
body: Between 1 and 22 December 2025, Chengdong Investment Corp disposed of 3,713,353,900 Bumi Resources shares in 21 transactions at prices ranging from Rp238 to Rp388, raising between Rp883.77 billion and Rp1.44 trillion. The divestment reduced Chengdong’s holding to 22.27 billion shares (5.99% of Bumi Resources), down from 25.98 billion shares (6.99%) before the sales, while Bumi Resources closed at Rp362 per share on 24 December 2025, a 4.74% decline from the prior session.

title: Chengdong Corporation Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Chengdong Corporation sold 3,713,353,900 shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK), reducing its holding from 25,989,764,030 to 22,276,410,130 shares. The transaction, classified as 'others' with a stated purpose of 'investment', occurred on December 29, 2025. No specific price per share was provided for this large-scale divestment, the significance of which lies in the substantial reduction of Chengdong Corporation's stake in the company.

title: Kreasi Jasa Persada Buy Shares of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk
body: Kreasi Jasa Persada acquired 94,940,000 shares of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk, increasing its stake from 0 to 94,940,000 shares. The transaction, occurring on December 24, 2025, at IDR 4,888 per share for a total of IDR 463,617,920,000, is for investment purposes. This marks Kreasi Jasa Persada's entry into significant ownership of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk.

title: Elang Media Visitama Buy Shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk
body: Elang Media Visitama acquired 150,000,000 shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA.JK) for investment purposes, with transactions on December 24, 2025, at IDR 1,050 per share (50,000,000 shares) and December 29, 2025, at IDR 895 per share (100,000,000 shares). This increases their holding from 9,175,800,159 shares to 9,325,800,159 shares.

title: Jimmy Budiarto Sell Shares of J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk
body: Jimmy Budiarto sold 661,500,000 shares of J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk (PSAB.JK) on December 23, 2025, at IDR 126 per share. This transaction reduced his holding from 24,475,500,000 shares to 23,814,000,000 shares, a decrease of 661,500,000 shares.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan divested 19,230,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). Following the transaction, his holdings decreased from 1,013,230,000 shares to 994,000,000 shares. The sales occurred on December 23, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 85.0 to IDR 92.0 per share. This divestment represents a reduction in Jemmy Kurniawan's ownership stake in the company.

title: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia Others Shares of PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk
body: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia disbursed IDR 450,000,000 through a repo facility, increasing its holdings in PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk from 0 to 450,000,000 shares. This transaction represents the establishment of a repo facility position.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan divested 19,230,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). The transactions occurred on December 23, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 85.0 to IDR 92.0 per share. Following the sale, Jemmy Kurniawan's holdings decreased from 1,013,230,000 shares to 994,000,000 shares, representing a reduction of 19,230,000 shares.

title: Ir Thio Eng Hok Buy Shares of PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk
body: Ir Thio Eng Hok acquired 17,100 shares of PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk for IDR 1,400 per share, totaling IDR 23,940,000. This transaction increases his holding from 44,900 to 62,000 shares. The purpose is stated as investment.

title: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia Others Shares of PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk
body: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia disbursed a Repo Facility amounting to IDR 450,000,000 for PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk. This transaction represents a new holding of 450,000,000 shares, as the initial holding was zero. The purpose of this transaction is the disbursement of a Repo Facility.

title: UOB Kay Hian estimates BRI and Bank Syariah Indonesia face the highest flood exposure in Sumatra, but sector risk remains limited
body: UOB Kay Hian analysts say Bank Syariah Indonesia (BRIS) has the highest proportional exposure to the Sumatra floods due to its dominance in Aceh’s Sharia‑compliant market, while Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) holds the largest absolute exposure because of its extensive micro‑loan franchise. Overall banking sector exposure is about 5% of loans and 4.6% of deposits, with limited liquidity impact expected.

title: Indonesia’s Ministry of Cooperatives urges village cooperatives to prioritize locally made goods and expand their role in processing, distribution and subsidy delivery
body: The ministry announced that Red and White Village Cooperatives must act as aggregators for micro‑enterprises, handling processing, packaging and marketing of local products while ensuring subsidized essentials like LPG, rice and medicines are sold at regulated prices. It also highlighted the cooperatives’ role in supporting the Free Nutritious Meals program and pledged infrastructure expansion to have the network fully operational by next year.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Indah Prakasa Sentosa Tbk (INPS) for a second time after the stock hit the auto‑rejection upper limit
body: The IDX halted PT Indah Prakasa Sentosa Tbk (INPS) trading on Monday, 29 December 2025, marking the second suspension within a week after the share surged 9.47% to the ARA ceiling of Rp370, having risen over 115% since early December. The continued suspension may lead to a Full Call Auction and keep the stock under special monitoring for about a week.

title: Garam Ventura Indonesia sells 116.4 million Multi Garam Utama shares for about Rp57 billion, cutting its stake to 45.14%
body: On December 23, 2025, Garam Ventura Indonesia sold 116,404,195 shares of Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) at Rp490 per share, generating roughly Rp57.03 billion and reducing its ownership to 1.66 billion shares (45.14%). The transferred shares were acquired by Sumber Garam Pratama, raising its holding to 1.14 billion shares (29.09%).

title: Indosterling Technomedia (TECH) approves 502.52 million‑share right issue to strengthen capital after leadership resignations and legal issues
body: The company plans a right issue of 502,520,000 shares at a nominal Rp50 each, approved by 51.33% of 443.19 million votes at the extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on 18 December 2025, with proceeds earmarked for financial recovery, new business development, obligations, recruitment and facilities. The issuance follows the simultaneous resignation of several directors and a 10‑year prison sentence for Komisaris Utama Sean William Henley, and any unsubscribed shares will be taken up by a standby buyer, potentially diluting existing shareholders.

title: Petrindo Jaya Kreasi (CUAN) moves to acquire majority stake in Singaraja Putra (SINI) amid divergent stock reactions
body: CUAN, via its subsidiary Kreasi Jasa Persada and affiliates, is negotiating to raise its indirect holding from 19.99% to at least 51% of Singaraja Putra (SINI) and will conduct a mandatory tender offer under POJK 9/2018. On 24 December 2025, SINI shares jumped 9.94% to Rp13,000 per share while CUAN shares slipped 1.77% to Rp2,220.

title: Jimmy Budiarto trims stake in J Resources Asia Pasifik and postpones ARA sale
body: On 23 December 2025, Jimmy Budiarto sold 661.5 million shares of J Resources Asia Pasifik (PSAB) through Artha Sekuritas Indonesia, Ciptadana Sekuritas Asia and Shinhan Sekuritas Indonesia, reducing his ownership to 90% (23.81 billion shares) and generating an estimated Rp380.36 billion. The divestiture of Arafura Surya Alam (ARA) to Danusa Tambang Nusantara (DTN) – a United Tractors (UNTR) subsidiary – has been delayed to 23 March 2026, with the conditional sale agreement valued at USD540 million (Rp8.8 trillion).

title: Directors of Global Digital Niaga purchase 813.9 million shares under MESOP at Rp436 each
body: On 18 December 2025, the management of Global Digital Niaga exercised the MESOP, buying a total of 813,8746 million shares at Rp436 per share for roughly Rp354.84 billion. The purchases were made by directors Kusumo Martanto, Lisa Widodo, Hendry and CFO Ronald Winardi, raising their individual holdings to between 0.029% and 0.135% of the company.

title: Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas (PADI) reports Q3 2025 profit swing and strong revenue growth
body: Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas (PADI) posted a net profit of Rp2.74 billion for the quarter ended 30 September 2025, a 185.33% increase from a loss of Rp28.99 billion a year earlier, driven by revenue of Rp38.47 billion (up 320.58%). The firm’s equity rose to Rp180.79 billion, total assets to Rp267.65 billion, while liabilities expanded to Rp86.85 billion.

title: Bank Julius Baer & Co.Ltd reduces its stake in Metro Healthcare Indonesia to 16.97% after a silent sale of 1 billion shares.
body: On 19 December 2025, Bank Julius Baer & Co.Ltd sold 1 billion Metro Healthcare Indonesia shares with the assistance of Bank HSBC Indonesia, lowering its holding to 5.64 billion shares (16.97%). Following a month-long suspension, Metro Healthcare's stock jumped 98.68% to Rp755 per share, which the company said it could not directly explain.

title: Bank Mandiri reports strong credit and asset growth amid stabilizing domestic liquidity in 2025
body: Bank Mandiri’s credit portfolio expanded 13.1% YoY to Rp1,452 trillion and its third‑party funds rose 15.9% YoY to Rp1,584 trillion, while total assets grew 14.6% YoY to Rp2,120 trillion, supported by an 8.3% YoY increase in M2 liquidity. The bank also improved asset quality with an NPL ratio of 0.99% and a 260% coverage ratio, and it aims to maintain double‑digit growth in credit and deposits through disciplined risk management and digitalisation.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) boosts UMKM La Suntu Tastio through Rumah BUMN program
body: Through its Rumah BUMN initiative, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) provided La Suntu Tastio with training, product curation, digital banking tools and market exposure, enabling the bag maker to expand nationally and employ ten staff. BRI’s micro‑business director, Akhmad Purwakajaya, said the success demonstrates the bank’s ongoing commitment to sustainable UMKM empowerment.

title: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk raises its stake in PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk to 87.27% after December 2025 share purchases
body: On 23 December 2025, PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk (PANI) bought about 74.8 million shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk (CBDK) at an average price of Rp6,450 per share (~Rp482.5 billion), increasing its direct ownership from 85.95 % to 87.27 %. Including a prior December purchase of roughly 2.3 billion shares for about Rp14.6 trillion, PANI’s total accumulation in December 2025 totals near Rp15.1 trillion, cementing near‑full control of CBDK, whose shares closed at Rp8,700, down 0.57 %.

title: Natureverse, the Controller, Acquires 15.34% Additional Shares in PT SLJ Global Tbk (SULI) for Rp126.99 Billion
body: Natureverse, the controller, significantly increased its stake in PT SLJ Global Tbk (SULI) by acquiring an additional 969.42 million shares, or 15.34% ownership, for an estimated Rp126.99 billion, boosting its total holding from 20.57% to 35.90%. Concurrently, PT SLJ Global Tbk (SULI) approved a private placement of up to 632 million new shares, equivalent to 10% of its paid-up capital, to strengthen its capital structure and support future expansion.

title: PT Green Power Group Tbk. Divests 0.15% Stake in PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk.
body: PT Green Power Group Tbk. (LABA) sold 2,430,900 shares, representing 0.15% of total outstanding shares, in PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk (KRYA) on December 23, 2025, reducing its ownership from 17.00% to 16.85%. This divestment, estimated at Rp401.10 million based on KRYA's closing price of Rp165 per share, was conducted through the regular market and reported by Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI).

title: PT MD Entertainment Tbk (FILM) Placed on Efek Tidak Dijamin List Amidst Unwarranted Price Surge
body: PT MD Entertainment Tbk (FILM) has been officially designated as Efek Tidak Dijamin (ETD) by Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) and PT Kliring Penjaminan Efek Indonesia (KPEI) for January 2 to January 30, 2026, following an unwarranted price surge and abnormal transaction patterns. This restriction limits trading of FILM shares to the Pasar Negosiasi without KPEI clearing guarantees, after the stock saw a 220.55% increase throughout 2025.

title: PT Gozco Plantations Tbk (GZCO) Discloses Rp200 Billion Affiliated Loan for Subsidiary PT Suryabumi Agrolanggeng (SA)
body: PT Gozco Plantations Tbk (GZCO) announced that its subsidiary, PT Suryabumi Agrolanggeng (SA), received an affiliated loan of Rp200 billion from Kreisna Dewantara Gozali on December 23, 2025. This loan, with an interest rate linked to JIBOR, is intended for PT SA's working capital, including debt repayment, and is assessed by management to maintain liquidity and operational continuity without negative impact on GZCO.

title: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra Buy Shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
body: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra acquired 200,000 shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk (ISSP.JK) at IDR 434 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases their holding from 4,138,567,530 to 4,138,767,530 shares. The purchase represents a marginal increase in their overall stake in the company.

title: Jimmy Budiarto Others Shares of J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk
body: Jimmy Budiarto reported an error in a previous filing related to J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk (PSAB.JK). The transaction involved 6,615,000,000 shares at an indicative price of IDR 126 per share, totaling IDR 833,500,000. This correction resulted in an increase of his holdings from 23,814,000,000 shares to 24,475,500,000 shares.

title: PT Haskojaya Abadi Sell Shares of Pelayaran Nelly Dwi Putri Tbk
body: PT Haskojaya Abadi sold 28,540,000 shares of Pelayaran Nelly Dwi Putri Tbk (NELY.JK) for IDR 350 per share. This transaction reduces PT Haskojaya Abadi's holding from 1,998,631,600 shares to 1,970,091,600 shares. The purpose of the transaction was sale. This represents a decrease in ownership for PT Haskojaya Abadi in the company.

title: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono Sell Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono sold 2,000,000 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk (MAXI.JK) at IDR 51.0 per share. The transaction reduced his holdings from 24,793,400 to 22,793,400 shares. The stated purpose is 'investment'. This sale represents a decrease in direct ownership for Mr. Kartono in MAXI.JK.

title: Handi Sutanto Sell Shares of Aneka Tambang Tbk.
body: Handi Sutanto sold 3,500 shares of Aneka Tambang Tbk. (ANTM.JK) for IDR 3,230 per share. This transaction, completed on December 24, 2025, resulted in Handi Sutanto's ownership decreasing from 3,500 shares to 0 shares. The stated purpose was 'Sale'.

title: Andri Hutama Putra Sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Andri Hutama Putra sold 900,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on December 23, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 1,395 to IDR 1,425 per share. Following the sale, Andri Hutama Putra's holding decreased from 20,252,100 shares to 19,352,100 shares.

title: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. Sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. sold 200,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for IDR 1440 per share, totaling IDR 288,000,000. This transaction reduces their holding from 1,710,700,057 to 1,710,500,057 shares. The stated purpose is for 'Other Investments'.

title: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk Buy Shares of PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk
body: Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk acquired 2,270,158,968 shares of PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk for IDR 6450 per share, increasing its total holding from 2,602,050,000 to 4,872,208,968 shares. This transaction signifies an increased ownership stake in the company.

title: Andri Hutama Putra Sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Andri Hutama Putra sold shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) at approximately IDR 1,410. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. Sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. sell shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) at approximately IDR 1,440. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Haskojaya Abadi Sell Shares of Pelayaran Nelly Dwi Putri Tbk
body: PT Haskojaya Abadi sold 28,540,000 shares of Pelayaran Nelly Dwi Putri Tbk for IDR 350 per share. This transaction reduced PT Haskojaya Abadi's holding from 1,998,631,600 shares to 1,970,091,600 shares. The stated purpose was a sale, indicating a reduction in ownership stake by the entity.

title: Atlas Resources (ARII) raises IDR 87.08 billion through private placement to Infra Alpha Investindo
body: Atlas Resources (ARII) completed a private placement of 319 million shares at IDR 273 per share, generating IDR 87.08 billion and increasing total shares to 3.75 billion, with all new shares subscribed by Infra Alpha Investindo. The proceeds will be used to strengthen working capital, improve equity‑to‑debt and liquidity ratios, and support the Mutara infrastructure hub.

title: Elang Media Visitama raises Superbank stake to 27.5% after December share purchases
body: Elang Media Visitama acquired an additional 9.32 billion Superbank shares (totaling 27.51% ownership) through purchases on 24 and 29 December 2025 at Rp1,050 per share, spending roughly Rp142 billion. Despite the stake increase, Superbank's price fell to Rp910, down 26.02% from 19 December but still 43.3% above its IPO price of Rp635.

title: Maybank Sekuritas acquires 450 million Sarana Mitra Luas shares in a repo transaction valued at roughly Rp165 billion
body: Maybank Sekuritas purchased 450 million shares of Sarana Mitra Luas, with the transaction settled on 24 December 2025 and estimated at Rp164.7 billion based on a Rp366 share price. At the same time, direct owner Hadi Suhermin transferred 138.5 million shares at Rp350‑370 each, incurring a payment of Rp48.77 billion.

title: Bangun Kosambi Sukses (CBDK) injects Rp2.78 trillion capital into subsidiaries Mega Andalan Sukses (MAS) and Cahaya Gemilang Indah Cemerlang
body: The company subscribed to 199,300 new shares, allocating Rp2 trillion to 88,300 Mega Andalan shares and Rp779 billion to 111,000 Cahaya Gemilang shares, resulting in 77.35% and 78.46% ownership respectively, while Agung Sedayu and Tunas Mekar Jaya each obtained 11.33% and 10.77% stakes. The capital raise aims to support working‑capital needs, improve financing flexibility, and enhance the group’s financial performance, particularly in the PIK 2 development project.

title: Indonesia's MSME Ministry launches Klinik UMKM Bangkit to support flood‑hit small businesses in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra
body: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises announced the Klinik UMKM Bangkit initiative, a one‑stop service offering financing, marketing support and production restart assistance for MSMEs affected by recent floods, with partnerships spanning 16 lending banks, six credit guarantee institutions, the Financial Services Authority (OJK), Bank Indonesia, Baznas and 22 companies including Lazada Indonesia, Shopee, Tokopedia, Grab, GoTo, Blibli, Indomaret, Alfamart and AEON. The clinics will operate from eight locations—Banda Aceh, Pidie, Pidie Jaya, North Aceh, Aceh Tamiang, Central Tapanuli, Medan and Padang—and are slated to begin early next year to create a closed‑loop local economy within six months.

title: Indonesia appoints OpenAI OpCo LLC and two other firms as VAT collectors for digital services, revokes Amazon Services Europe S.a.r.l. status
body: Indonesia’s Directorate General of Taxes appointed OpenAI OpCo LLC, International Bureau of Fiscal Documentation and Bespin Global as new value‑added tax collectors for digital services, while removing Amazon Services Europe S.a.r.l., raising the total designated VAT collectors to 254. As of 30 Nov 2025, 215 digital service providers had remitted Rp34.54 trillion ($2.2 billion) in VAT, contributing to overall digital‑economy tax receipts of Rp44.55 trillion.

title: Aracord Nusantara Group (RONY) reports a Rp4.02 bn loss for the quarter ended 30 September 2025, with equity falling to Rp2.75 bn
body: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, Aracord Nusantara Group (RONY) posted a net loss of Rp4.02 bn, driven by a 58.5% revenue decline to Rp835.67 mn and a sharp rise in general and administrative expenses to Rp3.86 bn. Equity contracted to Rp2.75 bn from Rp6.58 bn a year earlier, while total assets grew to Rp27.15 bn and liabilities surged to Rp24.39 bn.

title: PT Leyand International Tbk Announces New Board and Management Ahead of 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting as PT JSI Sinergi Mas Takes Control
body: PT Leyand International Tbk has scheduled an extraordinary shareholders meeting for 14 January 2026 to approve a new board, naming Jamal Abdul Nasir Bamadhaj as President Director along with four other directors and three commissioners. The restructuring follows PT JSI Sinergi Mas acquiring a 51% stake (2.02 billion shares) and its commitment to improve financial and operational performance through capital restructuring and new energy and mining ventures.

title: Panca Global (PEGE) approves 944.47 million-share right issue and matching warrant offering
body: Panca Global (PEGE) received unanimous shareholder approval at its extraordinary meeting on 24 December 2025 to issue up to 944.47 million new shares at a nominal Rp100 each, together with an equal number of warrants. The proceeds will be used for working capital, increasing its stake in subsidiaries and strengthening subsidiary capital, classified as material and affiliate transactions under POJK 17/2020 and POJK 42/2020.

title: Bel S.A completes mandatory tender for Mulia Boga Raya shares, absorbing only 0.019% of the offer and securing up to 26.6% ownership
body: Bel S.A finished the mandatory tender for Mulia Boga Raya (KEJU) on 23 December 2025, taking up 43,950 shares at Rp614 each (≈Rp26.98 million), which represents only 0,0191 % of the 229.85 million‑share target, leaving about 99.98 % unabsorbed. After the tender, Bel S.A will hold a maximum of 1,495,477,874 shares (26.59 % of paid‑up capital), below the 80 % threshold that would trigger a forced share‑sale under POJK 9/2018, and it has no plans to delist, go private, or liquidate the company while pursuing a joint cheese‑business collaboration with Garudafood.

title: PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk (TRON) signs MoU with PT INAKO Kreta Udhaya to explore procurement of up to 2,000 electric vehicles
body: PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk (TRON) and PT INAKO Kreta Udhaya signed a Memorandum of Understanding on December 29, 2025 to explore the procurement of approximately 2,000 electric vehicles and related after‑sales and operational support. The companies will conduct technical pilots, evaluate operational models and consider Battery‑as‑a‑Service, aiming to strengthen TRON’s electric mobility ecosystem and create long‑term value for stakeholders.

title: Post-Suspension, PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk. (NINE) Eyes USD150 Million Mongolian Mining Acquisition
body: PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk. (NINE) has secured an option to acquire mining assets in Mongolia from Poh Golden Ger Resources Pte Ltd. for an indicative USD150 million (approximately Rp2.52 trillion). This plan emerges after a four-month trading suspension, with NINE's stock subsequently experiencing consecutive auto rejections and a 26.46% decline to Rp228 per share.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk Reports Significant Progress on Rp17.4 Trillion Mining Services Contract and Strategic Group Synergies.
body: PT Petrosea Tbk (PTRO) has achieved over 7.2 million BCM of overburden removal for its life-of-mine mining services contract with PT Pasir Bara Prima (PBP), a project estimated at Rp17.4 trillion encompassing 234.9 million BCM overburden and 26.0 million tons of coal production. This development aligns with Petrindo's planned acquisition of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk (SINI) and includes PT Lintas Kelola Bersama (LKB) constructing a 29.6 km hauling road.

title: PT JACCS Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Finance Indonesia Tbk Temporarily Dismisses Director Supriyanto
body: PT JACCS Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Finance Indonesia Tbk (MPMF) temporarily dismissed Supriyanto from his director position, effective December 23, 2025, without disclosing the reason, though the company assures business operations remain unaffected. This follows the recent appointment of Yimmy Weddianto as a new director on November 4, 2025.

title: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA) Announces Interim Cash Dividend of Rp105.68 Billion for Fiscal Year 2025
body: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA) has announced plans to distribute an interim cash dividend totaling Rp105.68 billion for the 2025 fiscal year, setting the dividend at Rp25 per share. Based on the stock's closing price of Rp6,200 per share on December 29, this interim dividend reflects a yield of approximately 0.4 percent.

title: PT Djasa Ubersakti Tbk. Plans Private Placement, Making PT Penajam Makmur Jaya New Controlling Shareholder
body: PT Djasa Ubersakti Tbk. (PTDU) announced a private placement to issue up to 3.2 billion new shares at Rp50 each, aiming to raise approximately Rp160 billion for debt payment and working capital, with PT Penajam Makmur Jaya acquiring all new shares and becoming the new controlling shareholder. This corporate action is projected to significantly improve PTDU's financial structure by September 2025, with the current ratio increasing from 29.9% to 260% and the Debt to Equity Ratio improving from -16.74% to 0.62%.

title: PT Estika Tata Tiara Tbk (BEEF) Shares Surge Amidst Daesang Holdings Interest Speculation and Strategic Growth
body: PT Estika Tata Tiara Tbk (BEEF) shares surged 20% to Rp492 per share following market speculation of interest from South Korean food company Daesang Holdings. This interest is driven by BEEF's aggressive business transformation, its role in the Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) program, and integrated expansion in the national animal protein sector, positioning it as an attractive target for global investors.

title: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk. (CUAN) Subsidiary Acquires 19.74% Stake in PT Singaraja Putra Tbk. (SINI) for Rp464 Billion
body: PT Kreasi Jasa Persada, a subsidiary of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk. (CUAN), acquired approximately 95 million shares of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk. (SINI) at Rp4,888 per share, totaling around Rp464 billion. This transaction increased PT Kreasi Jasa Persada's direct ownership in SINI to 19.74%, with CUAN planning to further increase its stake to a minimum of 51% as part of its investment and business expansion strategy.

title: PT Roda Vivatex Tbk. (RDTX) Announces Rp200 Interim Cash Dividend Per Share for Fiscal Year 2025
body: PT Roda Vivatex Tbk. (RDTX) will distribute an interim cash dividend of Rp200 per share, totaling Rp53.76 billion, for the 2025 fiscal year, representing a 20.23% dividend payout ratio from its Rp265.79 billion net profit as of September 30, 2025. The cum dividend date for the cash market is January 12, 2026, with the dividend reflecting a yield of approximately 1.6% based on the Rp12,600 share price on December 29, 2025.

title: Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh Buys Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh acquired 30,800 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) through an investment transaction. The purchase price was IDR 156 per share, totaling IDR 4,804,800. Following this transaction, his total holdings increased from 1,190,000 shares to 1,220,800 shares, representing a net increase of 30,800 shares. This move indicates a growing stake in the company by Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh.

title: Doni Mora sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Doni Mora sold 50,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for IDR 164,000,000, at an average price of IDR 3,280 per share, for other investment purposes. This transaction reduced his total holdings from 2,987,100 shares to 2,937,100 shares, a decrease of 50,000 shares.

title: Multi Artha Pratama Increased Capital Participation Shares of PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk.
body: Multi Artha Pratama has increased its capital participation in PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk. (PANI.JK) by acquiring 969,970,500 shares at IDR 12,975 per share, for a total transaction value of IDR 12,579,510,000,000. This transaction increases Multi Artha Pratama's holding from 15,224,337,389 shares to 15,234,037,094 shares, representing a net increase of 9,699,705 shares.

title: R. Djoko Prayitno Se Buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: R. Djoko Prayitno Se acquired 63,900 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction, executed at IDR 156 per share, increased his total holdings from 2,444,700 to 2,508,600 shares, marking a net increase of 63,900 shares.

title: Helmi Arif Hidayat buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: Helmi Arif Hidayat acquired 62,800 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) at IDR 156 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases his total holdings from 2,450,100 to 2,512,900 shares, reflecting a net increase of 62,800 shares. The acquisition signifies a growing stake in the company by the investor.

title: Jimmy Budiarto Others Shares of J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk
body: Jimmy Budiarto reported an error in a previous transaction, adjusting holdings in J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk. The adjustment involved 6,615,000 shares at IDR 126 per share, totaling IDR 833,490,000. This correction increased his total holdings from 23,814,000,000 shares to 24,475,500,000 shares. The purpose is to rectify a reporting mistake.

title: Mariati buy Shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk
body: Mariati acquired 14,238,500 shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk (STTP.JK) at IDR 3,015 per share. This transaction, for settling rights and obligations, increases her stake from 65,001,000 to 79,239,500 shares. The total transaction value was IDR 42,941,177,500.

title: Erlin Sutioso sell Shares of ASHA
body: Erlin Sutioso sold shares of ASHA. The transaction details indicate a sale with no specific price or amount transacted provided. Consequently, there is no change in holdings reported, remaining at zero before and after the transaction.

title: Janto Lili Sell Shares of Wintermar Offshore Marine Tbk
body: Janto Lili sold 2,500,000 shares of Wintermar Offshore Marine Tbk (WINS.JK) for personal use. This transaction reduced his holding from 7,647,334 to 5,147,334 shares. The sales occurred on December 30, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 505 to IDR 535 per share, with a representative price of IDR 510 per share. The total value of the transaction was IDR 1,284,850,000.

title: Arif Suhirman Buy Shares of Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Timur Tbk
body: Arif Suhirman acquired 461,500 shares of Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Timur Tbk (BJTM.JK) at IDR 540 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases his total holdings from 1,183,400 shares to 1,644,900 shares, marking a net increase of 461,500 shares. The total transaction value amounts to IDR 249,210,000.

title: Henry Liem Sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold 11,500 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) for IDR 570 per share, totaling IDR 6,555,000. This transaction reduced his holdings from 155,009,459 to 154,889.59 shares. The purpose stated is to sell shares.

title: Karya Nusa Perdana Buy Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Karya Nusa Perdana acquired 13,760,000 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk for IDR 50 per share, totaling IDR 137,600,000. This investment increased their holdings from 2,864,259,300 to 3,001,859,300 shares. The transaction signifies a strategic investment by Karya Nusa Perdana in MAXI.JK.

title: Bank Of Singapore Limited others Shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk
body: Bank Of Singapore Limited transferred 2,800,000,000 shares of PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk. The transaction type is 'others' with the stated purpose of 'share transfer'. Following this transaction, Bank Of Singapore Limited's holding in BACA.JK decreased from 2,800,000,000 shares to 0 shares. The transaction occurred on December 24, 2025, with a total value of IDR 2,800,000,000.

title: Ritsuo Fukadai buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: Ritsuo Fukadai acquired 2,200 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) at IDR 156.0 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increased his total holdings from 116,700 to 118,900 shares, representing a marginal increase in his stake in the company.

title: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia Others Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia engaged in a Repurchase Agreement (REPO) transaction involving PT Hillcon Tbk shares. The transaction involved 136,700,000 shares with a price of IDR 256.0 per share, totaling IDR 136,700,000. Following the transaction, CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia's holdings increased from 2,839,135,000 to 2,975,835,000 shares, indicating a net increase of 136,700,000 shares.

title: Alexander Ramlie Sell Shares of PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk.
body: Alexander Ramlie sold 67,645,100 shares of PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk. (AMMN.JK) at IDR 6,200 per share on December 29, 2025. This transaction, amounting to IDR 419,399,620,000, is part of the restructuring of share ownership for estate planning purposes. Following the sale, Ramlie's holdings decreased from 253,422,860 to 185,777,760 shares.

title: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. Sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. sold 300,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on December 29, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 1,500 to IDR 1,720 per share. Following the sale, Mb Investment Management's holding decreased from 1,710,500,057 shares to 1,710,200,057 shares, a reduction of 300,000 shares.

title: Melissa Sintari Buy Shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk
body: Melissa Sintari acquired 17,081,200 shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk (STTP.JK) at IDR 3,015 per share on December 29, 2025. This transaction, intended for the settlement of rights and obligations between customers, increased her total holdings from 58,760,000 to 75,841,200 shares. The purchase represents a significant addition to her stake in the company.

title: Hanwha Life Insurance Indonesia Sell Shares of Lippo General Insurance Tbk
body: Hanwha Life Insurance Indonesia has divested 139,800,000 shares of Lippo General Insurance Tbk (LPGI.JK) at IDR 654 per share. This transaction reduces Hanwha Life's stake from 1,783,927,000 shares to 385,927,000 shares, a decrease of 1,398,000,000 shares. The total value of the divestment is IDR 1,398,000,000. This move signifies a significant reduction in Hanwha Life's holding in Lippo General Insurance Tbk.

title: Janto Lili Sell Shares of Wintermar Offshore Marine Tbk
body: Janto Lili sold 2,500,000 shares of Wintermar Offshore Marine Tbk (WINS.JK) for personal use. The transactions occurred on December 30, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 505 to IDR 535 per share. Following the sale, Janto Lili's direct holding decreased from 7,647,334 shares to 5,147,334 shares, a reduction of 2,500,000 shares.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko Sell Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko divested 3,538,760 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) at IDR 158.0 per share, totaling IDR 559,124,480. This transaction reduces his stake from 3,897,560 shares to 358,800 shares, a decrease of 3,538,760 shares. The stated purpose is 'Investment Strategy', indicating a potential shift in his investment approach. This significant reduction in holdings could impact market perception of the stock.

title: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk announces interim dividend schedule for FY 2025
body: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA) disclosed an interim dividend of Rp105,677 billion, or Rp25 per share, for FY 2025 and set the dividend timetable. Cum‑dividend dates are Jan 8 for regular and negotiation markets and Jan 9 for the cash market; ex‑dividend dates are Jan 9 for regular/negotiation and Jan 13 for cash, with the record date on Jan 12 2026 16:00 WIB and payment due by Jan 28 2026.

title: Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh Buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh acquired 30,800 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) through an investment transaction. The purchase price was IDR 156 per share. Following this transaction, his total holdings increased from 1,190,000 shares to 1,220,800 shares, marking a net increase of 30,800 shares.

title: Amman Mineral commissioner Alexander Ramlie sells 67.6 million shares for Rp419.4 billion, cutting his stake to 0.256%
body: On December 29, 2025, Alexander Ramlie, a commissioner of Amman Mineral (AMMN), completed the sale of 67,645,100 shares at Rp6,200 per share, generating approximately Rp419.39 billion. The divestment reduced his holding to 185.77 million shares (0.256% of the company), a decline of 0,093 percentage points, and was described as a personal estate‑planning restructuring.

title: PP Presisi (PPRE) secures three new contracts totaling Rp1.2 trillion in mining and construction projects
body: PP Presisi (PPRE) announced the award of three contracts worth a combined Rp1.2 trillion, including a Rp602 billion mining services add‑on in Halmahera, a Rp252 billion national road project in Aceh, and a Rp335 billion coal processing plant and conveyor system in East Kalimantan executed through its subsidiary. The company highlighted the deals as evidence of growing client confidence and its commitment to sustainable growth, ESG principles, and high‑quality project delivery.

title: Bank of Singapore sells 2.8 billion BACA shares at Rp1 each after earlier repurchase at Rp168 per share
body: On 24 December 2025, Bank of Singapore Limited divested its entire 2.8 billion‑share holding in Bank Capital Indonesia (BACA) at a price of Rp1 per share, with Gia Ventures Pte Ltd receiving Rp2.8 billion and not reducing its stake. This follows a 19 December 2025 repurchase‑agreement transaction where Bank of Singapore bought the same 2.8 billion shares at Rp168 per share, raising about Rp470 billion and temporarily holding the shares on behalf of Capital Global Investama, whose ownership fell to 10.1 billion shares (50.66%) after a 13.03% dilution.

title: Hanwha General Insurance Co.Ltd Increases Stake in Lippo Insurance to 61.5% After Rp914.29 Billion Share Purchase
body: Hanwha General Insurance Co.Ltd completed a purchase of Lippo Insurance shares worth Rp914.29 billion on 29 December 2025, raising its holding to 1.84 billion shares (61.5% of the paid‑up capital) at Rp654 per share. The transaction, which follows an earlier 14.9% stake acquired on 11 March 2025, does not alter control because both entities are ultimately under Hanwha Life Insurance Co.Ltd (HLI).

title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk Announces 2025 Interim Cash Dividend of IDR 1.34 per Share
body: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk (CDIA) approved an interim cash dividend for FY 2025 totaling IDR 167.67 billion, or IDR 1.34 per share, based on net profit attributable to the parent for the period ending 30 June 2025. The dividend will be paid on 29 January 2026, with cum‑dividend dates on 8 Jan (regular market) and 12 Jan (cash market) and ex‑dividend dates on 9 Jan and 13 Jan respectively.

title: AM Best upgrades Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia's outlook to stable, maintaining A‑ rating
body: AM Best changed the outlook for Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia (TUGU) from negative to stable, confirming its A‑ (Excellent) Financial Strength Rating, a‑ (Excellent) Long‑Term Issuer Credit Rating and an aaa.ID (Exceptional) Indonesia National Scale Rating. The upgrade reflects stronger underwriting, a Risk Based Capital ratio of 377.56%, and triggered a 5.83% rise in TUGU’s share price, while its price‑to‑book remains at 0.41×.

title: Indonesia's IHSG ends session in red as large‑cap and gold stocks pull down the index
body: The Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) closed at 8,609.06, down 35.18 points (0.41%) with 357 advancers, 289 decliners and 159 unchanged stocks. Pressure came from large‑cap PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) falling 3.17% and PT DCI Indonesia Tbk (DCII) dropping 9.29%, while gold‑related PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI), PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) each lost over 4%, even as the IDXInfra sector rose 2.19% led by PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (MORA) gaining 10.98%.

title: PT Darma Henwa Tbk Secures Rp5 Trillion Credit Facility from BCA and Bank Mandiri for Business Expansion
body: PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) signed a Rp5 trillion credit facility agreement with BCA and Bank Mandiri, comprising Rp3.39 trillion for investment and Rp1.61 trillion for working capital, to support its aggressive business expansion. This latest funding adds to previous loans secured this year, including Rp350 billion from BCA and OK Bank, Rp260 billion from a syndicate of banks, and Rp1 trillion from BCA, aiming to boost liquidity and operational financing.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BNI) Implements Credit Relaxation for Disaster-Affected Debtors in Sumatra.
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BNI) is implementing credit relaxation for business banking and consumer debtors impacted by disasters in Aceh, Sumatra Utara, and Sumatra Barat, in line with Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) policies. This special treatment, effective from December 10, 2025, to December 9, 2028, offers various restructuring schemes to support debtor recovery and maintain credit quality.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) posts strong 2025 results, completes corporate rebranding and receives numerous awards
body: In 2025, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBRI) appointed Hery Gunardi as President Director, launched the BRIVolution Reignite-driven corporate rebranding, and reported Q3 profit of IDR 41.2 trillion with assets up 8.2% to IDR 2,123.4 trillion, DPK up 8.2% to IDR 1,474.8 trillion, and a CAR of 25.4%. The bank also earned 163 recognitions, ranked 349th in Forbes Global 2000, topped Fortune Southeast Asia 500 among Indonesian banks, and was named Bank of the Year 2025 by The Banker.

title: PT Bank Aladin Syariah Tbk launches Phase I of its Rp500 billion Sustainable Sukuk Wakalah I offering, targeting up to Rp2 trillion in funding.
body: The bank will issue a Rp500 billion Sukuk Wakalah Berkelanjutan I with an 8.25% annual return, a 370‑day term, and first interest payment on 8 April 2026, aiming to raise up to Rp2 trillion overall. PT KB Valbury Sekuritas is appointed as the guarantor and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) will issue the jumbo certificate.

title: PT PP (Persero) Tbk accelerates divestments of PPIN and CRI to improve cash flow and balance sheet
body: PT PP (Persero) Tbk disclosed that it is speeding up the sale of its subsidiaries PT PP Infrastruktur (PPIN) and PT Celebes Railway Indonesia (CRI) with a total transaction value of about Rp1.69 trillion, involving independent consultants and regulatory compliance. The CRI sale, worth Rp282.1 billion, is at the winner‑selection stage, while the PPIN divestment to PT Varsha Zamindo Laksana for Rp1.41 trillion is pending conditions precedent, supporting a target of Rp16 trillion revenue and Rp23.5 trillion new contracts in 2026.

title: PT Widodo Makmur Perkasa Tbk aims to double 2026 revenue as beef demand and nutrition program boost outlook
body: WMPP projects national beef demand to reach 885.17 k tons by 2026, with its free nutrition program adding about 90 k tons and stimulating egg (700 k tons) and chicken (900 k‑1.1 M tons) demand, and targets revenue to be twice 2025 levels while returning to net profit through efficiency and higher asset utilization. In the first nine months of 2025 the company posted consolidated revenue of Rp697.6 billion, up 87.2% YoY, driven mainly by poultry (72.1%), and the recent PKPU resolution is expected to improve cash flow and enable divestment of non‑productive assets.

title: PT Indika Energy Tbk. establishes two new subsidiaries with PT Empat Mitra Tenaga Surya
body: On 24 December 2025, PT Indika Energy Tbk. and its subsidiary PT Empat Mitra Tenaga Surya (EMITS) created PT Indika Empat Mitra Timor (IEMT) and PT Indika Empat Mitra Sumbawa (IEMSU), each operating in Management Consulting (KBLI 70209) with INDY holding 90% and EMITS 10% of the shares. The move supports INDY’s diversification strategy and, because EMITS is 51% owned by INDY, its results will be consolidated into INDY’s financial statements.

title: Nessy Sarinda Sell Shares of PT Megalestari Epack Sentosaraya Tbk
body: Nessy Sarinda sold 397,200 shares of PT Megalestari Epack Sentosaraya Tbk (EPAC.JK) for IDR 30 per share. This transaction, intended as a sale, resulted in a decrease in her holdings from 495,802,500 to 495,405,300 shares, a reduction of 397,200 shares. The sale represents a minor adjustment in her stake within the company.

title: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono Sell Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono sold 1,700,000 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk (MAXI.JK) for IDR 51 per share. This transaction reduces his holding from 22,793,400 shares to 21,093,400 shares, a decrease of 1,700,000 shares. The stated purpose of the transaction is investment. The sale represents a direct reduction in Mr. Kartono's stake in the company.

title: Sujaka Lays Sell Shares of PT Black Diamond Resources Tbk
body: Sujaka Lays sold 70,073,800 shares of PT Black Diamond Resources Tbk (COAL.JK) for personal considerations. The transaction occurred on December 30, 2025, at a price of IDR 91.0 per share. This reduces Sujaka Lays' holding from 2,250,863,300 shares to 2,180,789,500 shares, a decrease of 70,073,800 shares.

title: Sentra Investa Maksima sell Shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk
body: Sentra Investa Maksima sold 200,000 shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk for IDR 57 per share, totaling IDR 11,400,000. This transaction reduces their holding from 99,970,600 to 99,770,600 shares, a decrease of 200,000 shares. The stated purpose for the sale is 'Liquid'. The transaction occurred on December 24, 2025.

title: Yos Effendi Susanto buy Shares of PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk
body: Yos Effendi Susanto acquired 2,600,500 shares of PT Famon Awal Bros Sedaya Tbk (PRAY.JK) through private transactions at IDR 792 per share. This purchase increases his total holdings from 117,912,000 to 120,512,500 shares, representing a net increase of 2,600,500 shares. The transaction occurred on December 29, 2025.

title: Nessy Sarinda Sell Shares of PT Megalestari Epack Sentosaraya Tbk
body: Nessy Sarinda sold a total of 23,128,500 shares of PT Megalestari Epack Sentosaraya Tbk (EPAC.JK). The transactions occurred between November 24, 2025, and December 23, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 29.0 to IDR 39.0 per share. Nessy Sarinda's stake decreased from 500,000,000 shares to 476,871,500 shares, representing a reduction of 23,128,500 shares. The purpose of the transaction is not specified. This sale indicates a decrease in Nessy Sarinda's direct ownership in the company.

title: Indonesia postpones official rice and corn self-sufficiency declaration amid flood relief efforts
body: Deputy Minister Sudaryono said the government will delay the formal announcement of rice and corn self‑sufficiency to focus on flood relief in Aceh and the Sumatra provinces, but the year‑end data still show no rice imports and record domestic production of 34.77 million tons. Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman also noted that national rice reserves reached a historic 3.39 million tons.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) outlines medium‑term growth outlook amid ongoing transformation and rebranding
body: CEO Hery Gunardi told investors that the eight‑month‑old BRIVolution Reignite transformation, which targets funding structure, operations, technology and talent, should yield stronger performance by 2026‑2027 and positions BBRI for medium‑ to long‑term investment. The bank also launched a corporate rebranding on 16 December 2025 to reinforce its universal‑bank identity rooted in UMKM and digital acceleration.

title: PT Mizuho Leasing Indonesia Tbk. Announces New Board Appointments Following Extraordinary General Meeting
body: The extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 23 December 2025 approved the respectful termination of Mohammad Syahrial as Independent Commissioner and the resignation of Konosuke Mizuta as President Director, appointing Takeshi Kurioka as his replacement pending issuance of a limited stay permit. Shareholders also approved the appointments of Fransisca Yuliana Gunawan and Ryuji Tarumi as directors, both receiving OJK approval.

title: PT Lion Metal Works Tbk’s subsidiary PT Singa Purwakarta Jaya signs an addendum for a Rp25 billion loan from PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk with a Rp20 billion deposit guarantee.
body: On 30 December 2025, PT Singa Purwakarta Jaya signed an addendum to obtain a Rp25 billion credit facility from PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk, securing the loan with a Rp20 billion deposit that represents about 4.99% of PT Lion Metal Works Tbk’s equity and is therefore not a material transaction under POJK No.17/POJK.04/2020. Management expects the loan to improve the subsidiary’s cash flow, enhance the group’s liquidity, and support sustainable business operations.

title: PT Dharma Henwa Tbk shifts to internal fleet and secures Rp1 trillion BCA loan to boost EBITDA by 2026
body: DEWA announced that from Q1 2026 it will cease using subcontractors, transferring all work to its own fleet, which will raise capex but is expected to improve margins and make EBITDA growth a quarterly KPI. The company also secured a Rp1 trillion loan from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BCA) – Rp850 billion working‑capital facility (2‑year, 7% p.a.) and Rp150 billion investment facility (5‑year, 7% p.a.) – to fund new heavy‑equipment purchases, take over subcontractor work at PT Kaltim Prima Coal and expand volume at PT Arutmin Indonesia and new coal projects.

title: PT Waskita Karya Tbk's subsidiary PT Waskita Karya Realty settles IDR 18.3 billion debt with affiliate PT Waskita Film Perkasa Realti via set‑off
body: PT Waskita Karya Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Waskita Karya Realty, resolved a reciprocal liability of IDR 18.3 billion with PT Waskita Film Perkasa Realti by offsetting the debt against cash dividend rights from its 90 % shareholding, a transaction approved by WFPR shareholders and deemed fair by the valuation firm Kantor Jasa Penilai Publik Yanuar, Rosye dan Rekan. The deal aims to streamline inter‑entity finance, improve the balance sheet and complies with OJK disclosure requirements without conflicts of interest.

title: PT Selamat Sempurna Tbk reports MYR3.2 million dividend from Malaysian subsidiary Bradke Synergies Sdn Bhd
body: PT Selamat Sempurna Tbk (SMSM) announced a dividend receipt of MYR3.2 million (approximately Rp13.14 billion) from its 100%‑owned Malaysian subsidiary Bradke Synergies Sdn Bhd, which reported net assets of Rp421.09 billion and a period‑ending profit of Rp64.03 billion. The company had previously received dividends of Rp34.12 billion from PT Panata Jaya Mandiri and Rp25.05 billion from PT Prapat Tunggal Cipta, totaling Rp59,174 billion.

title: Pefindo assigns idA+ stable rating to PT Summarecon Agung Tbk's Rp3 trillion Sustainable Bond V 2025 issuance
body: PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (Pefindo) gave an idA+ rating with a stable outlook to PT Summarecon Agung Tbk (SMRA) for its Rp3 trillion Sustainable Bond V 2025, also rating the company and its existing Sustainable Bond IV at idA+ for the period 10/9/2025 to 1/9/2026. The rating may be lowered if sales, construction progress, or debt levels fall short of expectations, while sustained sales growth, higher recurring revenue, and EBITDA above forecasts could lead to an upgrade.

title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk. secures up to USD200 million loan from Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited
body: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk. signed a term loan agreement with Bangkok Bank Public Company Limited for a maximum of USD200 million (approximately Rp3.36 trillion), which exceeds 20% of its USD995.99 million equity and is classified as a material transaction under POJK No. 17/POJK.04/2020. The loan, bearing interest based on Term SOFR plus a margin, will be used for general corporate purposes, including operational financing and business development, and is governed by Singapore law with disputes resolved by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre.

title: Shareholder Melissa Sintari increases stake in PT Siantar Top Tbk. (STTP) by buying 17.08 million shares
body: Melissa Sintari purchased 17,081,200 shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk. (STTP) at Rp3,015 per share, a transaction worth about Rp51.5 billion, raising her holding to 75.8 million shares (5.78%). The company's stock closed slightly higher on Dec 30, up 0.51% at Rp9,825.

title: Nessy Sarinda Sell Shares of PT Megalestari Epack Sentosaraya Tbk
body: Nessy Sarinda sold 397,200 shares of PT Megalestari Epack Sentosaraya Tbk (EPAC.JK) for IDR 30 per share. The transaction, described as a sale, resulted in a decrease in her direct holding from 495,802,500 shares to 495,405,300 shares, a reduction of 397,200 shares. The purpose of this transaction was stated as 'Sale'.

title: Singaraja Putra aims to raise its ownership to 51% in Petrindo Jaya Kreasi after CUAN subsidiary buys 19.74% of shares for Rp464 billion
body: Singaraja Putra (SINI) announced that its subsidiary CUAN has purchased 94.94 million shares (19.74%) of Petrindo Jaya Kreasi at Rp4,888 per share, amounting to Rp464 billion. The transaction is subject to ongoing negotiations with the controlling shareholders on the takeover mechanism, price, and timing, and will require definitive agreements and regulatory approvals.

title: Indonesia Strengthens Mining Governance with Enhanced Reporting, Reclamation Guarantees, and Digitalisation
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, through Director General Tri Winarno, outlined new measures for transparent, accountable and sustainable mining, including monthly reporting, real‑time production data, and mandatory reclamation guarantees that rose to 35 trillion rupiah in 2025. The government also emphasized digitalisation via MinerbaOne, formalisation of community mining, and stricter legal enforcement to curb illegal mining activities.

title: Indonesia bans imports of rice, sugar and corn for 2026 to boost self‑sufficiency
body: The Indonesian government announced a total ban on imports of rice, table sugar and corn for 2026, citing increased domestic production and a strategic shift toward national food self‑sufficiency. Forecasts show 2026 production of 3 million tonnes of sugar and 18 million tonnes of corn will exceed domestic demand, providing a buffer for price stability and food security.

title: Commissioner Jimmy Budiarto expands J Resources Asia holding by buying 661.5 million shares at a 77.69% discount
body: On 29 December 2025, Jimmy Budiarto purchased 661.5 million J Resources Asia shares at Rp126 each, costing roughly Rp83.34 billion and representing a 439‑point (77.69%) discount to the closing price of Rp565. The transaction raised his stake to 24.47 billion shares, or 92.5% of the company, up from 23.81 billion shares (90%) after a prior divestment facilitated by Artha Sekuritas Indonesia, Ciptadana Sekuritas Asia, and Shinhan Sekuritas Indonesia.

title: Mega Manunggal (MMLP) reports 77.8% decline in Q3 2025 net profit to Rp50.39 billion
body: For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, Mega Manunggal (MMLP) posted a net profit of Rp50.39 billion, down 77.76% year‑on‑year, and earnings per share fell to Rp7 from Rp33. Revenue slipped 3.24% to Rp265.45 billion while total expenses rose 11.03% to Rp118.92 billion, mainly due to higher salary and allowance costs and larger provisions for doubtful receivables.

title: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia expands Hillcon stake to 20.19% after Rp256 share purchase
body: On 29 December 2025, CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia acquired 136.7 million Hillcon shares at Rp256 per share, costing roughly Rp34.99 billion and raising its holding to 2.97 billion shares (20.19% of the company). Earlier, on 10 December 2025, Hillcon Equity Management sold 15 million shares at Rp160 each, generating Rp2.4 billion.

title: Indonesia Kendaraan Terminal (IPCC) reports 15.6% YoY increase in consolidated cargo to 1.1 million units through November 2025
body: The company handled 1,104,883 units of consolidated cargo up 15.58% year‑on‑year, driven by a 44.42% rise in truck/bus shipments and a 9.57% increase in CBU vehicles, while ship visits grew to 3,225. Management expects financial results to improve by more than 10% year‑on‑year, supported by digital PTOS‑C, BYD inland transport initiatives and rising demand for EVs, with Vietnam receiving the largest export volume of 72,776 units.

title: President Prabowo and BTN CEO visit Danantara housing project in Aceh Tamiang, announcing a target of 15,000 units
body: President Prabowo Subianto met with BTN CEO Nixon LP Napitupulu while inspecting the Danantara Huntara housing for flood‑affected residents in Aceh Tamiang, where the program aims to construct 15,000 units within the next three months. BTN CEO and Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) CEO Alex Sofjan Noor also distributed food‑aid packages to the community.

title: Founder Sujaka Lays reduces stake in PT Black Diamond Resources Tbk (COAL) to 34.9% after December share sales
body: Between 18 and 30 December 2025, founder shareholder Sujaka Lays sold a total of 819,773,900 PT Black Diamond Resources Tbk (COAL) shares, lowering his ownership from 48.01% to 34.89% and receiving prices ranging from Rp105 to Rp91 per share. During the same period, COAL’s stock price weakened, closing the year at Rp86 after fluctuating between Rp112 and a brief peak of Rp132.

title: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk (BABY) reports a material loan transaction and outlines a rights issue ahead of an extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk (BABY) disclosed a material transaction—a Rp345 billion loan from PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk involving its subsidiary PT Kanmo Multi Gemilang—that equals about 84% of its equity and is exempt from independent valuator requirements. The company also announced a rights issue of 238,571,825 new shares at Rp590 each and a planned acquisition of Emway Globalindo, subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 26 January 2026.

title: PT Bank Sumut converts to a state-owned enterprise (BUMD) and receives Rp280.98 billion capital injection from North Sumatra government
body: At its extraordinary shareholders meeting on 30 December, PT Bank Sumut approved a change of status from a private national bank to a state-owned enterprise (BUMD) organized as a Perseroan Terbatas, prompting a revision of its articles of association. The bank also received a capital contribution in kind valued at Rp280.98 billion, consisting of a 7,805 sqm land and building asset, accompanied by the issuance of new shares.

title: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol Tbk draws additional Rp100 billion loan from Bank Danamon, bringing total to Rp200 billion
body: On 31 December, Pembangunan Jaya Ancol Tbk disbursed a new Rp100 billion term loan from Bank Danamon, adding to a previous Rp100 billion disbursement on 23 September 2025 and raising the cumulative loan amount to Rp200 billion. The companies also signed a Rp20 billion Sight/Usance L/C agreement alongside the Kredit Aksep Bergaransi (KAB) facility.

title: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk completes acquisition of Esso fuel station network in Singapore
body: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk announced the closing of its purchase of the Esso-branded fuel station network in Singapore after obtaining all regulatory approvals, marking a strategic expansion of Chandra Asri Group’s integrated energy infrastructure in Southeast Asia. The company will retain the Esso brand, source fuel from ExxonMobil, maintain existing loyalty programs and keep current ExxonMobil staff operating the stations.

title: PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk reports 50% progress on free‑float divestment plan to meet BEI minimum requirement
body: PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk (RSGK) disclosed that its free‑float remains at 5.5% (51.19 million shares), below the 7.5% BEI minimum and the 10% target discussed by OJK, and that internal discussions with potential shareholders have reached 50% completion, with no divestment transactions executed yet. The company aims to sell shares via the negotiation market between December 2025 and December 2026, while the stock price has been capped at Rp980 since 31 January 2025.

title: Medco Energi (MEDC) Secures Rp24.17 Billion from Affiliated Divestment to Medco LNG Indonesia (MLI)
body: Medco Energi (MEDC) secured Rp24.17 billion from the divestment of 926,331,662 shares of Exspan Petrogas Intranusa (EPI) to Medco LNG Indonesia (MLI), an affiliated transaction completed on December 26, 2025. Medco Energi (MEDC) owns 99.99% of Exspan Petrogas Intranusa (EPI) and all shares of PT Medco LNG Indonesia (MLI), and while management claims no negative impact from the transaction, Medco Energi (MEDC) shares declined 0.74% to Rp1,345 per share at the end of last year.

title: Sillo Maritime (SHIP) Acquires New Very Large Gas Carrier for USD80.50 Million
body: Sillo Maritime (SHIP), through its subsidiary Cassa Mega Lautan, purchased a very large gas carrier for USD80.50 million from New Gas Taurus Limited, aligning with its growth strategy to boost market share and improve future financial performance. Following this transaction, total assets increased by 15.57% to USD537.89 million, total liabilities rose by 29.35% to USD319.5 million, and the debt to equity ratio improved to 53.08% from 113.13%.

title: PT Bakrie Metal Industries sells 1.26% stake in PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk to repay debt, VKTR shares close up 17.16%
body: PT Bakrie Metal Industries sold about 551.6 million shares of PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk, representing 1.26% of the capital, for an average price of Rp845 per share, raising roughly Rp466.1 billion to settle debt and reducing its ownership from 15.69% to 14.43% while retaining control. VKTR’s stock closed 17.16% higher at Rp990 on Friday.

title: PT Harum Energy Tbk. announces up to Rp335 billion share buyback program
body: PT Harum Energy Tbk. (HRUM) disclosed a voluntary share repurchase of up to Rp335 billion to be executed from 2 January to 1 April 2026 using internal cash, without affecting its operations or financial condition. The buyback, which will create treasury stock and could lift earnings per share, coincided with a 1.86% rise in the closing price on 2 January.

title: PT Boston Furniture Industries Tbk (SOFA) creates renewable‑energy subsidiary PT Parivarta Energi Nusantara following new shareholder takeover
body: After PT Asia Investment Capital acquired a 70.96% stake in PT Boston Furniture Industries Tbk (SOFA) for Rp24.64 billion on 24 October 2025, the company is expanding into renewable energy through its former subsidiary PT Pratama Satya Prima, now renamed PT Parivarta Energi Nusantara (PEN), with a capital increase funded by PT Sebelas Bersaudara Sinergi. PEN has formed a consortium with Hunan Construction Engineering Group Co. and Kintan Usahasama Sdn. Bhd. to bid on a waste‑to‑energy project tendered by PT Danantara Investment Management and is awaiting the tender outcome.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk temporarily halts mining operations pending approval of the 2026 RKAB
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO) announced a temporary suspension of mining activities across all IUPK areas because the 2026 Work Plan and Budget (RKAB) has not yet been approved by the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources. The company said the delay does not materially affect its financial condition and it remains committed to operational stability and safety while awaiting the approval.

title: Hanwha General Insurance Co Ltd Buy Shares of Lippo General Insurance Tbk
body: Hanwha General Insurance Co Ltd acquired shares of Lippo General Insurance Tbk for IDR 1,398,000,000. The transaction, priced at IDR 654 per share, was made to fulfill provisions of article 5 POJK NO 23 of 2023. This purchase increased Hanwha General Insurance's stake from 447,000,000 shares to 1,845,000,000 shares, signifying a substantial increase in ownership.

title: Bakrie Metal Industries Sell Shares of PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk
body: Bakrie Metal Industries sold shares of PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR.JK) at approximately IDR 845. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Hartono Limmantoro Sell Shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk
body: Hartono Limmantoro sold shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk (AMMS.JK) at approximately IDR 30. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Ikin Wirawan Buy Shares of PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk
body: Ikin Wirawan bought shares of PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk (WGSH.JK) at approximately IDR 140. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd Buy Shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk
body: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd bought shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk (AMMS.JK) at approximately IDR 30. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Mandara Mas Semesta Sell Shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk
body: Mandara Mas Semesta sold shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk (AMMS.JK) at approximately IDR 30. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd Buy Shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk
body: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd bought shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk (AMMS.JK) at approximately IDR 30. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan sold shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK) at approximately IDR 71. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia expands biomass co‑firing to boost bioenergy use and cut emissions
body: Indonesia’s biomass potential of 83.4 million tons per year remains largely untapped, and PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia (PLN EPI) is accelerating bioenergy deployment as part of its Net Zero by 2060 plan. As of 30 Nov 2025, co‑firing has been implemented in 49 coal‑fired plants with 2.2 million tons of biomass procured, reducing emissions by 2.53 million t CO₂e and targeting 3.0 million tons of biomass use in 2025, while the government aims for 9 million tons by 2030.

title: Palm oil producers seek regulatory clarity as EU finalizes deforestation rules
body: The Council of Palm Oil Producing Countries (CPOPC) met with EU policymakers in Brussels, urging clearer rules, realistic timelines and inclusion of smallholders in the upcoming EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) to avoid market uncertainty. CPOPC highlighted recent declines in deforestation in Indonesia and Malaysia and called for the EU to recognize this progress, while noting that UkrAgroConsult’s data underpins the AgriSupp platform.

title: Hanwha General Insurance Co. Ltd acquires 61.5% stake in PT Lippo General Insurance Tbk through a 1.398 billion‑share purchase
body: Hanwha General Insurance Co. Ltd purchased 1,398 billion shares of PT Lippo General Insurance Tbk on 29 December 2025 at Rp654 per share, raising its ownership from 14.9% to 61.5% (approximately Rp914.29 billion). The transaction complies with POJK No.23/2023 and, while boosting Hanwha's shareholding, does not automatically make it the controlling shareholder; under a broader strategic partnership with Lippo Group, Hanwha Group targets a 62.59% controlling interest.

title: Chandra Asri Pacific finalizes IDR 1.5 trillion sustainable bond issuance, detailing three series and guarantors
body: Chandra Asri Pacific announced the issuance of a IDR 1.5 trillion sustainable bond (V) in three series—Series A (IDR 150 bn at 6.5% maturing 13 Jan 2029), Series B (IDR 350 bn at 7% maturing 13 Jan 2031) and Series C (IDR 1 trn at 7.5% maturing 13 Jan 2023)—to be issued on 13 Jan 2026 and listed on 14 Jan 2026, with proceeds earmarked for working capital. The bond is underwritten by seven guarantors: BCA Sekuritas, BNI Sekuritas, BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, DBS Vickers Sekuritas, Henan Putihrai Sekuritas, Mandiri Sekuritas alias Mansek, and Trimegah Sekuritas.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. and State-Owned Enterprises Accelerate Huntara Temporary Housing Construction in Aceh Tamiang
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk., together with Danantara Indonesia and other members of Himpunan Bank Milik Negara (Himbara), is financing and supplying logistics for the first phase of the Danantara (Huntara) temporary housing project in Aceh Tamiang, delivering 600 units to the regional government on 8 January 2026 and aiming to build 15,000 units within the next three months. The construction is coordinated by PT Hutama Karya (Persero) and involves multiple BUMN, including PT Perkebunan Nusantara III (Persero), PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk, PT Brantas Abipraya (Persero), PT PP (Persero) Tbk, PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk, PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk, PT Nindya Karya (Persero), PT PLN (Persero) and PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, with President Prabowo Subianto highlighting the effort.

title: PT Toba Surimi Industries Tbk reports remaining IPO funds of Rp2.47 billion after allocating most proceeds to working capital and a vessel
body: The company disclosed net IPO proceeds of Rp55.23 billion, of which Rp52.1 billion was earmarked for working capital and Rp3.12 billion for a sea vessel; by 31 December 2025, 95.5% of the plan had been executed, using Rp52.7 billion (Rp52.1 billion for working capital and Rp650 million for the vessel) and leaving Rp2.47 billion unspent. PT Toba Surimi Industries Tbk’s IPO launched in 2022 at Rp150 per share, and its stock was trading around Rp280 as of 2 January 2026.

title: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama (PACK) announces a Rp3.25 trillion right issue using non‑interest bearing OWK with a detailed allocation plan and timeline
body: PACK will issue 32.58 billion new shares at Rp100 each, giving holders of 5 old shares a right to purchase one OWK, which can be converted 1:1 into ordinary shares before 21 January 2027; Eco Energi Perkasa (EEP) will act as standby buyer for the full subscription and the proceeds—about Rp2.82 trillion—will be used mainly for capital contributions and loans to subsidiaries Adhi Prakarsa Raya (APR) and Sumber Cahaya Raya (SCR) and for working‑capital expenses. The right‑issue schedule runs from 9 January to 28 January 2026, with listing on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on 15 January.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange sets theoretical price for PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk rights issue
body: BEI announced the theoretical price for PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET) rights issue, setting a 3:4 HMETD ratio with an execution price of Rp250 per share and a closing price of Rp770 on 2 January 2026. The theoretical price was listed at Rp472 (adjusted fraction) and the new individual stock index base price calculated at 61,912, as the company targets to raise up to Rp3.2 trillion by issuing up to 12.8 billion new shares.

title: Feisal and Jusuf Hamka restructure holdings in Citra Marga Nusaphala, each ending with ~5% stakes amid sharp CMNP price rally
body: Feisal Hamka acquired 335.33 million shares of Citra Marga Nusaphala (CMNP), bringing his stake to about 5.01%, while his brother Jusuf Hamka sold 130.8 million shares, leaving him with 360.7 million shares (5.39%). The transactions, facilitated by Indo Premier Sekuritas, Profindo Sekuritas Indonesia and Bank HSBC Indonesia, occurred as CMNP’s share price jumped 49.4% over five trading days, reaching Rp1,950 per share.

title: Wijaya Karya faces PKPU lawsuit from PT Abacurra Indonesia over a Rp794.49 million claim
body: PT Abacurra Indonesia has filed a PKPU petition against Wijaya Karya for the remaining Rp794.49 million of a Rp1.51 billion invoice, after the company paid Rp718.82 million. Wijaya Karya says the case, currently before the Jakarta Commercial Court with hearings on 29 December 2025 and 5 January 2026, will not affect its operations, legal standing, or financial performance.

title: Elang Media Visitama buy Shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk
body: Elang Media Visitama acquired 28,317,400 shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction, executed at IDR 910 per share, increased Elang Media Visitama's holding from 9,325,800,159 to 9,354,117,559 shares. This acquisition represents a minor change in the company's ownership structure.

title: President Prabowo reviews US$6 billion Danantara downstreaming projects
body: President Prabowo Subianto met Investment and Downstreaming Minister Rosan Roeslani at his Bogor residence to discuss Rp100 trillion (US$6 billion) downstreaming projects managed by Danantara, with groundbreaking ceremonies for five projects scheduled for early next month. The meeting also reviewed progress on the national waste‑to‑energy program aimed at reducing landfill waste while creating economic value.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia lifts suspension on PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk shares, stock rises 4.86%
body: After a suspension, PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk (NSSS) resumed trading on Monday, climbing 4.86% to IDR 970 and having gained over 20% in the week and nearly 54% since early December. Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) officials and NSSS CEO Teguh Patriawan said the price movement reflects market mechanisms and has no material impact on the company's operations or financial condition.

title: Master Print (PTMP) posts a Rp10.5 bn net loss for the quarter ended 30 September 2025, reversing a prior profit
body: Net loss for the period was Rp10.5 bn, resulting in a basic loss per share of Rp28 after a profit of Rp1.13 million per share in the same quarter last year. Net sales rose 3.72% to Rp97.3 bn, while gross profit fell to Rp25.59 bn and operating expenses increased, leading to a decline in equity to Rp88.17 bn and assets to Rp143.77 bn.

title: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd Acquires 51% Stake in Agung Menjangan Mas for IDR 18.9 Billion
body: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd became the new controlling shareholder of Agung Menjangan Mas (AMMS) by purchasing 630 million shares (51%) from Mandara Mas Semesta and Hartono Limmantoro for a total consideration of IDR 18.9 billion at IDR 30 per share. The company, directed by Brian Limiardi and David Viratama Batubara, will expand into digital financial assets, including tokenized instruments and B2B digital finance services.

title: Director Fadhl Muhammad Firdaus Increases Stake in PT Ayam-Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk with Rp13.75 billion Share Purchase
body: On 23 December 2025, PT Ayam-Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk director Fadhl Muhammad Firdaus bought 35,266,000 ordinary shares at Rp390 each, a transaction worth approximately Rp13.75 billion that raised his ownership from 0.80% to 1.68% of voting rights. The purchase was disclosed to the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) in compliance with Regulation No. 4/2024 and is viewed as a confidence signal amid the stock’s 204.23% rise during 2025.

title: PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (NISP) Announces Resignation of Commissioner Helen Wong, No Changes to Board of Directors
body: Helen Wong has resigned from the Board of Commissioners of PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (NISP) after a resignation letter received on 18 September 2025, ending her more than 40-year banking career; the remaining commissioner lineup and the board of directors remain unchanged.

title: Haskojaya Abadi sells 28.5 million NELY shares at a discount, raising Rp9.99 bn as the stock jumps 16%
