body: Haskojaya Abadi disposed of 28.54 million shares of Pelayaran Nelly Dwi Putri (NELY) on 24 and 29 December 2025 at an average price of Rp350 per share, generating Rp9.99 billion, which is 13.36 % below the closing price of Rp404. Following the divestment, NELY’s share price opened 2026 at Rp464, a 16 % increase from the prior close of Rp400.

title: SLJ Global (SULI) secures SGD2 million interest‑free shareholder loan to improve liquidity
body: On 31 December 2025, SLJ Global (SULI) received an interest‑free shareholder loan of SGD2 million (≈Rp25.86 billion) from Amir Sunarko and the majority‑shareholder Naturverse Inc (Pte Ltd), maturing on 31 March 2026. The loan is intended to reduce short‑term liabilities, strengthen cash flow and support the company’s operational continuity and growth plans.

title: Axiata Investments reduces Link Net stake to meet free‑float requirement
body: Axiata Investments divested 36,562,377 shares of Link Net on 30 December 2025, reducing its holding to 1.98 billion shares (69.38%) from 2.02 billion (70.66%). The sale, facilitated by Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia, raises Link Net’s free‑float to the regulatory minimum of 7.5% (214.73 million shares), while treasury shares stand at 111.61 million (3.9%) and XLSmart holds 550.31 million (19.22%).

title: Saka Industrial Arjaya raises its ownership in Mega Manunggal Property to 91.44% through a share addition valued at Rp266.33 billion
body: On 30 December 2025, Saka Industrial Arjaya, a subsidiary of Astra Group, added 534,813,870 thousand shares of Mega Manunggal Property (MMLP) with assistance from Mandiri Sekuritas (Mansek), increasing its stake to 6.29 billion shares (91.44%). The transaction, based on a closing price of Rp498 per share, was valued at Rp266.33 billion, and Mega Manunggal’s share price rose to Rp555 on 2 January 2026, up 11.45% from year‑end.

title: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk appoints new board and seeks loan facilities after extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk held an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 19 December 2025, appointing Dionysius Tjokro as President Director, Axel Tobias Joel as Director, Karnadi Margaka as President Commissioner, Adi Sulaiman as Commissioner, and Purwan Habibie Siswanto as Independent Commissioner. The new management is pursuing bank and financial institution loan facilities, citing low interest rates and a strong balance sheet with liabilities of Rp9.61 billion against equity of Rp41.43 billion as of 30 September 2025.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk plans to acquire 45% of PT Trimata Coal Perkasa for Rp1.6 trillion
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA) has signed a conditional agreement to acquire a 45% controlling stake in PT Trimata Coal Perkasa for Rp1.6 trillion, meeting the requirements for MEJA to become the controlling shareholder, with payment to be made in several stages. The deal follows Triple B’s recent purchase of 878,845,100 MEJA shares at Rp20 per share (totaling Rp17,576 billion) and gives MEJA access to Trimata’s 693.7 million‑ton coal resource and a production permit for 2.6 million tons in 2024‑2026.

title: PT Batavia Prosperindo Internasional Tbk completes capital reduction by cancelling 425.8 million treasury shares
body: PT Batavia Prosperindo Internasional Tbk (BPII) eliminated 425,820,000 treasury shares bought back in 2022, reducing its issued share count from 10,309,973,240 to 9,884,153,240. The reduction was approved by the Minister of Law (Decision No. AHU-0084330.AH.01.02.TAHUN 2025) and the Indonesia Stock Exchange (letter No. S-14574/BEI.PP2/12-2025).

title: PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk announces cessation of operations for three subsidiaries by end-2025
body: The company will halt operations of PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Boga, PT ANJ Agri Papua and PT Gading Mas Indonesia Teguh effective 31 December 2025 as part of a business‑strategy realignment, stating the move will not materially affect its overall operations, finances, legal standing or continuity. The decision follows last year’s reported 91.16% acquisition offer by First Resources Ltd.

title: PT Kentanix Supra International Tbk. increases capital in three affiliates by approximately IDR 872 billion
body: On 29 December 2025, PT Kentanix Supra International Tbk. (KSIX) raised its paid‑in capital in PT Semangat Panca Bersaudara (SPB) to 38,500 shares (IDR 38.5 billion), in PT Pancasatria Putraunggul (PSPU) to 452,600 shares (IDR 452.6 billion), and in PT Intan Buana Mandiri (IBM) to 380,935 shares (IDR 380.9 billion), supporting infrastructure works, land acquisition in Bekasi, and the Harvest City project. The transactions involve KSIX’s 99% stake in SPB, 40% in PSPU and 36.02% in IBM, qualifying them as related‑party transactions under market‑capital regulations.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk. (ADRO) Establishes Conversion Rate for 2025 Interim Cash Dividend
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk. (ADRO) has officially set the conversion rate for its 2025 interim cash dividend at Rp16,720 per USD, based on Bank Indonesia's mid-rate as of January 2, 2026. This conversion results in a total dividend payout of Rp4.18 trillion (Rp4,180,103,728,188), or Rp145.14 per share, with the company stating no material impact on its operations or financial condition.

title: PT MPX Logistics International Tbk (MPXL) Shares Rise Amidst 2026 Business Strategy Announcement
body: Shares of PT MPX Logistics International Tbk (MPXL) increased by 11.36% to Rp 294, following the company's announcement of six strategic business plans for 2026 aimed at strengthening performance. These strategies, which include expanding transport routes and commodity portfolios, are seen by market observers as potential catalysts for corporate actions and investor interest, supported by positive technical signals.

title: Yulisar Khiat Buys Shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk
body: Yulisar Khiat acquired 11,274,200 shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk (HEAL.JK) at IDR 1,387 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases Yulisar Khiat's total holdings from 975,554,966 to 986,829,166 shares, representing a net increase of 11,274,200 shares. The acquisition signifies continued confidence in the company's prospects.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama (BUMA) Announces Leadership Reshuffle Effective January 2026
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama (BUMA), a key subsidiary of PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk. (DOID), announced a reshuffle of its board of directors and commissioners, effective January 1, 2026. Ronald Sutardja, previously President Commissioner, has been appointed as the new President Director of BUMA, replacing Indra Kanoena, with other leadership adjustments approved to ensure management continuity and operational stability.

title: Ika Kusuma Putri B Buys Shares of PT Imago Mulia Persada Tbk
body: Ika Kusuma Putri B acquired 149 shares of PT Imago Mulia Persada Tbk through an investment transaction at IDR 655.0 per share. This purchase increases her holdings from 0 to 149 shares, marking her initial investment in the company. The transaction signifies a new direct ownership stake.

title: Saka Industrial Arjaya Buy Shares of PT Mega Manunggal Property Tbk
body: Saka Industrial Arjaya acquired 53,481,387 shares of PT Mega Manunggal Property Tbk (MMLP.JK) at IDR 580 per share. This transaction increases their holding from 5,764,371,329 to 6,299,185,199 shares. The stated purpose is investment, signifying a continued stake in the company.

title: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra Buy Shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
body: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra acquired 1,239,100 shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk (ISSP.JK) for an undisclosed total amount, at a representative price of IDR 424 per share. This transaction increases their holding from 4,138,767,530 shares to 4,140,006,630 shares, representing a net increase of 1,239,100 shares. The stated purpose of this acquisition is investment.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan divested 7,390,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). The transaction occurred on January 2, 2026, with sales prices at IDR 71.0 and IDR 72.0 per share. Following the divestment, Jemmy Kurniawan's holding decreased from 989,500,000 to 982,110,000 shares, a reduction of 7,390,000 shares.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com Buy Shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
body: 1 Inti Dot Com acquired 7,050,000 shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk for IDR 17,150,000,000 (IDR 1,715 per share) on December 18, 2025. This transaction increased their holding from 68,103,300 shares to 78,978,300 shares, representing a net increase of 10,875,000 shares. The stated purpose is investment.

title: Haryanto Sofian Buy Shares of Perdana Karya Perkasa Tbk
body: Haryanto Sofian acquired 50,000 shares of Perdana Karya Perkasa Tbk (PKPK.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction occurred on January 2, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 1,395 to IDR 1,400 per share. Following the purchase, Haryanto Sofian's holdings increased from 2,099,200 to 2,149,200 shares, representing a net increase of 50,000 shares.

title: Sumber Garam Pratama Sell Shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk
body: Sumber Garam Pratama divested 20,514,159 shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk at IDR 341 per share. This transaction reduced their holding from 1,148,510,940 shares to 1,127,996,781 shares. The purpose of this transaction was divestment.

title: Andri Hutama Putra Sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Andri Hutama Putra sold 1,500,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on December 29-30, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 1,500 to IDR 1,875 per share. Following these sales, Andri Hutama Putra's holdings decreased from 19,352,100 shares to 17,852,100 shares, representing a reduction of 1,500,000 shares.

title: Ika Kusuma Putri B Buy Shares of PT Imago Mulia Persada Tbk
body: Ika Kusuma Putri B acquired 149 shares of PT Imago Mulia Persada Tbk through an investment transaction at IDR 655 per share. This purchase marks the beginning of her holdings, increasing her stake from 0 to 149 shares. The transaction signifies a new investment in the company.

title: Oki Widjaja Bought Shares of PT Galva Technologies Tbk
body: Oki Widjaja acquired 138,700 shares of PT Galva Technologies Tbk (GLVA.JK) at IDR 422 per share. This transaction increased his holdings from 36,877,700 to 37,016,400 shares. The stated purpose is divestment, implying this purchase is part of a broader strategy. This buy transaction, despite the divestment purpose, adds to his stake in the company.

title: Buana Graha Utama Buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama acquired 100,000 shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk for IDR 570 per share, totaling IDR 57,000,000. This purchase increases Buana Graha Utama's stake from 287,146,518 shares to 287,246,518 shares, representing a minor increase in their investment in the company.

title: Yunita Sugiarto Ew Bought Shares of PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk
body: Yunita Sugiarto Ew acquired 272,900 shares of PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk (BOBA.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on December 30, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 179 to IDR 187 per share. Following these purchases, Yunita Sugiarto Ew's total holdings increased from 32,272,000 shares to 32,544,900 shares, marking a net increase of 272,900 shares.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher Buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher acquired 1,240,500 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred between December 30, 2025, and January 2, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 1,760 to IDR 1,970 per share. Following these purchases, Dannacher's holding increased from 200,283,122 shares to 201,523,622 shares, representing a net increase of 1,240,500 shares.

title: Dewi Irianty Wijaya Sell Shares of PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk
body: Dewi Irianty Wijaya sold a total of 3,613,600 shares of PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk. The transactions occurred on December 29, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 164.0 to IDR 192.0 per share. Following these sales, Wijaya's holding decreased from 67,423,900 shares to 63,810,300 shares. The purpose of the transaction was not specified. This represents a reduction in her stake in the company.

title: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng Sell Shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk
body: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sold 8,290,000 shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk at IDR 120 per share on January 5, 2026. This transaction reduces their holding from 314,135,000 shares to 305,845,000 shares, a decrease of 8,290,000 shares. The stated purpose is investment. This sale represents a direct reduction in the fund's stake in the company.

title: Indonesia’s Energy Ministry raises coal benchmark prices for the first half of January 2026
body: The benchmark (HBA) for 6,322 kcal/kg coal is set at USD 103.30 per ton, up 2.4%; 5,300 kcal/kg at USD 72.23 per ton (+3.2%); 4,100 kcal/kg at USD 47.05 per ton (+3.5%); and 3,400 kcal/kg at USD 35.13 per ton (+0.3%). These rates, effective 1–15 January 2026, follow Ministerial Decree No. 458.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2025 and are calculated per Decree No. 72 of 2025.

title: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja Buy Shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk
body: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja acquired 550,400 shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ.JK) for IDR 1,440 per share, totaling IDR 792,576,000. This transaction increased his holding from 126,051,060 shares to 126,601,460 shares. The stated purpose is 'Business'. This acquisition represents a minor increase in his stake within the company.

title: Sabana Prawira Widjaja Buys Shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk
body: Sabana Prawira Widjaja acquired 700,000 shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ.JK) for IDR 1440 per share, totaling IDR 1,008,000,000. This transaction, intended for business purposes, increased his total holdings from 5,527,219,300 to 5,527,919,300 shares. The acquisition represents a minor addition to his already substantial stake in the company.

title: Indonesia raises export benchmark price for copper concentrate to $5,868.51 per ton, citing global demand and a weaker dollar
body: The Ministry of Trade (Kemendag) set the export benchmark price (HPE) for copper concentrate with ≥15% Cu at USD 5,868.51 per wet metric ton for 1–14 January 2026, a 4.54% rise from the December 2025 level, while the HPE for gold increased to USD 138,324.41 per kilogram and its reference price to USD 4,302.37 per troy ounce. Acting Director General of Foreign Trade Tommy Andana attributed the copper price hike to stronger global demand for strategic minerals, a weaker U.S. dollar, and simultaneous price gains in copper (5.75%), gold (3.29%) and silver (16.46%), with pricing based on LME and LBMA data and coordinated among several ministries.

title: PT PP Presisi Tbk secures IDR 1.2 trillion in new mining and construction contracts by year‑end 2025
body: PT PP Presisi Tbk (PPRE) announced three new contracts worth about IDR 1.2 trillion, covering a mining services add‑on in Halmahera (IDR 602 bn), the Jantho–Keumala National Road Section 3 in Aceh (IDR 252 bn) and a coal processing plant with conveyor system in East Kalimantan (IDR 335 bn). The contracts strengthen the company’s mining services and infrastructure portfolio ahead of fiscal‑year close and underscore client confidence in its capabilities.

title: Mining issuers are set to boost inorganic growth through acquisitions in 2026, focusing on gold and critical minerals
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM), PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) and PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk (PSAB) are pursuing mine acquisitions domestically and abroad, with analysts expecting intensified activity and higher capex in 2026; target prices were set at IDR 4,100 for ANTM, IDR 32,000 for PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR), IDR 720 for PSAB and IDR 700 for DEWA.

title: Indonesia expects rebar export rebound after Australia lifts anti‑dumping duties
body: Australia’s Anti‑Dumping Commission exempted Indonesian hot‑rolled deformed steel rebar from anti‑dumping duties, finding a 1.3% dumping margin, and the Indonesian Ministry of Trade expects exports to recover after the probe halted a decline from $55.6 million in 2023 to about $31 million in 2024. Trade Minister Budi Santoso said the decision will restore market access and boost the competitiveness of Indonesian steel products.

title: Entitas Central Omega secures Rp245 billion loan for Mega Buana Resources from Bank China Construction Bank Indonesia
body: On 30 December 2025, Entitas Central Omega (DKFT) signed a three‑month direct loan agreement with Bank China Construction Bank Indonesia (MCOR) to provide Mega Buana Resources with a Rp245 billion facility, collateralised by a corporate deposit. The loan carries an interest spread of 0.5% per year and is intended to fund Mega Buana Resources' working capital for operations starting in 2026.

title: West Papua mandates indigenous approval for any forest release for palm oil expansion
body: The provincial government said all plans to open forest land for palm oil must include a letter of approval from indigenous communities, and without consent the governor will not issue recommendations or technical considerations. Officials also noted no new permits have been granted and highlighted carbon‑sequestration programs, while a regional council member urged a thorough impact study before any expansion.

title: 1 INTI DOT COM raises its stake in PT NFX Indonesia Tbk. to 11.85% after buying 7.05 million shares
body: On 18 December 2025, 1 INTI DOT COM purchased 7,050,000 shares of PT NFX Indonesia Tbk. (NFCX) at Rp1,715 per share, a transaction valued at approximately Rp12.09 billion. The purchase increased its holding to 78.9 million shares, or 11.85% of the outstanding shares, up from 68.1 million shares (10.22%).

title: Chandra Asri secures IDR 84 billion tactical funding through equipment sale to subsidiary Wastewater Solution Indonesia
body: Chandra Asri (TPIA) obtained IDR 84 billion tactical funding by selling tanks, vessels, machines, SKIDS and other equipment to its subsidiary Wastewater Solution Indonesia (WSI) in a transaction signed on 31 December 2025. The affiliate transaction, classified under POJK 42/2020, is intended to leverage WSI’s expertise in chemical, energy and infrastructure solutions to strengthen synergies and support its future development and expansion.

title: Morris Capital Indonesia acquires up to 49.9% of Multi Makmur Lemindo (PIPA) and plans a Rp3 trillion asset injection to pivot the company into a broader energy and infrastructure player
body: Morris Capital Indonesia (MCI) is set to acquire 48.88‑49.92% of Multi Makmur Lemindo (PIPA) and inject assets worth Rp3 trillion, aiming to diversify PIPA into oil & gas, fuel distribution, energy logistics and storage while expanding its HDPE pipe product line. The company reported a 30.5% YoY revenue increase to September 2025, but its stock remains highly volatile as investors weigh the long‑term fundamentals against short‑term technical fluctuations.

title: Merdeka Resources (EMAS) facilitates Rp39.37 billion equipment lease between Batutua Tembaga Raya (BTR) and Merdeka Mining Indonesia (MMI)
body: A Rp39.37 billion lease agreement, signed on 31 December 2025, allows Batutua Tembaga Raya (BTR) to provide heavy equipment to Merdeka Mining Indonesia (MMI) for the Pani Gold mine. The deal aims to maximise asset utilization, improve operational efficiency and generate positive value for the group and its shareholders.

title: Kimia Farma secures Rp846 billion shareholder loan from Bio Farma to support working capital
body: Kimia Farma (KAEF) received an Rp846 billion shareholder loan from Bio Farma, signed on 31 December 2025 and secured by up to Rp775.2 billion of assets. The funds will be used for short‑term working capital, operational liabilities and to advance the company's six‑pillar transformation strategy amid a challenging economic environment.

title: Techno9 Indonesia secures option to acquire USD150 million of Mongolian mining assets from Poh Golden Ger Resources Pte Ltd (PGGR)
body: Techno9 Indonesia has signed an option agreement to purchase 100% of PGGR's two mining concessions in Mongolia, with the transaction price to be set by the average of independent valuations from Indonesia and Australia, and subject to shareholder, OJK and BEI approvals within nine months. The company also plans to collaborate with a large EPC+F contractor, which is prepared to invest over USD100 million in mining projects that could produce more than 20 million tonnes annually, potentially creating material value for Techno9 shareholders.

title: Bank BTN Completes Rp5.56 Trillion Spin-off of Sharia Business Unit to Bank Syariah Nasional
body: Bank BTN (BBTN) executed a Rp5.56 trillion transaction on December 22, 2025, transferring the rights and obligations of its sharia business unit (UUS) to Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) to comply with regulatory mandates for UUS separation. This spin-off, intended to streamline sharia business strategy and decision-making, is projected to maintain Bank BTN's CAR and CET-1 ratios within healthy limits, ensuring no negative financial impact on the company.

title: PT UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk. (LABS) Announces Board of Directors Changes and New Board Composition
body: PT UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk. (LABS) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on December 30, 2025, accepting the resignation of Raditia Nurcahya as Operational Director. The meeting also approved the appointment of Dr. Yudha Indrawirawan as the new Operational Director and established the latest composition of the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.

title: Bank Mandiri Collaborates with Kementerian Pertahanan Republik Indonesia for Bailey Bridge Construction and Extensive Disaster Relief in Sumatra
body: Bank Mandiri partnered with Kementerian Pertahanan Republik Indonesia (Kemenhan) to construct five bailey bridges, aiming to restore connectivity in Sumatra regions affected by floods and landslides. The bank also provided over 288,889 aid packages, supported the building of 600 Hunian Danantara units, and deployed 20 Relawan Mandiri Tanggap Bencana, including members of Mandiri Emergency Response Unit (Team MERU) Mandiri Club, for comprehensive recovery efforts.

title: Bank Central Asia (BCA) Details Realized and Ongoing BBCA Share Buyback Programs
body: Bank Central Asia (BCA) has realized a buyback of 28,317,500 BBCA shares at an average price of Rp8,828.19, totaling approximately Rp249.99 billion, representing 24.99% of its Rp1 trillion budget for the program that concluded on May 15, 2025. Additionally, BCA is currently conducting another BBCA share buyback program with an allocated budget of Rp5 trillion, running from October 22, 2025, until January 19, 2026, with a maximum buyback price of Rp9,200.

title: Controlling Shareholder of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS) Divests Shares Amidst Increased Losses and Stock Volatility
body: Jemmy Kurniawan, the controlling shareholder of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS), divested 7.39 million shares on January 2, 2026, reducing his stake from 63.33% to 62.86%, with management affirming no change in control despite a cumulative 4.18% reduction since December 2025. Concurrently, MEDS reported an increased net loss of Rp5.72 billion in Q3 2025 and contracted sales to Rp4.95 billion, while its stock exhibited high volatility, gaining 48% in six months but declining 22.92% in the last month.

title: Medikaloka Hermina (HEAL) Director Yulisar Khiat Increases Share Ownership
body: Medikaloka Hermina (HEAL) director Yulisar Khiat purchased 11.27 million HEAL shares for Rp15.64 billion on December 30, 2025, increasing his ownership from 6.35% to 6.42% voting rights. This transaction brought his total HEAL shares to 986.83 million, now valued at Rp1.42 trillion based on the current share price of Rp1,440.

title: Ikin Wirawan Increases Share Ownership in PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk. (WGSH) for Investment
body: Ikin Wirawan, Commissioner and Controller of PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk. (WGSH), purchased 21,050,000 shares of WGSH on December 30, 2025, at Rp140 per share, totaling Rp2.95 billion for investment purposes. This transaction increased his direct ownership from 10.36% (108.02 million shares) to 12.38% (129.06 million shares); PT Walden Global Services remains the majority shareholder.

title: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama (PACK) Registers Rp3.25 Trillion Convertible Bond for Rights Issue
body: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama (PACK) has registered a Rp3.25 trillion convertible bond (OWK) with KSEI, accompanying its planned rights issue. The OWK, with an execution price of Rp100 per unit, will be issued on January 26, 2026, and is convertible into 32.58 billion new shares, with Eco Energi Perkasa (EEP) acting as the standby buyer.

title: PT Elang Media Visitama Increases Ownership in PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) with Recent Share Acquisition
body: PT Elang Media Visitama, an entity under PT Elang Mahkota Investama Tbk alias Emtek, purchased an additional 28,317,400 shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA) for Rp910 per share, totaling approximately Rp25.77 billion, for investment purposes. This acquisition increased Elang Media Visitama's direct ownership in SUPA to 27.60%, following earlier purchases in December 2025, while SUPA shares corrected 3.24% on Monday (5/2).

title: Saleh Buy Shares of Total Bangun Persada Tbk
body: Saleh acquired 200,000 shares of Total Bangun Persada Tbk (TOTL.JK) for approximately IDR 1005 per share, totaling IDR 201,000,000. This transaction increases Saleh's holding from 80,888 to 82,888 shares. The purpose is personal.

title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk Buy Shares of PT Bayan Resources Tbk
body: PT Bayan Resources Tbk executed a bought transaction of 7,200 shares of its own stock on January 2, 2026, at IDR 16,197 per share. This purchase increased its total holdings to 13,406,647,670 shares from 13,406,640,470 shares. The stated purpose is investment. This transaction signifies an increase in the company's treasury stock.

title: Ade Irawan Buy Shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk
body: Ade Irawan acquired 2,546,300 shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk (MINE.JK) via an investment transaction on January 2, 2026, at IDR 450 per share. This purchase increases Ade Irawan's direct holding from 0 to 2,546,300 shares, establishing a new direct ownership stake in the company.

title: Saleh Buy Shares of Total Bangun Persada Tbk
body: Saleh acquired 200,000 shares of Total Bangun Persada Tbk (TOTL.JK) for IDR 1,005 per share, totaling IDR 201,000,000. This personal transaction increased Saleh's holdings from 80,888 to 82,888 shares. The acquisition signifies a minor addition to his stake in the company.

title: Sabana Prawira Widjaja Buy Shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk
body: Sabana Prawira Widjaja acquired 700,000 shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ.JK) for IDR 1,008,000,000, at a price of IDR 1,440 per share. This transaction increased his total holdings from 5,527,219,300 to 5,527,919,300 shares. The stated purpose of the acquisition is business. This purchase represents a marginal increase in his stake within the company.

title: Investor Buy Shares of Jembo Cable Company Tbk
body: An investor acquired shares of Jembo Cable Company Tbk (JECC.JK) through multiple buy transactions on December 19, 2025, totaling 40,000,000 shares at IDR 600 per share, for an aggregate value of IDR 24,000,000,000. This increased the investor's holding from 459,575,000 shares to 499,575,000 shares, representing a net increase of 40,000,000 shares. The stated purpose for this transaction is investment. This indicates a significant increase in the investor's stake in JECC.JK.

title: Infiniti Wahana buy Shares of Steady Safe Tbk
body: Infiniti Wahana acquired 150,000 shares of Steady Safe Tbk (SAFE.JK) on January 5, 2026. The transactions occurred at prices ranging from IDR 394 to IDR 400 per share. Following this acquisition, Infiniti Wahana's holding increased from 464,159,613 shares to 464,309,613 shares, representing a slight increase in its ownership stake in the company.

title: Tan Yu Yeh Buy Shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk
body: Tan Yu Yeh acquired 400,000 shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk for investment purposes at a price of IDR 1,000 per share. This transaction increased Tan Yu Yeh's total holdings from 12,595,186,100 shares to 12,595,586,100 shares, representing a marginal increase in ownership. The transaction occurred on December 30, 2025.

title: Ivo Wangarry Buy Shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk
body: Ivo Wangarry acquired 1,082,000 shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk (MINE.JK) through an investment transaction on December 24, 2025, at IDR 465 per share. This purchase marks the beginning of his holdings in the company, increasing his stake from 0 to 1,082,000 shares. The transaction signifies a direct investment by Ivo Wangarry in MINE.JK.

title: John Simon Others Shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk
body: John Simon acquired 96,000 shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA.JK) through an 'others' transaction on January 2, 2026, at IDR 1,770 per share. This transaction, part of the MRT program implementation, increased his total holdings from 1,154,201 to 1,250,201 shares, a net increase of 96,000 shares. The filing was made on January 6, 2026.

title: Lani Darmawan Others Shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk
body: Lani Darmawan acquired 190,600 shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA.JK) on January 2, 2026, for IDR 1,770 per share, totaling IDR 337,262,000. This transaction, part of the MRT program, increased her total holdings from 1,826,901 to 2,017,501 shares, a delta of 190,600 shares. The purpose is the implementation of the MRT program.

title: Rusly Johannes Others Shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk
body: Rusly Johannes acquired 79,100 shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA.JK) through the MRT program for an undisclosed price, totaling 79,100 shares. Following the transaction, his holdings increased from 974,201 to 1,053,301 shares. This acquisition reflects the implementation of the company's MRT program.

title: Bambang Susilo sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Bambang Susilo sold 500,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) between January 2nd and 5th, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 1,870 to IDR 1,875 per share. This transaction reduced his total holdings from 23,400,200 shares to 22,900,200 shares. The stated purpose is investment.

title: Green City Sg Pte Ltd Sell Shares of PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk
body: Green City Sg Pte Ltd sold 80,000,000 shares of PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk (KRYA.JK) at IDR 150 per share. This transaction reduces their holding from 682,207,800 to 602,207,800 shares. The stated purpose is 'Investment'.

title: Green City Sg Pte Ltd Sell Shares of PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk
body: Green City Sg Pte Ltd sold 80,000,000 shares of PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk (KRYA.JK) for an estimated IDR 150 per share. This transaction reduced their holding from 682,207,800 shares to 602,207,800 shares, a decrease of 80,000,000 shares. The stated purpose of this transaction was investment. This sale represents a significant reduction in Green City Sg Pte Ltd's stake in KRYA.JK.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher acquired 220,400 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on January 5, 2026, at prices ranging from IDR 1,830 to IDR 1,845 per share. Following the purchase, Dannacher's total holding increased from 201,523,622 shares to 201,744,022 shares, representing a marginal increase in his ownership stake.

title: Henky Sulistyo Others Shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk
body: Henky Sulistyo acquired 60,600 shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA.JK) through the MRT program at an average price of IDR 1,770 per share. This transaction increases his total holdings from 243,700 shares to 304,300 shares, representing a delta of 60,600 shares.

title: Bambang Susilo sell Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Bambang Susilo sold 500,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) between January 2nd and January 5th, 2026, at prices ranging from IDR 1,870 to IDR 1,875 per share. This transaction reduced his total holdings from 23,400,200 shares to 22,900,200 shares. The stated purpose for the sale is investment. This represents a decrease of approximately 2.14% in his stake.

title: Ivo Wangarry Buy Shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk
body: Ivo Wangarry bought shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk (MINE.JK) at approximately IDR 450. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: Indonesia boosts oil output and strategic reserves as a precaution against Venezuela unrest
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources announced plans to raise national oil production through technologies such as fracking, enhanced oil recovery and horizontal drilling, reactivating 4,500 idle wells, and offering fiscal reforms and faster licensing to attract investors. Officials said Indonesia’s fuel supply remains stable because its crude does not come from Venezuela, but the government continues to monitor the situation for potential price impacts.

title: Hp Capital Resources Buy Shares of Intraco Penta Tbk
body: Hp Capital Resources acquired 89,800,000 shares of Intraco Penta Tbk at IDR 249 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increases their total holdings from 123,494,200 shares to 213,294,200 shares, representing a significant addition to their stake in the company.

title: Rmk Investama Sell Shares of PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk
body: Rmk Investama sold 60,000,000 shares of PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk (RMKO.JK) on January 2, 2026, at IDR 250 per share, for a total transaction value of IDR 15,000,000,000. This sale reduces Rmk Investama's holding from 999,980,000 to 939,980,000 shares. The stated purpose is to realize profits from increased share prices and to increase public share ownership.

title: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng Sell Shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk
body: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sold 13,876,300 shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk (YOII.JK) on January 6, 2026, at IDR 122 per share. This transaction reduces their holdings from 305,845,000 shares to 291,968,700 shares. The purpose stated is 'Investment'.

title: Fransiska Oei Lan Siem Others Shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk
body: Fransiska Oei Lan Siem acquired 66,700 shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA.JK) on January 2, 2026, for IDR 1770 per share, totaling IDR 117,979,000. This transaction, part of the MRT program, increased her holdings from 1,088,901 to 1,155,601 shares. The purpose is the implementation of the MRT program.

title: Lee Kai Kwong Others Shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk
body: Lee Kai Kwong acquired 81,500 shares of PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA.JK) via 'others' transaction type on January 2, 2026, at a price of IDR 1,770 per share. This acquisition, part of the MRT program implementation, increased his total holdings from 832,400 to 913,900 shares, a net increase of 81,500 shares. The transaction date was January 7, 2026.

title: PT Aneka Tambang (Antam) Tbk posts 197% net profit increase and 67% sales growth to Q3 2025
body: PT Aneka Tambang (Antam) Tbk reported net profit of Rp 6.61 trillion for the nine months ended September 2025, up 197% from the same period in 2024, while EBITDA rose 137% to Rp 9.33 trillion. Total sales of its core commodities—gold, nickel and bauxite—reached Rp 72.03 trillion, a 67% increase, driven mainly by a 64% jump in gold sales and an 83% rise in nickel product sales.

title: President Prabowo orders March 2026 groundbreakings for 18 Danantara Indonesia downstream projects
body: Prabowo Subianto directed that all 18 downstream industrial projects overseen by state‑backed Danantara Indonesia begin construction by March 2026, with six slated to start in January and the rest by February or March, requiring roughly 600 trillion rupiah (USD 38.5 billion) in investment. The portfolio includes a nationwide waste‑to‑energy program at 34 sites and coal‑gasification projects to produce dimethyl ether (DME) as part of Indonesia’s downstream energy strategy.

title: Indonesia’s rice reserves top 3 million tonnes, the highest level ever recorded, as President Prabowo declares early achievement of food self‑sufficiency
body: President Prabowo announced that state‑run Bulog’s rice stocks have exceeded 3 million tonnes, surpassing the previous peak of about 2 million tonnes recorded during President Soeharto’s era, and that the four‑year self‑sufficiency target was reached by the end of 2025. He warned that reliance on imports from Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam is risky amid geopolitical tensions and urged broader self‑sufficiency in other staples such as corn, cassava and protein sources.

title: Indonesia bans pork imports from Spain due to African swine fever outbreak
body: The Indonesian Quarantine Agency (Barantin) has prohibited the entry of pork and pork products from Spain after a World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH) report confirmed a recurrence of African swine fever in Barcelona. The measure aims to protect the national pig industry and prevent economic losses, with violations subject to rejection or destruction of the goods.

title: PT Pinago Utama Tbk. (PNGO) to Distribute Interim Cash Dividend of Rp90 Per Share for 2025 Fiscal Year
body: PT Pinago Utama Tbk. (PNGO) announced an interim cash dividend of Rp90 per share, totaling Rp70.31 billion, from its 2025 financial books, with payment scheduled for January 27, 2026. This dividend, reflecting a 2.86% yield, is supported by a net profit of Rp212.73 billion and unrestricted retained earnings of Rp1.05 trillion as of September 30, 2025.

title: InJourney Airports records 10.2 million passengers during 2025/2026 year‑end holiday period
body: State‑owned PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia, operating under the InJourney Airports brand, handled about 10.20 million passengers across its 37 airports from Dec 15 2025 to Jan 4 2026, with roughly 76,000 flights and slot utilization near 90 %. The busiest hub was Soekarno‑Hatta International Airport with 3.5 million passengers, and the operator introduced themed decorations and mobile service officers to improve passenger experience.

title: Green City SG Pte Ltd sells 80 million Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya shares at a premium, cutting its stake to 36.2%
body: On 30 December 2025, Green City SG Pte Ltd divested 80 million shares of Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya (KRYA) at an execution price of Rp150 per share, about 6.38% above the closing price of Rp141. The transaction raised roughly Rp12 billion and reduced Green City’s holding to 602.2 million shares (36.20% ownership), down from 682.2 million shares (41%).

title: Triniti Dinamik (TRUE) discloses 55.34% utilization of its IPO proceeds by end‑2025
body: Triniti Dinamik (TRUE) reports that out of net IPO proceeds of Rp147.61 billion, Rp81.71 billion (55.34%) has been spent, primarily on office space (Rp22.8 billion), the District East project (Rp15.1 billion) and working capital (Rp43.81 billion). The remaining Rp65.9 billion (44.66%) is retained, with the spent portion routed through PT Sarijaya Batamsentoso.

title: Envy Technologies Indonesia denies alleged default on BSI financing, calls reports inaccurate
body: Envy Technologies Indonesia (ENVY) said it has never entered into a financing arrangement with Bank Syariah Indonesia alias BSI (BRIS) and disputes claims of a Rp229.41 million missed installment and an Rp11.97 billion outstanding principal. The company urged investors to rely only on its official disclosures to the Indonesia Stock Exchange.

title: Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) raises Rp40.79 billion through treasury‑share sales to Rahayu Saraswati
body: Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) transferred 72.19 million treasury shares to Rahayu Saraswati, netting Rp40.79 billion at an average price of Rp964 per share. The largest disposals occurred on 11 December 2025 (47.16 million shares at Rp530) and 11 November 2025 (15.51 million shares at Rp370), with remaining sales spread across December 2025 and early January 2026.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BCA) Continues BBCA Share Buyback Program Amidst Price Fluctuations
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BCA) is implementing a Rp5 trillion BBCA share buyback program, initiated on October 22, 2025, with a maximum price of Rp9,200 per share and scheduled to conclude by January 19, 2026. Since the program's start, BBCA's share price has fluctuated, closing 2025 at Rp8,075 and trading around Rp8,025-Rp8,100 in early 2026, despite an earlier peak of Rp8,700.

title: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol receives Rp175.91 billion compensation for land acquisition related to the Ir. Wiyoto Wiyono Toll Road project
body: On 6 January 2026, Pembangunan Jaya Ancol (PJAA) secured tactical funds of Rp175.91 billion as compensation for acquiring six parcels of land (7,185 m²) and related assets for the Ir. Wiyoto Wiyono Toll Road, Section Harbour Road II. The company states that the receipt of these funds has no material impact on its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Karya Pacific Investama readies IDR 53 billion fund for voluntary tender offer to boost its stake in MNC Energy (IATA) to 50.5%
body: Karya Pacific Investama is allocating a tactical fund of IDR 53 billion to purchase 535.38 million MNC Energy (IATA) shares at IDR 99 per share, representing 1.71% of the company and raising its holding to 15.79 billion shares (50.50%). The voluntary tender will run from 5 February to 6 March 2026, with allocation on 9 March, return of unbought shares on 12 March, and payment on 13 March, and no changes to management, labor relations, or a go‑private plan are planned.

title: Darma Henwa (DEWA) completes 45.2% of its planned share buyback, using Rp429.99 billion
body: Darma Henwa (DEWA) spent Rp429.99 billion to repurchase 790.69 million shares at Rp430‑645 per share, with transactions on 10 Dec 2025 (372.09 million shares at Rp430) and 6 Jan 2026 (418.6 million shares at Rp645). This represents about 45.2% of the original Rp950 billion allocation, leaving Rp520.01 billion unspent, and is conducted under OJK Regulation No.13/2023.

title: PT Optima Prima Metal Sinergi Tbk plans to diversify into 16 fast‑moving consumer goods lines, shifting focus from scrap metal
body: The board approved a diversification strategy that adds 16 FMCG business lines—including sugar, chocolate, coffee, dairy and meat products—effective Q4 2025 with reporting by 31 March 2026, while the company will still maintain its scrap‑metal supply chain. Analysts note the move has boosted investor sentiment, reflected in a 163.38% rise in OPMS shares over the past six months and expectations of higher future earnings and dividends.

title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk adds 13,768 shareholders in December 2025 while ownership percentages remain unchanged
body: The monthly shareholder registry showed PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk (CDIA) increased its shareholder count by 13,768 to a total of 270,828 by the end of December 2025, with no change in any holder owning more than five percent. Controlling shareholder PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk retained 60% (74.89 billion shares), Phoenix Power B.V. held 30% (37.44 billion shares), and the public owned 9.97% (12.44 billion shares).

title: PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk (SMIL) Reports Changes in Share Ownership Structure and Shareholder Composition
body: In December 2025, PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk (SMIL) experienced a shift in ownership as CEO Hadi Suhermin reduced his stake from 50.54% to 46.99%, while PT Maybank Sekuritas acquired 5.13% ownership. This resulted in an increase in non-controlling shares to 53.01% and a decrease in free float to 15.4%, with SMIL's share price strengthening 3.01% today but declining 16.59% over the past month.

title: PT Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara Tbk Secures Rp822.9 Billion Loan for Strategic Acquisitions
body: PT Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara Tbk (MKNT) has officially signed loan agreements totaling Rp822.9 billion with PT Headwell Bintang Energi Hijau (HBEH) and PT Mantra Capital Persadan (MCP) to finance the acquisition of 99.99% stakes in PT Radja Udang Mallingping (RUM) and PT Citra Baru Steel (CBS). The financing includes Rp154.9 billion from MCP and an interest-free Rp668 billion from HBEH, both with a six-month tenor until June 30, 2026, intended to strengthen MKNT's business foundation.

title: Dapen Bank Jateng Reduces Stake in PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk. (YOII) Amidst Regulatory Capital Deadline
body: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Tengah (Dapen Bank Jateng) sold 8,290,000 shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk. (YOII) for Rp994.8 million, reducing its ownership to 8,8272%. This divestment occurred as YOII's equity of Rp205.23 billion remains below the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK)'s minimum requirement of Rp250 billion by December 2026.

title: PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (MORA) Sees Free Float Increase and Strategic Merger Plans Amidst Stock Surge
body: PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (MORA) experienced a significant increase in its free float to 33.83% after PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL) sold its entire 18.32% stake for Rp1.87 trillion. This change, alongside a planned merger with PT Eka Mas Republik (MyRepublic Indonesia), an entity of Sinar Mas Group via PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA), has driven a 15.22% stock price surge for MORA in the last month.

title: Bank Raya and Visa Partner to Sponsor Sorak Sorai Festival 2025, Driving Digital Banking Adoption and Transactions
body: Bank Raya and Visa collaborated to sponsor the Sorak Sorai Festival (SSF) from December 31, 2025, to January 2, 2026, at Taman Mini Indonesia Indah (TMII), using the event to promote the Aplikasi Raya and introduce a digital debit Visa card. The festival's success, marked by significant visitor enthusiasm, resulted in a total transaction volume of 207,429 million transactions on the Aplikasi Raya.

title: Bumi Serpong Damai (BSDE) Prepares Rp7.5 Billion for Bond Interest and Sukuk Profit Sharing Payments
body: Bumi Serpong Damai (BSDE) is preparing Rp7.5 billion for upcoming payments, specifically Rp4.9 billion for the 7.5% interest on its Obligasi Berkelanjutan III Bumi Serpong Damai Tahap I Tahun 2022 Seri B and Rp2.6 billion for the 7.75% profit sharing on its Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Tahap I Tahun 2022. These payments are scheduled for January 7, 2026, with the total funds already placed at PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) on January 5, 2026.

title: Pusaka Mas Persada Sell Shares of PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk
body: Pusaka Mas Persada sold 5,200,000 shares of PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk (WGSH.JK) at IDR 250 per share on January 5, 2026. This transaction, part of an investment strategy, reduces Pusaka Mas Persada's holdings from 101,976,601 shares to 96,776,601 shares, a decrease of 5,200,000 shares. The total value of the transaction was IDR 1,300,000,000. This sale impacts the ownership structure of WGSH.JK.

title: Yessie Dianty Yosetya buy Shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: Yessie Dianty Yosetya acquired 20,000 shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL.JK) through a purchase transaction. The purchase was executed at an average price of IDR 3,760 per share, totaling IDR 75,200,000. This transaction increases Yessie Dianty Yosetya's total holdings in EXCL.JK from 1,869,700 shares to 1,889,700 shares.

title: Andhesti Tungkas Pratama Sell Shares of Darma Henwa Tbk
body: Andhesti Tungkas Pratama divested 400,000,000 shares of Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA.JK) at an average price of IDR 581 per share. This transaction reduced their holding from 3,805,013,366 shares to 3,405,013,366 shares, a decrease of 400,000,000 shares. The divestment was completed on December 31, 2025.

title: Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Danantara Asset Management Others Shares of PT Jasa Marga Tbk
body: Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Danantara Asset Management divested 50,805,097 shares of PT Jasa Marga Tbk. title: Buana Graha Utama Buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama bought shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk (MICE.JK) at approximately IDR 569. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: GAPKI warns that upcoming foreign‑exchange withholding (DHE) and a shift to B50 biodiesel could strain Indonesia's palm oil sector
body: Chairman Eddy Martono said the 50% DHE rule slated for January 2026 may cut cash flow, forcing growers to cut fertilizer and risking production drops, while upgrading the biodiesel blend from B40 to B50 would require an extra 3 million tonnes of palm oil. He urged the government to limit DHE withholding to 5‑10% and allow fund placement in non‑Himbara banks to preserve the industry's competitiveness and export earnings.

title: Indonesia's CPO exports face potential decline in 2026 amid stagnant production, rising domestic demand and the B50 biodiesel mandate
body: GAPKI reported that Indonesia’s crude palm oil exports rose to 27.69 million tons in October 2025 but may stagnate or fall in 2026 as production stalls, domestic consumption climbs to 20.68 million tons and the mandatory B50 biodiesel program absorbs more supply. POPSI warned the B50 funding could divert resources from smallholder development, adding further pressure on the industry.

title: Palm oil association objects to 50% foreign‑exchange withholding in revised DHE rule effective 2026
body: GAPKI says the requirement to retain half of export foreign‑exchange proceeds for one year will strain liquidity, raise financing costs and could hurt smallholder prices and Indonesia’s palm‑oil competitiveness, though it accepts the placement of funds in Bank Himbara and the monitoring system. The association has asked the government to review the withholding policy while acknowledging the goal of strengthening foreign‑exchange reserves.

title: Indonesia to launch recovery program for over 2.3 million MSMEs affected by Sumatra floods
body: Indonesia will begin reconstruction and economic recovery for more than 2.3 million micro, small and medium enterprises hit by recent Sumatra floods on Jan 9, focusing on reopening markets, cleaning stalls and providing loan relief to over 200,000 KUR‑program businesses. The plan includes eight MSME Rise Clinics across Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra, deployment of 1,132 staff to reactivate markets, and cash‑for‑work programs coordinated with multiple ministries.

title: Indonesia plans to develop 1,100 Red and White Fishing Villages in 2026 to strengthen food security
body: President Prabowo Subianto announced the goal of establishing 1,100 KNMP fishing villages and hundreds of fish‑farming centers this year to achieve self‑sufficiency in animal protein, while also scaling up the livestock sector. He noted rising incomes for fishermen and emphasized the importance of protein for the nation's future.

title: PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk Holds First Digging Ceremony Following Rp5 Trillion Mining Contractor Agreement
body: PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Arthaco Prima Energy, signed a Rp5 trillion, five‑year Mining Contractor Agreement with PT Kalimantan Prima Persada (KPP Mining), a United Tractors unit, and marked the deal with a first digging ceremony on 7 January 2026. The partnership aims to ramp up coal output to an initial 3 million metric tons in 2026, with potential to reach 7 million metric tons annually in the medium term.

title: Lovina Beach Brewery targets global expansion with export-focused growth plan and capacity boost
body: Lovina Beach Brewery (STRK) announced a strategy to raise revenue and net profit by 2026, aiming for about 60% of sales from exports and increasing bottling capacity from 3,000 to 20,000 bottles per hour. The plan is supported by a Letter of Intent with Japan’s Naoyoshi Co., Ltd., the launch of three new products (COCO BALI RTD, CLARISSA, LIBARRON), and follows 2024 sales of Rp29.8 billion.

title: PT Bukit Asam (PTBA) earmarks Rp27.15 billion for Q4 2025 mining exploration across multiple sites
body: PT Bukit Asam (PTBA) allocated Rp27.15 billion for exploration work in Q4 2025 at Tanjung Enim (South Sumatra), Peranap (Riau), Ombilin (West Sumatra) and its subsidiary Internasional Prima Coal in Samarinda, covering drilling, sampling and TOC/BOC monitoring. The program includes 95 drill holes totalling 19,142 m and extensive coal and rock sampling, while no further exploration is planned for PT Internasional Prima Coal (PT IPC) in 2025.

title: Glencore International Ltd trims stake in Trimegah Bangun Persada amid share price rally
body: Glencore International Ltd sold a total of 18.28 million Trimegah Bangun Persada shares on 2, 5 and 6 January 2026, reducing its holding to 4.51 billion shares (7.16 %). The sales came as Trimegah Bangun Persada’s stock rose 100 points to Rp1,400, up 7.69 % and gained 265 points (23.35 %) over the previous five days.

title: Wismilak Inti Makmur raises Rp29.66 bn from treasury‑share sale and reports strong stock gains
body: Wismilak Inti Makmur (WIIM) secured tactical funding of Rp29.66 billion by selling 14.93 million treasury shares, with 12.97 million buyback shares remaining and an earlier transfer of 11.13 million shares at an average price of Rp1,500 per share generating Rp16.69 billion. The company plans to transfer 24,100,400 shares between 6 Oct 2025 and 5 Oct 2026, and its stock jumped 7.53% to Rp1,785 on 7 Jan 2026, up 121.74% (980 points) over the previous six months.

title: Dana Pensiun (Dapen) Bank Jateng sells 13.87 million shares of Asuransi Digital Bersama (YOII) at a profit
body: On 6 January 2026, Dana Pensiun (Dapen) Bank Jateng divested 13.87 million shares of Asuransi Digital Bersama (YOII) at Rp122 per share, generating Rp1.69 billion and reducing its holding to 291.96 million shares (8.52%). The sale follows investor focus on insurers’ capital adequacy ahead of the OJK’s POJK No. 23/2023 requirement for a minimum equity of Rp250 billion by 31 December 2026.

title: Danantara Asset Management cuts Garuda Indonesia stake, transferring 3.74 billion shares to BP BUMN
body: Danantara Asset Management (Danantara AM) sold 3.74 billion Garuda Indonesia (GIAA) shares to Badan Pengaturan BUMN (BP BUMN) at Rp459 per share, using a tactical fund of Rp1.71 trillion. After the transfer, Danantara AM holds 370.9 billion shares (91.11%), while BP BUMN holds 3.74 billion shares (0.92%) alongside Trans Airways and the public.

title: Sidomulyo Selaras (SDMU) Completes Rp61.35 Billion Private Placement to Convert Debt, Improving Financial Ratios
body: Sidomulyo Selaras (SDMU) finalized a Rp61.35 billion private placement by issuing 1.11 billion new shares at Rp55 each to Tjoe Mien Sasminto (TMS), converting debt into equity. This action significantly strengthened SDMU's capital structure, reducing its debt-to-equity ratio from 517.56% to 58.59% and increasing its total assets to short-term liabilities ratio from 30.15% to 95.86%.

title: PT RMK Energy Tbk (RMKE) Stock Surges Amidst Strong Coal Logistics Performance and Ambitious 2026 Expansion Plans.
body: PT RMK Energy Tbk (RMKE) stock closed at Rp6,775, marking over 1,000% year-on-year growth, driven by its integrated coal logistics business which reported Q3-2025 operating revenue of Rp546.7 billion and net profit of Rp138.2 billion. The company plans significant infrastructure expansion, including new hauling roads connecting to PT Wiraduta Sejahtera Langgeng (WSL), PT Duta Bara Utama (DBU), and Menambang Muara Enim (MME), projecting Rp4.1 trillion revenue and Rp800 billion net profit in 2026, alongside a planned Rp600 billion bond issuance and a minimum 20% dividend payout.

title: Andhesti Tungkas Pratama Divests 400 Million Shares of PT Darma Henwa Tbk. Amidst Significant Price Rally
body: Andhesti Tungkas Pratama sold 400 million shares of PT Darma Henwa Tbk. (DEWA) for Rp581 per share on December 30, 2025, totaling approximately Rp232.4 billion, reducing their stake from 3,805 billion to 3,405 billion shares. This divestment occurred while DEWA's stock price had surged, gaining 19.44% in the last week, 94.17% in the last month, and 145.40% in the last quarter, despite closing at Rp825 per share with a 1.84% drop on Wednesday (7/1).

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk Completes Sharia Unit Spin-off and Secures Controlling Stake in Bank Syariah Nasional
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk (BBTN) finalized a Rp5.56 trillion transaction on December 22, 2025, transferring its Sharia Business Unit (UUS) to Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN), making BBTN the controlling shareholder with a 99.99% stake. In 2025, BBTN's stock price saw a 3.07% increase, closing at Rp1,175, with analysts projecting a one-year price range of Rp900 to Rp1,600.

title: HP Capital Resources Increases Stake in PT Intraco Penta Tbk to 8.36%
body: HP Capital Resources acquired 89.8 million shares of PT Intraco Penta Tbk (INTA) for Rp22.36 billion on December 30, 2025, increasing its ownership from 4.84% to 8.36% for investment purposes. Following this transaction, INTA's stock strengthened 9.52% on January 6, 2026, and has seen a 1,050% increase over the last six months.

title: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk. (ADHI) Adjusts State Shareholding Structure by Transferring 54,087,737 Series B Shares to BP BUMN
body: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk. (ADHI) transferred 54,087,737 Series B shares, previously held by PT Danantara Asset Management (Persero), directly to the State of the Republic of Indonesia through Badan Pengaturan Badan Usaha Milik Negara (BP BUMN) on January 5, 2026. This administrative action implements Law No. 16 Tahun 2025 to ensure the state's direct 1% ownership, without altering the company's control as the State of the Republic of Indonesia remains the Ultimate Beneficial Owner.

title: PT Sumber Sinergi Makmur Tbk (IOTF) Optimizes AI for Business Operations, Targeting Double-Digit Growth
body: PT Sumber Sinergi Makmur Tbk (IOTF), an IoT company for transportation, is optimizing Artificial Intelligence (AI) in its operations, anticipating double-digit revenue and net profit growth, targeting around a 30% increase this year. The company also aims to boost revenue per employee by 50% to Rp 3 billion by 2026, integrating AI into its in-house ERP system, Fox Ledger.

title: Bank Mandiri and BRI Transfer Shares in PT Danantara Asset Management to BP BUMN
body: Bank Mandiri announced the transfer of 485,333,332 Series B shares, representing 0.52% of PT Danantara Asset Management, to BP BUMN, following a similar transaction by BRI involving 806,109,768 Series B shares (0.53%). These transfers, conducted in the framework of implementing UU BUMN, do not affect the operational, legal, financial condition, or business continuity, with Negara Indonesia remaining the ultimate beneficial owner.

title: Three Directors and Commissioners of PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) Reported Not to Own Shares
body: A monthly registration report for PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) as of December 31, 2025, revealed that three out of 13 directors—Alexandra Askandar, Abu Santosa, and Munadi Herlambang—do not own BBNI shares. Furthermore, all BBNI commissioners also reportedly hold no shares, while PT Danantara is the main shareholder with 60% ownership.

title: Pusaka Mas Persada Divests Shares in PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk Amidst Controller's Increased Stake
body: Pusaka Mas Persada, a major shareholder of PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk (WGSH), divested 5.2 million WGSH shares for Rp1.30 billion on January 5, 2026, reducing its ownership to 9.28% for strategic investment purposes. This move contrasts with WGSH controller Ikin Wirawan's purchase of 21.05 million shares for Rp2.95 billion on December 30, 2025.

title: Badan Pengaturan Badan Usaha Milik Negara Republik Indonesia Others Shares of PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
body: Badan Pengaturan Badan Usaha Milik Negara Republik Indonesia acquired 516,023,535 shares of PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, increasing its holding from 1 to 516,023,536 shares. body: Jemmy Kurniawan divested 3,500,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK). body: Negara Republik Indonesia acquired 223,783,877 shares of PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk for IDR 3,750 per share, fulfilling Law Number 16 of 2025. This transaction increased the holding from 1 to 223,783,878 shares.

body: Hady Kuswanto S Kom acquired 300,000 shares of PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk for investment purposes. This purchase increased his total holding from 45,475,100 shares to 45,775,100 shares, representing a net increase of 300,000 shares.

title: Vale Indonesia allocates $1.67 million for Q4 2025 exploration across multiple Sulawesi blocks
body: Vale Indonesia (INCO) will spend USD1.67 million (approximately Rp28.13 billion) on exploration activities in October, November and December 2025, targeting the Sorowako, Bahodopi and Pomalaa blocks in Sulawesi using core drilling and electrical resistivity tomography. The work, conducted with third‑party contractors, aims to generate complete laterite profiles and support resource and reserve calculations using ordinary kriging.

title: PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk approves private placement of up to 394.81 million new shares to raise up to IDR 56.99 billion
body: The extraordinary shareholders' meeting authorized the issuance of a maximum of 394.81 million new shares (10% of paid‑up capital) at a price of IDR 398 per share, targeting fresh capital of up to IDR 56.99 billion and raising total paid‑up capital to IDR 81.82 billion. The proceeds will be used to strengthen working capital and support the group's future development and expansion plans, with the new shares slated for listing on 15 January 2026.

title: PT Atlas Resources Tbk allocates US$66,819.27 for Q4 2025 exploration via PT Gorby Energy
body: PT Atlas Resources Tbk (ARII) spent US$66,819.27 in Q4 2025 on exploration activities conducted by its subsidiary PT Gorby Energy in Rawas Ilir, South Sumatra, using contractors PT RNA Daya Sinergi, PT Leon Testing, PT Intertek Utama Services, and PT Studio Mineral Batubara to drill previously untested areas and gather geological, coal quality, acid drainage, and rock physical data. Other subsidiaries—including PT Gorby Putra Utama, PT Banyan Koalindo Lestari, PT Hanson Energy (Baturaja GPU), and PT Diva Kencana Borneo—reported no exploration activity during the same period.

title: PT Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa Tbk (RISE) Secures Shareholder Approval for Capital Increase and Bonus Share Distribution.
body: PT Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa Tbk (RISE) shareholders approved an increase in basic capital to Rp3 trillion and the distribution of bonus shares from capitalized Additional Paid-in Capital. This corporate action will see RISE issue 5,253,600,000 new shares with a 25:12 ratio, aimed at enhancing share liquidity and strengthening the company's capital for future property project expansions.

title: Danantara AM transfers 217.05 million Waskita Karya Series B shares to BP BUMN to meet 1% ownership requirement
body: Danantara Asset Management (Danantara AM) moved 217.05 million Series B shares of Waskita Karya, representing 0.75% of the company's issued capital, to the BP BUMN unit to satisfy Law No. 16/2025’s 1% state‑ownership rule. After the transfer, the Indonesian state holds the shares directly via BP BUMN and indirectly through Danantara AM’s 21.4 billion Series B shares consolidated under BPI Daya Anagata Nusantara.

title: GAPKI warns that upcoming DHE withholding rules and a possible B50 biodiesel shift could strain Indonesia's palm oil sector
body: GAPKI chairman Eddy Martono warned that the new foreign‑exchange withholding rule (DHE) slated for Jan 2026, which could retain up to 50 % of palm‑oil export proceeds, may strain cash flow, reduce fertilizer use and cut production, while an upgrade of the biodiesel blend from B40 to B50 would require an additional ~3 million tonnes of palm oil. He urged the government to limit DHE retention to 5‑10 % and allow funding through both state‑owned and private banks, noting the sector’s role in employing 16 million people and generating US$39.2 billion in foreign‑exchange earnings.

title: Indonesia plans to cut 2026 coal output to about 600 million tons to support global price stability
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, led by Minister Bahlil Lahadalia, announced a reduction of coal production from 790 million tons in 2025 to roughly 600 million tons in 2026, aiming to lift falling global coal prices. The ministry also signaled a yet‑to‑be‑determined cut in nickel output, citing industrial demand and the need to strengthen local producers.

title: Indonesia's rice self‑sufficiency drives 44% drop in global rice prices
body: Indonesia halted rice imports, boosting domestic stocks to a record 3.25 million metric tons and creating oversupply in other exporting nations, which led the world rice price to fall from USD 650 to USD 340 per metric ton, a 44% decline. Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman said the policy under President Prabowo Subianto stabilises global prices and highlights Indonesia’s growing influence in the rice market.

title: Bank Mandiri disburses Rp40.99 trillion KUR to 355,658 UMKM in 2025, keeping non‑performing loans below 1%
body: Bank Mandiri has disbursed Rp40.99 trillion in Kredit Usaha Rakyat (KUR) to 355,658 micro, small and medium enterprises across Indonesia in 2025, maintaining a non‑performing loan ratio under 1%. The funding, led by the production sector (61.5% or Rp25.13 trillion) and agriculture (31.2% or Rp12.75 trillion), is delivered via an integrated ecosystem and the Mandiri Agen network to boost UMKM capacity, employment and digital financial literacy.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange records four sustainable bond and sukuk issuances totaling Rp1.35 trillion in the first five trading days of 2026
body: The Bursa Efek Indonesia logged four issuances—Summarecon Agung's Sustainable Bond V Phase I, Eagle High Plantations' Sustainable Bond I Phase III and Sukuk Mudharabah I Phase II, and Energi Mega Persada's Sustainable Bond I—comprising eight series with a total face value of Rp1.35 trillion and ratings ranging from idA‑ to idA+. The respective trustees are PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, PT Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Barat dan Banten Tbk, and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk.

title: Energi Mega Persada provides Rp105.14 billion loan to subsidiary Bangun Sarana Samudra Laut for debt repayment
body: Energi Mega Persada (ENRG) granted a Rp105.14 billion loan to its 99.8% owned subsidiary Bangun Sarana Samudra Laut (BSSL) on 8 January 2026, with a five‑year maturity and interest tied to its Series C bond rate, to settle BSSL's principal and interest owed to Bank Mandiri (BMRI). The transaction is classified as an affiliated transaction exempt from certain reporting requirements under POJK 42/2020 and was stated to have no adverse effect on the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) plans 757.11 million-share private placement to strengthen capital
body: Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) will issue 757,110,786 new shares (approximately 757.11 million) at a nominal value of Rp25, representing up to 10% of its share capital and fully paid, to enhance its capital structure, fund working capital and general business, which is expected to raise assets by 8.86% and equity by 10.04%; shareholders who do not participate will experience a 9.09% ownership dilution, and an extraordinary shareholders' meeting is scheduled for 12 January 2026 to approve the placement.

title: Celebes Mining Resources raises its stake in Harapan Duta Pertiwi to 18.8% after December share purchases
body: Celebes Mining Resources bought a total of 60,159 million shares of Harapan Duta Pertiwi (HOPE) on 22 and 24 December 2025 at Rp129‑138 per share, spending about Rp8.1 billion and increasing its holding to 400.94 million shares (18.82%). As of 30 November 2025, the main shareholders were Harapan Group Sukses (32.27%), Meranti Samudra (5%), Celebes Mining Resources (22.1%) and the public (40.63%), with the number of shareholders falling to 4,636.

title: MNC Tourism Indonesia (KPIG) plans a Rp78.75 billion private placement to fund KEK Mido City projects
body: The company will issue 514.71 million new shares at an execution price of Rp153 each, raising Rp78.75 billion, with proceeds earmarked for the development of the KEK MNC Lido City tourism hub and related hotel, golf, and theme‑park facilities. No strategic investors have been identified yet, and the new shares will be offered to all existing shareholders and the public.

title: Nusatama Berkah partners with Kalista to develop heavy‑duty electric trucks for industry and logistics
body: Nusatama Berkah (NTBK) announced a collaboration with Kalista to accelerate development of heavy‑duty electric trucks aimed at industrial, logistics and mining applications, emphasizing performance testing and customer‑specific specifications. The partnership aligns with Indonesia’s carbon‑reduction agenda and positions Nusatama as an early player in the industrial EV ecosystem.

title: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara discloses shareholder structure and Rp822.9 bn loan for acquisitions
body: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara (MKNT) reported that its controlling shareholder PT Monjess Investama holds 22.63% of shares, with a total of 7,385 shareholders and a free‑float of 66.11% (3.63 bn shares) as of 31 December 2025. The company also secured an Rp822.9 bn loan from PT Headwell Bintang Energi Hijau (HBEH) and PT Mantra Capital Persadan (MCP) to acquire 99.99% of PT Radja Udang Mallingping for Rp154.92 bn and 99.99% of PT Citra Baru Steel for Rp668 bn.

title: PT Express Transindo Utama Tbk's Annual RUPS Fails for Third Time Due to Low Quorum
body: PT Express Transindo Utama Tbk recorded 14,726 shareholders by December 2025, but its 100% free float structure and lack of a controlling shareholder present challenges for decision-making. The 2024 Annual RUPS for PT Express Transindo Utama Tbk failed for the third time as only 27.91% of total outstanding shares were represented, falling short of the OJK's 35% quorum requirement.

title: PP Presisi announces Rp1.3 trillion BRI loan to subsidiary PT Lancarjaya Mandiri Abadi
body: PP Presisi disclosed a material loan of Rp1.3 trillion from BRI to its subsidiary PT Lancarjaya Mandiri Abadi (LMA), equal to 65.7% of LMA's equity and secured by collateral worth Rp1.45 trillion plus a land parcel valued at Rp10.51 billion. The loan is intended to support ongoing and future projects and is reported to have no legal or negative impact on the businesses.

title: Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa (RISE) Approves Bonus Share Distribution and Capital Increase

This corporate action, with a cum date of January 19, aims to strengthen capital structure, increase stock liquidity, and expand its investor base.

title: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk. (AISA) Signs Logistics Service Agreement with Affiliated PT Karya Nusa Logistika (KNL).
body: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk. (AISA) officially signed a Rp3.57 billion logistics service agreement with affiliated PT Karya Nusa Logistika (KNL) to improve distribution efficiency and optimize its supply chain. This transaction, involving warehousing and product handling, is not deemed material under POJK No. 42 Tahun 2020, despite both companies being indirectly controlled by FKS Food and Agri Pte Ltd.

title: PT Trimitra Trans Persada Tbk. (BLOG) Fully Realizes IPO Funds for Cold Chain Logistics Expansion by End of 2025.
body: PT Trimitra Trans Persada Tbk. (BLOG) has fully realized its IPO funds by the end of 2025, allocating the capital, after deducting Rp2.58 billion in emission costs, as a capital injection to its subsidiary, PT Simpan Sini Aja. This subsidiary utilized Rp92.61 billion to build cold storage facilities in Kabupaten Tangerang, Pontianak, and Makassar, expanding its cold chain logistics network to support growth in temperature-sensitive product services.

title: Indonesia's Mining Authority Emphasizes Tight Supervision, Reclamation Guarantees, and Digitalisation to Strengthen Sector Governance
body: Director General Tri Winarno outlined the 2025 focus on real‑time production reporting, monthly environmental monitoring, and a five‑point reclamation guarantee system that raised pledged funds from about IDR 17‑20 trillion to IDR 35 trillion. He also announced stricter enforcement through digital platforms like MinerbaOne, formalisation of community mining, and penalties of up to five years imprisonment and IDR 100 billion for non‑compliance.

title: Indonesian government to waive KUR interest for disaster‑hit MSMEs in Sumatra in 2026
body: The government will set the People’s Business Credit (KUR) interest rate at 0% for 2026, rising to 3% in 2027 and 6% in 2028, to support 158,848 MSME borrowers affected by floods and landslides in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra, where KUR disbursements totalled Rp8.9 trillion. Lenders will continue receiving payments while the state covers the interest subsidy.

title: Indonesia’s fishery export certification eases market entry, highlighted by cleared shrimp shipment to the United States
body: The Ministry of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries said its Fish Products Quality and Safety Certificate (SMKHP) confirms that Indonesian fishery products meet international sanitation, hygiene and food‑safety standards, and the certificate can now be obtained online via the Siap Mutu application supported by 46 quality‑control units nationwide. After presenting the SMKHP, exporter Clorinda successfully cleared 20 containers of frozen shrimp from Surabaya valued at Rp63.4 billion (about US$3.8 million) that had been temporarily held at a U.S. port.

title: Indonesia prioritizes aquaculture and farmland recovery in flood‑hit Aceh
body: Coordinating Minister for Food Affairs Zulkifli Hasan, joined by Marine Affairs and Fisheries Minister Sakti Wahyu Trenggono and Trade Minister Budi Santoso, inspected flood‑damaged areas in Aceh to accelerate the rehabilitation of over 30,000 hectares of shrimp and milkfish ponds and rice fields, while the Trade Ministry has allocated Rp450 billion (US$26.75 million) for relief and basic needs. The government will also provide living allowances, temporary housing, and cross‑sector support to safeguard food security and regional economic recovery.

title: UBS AG London sells 289.62 million Bumi Resources shares, reducing its stake to 5.96%
body: On 6 January 2026, UBS AG London disposed of 289.62 million Bumi Resources (BUMI) shares at Rp462 per share, cutting its stake to about 5.96% (22.13 billion shares). The move follows earlier January transactions—including a sale of 34.12 million shares at Rp453 and a purchase of 219.53 million shares at the same price—while Bumi Resources’ share price has risen 305.26% over the past six months to Rp462.

title: Aneka Tambang (ANTM) earmarks Rp245.76 billion for gold, nickel and bauxite exploration through 2025
body: ANTM will spend Rp245.76 billion on exploration projects up to 31 December 2025, focusing on gold in Pongkor (West Java), nickel in North Konawe and Pomalaa (Southeast Sulawesi) and bauxite in Tayan, Landak and Mempawah‑Toho (West Kalimantan). The activities include drilling, geological mapping, test pits and laboratory analysis, carried out by its own units and subsidiary PT Sumberdaya Arindo (PT SDA).

title: Satria Mega Kencana (SOTS) postpones its extraordinary shareholders meeting to March 31, 2026 after a 748% stock surge
body: The stock halted at Rp2,580 per share, reflecting strong investor interest following its exit from the FCA board, and has risen 748% over the past year. The company moved the RUPSLB from January 28 to March 31, 2026 to finalize a right issue targeting up to Rp137.5 billion to strengthen capital and support future growth.

title: Jaya Sukses Makmur (RISE) Announces Rp525.36 bn Bonus Share Issue with 25:12 Ratio for FY2024
body: Jaya Sukses Makmur (RISE) will distribute 5.25 billion bonus shares at a 25:12 ratio (48 new shares per lot), valued at approximately Rp525.36 billion, based on FY2024 financials of paid‑in capital Rp567.89 billion and total equity Rp2.6 trillion. The dividend record and payment dates are set for January–February 2026, and the company expects the issuance to boost market liquidity and long‑term shareholder value.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk reports rise in shareholders to 362,993 and free‑float to 32.53% by end‑December 2025
body: At the end of December 2025 PT Bumi Resources Tbk had 362,993 shareholders, up 148,255 from the previous month, and its free‑float increased to 120.78 billion shares (32.53% of total). The largest shareholders above 5% are Mach Energy (Hongkong) with 45.78%, Treasure Global (Hongkong) 8.08% and HSBC‑Fund SVS A/C 5.76%, while PT Bakrie Capital and Mach Energy (Hongkong) act as controlling shareholders.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk nears commercial start of Pani Gold Mine, targeting Q1 2026
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk reported that civil works are 87.83% complete, transport and customs 98.93% complete, and commissioning 55% complete as of December 2025, with overall preparation at about 30% and aims to finish remaining work in Q1 2026 to commence commercial production. The Pani Gold Mine, a multi‑decade open‑pit project in Gorontalo, holds 190 million tonnes of ore containing roughly 4.8 million ounces of gold and is managed under PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA).

title: PT Intraco Penta Tbk reports share transfer by HD Capital Resources and purchase by HP Capital Resources at a premium price
body: On 30 December 2025, HD Capital Resources transferred 213.29 million INTA shares (8.36%) via a repurchase agreement at Rp249 per share, eliminating its voting rights, while HP Capital Resources bought 89.8 million shares at the same price, raising its stake to 8.36% from 4.84%. The transaction price was well above the market price of Rp166 per share, where INTA closed at Rp166 on 9 January 2026, up 9.9% from the previous day and up 1,283% over the past six months.

title: PT Kimia Farma Tbk Secures Rp846 Billion Shareholder Loan to Support Working Capital amid Restructuring
body: PT Kimia Farma Tbk is obtaining an Rp846 billion Shareholder Loan (SHL) from PT Danantara Asset Management, channeled through PT Bio Farma (Persero), to fund working capital for production and sales. The loan, backed by an independent fairness opinion, is intended to strengthen the company’s financial structure and operational performance during its restructuring plan.

title: Investindo Buana Ultima reduces stake in PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) by selling 84.8 million shares
