body: Investindo Buana Ultima sold 84,800,000 common shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk at Rp625 per share on 2 January 2026, generating approximately Rp53 billion and decreasing its ownership from 9.94% (615.6 million shares) to 8.57% (530.8 million shares). The IRSX share price was Rp670 on 9 January, reflecting a 1.47% weekly decline, a 32.67% monthly gain, and a 124.83% rise over the last quarter.

title: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk reports Rp794.08 billion proceeds from 2023 buy‑back share transfers while 1.5 billion shares remain in treasury
body: The company disclosed that by 31 December 2025 it had transferred 24,815 million treasury shares from its 2023 buy‑back program, generating Rp794.08 billion, and that no loss was incurred on the sales. However, 1,516 billion shares (about 19.7% of total) are still untransferred, and the shareholder base grew to 4,762 holders.

title: Techno9 Indonesia (NINE) to acquire Mongolian mining assets via right issue backed by Poh Group
body: Techno9 Indonesia (NINE) announced a strategic move, supported by majority shareholder Poh Group, to integrate Mongolian mining assets owned by Poh Golden Ger Resources Pte Ltd (PGGR) into its portfolio through a right issue planned by Q2‑2026, with no cash outlay for the acquisition. The assets are linked to a framework agreement with an experienced EPC+F partner that could invest over USD100 million to develop projects producing more than 20 million tons annually, while the partner holds assets exceeding USD500 million and employs over 1,000 staff.

title: PT Krakatau Steel (Persero) Tbk. secures a Rp13.94 trillion asset guarantee as part of a restructuring under the 2025 state‑owned enterprise law.
body: The company announced that it has pledged assets exceeding 50% of its net assets, valued at Rp13.94 trillion, through agreements signed on 8 January 2026 following a shareholder‑approved loan pact with PT Danantara Asset Management (Persero) on 19 December 2025. The corporate secretary, Fedaus, stated that the transaction has no material negative impact on operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity and supports the firm’s capital‑strengthening and performance‑recovery goals.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk after 34% price surge
body: BEI halted PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk (NSSS) shares from the opening session on 9 January 2026, citing a cumulative price increase of 320 points (34.41%) to Rp1,250 per share. The company said it has no material information affecting its business and that the price move is market‑driven, while BEI stated the suspension is to protect investors.

title: PT Humpuss Maritim Internasional Tbk experiences sharp increase in shareholders and free‑float reaching 23.5% by end‑2025
body: The number of public shareholders of PT Humpuss Maritim Internasional Tbk (HUMI) surged to 23,876 by the end of December 2025, driving the free‑float from 15% in January to 23.5% in the October‑December period. Major owner PT Humpuss Intermoda Transportasi Tbk (HITS) holds 13,805 172 800 shares, while Lukman Hakim and Ferdinand Manorsa each own over five percent of the company.

title: Indonesia and Pakistan seek to upgrade their Preferential Trade Agreement to a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement by 2027
body: Deputy Trade Minister Dyah Roro Esti and Pakistan Commerce Minister Jam Kamal Khan agreed to accelerate the expansion of the Indonesia‑Pakistan Preferential Trade Agreement into a CEPA, targeting completion by 2027 and initiating technical talks in early 2026. Bilateral trade reached US$4.1 billion in 2024, driven largely by Indonesian palm oil exports, and the two sides signed an MoU to create a Joint Trade Committee to boost trade, SME cooperation, and address barriers.

title: PT Mahkota Group Tbk begins treasury‑stock sell‑off after 2025 buyback, raising about Rp611.8 million
body: On 31 December 2025, PT Mahkota Group Tbk (MGRO) sold 802,900 treasury shares at an average price of Rp762, generating Rp611,778,477 in proceeds, with PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk acting as the broker. The company still holds 28,353,000 treasury shares, with no disclosed timeline for further disposals.

title: PT Paragon Karya Perkasa Tbk reports sharp rise in 2025 coal sales, revenue and profit despite lower average price
body: In 2025 PT Paragon Karya Perkasa Tbk (PKPK) increased coal sales volume to 1,075 million tons and sales value to Rp732,374 billion, with production reaching 1,090 million tons, while the average selling price fell to Rp680,696 per ton. The company’s consolidated revenue grew to Rp749.37 billion and net profit to Rp15.62 billion, a 136.8% increase year‑on‑year, raising earnings per share to Rp13.02.

title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk reports Q4 2025 exploration spending of $3.03 million across Blocks II Elang and III Rinti
body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk disclosed that its subsidiary PT Amman Mineral Nusa Tenggara spent about USD3.03 million on exploration in Q4 2025, mainly USD2.8 million on drilling and geological mapping in Block II Elang and USD226 thousand in Block III Rinti, completing 18 core holes (6,438.5 m) and 2 holes (1,033.4 m) respectively. No exploration was undertaken in Block IV Lampui, and the company plans to continue resource drilling in Elang and further exploration in Gerbang Timur and Rinti.

title: PT Timah Tbk (TINS) reports IDR 42.73 bn exploration spend in Q4 2025 and outlines continued drilling plans for early 2026
body: The company disclosed a total exploration expenditure of IDR 42.73 billion for October‑December 2025, split between IDR 22.6 billion for operational costs and IDR 20.1 billion for investment, achieving 20,650.11 m of offshore and 13,117.55 m of onshore drilling depth. For Q1 2026, PT Timah Tbk (TINS) plans to deploy four drill ships and four pontoon rigs offshore and continue land‑based aluvial and guide‑hole drilling in Bangka and Belitung.

title: Metro Pacific Tollways increases its stake in PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk (META) to 97% amid a go‑private tender offer
body: At the end of December 2025 Metro Pacific Tollways held 17,202,056,874 shares of PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk (META), raising its ownership from 96% to 97% and reducing the public float to 0.68% (120,793,876 shares). The company, which received OJK approval for a voluntary tender offer on 15 March 2024, aims to purchase up to 4.49 billion shares (23.18% of the float) at Rp250 per share, a 34% premium to the recent 90‑day average high of Rp187.

title: Pefindo gives Chandra Asri an idAA- rating for its sustainable bond and affirms the company's idAA- rating
body: Pefindo assigned an idAA- rating to Chandra Asri's sustainable bond (maximum Rp6 trillion) intended to fund working‑capital needs, while reaffirming the company's idAA- rating and a stable outlook. The rating reflects Chandra Asri's leading position in the petrochemical sector, recent acquisitions (Aster Chemical and Energy Pte Ltd, Chevron Phillips Singapore Chemicals, condensate splitter unit) and strong liquidity, but could be downgraded if financial flexibility weakens or profit margins fall.

title: Sumber Garam Pratama sells 157.9 million Multi Garam Utama shares at deep discount and plans Rp56.99 billion private placement
body: Sumber Garam Pratama divested 157,926 million shares of Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) on 8 January 2026 at Rp75 per share, raising Rp11.84 billion (an 88.2% discount to the closing price) and reducing its holding to 970.07 million shares (24.57%). The company also announced a Rp56.99 billion private placement of 394.81 million shares at Rp398 each, representing about 10% of equity and approved by shareholders on 12 December 2025, while Multi Garam's stock has surged over the past six months.

title: Agincourt Resources completes Q4 2025 exploration in Sibolga, spending $730.98 k
body: Agincourt Resources, a subsidiary of United Tractors (UNTR), spent USD730.98 k (≈Rp12.16 bn) on exploration in Sibolga, North Sumatra during October‑December 2025, drilling a total depth of 3,397 m in October, 3,649 m in November and 503 m in December. The monthly exploration costs were USD313,618 k in October, USD406,812 k in November and USD10,550 k in December.

title: Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) plans a 757.1‑million‑share private placement and moves its extraordinary AGM to 11 February 2026
body: The company will issue up to 757,110,786 new shares at a nominal value of Rp25 each, representing up to 10% of its capital, with proceeds earmarked for working capital and project development; the extraordinary shareholders' meeting was rescheduled from 12 January to 11 February 2026, with a new record date of 20 January. Following the announcement, the stock rose 10.89% to Rp448, while the private placement is expected to increase assets by 8.86% and equity by 10.04%, causing a 9.09% ownership dilution for existing shareholders who do not participate.

title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk. (BYAN) sees shareholder Low Tuck Kwong increase stake to over 40% with January 2026 share purchases
body: Between 2 and 8 January 2026, Low Tuck Kwong bought about 212,300 BYAN shares for roughly Rp3.6 billion, raising his holding to 13,406,852,770 shares (40.22% of voting rights). The latest purchase of 6,400 shares at Rp17,289 each was followed by a modest 0.15% rise in BYAN’s price to Rp17,225.

title: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng Sell Shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk
body: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sold 500,000 shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk (YOII.JK) on January 9, 2026, at IDR 112 per share. This transaction reduces their holding from 291,968,700 shares to 291,468,700 shares, a decrease of 500,000 shares. The stated purpose is investment. This represents a minor adjustment in their investment portfolio.

title: Sentra Investa Maksima Sell Shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk
body: Sentra Investa Maksima sold 217,700 shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk (BMBL.JK) for IDR 54.0 per share, totaling IDR 11,755,800. This transaction reduces their holding from 99,770,600 shares to 99,552,900 shares, a decrease of 217,700 shares. The stated purpose for this sale is 'Liquid'.

title: Andreas Utomo Sell Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
body: Andreas Utomo sold 15,000,000 shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK) for IDR 288 per share, totaling IDR 4,320,000,000. This divestment reduces his stake from 110,876,400 shares to 95,876,400 shares. The transaction occurred on January 9, 2026.

title: Management Buy Shares of Bayan Resources
body: On January 9, 2026, management acquired 13,500 shares of Bayan Resources (BYAN.JK) at IDR 17,181 per share. This purchase, valued at approximately IDR 231,843,500, increases their total holding from 13,406,852,770 to 13,406,866,270 shares. The transaction is categorized as an investment.

title: Danantara Aset Management reduces PT PP stake by transferring 31.61 million shares to BP BUMN, raising state ownership to 0.51%
body: Danantara Aset Management transferred 31.61 million PT PP shares at Rp100 each, cutting its holding from 51% to 50.49% and increasing BP BUMN’s stake to 0.51% in line with Law No. 16/2025 amendment. In the following week PT PP’s share price rose 2.48% to Rp414, after a 16.29% gain over the past month from Rp356.

title: J Trust Co., Ltd. Sell Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: J Trust Co., Ltd. sold 878,377,481 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) for IDR 310 per share, totaling IDR 272.3 billion. This transaction reduces J Trust's holding from 13,081,512,691 shares to 12,203,135,210 shares, a decrease of 878,377,481 shares. The stated purpose is for investment receipts.

title: Indonesia to build 34 waste-to-energy plants to alleviate overfilled landfills
body: Deputy Minister of Public Works Diana Kusumastuti announced that the government will construct waste-to-energy facilities at 34 districts and cities where daily waste exceeds 1,000 tonnes, aiming to cut landfill use, emissions and health risks. State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi said the projects will also feed electricity into local grids as part of a downstreaming strategy.

title: Indonesia's state-run Bulog prepares to export rice and corn after achieving self‑sufficiency
body: Bulog said it is operationally ready to start exporting rice and corn this year, awaiting government coordination to identify destination countries with the greatest need. The agency also targets procuring four million tonnes of rice for 2026 reserves—three million tonnes in the first half—and currently manages 3.25 million tonnes of stock while earmarking about one million tonnes for possible export.

title: Sinarmas Sekuritas Maintains Buy Rating on RMK Energy (RMKE) and Raises Target Price to IDR10,000 per Share
body: Sinarmas Sekuritas, after a site visit to RMK Energy’s (RMKE) coal logistics facilities in South Sumatra, kept its buy recommendation and lifted the target price to IDR10,000 per share, citing ample unused capacity and strong volume growth prospects. The broker highlighted that current utilization is about 30% of the 30 million‑ton annual handling capacity, with plans to reach 15‑20 million tons by 2026‑2027 supported by regional transport regulations.

title: Dapen Bank Jateng sells 500,000 Asuransi Digital shares at Rp112 each, cutting its stake to 8.5%
body: On 9 January 2026, Dapen Bank Jateng sold 500,000 Asuransi Digital shares at an execution price of Rp112 per share, raising Rp56 million and reducing its holding to 291.46 million shares (approximately 8.5%). The free‑float remains at 20% (68.93 million shares) and the number of shareholders rose to 2,180, with major owners Adi Wibowo Adisaputro (42.3%), Dwijiwanti Widiatmadja (1.25%), Djajus Adisaputro (27.27%), Dapen BPD Jateng (9.17%) and the public (20%).

title: Capitalinc Investment (MTFN) reports Rp46.13 bn exploration spend across Sumur AK-2 in South Sumatra and Sumur Bantuas-1 in East Kalimantan
body: Capitalinc Investment (MTFN) has incurred total exploration expenditures of Rp46.13 billion as of January 2026, mainly Rp45.72 billion for the AK-2 well in South Sumatra’s Cahaya Batu Raja Blok (CRRB) block and Rp410 million for the Bantuas-1 well operated by Kutai Etam Petroleum (KEP) in East Kalimantan. Both projects employ testing methods and subsurface data selection and are proceeding while the company is in the process of transferring assets.

title: Widodo Perkasa divests 161.5 million Widodo Unggas shares, leaving a 29 % stake as the stock jumps 8.8 %
body: Between 2 and 8 January 2026, Widodo Perkasa sold a total of 161,498,100 Widodo Unggas shares with the assistance of several financial institutions, reducing its holding to 3.75 billion shares (29.03 %). Following the divestments, Widodo Unggas shares surged 5 points to Rp62, an 8.77 % increase, after a month of trading in the red zone.

title: Indo Tambangraya Megah allocates Rp12.55 billion for 2025 exploration across multiple subsidiaries
body: Indo Tambangraya Megah (ITMG) recorded exploration expenses of Rp12.55 billion for the October‑December 2025 period, conducted by its subsidiaries Indominco Mandiri, Trubaindo Coal Mining, Bharinto Ekatama, Tepian Indah Sukses and Nusa Persada Resource (NPR). The drilling programmes involved 23 open‑hole and coring wells by Trubaindo (costing Rp1.84 billion), 22 pre‑production wells by Indominco Mandiri (Rp1.66 billion), 237 wells by Bharinto Ekatama (Rp8.14 billion), and additional sampling and laboratory analysis costing Rp911.22 million.

title: Summarcon Agung (SMRA) completes IDR 1.17 trillion of affiliate capital injections in the 7‑9 January 2026 period
body: Between 7 and 9 January 2026, Summarcon Agung (SMRA) executed a series of affiliate transactions totaling IDR 1.17 trillion, injecting capital into numerous subsidiaries such as Summarecon Property Development (SPD), Summarecon Investment Property (SIP), and others with individual amounts ranging from hundreds of millions to hundreds of billions of rupiah. Corporate Secretary Lydia Tio said the injections are intended to boost the group’s performance.

title: Inti Bangun Sejahtera (IBST) free float falls to 0.05% while PT Iforte Solusi maintains 99.95% ownership after July 2024 acquisition
body: As of the end of December 2025, IBST’s public float comprised only 0.05% (650,832 shares held by 424 investors), with PT Iforte Solusi holding 99.95% of the shares, unchanged from the prior month. The July 1, 2024 acquisition by Iforte Solusi Infotek (iForte) of 90.11% of IBST at Rp2,813 per share (totaling Rp3.42 trillion) integrated IBST into Grup Djarum, and the stock has fallen 8.44% over the past year but risen 6.85% in the last month to Rp5,150 per share.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk reports a sharp decline in investor numbers as its share price jumps 207.5% to Rp1,230
body: The number of investors in PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk fell by 22,887 to 97,738 by the end of December 2025, while the free‑float remained steady at 46.83% (66.39 billion shares). Despite the shrinking investor base, the stock surged 830 points (207.5%) over six months, closing the latest session up 2.07% to Rp1,230, with major shareholders unchanged.

title: PT Xolare RCR Energy Tbk. (SOLA) Management and Commissioners Acquire 1.54 million Shares under MESOP Phase II
body: On 6 January 2026, five PT Xolare RCR Energy Tbk. (SOLA) executives purchased a total of 1,537,000 shares at the Rp121 exercise price, amounting to roughly Rp185.98 million, as part of the newly launched MESOP Phase II program that runs from 29 December 2025 to 20 January 2026.

title: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) reports January 2026 gold exploration progress in Sumbawa, NTB with a Rp6.68 billion budget
body: The company's subsidiary PT Intam Eksplorasi conducted integrated exploration in the Ledang, Lebin and Lantung areas, allocating Rp6.68 billion and involving partners PT Geo Inti Sinergy, PT Rifaya Geo Teknologi, and PT Unitest Presisi Indonesia. Findings include a 16‑meter siliceous‑quartz breccia zone with 1.27 ppm gold in Lebin and drill results showing sulfide mineralization and up to 1.6 ppm gold in the Batururu prospects.

title: PT PP Presisi Tbk's Subsidiary, PT Lancarjaya Mandiri Abadi, Secures Rp1.3 Trillion Credit Facility from PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
body: PT Lancarjaya Mandiri Abadi (LMA), a subsidiary of PT PP Presisi Tbk (PPRE), obtained a Rp1.3 trillion credit facility from PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) for working capital, valid from January 9, 2026, to January 9, 2027. This facility, secured by Rp1.46 trillion in collateral, represents 65.7% of PT LMA's Rp1,978 trillion equity and is a Material Transaction, though exempt from RUPS approval as per POJK No. 17/2020.

title: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja, Commissioner of PT Ultra Jaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk., Acquires 8.16 Million ULTJ Shares
body: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja, a commissioner of PT Ultra Jaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk. (ULTJ), acquired approximately 8.16 million ULTJ shares between late December 2025 and early January 2026 for around Rp11.7 billion. This transaction, conducted for business purposes at prices ranging from Rp1,425 to Rp1,440 per share, increased his direct ownership to 1.29 percent, totaling 134,214,860 shares.

title: PT Adhi Kartiko Pratama Tbk (NICE) Secures Rp100 Billion Loan from PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk.
body: PT Adhi Kartiko Pratama Tbk (NICE) officially secured a Rp100 billion loan facility from PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk. (BTPN) on January 7, 2026. This 12-month facility, with an interest rate of COF + 1.25% per year, is intended for working capital and is expected to strengthen NICE's funding flexibility without a material impact on its financial condition.

title: M Slamet Sugiharto Buy Shares of Vale Indonesia Tbk
body: M Slamet Sugiharto acquired 8,000 shares of Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO.JK) at IDR 5,975 per share, totaling IDR 47,800,000. This transaction increases his direct ownership from 0 to 8,000 shares, representing 0.001% of the total issued capital. The purpose is stated as investment.

title: Carolina Renata Djaja Sell Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Carolina Renata Djaja sold 4,000,000 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk (MAXI.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred between January 6-7, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 53.0 to IDR 56.0 per share. Following the sale, her holding decreased from 39,004,743 shares to 35,004,743 shares, representing a reduction of 4,000,000 shares. This transaction impacts her direct ownership in the company.

title: Buana Graha Utama Buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama acquired 300,000 shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on January 8-9, 2026, at IDR 570 per share, totaling IDR 171,000,000. Following the purchase, Buana Graha Utama's holding increased from 287,846,518 shares to 288,146,518 shares, representing a marginal increase in ownership.

title: Arkora Bakti Indonesia Sell Shares of PT Arkora Hydro Tbk.
body: Arkora Bakti Indonesia divested 87,854,850 shares of PT Arkora Hydro Tbk. (ARKO.JK) at IDR 1,800 per share. This transaction reduces Arkora Bakti Indonesia's holding from 1,226,692,775 to 1,138,837,925 shares, marking a decrease of 87,854,850 shares. The purpose stated is divestment.

title: Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia Sell Shares of PT Diamond Citra Propertindo Tbk.
body: Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia sold 60,000,000 shares of PT Diamond Citra Propertindo Tbk. (DADA.JK) for IDR 67 per share, totaling IDR 4,020,000,000. This transaction reduces Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia's holding from 2,200,000,000 shares to 1,600,000,000 shares. The stated purpose is investment.

title: PT Era Graharealty Tbk. (IPAC) Establishes New Subsidiary PT Fajar Makmur Sukses for Business Expansion
body: PT Era Graharealty Tbk. (IPAC) announced the establishment of its new subsidiary, PT Fajar Makmur Sukses, on January 9, 2026, to develop its real estate business and expand market reach. IPAC holds a 51% stake in PT Fajar Makmur Sukses, which was founded with a basic capital of Rp1 billion and placed capital of Rp250 million.

title: PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa Tbk (INTP) Reduces Capital with Buyback Shares and Reports New Buyback Progress
body: PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa Tbk (INTP) formally transferred 165,628,900 shares from its 2021-2022 buyback program by reducing capital, with 84,529,400 treasury shares still pending transfer, and also reported accumulating 81,099,500 shares in a new buyback program (May-December 2024). Heidelberg Materials AG (Jerman) maintains a 53.4% stake in INTP, which currently holds 210,492,400 treasury shares.

title: Dato' Dr Low Tuck Kwong Buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Dato' Dr Low Tuck Kwong acquired 4,500 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction occurred on January 12, 2026, at a price of IDR 17,024.0 per share. This purchase increased the shareholder's total holdings from 13,406,866,270 to 13,406,870,770 shares.

title: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono Sell Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono sold shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk (MAXI.JK) at approximately IDR 54. This filing was disclosed by the exchange.

title: PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk Reports Realization of IPO Funds, Channeling Rp289.2 Billion to Subsidiaries by December 2025
body: PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk (NSSS) reported the utilization of Rp289.2 billion from its Rp430.5 billion net IPO funds by December 2025, primarily allocating it to subsidiaries for business expansion. Funds were distributed to PT Borneo Sawit Perdana for capital expenditure, PT Bina Sarana Sawit Utama for land acquisition and seedling financing, and PT Prasetya Mitra Muda for working capital, with Rp141.2 billion remaining in Bank Mandiri and Bank Panin.

title: Andreas Utomo Divests Shares in PT Aman Agrindo Tbk. Amidst Stock Price Rally
body: Andreas Utomo, Controller and President Director of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk. (GULA), sold 15,000,000 shares of GULA on January 9, 2026, for approximately Rp4.32 billion at Rp288 per share, reducing his ownership from 10.36% to 8.96%. Despite this divestment, GULA's stock price surged 24.84% to Rp382 per share on January 12, reaching Auto Rejection Atas (ARA).

title: Rahayu Saraswati D. Djojohadikusumo Becomes Strategic Investor in PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk with Initial 5% Share Acquisition
body: Rahayu Saraswati D. Djojohadikusumo, through her entities PT Raksaka Satya Devya and PT Rada Saraswati Surya, has completed the initial acquisition of 5% of PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) shares, becoming a strategic investor. This transaction, valued at approximately Rp45.5 billion at Rp200 per share on December 16, 2025, is the first step towards increasing her total ownership to 20%.

title: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk. (BWPT) Approves New Board of Directors and Commissioners Following RUPSLB
body: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk. (BWPT) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) on January 7, 2026, approving a reshuffle of its Board of Directors and Commissioners. The RUPSLB appointed Ahmad Nizam bin Hamid, Razuwan bin Che Rose, and Erwin Soejono to the Board of Commissioners, honorably dismissed previous members, and approved the new board's term until the 2030 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.

title: PT Bank UOB Indonesia Completes Issuance of Rp500 Billion Subordinated Bonds with 6.50% Interest
body: PT Bank UOB Indonesia is completing the issuance of Subordinated Bonds IV Phase II Year 2026 amounting to Rp500 billion, offering an annual interest rate of 6.50% and maturing on January 9, 2033. The funds will be utilized to increase credit distribution and maintain capital resilience as per POJK No.5 Tahun 2024, with BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, Indo Premier Sekuritas, and Kay Hian Sekuritas as underwriters and PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk. as trustee.

title: PT Jaya Real Property Tbk (JRPT) Reports Realization of Share Buyback from April to December 2025
body: PT Jaya Real Property Tbk (JRPT) reported the realization of its share buyback program from April 9 to December 31, 2025, acquiring 68.81 million shares for a total expenditure of Rp54.79 billion. The company still has Rp82.61 billion prepared for future buybacks, having conducted 170 transactions amidst fluctuating market conditions.

title: Rada Saraswati Surya Sell Shares of PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk
body: Rada Saraswati Surya sold 45,514,573 shares of PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk for investment purposes. The transaction occurred at an average price of IDR 200 per share. Post-transaction, Rada Saraswati Surya holds 45,514,573 shares, indicating an initial holding of 0 shares before this transaction.

title: Andreas Utomo sell Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
body: Andreas Utomo divested 20,000,000 shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK). The transactions occurred on January 12, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 306 to IDR 312 per share. Following the divestment, Utomo's holding decreased from 95,876,400 shares to 75,876,400 shares, representing a reduction of 20,000,000 shares. This move signifies a reduction in Andreas Utomo's stake in the company.

title: Hsbc-Fund Svs A/C Chengdong Investment Corp-Self Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Hsbc-Fund Svs A/C Chengdong Investment Corp-Self divested 3,713,353,900 shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK). This divestment reduced their holding from 22,276,410,130 shares to 18,563,056,230 shares. Transactions occurred between December 23, 2025, and January 8, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 363 to IDR 461 per share. The purpose of the transaction was divestment.

title: Hsbc-Fund Svs A/C Chengdong Investment Corp-Self Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Hsbc-Fund Svs A/C Chengdong Investment Corp-Self divested 3,713,353,900 shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK). The transactions occurred between December 23, 2025, and January 8, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 363 to IDR 461 per share. This divestment reduced the holder's stake from 22,276,410,130 shares to 18,563,056,230 shares.

title: Chengdong Corporation Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Chengdong Corporation divested shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK). The total transaction amounted to IDR 3,713,353,900. Holdings decreased from 22,276,410,130 to 18,563,056,230 shares. Transactions occurred between December 23, 2025, and January 8, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 363 to IDR 461 per share. This represents a significant divestment by Chengdong Corporation.

title: Henry Liem Sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold a total of 166,700 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK). The transactions occurred on January 12, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 585 to IDR 600 per share. Following the sale, Liem's holdings decreased from 15,488,959 shares to 15,322,259 shares. This represents a reduction in his ownership stake in the company.

title: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja buy Shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk
body: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja acquired 1,522,700 shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ.JK) for business purposes. The transactions occurred between January 8 and January 13, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 1,440 to IDR 1,450 per share. This acquisition increased his total holdings from 134,214,860 shares to 135,737,560 shares, representing a net increase of 1,522,700 shares.

title: Bank Of Singapore Limited Buy Shares of Pioneerindo Gourmet International Tbk
body: Bank Of Singapore Limited purchased 20,000 shares of Pioneerindo Gourmet International Tbk (PTSP.JK) at an average price of IDR 1,000 per share. This transaction increased its holdings from 17,637,920 to 17,657,920 shares. The purpose of this transaction was a purchase. This represents a minor increase in the institutional investor's stake in the company.

title: Chengdong Corporation Sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Chengdong Corporation divested 3,713,353,900 shares of Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI.JK) between December 23, 2025, and January 8, 2026. The transactions occurred at prices ranging from IDR 363 to IDR 461 per share. This divestment reduced Chengdong Corporation's holdings from 22,276,410,130 shares to 18,563,056,230 shares, representing a decrease of 3,713,353,900 shares.

title: PT Saratoga Investama Investasi Buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: PT Saratoga Investama Investasi acquired 4,500 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction, valued at approximately IDR 76,608,000 at an average price of IDR 17,024 per share, occurred on January 12, 2026. This purchase slightly increased PT Saratoga Investama Investasi's holding in BYAN.JK from 13,406,866,270 shares to 13,406,870,770 shares, representing a minor change in their overall stake.

title: PT Energia Prima Nusantara Wins National Energy Efficiency Award (PEEN 2025) at Subroto Awards
body: PT Energia Prima Nusantara (EPN), a unit of PT United Tractors Tbk (UT), received the PEEN 2025 Special Innovation Award for Energy Management in Industry, presented by Director General Eniya Listiani Dewi. The award recognizes EPN's integrated, sustainable energy‑management innovations and its contribution to Indonesia’s national energy‑efficiency agenda.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk reports Q3 2025 net revenue of Rp100.5 trillion, profit falls 26% amid mixed segment performance
body: For the quarter ended September 2025, PT United Tractors Tbk posted net revenue of Rp100.5 trillion, a 1% increase year‑on‑year, while net profit dropped 26% to Rp11.5 trillion as Mining Contractor and Thermal Coal segments declined, offset by an 11% rise in Construction Machinery revenue and a 53% surge in Gold & other minerals revenue. Komatsu heavy‑equipment sales grew 10% to 3,653 units, PAMA’s overburden removal volume fell 10% due to heavy rains, and Turangga Resources increased coal volume 15% but saw revenue fall on lower prices.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk and Yayasan Karya Bakti United Tractors launch SOBAT Competition 2025 with a new disability category and 1,028 entries
body: The seventh edition of the SOBAT Competition, organized by PT United Tractors Tbk together with Yayasan Karya Bakti United Tractors, runs from June to October 2025 across seven categories—including a newly added disability group—and received 1,028 innovation submissions, up from 848 in 2024. The program, judged by experts from industry and academia, aims to foster inclusive, sustainable innovation aligned with PT United Tractors Tbk’s ESG commitments.

title: Arkora Bakti Indonesia Sells 87.85 Million Shares of Arkora Hydro (ARKO) for Rp158.13 Billion
body: Arkora Bakti Indonesia divested 87,854,850 shares of Arkora Hydro (ARKO) on January 9, 2026, at Rp1,800 per share, generating Rp158.13 billion. This transaction reduced Arkora Bakti's ownership in Arkora Hydro to 38.89% from 41.89%.

title: PT Vale Indonesia (INCO) Spent USD 1.67 Million on Exploration in Q4 2025
body: PT Vale Indonesia (INCO) spent USD 1.67 million on exploration activities during the fourth quarter of 2025, focusing on its Sorowako, Bahodopi, and Pomalaa Blocks within its Special Mining Business Permit areas. The exploration, conducted with third parties, utilized HQ-3 core drilling and Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT) methods to upgrade resource classification and obtain complete laterite profiles, with further work planned in the Pomalaa Block.

title: Indonesia's Investment Minister Meets Tsingshan Group to Discuss Sustaining Nickel Industry Investment and Downstreaming
body: Investment and Downstreaming Minister Rosan Roeslani met with representatives of China’s Tsingshan Group to discuss sustaining investment, deepening value-addition, and the direction of industrial-park development for nickel-based industries and mineral downstreaming. Tsingshan Group has a long-standing partnership in Indonesia, with affiliates such as PT Weda Bay Nickel, PT Indonesia Tsingshan Stainless Steel (ITSS), PT Indonesia Guang Ching Nickel and Stainless Steel Industry (GCNS), and PT Sulawesi Mining Investment (SMI) operating in the country.

title: NuEnergy Gas Limited Partners with PT Beijing Energy Linking to Accelerate Indonesia's CBM Development
body: NuEnergy Gas Limited (ASX: NGY) has partnered with Chinese strategic ally PT Beijing Energy Linking (PT BEL) to accelerate Coal Bed Methane (CBM) projects in South Sumatra, focusing on the Tanjung Enim Working Area with support from SKK Migas. This collaboration follows NuEnergy’s subsidiary, Dart Energy (Tanjung Enim), signing a Gas Sales Agreement with PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGN) for an initial contract value of around USD 200 million, targeting first gas sales of 1 MMSCFD in the first half of 2026.

title: PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk (IATA) Commences Mining Operations Following Rp5 Trillion Contract with PT Kalimantan Prima Persada (KPP Mining)
body: PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk (IATA) held its 1st Digging Ceremony, marking the start of mining operations after its subsidiary, PT Arthaco Prima Energy (APE), signed a Rp5 trillion, five-year mining contractor agreement with PT Kalimantan Prima Persada (KPP Mining). This collaboration targets an initial coal output of around 3 million metric tons in 2026, with potential to increase to up to 7 million metric tons per year.

title: Balikpapan Refinery RDMP Project Reduces Gasoline Imports by 5.8 Million Kiloliters Annually
body: The inauguration of the Balikpapan Refinery's Refinery Development Master Plan (RDMP) project is projected to cut gasoline imports by 5.8 million kiloliters per year, reducing total national imports to 19 million kiloliters. This revitalization also boosts the refinery's capacity from 260,000 to 360,000 barrels of oil per day and produces Euro 5 quality fuel.

title: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto Announces US$6 Billion Downstreaming Projects to Commence Soon
body: President Prabowo Subianto announced that US$6 billion worth of downstreaming projects, part of a national strategy to accelerate industrialization and increase value from natural resources, will break ground within weeks. These projects, initially six with potential to expand to eleven, are expected to attract large-scale foreign investments and strengthen Indonesia's national industry.

title: Balikpapan RDMP Operation Enhances Indonesia's Energy Self-Sufficiency and Fuel Production Capacity
body: The Balikpapan Refinery Development Master Plan (RDMP), inaugurated by President Prabowo Subianto, significantly boosts Indonesia's energy self-sufficiency by increasing fuel production capacity from 260 thousand barrels per day to 360 MBOPD, meeting Euro V standards, following an investment of approximately US$7.4 billion. This project, involving cooperation between PT Pertamina and private partners, also improved the refinery's complexity and yield of high-value products, with further RDMP expansions planned for sites like Dumai, operated by PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional (KPI) Refinery Unit II Dumai.

title: Indonesia Aims to End Aviation Fuel Imports by 2027 Following Major Refinery Expansion
body: Indonesia plans to halt aviation fuel imports by 2027 and CN48 diesel fuel imports this year, driven by its energy self-sufficiency goal and the inauguration of the US$7.4 billion Refinery Development Master Plan (RDMP) project. This project, inaugurated by President Prabowo Subianto, expanded the Balikpapan refinery's daily processing capacity from 260,000 to 360,000 barrels and increased high-value product yield, with state-owned oil and gas company Pertamina also instructed to reduce diesel fuel imports.

title: Indonesian President Prabowo Announces 20 Percent Fertilizer Price Reduction and Higher Farmer Welfare
body: President Prabowo Subianto announced a 20 percent reduction in fertilizer prices, achieved through major reforms to regulatory and distribution systems, directly benefiting farmers with lower costs and more reliable supplies. These reforms led to the Farmer's Exchange Rate rising from 106 to 125, the highest in history, and contributed to record-high rice reserves exceeding 3 million tons.

title: United Tractors (UNTR) Injects Rp500 Billion into Karya Supra Perkasa (KSP) to Strengthen Control
body: United Tractors (UNTR) injected Rp500 billion into its business entity, Karya Supra Perkasa (KSP), by absorbing 500,000 new shares, increasing its ownership to 99.97% of KSP. This capital injection, patented on January 8, 2026, aims to fulfill KSP's funding needs and significantly strengthen UNTR's control over the entity.

title: President Prabowo Subianto Inaugurates Indonesia's Largest Oil Refinery in Balikpapan
body: President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated Indonesia's largest oil refinery, the Refinery Development Master Plan (RDMP) project at Refinery Unit V in Balikpapan, operated by state-owned energy company Pertamina, on January 12, 2026. Built with an investment of Rp123 trillion (US$7.3 billion), the facility aims to reduce fuel imports by Rp68 trillion and contribute Rp514 trillion to the gross domestic product, strengthening national energy security.

title: Indonesia Plans National Single-Price Rice Policy Starting 2026 to Reduce Regional Disparities
body: The Indonesian government plans to implement a national single-price rice policy starting in 2026 to reduce regional rice price disparities by subsidizing distribution costs. This initiative aims to keep prices consistent nationwide and requires strengthening the role of state food logistics agency Bulog, including granting it an assignment margin for stabilization and distribution tasks.

title: Indonesia Targets 4 Million Tons of Rice Reserves Through 2029 Amidst Higher Production Forecast
body: The Indonesian government aims to secure a four-million-ton rice reserve through 2029, bolstered by a projected 5–10 percent increase in national rice production for 2026 due to an early harvest. Strategies include constructing around 100 new Bulog warehouses with Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI) support and mobilizing Red and White Village Cooperatives (KDMP) for local storage and distribution.

title: President Prabowo Subianto Convened Meeting to Strengthen Indonesia's Textile and Automotive Chip Industries, Reviewing US$6 Billion in New Downstreaming Projects
body: President Prabowo Subianto led a meeting to revitalize the textile and garment industry's supply chain and bolster automotive and electronics sectors through investment in semiconductor technology. The meeting also covered progress on six new downstreaming projects, valued at US$6 billion, set for early February 2026 groundbreaking, and the upcoming inauguration of Pertamina’s RDMP in Balikpapan.

title: Chandra Asri Pacific (TPIA) to Conduct Scheduled Turnaround Maintenance at Petrochemical Facilities Starting January 2026
body: Chandra Asri Pacific (TPIA) will undertake scheduled Turnaround Maintenance (TAM) at its Cilegon petrochemical plant facilities, commencing January 2026, with phases estimated for 26 and 41 days. This periodic maintenance, a global industry standard, aims to ensure the reliability, safety, and long-term operational integrity of the facilities, with Chandra Asri Group coordinating operations to minimize supply chain and customer impact.

title: Strategic Investor Djoni Acquires 5.09% Stake in Multi Garam Utama (FOLK)
body: Strategic investor Djoni has acquired a 5.09% stake, equivalent to 201 million shares, in Multi Garam Utama (FOLK), effective January 9, 2026, which is viewed by the market as a strategic signal aligning with expectations of a major conglomerate group's potential entry. This investment, alongside FOLK's recent Private Placement (PMTHMETD) which increased its free float to 28.15%, is seen as confidence in the company's long-term growth and readiness for larger-scale expansion.

title: Merdeka Copper Gold (MDKA) Expended USD5.93 Million on Exploration Across Key Projects in Q4 2025
body: Merdeka Copper Gold (MDKA) spent Rp99.16 billion (USD5.93 million) on exploration during Q4 2025, primarily targeting copper-gold and gold-silver resources at Tujuh Bukit, copper at Pulau Wetar, and copper-gold-silver at Damai Suksesindo (DSI). The majority of the budget, Rp88.18 billion (USD5.28 million), was allocated to Tujuh Bukit for extensive drilling and geophysical surveys, while DSI's field exploration has been suspended for one year to conduct desktop studies.

title: Alamtri Resources Indonesia (ADRO) Completes Transfer of 1.36 Billion Buyback Shares Through Capital Reduction
body: Alamtri Resources Indonesia (ADRO) has completed the transfer of 1.36 billion buyback shares, valued at Rp2.71 trillion, through a reduction in placed and fully paid-up capital. This transaction, finalized on August 5, 2025, relates to buybacks conducted from May 16 to June 3, 2025, leaving 589.19 million shares (Rp1.13 trillion) yet to be transferred.

title: Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia Divests 600 Million Shares of Diamond Citra (DADA) for Rp40.2 Billion
body: Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia divested 600 million shares of Diamond Citra (DADA) on January 7, 2026, at Rp67 per share, generating Rp40.2 billion. This transaction reduced Karya Permata's ownership in Diamond Citra from 29.60% to 21.53%, occurring when DADA's stock experienced a sudden surge.

title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) Addresses BEI Inquiry on Board Composition, Committing to Independent Commissioner Compliance
body: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) responded to the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) regarding its Board of Commissioners' composition, which falls short of the 30% independent commissioner requirement mandated by POJK No. 33 Tahun 2014 after a recent RUPSLB on December 2, 2025. TRIN acknowledged the non-compliance, attributing it to ongoing changes including the appointment of Rahayu Saraswati Djojohadikusumo as President Commissioner, and committed to holding an upcoming Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham to achieve full regulatory compliance.

title: Bank Banten (BEKS) Clarifies Rp2.82 Trillion Deficit and Mitigation Strategies to Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI)
body: Bank Banten (BEKS) explained to Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) that its Rp2.82 trillion deficit as of September 30, 2025, is due to accumulated operational losses and significant impairment loss provisions from previous years. To overcome this, the bank plans to improve operational efficiency, focus on profitable segments, and consider capital injection through a rights issue or strategic investor, while confirming its ability to continue operations with shareholder support, including from Bank Jatim.

title: PT Avia Avian Tbk. Reports Rp250.56 Billion in Remaining IPO Funds Placed Across Multiple Banks.
body: PT Avia Avian Tbk. (AVIA) reported Rp250.56 billion in unused IPO funds as of December 31, 2025, with the majority deposited in PT Bank Central Asia Tbk. along with PT Bank UOB Indonesia and PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk. The company, which secured Rp5.65 trillion from its 2021 IPO, utilized Rp4.23 trillion for its own operations and allocated Rp1.42 trillion to its subsidiary, PT Tirtakencana Tatawarna, for various purposes including working capital, capital expenditure, and debt repayment.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Buy Shares of PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk.
body: Prajogo Pangestu acquired 1,330,000 shares of PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk. (BREN.JK). The transactions occurred on January 13, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 8,800 to IDR 9,025 per share. This purchase increased his total holdings from 138,459,700 to 139,789,700 shares. The purpose of the transaction was not specified in the filing.

title: Buana Graha Utama buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama acquired 400,000 shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk through open market purchases on January 12, 2026, at prices ranging from IDR 570 to IDR 575 per share. This transaction increased Buana Graha Utama's total holdings to 288,546,518 shares, representing a modest increase from 288,146,518 shares previously held. The stated purpose of this acquisition is investment, signaling continued confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Miki Ojisan Indomitra Sell Shares of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk
body: Miki Ojisan Indomitra sold 11,473,300 shares of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk (KMDS.JK) for IDR 600 per share, totaling IDR 6,883,980,000. This transaction, aimed at Investment Realization, reduces Miki Ojisan Indomitra's stake from 169,523,811 shares to 158,050,511 shares. The sale represents a decrease of 11,473,300 shares in their holdings.

title: PT Saratoga Investama Investasi Buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: PT Saratoga Investama acquired 2,500 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) on January 13, 2026, for an undisclosed price, increasing its holdings from 13,406,870,770 to 13,406,873,270 shares. The purpose is listed as investment. This transaction represents a marginal increase in PT Saratoga Investama's stake in the company.

title: Celebes Mining Resources Sell Shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk
body: Celebes Mining Resources divested 105,393,767 shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk (HOPE.JK) on January 9, 2026, at IDR 45.0 per share. This transaction reduced their holding from 400,940,500 shares to 295,546,733 shares, a decrease of 105,393,767 shares. The purpose stated for this sale is divestment.

title: Dato' Dr Low Tuck Kwong Buy Shares of PT Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On January 13, 2026, an investment transaction occurred involving PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK). A total of 2,500 shares were transacted at a price of IDR 17,088.00 per share. This purchase increased the total holdings to 13,406,873,270 shares from a previous 13,406,870,770 shares, representing a net increase of 2,500 shares. The stated purpose of this transaction is investment.

title: Celebes Mining Resources Sell Shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk
body: Celebes Mining Resources divested 105,393,767 shares of PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk. The transaction occurred at an average price of IDR 45.0 per share. Following the sale, Celebes Mining Resources' holding decreased from 400,940,500 shares to 295,546,733 shares, a reduction of 105,393,767 shares. This divestment signifies a strategic shift in their investment portfolio for PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk.

title: Miki Ojisan Indomitra Sell Shares of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk
body: Miki Ojisan Indomitra has sold 11,473,300 shares of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk (KMDS.JK) for investment realization. The transaction occurred at IDR 600 per share. Following the sale, Miki Ojisan Indomitra's stake decreased from 169,523,811 shares to 158,050,511 shares, a reduction of 11,473,300 shares.

title: Sumber Garam Pratama Sell Shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk
body: Sumber Garam Pratama divested 66,740,500 shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk, reducing its holdings from 970,070,781 to 903,330,281 shares. The transactions occurred on January 13, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 75.0 to IDR 80.0 per share. This divestment represents a strategic move by the shareholder.

title: Ubs Ag, London Others Shares of BISI INTERNATIONAL Tbk
body: Ubs Ag, London transferred 25,000,000 shares of BISI INTERNATIONAL Tbk. The transaction, classified as 'others' with a stated purpose of 'share transfer', resulted in a decrease in Ubs Ag, London's holding from 246,118,109 to 221,118,109 shares. The specific price per share was not disclosed, but the total amount transacted was IDR 25,000,000. This transfer impacts the direct holdings of Ubs Ag, London in BISI.

title: Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo Others Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo acquired 35,607,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) for IDR 444 per share, totaling IDR 15,816,528,000. This transaction, classified as 'others' with the purpose 'MSOP', increased his total holdings from 3,997,000 to 39,604,000 shares. The filing occurred on January 14, 2026.

title: Andreas Utomo Sell Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
body: Andreas Utomo divested 26,320,000 shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK) at IDR 380 per share. This transaction reduces his stake from 75,876,400 shares to 49,556,400 shares, a decrease of 26,320,000 shares. The purpose cited is divestment.

title: Indonesia and Pakistan deepen palm oil trade ties with new MoUs and a focus on balanced economic cooperation
body: At a networking reception in Karachi hosted by the Indonesian consulate and GAPKI, Indonesia and Pakistan signed three MoUs—including a joint trade commission and cooperation with PEORA and PVMA—to strengthen palm‑oil trade, which already supplied over 3 million tons to Pakistan in 2024, making it Indonesia’s third‑largest market. Ambassadors highlighted the move toward a more strategic, value‑added partnership beyond conventional trade.

title: From Illegal Gold Mining to Sustainable Sheep Farming: Gember’s Transformation under PT Aneka Tambang Tbk’s Sundung Cisarua Program
body: After the government shut down illegal gold mining in Cisarua, former miner Gember joined PT Aneka Tambang Tbk’s (ANTAM) Sundung Cisarua community development program, learning sheep husbandry and expanding Jaro Farm from 50 to over 800 Garut sheep, generating about Rp400 million in annual revenue. The initiative, which also created women’s farming groups and earned the Subroto Award 2025 for innovative mineral‑related community development, demonstrates a shift from illicit mining profits to sustainable local income.

title: Indonesia's 2025 ESDM Regulation Defines Four Coal HBA Categories and Links HPB to Coal Quality Parameters
body: Decision No. 72/2025 of the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources establishes four HBA categories based on calorific values of 6,322, 5,300, 4,100, and 3,400 kcal/kg GAR. The resulting Coal Reference Price (HPB) is calculated considering calorific value, moisture, sulfur, and ash content.

title: Indonesia to launch a US$6 billion state‑owned textile SOE to boost exports
body: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto announced that President Prabowo Subianto has directed the creation of a new state‑owned textile enterprise, funded with US$6 billion through Indonesia’s sovereign wealth manager Danantara, to modernize the sector and raise exports from US$4 billion to US$40 billion over ten years. The plan also includes a roadmap to address gaps in the value chain and a parallel push to revitalize the semiconductor industry with up to US$1 billion in investment.

title: Indonesia may halt gasoline imports of RON 92‑98 by 2027 if refinery capacity expands, minister says
body: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said Indonesia could stop importing RON 92, RON 95 and RON 98 gasoline by 2027 once domestic refinery output meets the roughly 38.5 million kiloliters annual demand, noting the Balikpapan Refinery revamp could cut imports by up to 5.8 million kiloliters per year. He added that private stations such as Shell, bp and Vivo will be required to purchase fuel from state‑owned Pertamina while import quotas remain necessary due to current production shortfalls.

title: Indonesia to consider an additional cigarette excise tier to curb illegal tobacco, with stricter enforcement
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa announced plans to add a new layer of excise tax on cigarettes this year to push illicit producers into the legal market and warned of firm sanctions for non‑compliance. The Directorate General of Customs and Excise reported seizing 1.4 billion illegal cigarettes since 2025, including a recent 160 million‑cigarette haul in Pekanbaru that accounted for about 11 % of total seizures, and total 2025 seizure value rose 2.1 % to Rp9.8 trillion (US$564 million).

title: Indonesia Keeps B40 Biodiesel Blend for 2026 as B50 Remains Under Review
body: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said the government will retain the mandatory 40% palm‑oil biodiesel blend this year, pending further assessment of price differentials before any shift to a 50% blend. Technical studies and automotive trials for B50 continue, but implementation will depend on market conditions and the president’s directive.

title: Unknown Shareholder Buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: A transaction involving 1,100 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) was executed on January 14, 2026, at a price of IDR 17,150 per share. The purpose of this transaction is stated as 'Investment'. Following this purchase, the shareholder's total holdings increased from 13,406,873,270 shares to 13,406,874,370 shares, marking a net increase of 1,100 shares.

title: UAE’s Masdar plans to expand its geothermal investments in Indonesia through partnership with Pertamina Geothermal Energy and the Indonesia Investment Authority
body: Masdar announced plans to deepen its stake in Indonesia’s geothermal sector, building on its 2023 investment in Pertamina Geothermal Energy (PGE) and a partnership with the Indonesia Investment Authority (INA). PGE’s plants currently generate 4.8 TWh of electricity annually, avoiding about 3.9 million tonnes of CO₂, while Indonesia’s geothermal potential stands at 23,742 MW versus 2,744 MW installed.

title: Indonesia Prioritizes Administrative Sanctions for Fishery Import Violations
body: Indonesia’s Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries is prioritizing administrative sanctions to enforce compliance in fishery import cases, aiming to safeguard business continuity and protect workers while criminal charges are reserved as a last resort. This approach, which includes fines and permit actions, recently led to a Rp1 billion administrative fine on a company whose licensing manipulation could have caused estimated economic losses of Rp4.48 billion (US$265,000).

title: Indonesia Achieves Diesel Self-Sufficiency Following Major Balikpapan Refinery Expansion
body: Indonesia has declared self-sufficiency in diesel fuel after President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated the expanded Balikpapan Refinery Development Master Plan (RDMP) project, marking the nation's first major refinery development in 32 years. This US$7.4 billion expansion increased processing capacity to 360,000 barrels per day, is projected to cut fuel imports by over US$4 billion annually, and contribute US$30.5 billion to GDP.

title: PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk. (MPMX) Completes Treasury Stock Transfer via Capital Reduction
body: PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk. (MPMX) has completed the transfer of 116,715,515 treasury shares, representing 94.24% of its total treasury stock, by reducing placed and paid-up capital as approved by shareholders. This transfer, which did not generate cash proceeds and resulted in no recorded loss, leaves 7,139,585 treasury shares remaining, originating from a 2017 buyback at an average price of Rp924.45 per share.

title: Indonesia's KKP Prevents US$258 Thousand Loss from Illegal Frozen Fish Imports
body: The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries (KKP) prevented Rp4.48 billion (US$258 thousand) in potential state losses by seizing nearly 100 tons of illegal frozen Pacific mackerel imported through Tanjung Priok Port. This action, which included imposing Rp1 billion (US$57,600) in administrative fines, aims to protect the domestic fisheries sector from market disruption and unregistered imports.

title: Indonesia Prepares Airline Ticket Discounts for Eid al-Fitr 2026 to Boost Economy
body: The Indonesian government is preparing airline ticket discount incentives for Eid al-Fitr 2026, as announced by Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto. This measure aims to maintain public purchasing power, encourage mobility, and stimulate national economic growth across tourism, transportation, and domestic consumption sectors.

title: PT PIMSF Pulogadung to Launch Mandatory Tender Offer for PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk Shares Following Change of Control
body: PT PIMSF Pulogadung will conduct a Mandatory Tender Offer for up to 363,707,303 (54.55%) shares of PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk (GPSO) at Rp436 per share, valuing the offer at a maximum of Rp158.58 billion, following its acquisition of 45.45% of GPSO from Karnadi Margaka. The tender, funded by internal cash and running from January 15 to February 13, 2026, aims to integrate GPSO into Tjokro Group for machining industry development and business consolidation.

title: United Tractors (UNTR) and Astra International (ASII) Conclude Share Buyback Programs Ahead of Schedule
body: United Tractors (UNTR) has completed its share buyback, spending Rp1.99 trillion to acquire 68,519,800 shares at an average price of Rp29,188 per share, effectively ending on January 14, 2026, earlier than planned. Similarly, its parent company, Astra International (ASII), also concluded its Rp2 trillion buyback ahead of schedule, utilizing a maximum of Rp1.99 trillion to purchase 305,213,900 shares at an average price of Rp6,552 per share, with no negative impact on its business continuity.

title: I Gusti Ngurah Askhara Danadiputra Appointed President Director of Humpuss Maritim Internasional (HUMI)
body: Humpuss Maritim Internasional (HUMI) has appointed I Gusti Ngurah Askhara Danadiputra as its new President Director, replacing Tirta Hidayat, following an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on January 14, 2026, aimed at organizational refreshment and strengthening Good Corporate Governance. Ari Askhara plans to focus on healthy revenue growth, fleet development, sustainable business diversification, and integrating ESG principles to minimize carbon footprint and align with energy transition goals.

title: Indika Energy (INDY) Establishes New Subsidiary INVI Manufaktur Andalan Indonesia (IMAI) for Electric Vehicle Business
body: Indika Energy (INDY) has formed INVI Manufaktur Andalan Indonesia (IMAI) through its subsidiaries Energi Makmur Buana (EMB) and Mitra Motor Group (MMG) to seriously develop its electric vehicle business line, encompassing the industry for four-wheeled motor vehicles or more. This new consolidated subsidiary aligns with INDY's business diversification strategy and is not expected to impact the parent company's operational, legal, or financial condition.

title: Superbank (SUPA) Manages Unused IPO Funds and Allocates Capital for Credit Expansion
body: Superbank (SUPA) has Rp1.44 trillion of its net Rp2.73 trillion IPO funds remaining, which are placed at Bank Indonesia's Fasilitas Simpanan Bank Indonesia (Fasbi) at a 3.75% overnight interest. Of the total IPO proceeds, Rp1.29 trillion has been absorbed for working capital to strengthen credit distribution, while Rp819.22 billion allocated for capital expenditure remains unutilized.

title: Controlling Shareholders Continue Share Distribution of Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) for Rahayu Saraswati's Acquisition
body: Controlling shareholders Kunci Daud Indonesia and Intan Investama Internasional distributed 136.6 million shares of Perintis Triniti Properti (TRIN) as part of Rahayu Saraswati's acquisition. Following this and previous transactions, Rahayu Saraswati now controls 227.5 million shares, or five percent of TRIN, through her entities Raksaka Satya Devya and Rada Saraswati Surya.

title: Goto Group (GOTO) Details IPO Fund Utilization and Recent Stock Performance
body: Goto Group (GOTO) utilized Rp13.57 trillion from its net IPO proceeds, allocating funds across various entities including Tokopedia, Dompet Anak Bangsa, Multifinance Anak Bangsa, Velox Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, and Go Viet Tehnology Trading Joint Stok, as well as for company working capital. Concurrently, GOTO shares saw a recent increase, rising 2.99% to Rp69 per share yesterday and a total of 16.95% over the last month.

title: Abadi Lestari (RLCO) Reports Minimal IPO Fund Absorption While Its Shares Experience Significant Gains.
body: Abadi Lestari (RLCO) has only absorbed Rp10 billion, or 10%, of its net IPO proceeds of Rp100.23 billion, with Rp90.23 billion remaining unutilized and held in current accounts at 1.5% interest. Despite the low fund utilization, RLCO shares have surged 2,906% to Rp5,050 from their Rp168 IPO price, experiencing auto reject atas for 18 out of 21 trading days since listing, and the number of shareholders drastically increased to 279,042, with Realco Omega holding 77.6%.

title: PT Indospring Tbk's Corporate Actions and Dividend Approval Boost Stock Performance
body: PT Indospring Tbk (INDS) strengthened operations through strategic corporate actions, including acquiring operational assets from its subsidiary PT Indobaja Primamurni for Rp3,017,747,000 and leasing office space from its parent entity PT Indoprima Investama for Rp60,000,000. These actions, coupled with the approval of a cash dividend of Rp8 per share (totaling up to Rp52,499,976,800) for the 2024 fiscal year, have led to a significant stock surge, with INDS shares increasing 147.77% monthly and 145.58% year-to-date.

title: PT Millennium Pharmacon International Tbk (SDPC) Appoints New President Director and Approves Board Composition Changes
body: PT Millennium Pharmacon International Tbk (SDPC) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (EGMS) where shareholders approved the resignation of Ahmad bin Abu Bakar and appointed Dr. Imam Fathorrahman, M.M as the new President Director. This meeting also finalized the composition of the Board of Commissioners and Directors until the 2027 Annual General Meeting, with the company anticipating stronger strategic direction and improved performance.

title: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (SMGR) Targets Infrastructure Sector Expansion by 2026 Through Strategic Collaboration and Green Innovation
body: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (SMGR) aims to enter the infrastructure sector by 2026, focusing on strengthening collaboration and business transformation to offer innovative building solutions. This strategy includes developing SIG's green cement, which reduces carbon emissions by up to 38% and has a domestic content level (TKDN) exceeding 90%, as discussed at the SIG Infrastructure Summit.

title: Serial System International Pte. Ltd. Sells Shares of PT Sentral Mitra Informatika Tbk
body: Serial System International Pte. Ltd. divested 10,700,000 shares of PT Sentral Mitra Informatika Tbk (LUCK.JK) on January 14, 2026, at IDR 168.0 per share. This transaction reduces their holdings from 113,784,540 to 103,084,540 shares. The divestment marks a decrease in ownership for Serial System International Pte. Ltd. in the company.

title: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) Plans Rp3.71 Trillion Right Issue with Warrant Incentive
body: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) announced a right issue (PMHMETD I) targeting Rp3.71 trillion by issuing 12,390,094,754 new shares at Rp300 per share, offering Waran Seri II as an incentive, with PT Matra Tri Abadi (MTA) committing to exercise its rights and act as a standby buyer. The majority of the proceeds will be used to strengthen the working capital of its subsidiaries, including PT Folago Karya Indonesia (FKI), PT Folago Digital Media (FDM), and PT Folago Picture Indonesia (FPI), to support their digital and creative ecosystem expansion.

title: PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT) Reallocates 81.28% of Treasury Shares from Buyback Program
body: PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT) has reallocated 153,973,614 shares, representing 81.28% of its 189,450,729 total treasury shares from its buyback program, as of December 31, 2025. These reallocations, conducted through mechanisms such as MESOP and bonus share distribution, leave 36,477,115 shares still recorded as treasury stock.

title: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Reinforces Business Transformation and Green Construction Amidst Market Slowdown
body: Amidst domestic market overcapacity and slowdown in 2025, PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (SIG) is focusing on business transformation, innovating building material solutions, and strengthening its role as a strategic partner through green cement and integrated construction. This strategy, highlighted at the SIG Infrastructure Summit, aligns with PT Bank Mandiri Tbk's forecast of a 2.5% national cement sales growth in 2026, driven by infrastructure and property despite persistent overcapacity.

title: PT Jaya Real Property Tbk (JRPT) Reports Progress on Share Buyback from October 2025 to January 2026
body: PT Jaya Real Property Tbk (JRPT) successfully repurchased 22.4 million shares from October 14, 2025, to January 12, 2026, for a total of Rp21.45 billion at an average price of Rp958 per share. This buyback accounts for 21.45% of the total target, with the company still allocating Rp79.8 billion for continued share repurchases.

title: PT Celebes Mining Resources Divests 4.95% Stake in PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk. for Rp4.7 Billion
body: PT Celebes Mining Resources sold 105,393,767 shares, representing a 4.95% stake, in PT Harapan Duta Pertiwi Tbk. (HOPE) for approximately Rp4.7 billion on January 9, 2026. This divestment, priced at Rp45 per share significantly below the market price of Rp220, reduced PT Celebes Mining Resources' ownership in HOPE from 18.82% to 13.87%.

title: PT Emdeki Utama Tbk Reports on IPO Fund Utilization and Project Delays
body: PT Emdeki Utama Tbk reported the realization of Rp135.3 billion from its Rp175.3 billion IPO net proceeds by December 31, 2025, with funds allocated for factory construction, capital for PT Emde Plast Utama, and working capital. The company also disclosed delays for its carbide desulphuriser and ferro silica factory projects, placing the remaining IPO funds in a 3-month deposit yielding 4.5% interest.

title: Gozco Capital Buy Shares of PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk.
body: Gozco Capital acquired 207,000,000 shares of PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk. (BBYB) at IDR 474 per share for investment purposes. This transaction increased Gozco Capital's stake from 1,035,384,381 shares to 1,242,384,381 shares, representing a significant addition to their holdings in the company.

title: Junichiro Waide Sell Shares of PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk
body: Junichiro Waide has sold a total of 7,020,000 shares of PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk (VTNY.JK) as part of a portfolio adjustment. The transactions occurred between January 6 and January 13, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 93 to IDR 97 per share. This sale reduces his total holdings from 1,281,436,974 shares to 1,274,416,974 shares.

title: Batubara Development Pte. Ltd. Sell Shares of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk
body: Batubara Development Pte. Ltd. sold 3,500,000 shares of PT Singaraja Putra Tbk (SINI.JK). The transactions occurred between January 9 and January 14, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 13,200 to IDR 15,800 per share. This sale reduces Batubara Development Pte. Ltd.'s holding from 78,030,000 shares to 74,530,000 shares. The stated purpose is to increase the number of shares in circulation within the community. This transaction may impact SINI.JK's share price and liquidity.

title: Timothy Utama Buy Shares of PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
body: Timothy Utama acquired 155,000 shares of PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk through an investment transaction on January 9, 2026, at IDR 4,800 per share. This increased his total holdings from 10,334,300 to 10,489,300 shares. The transaction was reported on January 15, 2026, reflecting a minor increase in his stake in the company.

title: Samuel International Stock Lending and Borrowing Shares of PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk
body: Samuel International engaged in stock lending and borrowing for PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk (NSSS.JK). The transaction involved 165,000,000 shares with a representative price of IDR 570 per share, resulting in a total transaction amount of IDR 93,950,000,000. Following the transaction, Samuel International's holdings increased from 1,855,188,500 shares to 2,020,188,500 shares, marking an increase of 165,000,000 shares. This activity is part of stock lending and borrowing operations.

title: Sinergi Asia Corporindo sell Shares of PT Sinergi Multi Lestarindo Tbk
body: Sinergi Asia Corporindo divested 25,842,000 shares of PT Sinergi Multi Lestarindo Tbk (SMLE.JK) on January 13, 2026, at IDR 195 per share. This transaction reduced their holding from 1,677,335,400 to 1,651,493,400 shares, a decrease of 25,842,000 shares. The purpose of this transaction is divestment.

title: Titan Hermawan Sell Shares of PT MNC Digital Entertainment Tbk
body: Titan Hermawan sold 250,000 shares of PT MNC Digital Entertainment Tbk (MSIN.JK) on January 9, 2026, for IDR 418 per share. This transaction reduces his total holdings from 2,426,500 shares to 2,176,500 shares, a decrease of 250,000 shares. The purpose of the transaction was stated as 'Sold'.

title: Dion Amaury Buy Shares of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk
body: Dion Amaury acquired 3,000,000 shares of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk (KMDS.JK) through multiple transactions between January 12, 2026, and January 14, 2026, for investment purposes. The purchases were made at prices ranging from IDR 600 to IDR 635 per share. Following these transactions, Dion Amaury's total holding increased from 654,000 shares to 3,654,000 shares, representing a significant increase in ownership.

title: Anita Anwar Others Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Anita Anwar acquired 27,509,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk for IDR 444 per share, totaling IDR 12,224,076,000. This transaction, classified as 'others', is for the implementation of the MESOP. Following the transaction, Anita Anwar's holdings increased from 2,600 to 27,511,600 shares.

title: PT Jalin Pembayaran Nusantara (Jalin) partners with BPC to expand real-time fraud monitoring
body: PT Jalin Pembayaran Nusantara (Jalin), Indonesia’s national payment systems infrastructure enabler, signed an MOU with technology firm BPC to broaden the use of BPC’s technology for real-time fraud monitoring, aiming to accelerate investigations and enhance risk mitigation for financial institutions on its network. The agreement also establishes a framework for joint development, system enhancements, and long‑term operational alignment.

title: Indonesia targets construction of hundreds of subsidized vertical housing units in 2026
body: Housing Minister Maruarar "Ara" Sirait announced plans to build hundreds of subsidized flats this year and said a new regulation involving developers, state banks and residents will be drafted to set loan terms and pricing. The Public Housing Savings Management Agency (BP Tapera) will work with the Ministry of Finance on financing schemes to address urban housing backlogs.

title: Indonesia's Bango soy sauce signs $120,000 export LOI with Dutch importer InterAromat BV
body: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk’s Bango brand signed a letter of intent with Dutch importer and distributor InterAromat BV at the Horecava 2026 fair, securing a contract worth US$120,000 (about two billion rupiah) to export soy sauce to the Netherlands. The deal is part of the Trade Ministry’s S’RASA program aimed at expanding Indonesian processed‑food products in European markets.

title: Indonesia calls for global investment to develop its underused geothermal potential
body: Deputy Speaker Eddy Soeparno said Indonesia has about 24 GW of geothermal potential but only 10 % is developed, and the government needs roughly US$190 billion to meet its electricity plan, which includes 5.2 GW of new geothermal capacity. He noted regulatory reforms such as updates to the Geothermal Law and renewable‑energy bills aim to attract foreign investors and reduce reliance on energy imports.

title: Indonesia to mandate halal certification for all products starting October 2026
body: Indonesia will enforce mandatory halal certification from October 2026 to strengthen consumer protection and improve the competitiveness of its goods in domestic and international markets, according to Ahmad Haikal Hasan of the Halal Product Assurance Agency (BPJPH). The requirement, grounded in the 2014 Halal Product Assurance Law and a 2024 regulation, targets micro, small and medium enterprises and includes initiatives such as a partnership with market traders and the issuance of 1.35 million free halal certificates in 2026.

title: PT Fore Kopi Indonesia Tbk. (FORE) Reports IPO Fund Utilization as of December 2025
body: PT Fore Kopi Indonesia Tbk. (FORE) reported utilizing Rp101.8 billion, or 30.18%, of its net IPO proceeds of Rp337.19 billion by December 31, 2025. These funds were allocated for new store expansion and capital injection into a subsidiary, with the remaining Rp235.3 billion held in giro at Bank Mandiri.

title: Diamond Citra’s controlling shareholder Karya Permata sells 600 million shares, cutting its stake to 21.5% while maintaining control
body: On 7 January 2026, Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia divested 600 million Diamond Citra shares at Rp 67 each, raising about Rp 40.2 billion and lowering its ownership from 29.6% to 21.53%. The company said the sale is a portfolio‑management move, does not reflect any material information, and does not change the control structure, although the stock later fell to Rp 53 after a brief rally.

title: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd becomes controlling shareholder of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk after 51% stake acquisition
body: Radiant Ruby Company Ltd purchased 630,001,369 shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk for Rp30 per share, amounting to an Rp18.90 billion transaction that gives it a 51% controlling interest. The new owner plans to steer the company toward digital financial asset development and B2B digital finance education.

title: PT Intermedia Capital Tbk (MDIA) reaffirms focus on free‑to‑air TV while reporting higher operating profit despite revenue dip
body: PT Intermedia Capital Tbk (MDIA) confirmed it will continue to concentrate on its core free‑to‑air television business with family‑oriented entertainment, expand digital distribution and add national films and sinetron in 2026. For the nine months ended 30 September 2025, revenue fell to Rp465 billion from Rp483.4 billion, but operating profit surged to Rp97.1 billion from Rp29.9 billion due to lower operating costs.

title: Controlling shareholder PT Sinergi Asia Corporindo sells 25.842 million SMLE shares, reducing its stake to 70.94%
body: On 13 January 2026, PT Sinergi Asia Corporindo, the controlling shareholder of PT Sinergi Multi Lestarindo Tbk. (SMLE), sold 25,842,000 SMLE shares at Rp195 each, generating about Rp5.03 billion and cutting its ownership from 72.05% to 70.94%. After the divestment, SMLE’s share price slipped 2.01% to Rp195, reflecting declines of 13.72% weekly, 19% monthly and 43.35% over the last quarter.

title: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk completes full 100% utilization of its Rp15.73 trillion rights issue, allocating most funds to PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses
body: By 8 January 2026, PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk reported that the entire Rp15.72 trillion net proceeds from its November 2025 rights issue were fully absorbed, with Rp15.12 trillion invested in additional shareholding of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses and the remaining Rp600 billion allocated to PT Panorama Eka Tunggal, PT Cahaya Inti Sentosa and PT Karunia Utama Selaras. Total offering costs amounted to Rp7.5 billion (0.047% of proceeds).

title: PT Astra International Tbk expands rural development impact, reaching 1,500 villages and generating Rp349 bn in export value (2020‑2024)
body: Chief of Corporate Affairs Boy Kelana Soebroto said Astra's Desa Sejahtera Astra and Kampung Berseri Astra programs have reached 1,500 villages across 35 provinces, benefiting 2.63 million people and delivering Rp349 billion in export valuation between 2020 and 2024. The company also supported the 2026 National Village Day in Boyolali by donating three Daihatsu Grand Max Pick‑Up trucks to award‑winning village enterprises.

title: PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA) CEO Andreas Utomo sells another 2.46% of shares, cutting his stake to 4.63%
body: On January 13, 2026, Andreas Utomo sold 26.32 million shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA) at Rp380 each, valued at about Rp10 billion, following a prior sale of 20 million shares on January 12 at Rp306‑Rp312. The transactions reduced his ownership from 7.09% (75.88 million shares) to 4.63% (49.56 million shares), and the stock slipped 0.54% to around Rp370.

title: RMK Energy appoints Edwin Tedjasukmana as director and targets 12.7 million tons of coal logistics in 2026 after adding three new customers
body: RMK Energy (RMKE) held an extraordinary shareholders meeting and approved the appointment of Edwin Tedjasukmana as a director, aiming to strengthen governance and future corporate actions. The company also announced three new customers—PT Wiraduta Sejahtera Langgeng (WSL), PT Duta Bara Utama (DBU), and PT Menambang Muara Enim (MME)—and set a logistics volume target of 12.7 million tons of coal for 2026.

title: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk launches Rp1.5 trillion Sustainable Bond V Phase I 2025, bringing total BEI issuances to seven
body: The new Sustainable Bond V Phase I 2025 by PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk totals Rp1.5 trillion, split into Series A (Rp150 bn at 6.5% for 3 years), Series B (Rp350 bn at 7% for 5 years) and Series C (Rp1 trn at 7.5% for 7 years) with an idAA‑ rating from PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (PEFINDO) and PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk as trustee.
