This issuance raises the number of bond and sukuk offerings recorded on the Indonesia Stock Exchange this year to seven, with a combined value of Rp2.85 trillion.

title: PT Bintang Cahaya Investment Acquires Majority Stake in PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk, Triggering Mandatory Tender Offer
body: PT Bintang Cahaya Investment (BCI) acquired 594,720,000 shares, or 69.69%, of PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk (AYLS) from PT Anugrah Cakrawala Dunia (ACD) for Rp39.85 billion, resulting in a change of control. This transaction obligates BCI to conduct a Mandatory Tender Offer for AYLS's public shares to facilitate business expansion, while AYLS shares surged 24.80% on the news.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. (INCO) Resumes Operations After Securing 2026 RKAB Approval
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. (INCO) has received approval for its 2026 Work Plan and Budget (RKAB) from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, ending the temporary suspension of its mining activities. This approval ensures operational continuity, allows for the gradual resumption of all activities in Sorowako, Pomalaa, and Bahodopi, and supports long-term investments in downstream projects and low-emission technologies.

title: Humpuss Maritim Internasional (HUMI) Appoints New President Director and Management Board
body: Humpuss Maritim Internasional (HUMI) appointed I Gusti Ngurah Askhara Danadiputra as its new President Director, along with a new management board, during an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on January 14, 2026, to refresh the organization and strengthen Good Corporate Governance. The new leadership will focus on healthy revenue growth through synergy, fleet development, sustainable diversification, operational efficiency, and integrating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles.

title: Serial System International Pte. Ltd. Buy Shares of PT Sentral Mitra Informatika Tbk
body: Serial System International Pte. Ltd. acquired 5,000,000 shares of PT Sentral Mitra Informatika Tbk (LUCK.JK) through an investment transaction on January 15, 2026, at IDR 147 per share. This purchase increased their total holdings from 103,084,540 shares to 108,084,540 shares, representing a net increase of 5,000,000 shares. The transaction signifies a strategic investment by Serial System International Pte. Ltd. in LUCK.

title: PT Pos Indonesia launches international cargo service for Indonesian migrant workers, Hajj and Umrah pilgrims
body: PT Pos Indonesia has introduced an international cargo service targeting Indonesian migrant workers and Hajj/Umrah pilgrims, offering air‑freight shipments to Indonesia with relaxed import duties, competitive rates, real‑time tracking and faster delivery. The service currently handles 80‑100 tons per month from Saudi Arabia and leverages the company's nationwide network to ensure customs compliance and secure distribution.

title: Indonesia’s 2026 National Mining Safety Month Highlights Safety as a Strategic Investment and Shows Strong Sector Economic Contributions
body: Director General Tri Winarno opened the 2026 National Mining Safety (K3) Month, emphasizing that mining safety is a long‑term investment protecting workers, assets and industry reputation. He cited the sector’s economic impact, noting non‑tax state revenue reached 104.38% of the 2025 APBN target and 2025 investment totaled US$6.7 billion, and announced the launch of an E‑Catalog of Mining Safety Innovations.

title: Government and Mining Companies Advance Sustainable Post‑Mining Reclamation in Indonesia
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources’ Directorate General (Ditjen Minerba) is overseeing post‑mining and reclamation programs under Kepmen ESDM No. 1827/2018, with active participation from PT Vale Indonesia Tbk and PT Timah Tbk. PT Vale Indonesia’s nursery has produced 700,000 seedlings and reclaimed 3,791.12 ha of its Sorowako mine, while PT Timah is implementing marine reclamation with artificial reefs, mangrove planting and restocking of squid and crabs, involving local fishing communities.

title: Indonesia to pay farmers daily wages to rehabilitate flood-damaged rice fields in Sumatra
body: Indonesia's government will pay farmers daily wages while covering all rehabilitation costs—including seeds, land preparation and irrigation repairs—for flood‑damaged rice fields across Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra, affecting 98,002 hectares. The scheme aims to restore 90‑95% of recoverable fields, starting with 13,708 hectares of lightly and moderately damaged land, to safeguard national rice production.

title: PT Pertamina Hulu Rokan confirms oil discovery at Mustang Hitam-001 well in Riau Province
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Rokan (PHR) announced that production tests at the Mustang Hitam-001 (MTH-001) well in the Rokan Block confirmed hydrocarbons in the Menggala and Pematang URB formations, with modest early output but potential for increased production through further interventions. The well’s proximity to the Oki, Kokoh fields and the Libo Gathering Station supports efficient development in the Central Sumatra Basin.

title: Turkey ends anti-dumping investigation, clearing Indonesia’s cold-rolled stainless steel from duties
body: Turkish authorities concluded the 18-month anti-dumping probe on Indonesian cold-rolled stainless steel flat products on Dec. 27, 2025, finding dumping margins de minimis and imposing no duties. The ruling is expected to boost confidence and support Indonesia’s exports, which grew from $21.9 million in 2020 to $108.6 million in 2024.

title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. reports solid UMKM financing growth to Rp51.78 trillion by November 2025
body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. (BRIS) recorded UMKM financing reaching Rp51.78 trillion through November 2025, with a macro‑prudent inclusive financing ratio of 33.91 % above regulator requirements and serving over 349,710 UMKM clients. The expansion was supported by government initiatives such as MBG, KUR Syariah subsidies, halal certification and the bank’s UMKM Centers, while maintaining prudent risk management amid global macro‑economic challenges.

title: PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk reports near-complete utilization of its IPO proceeds, primarily for subsidiary debt repayment and fleet expansion
body: PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk (ALII) disclosed that of the net IPO proceeds of Rp847.1 billion, Rp635.3 billion was loaned to subsidiary PT MCT to repay debt to OCP Asia Fund IV (SF 1) Pte. Limited and OCP Asia Fund V (SF 1) Pte. Limited, strengthening the group’s capital structure. The remaining funds were spent on capex, including Rp181.4 billion for river barges and Rp30.08 billion for other assets, leaving a balance of Rp215.9 million in a giro account at PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk.

title: Pefindo downgrades PT Pembangunan Perumahan (Persero) Tbk (PTPP) credit rating to idBBB+ with negative outlook
body: Pefindo lowered PT Pembangunan Perumahan (Persero) Tbk (PTPP)'s credit rating and its Sustainable Sukuk I and Sustainable Bonds III and IV to idBBB+ from idA, citing higher refinancing risk and tighter funding in the domestic construction sector, with the nearest debt due on 11 April 2026. PT Pembangunan Perumahan (Persero) Tbk (PTPP) said it remains able to meet obligations and has paid the 11th interest on its 2023 Sustainable Bond III (Rp11.08 billion) and Sustainable Sukuk I (Rp2.79 billion) on 9 January 2026.

title: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk (BWPT) makes Rp180 billion capital injection to PT Manunggal Adi Jaya and approves board reshuffle at extraordinary shareholders’ meeting
body: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk (BWPT) deposited Rp180 billion into its subsidiary PT Manunggal Adi Jaya, a transaction it says has no material impact on its financial or operational condition and involves no conflict of interest. On 7 January 2026, an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting approved the resignation, release and re‑appointment of the board and commissioners, establishing a new lineup that will serve until the 2030 annual general meeting.

title: PT Garuda Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (GIAA) fully deploys funds raised from 2022 rights issue
body: The airline raised Rp7.79 trillion through its 2022 PUT II rights issue, netting Rp7.77 trillion after fees, and by Dec 31 2025 had allocated the entire amount to fleet maintenance and restoration (Rp3.6 trillion), maintenance reserve (Rp900 billion), fuel purchases (Rp1.73 trillion), restructuring costs (Rp370 billion) and working capital (Rp275.88 billion).

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk reports rights‑issue fund usage, with Rp107.6 billion still pending for land acquisition
body: The company raised Rp600.44 billion from its November 2025 rights issue, of which Rp492.83 billion has been deployed—Rp416.23 billion for acquiring PT Bukit Permai Properti shares and Rp76.60 billion for capital participation in PT Bukit Bali Permai. The remaining Rp107.60 billion earmarked for land purchase and development remains unspent as of 31 December 2025.

title: PT Gozco Capital increases stake in PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk (BBYB) to 9.31% after buying 207 million shares
body: On 15 January 2026, PT Gozco Capital purchased 207 million BBYB shares at Rp474 each, valuing the transaction at roughly Rp98.12 billion and raising its ownership to 9.31% of PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk (BBYB). The acquisition was followed by a 5.49% rise in BBYB’s share price, closing at Rp500.

title: PT RMK Energy Tbk Attributes Revenue and Operational Cash Flow Decline to Weak Coal Sales and Global Economic Factors
body: PT RMK Energy Tbk (RMKE) reported a decline in revenue to Rp1.12 trillion from Rp1.75 trillion and an operational cash flow deficit of Rp65 billion as of September 30, 2025, primarily due to weak coal sales driven by lower prices and decreased demand from China. In response, RMKE plans to increase domestic coal sales, boost coal transportation volume through its hauling road, and manage liquidity conservatively to improve future performance.

title: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk. (RATU) Fully Utilizes IPO Funds and Records Significant Stock Rally.
body: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk. (RATU) announced the full realization of its Rp212.23 billion net IPO funds by December 31, 2025, with major allocations including Rp157.3 billion to PT Raharja Energi Tanjung Jabung and Rp34.9 billion to PT Petrogas Jatim Utama Cendana. Since its IPO on January 8, 2025, RATU's shares have surged 654.35% to Rp8,675 as of January 15, 2025.

title: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) Distributes Rp9.3 Trillion Interim Dividend for 2025 Financial Year
body: Bank Mandiri (BMRI) distributed an interim dividend of Rp9.3 trillion (Rp100 per share) for the 2025 financial year on January 14, 2026, reflecting its solid fundamentals, strong liquidity, and consistent performance. This payout, which also serves as a contribution to the state via its largest shareholder Danantara Indonesia, is supported by robust financial performance including Rp1,452 trillion in credit, Rp1,584 trillion in DPK, and Rp2,120 trillion in total assets as of November 2025.

title: PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk. (TOWR) Executives Accumulate Shares via MESOP Below Market Price
body: Two executives of PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk. (TOWR), Anita Anwar and Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo, significantly increased their shareholdings by executing Management and Employee Stock Option Program (MESOP) on January 14, 2026. They collectively accumulated 63,116,000 shares at Rp444 per share, totaling approximately Rp28.02 billion, which was below the market closing price of Rp550 per share.

title: Gozco Capital Increases Stake in Bank Neo (BBYB) to 9.31% After Acquiring 207 Million Shares
body: Gozco Capital acquired 207 million shares of Bank Neo (BBYB) for Rp98.11 billion at Rp474 per share on January 15, 2026. This transaction increased Gozco Capital's ownership in Bank Neo to 1.03 billion shares, representing 9.31%, up from 7.76% previously.

title: Astra International (ASII) Announces Rp2 Trillion Share Buyback Program
body: Astra International (ASII) has allocated Rp2 trillion for a share buyback program, scheduled from January 19, 2026, to February 25, 2026, using internal funds. This initiative aims to stabilize share prices and provide investor confidence, though it will reduce the company's assets and equity by a maximum of Rp2 trillion.

title: Director of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk. (KMDS) Dion Amaury Increases Shareholding by Accumulating 3 Million Shares
body: Dion Amaury, Director of PT Kurniamitra Duta Sentosa Tbk. (KMDS), acquired a total of 3,000,000 shares in two transactions on January 12 and 14, 2026, with an investment value of approximately Rp1.8 billion. This accumulation increased his direct ownership in KMDS from 654,000 shares (0.08%) to 3,654,000 shares (0.46%) of the total outstanding shares.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange records nine bond and sukuk issuances totalling Rp5.85 trillion in early 2026
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) completed nine bond and sukuk issuances from seven issuers—including Eagle High Plantations, Summarecon Agung, Energi Mega Persada, Chandra Asri Pacific, Permodalan Nasional Madani (PNM), Bank UOB Indonesia, and Bank Aladin Syariah—raising Rp5.85 trillion. BEI also has ten additional issuances from five issuers in the pipeline, while total market figures stand at 665 issuances with Rp542.85 trillion outstanding.

title: Bank Mandiri deploys full proceeds of Rp5 trillion sustainable bond to expand credit within one month
body: Bank Mandiri received net proceeds of Rp4.97 trillion from its Rp5 trillion sustainable bond issued on 22 December 2025, after deducting Rp33.68 billion in issuance costs, and will allocate the entire amount to credit expansion and ESG‑aligned projects. The bank aims to absorb the funds within a year in line with POJK 18/2023 to support broader economic impact and financial sector resilience.

title: Bank Neo Commerce reports full utilization of 2021 rights issue proceeds
body: Bank Neo Commerce confirmed that the entire Rp2.5 trillion raised in its 2021 rights issue has been spent, allocating Rp681.45 billion to IT development and Rp375.41 billion to strengthen its Minimum Capital Provision (KPMM) ratio. The bank indicated that the remaining funds have been fully deployed as planned.

title: Serial System International Pte Ltd Increases Stake in Sentral Mitra Informatika (LUCK) to 15.10%
body: On 15 January 2026 Serial System International Pte Ltd purchased an additional 5 million shares of Sentral Mitra Informatika (LUCK) at Rp147 per share, raising its holding to 108.08 million shares (15.10% of the company) and spending Rp735 million. The previous day it sold 10.7 million shares at Rp168 each, generating Rp1.79 billion, and as of 31 December 2025 the main shareholders were Serial System (15.9%), Josephine Handayani (14.6%), Christine Herawati (14.6%), Caroline Himawati (29.2%) and the public (25.7%).

title: Indokripto Koin Semesta (COIN) leaves IPO proceeds of Rp207 billion idle in deposits and giro accounts
body: The company has kept the Rp207 billion raised from its July 9, 2025 IPO in short‑term deposits (Rp30 billion at 5% annual) and a giro account (Rp177.05 billion at 6% annual), with none of the planned allocations to CFX and ICC capital work realized. The IPO originally targeted 85% of funds for CFX infrastructure and liquidity provisions and 15% for ICC, but these allocations have not been executed.

title: TBS Energi Utama (TOBA) to Issue IDR 500 billion Sustainable Bonds in Three Tranches
body: TBS Energi Utama (TOBA) will issue IDR 500 billion of sustainable bonds in three series (A: IDR 100 bn at 7.25% for 3 years, B: IDR 175 bn at 8% for 5 years, C: IDR 225 bn at 8.65% for 7 years) as part of an IDR 800 bn target program, with interest paid quarterly starting 22 April 2026. Proceeds of approximately IDR 400.93 bn will refinance a 2023 Series A bond, IDR 46.39 bn will be invested as capital in Trisensa Mineral Utama (TMU) for coal‑mining working capital, and the balance will support general corporate purposes; the offering is scheduled for 15‑23 January 2026.

title: Batubara Development sells 3.5 million Singararaja Putra shares, raising Rp50.75 billion and sees the stock jump 9.9% to Rp17,475
body: Batubara Development divested 3.5 million shares of Singararaja Putra (SINI) between 9 and 14 January 2026 at prices of Rp13,200‑15,800 per share, generating approximately Rp50.75 billion and leaving it with a 16.22% stake. Following the transaction and a purchase by Petrindo Jaya Kreasi (CUAN), Singararaja Putra’s share price rose 9.91% to Rp17,475.

title: Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BBRI) sells 115 million treasury shares, generating Rp531.94 billion
body: BBRI transferred 115,037,300 treasury shares at an average price of Rp4,624.1 per share, raising Rp531.94 billion, with BRI Danareksa facilitating the transaction. The sale follows a 2022‑2023 buyback program that repurchased 647.38 million shares, of which 532.34 million remain unallocated.

title: Pertamina Energy (PGEO) absorbs 57.4% of its IDR 8.77 trillion IPO proceeds, allocating funds to capex, digital projects and debt repayment
body: Pertamina Energy (PGEO) has used IDR 5.03 trillion (57.39%) of the net IDR 8.77 trillion raised, directing the bulk to capital‑expenditure projects, a digital‑analytics initiative and full repayment of a facilities agreement, while the remaining IDR 3.73 trillion is placed with Bank Mandiri at a 4.31% quarterly interest rate. The IPO grossed IDR 9.05 trillion before deducting IDR 283.1 billion in offering costs.

title: Garuda Multi Investama buy Shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk.
body: Garuda Multi Investama acquired 50,000,000 shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk. (BOLT.JK) for IDR 1,000 per share, totaling IDR 50,000,000,000. This transaction, classified as an addition of operator shares, increased Garuda Multi Investama's total holdings from 1,395,000,000 to 1,445,000,000 shares. The acquisition reflects a strategic increase in the company's stake in PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk.

title: Rudi R Sutantra Sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold 4,508,100 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK). The transaction occurred on December 24, 2025, at a price of IDR 61.00 per share. This sale reduced Mr. Sutantra's holdings from 2,988,462,300 shares to 2,983,954,200 shares, a decrease of 4,508,100 shares. The purpose of the transaction was not specified.

title: Glencore International Investment sells 224.5 million Trimegah Persada (NCKL) shares in six transactions, cutting its stake to 6.74%
body: Between 6 and 14 January 2026, Glencore International Investment disposed of a total of 224.48 million Trimegah Persada (NCKL) shares in six trades brokered by Citibank NA, reducing its holding to 4.25 billion shares (6.74% of the company) and valuing the sales at roughly Rp297 billion. During the same period Trimegah Persada’s share price rose 0.71% to Rp1,420, up about 21.9% year‑to‑date, while foreign investors sold Rp116.87 billion of the stock.

title: Jaya Sukses Makmur (RISE) to issue 5.25 billion bonus shares worth Rp525.36 billion
body: The company will distribute a 25:12 bonus‑share ratio, equivalent to 48 new shares for each lot, based on a total of 5.25 billion shares with a nominal value of Rp100 each, amounting to Rp525.36 billion. The bonus‑share schedule follows the 2024 fiscal‑year results and includes dividend record dates from 19‑22 January 2026 and the actual distribution on 9 February 2026.

title: OJK grants principle approval for PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk to spin off its Islamic Business Unit and establish PT Bank CIMB Niaga Syariah
body: OJK issued a principle approval on 14 January 2026 for PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk to separate its Unit Usaha Syariah (UUS) and form a new Islamic commercial bank, PT Bank CIMB Niaga Syariah, following shareholder approval on 26 June 2025. The spin‑off, required by POJK No.12/2023, is expected to strengthen the bank’s Islamic business focus without affecting its current operations or financial condition.

title: PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk obtains Rp15 billion credit top‑up, increasing total loan facility to Rp65 billion
body: On 15 January 2026, PT Mutuagung Lestari Tbk added a Rp15 billion top‑up to its existing Rp50 billion credit facility, extending the loan to a total ceiling of Rp65 billion with a 36‑month tenor. The company said the funds will support working‑capital needs, inventory and service expansion, and expects the financing to boost liquidity and earnings despite creating principal and interest obligations.

title: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk. reports 20.96% of buyback treasury shares transferred as of 31 December 2025
body: As of 31 December 2025, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk. (MDKA) had transferred 14,871,800 of its 70,953,500 buyback treasury shares, representing roughly 20.96% of the total. The remaining 56,081,700 shares are retained for future strategic uses such as MESOP, bonus allocations, and capital‑structure strengthening.

title: PT Indoritel Makmur Internasional Tbk. obtains shareholder approval to pledge assets for a up to Rp450 billion loan from PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk.
body: Shareholders representing 99.54% of voting rights approved at the extraordinary general meeting on 14 January 2026 to use the company's bonds and customer fund accounts as collateral for a term loan facility with PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk., providing a maximum credit of Rp450 billion split into two Rp225 billion tranches with five- and seven‑year terms. The pledge aims to enhance funding flexibility and support DNET’s future investment expansion.

title: Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk Buy Shares of Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk
body: Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk has acquired 7,800,000 shares of its own stock at IDR 575 per share, totaling IDR 4,485,000,000. This transaction, classified as an investment, increases the company's treasury stock. Following this, Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk's direct holding in the company has risen from 465,158,700 shares to 472,958,700 shares, representing an increase of 7,800,000 shares.

title: PT Pancaran Samudera Transport Tbk. completes full deployment of its IPO proceeds for fleet expansion
body: PT Pancaran Samudera Transport Tbk. (PSAT) reported net IPO proceeds of Rp193.27 billion received on 30 June 2025, which have been fully allocated—Rp175 billion for new vessels and Rp18.28 billion for fuel—in line with its prospectus. As of 15 January 2026 the stock trades around Rp1,230 per share, above the IPO price of Rp900 but below the 52‑week high of Rp3,410.

title: PT Gema Buana Indonesia reduces its stake in PT Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk to below 10%
body: PT Gema Buana Indonesia sold 31.25 million shares of PT Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk, cutting its ownership from 11.73% to 9.98% and valuing the transaction at about Rp99.38 billion based on the closing price of Rp3,180 per share. The shares were sold through PT INA Sekuritas Indonesia, and the stock closed at Rp3,250 on Jan 15, up 2.2%.

title: PT Pelayaran Jaya Hidup Baru Tbk utilizes 20% of IPO proceeds for LCT construction, with remaining funds held at PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk
body: PT Pelayaran Jaya Hidup Baru Tbk (PJHB) has spent Rp25.8 billion, about 20% of its Rp154.5 billion IPO proceeds, on projects through Dec 31 2025, while the remaining Rp128.73 billion stays invested at PT Bank Capital Indonesia Tbk (BACA) earning 7% per annum. The IPO proceeds are earmarked for building three new 2,500‑DWT Landing Craft Tank vessels in partnership with PT Untung Brawijaya Sejahtera and PT Adiluhung Saranasegara Indonesia, with the Rp163 billion total cost to be covered by the IPO funds and PJHB’s internal cash.

title: UBS AG cuts its stake in PT Bisi International Tbk to 5.3% after two January 2026 share sales
body: UBS AG sold 25 million shares of PT Bisi International Tbk on 9 January 2026 and another 25 million on 13 January 2026, amounting to an estimated transaction value of roughly Rp44.38 billion. After the sales, UBS's holding fell to 158.9 million shares (5.3%), indicating a cumulative divestment of about 87.2 million shares, far exceeding the disclosed transactions.

title: Rudi R Sutantra Sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold 3,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK). The transaction occurred on December 15, 2025, at a price of IDR 67.0 per share. Following the sale, Mr. Sutantra's holdings decreased from 2,991,462,300 shares to 2,988,462,300 shares, representing a reduction of 3,000,000 shares. The purpose of this transaction was not specified in the filing.

title: PT Samuel International Increases Ownership in PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk. (NSSS) Amidst Share Suspension
body: PT Samuel International acquired an additional 165,000,000 shares of PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk. (NSSS) for Rp94.05 billion at Rp570 per share on January 13, 2026, increasing its stake to 8.50% from 7.80% for share lending purposes. This crossing transaction occurred while NSSS shares were suspended at Rp1,250, with the transaction price significantly below the market suspension level.

title: Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk Buy Shares of Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk
body: Panorama Sentrawisata Tbk acquired 7,800,000 shares of its own company at IDR 575 per share, totaling IDR 4,485,000,000. This investment increases its holdings from 465,158,700 to 472,958,700 shares. The transaction is intended as an investment.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold 3,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK). This transaction decreased his total holdings from 2,991,462,300 shares to 2,988,462,300 shares. The sale occurred on December 15, 2025, at a price of IDR 67.0 per share. The purpose of the transaction was not specified.

title: Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk Sell Shares of PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk
body: Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk divested 750,000 shares of PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk (NRCA.JK) on January 14, 2026, at IDR 1,218 per share. This transaction resulted in Saratoga's stake decreasing from 150,162,700 shares to 149,412,700 shares, a reduction of 750,000 shares. The stated purpose for this transaction is divestment.

title: Rudi R Sutantra Sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold 20,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK). The transactions occurred on December 12, 2025, with prices ranging from IDR 65.0 to IDR 66.0 per share. Following the sale, Sutantra's holding decreased from 3,011,462,300 shares to 2,991,462,300 shares. The purpose of the transaction was not specified.

title: Rudi R Sutantra Sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold a total of 20,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK). The transactions occurred on December 12, 2025, with sales at IDR 66.0 and IDR 65.0 per share. Following the sale, his holdings decreased from 301,146,2300 shares to 299,146,2300 shares. The specific purpose of the transaction was not disclosed in the filing. This represents a reduction in Rudi R Sutantra's stake in the company.

title: Turniady Widjaja Buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja acquired 5,000 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK) between January 12 and January 15, 2026, for investment purposes. The transactions involved multiple buys at prices ranging from IDR 13,350 to IDR 16,900 per share. This acquisition increased Mr. Widjaja's total holdings from 50,394,600 shares to 50,399,600 shares, representing a minor increase in his stake in the company.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Buy Shares of Barito Pacific Tbk
body: Prajogo Pangestu acquired 3,000,000 shares of Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT.JK) for an undisclosed price, stated as an investment. This transaction increases his total holdings from 66,898,030,165 to 66,901,030,165 shares. The purchase occurred on January 15, 2026, and was reported on January 19, 2026.

title: Bayan Resources Tbk Buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On January 15, 2026, an investment transaction involved the purchase of 2,700 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) at IDR 17,131.0 per share. This acquisition increased the total holdings to 13,406,877,070 shares from a previous 13,406,874,370 shares, representing a net increase of 2,700 shares. The purpose of this transaction is stated as investment. This indicates a minor increase in stake by an unspecified holder within the company.

title: Drs Mahirudin Sell Shares of PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk
body: Drs. Mahirudin sold 500,000 shares of PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk (TLDN.JK) on December 18, 2025, at IDR 700 per share, totaling IDR 350,000,000. This transaction reduces his direct holding from 500,000 shares to zero. The purpose stated is for share sales. This represents a complete divestment of his direct stake in the company.

title: Andreas Utomo Sell Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
body: Andreas Utomo divested 20,000,000 shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK) on January 15, 2026, at IDR 250 per share. This transaction reduces his total holdings from 49,556,400 to 29,556,400 shares, a decrease of 20,000,000 shares. The purpose of this transaction is noted as divestment.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: Prajogo Pangestu acquired 3,500,000 shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on January 15, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 1,850 to IDR 1,900 per share. Following the purchase, Prajogo Pangestu's total holdings increased from 94,517,650,000 to 94,521,150,000 shares. This represents a net increase of 3,500,000 shares in his stake.

title: Rudi R Sutantra Sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK) at IDR 60.0 per share on December 5, 2025. This transaction reduces his holding from 3,021,462,300 shares to 3,011,462,300 shares, a decrease of 10,000,000 shares. The purpose of the transaction was not disclosed.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional Sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional has divested 59,375,000 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk (WINR.JK). This transaction results in a decrease in their holdings from 3,730,000,000 to 3,670,625,000 shares. The divestment was executed on January 13, 2026, with a total transaction value of IDR 3,800,000,000, indicating a representative price of approximately IDR 64 per share. This move signifies a reduction in the entity's stake in the company.

title: Proinvestindo Sell Shares of PT Tunas Alfin Tbk
body: Proinvestindo divested 60,100 shares of PT Tunas Alfin Tbk (TALF.JK). The transaction occurred on January 15, 2026, with a total value of IDR 44,376,653.00, averaging IDR 738.38 per share. Following this sale, Proinvestindo's holding decreased from 1,239,986,500 shares to 1,239,926,400 shares, representing a reduction of 60,100 shares. This divestment signifies a decrease in Proinvestindo's stake in the company.

title: Ario Wibisono Others Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Ario Wibisono acquired 8,540,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) for IDR 444 per share, totaling IDR 3,797,760,000. This transaction, described as 'others' and related to the implementation of MESOP, increased his holdings from 241,655,800 to 250,195,800 shares. The acquisition represents a change in his direct ownership stake in the company.

title: Kenny Harjo others Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Kenny Harjo acquired 8,540,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) through the implementation of MESOP at a price of IDR 444 per share. This transaction increased his total holdings from 0 to 8,540,000 shares, representing his initial stake in the company acquired via the MESOP program.

title: Ferdinandus Aming Santoso Others Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Ferdinandus Aming Santoso acquired 95,156,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) at IDR 444 per share, totaling IDR 42,229,584,000. This transaction, conducted on January 14, 2026, is an implementation of the MESOP. His holdings increased from 12,613,281 to 107,769,281 shares, reflecting a significant rise in his stake.

title: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono Sell Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono divested 1,500,000 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk (MAXI.JK) at IDR 53.0 per share. This transaction reduces his direct holding from 14,068,700 shares to 12,568,700 shares, a decrease of 1,500,000 shares. The stated purpose for this sale is investment. The transaction took place on January 15, 2026.

title: Putra Borneo Agro Lestari Buy Shares of PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk
body: Putra Borneo Agro Lestari acquired 122,905,000 shares of PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk for IDR 1545 per share, totaling IDR 189,889,975,000. This transaction increases their holding from 965,196,485 to 1,088,101,485 shares. The purpose is listed as the purchase of shares.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: Prajogo Pangestu acquired 3,500,000 shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred on January 15, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 1,850 to IDR 1,900 per share. Following the purchase, Prajogo Pangestu's total holdings increased by 3,500,000 shares to 94,521,150,000 shares, representing an increase from 94,517,650,000 shares.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk.
body: Prajogo Pangestu acquired 1,000,000 shares of PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk. (BREN.JK) for personal investment purposes. The transactions occurred on January 15, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 9,525 to IDR 9,675 per share. Following the purchase, Prajogo Pangestu's total holdings increased from 139,789,700 to 140,789,700 shares.

title: Indonesia’s 2025 Minerba Policies Aim to Balance State Oversight, Industry Growth, and Social‑Environmental Goals
body: In 2025 the Directorate General of Minerals and Coal tightened licensing, reclamation compliance, shifted RKAB planning to annual cycles, curbed illegal mining and promoted domestic market obligations to reinforce state stewardship of mineral resources while supporting investment and value‑addition. The government also expanded participation of cooperatives, UMKMs and regional BUMDs, positioning the policies as a constitutional effort to ensure resource wealth benefits the current and future population.

title: Indonesia's BPJPH coordinates agencies ahead of mandatory halal certification rollout in October 2026
body: The Halal Product Assurance Agency (BPJPH) is working with the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Investment and the National Committee for Islamic Economy and Finance (KNEKS) to ready the mandatory halal certification program set to begin on October 18, 2026, under the 2014 Halal Product Assurance Law and Government Regulation No. 4 of 2024. The agency says the requirement will protect consumers, build trust and help micro‑ and small‑enterprise competitiveness in domestic and global markets.

title: Indonesia to grant zero‑percent export tariffs on tuna and skipjack products to Japan under amended IJEPA
body: The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries will help fish processing units obtain zero‑percent tariff registration for tuna, cakalang and tongkol exports to Japan, eliminating the previous 9.6% duty. Indonesia, currently the third‑largest canned tuna exporter to Japan with $30.28 million value and a 13.82% CAGR, aims to become the top supplier.

title: Astrindo (BIPI) targets Q2 2026 start‑up of mini LNG plant in East Java to diversify from coal to clean energy
body: Astrindo (BIPI) plans to commission a mini LNG plant in East Java by the second quarter of 2026, aiming to capture rising gas demand in the region and generate sustainable revenue. The move is part of a strategic shift away from declining coal earnings amid falling international coal prices and intensifying global competition.

title: Merdeka Resources (EMAS) allocates 93.7% of its Rp4.25 trillion net IPO proceeds to capital deposits, loan, debt repayment and bank deposits
body: Merdeka Resources (EMAS) absorbed Rp4.25 trillion net IPO proceeds, representing 93.7% of the total, with USD20 million each (Rp329.2 billion) earmarked for a capital‑deposit advance to Pani Bersama Tambang (PBT) and a loan to Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera (PETS). The bulk of the funds, about Rp3.88 trillion (86%), will be used to pre‑pay Merdeka Copper Gold (MDKA) debt, while the remaining Rp292.11 billion is placed in bank deposits at Bank HSBC and Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BBRI) earning 4‑5% interest until the end of 2025.

title: Triniti Properti (TRIN) raises Rp27.32 billion via discounted share transfer to Kunci Daud Indonesia and Intan Investama Internasional
body: On 13 January 2026, Triniti Properti (TRIN) completed a tactical fund‑raising of Rp27.32 billion by transferring 136.6 million shares at Rp200 each, a 87.42 % discount to the closing price of Rp1,590. The transaction, facilitated by Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia, left Kunci Daud Indonesia with 35.78 % and Intan Investama Internasional with 27.28 % of TRIN’s shares, while Rahayu Saraswati’s related entities now hold about five percent.

title: Chandra Asri Pacific (TPIA) allocates the net Rp15.49 trillion right‑issue proceeds to term deposits and securities at DBS Singapore, BRI and BNI
body: Chandra Asri Pacific (TPIA) has deposited the net Rp15.49 trillion raised from its right issue in term deposits at Bank DBS Singapore (USD, 3.37% p.a., 1‑year) and in rupiah deposits at Bank BRI (BBRI) and Bank BNI (BBNI) (3.5‑5.25% p.a., 1‑month), while also investing in USD‑ and IDR‑denominated securities yielding 1.5‑6.25% and 2‑8.38% per annum over 1‑7 years. The funds, intended to finance the new integrated petrochemical complex Chandra Asri Perkasa 2 (CAP‑2), are net of Rp6.89 billion in offering costs.

title: Teka-teki Triniti Dinamik alias True Land (TRUE) sets extraordinary shareholders meeting for Feb 25 2026 to approve a 757.11 million‑share private placement
body: The company announced that its extraordinary shareholders meeting will be held on 25 February 2026 at The Langham, Sudirman Central Business District, with shareholders recorded as of 2 February 2026 eligible to vote on the approval of a private placement of 757,110,786 shares (757.11 million) at a nominal value of Rp25, representing up to 10 % of the issued capital. The placement is expected to increase assets by 8.86 % and equity by 10.04 %, raise total paid‑in capital to 8.32 billion shares, and will fund working‑capital needs, general operations and project development, while absent shareholders face a 9.09 % dilution.

title: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. Buys Shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk
body: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. acquired shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred between January 14, 2026, and January 19, 2026, with an average price of approximately IDR 1,077 per share. The total amount transacted was IDR 362,716,600. Following these purchases, A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd.'s stake increased from 3,398,682,495 shares to 3,761,399,095 shares, marking a significant addition to their holdings.

title: Vina Nauli Jordania Sell Shares of PT Sumber Mas Konstruksi Tbk
body: Vina Nauli Jordania divested 300,000 shares of PT Sumber Mas Konstruksi Tbk (SMKM.JK) on January 15, 2026, at a price of IDR 37.0 per share. This transaction reduced her total holdings from 1,367,500 shares to 1,067,500 shares, marking a decrease of 300,000 shares. The purpose stated is 'Divestment Through'.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange reports at least one conglomerate and seven firms preparing IPOs, alongside growing bond and rights‑issue activity in early 2026
body: BEI said a conglomerate is in its IPO radar, and seven companies—five with assets over Rp250 billion, one medium‑sized and one small—are slated for listings across sectors such as basic materials, finance, energy, industry, technology, and transport. In the same period, nine debt issuances raised Rp5.85 trillion, ten more are pending, and three rights issues have generated Rp2.90 trillion.

title: PT Archi Indonesia Tbk spends $10 million on 2025 gold exploration at Toka Tindung Mine, reporting Q3 profit surge
body: In 2025, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI) invested about USD 10 million in gold exploration at the Toka Tindung Mine, completing 397 drill points and 85,893 m of drilling through its subsidiaries PT Meares Soputan Mining (MSM) and PT Tambang Tondano Nusajaya (TTN), with high‑grade intervals up to 26.57 g/t. The company posted a Q3 net profit of USD 70.47 million, up from a loss a year earlier, and its gold production rose 23% to 90,000 koz, supporting total equity of USD 343.95 million.

title: Indonesia prepares community mining permit regulations to curb illegal mining activities
body: Deputy Chair of Commission VI Andre Rosiade announced that the government will draft rules for community mining permits (IPR), including the designation of Mining Areas (WP) and Community Mining Areas (WPR), allowing cooperatives up to 10 hectares and individuals up to 5 hectares to mine legally. West Sumatra Governor Mahyeldi also reported mapping of illegal mining hotspots in several districts for enforcement.

title: PT Kencana Energi Lestari Tbk signs $25 million PPA with PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara for 10 MW solar plant in Tobelo
body: PT Kencana Energi Lestari Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Energi Surya Halmahera, signed a Power Purchase Agreement with PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara on 19 January 2026 to build and operate a 10 MW solar power plant with 8.4 MWh battery storage in Tobelo, valued at about US$ 25 million. Construction revenue is projected at US$ 13.8 million, and once the plant becomes commercially operational in Q1 2027 it is expected to generate roughly US$ 1.6 million of annual electricity sales under a 20‑year contract.

title: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) reports billion‑rupiah revenue from hybrid Brian McKnight concert
body: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) generated billions of rupiah in revenue from the sold‑out hybrid Brian McKnight concert at Balai Sarbini, which attracted over 1,300 offline attendees and 48,000 viewers via TikTok LIVE and combined physical tickets, paid digital ticketing and sponsorships. The company plans to replicate the model with a Westlife concert on 8 February 2026 in Surabaya, emphasizing scalable hybrid revenue and recurring income.

title: Arfindi A Batubara Buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Arfindi A Batubara acquired 31,100 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) for investment strategy purposes. The transaction increased his holdings from 159,700 to 190,800 shares. The average purchase price was approximately IDR 160 per share.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk reports USD 3.20 million Q4 2025 exploration and production spending across five subsidiaries
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) spent a total of USD 3.20 million (IDR 53.76 billion) on exploration and production activities in the fourth quarter of 2025 through its five subsidiaries. PT Citra Palu Minerals allocated USD 747,040.10 for gold exploration in Sulawesi, PT Dairi Prima Mineral recorded USD 21,275.86 in production costs with no exploration, PT Gorontalo Minerals spent USD 1,817,796.70 on gold and copper production and drilling, PT Linge Mineral Resources used USD 338,794.52 for gold exploration, and PT Suma Heksa Sinergi incurred USD 277,009.01 for gold and silver production operations.

title: Indonesia and UK sign Economic Growth Partnership during President Prabowo's visit
body: Indonesia's Coordinating Economic Affairs Minister Airlangga Hartarto and UK Secretary of State for Business and Trade Peter Kyle signed an Economic Growth Partnership in London, targeting deeper cooperation in clean energy, digital economy, infrastructure, transport, education and health, while addressing non‑tariff barriers and encouraging larger two‑way investment. The agreement was part of President Prabowo Subianto's official visit, which also includes meetings with British Prime Minister Keir Starmer and King Charles III.

title: Amir Sunarko Buys Shares of PT SLJ Global Tbk
body: Amir Sunarko acquired 28,267,003 shares of PT SLJ Global Tbk (SULI.JK), increasing his total holdings from 293,467,104 to 321,734,107 shares. The transactions occurred on January 15, 2026, with purchase prices ranging from IDR 105.0 to IDR 148.0 per share. This acquisition, despite some concurrent sales, signifies an increase in direct ownership by Amir Sunarko in the company.

title: Turniady Widjaja Buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja acquired 500 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK) through a series of buy transactions on January 19, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 15,500 to IDR 16,200 per share. The total number of shares transacted was 500, increasing his holdings from 50,399,600 to 50,400,100 shares. This investment activity represents a minor increase in his stake in the company.

title: Indonesia targets Rp134 trillion in mineral and coal revenue for 2026 despite planned production cuts
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources set a 2026 revenue target of Rp134 trillion (about US$7.9 billion) from minerals and coal, up from Rp124.7 trillion for 2025, citing rising prices for tin, nickel, gold and other commodities. At the same time, the government plans to cut coal output to about 600 million tons and reduce nickel production to help stabilise global commodity markets.

title: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja Buy Shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk
body: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja acquired 44,800 shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk (ULTJ.JK) for business purposes. The transaction, executed on January 15, 2026, at IDR 1,450 per share, increased his total holdings from 135,737,560 to 135,782,360 shares. This represents a net increase of 44,800 shares.

title: Indonesia seeks to become a global coffee hub and explore a role in setting world coffee prices
body: Trade Minister Budi Santoso announced that Indonesia will take steps to position itself as a global coffee hub following a proposal from the Indonesian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Kadin), while noting that any move to influence coffee pricing will be examined carefully and coordinated with international stakeholders. The government plans to strengthen ties with global coffee forums to build credibility and promote Indonesian coffee varieties such as Arabica, Robusta and Luwak.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional Sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional divested 2,854,000 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk, reducing its holdings from 367,062,500 to 364,208,500. The transaction occurred on January 14, 2026, at a price of IDR 70 per share. This divestment represents a strategic move by the shareholder.

title: Indonesia earmarks Rp40 trillion to accelerate downstream processing of coconuts, cocoa and cashews and raise farmers' incomes
body: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman announced a Rp40 trillion (US$2.3 billion) budget for district governments to develop downstream industries for coconuts, cashew nuts, cocoa and other commodities, citing the success of coconut processing in North Maluku. He noted that while raw coconut exports are worth about Rp24 trillion, processing could lift export value to as much as Rp896 trillion.

title: Turniady Widjaja Bought Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja acquired 500 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK) through a series of buy transactions on January 19, 2026, with prices ranging from IDR 15,500 to IDR 16,200 per share. This purchase increases his total holdings from 50,399,600 to 50,400,100 shares. The stated purpose is investment. This transaction represents a minor increase in his stake within the company.

title: PT PP Tbk (PTPP) reports Rp 24.95 trillion new contract wins for 2025 and a rating downgrade to idBBB+ by Pefindo
body: PT PP Tbk (PTPP) secured Rp 24.95 trillion in new contracts for 2025, down from Rp 27.09 trillion in 2024, with 45% from government projects and the building segment contributing the most (35%). Pefindo downgraded PTPP's rating to idBBB+ with a negative outlook, but the company said it remains able to meet its obligations, having paid a Rp 11.08 billion coupon and Rp 2.78 billion sukuk interest in January 2026.

title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk Buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: PT Bayan Resources Tbk acquired 8,100 shares of its own stock for investment purposes. The transaction, executed at an undisclosed price on January 19, 2026, increased its total holdings from 13,406,877,070 to 13,406,885,170 shares. This buyback activity, though small relative to total shares, indicates a potential signal of management's confidence in the company's valuation.

title: Nanotech Investama Sedaya Sell Shares of PT Nanotech Indonesia Global Tbk
body: Nanotech Investama Sedaya sold 214,272,013 shares of PT Nanotech Indonesia Global Tbk (NANO.JK) at IDR 55 per share. The transaction, aimed at strengthening the company's shareholder structure, reduced Nanotech Investama Sedaya's holdings from 2,400,000,000 to 2,185,727,987 shares. This represents a decrease of 214,272,013 shares.

title: PT Agung Podomoro Land Tbk sells Mall Deli Park for Rp 2.44 trillion to PT DPM Assets Indonesia
body: PT Agung Podomoro Land Tbk (APLN) disclosed that its subsidiary PT Sinar Menara Deli (58% owned by APLN) sold Mall Deli Park to PT DPM Assets Indonesia for Rp 2.44 trillion, with payment made in full at signing and proceeds earmarked for deleveraging (Rp 252 billion to Bank Maybank Indonesia and Rp 400 billion to Bank Danamon Indonesia), capital strengthening and a Balikpapan development project. The transaction was viewed positively by the market, lifting APLN’s share price by about 64% over the past month.

title: Indonesia to mandate 1% SAF blend on international flights from 2026, aiming for 5% by 2029
body: The Indonesian government plans to require a 1% sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) blend on international flights starting in 2026, with a phased increase to 5% by 2029 and a longer‑term roadmap to 2035, pending a draft regulation. A recent commercial test using 2.4% palm‑kernel‑oil‑based SAF was successfully flown on a Boeing 737‑800 NG owned by PT Garuda Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, highlighting the technical readiness amid concerns that higher SAF costs could raise ticket prices.

title: PT PP Tbk secures $174 million contract for 1 Mt/yr alumina refinery in West Kalimantan
body: PT PP Tbk, in partnership with China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Ltd (Chalieco), signed a USD 695 million construction contract for a 1 Mt/yr Smelter Grade Alumina Refinery owned by PT Borneo Alumina Indonesia, with PTPP’s 25% share valued at USD 174 million (≈IDR 2.6 trillion). The refinery is slated to be operational by 2022, and PTPP targets a new contract value of IDR 40.3 trillion this year, a 20.3% rise from 2019.

title: Indonesia Investment Authority's Danantara to invest $2.8 billion in six strategic downstream projects, with a focus on bauxite‑to‑aluminum in West Kalimantan
body: Danantara Indonesia, the investment arm of the Indonesia Investment Authority, will launch six national strategic projects this year, allocating about USD 2.8 billion (≈IDR 43.8 trillion) primarily to bauxite, alumina and aluminum downstreaming in West Kalimantan, a region rich in bauxite reserves. The plan also includes industrial developments in Cilacap and Banyuwangi, bio‑avtur production, and livestock sector downstreaming across five locations after feasibility studies.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk receives approval for 2026 Work Plan and Budget, resuming mining operations
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources approved PT Vale Indonesia Tbk's 2026 Work Plan and Budget (RKAB) on 15 January 2026, allowing the company to restart mining activities at Sorowako, Pomalaa and Bahodopi under safety and licensing requirements. CEO Bernadus Irmanto said the approval provides certainty for production discipline, governance and the sustainability of Indonesia's nickel industry.

title: Indonesian rupiah hits record low against the US dollar amid concerns over Bank Indonesia's independence
body: The rupiah slipped to a record low of about Rp 16,975 per US dollar on Tuesday as investors feared President Prabowo Subianto's nomination of his nephew to the Bank Indonesia board could erode the central bank's independence, amid widening fiscal deficits and global trade uncertainty. Additional pressure came from US tariff policy and the government's ambition to raise growth to 8% by 2029, despite Bank Indonesia's commitment to maintain exchange‑rate stability.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk to acquire 45% of PT Trimata Coal Perkasa as part of 2026 diversification into energy
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA) plans to diversify into the energy sector by acquiring a 45% controlling stake in PT Trimata Coal Perkasa, with the transaction approved by its controlling shareholder PT Triple Berkah Bersama (Triple B) under a conditional agreement dated 22 December 2025. The Rp 1.6 trillion deal will be paid in structured installments, and an extraordinary shareholders meeting will be convened to obtain approval, complying with POJK 17/2020.

title: Antam gold price climbs to Rp 2.705 million per gram on Jan 20, 2026
body: On Tuesday, Jan 20, 2026, the price of 1‑gram Antam gold certified by Logam Mulia PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) rose to Rp 2,705,000, up Rp 2,000 from the previous day, while the buyback price increased to Rp 2,546,000, up Rp 1,000. The article notes that per‑gram prices vary with bar size due to additional printing costs, with the 1‑kilogram bar serving as the standard reference for the market.

title: PT Bersama Zatta Jaya Tbk shares jump 34.57% ahead of Feb. 18 extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: On Jan 19, 2026, PT Bersama Zatta Jaya Tbk (ZATA) stock auto‑rejected upward and closed up 34.57% at IDR 109 per share as the company announced an extraordinary shareholders meeting on Feb 18, 2026. The meeting will consider, among other items, a proposed sale of land and building assets worth IDR 75 billion (including VAT) to PT Karya Utama Putra Mandiri.

title: Indonesian tycoon Prajogo Pangestu’s share purchases lift PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) and PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk (BREN) stocks
body: On Jan 19, 2026, PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) closed at 2,020 rupiah, up 9.19% after Prajogo Pangestu bought 3.5 million shares at 1,850‑1,900 rupiah, investing roughly 6.5 billion rupiah. He also increased his stake in PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk (BREN) by buying 1 million shares at about 9,525‑9,675 rupiah, spending around 9.6 billion rupiah.

title: Agung Podomoro Land (APLN) sells Mall Deli Park to DPM Assets Indonesia for Rp2.44 trillion to bolster liquidity and capital structure
body: On 8 January 2026, Agung Podomoro Land (APLN) divested Mall Deli Park through its subsidiary Sinar Menara Deli (SMD) to DPM Assets Indonesia for Rp2.44 trillion, aiming to strengthen cash, reduce leverage and fund projects such as the Balikpapan development via PT Pandega Citraniaga. The transaction follows SMD’s pre‑sale audited 2024 revenue of Rp557.43 billion and net profit of Rp67.73 billion and is expected to increase equity through asset‑disposal gains in the next reporting period.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia Sets Theoretical Price for Jaya Sukses Makmur's Bonus Shares
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia announced the theoretical price of Rp6,550 for Jaya Sukses Makmur (RISE) bonus shares, which are distributed at a 25:12 ratio totaling Rp525.36 billion. Based on a Rp9,700 cum date price, these bonus shares are scheduled for distribution on February 9, 2026, aiming to enhance liquidity and long-term shareholder value.

title: Kencana Energi (KEEN) Secures USD25 Million Contract with PLN for Tobelo Solar Power Plant
body: Kencana Energi (KEEN), through its subsidiary Energi Surya Halmahera, secured a USD25 million electricity purchase agreement with PLN to build and operate the 10 MW PLTS Tobelo, equipped with 8.4 MWh battery storage. The project, commencing construction in 2026 and targeting commercial operation by Q1-2027, is projected to generate USD13.8 million in construction revenue and an additional USD1.6 million annually from electricity sales to PLN for 20 years.

title: Saiko Consultancy Pte Ltd to Acquire Controlling Stake in Soraya Berjaya Indonesia (SPRE)
body: Saiko Consultancy Pte Ltd plans to become the new controlling shareholder of Soraya Berjaya Indonesia (SPRE) by acquiring 222.6 million shares, representing 27.83%, from Rizet Ramawi, with negotiations ongoing. This acquisition aims to support Saiko's business expansion, and following the announcement, SPRE shares surged 9.88% to Rp356.

title: PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk Attracts Global Investor Interest While PT Prima Multi Usaha Indonesia Tbk Reports Strong Net Profit Growth.
body: PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk (GPRM) is drawing global investor attention, with its stock price increasing over 60% since early 2026, despite a Q3 2025 sales decline of 11% but an 8% growth in net profit due to increased efficiency. Concurrently, its parent company, PT Prima Multi Usaha Indonesia Tbk (PMUI), posted a 25.98% rise in net profit to Rp33.73 billion during the same period.

title: PT Soechi Lines Tbk (SOCI) Explains Stock Price Surge Driven by Investor Interest in Tanker Shipping Sector and Valuation Adjustments.
body: PT Soechi Lines Tbk (SOCI) informed BEI that its recent stock price surge is attributed to increased investor interest in the tanker shipping sector and market valuation adjustments, with its PER at 17.80x and PBV at 0.73x as of January 15, 2026. The management considers these valuations reasonable compared to the broader market and peers, confirming no undisclosed material information beyond previously reported corporate actions.

title: Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Distributes Rp20.63 Trillion Interim Dividend for Fiscal Year 2025.
body: Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) has distributed an interim dividend totaling Rp20.63 trillion for the fiscal year 2025, paid on January 15, 2026, at Rp137 per share. Of this, the government received Rp11.04 trillion through Danantara and BP BUMN, with the remaining Rp9.59 trillion distributed to other shareholders.

title: Bakrie & Brothers Plans 90 Billion Share Right Issue at Rp12 Each to Optimize Funding and Support Operations
body: Bakrie & Brothers (BNBR) plans a right issue of 90 billion Series E shares at a nominal value of Rp12 per share, primarily to optimize the funding structure of Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways (CCT), support working capital, and fulfill obligations. Shareholders not participating in this action will experience a maximum dilution of 33.33%, with the plan contingent on approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting on February 27, 2026.

title: A5-DB Holdings Pte Ltd Increases Stake in Superbank (SUPA) by Acquiring 362.71 Million Shares
body: A5-DB Holdings Pte Ltd acquired 362.71 million Superbank (SUPA) shares through transactions on January 14, 2025, January 15, 2025, and January 19, 2026, for a total of approximately Rp382.06 billion. This purchase increased A5-DB Holdings' stake by 1.07% to 11.10%, now holding 3.76 billion shares of the Emtek Group-backed digital bank.

title: Darma Henwa (DEWA) Secures Rp10.5 Trillion Contract Extension with Arutmin Indonesia
body: Darma Henwa (DEWA) executed a Rp10.5 trillion contract extension for its Kintap and Asam Asam mining projects with Arutmin Indonesia, with the agreement signed on January 19, 2026. This life-of-mine contract, located in Tanah Laut, Kalimantan Selatan, involves an estimated production of 252 million bcm for overburden and 50 million tons of coal, ensuring long-term operational certainty and a positive impact on the company's performance and financial condition.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA) Plans Rp1.6 Trillion Acquisition of PT Trimata Coal Perkasa
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA) is set for a significant business transformation in early 2026 through the planned Rp1.6 trillion acquisition of 45% of PT Trimata Coal Perkasa shares. This strategic move, facilitated by MEJA's controlling shareholder PT Triple Berkah Bersama, aims to make MEJA the new controlling shareholder of PT Trimata Coal Perkasa and strengthen its foundation in the prospective energy sector.

title: Henan Putihrai Sekuritas Leads Accumulation in PT RMK Energy Tbk as Stock Reaches All-Time High
body: PT RMK Energy Tbk (RMKE) shares have surged 32% year-to-date in 2026 to an all-time high of Rp7,875 per share, propelled by significant broker accumulation. Henan Putihrai Sekuritas was the most aggressive, with a net buy of Rp59 billion in RMKE, and also accumulated other strategic stocks like PT Petrosea Tbk, PT Rukun Raharja Tbk, and PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk, reflecting institutional confidence in the energy and mining sectors.

title: PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG) Reduces Stake in PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk (NRCA) Through Divestment
body: PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG) sold 750,000 shares of PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk (NRCA) on January 14, 2026, at Rp1,218 per share, totaling Rp913.5 million, as part of a divestment. This transaction decreased SRTG's ownership in NRCA from 6,0155 percent to 5,9855 percent.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Increases Stake in PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) Following Share Price Decline
body: Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) experienced a decline in early 2026, falling from Rp2,300 to Rp1,850 per share by January 15. In response, controlling shareholder Prajogo Pangestu bought shares, increasing his ownership from 84.076% to 84.079% and leading to a price recovery to Rp2,010.

title: PT Sanurhasta Mitra Tbk (MINA) Approves Fund Reallocation and New Management at EGM
body: PT Sanurhasta Mitra Tbk (MINA) held an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on December 15, 2025, approving a revised rights issue fund allocation with 67.04% for capital expenditure and 30.32% for the Company's working capital, alongside smaller portions for The Santai and PT Sanur Hasta Griya. The meeting also sanctioned a management reshuffle, appointing Astini Bernawati Oudang as the new President Director and Hendry Utomo as President Commissioner, effective immediately.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Increases Stakes in PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk., PT Barito Pacific Tbk., and PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk. Amidst Price Corrections
body: Conglomerate Prajogo Pangestu directly acquired more shares in PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk. (BREN), PT Barito Pacific Tbk. (BRPT), and PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk. (CUAN) on January 15, 2026, investing a total of approximately Rp24.59 billion. These transactions, which followed year-to-date price corrections for the three stocks, slightly increased his controlling ownership and were followed by a market rebound for the shares.

title: OJK Issues Regulation for Lawsuits to Strengthen Financial Consumer Protection
body: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) has issued Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (POJK) Nomor 38 Tahun 2025, effective December 22, 2025, to strengthen consumer protection in the financial services sector by granting OJK the authority to file lawsuits for consumer loss recovery. These lawsuits, based on institutional legal standing and without cost to consumers, aim to enforce justice against Pelaku Usaha Jasa Keuangan that cause harm.

title: Rudi Sutantra Reduces Ownership in PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk.
body: Rudi R. Sutantra, President Commissioner of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk. (ATLA), sold 3,000,000 ATLA shares at Rp67 per share on December 15, 2025. This transaction reduced his direct ownership from 48,2526% (2,991,462,300 shares) to 48,2042% (2,988,462,300 shares), with the purpose of the sale undisclosed.

title: Sailun Group Officially Opens New Tire Manufacturing Facility in Demak, Indonesia with $251.44 Million Investment
body: Sailun Group, through its subsidiary PT Sailun Manufacturing Indonesia, has officially commenced operations of its new $251.44 million manufacturing facility in Demak, Central Java. This facility targets an initial annual production of 3.6 million PCR tires, 600 thousand TBR tires, and 37,000 tons OTR tires, aiming to serve both domestic needs and act as an export base for the Asia Pacific region, as stated by PT Sailun Tire Indonesia.

title: Putra Borneo Agro Lestari Increases Stake in PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk.
body: Putra Borneo Agro Lestari increased its direct share ownership in PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk. (SSMS) by purchasing 122,905,000 shares at Rp1,545 per share on January 15, 2026. This transaction raised its stake from 10.13% (965,196,485 shares) to 11.42% (1,088,101,485 shares).

title: PT Agung Podomoro Land Tbk Sells Mall Deli Park for Rp2.44 Trillion
body: PT Agung Podomoro Land Tbk (APLN), through its subsidiary PT Sinar Menara Deli (SMD), sold Mall Deli Park to PT DPM Asset Indonesia for Rp2.44 trillion, including PPN. This transaction is part of APLN's strategy to optimize asset portfolio rebalancing, allowing the company to focus on strategic assets contributing to long-term performance.

title: PT Djasa Ubersakti Tbk (PTDU) Cancels Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders Due to Unfulfilled Regulatory Requirements
body: PT Djasa Ubersakti Tbk (PTDU) canceled its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPSLB) scheduled for January 20, 2026, citing incomplete fulfillment of regulatory requirements from Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK), Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI), and creditors. Key outstanding requirements include a fairness assessment report, a 5-year lock-up statement from the new Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO), a written commitment for fund usage including Rp10 billion, and clarifications on a waiver from PT BPD Kaltim Kaltara.

title: PT Honda Prospect Motor (HPM) Refreshes Honda Brio Satya with CVT Technology Priced at Rp183.500.000
body: PT Honda Prospect Motor (HPM) has officially updated the Honda Brio Satya, now featuring CVT technology to cater to consumer demand for an efficient and affordable automatic transmission and to strengthen its market position. This LCGC vehicle, equipped with a 1,200 cc engine, is offered with the new CVT variant at Rp183,500,000, providing enhanced driving comfort, fuel efficiency, and long-term reliability.

title: SKK Migas and PetroChina International Jabung Ltd. Commence 2026 Drilling Program in Jabung WK
body: SKK Migas and PetroChina International Jabung Ltd. (PCJL) have officially initiated their 2026 drilling program in the Jabung Working Area (WK) with the spudding of the NEB-85ST well. This marks the first of 6 development wells planned by PCJL for the year, alongside 11 workovers and 170 well services, aiming to support national oil and gas production targets safely and efficiently.

title: Hendry Buys Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Hendry, an insider, bought 6,030,700 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk, increasing his holding from 34,976,391 to 41,007,091. The transaction, related to the MESOP Program, occurred at a price of 436.00 per share, with a total transaction amount of 183,513,900 shares on December 19, 2025.

title: Sulistiono Sells Shares of PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk.
body: Sulistiono divested 30,000,000 shares of PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk. (ASLI.JK) at IDR 11.0 per share. This transaction reduces his holdings from 325,000,000 to 295,000,000 shares. The purpose stated is divestment.

title: Sudjatmiko Sells Shares of PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk.
body: Sudjatmiko has divested 4,345,000,000 shares of PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk. (ASLI.JK). The transaction, valued at IDR 4.34 billion, resulted in Sudjatmiko's holdings decreasing from 4,345,000,000 shares to 0 shares. This divestment marks a complete exit from the company by the shareholder.

title: Buana Graha Utama Buys Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: PT Buana Graha Utama acquired 800,000 shares of PT Multi Indocitra Tbk (MICE.JK) for investment purposes. The transactions occurred between January 15 and January 19, 2026, at prices ranging from IDR 570 to IDR 580 per share. Following these purchases, Buana Graha Utama's stake increased from 288,903,618 shares to 289,703,618 shares.

title: Hendry sells shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Hendry, an insider, sold 17,748,320 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk, a technology company, at IDR 470 per share. The transaction, classified as a divestment, resulted in Hendry's ownership changing from 34,976,391 shares to 41,007,091 shares, an increase of 6,030,700 shares.

title: Kenneth Ronald Kennedy Crichton buy Shares of PT Archi Indonesia Tbk
body: On 9 Dec 2025, investor Kenneth Ronald Kennedy Crichton purchased 5,000,000 shares of PT Archi Indonesia Tbk at IDR 750 per share, increasing his holding from 0 to 5,000,000 shares. The transaction, classified as a buy for investment purposes, represents a significant new equity stake in the company, potentially influencing its shareholder composition and signaling confidence in its future prospects.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Buy Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: On 2025-12-16, Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 2,162,984,400 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 142 per share under a reverse repo arrangement. The holding rose from 6,655,276,554 to 8,818,260,954 shares, reflecting a substantial increase in the shareholder's stake. The transaction, recorded on 2025-12-17, signals a liquidity provision to the market and strengthens Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia's position in Sentul City Tbk.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 15,000,000 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk at IDR 160 per share on 10 Dec 2025, reducing its stake from 6,537,713,000 to 6,522,713,000 shares (a decline of 15,000,000 shares). The transaction is classified as an investment‑related divestment and reflects a modest reallocation of holdings by the equity management entity, potentially signalling a shift in its portfolio strategy.

title: Gema Lintas Benua sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: On 9 Dec 2025, Gema Lintas Benua sold 4,000,000 shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR.JK) at IDR 1,205 per share to meet cash requirements. The holding decreased from 755,240,483 to 751,240,483 shares, a reduction of 4,000,000 shares, representing a marginal change in ownership without immediate material impact on the company's share structure.

title: Henry Liem Sells Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold 102,600 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at a price of IDR 570.0 per share. This transaction, with the stated purpose of selling shares, reduced his total holding from 15,901,559 shares to 15,798,959 shares. title: Karya Pacific Investama Buys Shares of PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk
body: Karya Pacific Investama bought 1,259,388,400 shares of PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk (IATA.JK) for investment purposes. title: Yudho Pratikto Buys Shares of PT Cikarang Listrindo Tbk
body: Yudho Pratikto, a shareholder of PT Cikarang Listrindo Tbk (POWR.JK), executed a buy transaction for investment purposes. title: PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk Shareholder Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia repaid a repo facility with PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk, exchanging its 739,670,200 IDR stake for cash. The transaction, valued at 739,670,200 IDR, reduced the holder’s position from 739,670,200 IDR to zero, leaving the company’s ownership unchanged. This repo repayment reflects routine financing activity and does not alter the equity structure of PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk.

title: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra buy Shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
body: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra bought 1,643,500 shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk on 15 December 2025 at IDR 478.0 per share, increasing his holding from 4,136,724,030 to 4,138,367,530 shares. The transaction was made for investment purposes, slightly raising the shareholder’s stake in the company and reflecting continued confidence in the steel pipe sector.

title: Yessie Dianty Yosetya Buy Shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: Yessie Dianty Yosetya bought 80,000 shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL.JK) between 11 and 15 December 2025, raising her holding from 1,669,700 to 1,749,700 shares. The transaction increases her ownership stake in the telecom company, potentially enhancing her influence on corporate governance and signaling confidence in the firm’s prospects. The move is a routine shareholder activity and does not trigger any regulatory thresholds beyond normal disclosure.

title: Budi Dharmo Buy Shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk.
body: On 12 December 2025, Budi Dharmo purchased 45,000,000 shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk. (BOLT.JK) at IDR 1,000 per share, increasing his holding from 1,350,000,000 to 1,395,000,000 shares. title: Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Danantara Asset Management Buys Shares of Garuda Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
body: Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Danantara Asset Management bought 315,610,920,000 shares of Garuda Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (GIAA.JK) at IDR 75.0 per share. This transaction increased Danantara's holding from 59,038,124,402 shares to 374,649,044,402 shares. The purpose of this significant acquisition is the "Implementation of PMTHMETD in the Context of Improving Financial Position," reflecting a strategic move to support GIAA's financial health and stability.

title: Henry Liem Sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Shareholder Henry Liem sold 6,600 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 580 per share on November 28, 2025. This transaction decreased his total holding from 15,908,159 shares to 15,901,559 shares. The purpose of this transaction was to sell shares.

title: R Arief Wicaksono buy Shares of Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Timur Tbk
body: R Arief Wicaksono purchased 4,615 shares of Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jawa Timur Tbk on 16 December 2025 at IDR 540 per share, raising his holding from 1,397,100 to 1,858,600 shares—a 461,500 share increase—under an investment purpose, indicating confidence in the bank’s prospects.

title: Yessie Dianty Yosetya Buy Shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: Yessie Dianty Yosetya purchased 150,000 shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL.JK) through multiple transactions between December 5 and December 10, 2025, with a representative price of IDR 3,710 per share. This transaction, executed for personal purchase, increased her total holdings from 1,519,700 shares to 1,669,700 shares. This significant insider buying reflects an increased stake by a key individual in the company.

title: Baritono Prajogo Pangestu Buy Shares of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk
body: Baritono Prajogo Pangestu purchased 26,000 shares of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA.JK) at a price of IDR 7,650.0 per share. This transaction, executed for investment purposes, increased his total holding from 298,100 shares to 324,100 shares, reflecting an increased stake in the company.

title: Eko Desriyanto Sell Shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk
body: Eko Desriyanto sold 10,000,000 shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk (IDEA.JK) for IDR 50.0 per share on December 9, 2025. This divestment reduced his ownership from 412,818,600 shares to 402,818,600 shares. The transaction signifies a decrease in Eko Desriyanto's stake in the company.

title: Henry Liem Sells Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold 14,200 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 570 per share. This transaction, completed on December 8, 2025, reduced his stake from 15,797,459 shares to 15,783,259 shares. title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk Shareholder Sutiana Ali Reports New Transaction
body: Sutiana Ali, a shareholder of Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK.JK), acquired 2,000,000 shares under the MESOP Program – Implementation Period I. The transaction raised her stake from 11,860,000 to 13,860,000 shares, an increase of 2,000,000 shares. The acquisition aligns with the company’s program to enhance shareholder engagement and capital structure. No price disclosed.

title: Sukarto Bujung Buys Shares of PT Buyung Poetra Sembada Tbk
body: Sukarto Bujung executed multiple buy transactions of PT Buyung Poetra Sembada Tbk (HOKI.JK) shares for investment purposes, acquiring a total of 43,622,700 shares at a representative price of IDR 144 per share. This increased his total ownership from 537,296,806 shares to 580,919,506 shares. The significant increase in holding by a key shareholder signals confidence in the company's future prospects.

title: Sukarto Bujung Buys Shares of PT Buyung Poetra Sembada Tbk
body: Sukarto Bujung, a shareholder of PT Buyung Poetra Sembada Tbk (HOKI.JK), acquired 43,622,700 shares through multiple buy transactions for investment purposes. The latest transaction occurred at IDR 75 per share. This increased Sukarto Bujung's total holding from 537,296,806 shares to 580,919,506 shares, representing a notable increase in insider ownership and signaling confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Raymond Buys Shares of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk
body: Raymond, a shareholder of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA.JK), acquired 200,000 shares of the company. These transactions, executed between December 4 and 5, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 7,625 to IDR 7,675 per share, increased Raymond's total holding from 2,800,000 to 3,000,000 shares. The stated purpose for this acquisition is investment, signaling a strengthened position and confidence in the petrochemical company.

title: Robin Sindo Buys Shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk
body: Robin Sindo bought 29,187,400 shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk (STTP.JK) on December 9, 2025, at IDR 3,015 per share. This transaction, purposed for the settlement of rights and obligations between customers, increased Robin Sindo's total holding from 64,916,500 shares to 94,103,900 shares, marking a significant increase in his stake in the company.

title: PT Lintas Benua sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: PT Lintas Benua sold 144,614,496 shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk at IDR 300 per share on 2025‑12‑15 to meet cash requirements. The transaction reduced the holder’s stake from 712,867,083 to 568,252,587 shares, a decline of 144,614,496 shares. The sale provides liquidity for the shareholder and may influence the company’s capital structure.

title: Citra Borneo Indah Buy Shares of PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk
body: Citra Borneo Indah bought 739,670,200 shares of PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk (SSMS.JK) at a price of IDR 1,660.0 per share on December 11, 2025. This transaction, described as a Repurchase of Shares Repurchase Agreement, increased Citra Borneo Indah's holding from 5,530,577,200 shares to 6,270,247,400 shares, representing an increase of 739,670,200 shares. This signifies a notable increase in Citra Borneo Indah's ownership stake in the company.

title: Bahtera Bintang Nusantara Sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
