body: Bahtera Bintang Nusantara sold 64,425,000 shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR.JK) through multiple transactions between December 3 and December 8, 2025, at prices ranging from IDR 550 to IDR 965 per share, with a representative price of IDR 610 per share. This divestment, totaling 64,425,000 shares, was conducted for operational financing, resulting in Bahtera Bintang Nusantara's complete exit from KETR.JK, with its holding decreasing from 64,425,000 shares to 0 shares. This significant shareholder exit is relevant for Indonesian stock market investors.

title: Agus Winarno Sells Shares of PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk
body: Agus Winarno, a shareholder of PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk (MTEL.JK), sold 200 shares on November 7, 2025, at a price of IDR 560 per share. This transaction reduced his total holding from 157,500 shares to 157,300 shares, representing a minor adjustment in the shareholder's investment in the company.

title: Alam Sutera Realty Tbk Shareholder Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia, a shareholder of Alam Sutera Realty Tbk (ASRI.JK), executed a top up repo transaction, increasing its holding by 342,987,900 shares. This transaction raised its total ownership from 893,056,400 shares to 1,236,044,300 shares, reflecting an adjustment in its repo position.

title: Drs. Hendro Martowardojo Buys Shares of Nusa Konstruksi Enjiniring Tbk
body: Drs. Hendro Martowardojo acquired 5,000,000 shares of Nusa Konstruksi Enjiniring Tbk (DGIK.JK) in a buy transaction for investment purposes. This transaction, executed at IDR 120 per share, increased his total ownership from 200,000 shares to 5,200,000 shares. This significant increase in holding by a key individual signals a positive outlook on the company's future.

title: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra Buy Shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
body: Cakra Bhakti Para Putra bought 2,778,400 shares of PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk (ISSP.JK) at a price of IDR 460 per share on December 9, 2025. This transaction increased the shareholder's total holding from 4,133,945,630 shares to 4,136,724,030 shares. The stated purpose for this acquisition is investment, indicating a strategic move to strengthen its position in the company.

title: Sumber Garam Pratama Sells Shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk
body: Sumber Garam Pratama sold 16,666,600 shares of PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk (FOLK.JK) at a price of IDR 300 per share. This transaction reduced Sumber Garam Pratama's holding from 1,048,773,345 shares to 1,032,106,745 shares. The stated purpose for this divestment was to realize profits.

title: Budi Dharmo buy Shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk.
body: Budi Dharmo purchased operator shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk. on 12 Dec 2025 for IDR 1,000 per share, totaling IDR 45,000,000. The transaction increased his holding from IDR 1,350,000,000 to IDR 1,395,000,000, a net gain of IDR 45,000,000. This addition reflects the operator’s intent to strengthen its equity position in the company. The move is significant for investors as it signals confidence in the firm’s prospects and may influence share liquidity.

title: Amelia Sintari buy Shares of PT Siantar Top Tbk
body: Amelia Sintari purchased 22,553,900 IDR worth of PT Siantar Top Tbk shares on 12 December 2025 at IDR 3,015 per share, increasing her stake from 64,589,200 to 87,143,100 shares. The transaction, executed to settle rights and obligations between customers, raises her ownership by 22,553,900 shares and reflects a strategic capital allocation that may strengthen her influence in the company.

title: Buana Graha Utama Buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama purchased 200,000 shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk on 15 December 2025 at IDR 580.0 per share, raising its stake from 286,817,218 to 287,017,218 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment purchase, reflects confidence in the company’s prospects and slightly boosts the shareholder’s ownership percentage, reinforcing its position in the Indonesian equity market.

title: Henry Liem Sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem, a shareholder of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK), sold 1,500 shares on December 9, 2025, at a price of IDR 565 per share. This transaction, executed with the purpose to sell shares, decreased his total ownership from 15,798,959 shares to 15,797,459 shares, reflecting a minor reduction in his stake in the company.

title: PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk Shareholder Tan Yu Yeh Reports New Transaction
body: On 17 Dec 2025, shareholder Tan Yu Yeh restructured his stake in PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (MDIY.JK) at an indicative price of IDR 1,100 per share. His holding fell from 18,431,922,732 shares to 12,572,724,300 shares, a reduction of 5,859,198,432 shares (approximately 31.8%). The move aligns with the stated purpose of share‑ownership restructuring and represents a significant shift in the shareholder’s equity position.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sell Shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sold 180,000,000 IDR worth of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk shares on 15–16 December 2025, reducing its holding from 21,195,395,000 to 21,015,395,000 shares, a drop of 1,800,000,000 shares. The sale, executed at a representative price of IDR 3,050 per share, was driven by Investment Realization and Increasing Free Float objectives. The transaction lowers insider ownership, expands the free‑float pool, and may enhance market liquidity and investor confidence.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk Shareholder Titi Maria Rusli Reports New Transaction
body: Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK.JK) disclosed that shareholder Titi Maria Rusli increased her stake under the MESOP Program – Implementation Period I. Her holding rose from 12,000,000 to 13,500,000 shares, an addition of 1,500,000 shares. The transaction reflects a capital allocation within the program and modestly raises her ownership proportion in the company.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher Buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher, a shareholder of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK), executed a series of buy transactions on December 3-4, 2025. He acquired a total of 5,672,100 shares at various prices, including a representative price of IDR 1,405 per share, for investment purposes. This transaction increased his holding from 192,709,622 shares to 198,381,722 shares, indicating a strengthened position in the company.

title: Infiniti Wahana sell Shares of Steady Safe Tbk
body: Infiniti Wahana sold 587,900 shares of Steady Safe Tbk on 17 December 2025 at IDR 444.0 per share, reducing its stake from 464,597,013 to 464,009,113 shares. The transaction reflects a routine divestment and does not materially alter the shareholder structure or strategic direction of the company.

title: Triple Berkah Bersama Buy Shares of PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk
body: Triple Berkah Bersama bought 878,845,100 shares of PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk (MEJA.JK) at IDR 20.0 per share on December 4, 2025. This transaction marks a significant ownership change, increasing Triple Berkah Bersama's holding from 0 to 878,845,100 shares. The acquisition is for investment purposes, establishing Triple Berkah Bersama as a new shareholder in MEJA.JK.

title: Abed Nego buy Shares of PT Archi Indonesia Tbk
body: Abed Nego purchased 25,200,000 shares of PT Archi Indonesia Tbk at IDR 750 per share on 8 Dec 2025, increasing his holding from zero to 25,200,000 shares (an addition of 25,200,000 shares). The transaction, classified as an investment, introduces a new shareholder with a sizable stake, potentially impacting the company’s shareholder composition and signaling confidence in its prospects.

title: Tunas Mekar Jaya sell Shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk
body: Tunas Mekar Jaya sold 1,164,221,790 IDR worth of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk shares on 19 December 2025 at IDR 6,450 per share, reducing its holding from 1,250,000,000 to 85,778,210 shares. The divestment aims to realize investment value and may signal portfolio rebalancing for the investor. This move decreases the shareholder’s stake to about 6.8% of the company, potentially impacting voting power and market perception.

title: Danantara Indonesia targets tripling its $900 billion asset base by 2030 by consolidating over 1,000 state-owned enterprises
body: Danantara Indonesia, Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund, said it will merge 1,068 state‑owned enterprises into about 221 professionally run entities within the next three to four years, aiming to lift its current $900 billion (≈15.29 quadrillion rupiah) asset value to three times that amount by 2030. The restructuring, highlighted at the World Economic Forum in Davos, is intended to boost efficiency, competitiveness and add more Indonesian firms such as Pertamina and PLN to the Fortune Global 500.

title: Indonesia's Finance Ministry prepared to fund post‑disaster rehabilitation and reconstruction in Sumatra
body: Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Regional Development Agus Harimurti Yudhoyono said the Ministry of Finance will provide immediate financial support for damaged infrastructure and housing in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra, with a projected need of up to Rp74 trillion (about US$4.3 billion). The recovery plan also includes land rearrangement and spatial planning to prevent future settlement in disaster‑prone areas, covering 139,485 flood‑affected homes.

title: Indonesia’s People’s Business Credit (KUR) program disbursed Rp270 trillion in 2025, nearing its target and supporting millions of MSMEs
body: The Ministry of MSMEs reported that the KUR program disbursed Rp270 trillion (US$16 billion) in 2025, reaching 96% of its Rp280 trillion target and serving 4.58 million borrowers, including 2.7 million new ones. The program is estimated to generate 7.7–11.6 million jobs, with 60.7% of funds allocated to the production sector, while the government issued 3 million business identification numbers, 2.8 million halal certifications and simplified standards for over a million micro‑enterprises.

title: Finance Minister says BI deputy governor nominee will not threaten central bank independence
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa dismissed concerns that Deputy Finance Minister Thomas Djiwandono’s nomination as a Bank Indonesia deputy governor could compromise the central bank’s independence, emphasizing that decisions are made by consensus among the seven deputy governors. He noted that Djiwandono will relinquish his party position, the vacancy follows the resignation of deputy governor Juda Agung, and analysts say the rupiah and macroeconomic stability should remain unaffected if institutional safeguards are preserved.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange suspends trading of eight stocks and two warrants amid sharp price jumps
body: The IDX halted trading of Magna Investama Mandiri (MGNA), Indo Boga Sukses (IBOS), Harapan Duta Pertiwi (HOPE), Satu Visi Putra (VISI), Indospring (INDS), Bersama Mencapai Puncak (BAIK), Abadi Lestari Indonesia (RLCO), Bersama Zatta Jaya (ZATA) and the MGNA‑W and BAIK‑W warrants as a cooling‑down measure; six of the stocks closed with abnormal price rises ranging from 9.5% to 34.7% before suspension. The suspensions are categorized into three clusters, with some securities expected to resume trading the next day and others facing longer pauses up to a month.

title: Agpa Pte Ltd launches a IDR 4.93 trillion mandatory tender offer for Prime Agri Resources after acquiring a 65.7% stake
body: Agpa Pte Ltd is mobilising a tactical fund of IDR 4.93 trillion, using Posco International Corporation to conduct a mandatory tender offer for up to 623.33 million Prime Agri Resources (SGRO) shares at IDR 7,903 per share from 21 January to 19 February 2026. The offer follows Agpa's direct acquisition of 1.19 billion shares (65.721% of capital) from Twinwood Family Holdings Limited, and the company intends to maintain Prime Agri's operations without delisting or converting it to a private entity unless listing requirements are no longer met.

title: Multi Garam Utama (FOLK) completes Rp56.99 bn private placement, boosting paid‑up capital to Rp81.82 bn
body: The company issued 143.21 million new shares at Rp398 each, raising Rp56.99 bn, with Garam Ventura Indonesia (GVI) purchasing 92.96 million shares and Sutopo Widodo acquiring 50.25 million shares. The placement increased total shares to 4.09 billion and paid‑up capital to Rp81.82 bn, and the stock rose to about Rp985, up 0.5% on the day.

title: Sinar Mas Agro (SMAR) to Issue Rp1.2 Trillion Sustainable Bonds and Sukuk in 2026
body: Sinar Mas Agro (SMAR) will issue a total of Rp1.2 trillion in sustainable financing, comprising a Rp672 billion Phase II 2026 green bond (Series A: Rp385 billion at 6.20% for 5 years; Series B: Rp287 billion at 6.50% for 7 years) and a Rp528 billion Phase II 2026 green sukuk ijarah (Series A: Rp460 billion at 6.20% for 5 years; Series B: Rp68 billion at 6.50% for 7 years). About 78% of the bond proceeds and 99% of the sukuk proceeds will be used to repay a Rp520 billion long‑term bank loan, with the remaining funds allocated to working capital.

title: Dragonmine Mining advances due‑diligence talks to acquire 80% of Berkah Prima Perkasa (BLUE) as its shares surge
body: Dragonmine Mining (Hong Kong) Limited is negotiating to purchase 80% of Berkah Prima Perkasa (BLUE), amounting to 334.4 million shares, with due‑diligence and agreement drafting ongoing. Following the talks, Berkah Prima’s stock jumped 150 points to Rp5,225, up about 2.96% and up 63.28% year‑to‑date.

title: Lippo Cikarang reviews Ministry of Housing's plan to build 18 subsidized towers in Meikarta amid stock volatility
body: The Ministry of Housing and Settlement Areas (PKP) intends to construct 18 Rusun towers in Meikarta, and Lippo Cikarang (LPCK) says the project complies with existing laws and no assets are under seizure. The company's shares fell 55 points (7.75%) to Rp655 after a red‑zone correction, while year‑to‑date they have risen 60 points (10.08%) to Rp595.

title: Ascendia Capital Indonesia buy Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: Ascendia Capital Indonesia has purchased shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk, acquiring a total of IDR 144,614,496 at a unit price of IDR 300.0. The transaction, filed on 19 December 2025, elevates the investor’s stake from zero to 144,614,496 IDR, marking its first entry into the company’s equity. The purchase is part of an investment strategy aimed at expanding exposure to the Indonesian industrial sector. This initial stake may signal confidence in PT Ketrosden’s growth prospects and could influence future shareholder dynamics.

title: PT Agro Bahari Nusantara Tbk (UDNG) denies any change in controlling shareholder or takeover plans and confirms shrimp operations remain normal
body: The company confirmed that its controlling shareholder has not signed any definitive agreement to sell shares and it is unaware of any takeover that would shift its business from fisheries to digital infrastructure, with its shrimp farms continuing normal production. UDNG's stock closed at Rp4,100, down 4.65% on the day and 18% YTD, while one‑year holders have recorded a 10,150% gain.

title: PT Sampoerna Agro Tbk. (SGRO) completes full use of proceeds from sustainable bond and sukuk issuance to prepay bank debt
body: PT Sampoerna Agro Tbk. (SGRO) raised Rp200 billion from a sustainable bond (Rp75 billion) and sukuk Ijarah (Rp125 billion) and, after Rp5 billion underwriting costs, used the net Rp195 billion to repay bank loans early (Rp72.89 billion from bonds and Rp122.10 billion from sukuk). The early repayment leaves no remaining proceeds and is expected to strengthen the company’s capital structure and reduce financial burden.

title: Controlling shareholder Nanotech Investama Sedaya reduces its stake in PT Nanotech Indonesia Global Tbk. to 51.0% after selling 214 million shares
body: On 19 January 2026, Nanotech Investama Sedaya sold 214,272,013 shares of PT Nanotech Indonesia Global Tbk. (NANO) at Rp55 per share, generating approximately Rp11.78 billion and lowering its ownership from 56.004% to 51.003%. Management said the sale aims to strengthen the company’s shareholder structure, and the stock rose 4.92% to Rp64 the following day.

title: PT MNC Tourism Indonesia Tbk raises Rp78.75 billion through a non‑preemptive rights capital increase
body: On 15 January 2026, PT MNC Tourism Indonesia Tbk completed a Penambahan Modal Tanpa Hak Memesan Efek Terlebih Dahulu (PMTHMETD), issuing 514,710,000 new shares at an exercise price of Rp153 per share and raising Rp78.75 billion. The net proceeds will be used to strengthen the company’s capital structure, improve its financial condition, and support financing of future projects.

title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) Inaugurates Heritage and Environmentally Friendly Pavilion in Bogor to Strengthen Sharia Inclusion
body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) launched its new BSI Pavilion in Bogor on January 19, a heritage-themed and environmentally friendly building designed as a one-stop solution to strengthen sharia financial inclusion. The Bogor region shows strong growth with Third Party Funds reaching Rp8.4 trillion, up 4.5% YTD, and financing distribution at Rp1.92 trillion, up 5.17% YTD, as of December 2025.

title: PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk. Addresses Meikarta Issues and Confirms No Asset Seizure
body: PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk. (LPCK) clarified to BEI that the plan for Meikarta's utilization as subsidized flats is still under study and no legal obligations directly hinder it. The company further confirmed that no Meikarta project assets have ever been or are currently seized as evidence in any reported bribery case.

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk proposes a rights issue of up to 50 billion new shares, seeking shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 26 Feb 2026
body: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk announced a rights issue (PMHMETD II) to issue up to 50 billion new shares, representing up to 203.11% of its current fully paid shares at a nominal value of Rp50 per share. The company warned that shareholders who do not exercise their rights could face dilution of up to 67.01% and the plan will be voted on at an extraordinary general meeting on 26 February 2026.

title: PT Putra Borneo Agro Lestari increases stake in PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk. (SSMS) by 1.29%
body: On January 15, 2026, PT Putra Borneo Agro Lestari purchased 122,905,000 shares of PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk. (SSMS) at Rp1,545 per share, valuing the transaction at about Rp189.9 billion and raising its ownership to 11.42%. The announcement boosted SSMS’s share price by 2.59% to Rp1,585 the next trading day.

title: PT Wahana Konstruksi Mandiri (WKM) Acquires Controlling Stake in PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk (ASLI)
body: PT Wahana Konstruksi Mandiri (WKM) officially became the new controlling shareholder of PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk (ASLI) after acquiring 62.72% of ASLI's shares through a crossing mechanism on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on January 19, 2026. This acquisition, aimed at business development and synergy in the construction industry, will be followed by a Mandatory Tender Offer for ASLI's remaining public shares.

title: PT Pertamina (Persero) Disburses Rp 900 Million in Appropriate Technology Grants to 100 UMKs
body: PT Pertamina (Persero), through its Pertamina UMK Academy program, has disbursed Rp 900 Million in appropriate technology grants to 100 Micro and Small Enterprises (UMK), with Rp 555 Million already realized and the remainder to be completed in January. This initiative aims to boost UMK competitiveness, independence, and production efficiency through tools, training, and mentoring, aligning with national development goals.

title: PT Toba Pulp Lestari Tbk (INRU) Responds to Alleged PBPH Permit Revocation, Awaiting Official Notification
body: PT Toba Pulp Lestari Tbk (INRU) has issued a clarification regarding reports from Satuan Tugas Penertiban Kawasan Hutan (Satgas PKH) about the alleged revocation of its Business Permit for Forest Utilization (PBPH) in North Sumatra, stating it has not received any official administrative decision. The company is actively coordinating with Kementerian Kehutanan for clarification, warning that an effective revocation would fundamentally impact its raw material supply chain, operational performance, and financial stability.

title: PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk Shareholder Mdih (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. Reports New Transaction
body: Mdih (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., a shareholder of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (MDIY.JK), executed a share restructuring on 17 Dec 2025, transferring 5,201,816,184 shares at IDR 1,100 per share. Its holding increased from 3,695,743,216 to 8,897,559,400 shares, reflecting a substantial boost in ownership. The move aims to reorganize the share ownership structure, potentially enhancing control and liquidity for the shareholder.

title: Null buy Shares of PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk
body: On 12 Dec 2025, an entity identified as Null purchased 627,000,000 shares of PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk at IDR 105 per share, amounting to an acquisition transaction. The shareholder's holding increased from 0 to 627,000,000 shares, representing a delta of 627,000,000 shares. This acquisition expands the shareholder's stake to a significant position in the company, potentially influencing corporate governance and future strategic direction.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 17 December 2025, shareholder Henry Liem sold 101,700 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 565.0 per share, reducing his holding from 15,783,259 to 15,681,559 shares.

title: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono buy Shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk
body: Garret Suryowijoyo Kartono purchased 27,993,400 shares of PT Maxindo Karya Anugerah Tbk, increasing his holding from 0 to 27,993,400 shares (a delta of +27,993,400). The buy was executed at a representative price of IDR 50 per share and is classified as an investment. This transaction gives Kartono a substantial new ownership position in the listed construction firm, potentially influencing future capital structure and signaling confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Eddy Purwana Wikanta sell Shares of PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk
body: Eddy Purwana Wikanta sold 2,200,000 shares of PT Nusa Raya Cipta Tbk (NRCA.JK) at an average price of IDR 2,004.0 per share on 16‑18 December 2025. The transaction reduced his holding from 61,352,500 to 59,152,500 shares, a decrease of 2,200,000 shares. The sale was executed for investment purposes and may affect the shareholder’s influence on the company, potentially influencing the stock’s liquidity and market perception.

title: Ram Jethmal Punjabi buy Shares of PT Tripar Multivision Plus Tbk
body: Ram Jethmal Punjabi purchased 2,797,400 shares of PT Tripar Multivision Plus Tbk at an average price of IDR 236.0 per share on 15–16 December 2025, increasing his holding from 4,596,669,982 to 4,599,467,382 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, reflects confidence in the company’s prospects and adds liquidity to the market.

title: Junichiro Waide sell Shares of PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk
body: Junichiro Waide sold 8,650,000 shares of PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk at an average price of IDR 97.00 per share on 11–18 December 2025, reducing his stake from 1,298,016,974 to 1,289,366,974 shares (−8,650,000). The sale, filed on 19 December, was part of a portfolio adjustment strategy, allowing Waide to rebalance holdings without affecting market liquidity. The transaction slightly decreases the company’s shareholder concentration and may signal a strategic shift in Waide’s investment approach.

title: Garuda Multi Investama Buy Shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk.
body: Garuda Multi Investama purchased 45,000,000 shares of PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk on 12 December 2025 at IDR 1,000 per share, raising its operator holding from 1,350,000,000 to 1,395,000,000 shares. The transaction, valued at IDR 45,000,000, reflects a strategic increase in operator ownership, potentially strengthening its influence over corporate decisions and signaling confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sell Shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk
body: Harimas Tunggal Perkasa sold 316,500,000 shares of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk at an average price of IDR 2,950 per share, reducing its stake from 21,015,395,000 to 20,698,895,000 shares. The transaction, valued at roughly IDR 933,000,000,000, was aimed at investment realization and boosting the company’s free float, potentially enhancing market liquidity and investor access.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk Shareholder Yuslinda Nasution Reports New Transaction
body: Yuslinda Nasution increased her stake in Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk by 200,000 shares, raising her holding from 14,046,000 to 14,246,000 shares. The transaction, part of the MESOP Program Implementation Period I, reflects her participation in the company’s structured equity program. This move may signal confidence in EMTK’s growth prospects and aligns with the program’s objectives to strengthen shareholder base.

title: PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk buy Shares of PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk
body: PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk announced a share buy transaction on 15 December 2025, purchasing 405,397,500 shares at a price of IDR 130.0 per share. The transaction increased the company’s holdings from IDR 627,000,000 to IDR 1,032,397,500, a delta of IDR 405,397,500, representing an approximately 64.7% increase in share ownership. The acquisition aims to consolidate control and strengthen the company’s capital structure, signalling confidence to investors and potentially enhancing market perception.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk Shareholder Jay Geoffrey Wacher Reports New Transaction
body: Jay Geoffrey Wacher increased his stake in Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk from 54,949,000 shares to 71,949,000 shares, adding 17,000,000 shares under the MESOP Program – Implementation Period I. The transaction amount totaled IDR 17,000,000. This move reflects the shareholder’s participation in the program and expands his ownership, potentially aligning his interests with the company’s strategic initiatives.

title: Treasure Global Investments Limited sell Shares of Bumi Resources Tbk
body: Treasure Global Investments Limited sold 18,195,000,000 BUMI shares on 19 Jan 2026 at IDR 380 per share as part of a shareholder restructuring. Its holding fell from 30,000,000,000 to 11,805,000,000 shares, a reduction of 18,195,000,000 shares. The transaction, valued at roughly IDR 6.91 trillion, significantly lowers the investor’s stake in Bumi Resources Tbk, potentially impacting voting power and market perception of the company’s ownership structure.

title: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd sell Shares of PT Lovina Beach Brewery Tbk
body: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd sold 8,262,500 shares of PT Lovina Beach Brewery Tbk at IDR 229 per share on 2026-01-15, reducing its holding from 1,719,024,000 to 1,710,761,500 shares (a decrease of 8,262,500 shares). The transaction, classified as a profit‑earning sale, slightly lowers the shareholder’s stake but the firm remains a major holder, indicating continued confidence while realizing gains.

title: Hendry Buys Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Hendry, an insider, bought 183,513,900 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk at IDR 436 per share. The transaction, related to the MESOP Program, increased Hendry's holding from 34,976,391 to 218,490,291 shares, a gain of 183,513,900 shares.

title: Ronald Winardi sells Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Ronald Winardi, an insider, sold 600,000 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk, reducing his holdings from 46,870,000 to 46,270,000. The transaction was for divestment purposes, with a representative price of IDR 470 per share. The change in ownership is a decrease of 600,000 shares.

title: Null buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On 2026-01-21, the shareholder identified as Null purchased 4,500 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk at a price of IDR 17,192 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised the holder's stake from 13,406,887,270 to 13,406,891,770 shares, a net increase of 4,500 shares, reflecting a marginal change in ownership but indicating continued investment interest in the company.

title: Hendry Sells Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Hendry, an insider, sold 177,483,200 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk, reducing holdings from 218,490,291 to 41,007,091. The transaction, at IDR 470 per share, was for divestment purposes.

title: Lisa Widodo buys Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Lisa Widodo, an insider, bought 154,560,800 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk at IDR 436 per share. Her holdings increased from 35,237,591 to 189,798,391 shares, a gain of 154,560,800 shares, for investments related to the MESOP Program.

title: Lisa Widodo Sells Shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Lisa Widodo, an insider, sold 150,238,600 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk, reducing her holding from 189,798,391 to 39,559,791. The transaction, valued at IDR 70,662,232,000,000, was conducted at IDR 470 per share. The purpose of the transaction was divestment.

title: Kusumo Martanto buys shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Kusumo Martanto, an insider, bought 375,805,600 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk at IDR 436 per share. The transaction, related to the MESOP Program, increased his holdings from 170,339,761 to 546,145,361 shares.

title: Kusumo Martanto sells shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
body: Kusumo Martanto, an insider, sold 363,805,600 shares of PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk at IDR 470 per share. The transaction, classified as a divestment, resulted in a decrease in Kusumo Martanto's holdings from 546,145,361 shares to 182,339,761 shares, a reduction of 363,805,600 shares.

title: Simon Hendiawan buy Shares of PT Mitra Angkasa Sejahtera Tbk
body: Director Simon Hendiawan purchased 1,600,000 shares of PT Mitra Angkasa Sejahtera Tbk at IDR 60 per share on 21 Jan 2026, increasing his stake from 4,430,000 to 6,030,000 shares (a net gain of 1,600,000 shares). The buy aligns with his personal investment strategy and signals confidence in the company's future amid government infrastructure initiatives, potentially reinforcing market perception of the firm’s growth prospects.

title: President Prabowo says Indonesia can produce DME from coal gasification to replace LPG imports and aims to end energy imports within 5–7 years
body: At the Balikpapan RDMP inauguration, President Prabowo Subianto highlighted Indonesia's coal reserves and potential to produce dimethyl ether (DME) as a domestic LPG substitute, while also noting abundant biodiesel, geothermal and hydropower resources and a target to stop importing energy commodities in the next 5–7 years. Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia added that the coal‑gasification‑to‑DME project will be finalized within a month in coordination with Danantara Investment Management Agency CEO Rosan Roeslani before groundbreaking.

title: Indonesia and UK Chambers of Commerce Commit to Boost Bilateral Trade and Investment
body: President Prabowo Subianto met with the UK Prime Minister and Deputy Prime Minister in London and announced a partnership between Indonesia’s Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Kadin) and the British Chamber of Commerce (BritCham) to expand market access, investment and technology cooperation. Kadin chairperson Anindya Bakrie said the collaboration will translate government commitments into concrete business deals that drive growth and job creation.

title: Indonesia's manpower ministry proposes labor-intensive programs to aid Sumatra disaster recovery
body: Manpower Minister Yassierli told lawmakers that volunteers are deployed and labor-intensive projects will create jobs while rebuilding infrastructure in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra, and the ministry has introduced Regulation No. 50 of 2025 to discount work‑accident insurance for affected workers for up to 15 months. The ministry also continues vocational‑training centre services and urges businesses to negotiate with workers rather than impose layoffs.

title: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara Indonesia plans to boost assets by consolidating state-owned enterprises
body: Danantara Indonesia, which currently manages about $900 billion in assets, intends to merge 1,068 state-owned enterprises into roughly 221 professionally run entities over the next three to four years to enhance efficiency and global competitiveness. The restructuring aims to support Indonesia’s goal of becoming a high‑income country by 2045 and could lift more firms, such as Pertamina and PLN, onto the Fortune Global 500 list.

title: Telkomsel launches verified Rich Communication Services (RCS) for Business in Indonesia
body: Telkomsel has introduced an RCS‑based business messaging service that lets brands send verified, interactive messages with images, videos and call‑to‑action buttons via the default messaging app, partnering with Infobip and Google for rollout. The service targets sectors such as banking, e‑commerce and retail, and aims to boost engagement and click‑through rates compared with standard SMS.

title: Indonesia's IHSG drops 1.36% amid foreign outflows and a weaker rupiah while gold hits all‑time high and US markets rise
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 1.36% to 9,010 on Jan 21, driven by a net foreign outflow of Rp 1.88 trillion, a weaker rupiah and concerns over possible new US tariffs, while gold surged to an all‑time high of $4,861 per ounce. Analysts noted bullish potential for ANTM (support 4,110‑4,180, target 4,350‑4,420), breakout prospects for PSKT and EMTK, and highlighted MNCN’s profit decline.

title: Bank Central Asia completes BBCA share buyback on 19 January 2026
body: Bank Central Asia ( BCA) announced that its BBback buyback, budgeted at Rp55 trillion and running from 22 October 2025 to 19 January 2026, has concluded, with the stock briefly rising from Rp8,200 to Rp88700 before a decline to around Rp88125 by the program's end. EVP Hera F. Haryn said no further buybacks are planned and future price movements will depend on market dynamics and BCA's business fundamentals.

title: Chitose Internasional (CINT) reports 53% YoY profit growth in Q3 2025 and outlines 2026 growth strategy
body: Chitose Internasional (CINT) posted net sales of Rp324.29 billion and net profit of Rp10.23 billion in Q3‑2025, a 53.06% year‑on‑year increase. The company will pursue sustainable growth in 2026 through stronger institutional demand, operational‑efficiency programs, production‑line modernization and expanded distribution to remote education markets.

title: United Tractors (UNTR) Announces Rp2 trillion Share Buyback Program from Jan 22 to Apr 15 2026
body: United Tractors (UNTR) will allocate a Rp2 trillion budget for a share buyback that runs from 22 January 2026 to 15 April 2026, using internal cash and complying with POJK No. 13/2023 limits of not exceeding 20% of paid‑up capital and maintaining at least 7.5% free float. After the three‑month period, the repurchased shares are intended to be held as treasury stock before any further disposition under applicable regulations.

title: Cipta Perdana Lancar (PART) obtains a Rp277.17 billion credit facility from Bank Central Asia (BBCA)
body: On 19 January 2026, Cipta Perdana Lancar (PART) signed a loan agreement with Bank Central Asia (BBCA) for a total of Rp277.17 billion, comprising working‑capital revolving credit, installment loans and investment loans with interest rates between 8.00% and 8.38% per annum. The facility, secured by assets worth Rp322.15 billion, will fund new projects, including the purchase of production machinery, tooling equipment, and raw‑material inventories to expand production capacity.

title: Multitrend (BABY) to raise Rp140.75 bn via rights issue to fund acquisition of Emway Globalindo (EGI) and in‑bring from Blooming Years Pte Ltd
body: Multitrend (BABY) announced a Rp269.98 billion transaction comprising the acquisition of Emway Globalindo (EGI) for Rp139.99 billion and an in‑bring from Blooming Years Pte Ltd of Rp129.98 billion, which will be financed through a rights issue of 238,571,825 new shares at Rp590 each, raising Rp140.75 billion (8.36% of paid‑up capital). Blooming Years Pte Ltd, the controlling shareholder with 92.35% of existing shares, will exercise all 255,077,189 subscription rights, and the company will seek shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 26 January 2026.

title: Astra Agro Lestari pays Rp571 billion administrative fine, shares tumble amid broader forest‑zone penalties
body: Astra Agro Lestari (AALI) settled a Rp571 billion administrative fine with the Satuan Tugas Penerbitan Kawasan Hutan (Satgas PKH) in December 2025, which the company says will not materially affect its financial performance. The payment contributed to a 2.61% drop in Astra Agro’s stock, while Satgas PKH has collected a total of Rp4.76 trillion in fines from 41 corporations, including a Rp2.33 trillion penalty from the Salim Group.

title: OL Master Limited cuts Visi Media Asia stake, shares plunge 9% after sale
body: OL Master Limited sold 70 million Visi Media Asia (VIVA) shares at an execution price of Rp84, raising about Rp8.25 billion and reducing its holding to 754.85 million shares (4.58%). Following the divestment, Visi Media's share price fell 9.09% to Rp60, a 22.08% drop over the past five trading days from Rp77 on 14 January 2026.

title: Asuransi Digital Bersama (YOII) plans a 16.67% right issue of 684.94 million shares to fund working capital
body: The insurer intends to issue up to 684,937,500 new shares at a nominal value of Rp100, representing 16.67% of its paid‑in capital, with proceeds earmarked for working‑capital needs and to meet the minimum equity requirement under OJK Regulation No. 23/2023. The proposal will be presented at an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on 3 March 2026, with eligibility limited to shareholders recorded by 5 February 2026.

title: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk announces Rp1 trillion 2026 bond and sukuk issuance to fund FTTH expansion
body: The company will issue up to Rp500 billion each of bonds and sukuk Ijarah in two series (370‑day and 3‑year) with a total target of Rp1 trillion, receiving irA ratings from PT Kredit Rating Indonesia. Proceeds, after issuance costs, will be loaned to its subsidiary PT Garuda Prima Internetindo for FTTH network construction in West Kalimantan, while the sukuk is backed by a 430‑km fiber optic cable asset of PT Pusat Fiber Indonesia valued at Rp928.80 billion.

title: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk begins major restructuring under new owner PT PIMSF Pulogadung, targeting Rp3 trillion in assets
body: After its acquisition by PT PIMSF Pulogadung, part of the Tjokro Group, PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk signed a CSPA to acquire assets worth about Rp700 billion from PT Morita Tjokro Gearindo and PT Jaya Indah Casting, including majority stakes in PT Pulogadung Tempajaya, PT Tjokro Bersaudara Komponenindo and PT Jakarta Marten Logamindo and related land and buildings. The deal will transform GPSO into a strategic holding and estate management company, raise its total assets to roughly Rp900 billion and equity to Rp750 billion, with a longer‑term goal of reaching Rp3 trillion in assets.

title: Bank Raya (AGRO) Introduces Uang Saku Feature to Boost Family Financial Literacy and Reports Strong Digital Growth
body: Bank Raya (AGRO), the digital arm of BRI Group, is promoting its new Uang Saku feature that lets parents monitor and manage children’s pocket money through the Raya app, offering up to five supervised sub‑accounts per child. By September 2025 the app had over 1.6 million users, with transactions up 45.4 % YoY to 3.8 million and digital savings reaching Rp 1.75 trillion, a 61.4 % YoY increase.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBNI) contributes 120 units to the first phase handover of 600 Danantara housing units in Aceh Tamiang
body: On 21 January 2026, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk. (BBNI) handed over 120 of the 600 Danantara (huntara) housing units in Aceh Tamiang, representing about 20% of the first phase, as part of a government‑backed program to deliver 15,000 post‑disaster homes in Aceh, West Sumatra and North Sumatra. The project, coordinated by Danantara Indonesia and executed by PT Hutama Karya (Persero) with other BUMN partners, includes amenities such as playgrounds, Wi‑Fi, a musala and sanitation facilities.

title: UNTR shares tumble 14.9% after the government revokes the Martabe gold mine permit, pulling down parent Astra International
body: On 21 January 2026, PT United Tractors Tbk. (UNTR) fell to the lower auto‑rejection band after the government withdrew the IUP for the Martabe gold mine operated by PT Agincourt Resources, and PT Astra International Tbk. (ASII) nearly hit its own ARB. Analysts estimate the mine could have contributed 27‑39% of UNTR’s 2026 net profit, so the revocation poses a material financial risk.

title: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk to Hold Extraordinary General Meeting for Board Restructuring
body: The company announced an Extraordinary General Meeting on 27 February 2026 to seek shareholder approval for changes to its board of directors, though the specific names of directors to be appointed or dismissed were not disclosed. PT Philip Morris Indonesia remains the controlling shareholder with 92.44% of the shares, and HMSP's stock rose 0.65% to IDR 780, marking a 5.4% gain year‑to‑date.

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO) appoints Ahmad Yani as President Director and reshuffles its board
body: At an extraordinary general meeting on 20 January 2026, shareholders approved Ahmad Yani as the new President Director of PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk (PGEO), replacing Julfi Hadi, and appointed Andi Joko Nugroho as Director of Operations. The remaining directors and the entire Board of Commissioners remain unchanged.

title: Lim Shrimp Org Pte. Ltd.'s Mandatory Tender Offer for PT Sumber Mas Konstruksi Tbk Ends Without Share Transactions
body: The mandatory tender offer launched by Lim Shrimp Org Pte. Ltd. through PT Lim Shrimp Org for up to 689,419,856 shares (55.02% of PT Sumber Mas Konstruksi Tbk's capital) ran from 10 December 2025 to 9 January 2026 but no shareholders sold any shares and the new controller did not purchase any. Consequently, Lim Shrimp Org Pte. Ltd. remains holding 313.25 million shares, representing 25% of SMKM’s paid‑up capital.

title: Treasure Global Investments Limited sells 4.9% stake in PT Bumi Resources Tbk., reducing its holding to 3.18% and pushing BUMI shares down 5.8%
body: Treasure Global Investments Limited disposed of 18,195 billion PT Bumi Resources Tbk. (BUMI) shares, equivalent to 4.9% of the company, at an average price of Rp380 per share, amounting to roughly Rp6.9 trillion. The sale lowered Treasure Global’s direct ownership from 8.08% to 3.18% and BUMI’s stock fell about 5.8% to Rp390 on the following trading day.

title: Emiten Grup Lippo, PT Lippo General Insurance Tbk. (LPGI) announces resignation of President Commissioner Kim Dong Wook and appoints Park Young Mock as successor
body: Kim Dong Wook resigned as President Commissioner of PT Lippo General Insurance Tbk. after serving since 19 January 2024, and the company appointed Park Young Mock to the role, with the appointment approved at the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on 12 December 2025. The board stated the change will not affect operations or performance and is part of strengthening corporate governance.

title: Nickel quota cut raises operational risk for PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO) but analysts keep buy recommendations
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources reduced the 2026 nickel production quota to 250‑260 million tonnes, about 30 % of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO)’s requested quota, potentially constraining ore supply for its three downstream projects. Despite the risk, analysts from Infovesta, BRI Danareksa Sekuritas and Maybank Sekuritas maintain buy ratings, targeting the stock between Rp 6,800 and Rp 8,000, citing expected ore volume growth and possible nickel price support from tighter supply.

title: Sentra Investa Maksima Sell Shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk
body: Sentra Investa Maksima sold 400,000 shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk (BMBL.JK) at IDR 54 per share on 30 Dec 2025. The holding fell from 99,770,600 to 99,370,600 shares, a decrease of 400,000 shares. The sale is classified as liquid, indicating a cash‑raising or portfolio‑rebalancing motive, and slightly reduces the shareholder’s stake in the company.

title: Sentra Investa Maksima sell Shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk
body: On 19 Jan 2026, Sentra Investa Maksima sold 600,000 shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk at IDR 61 per share, reducing its stake from 99,370,600 to 98,770,600 shares (a decrease of 600,000). The sale is classified as liquid, indicating a cash‑raising or portfolio‑rebalancing motive, and marginally lowers the shareholder's ownership percentage in the listed company.

title: Suhendra Prawira Widjaja buy Shares of PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk
body: Shareholder Suhendra Prawira Widjaja purchased a total of 6,338,600 PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk shares between 19 and 21 January 2026 at approximately IDR 1,460 per share for business purposes. His holding rose from 135,782,360 to 142,120,960 shares, a net increase of 6,338,600 shares, strengthening his ownership stake in the company.

title: Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk Shareholder Bank Of Singapore Limited Reports New Transaction
body: Bank of Singapore Limited transferred 25,000,000 shares of Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk on 19 Jan 2026 at IDR 1 per share. Its holding fell from 102,786,500 to 77,786,500 shares, a reduction of 25,000,000 shares (≈24.3%). The share transfer reduces the shareholder’s stake and may influence voting power and market perception of the company.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 13,389,300 PT Hillcon Tbk shares at IDR 160 per share on 21 Jan 2026. The transaction reduced its holding from 6,304,013,000 to 6,290,623,700 shares, a decline of 13,389,300 shares. The sale is classified as an investment purpose. This sizable insider divestment may be noted by investors as a potential signal regarding the shareholder's view on the company's valuation.

title: Null buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Bayan Resources Tbk reported that an unnamed shareholder (holder name: Null) purchased 2,000 shares on 22 Jan 2026 at IDR 17,170 per share. The stake increased from 13,406,891,770 to 13,406,893,770 shares, a net addition of 2,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment and represents a marginal change in the shareholder’s position.

title: Dua Putra Bersinergi sell Shares of PT Isra Presisi Indonesia Tbk
body: Dua Putra Bersinergi sold 100,000,000 PT Isra Presisi Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 50 per share on 21 Jan 2026, reducing its stake from 2,125,940,000 to 2,025,940,000 shares (a decline of 100,000,000 shares, about 4.7%). The divestment is recorded as a sell transaction for ISAP.JK.

title: United Tractors reports permit revocation for Agincourt Resources amid pending environmental lawsuit
body: United Tractors (UNTR) was listed among 28 companies whose licenses were revoked by the government, including Agincourt Resources (AR) for alleged forest‑area violations. AR said it has not received any official notice of the revocation or of the Ministry of Environment’s lawsuit filed in South Jakarta District Court and is coordinating with the relevant authorities.

title: Indonesia’s banking sector stabilises in 2026 with better liquidity but credit growth hampered by micro‑SME loans and flood risks
body: UOB Kay Hian (UOBKH) reports that Bank Indonesia’s IDR201 trn liquidity injection in 2025 has improved banks’ funding buffers and lowered reliance on special‑rate deposits, while loan growth slowed to mid‑single‑digit levels and credit costs are expected to stay flat to slightly higher. Nomura Securities expects credit costs to remain elevated but stable, and highlights that Sumatra floods could raise provisioning for Bank Syariah Indonesia (BRIS) and Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI).

title: Bank Indonesia announces payment system regulatory reforms to support digital economy growth
body: Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo and Deputy Governor Filianingsih Hendarta outlined new regulations (BI Regulation No. 10/2025 and Board Regulation No. 32/2025) that will take effect on March 31, 2026, introducing the TIKMI framework to strengthen industry structure, risk management and IT infrastructure. The reforms aim to sustain the rapid rise of digital transactions, which the central bank projects will reach 147.3 billion transactions by 2030.

title: Erajaya (ERAA) Announces Rp150 Billion Share Buyback Program Running Jan–Apr 2026
body: Erajaya (ERAA) will repurchase up to 20% of its paid‑up capital, allocating Rp150 billion for a phased buyback from 23 January to 23 April 2026 via the Indonesia Stock Exchange, with Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia acting as adviser. The company expects no material impact on operating costs and plans to cancel the bought‑back shares in accordance with POJK No. 13/2023.

title: President Prabowo says Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara will power growth and enable global co‑investment partnerships
body: Speaking at the World Economic Forum in Davos, President Prabowo Subianto highlighted Danantara’s $1 trillion assets under management and its role in positioning Indonesia as a "land of opportunity" for investors. He announced plans to streamline the fund’s oversight by reducing the number of state‑owned enterprises it manages from 1,044 to about 300 and to recruit foreign talent for key companies.

title: Indonesia to break ground on six downstream projects by end of January 2026
body: State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi said six downstream industrial projects will be launched by the end of January 2026 as part of the 2025–2029 National Medium‑Term Development Plan to boost the real sector and reduce reliance on raw‑material exports. The sovereign‑wealth fund Danantara Indonesia also flagged additional projects for February, covering bauxite and aluminum processing, bio‑aviation fuel, a refinery, poultry farming and a coal‑gasification plant for dimethyl ether.

title: UK and Indonesia sign maritime partnership to build 1,582 fishing vessels, projected to create up to 600,000 jobs
body: The UK-Indonesia Maritime Partnership Programme will construct 1,582 fishing vessels in Indonesia, employing roughly 600,000 people—including 30,000 crew members, 400,000 shipyard workers and 170,000 indirect jobs. The agreement, announced after talks between President Prabowo Subianto and Prime Minister Keir Starmer, aims to boost Indonesia's maritime economy, shipbuilding investment and naval capacity.

title: PT Nusa Palapa Gemilang Tbk reports 33.4% sales growth and 69% production increase in 2025, plans new fertilizer launches
body: PT Nusa Palapa Gemilang Tbk recorded a 33.4% year‑on‑year sales increase and a 69% rise in production for 2025, attributing the gains to improved production planning, process efficiency and distribution. The company will introduce Mono Potassium Phosphate (MKP) and Potassium Nitrate (KNO) products and focus on market penetration and brand strengthening in 2026.

title: Dana Pensiun (Dapen) Bank Jateng reduces its stake in Asuransi Digital Bersama by selling 42.1 million shares for Rp5.93 billion
body: On 22 January 2026, Dana Pensiun (Dapen) Bank Jateng sold 42.1 million shares of Asuransi Digital Bersama at an execution price of Rp141 per share, generating Rp5.93 billion and lowering its ownership to 7,2496% (248.36 million shares). The company previously sold 1 million shares at Rp111 per share and Asuransi Digital Bersama plans a right issue of up to 684.94 million new shares at a nominal Rp100 to fund working capital.

title: Darma Henwa (DEWA) allocates Rp590 bn for share buyback, leaving Rp360 bn unspent
body: Darma Henwa (DEWA) used Rp590 bn of its Rp950 bn buyback budget to purchase 1.04 bn shares in four transactions between 10 Dec 2025 and 22 Jan 2026, leaving a remaining budget of Rp359.99 bn. Following the buyback, the Bakrie Group’s shares fell 70 points, or 9.52%, to Rp665 per share.

title: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd sells 8.26 million Lovina Beach Brewery (STRK) shares at Rp229 each, reducing its holding to 15.96%
body: On 15 January 2026, Phillip Securities Pte Ltd disposed of 8.26 million Lovina Beach Brewery (STRK) shares at an execution price of Rp229 per share, costing about Rp1.89 billion, which is above the closing price of Rp220. After the sale, its stake fell to 1.71 billion shares (15.96% of the company), a 0.07‑percentage‑point decrease.

title: Rama Indonesia to Acquire 59.24% Stake in Dua Putra Utama Makmur from Pandawa Putra Investama
body: Rama Indonesia is negotiating to purchase a 59.24% share of the paid‑up capital of Dua Putra Utama Makmur from current controller Pandawa Putra Investama, which would make Rama Indonesia the new controlling shareholder. The parties are still finalising the purchase price and closing timeline, and Rama Indonesia will conduct a mandatory tender offer in accordance with OJK Regulation No. 9/2018, with no expected negative impact on the company’s operations or finances.

title: RMK Energy shares surge after suspension lift, spurred by strong investor buying and supportive logistics policies
body: RMK Energy (RMKE) stock jumped from the reopening price of Rp7,875 to close at Rp8,725 after trading resumed, driven by net buying of about Rp59.8 billion by Henan Putihrai Sekuritas and positive sentiment from new South Sumatra coal‑transport regulations. The company also completed an oversubscribed sustainable bond issuance of up to Rp600 billion (7.75% 5‑yr and 8.25% 7‑yr) and CEO Bernadus Wijaya of Sucor Sekuritas highlighted its integrated logistics assets and coal concessions as long‑term growth catalysts.

title: PT Bank Nationalnobu Tbk. Holds Extraordinary General Meeting, Appoints New Directors and Independent Commissioner
body: On 15 January 2026, PT Bank Nationalnobu Tbk. held an extraordinary shareholders' meeting with quorum representing 6,346,350,141 shares (84.86% of voting rights) and approved the respectful termination of Director Andrian Meirawan Saputra. The meeting also appointed Patrick Nai-Chung Chang as an Independent Commissioner and Lee Joo Hwan as a Director, with their terms lasting until the close of the third annual shareholders' meeting following the 2023 RUPST.

title: PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk’s subsidiary BUMA SG invests $29.16 million to maintain its 19.44% stake in 29Metals Limited
body: On 20 January 2026, Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama Pte. Ltd. (BUMA SG) subscribed to 72.9 million new shares of 29Metals Limited at US$0.40 each, totaling US$29.16 million, to keep its ownership at 19.44%. The purchase raised BUMA SG’s shareholding from 266.8 million to 339.7 million shares, and the transaction was treated as an affiliate deal exempt from certain POJK 42/2020 requirements.

title: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) signs MOU for co‑investment in over 10 feature films with major Indonesian studios
body: Folago Pictures, the film unit of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX), signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Visinema Pictures, MVP Pictures, VMS Pictures, Tiger Wong Entertainment and KUY STUDIO to co‑invest in more than 10 feature films through an asset‑light model, targeting up to 200% revenue growth. The partnership aims to create a mid‑term content pipeline through 2026, positioning IRSX as a capital, distribution and scaling partner rather than a competing production house.

title: PT Perma Plasindo Tbk (BINO) secures Rp35 billion sales contract with PT Deli Group Indonesia Jakarta through subsidiary PT Bino Mitra Sejati (BMS)
body: PT Bino Mitra Sejati (BMS), a subsidiary of PT Perma Plasindo Tbk (BINO), signed a contract on 22 January 2026 to supply Bantex brand notebooks to PT Deli Group Indonesia Jakarta, valued at Rp35 billion for the 2026 year. Payment is due 100% within 120 days after delivery and acceptance, and the transaction is stated to have no conflict of interest or material impact on the company's finances.

title: Pefindo assigns idA rating to PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk's 2025 Series A bond amid strong liquidity
body: PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia (Pefindo) gave an idA rating to PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA)'s Rp824.95 billion 3‑year bond maturing on 22 April 2026, noting the company will repay using internal funds and third‑party financing. As of end‑November 2025, MBMA held USD177 million in cash and an undrawn USD140 million revolving credit facility, which Pefindo said provides adequate liquidity to meet the obligation.

title: PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk aims for OJK effective merger date of March 13, 2026 with Eka Mas Republik
body: PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (MORA) has applied to the Ministry of Communication and Digital for radio‑frequency spectrum transfer and merger approval, targeting principle approval before the OJK declares the merger effective, with OJK review set for a March 13, 2026 effective date. The merger, expected to become effective on April 22, 2026, will be notified to the KPPU, which has a statutory 90‑day approval period.

title: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk reports 49.8% revenue growth and strong property sales in FY2025, targeting continued expansion in 2026
body: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk (Paradise Indonesia) posted a 49.8% YoY revenue increase to Rp1.31 trillion and net profit of Rp493.9 billion in Q3‑2025, driven by a Rp500 billion investment gain from its joint venture with Hankyu Hanshin Properties and robust sales of Antasari Place, of which 80% of units were sold. The company also expanded the 23 Paskal Shopping Center by over 6,600 m² and said it will focus on further commercial projects in Semarang and Balikpapan to sustain growth into 2026.

title: PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk. signs 10‑year MoU with United Imaging Healthcare to deploy Integrated CT‑Linac technology
body: PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk., via its MRCCC Siloam Semanggi, launched Integrated CT‑Linac equipment at a Indonesia‑China collaboration event in Jakarta and signed a MoU with United Imaging Healthcare for a up‑to‑10‑year supply of machines valued at about Rp100 billion each. PT Multipolar Technology Tbk. will serve as the local partner to integrate AI solutions, with gradual rollout planned across Siloam hospitals.

title: PT Soho Global Health Tbk and PT Eastparc Hotel Tbk announce interim cash dividend payments on Jan 22, 2026
body: PT Soho Global Health Tbk will pay an interim dividend of Rp420.09 billion (Rp33.1 per share) and PT Eastparc Hotel Tbk will pay Rp23.11 billion (Rp5.6 per share) to shareholders of record on 8 January 2026; as of 14:22 WIB, SOHO shares fell 5.72% to Rp2,800 while EAST shares rose 2.08% to Rp98, despite year‑to‑date moves of +104.4% and –6.7% respectively.

title: BPJPH calls for stronger regulations and coordination ahead of Indonesia's Mandatory Halal 2026 rollout
body: BPJPH chief Ahmad Haikal Hasan emphasized the need to strengthen regulations, simplify halal certification, digitize services, and improve inter‑agency coordination before the mandatory halal policy takes effect in October 2026. He said the policy aims to protect consumers and boost the competitiveness of Indonesian food, beverage, raw material, additive, and related service products, especially for micro and small enterprises.

title: Indonesia targets zero solar imports by 2026 and aims to eliminate gasoline and jet‑fuel imports by 2027 through rising biodiesel mandates
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources reported that mandatory biodiesel blending rose from B30 in 2021 to B40 in 2025, achieving 14.2 million kiloliters—105.2 % of the 13.5 million‑kiloliter target—and reducing solar imports by about 3.3 million kiloliters, creating a surplus of roughly 1.4 million kiloliters. Leveraging this surplus, the government plans to stop solar imports in 2026 and to end imports of mid‑ and high‑octane gasoline and jet fuel by 2027.

title: Indonesia aims for 610,000 bpd oil lifting in 2026 amid technical challenges
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources announced a target of 610,000 barrels per day of oil lifting for 2026, up from the 605,300 bpd achieved in 2025, despite a recent pipeline leak that cost about 2 million barrels. To meet the goal, the government will reactivate old wells, fast‑track permits for over 40,000 community wells, apply Enhanced Oil Recovery at Pertamina’s Block Rokan and Exxonmobil’s Banyu Urip fields, and accelerate development of more than 100 new oil blocks.

title: PT PLN (Persero) launches digital power‑increase service through PLN Mobile app
body: Customers can now apply for additional electricity capacity directly via the PLN Mobile application, which handles the request, cost calculation, payment and real‑time tracking digitally. Executive Vice President Gregorius Adi Trianto said the service aims to provide a transparent, fast and reliable solution for households and businesses.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sells 13.4 million Hillcon shares but retains controlling stake
body: On 21 January 2026, Hillcon Equity Management sold 13,389,300 ordinary shares of PT Hillcon Tbk at Rp160 per share, amounting to roughly Rp2.14 billion and reducing its ownership from 42.76% to 42.67% of voting rights. The shareholder affirmed it will continue to hold a controlling position in the mining and construction firm.

title: Antam gold prices rise to Rp2.88 million per gram, buyback price climbs to Rp2.715 million
body: On Friday, the price of Aneka Tambang (Antam) gold increased by Rp90,000 per gram to Rp2,880,000, while the buyback price rose by Rp80,000 to Rp2,715,000 per gram, according to logammulia.com. The article also provides the updated prices for Antam gold pieces ranging from 1 gram to 1,000 grams.

title: PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk. (ERAA) Prepares Rp150 Billion for Share Buyback Amidst Market Fluctuations.
body: PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk. (ERAA) plans a share buyback, allocating Rp150 billion, over three months from January 23, 2026, to April 23, 2026, in response to significant market fluctuations. The company, with PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk. as agent, expects no material negative impact on its business or revenue due to adequate capital and cash flow.

title: Buana Graha Utama buy Shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk
body: Buana Graha Utama purchased a total of 310,400 shares of Multi Indocitra Tbk between 20‑22 Jan 2026 at around IDR 570 per share. The buy raised its holding from 289,703,618 to 290,014,018 shares, a net increase of 310,400 shares (≈0.11%). The transaction is classified as an investment, indicating confidence in the company’s prospects and slightly strengthening the shareholder’s stake.

title: Tjoe Mien Sasminto sell Shares of Sidomulyo Selaras Tbk
body: On 15 Jan 2026, shareholder Tjoe Mien Sasminto sold 18,000,000 Sidomulyo Selaras Tbk shares at IDR 110 per share for personal reasons. His holding decreased from 1,195,214,644 to 1,177,214,644 shares, a reduction of 18,000,000 shares (≈1.5% of his stake). The transaction reflects a modest divestment without immediate impact on company control.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Buy Shares of PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk.
body: Prajogo Pangestu executed a buy transaction of 900,000 shares in PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk. (BREN.JK) on 23 January 2026, increasing his holding from 140,789,700 to 141,689,700 shares, a net gain of 900,000 shares. The purchase was made at an average price of about IDR 9,275 per share. The move signals continued confidence in the renewable energy company and strengthens the shareholder’s stake, potentially influencing future strategic decisions.

title: Gilarsi Wahju Setijono sell Shares of PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk
body: Gilarsi Wahju Setijono sold a total of 12,500,000 shares of PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk on 22 Jan 2026 at a representative price of IDR 1,030 per share, amounting to a divestment of roughly IDR 12.9 billion. His holding fell from 25,000,000 to 12,500,000 shares, a 50% reduction in ownership. The transaction is classified as a divestment, indicating a strategic exit or reallocation of capital. The sizable share reduction may lower the shareholder’s voting influence and could be noted by investors monitoring ownership concentration in VKTR.

title: Martin Suharlie buy Shares of PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk
body: On 21 Jan 2026, shareholder Martin Suharlie purchased 99,100 shares of PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk at IDR 580 per share for an investment purpose. His holding increased from 70,777,500 to 70,876,600 shares, a net gain of 99,100 shares, reflecting a modest stake expansion and signaling confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Buy Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: Prajogo Pangestu purchased 2,500,000 shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk on 2026‑01‑23 at IDR 1,735.0 per share, increasing his stake from 94,521,150,000 to 94,523,650,000 shares (+25,000,000). The purchase was for personal investment purposes. The transaction represents a modest addition to an already large holding and does not materially alter the shareholder’s control or the company’s ownership structure.

title: Prajogo Pangestu Buy Shares of Barito Pacific Tbk
body: Prajogo Pangestu executed a buy transaction of 5,000,000 shares in Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT.JK) on 23 January 2026, purchasing shares at an average price of IDR 2,560 per share for investment purposes. The acquisition increased his stake from 66,901,030,165 shares to 66,906,030,165 shares, a net gain of 5,000,000 shares. This modest increase underscores continued confidence in the company’s prospects and slightly augments his voting influence in the shareholder register.

title: Iwan Hadiantoro Buy Shares of United Tractors Tbk
body: Iwan Hadiantoro purchased 40,000 shares of United Tractors Tbk on 21 January 2026, increasing his stake from 168,100 to 208,100 shares (a 23.8% rise). The transaction was executed at IDR 27,250.0 per share, totaling roughly IDR 1,090,000,000. This investment move raises his ownership to about 8.3% of the company, potentially giving him greater influence in corporate decisions and reflecting confidence in the firm’s growth prospects.

title: Southern Cross Textileindustry Sell Shares of PT Trisula Textile Industries Tbk
body: Southern Cross Textileindustry sold 8,000,000 shares of PT Trisula Textile Industries Tbk on 15 and 19 January 2026, reducing its holding from 724,249,700 to 716,249,700 shares. The sale, executed for investment purposes, was priced around IDR 110.0 per share. The transaction reflects a portfolio adjustment, modestly decreasing Southern Cross's stake in the textile firm without altering control dynamics.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: On 20 Jan 2026, shareholder Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sold 78,090,000 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk (WINR.JK) at IDR 60 per share as a divestment. The holding decreased from 3,642,085,000 to 3,563,995,000 shares, a reduction of 78,090,000 shares, indicating a modest shrinkage of its stake in the company.

title: SGX proposes cutting board lot sizes for $10‑$100 stocks to boost investor participation
body: The Singapore Exchange (SGX) plans to reduce the standard board lot size from 100 to 10 units for securities priced between $10 and $100, aiming to lower the minimum investment threshold and attract more investors. Industry participants view the change as a positive step, though they note it is only one element of broader efforts to make the local market more appealing.

title: Null buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On 23 Jan 2026, the shareholder identified as Null purchased 3,700 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk at IDR 16,996 per share for investment purposes. The holding increased from 13,406,893,770 to 13,406,897,470 shares, a net addition of 3,700 shares, representing a marginal change in ownership.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey buy Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: On 22 Jan 2026, shareholder Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 300,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk at IDR 3,078 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 2,631,700 to 2,931,700 shares, a net increase of 300,000 shares. The transaction raises his ownership stake and reflects confidence in the company's copper and gold assets, potentially supporting future capital projects.

title: Kurnyatjan Sakti Efendie sell Shares of PT Pelayaran Kurnia Lautan Semesta Tbk
body: On 20 Jan 2026, shareholder Kurnyatjan Sakti Efendie sold 120,000,000 PT Pelayaran Kurnia Lautan Semesta Tbk shares at IDR 102 per share, reducing his stake from 2,731,997,395 to 2,611,997,395 shares (a decrease of 120,000,000 shares). The transaction is classified as a disinvestment and reflects a reduction in ownership concentration, potentially signaling the shareholder's strategic reallocation of capital.

title: Junichiro Waide sell Shares of PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk
body: Junichiro Waide sold a total of 4,610,000 VTNY shares between 21‑23 Jan 2026 as a portfolio adjustment. The sales were executed at approximately IDR 95 per share, reducing his holding from 1,274,416,974 to 1,269,806,974 shares. The transaction represents a modest decline in his stake in PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk, reflecting a strategic rebalancing of his investment portfolio.

title: Fancy Marsiana buy Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 23 Jan 2026, shareholder Fancy Marsiana purchased 5,700,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk at IDR 60 per share, increasing her holding from 56,800,000 to 62,500,000 shares. The transaction, aimed at increasing the number of shares owned, raises her stake by 5,700,000 shares, reflecting a notable expansion of ownership in the company.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 22-23 January 2026, shareholder Jemmy Kurniawan sold a total of 8,947,800 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk shares at representative prices around IDR 87 per share, reducing his holding from 978,610,000 to 969,662,200 shares (a decline of 8,947,800 shares). The transaction is classified as a reduction of the number of shares owned. This insider divestment may signal a shift in personal exposure but does not directly affect the company's capital structure.

title: Sentra Amanah Ventura buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Sentra Amanah Ventura purchased 55,000 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk at a representative price of IDR 158 per share as part of its investment strategy. The transaction raised the shareholder's holding from 735,150,000 to 735,205,000 shares, a net increase of 55,000 shares, indicating a marginal stake expansion without materially altering overall ownership structure.

title: Andrew Sanusi sell Shares of PT Jaya Swarasa Agung Tbk
body: Andrew Sanusi sold 3,100,000 shares of PT Jaya Swarasa Agung Tbk at IDR 103 per share on 23 Jan 2026, reducing his holding from 55,324,400 to 52,224,400 shares (a decrease of 3,100,000 shares). The sale, cited for diversification, lowers his ownership percentage but he remains a significant shareholder.

title: SGX‑Nasdaq dual‑listing bridge sets S$2 billion market‑cap threshold to attract sizable, liquid issuers
body: The Singapore Exchange’s dual‑listing bridge with Nasdaq will require issuers to have at least S$2 billion in market capitalisation, targeting Nasdaq‑listed or Nasdaq‑ready firms with strong governance and liquidity. Analysts say the size filter ensures institutional depth and reduces execution and systemic risks for both markets.

title: SGX-listed pawnbrokers surge as gold prices rally, with MoneyMax Financial leading gains
body: Shares of Singapore Exchange pawnbrokers such as MoneyMax Financial, ValueMax, CNMC Goldmine and Aspial Lifestyle jumped on Jan 26, with MoneyMax up 13.2% on the day, 40.2% year‑to‑date and nearly 330% over the past year after receiving in‑principle approval to move to the mainboard. Analysts note that higher gold prices—up about 65% in 2025 and 15% so far this year—boost the value of the gold collateral these firms hold, driving loan growth, interest income and a strong correlation (0.5‑0.8) between pawnbroker share prices and gold.

title: Singapore's Straits Times Index hits record high of 4,912.46 as DBS and OCBC lead gains ahead of Fed meeting
body: The Straits Times Index rose to a historic 4,912.46, driven by more than 1% gains in DBS (up 1.3% to S$59.06) and OCBC (up 1% to S$21.25), with other blue‑chip stocks such as Singtel, Yangzijiang Shipbuilding and Wilmar International also trading higher. The rally comes before the U.S. Federal Reserve’s two‑day meeting, where rates are expected to stay steady, and analysts project the STI could reach 5,400 by end‑2026.

title: SGX-Nasdaq dual listing bridge offers Temasek and GIC portfolio firms a cost‑effective path to US and Singapore markets
body: The new SGX‑Nasdaq dual listing bridge lets companies list on both exchanges simultaneously, reducing cost and complexity compared with separate listings. Temasek and GIC portfolio companies such as Grab, Sea and Gogoro are positioned to benefit most from the framework.

title: Toku to raise S$13.7 million via SGX Catalist listing, targeting expansion
body: Toku will raise net proceeds of S$13.7 million by offering 65 million shares at S$0.25 each on the SGX Catalist board, giving it a post‑listing market capitalisation of S$142.6 million. Founder and CEO Thomas Laboulle says the listing is a stepping stone to accelerate the company’s expansion and enhance its customer‑experience platform’s profile with large enterprises.

title: SGX explores launch of Asian sovereign bond futures for multiple countries by early 2026
body: SGX held calls with global bank treasury officials about introducing three‑, five‑ and ten‑year futures on Indian, Indonesian, Malaysian, Philippine and Thai government bonds, settled in US dollars and priced on a basket of up to three sovereign yields. The bourse aims to roll out the products in the first half of 2026, with India’s contracts linked to the Fully Accessible Route after overseas investors poured $21 billion into its sovereign bonds since inclusion in JPMorgan Chase’s index in June 2024.

title: MAS proposes regulatory changes for SGX‑Nasdaq dual‑listing bridge as Nam Lee shareholders remove chairman
body: The Monetary Authority of Singapore proposed legislative and regulatory amendments to facilitate a SGX‑Nasdaq dual‑listing bridge, including a single prospectus and earlier retail investor engagement. Shareholders of Nam Lee Pressed Metal Industries voted to remove chairman Joanna Yong, sending Nam Lee shares up 3.1% to S$0.66.

title: MAS and SGX open consultations on dual‑listing rules for Nasdaq and Singapore’s Global Listing Board
body: On Jan 9, the Monetary Authority of Singapore began a public consultation on amendments to the Securities and Futures Act and draft regulations that would allow companies to list simultaneously on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and SGX’s new Global Listing Board using a single prospectus. The same day, SGX Regulation released a separate consultation on the GLB listing rule book, outlining admission criteria and ongoing issuer requirements.

title: Retail investors pour billions into SGX-listed ETFs and local banks in 2025
body: Retail investors recorded S$2.6 billion of net inflows into Singapore stocks in 2025, with the Amova-StraitsTrading Asia ex-Japan Reit Index ETF (S$216 million) and Lion-Phillip S-Reit ETF (S$170 million) topping ETF purchases and SPDR Gold Shares ranking third at S$141 million. DBS Group Holdings, UOB and OCBC together attracted close to S$3.9 billion, highlighted by an S$826 million surge in DBS shares during mid‑April, while other REIT ETFs and the Straits Times Index also saw strong net retail flows.

title: Rizki Indrakusuma sell Shares of PT Archi Indonesia Tbk
body: On 26 Jan 2026, shareholder Rizki Indrakusuma sold 13,190,800 PT Archi Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 2,030 per share, reducing his holding from 25,200,000 to 12,009,200 shares, a decline of roughly 48%. The sale, valued at approximately IDR 26.8 billion, is stated to diversify his investment portfolio and marks a significant shift in ownership concentration for the listed company.

title: Prinsep Management Limited buy Shares of PT FAP Agri Tbk
body: Prinsep Management Limited purchased 240,924,800 shares of PT FAP Agri Tbk on 2026-01-23 at IDR 4,300 per share, spending approximately IDR 1,035,976,640,000. The shareholder's holding rose from 2,637,717,530 to 2,878,642,330 shares, a net increase of 240,924,800 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding Prinsep Management's ownership stake in the agribusiness company and signaling confidence in its future performance.

title: Patsnap Mulls Dual Hong Kong‑Singapore Listing While Singapore IPO Activity Hits Six‑Year High
body: Intellectual‑property data provider Patsnap, backed by HongShan Capital, SoftBank Group and Tencent Holdings, is considering a dual listing in Hong Kong and Singapore to raise between US$300 million and US$400 million, with details on size, timing and venues still under discussion. Meanwhile, first‑time share sales in Singapore reached a six‑year high in 2025 as the city‑state allocates part of its S$5 billion equity‑market revival fund, and Hong Kong Exchanges & Clearing seeks to attract more non‑Chinese issuers.

title: Jimmy Tandyo sell Shares of PT AKR Corporindo Tbk.
body: Jimmy Tandyo, a major shareholder of PT AKR Corporindo Tbk. (AKRA.JK), sold a total of 1,750,000 shares over 26‑27 Jan 2026 at prices of IDR 1,340 and IDR 1,385 per share, respectively (representative price IDR 1,385). His holding fell from 48,000,000 to 46,250,000 shares, a decrease of 1,750,000 shares. The sale, classified as an investment‑related divestment, reduces his ownership percentage and may signal portfolio rebalancing.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 26 January 2026, shareholder Jemmy Kurniawan sold a total of 3,373,700 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk shares at prices between IDR 91 and IDR 99 per share, with a representative price of IDR 91 per share. The transaction reduced his holding from 969,662,200 to 966,288,500 shares, a decline of 3,373,700 shares. The stated purpose is a reduction of the number of shares held. This insider divestment lowers Kurniawan's ownership percentage and may be noted by investors monitoring insider activity.

title: Hoo Anton Siswanto buy Shares of PT Esta Indonesia Tbk
body: On 27 Jan 2026, shareholder Hoo Anton Siswanto purchased 19,700,000 PT Esta Indonesia Tbk (NEST.JK) shares at IDR 410 per share, increasing his holding from 3,290,546,700 to 3,310,246,700 shares (a net gain of 19,700,000 shares).
