The transaction is classified as a buy for long‑term investment, indicating confidence in the company's future prospects and marginally raising the insider's ownership stake.

title: Triyanto Sukses Mandiri sell Shares of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk
body: On 26 January 2026, shareholder Triyanto Sukses Mandiri sold its entire holding of 164,000,000 PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk (GRPM.JK) shares at IDR 120 per share, reducing its stake from 164,000,000 to 0 shares (a divestment of 164,000,000 shares). The purpose is listed as divestment, representing a complete exit by the shareholder and potentially affecting the company’s shareholder composition.

title: Agus Susanto buy Shares of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk
body: On 26 Jan 2026, shareholder Agus Susanto purchased 152,614,100 shares of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk (GRPM.JK) at IDR 120 per share. The acquisition raises his holding from zero to 152,614,100 shares, reflecting a full entry into the company's equity. The transaction is classified as a divestment purpose, indicating a strategic reallocation of capital. This sizable buy‑in may signal confidence in GRPM's prospects and could affect the stock's liquidity and price dynamics for Indonesian investors.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: On 28 January 2026, Prajogo Pangestu purchased an additional 7,000,000 shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN.JK) for personal investment, with transactions executed at prices ranging from IDR 1,525 to IDR 1,580 per share; a representative price is IDR 1,555 per share. The shareholder's holding increased from 94,523,650,000 shares to 94,530,650,000 shares, a net rise of 7,000,000 shares, representing a marginal change in overall ownership. The acquisition underscores Pangestu's continued confidence in the company and may slightly boost market perception of insider support.

title: SGX approves reduced board lot sizes for 13 stocks, allowing investors to buy in lots of 10
body: SGX confirmed that 13 listed companies—including local banks DBS, OCBC and UOB as well as Jardine Matheson, SGX, Venture and Keppel—will have their standard board lot size cut from 100 to 10 shares for stocks priced between S$10 and S$100. The change, effective mid‑2026, is expected to boost affordability, with the qualifying stocks generating S$542 million in daily turnover in 2025 (up 30% YoY) and representing 36.9% of total trading activity.

title: Singapore market rally lifts STI to record as investor participation widens beyond blue‑chips
body: The STI rose 5.4% to a record 4,909 points as investor participation broadened beyond blue‑chips, with 100 Singapore‑listed stocks posting at least $1 million average daily turnover in January, driven by IPOs such as Toku and The Assembly Place and strong institutional buying in firms like Embracing Future Holdings, PC Partner, Raffles Education and several technology names. Analysts also highlighted AI‑infrastructure beneficiaries including Keppel DC Reit, Mapletree Industrial Trust, CapitaLand Ascendas Reit, Sembcorp Industries, Singtel and others, while the government pledged $1 billion for AI research through 2030.

title: Indonesia adds 33 seafood processors to export list for Taiwan and South Korea
body: Indonesia’s fisheries ministry said 33 more processing units, including facilities such as PT Kelola Mina Samudra, have been granted export approval, bringing the total eligible processors to 711 for Taiwan and 710 for South Korea. In 2025 the two markets received 57,308 tons to Taiwan (US$106.3 million) and 26,107 tons to South Korea (US$87.3 million), and the ministry is also preparing zero‑tariff access for tuna exports to Japan.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange temporarily suspends trading of PT Buana Artha Anugerah Tbk after abnormal price surge
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily halted trading of PT Buana Artha Anugerah Tbk on Thursday, January 29, 2026, after the stock jumped 24.8% to Rp780, reaching the auto‑rejection upper limit while most other stocks fell sharply. This is the third suspension for the stock, following similar halts on December 1 and 3, 2025, and trading will resume only when sufficient information is provided.

title: Prajogo Pangestu expands stake in Petrindo Jaya Kreasi to over 84% after 7 million‑share purchase
body: On 28 January 2026, Prajogo Pangestu bought a total of 7 million shares of Petrindo Jaya Kreasi (CUAN) in twelve transactions, spending roughly IDR 10.7‑11.0 billion and raising his ownership to 84.09% (94.53 billion shares). The CUAN share price fell 12.36% to IDR 1,560 during trading, marking a 31.88% decline from the start of the year.

title: Null buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On 2026-01-28, an investor identified as Null purchased 14,200 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk at IDR 15,756 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised the holder's stake from 13,406,897,470 to 13,406,911,670 shares, a net increase of 14,200 shares, indicating a marginal adjustment in ownership without material impact on the company's share structure.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources starts heap leach irrigation at Pani Gold Mine, targeting first‑quarter 2026 production
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk announced that heap leach irrigation began at its Pani Gold Mine on 27 January 2026, keeping first‑quarter 2026 gold output on track and confirming that the ADR plant is ready for processing. The company also accelerated construction of a 12‑million‑tonne‑per‑year Carbon‑in‑Leach facility, and the mine holds an ore reserve of about 4.8 million ounces of gold, supporting a potential peak production of over 500,000 ounces annually.

title: Indonesia targets global investment in maritime and fisheries at Bali's Ocean Impact Summit 2026
body: Indonesia will host the Ocean Impact Summit (OIS) 2026 in Bali on June 8‑9, with support from the World Economic Forum, to attract investment commitments, private‑sector partnerships and financing for its blue economy. The summit aims to shift the maritime narrative from pure conservation toward using maritime resources for innovation, job creation and sustainable economic growth.

title: Merdeka Gold Resources eyes Hong Kong listing while gold mine project targets 2026 production
body: Merdeka Gold Resources is exploring a potential Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing, having reportedly engaged Citic Seurities Co, Morgan Stanley and UBSS Group AG, but the company says the plan is still in early discussion with no material details disclosed. The firm operates the Pani gold mine in Gorontalo, targeting first production in Q1‑2026, and its shares traded flat at around Rp6,900‑7,250 amid a 7.35% drop in the IHSG.

title: RMK Energy to Issue IDR 600 Billion Sustainable Bonds in Two Tranches with Fixed Coupons
body: RMK Energy will issue IDR 600 billion of sustainable bonds in two series—Series A of IDR 450 billion at a 7.75% fixed coupon for five years and Series B of IDR 150 billion at 8.25% for seven years, with quarterly interest starting May 2026 and bullet repayment in 2031 and 2033. After deducting 31.67% issuance costs, the net proceeds will be loaned to Royaltama Multi Komoditi Nusantara, also known as RMKN, for coal procurement; to Royaltama Mulia Kencana, also known as RMUK, for working capital; and to its subsidiary RMUK for capital expansion, with the offering scheduled for February 2026 on the IDX.

title: Rukun Raharja RAJA announces a 250 billion rupiah share buyback program for Happy Hapsoro
body: Rukun Raharja RAJA has allocated Rp250 billion for a share buyback of Happy Hapsoro, to be executed between 28 January and 28 April 2026 via the Indonesia Stock Exchange and off‑exchange transactions. The buyback will not exceed 20 % of the issued capital, will be funded from internal cash, and the repurchased shares will be held as treasury stock without voting rights.

title: Darma Henwa DEWA reports a 495% jump in net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2025
body: Darma Henwa DEWA posted a net profit of Rp234.6 billion for the quarter, up 494.72% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share rising to Rp6.34. Revenue reached Rp4.65 trillion and total assets grew to Rp10.83 trillion, reflecting strong top‑line and balance‑sheet expansion.

title: Saiko Consultancy Pte Ltd cancels planned acquisition of 27.83% stake in Soraya Berjaya Indonesia
body: Saiko Consultancy Pte Ltd announced it has withdrawn its intention to acquire 222.6 million shares, representing up to 27.83% of Soraya Berjaya Indonesia, with no disclosed reason and no adverse impact on the issuer’s operations or finances. The cancellation follows ongoing negotiations with the current controlling shareholder Rizet Ramawi, and any future acquisition would be subject to POJK 9/2018 tender‑offer requirements.

title: Bank Central Asia BBCA plans a Rp5 trillion share buyback approved at its 2026 AGM
body: Bank Central Asia BBCA announced a planned share buyback of up to Rp5 trillion, to be approved at its AGM on 12 March 2026 and executed within 12 months using internal funds, underwritten by BCA Sekuritas, with limits of 10 % of paid‑up capital and a minimum 7.5 % free float. Following the announcement, the stock fell 6.33 % to Rp7,025, a 12.46 % decline year‑to‑date from the Jan 2 2026 level of Rp8,025.

title: Bank Tabungan Negara launches BTN Expo 2026 showcasing an integrated housing, lifestyle and business ecosystem
body: Bank Tabungan Negara (BBTN) inaugurated BTN Expo 2026, promoting an ecosystem model that links affordable housing, sustainable development, UMKM participation, talent recruitment and digital finance solutions. The expo also hosted the BTN Housingpreneur 2025 award, a culinary and fashion festival, and a Ruangguru‑sponsored competition that drew young participants such as graduate Dzikrina Aulia.

title: Poh Holdings Pte Ltd completes mandatory tender offer for PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk with low shareholder participation
body: Poh Holdings Pte Ltd, through PT Poh Investments Indonesia, launched a mandatory tender offer for up to 1,288,451,545 shares (59.73% of PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk’s capital) from 19 Dec 2025 to 18 Jan 2026, but only eight shareholders tendered 53,300 shares (0.00%). After settlement on 27 Jan 2026, Poh Holdings Pte Ltd holds 773,352,631 shares (35.85%) of PT Techno9 Indonesia Tbk while PT Poh Investments Indonesia holds 53,300 shares (0.00%).

title: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk launches shared service center PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi to centralize back‑office functions
body: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk announced that its newly operating PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) will serve as a shared service center to centralize finance, human resources, procurement and customer operations for the Chandra Asri Group, initially supporting Aster Chemical & Energy Pte Ltd, a joint venture with Glencore. The move aims to improve process standardization, operational flexibility and cost efficiency across Indonesian and regional entities, with plans to expand CASS staff to 200 or more.

title: PT Bundamedik Tbk targets double-digit revenue growth in 2026 with integrated, sustainable health services
body: PT Bundamedik Tbk highlighted its shift toward integrated, life‑cycle health services, noting the launch of kidney transplantation and Southeast Asia's first robotic skin‑sparing mastectomy in 2025. The company projects double‑digit revenue growth for 2026 while maintaining profitability, healthy cash flow, and gradually expanding bed capacity through 2027.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk posts 4.9% net profit growth in 2025 and receives buy recommendation from BRIDanareksa Sekuritas
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk reported a net profit of Rp57.5 trillion for 2025, up 4.9% year‑on‑year, supported by a 4.0% rise in net interest income to Rp85.8 trillion and a 7.7% reduction in operating expenses. Despite sector challenges, BRIDanareksa Sekuritas and Bloomberg analysts maintain buy ratings, targeting Rp10,800 and Rp10,266 per share respectively, and project 2026 net profit of at least Rp61.8 trillion.

title: PT Paramita Bangun Sarana Tbk aims for Rp202 billion net profit in 2025 after strong Q3 results
body: PT Paramita Bangun Sarana Tbk reported a net profit of Rp158 billion for the first three quarters of 2025 and reaffirmed its target of Rp202 billion net profit for the full year, citing solid performance and rising revenue projected at Rp1.38 trillion. The company noted that liabilities grew proportionally with higher operational volume, supported by extended supplier credit, reflecting partner confidence.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk and PT Pos Indonesia sign MoU to expand affordable internet services across Indonesia
body: On 27 January 2026, PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk, also known as Surge, and PT Pos Indonesia signed a memorandum of understanding to jointly develop integrated digital services by using Pos Indonesia’s nationwide branch network and infrastructure. The collaboration aims to broaden the reach of Surge’s low‑cost internet offerings, improve operational efficiency, and support Indonesia’s digital transformation agenda.

title: Garuda Indonesia launches GOTF 2026 with up to 65% ticket discounts and Bank Mandiri partnership
body: Garuda Indonesia, together with Bank Mandiri, is holding its first 2026 Garuda Indonesia Online Travel Fair (GOTF) from Jan 29 to Feb 4, offering 140 000 domestic and international seats with ticket discounts of up to 65% and a welcome bonus of 1 000 miles for new members. Bank Mandiri will provide cardholders discounts up to Rp3.5 million, cashback up to Rp500 thousand and up to 12‑month installments, while special route fares start from around Rp1.8 million to Rp13.7 million.

title: PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk announces up to Rp150 billion share buyback to be executed Jan–Apr 2026
body: PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk will repurchase shares worth up to Rp150 billion between 23 January and 23 April 2026 through PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk, using internal cash and complying with OJK limits of no more than 20% of paid‑up capital and a minimum 7.5% free float. Analyst Rully Arya Wisnubroto of PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia noted the buyback reflects a valuation‑driven approach and does not affect the company’s liquidity, while the group continues to expand its business through Erajaya Active Lifestyle and Erajaya Food & Nourishment.

title: Indonesia's IHSG trading halt repeats, finance minister says the shock is temporary
body: The Jakarta Stock Exchange (PT Bursa Efek Indonesia) halted trading of the IHSG after it fell 8% to 7,654.66 points, a move the finance minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa described as a short‑term shock lasting two to three days. He added that the market fundamentals remain strong, OJK will address MSCI concerns, and he remains optimistic that the index could reach 10,000 by the end of 2026.

title: BNI Sekuritas Advises Strategic Rights Issue Between Angkasa Pura Indonesia and Garuda Maintenance Facility Aero Asia
body: PT BNI Sekuritas, a subsidiary of PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk, acted as strategic advisor for a rights‑issue transaction in which PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia contributed 972,123 m² of land valued at Rp5.66 trillion to PT Garuda Maintenance Facility Aero Asia Tbk, issuing 82.1 billion new shares and raising API’s stake to 68.6%. The deal increased GMFI’s equity to about USD59.9 million, improving its capital structure and supporting future aviation‑industry growth while BNI Sekuritas ensured regulatory compliance and good governance.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold shares of Sentul City Tbk (BKSL.JK) under a Repurchase Agreement on 29 Jan 2026. The transaction involved 978,382,100 shares at IDR 150 per share, reducing the shareholder’s holding from 8,665,555,354 to 7,656,573,200 shares—a decline of 1,008,982,154 shares. The sale represents a significant decrease in Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia’s stake in the listed property developer, indicating a strategic divestment or liquidity move within the agreement framework.

title: Ario Wibisono sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Ario Wibisono sold 6,949,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) at IDR 546 per share on 28 Jan 2026, reducing his holding from 250,195,800 to 243,246,800 shares. The divestment lowers his stake by about 2.8% and reflects a strategic portfolio adjustment.

title: Kenny Harjo sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Kenny Harjo sold 6,949,000 Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) shares at IDR 546 per share as a divestment. His holding fell from 8,540,000 to 1,591,000 shares, reducing his stake by roughly 81%. The transaction reflects a significant reduction in insider ownership, potentially signaling a shift in confidence or a strategic reallocation of capital.

title: Ferdinandus Aming Santoso sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Ferdinandus Aming Santoso sold 77,431,000 Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) shares on 28 Jan 2026 at IDR 546 per share, reducing his stake from 107,769,281 to 30,338,281 shares. The transaction, classified as a sale/divestment, represents a significant reduction of roughly 72% in his holding, potentially affecting his influence over the tower infrastructure company.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of Barito Pacific Tbk
body: On 29 Jan 2026, Indonesian investor Prajogo Pangestu purchased an additional 4,000,000 shares of Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT.JK) at a representative price of IDR 2,160 per share, raising his holding from 66,906,030,165 to 66,910,030,165 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment and increases the shareholder's ownership marginally, indicating continued confidence in the company's prospects.

title: PT. Delta Royal Sejahtera sell Shares of PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk.
body: On 2026-01-29, PT. Delta Royal Sejahtera sold 443,768,956 shares of PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk. (BULL.JK) to Kingswood Union Corporation at IDR 468 per share. The transaction reduces its holding from 2,695,666,498 to 2,251,897,542 shares, a decline of 443,768,956 shares. The sale is classified as an investment realization. The divestment lowers the shareholder’s ownership percentage and may influence the stock’s liquidity and price dynamics in the Indonesian market.

title: Corin Investa Corpora buy Shares of Malindo Feedmill Tbk
body: Corin Investa Corpora purchased 300,000 shares of Malindo Feedmill Tbk at IDR 842 per share on 26 Jan 2026, raising its holding from 111,900,000 to 112,200,000 shares (an increase of 300,000 shares). The buy is for long‑term investment, signalling confidence in the company and modestly expanding the shareholder's stake.

title: Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Eko Santoso Hadiprodjo sold 28,974,000 shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk at IDR 546 per share, reducing his holding from 39,604,000 to 10,630,000 shares (a decline of 28,974,000 shares). The transaction, classified as a stock sale, lowers his ownership stake by roughly 73%, indicating a significant divestment from the company.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: On 2026-01-29, shareholder Prajogo Pangestu purchased 4,000,000 PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk shares for personal investment, at representative prices around IDR 1,805 per share. The transaction raised his holding from 94,530,650,000 to 94,534,650,000 shares, a net increase of 4,000,000 shares. This modest acquisition signals continued confidence from a major insider and marginally dilutes the free float, which may be noted by investors monitoring ownership concentration.

title: Green City Sg Pte Ltd Sell Shares of PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk
body: Green City Sg Pte Ltd sold 80,000,000 shares of PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk on 20 January 2026 at IDR 150.00 per share, generating IDR 12,000,000,000. The sale reduced its holding from 561,322,772 shares to 522,207,800 shares, a decrease of 39,114,972 shares (≈7% of its stake). The transaction was part of the company’s investment strategy and may affect its influence on corporate governance.

title: Ny Farida Helianti Buy Shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk
body: Ny Farida Helianti purchased 800,000 Samudera Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 360 per share on 2026-01-28, increasing her holding from 0 to 800,000 shares (a +800,000 share acquisition). The transaction is classified as an investment and adds a new shareholder with a notable stake, reflecting confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Bani Maulana Mulia buy Shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk
body: Shareholder Bani Maulana Mulia purchased a total of 200,000 SMDR.JK shares at IDR 390 per share on 27‑28 Jan 2026, raising his holding from 55,078,800 to 55,278,800 shares (+200,000). The transaction is classified as an investment, increasing his ownership stake marginally and reflecting continued confidence in Samudera Indonesia Tbk.

title: Anita Anwar sell Shares of Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk
body: Anita Anwar sold 22,385,000 Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR.JK) shares at IDR 546 per share on 28 Jan 2026, reducing her holding from 27,511,600 to 5,126,600 shares, a decline of 22,385,000 shares. The transaction is a divestment and markedly lowers her ownership stake, signaling a substantial exit by a key shareholder.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey Buys Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: On 2026-01-28, investor Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 350,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk at IDR 3,422 per share for investment purposes. His holding increased from 2,931,700 to 3,281,700 shares, a net gain of 350,000 shares, reflecting a higher stake in the copper and gold producer and potentially signaling confidence in the company's growth prospects.

title: SGX board‑lot reduction and calls for bonus issues or stock splits to boost retail participation
body: The Singapore Exchange plans to cut standard board lot sizes to lower entry barriers for retail investors, especially younger ones. The article argues that, alongside this reform, bonus issues or stock splits by companies such as DBS Bank and UOB would further improve affordability and market participation.

title: SGX RegCo proposes broker‑custody model allowing retail investors to consolidate Singapore and overseas holdings
body: SGX RegCo is seeking public feedback on rule amendments that would let retail investors move Singapore‑listed stocks, Treasury bills, bonds and foreign‑listed securities into broker‑custody accounts—potentially effective from June, with Singapore Savings Bonds excluded—while still permitting them to keep CDP direct accounts. Brokers such as Tiger Brokers, Moomoo, Interactive Brokers and DBS could then offer integrated portfolio services, and regulators stress robust custody standards and data‑protection safeguards.

title: Singapore regulator urges listed firms to provide thoughtful forward‑looking guidance despite historic aversion
body: For years Singapore-listed companies have avoided forward‑looking guidance, preferring safe backward‑looking statements, but the Singapore Exchange Regulation now advises firms to offer such guidance responsibly to build investor trust.

title: SGX RegCo proposes rule changes to expand broker‑custody accounts for retail investors in Singapore
body: SGX RegCo is consulting on amendments that would permit omnibus broker‑custody accounts, strengthen oversight of depository agents and require brokers to support shareholder rights, with the consultation running until 27 March; the move aims to shift many investors from direct CDP accounts to broker custody, offering services such as fractional trading and attracting internationally active asset managers. Companies mentioned include SGX, CDP, DBS and Interactive Brokers Singapore.

title: Vina Nauli Jordania sell Shares of PT Sumber Mas Konstruksi Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Vina Nauli Jordania sold 44,100,000 shares of PT Sumber Mas Konstruksi Tbk at IDR 37 per share, reducing her holding from 106,750,000 to 62,650,000 shares. The divestment, classified as a divestment through, lowers her ownership by about 41.3% and may signal portfolio rebalancing.

title: Rika Juniaty Tanzil Buys Shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Rika Juniaty Tanzil purchased 170,000 PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (MDIY.JK) shares at IDR 887 per share for personal investment. Her holding rose from 855,500 to 1,025,500 shares, a net increase of 170,000 shares, strengthening her stake in the company.

title: Yacobus Jemmy Hartanto buy Shares of PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk
body: Shareholder Yacobus Jemmy Hartanto increased his stake in PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk by purchasing a total of 1,187,300 shares, at a representative price of IDR 214 per share. The transactions, recorded on Jan 22, Jan 23 and Jan 28 2026, resulted in holdings rising from 253,082,900 to 254,270,200 shares, a net increase of 1,187,300 shares. The purchase is classified as a change of ownership of shares.

title: Sight Investment Company Pte Limited buy Shares of PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk
body: Sight Investment Company Pte Limited purchased 5,620,000 shares of PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk at IDR 2,593 per share on 2026-01-28, increasing its holding from 8,318,473,832 to 8,324,093,832 shares (+5,620,000). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises the shareholder’s stake marginally and signals continued confidence in the hospital group's growth prospects.

title: Edwin Cheah Yew Hong buy Shares of PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Edwin Cheah Yew Hong purchased 100,000 PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk (MDIY.JK) shares at IDR 875 per share for personal investment. His holding increased from 98,648,600 to 98,748,600 shares, a delta of 100,000. The transaction raises his ownership stake and signals confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Lal Naveen Chandra sell Shares of PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk.
body: Lal Naveen Chandra sold a total of 895,300 PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk. shares at IDR 7,800 per share on 27‑28 Jan 2026 for personal investment. His holding decreased from 53,056,600 to 52,161,300 shares, a reduction of 895,300 shares, but he remains a substantial shareholder. The transaction reflects a modest divestment without altering the company's control structure.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 29 Jan 2026, Jemmy Kurniawan sold a total of 12,000,000 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK) shares at an indicative price of IDR 87 per share, reducing his stake from 966,288,500 to 954,288,500 shares (a decline of 12,000,000 shares). The transaction is a reduction of the number of shares held, indicating a decrease in insider ownership.

title: Lianawaty Suwono Buys Shares of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk.
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Lianawaty Suwono purchased 300,000 BCA shares at IDR 7,025 per share, raising her holding from 2,840,417 to 3,140,417 shares (an increase of 300,000). The transaction, classified as an investment, expands her stake in PT Bank Central Asia Tbk. (BBCA.JK) and reflects a notable ownership change.

title: Goldman Investindo Sedaya sell Shares of PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk
body: Goldman Investindo Sedaya sold a total of 253,200,000 PT Indo Boga Sukses Tbk shares between 14‑20 Jan 2026 at representative prices around IDR 92.5 per share. The holding fell from 3,689,075,937 to 3,435,875,937 shares, a decline of 253,200,000 shares (approximately 6.9% of the prior stake). The disposal is stated to fund venture‑capital activities, reducing the shareholder’s influence in the company and potentially increasing free float for other investors.

title: Prajogo Pangestu buy Shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: On 30 Jan 2026, Indonesian investor Prajogo Pangestu purchased an additional 7,300,000 shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN.JK) for personal investment purposes. The transaction was executed at approximately IDR 1,775 per share, raising his total holding from 94,534,650,000 to 94,541,950,000 shares, a net increase of 0.008%. The buy adds to his insider stake and signals confidence in the company's outlook.

title: SGX adds three new Hong Kong‑listed Singapore Depository Receipts, including Zijin Gold, Horizon Robotics and China Mobile, from Feb 2
body: The Singapore Exchange will list SDRs for Zijin Gold, Horizon Robotics and China Mobile on Feb 2, expanding its portfolio to 32 SDRs and reflecting a ten‑fold YoY rise in daily turnover to S$12 million across 29 underlyings. The new listings offer low minimum investments (under S$400) and come as Zijin Gold’s shares have risen over 60% to HK$218.60 after a US$3.2 billion IPO, while net retail inflows into Hong Kong SDRs reached S$150 million last year.

title: Survey finds only 42% of Singapore firms plan climate‑risk investments, with low uptake of mitigation and adaptation solutions despite rising reporting pressures
body: Schneider Electric’s survey of 543 Singapore business leaders shows 42% intend to allocate resources to climate‑risk management, with 25% targeting mitigation (renewable energy, green infrastructure) and 17% adaptation (flood‑risk systems) while 58% have no plans; more than 90% have begun International Sustainability Standards Board‑aligned reporting but most meet only 25% of obligations, citing skill gaps and costs, and the Singapore Exchange and Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority have extended disclosure timelines.

title: Singapore-China cooperation eases secondary listings for Chinese A‑share firms, boosting SGX presence
body: At the 21st Singapore‑China Joint Council, both sides agreed to support secondary listings of Chinese A‑share companies on SGX by allowing them to follow only Chinese listing rules, a move that has already attracted enquiries and led to recent dual listings such as China Medical System and Concord New Energy, whose shares jumped about 10% on debut; today roughly 100 Chinese firms—about 20% of SGX’s listings—are using the platform to raise capital, expand regionally and improve governance. The streamlined prospectus requirements, acceptance of Chinese accounting standards, and access to Singapore‑based investors and sovereign wealth funds are cited as key advantages over Hong Kong listings.

title: Singapore's STI hits record high as JPMorgan lifts 2026 target amid strong earnings outlook and market reforms
body: The Straits Times Index reached a new high of 4,923.02 on Jan 27, prompting JPMorgan to raise its 2026 target to 6,000 (6,500 in a bull case) on the back of upbeat earnings expectations, a firm Singapore dollar and dividend appeal, with top picks DBS, UOL and Keppel. The rally extended to small‑ and mid‑cap stocks, boosting trading turnover and lifting shares of companies such as CSE Global, Nam Cheong, Ho Bee Land, Skylink Holdings, Don Agro International (now UpHealth Group) and Mirxes, while upcoming earnings reports and the Fed chair nomination could add volatility.

title: SGX RegCo proposes smaller board lot sizes and broader broker custody accounts to lower trading frictions
body: SGX RegCo is consulting on cutting the standard board lot size for high‑price shares, a move expected to favour SGX and brokers, while also encouraging wider use of broker custody accounts to ease shareholder‑rights exercises. The proposal echoes past informal pooling practices in Malaysia’s 1990s market, where investors combined funds to reduce entry costs.

title: Humpuss sell Shares of Humpuss Intermoda Transportasi Tbk
body: On 30 Jan 2026, shareholder Humpuss sold its entire holding of 3,401,023,343 HITS.JK shares at IDR 152 per share, reducing its stake from 3,401,023,343 to zero. The transaction, valued at roughly IDR 516,955,548,136, is part of an investment strategy tied to an acquisition price agreement. This complete divestment eliminates Humpuss as a shareholder, potentially increasing free float and influencing market liquidity for Humpuss Intermoda Transportasi Tbk.

title: Anggara Suryawan buy Shares of PT Futura Energi Global Tbk
body: Anggara Suryawan purchased a total of 604,900 shares of PT Futura Energi Global Tbk for investment purposes. The acquisition was executed in three trades on Jan 21, Jan 26 and Jan 28 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 434 to IDR 560 per share, with a representative price of IDR 490 per share. His holding increased from 0 to 604,900 shares, establishing a new equity position in the company.

title: H Hutomo Mandala Putra sell Shares of Humpuss Intermoda Transportasi Tbk
body: H Hutomo Mandala Putra sold all 738,692,651 HITS.JK shares on 30 Jan 2026 at IDR 391 per share, reducing his holding from 738,692,651 to zero, a decline of 738,692,651 shares. The transaction is classified as a sell and is driven by his investment strategy under the agreed acquisition price. The full divestment removes the shareholder’s stake in Humpuss Intermoda Transportasi Tbk, potentially affecting the company’s shareholder composition.

title: Aditya Sasmito buy Shares of PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk.
body: On 8 Jan 2026, shareholder Aditya Sasmito purchased 200,000 PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk. (AMMN.JK) shares at IDR 8,425 per share for personal investment. His holding rose from 71,186,700 to 71,386,700 shares, a 0.28% increase, reflecting a modest boost in personal ownership and signaling confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Singapore proposes safe‑harbour rules for forward‑looking disclosures to boost transparency while warning of investor risks
body: The Monetary Authority of Singapore and SGX RegCo are consulting on amendments to the Securities and Futures Act that would allow listed companies to issue forward‑looking statements under US‑style safe‑harbour protections, provided the guidance is based on credible assumptions and disclosed on SGXNet. Experts say the change could narrow information gaps but stress that investors must still perform due diligence and understand the accompanying cautions.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk launches emergency flood relief operations in Jakarta, providing shelters, aid and free medical services
body: Following severe flooding in Jakarta beginning mid‑January 2026, PT United Tractors Tbk quickly established evacuation tents, distributed food and logistics, and set up a free mobile clinic for affected residents. The effort was coordinated with local authorities, BNPB and the company‑trained KATANA community team to ensure ongoing support and preparedness.

title: PT Nusa Palapa Gemilang Tbk secures Rp54.02 billion credit facility from PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk
body: PT Nusa Palapa Gemilang Tbk obtained a Rp54.02 billion credit facility from PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk, comprising a Rp45 billion demand loan and a Rp9 billion PRK, both at 9.75% interest maturing on 16 October 2026, plus a corporate credit card limit of Rp20 million at 21% interest until 30 June 2029. The company said the financing is intended for working‑capital needs and is not expected to have a material impact on its financial or operational condition.

title: PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk launches up to 0.30% share buyback program worth up to IDR 500 billion
body: PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk announced a share buyback program of up to 0.30% of its paid‑up capital, equivalent to about 166.13 million shares, with a maximum funding of IDR 500 billion. The buyback will be executed using internal funds from 3 February to 2 May 2026 (or earlier) and PT BCA Sekuritas has been appointed as the intermediary.

title: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk invests Rp35 billion in PT Lancar Wiguna Sejahtera to bolster subsidiary capital
body: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk added a Rp35 billion equity investment to its 70%‑owned subsidiary PT Lancar Wiguna Sejahtera on 2 February 2026, aiming to maintain its ownership percentage and strengthen the subsidiary’s capital structure. The transaction is classified as an affiliate transaction under POJK No. 42/2020.

title: Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk buy Shares of PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk
body: Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk acquired 1,687,455,000 shares of PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk at IDR 63 per share, increasing its stake from 0 to 1,687,455,000 shares. The transaction, recorded on 2 February 2026, is classified as a buy for acquisition purposes, marking the shareholder’s entry into PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk and potentially influencing the company’s capital structure.

title: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara Buy Shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk
body: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara purchased an additional 124,400,000 shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET.JK) at IDR 364 per share on 3 Feb 2026, raising its holding from 12,508,316,800 to 12,632,716,800 shares. The transaction, valued at IDR 12,632,716,800, reflects the shareholder’s intent to increase its ownership stake in INET. This incremental acquisition may enhance Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara’s influence in corporate decisions and signals confidence in the company’s outlook.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: On 3 February 2026, Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold 713,758,700 shares of Sentul City Tbk in a repo transaction at IDR 145.0 per share. The sale reduced the shareholder’s holding from 8,399,288,200 to 7,685,529,500 shares, a decrease of 713,758,700 shares. This transaction reflects a short‑term financing activity and may impact liquidity and voting power for the shareholder.

title: Djonny Saksono buy Shares of PT Indonesian Tobacco Tbk
body: Djonny Saksono purchased 188,800 shares of PT Indonesian Tobacco Tbk on 2026‑02‑02, raising his holding from 642,842,000 to 643,030,800 shares. The transaction was executed at IDR 307.0 per share for investment purposes. This modest increase represents a small percentage of the company’s total shares and is unlikely to significantly alter control or voting power.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buy Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 712,715,000 shares of Sentul City Tbk at IDR 145.0 per share, increasing its stake from 768,657,200 to 8,399,288,200 shares (a gain of 7,630,631,000 shares). The transaction, executed on 30 January 2026, was for a REPO arrangement, providing short‑term liquidity for the company. This move strengthens Sentul City’s capital structure and may signal confidence in its future earnings, potentially impacting investor sentiment in the Indonesian equity market.

title: Dr Hasmoro buy Shares of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk
body: Dr Hasmoro, an individual shareholder of PT Medikaloka Hermina Tbk, executed a buy transaction of 3,552,300 shares on 28–29 January 2026 at a representative price of IDR 1,362 per share, raising his stake from 753,011,889 to 756,564,189 shares. The purchase was made for investment purposes, reflecting confidence in the company’s prospects and slightly strengthening the shareholder structure.

title: Shanti Lasminingsih Poesposoetjipto Buy Shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk
body: Shanti Lasminingsih Poesposoetjipto purchased 271,700 shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk on 30 January 2026, increasing her stake from zero to 271,700 shares. The transaction was executed at IDR 368.0 per share, totaling approximately IDR 99,844,800. This buy‑side investment reflects a strategic entry into the company’s equity, potentially signaling confidence in its maritime logistics operations and providing the shareholder with a significant position in a leading Indonesian shipping firm.

title: Indonesia and China's CSES sign MoU to develop low‑carbon palm oil industry
body: The Ministry of National Development Planning/National Development Planning Board PPN/Bappenas and the Chinese Society of Environmental Sciences CSES have signed a memorandum of understanding to create low‑emission palm oil technology (PaMER) that can cut carbon emissions by 79.19% and to establish carbon‑trading mechanisms for smallholder cooperatives. The partnership will also provide training, capacity‑building and welfare improvements for palm oil farmers while positioning the sector for greener, more competitive growth.

title: Indonesian oil palm smallholders call for a centralized Palm Oil Authority to streamline fragmented governance
body: Apkasindo chairman Gulat Manurung urged the government to create a Palm Oil Authority Board to consolidate oversight across about 37 ministries, improve upstream development, and enhance data integration, revenue and food‑energy security. He cited a doctoral dissertation and recent Sumatra disasters as catalysts, and outlined measures such as a single data system, CPO exchange, research centre, land‑tenure acceleration and AI adoption.

title: PT Putra Perkasa Abadi partners with Telkomsel to launch Indonesia’s first private network for smart mining
body: PT Putra Perkasa Abadi (PPA) signed a memorandum of understanding with Telkomsel at the Telkomsel Enterprise Solution Day 2023 to deploy a private network and Telkomsel Enterprise’s smart‑mining suite across its mining operations. The initiative provides sub‑50‑millisecond latency, IoT fuel monitoring and Infrastructure‑as‑Service to improve efficiency, production and safety.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Industri Baterai Indonesia and Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt sign framework to fast‑track an integrated battery ecosystem in Indonesia
body: The three companies, together with HYD Investment Limited, EVE Energy Co Ltd and PT Daaz Bara Lestari Tbk, signed a Framework Agreement to accelerate nickel downstreaming and build a domestic end‑to‑end battery supply chain. The planned project targets up to 20 GWh of capacity with an investment of USD 5–6 billion, creating thousands of jobs and supporting Indonesia’s industrial and energy transition goals.

title: Indonesia aims to finish coconut downstreaming preparation by Dec 2026, with $34.9 bn investment and a Chinese $100 m project
body: Minister Rosan Roeslani said the government expects to complete the preparation phase for coconut downstreaming projects by December 2026, after downstreaming investment reached Rp584.1 trillion ($34.9 bn) in 2025, including Rp144.5 trillion in coconut projects. A $100 million Chinese-backed investment, overseen by Danantara, is slated to create up to 10,000 jobs and expand coconut derivative production.

title: PT Indika Energy Tbk establishes new subsidiary PT Bima Invi Sinergi Alami to diversify into mining support and equipment rental
body: On January 26 2026 PT Indika Energy Tbk, through its subsidiaries PT Energi Makmur Buana (25%) and PT Invi Mining Unggulan Nusantara (75%), founded PT Bima Invi Sinergi Alami with a paid‑up capital of IDR 1 billion. The new entity will focus on support activities for mining, quarrying and heavy‑equipment rental as part of Indika Energy’s diversification and sustainability strategy and will be consolidated into the group’s financial statements without material adverse impact.

title: Indonesia's downstream mineral policy drives job creation, with MIND ID Group's bauxite‑alumina‑aluminum project set to employ 14,700 workers
body: Member of Commission XII of the DPR, Eddy Soeparno, praised Indonesia’s mineral downstreaming policy, noting that the IDR 60 trillion integrated bauxite‑alumina‑aluminum project led by MIND ID Group (based on a Pre‑Feasibility Study by BPI Danantara) is expected to create up to 14,700 jobs and stimulate surrounding sectors. He added that with domestic aluminum demand of 1.2 million t yr⁻¹ and 54 % still imported, leveraging the country’s 7.78 billion‑ton bauxite resources is essential for sustainable employment.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk begins heap‑leach irrigation at Pani Gold Mine, targeting first gold output in Q1 2026
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk announced that heap‑leach irrigation has started on the Pani Gold Mine’s leach pad, confirming the target of first gold production in the first quarter of 2026 and indicating that the ADR plant is ready for processing. The company also accelerated construction of a 12‑million‑ton‑per‑year Carbon‑in‑Leach facility to 2026, with the mine holding an ore reserve of about 4.8 million troy ounces and a potential peak output of over 500,000 troy ounces annually.

title: Indonesia and the United Kingdom to commence CEPA negotiations to broaden market access
body: Indonesia’s Trade Minister Budi Santoso announced that comprehensive economic partnership agreement talks with the UK will start soon, aiming to expand market options beyond the current trade surplus. Bilateral trade reached US$2.41 billion in Jan‑Nov 2025 (exports US$1.43 billion, imports US$973.2 million) and the UK pledged roughly £4 billion in investment, primarily for maritime projects such as new fishing vessels and villages.

title: Indonesia invites Malaysia to cooperate on next‑generation semiconductor development
body: At the 2026 Indonesia Economic Summit, Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto announced that Indonesia will seek Malaysia’s expertise to develop new‑generation semiconductor technology, outlining a three‑phase plan covering startups, industrial transformation and chip production for digital automotive and electronics. He emphasized that regional collaboration will accelerate research, strengthen supply chains and add value to Indonesia’s upstream strengths such as silica sand and solar‑panel manufacturing.

title: Multi Makmur Lemindo PIPA shifts to oil and gas business under Morris Capital Indonesia MCI after board overhaul
body: Multi Makmur Lemindo PIPA, formerly a PVC pipe and building materials manufacturer, is being transformed into an oil and gas company after Morris Capital Indonesia MCI took control, with a new board that appointed Firrisky Ardi Nurtomo as president director and added Noprian Fadli to the board until July 2027. The firm plans 2026 core investments in oil‑gas processing, logistics and acquisitions, while conducting capital structure strengthening, asset valuation and tax exposure studies in line with Otoritas Jasa Keuangan OJK governance standards.

title: Ashmore Indonesia reports 9% drop in H1 net profit while AUM jumps 37% to Rp34.4 trillion
body: Ashmore Indonesia posted net profit of Rp33.36 billion for the first semester ending 31 December 2025, a 9% decline from the prior year, with revenue of Rp140.72 billion and earnings per share falling to Rp15. Despite the profit dip, assets under management rose 37% to Rp34.4 trillion on net inflows of Rp8.3 trillion, and equity stayed robust at Rp274.07 billion, underpinning an optimistic outlook for 2026.

title: Nanotech Investama Sedaya sells 364 million Nanotech Indonesia Global shares for IDR 20.03 billion, cutting its stake to 47.5%
body: Nanotech Investama Sedaya disposed of 364.27 million Nanotech Indonesia Global shares at IDR 55 per share in two tranches on 19‑20 January 2025, generating roughly IDR 20.03 billion. After the sale, its holding fell to 2.03 billion shares (47.5% of the company), down from 51.0% previously.

title: Indonesia aims to elevate UK partnership to CEPA, backed by £4 billion maritime investment
body: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said Indonesia will upgrade its Economic Growth Partnership with the United Kingdom to a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement covering clean energy, digital technology, food resilience, education, health and maritime sectors. The UK has pledged a £4 billion (approximately Rp91.47 trillion) investment to produce 1,582 fishing boats and develop fishing villages across Indonesia.

title: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara to break ground on US$1.1 billion integrated chicken farm on Feb 6
body: Danantara will hold the groundbreaking ceremony on February 6 for a US$1.1 billion integrated broiler and layer chicken farm, including a feed factory and day‑old chick production, aimed at supporting the Free Nutritious Meal program and national food security. The project will involve state‑owned PT Perkebunan Nusantara III Persero and PT Berdikari to ensure stable supply chains and farmer welfare.

title: PT Paramita Bangun Sarana Tbk launches up to IDR 100 billion share buyback program
body: PT Paramita Bangun Sarana Tbk announced a share buyback program of up to IDR 100 billion using internal cash, scheduled from 3 February to 17 March 2026 with PT BCA Sekuritas acting as the broker on the IDX. The buyback will not exceed 20% of the issued capital and is intended to support price stability amid market volatility.

title: Barito Pacific, Chandra Asri and Petrindo Jaya Kreasi announce a combined IDR 3.75 trillion share buyback program
body: Barito Pacific, Chandra Asri and Petrindo Jaya Kreasi will each allocate fresh cash—IDR 1 trillion, IDR 2 trillion and IDR 750 billion respectively—for a three‑month buyback from 4 February to 3 May 2026, funded from internal cash balances. The companies have appointed Sucor Sekuritas, Henan Putihrai Sekuritas and BNI Sekuritas to execute the buybacks, with Chandra Asri targeting up to 250 million shares at a maximum price of IDR 10,000 per share.

title: Indo Boga outlines 2026 expansion plan with new Segafredo Caffe outlets and a Bohemian‑style restaurant in Yogyakarta
body: Indo Boga announced a 2026 strategic plan to open several new Segafredo Caffe outlets—including locations at Soekarno Hatta International Airport Terminal 3, a flagship in Yogyakarta, Yogyakarta International Airport, and Ngurah Rai Bali Airport—and to launch a Bohemian‑ambience restaurant with Mediterranean‑Western fusion menu in Yogyakarta. The plan follows 2025 actions that added two bars in Yogyakarta, rebranded D’Monaco to BAKI Restoran, secured an exclusive franchise agreement with Segafredo Zanneti Espresso Worldwide Ltd for Indonesia, and introduced Salzburg sparkling drinks via its subsidiary PT Kairos Sukses Indonesia.

title: PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk backs PT Central Finansial X's fee cuts to enhance crypto market liquidity
body: PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk announced that its subsidiary PT Central Finansial X will reduce transaction fees from 0.04% to 0.02% on 1 March 2026 and further to 0.01% on 1 October 2026 to boost market liquidity and competitiveness. The company expects the lower fees to attract domestic users, increase trading volume and support new revenue streams such as crypto derivatives.

title: PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk announces a rights issue of up to 996.7 million new shares
body: PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk plans to issue up to 996,676,699 new shares at a nominal price of Rp12 each, subject to shareholder approval at the meeting on 12 March 2026. The net proceeds, after issuance costs, will be used to repay third‑party debt, support working capital and fund capital expenditures.

title: President Prabowo meets Garuda Indonesia CEO and Embraer leaders to discuss aviation technology coordination
body: President Prabowo Subianto met with PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk CEO Glenny Kairupan and senior executives of Embraer at the Merdeka Palace to discuss global aviation technology trends and the need for Indonesia's aviation ecosystem to keep pace. The discussion was limited to technology coordination, with no immediate plans for new aircraft purchases.

title: DEWA Executes Rp675 Billion Share Buyback, Using 71% of Authorized Budget
body: DEWA allocated Rp675 billion to repurchase 1.19 billion shares from 10 December 2025 to 30 January 2026, covering 71.10 % of its Rp950 billion buy‑back ceiling at an average price of Rp566 per share. The stock rose 14.13 % to Rp525 but remains 30 % below the Jan 2 2026 level of Rp750.

title: Semen Indonesia alias SIG trains 500 construction experts across five cities, sets MURI record and plans nationwide rollout
body: On 1 February 2026, Semen Indonesia alias SIG partnered with the Lembaga Sertifikasi Profesi to deliver a simultaneous Building Expert Training and Certification program for 500 participants in five Indonesian cities, achieving a MURI record for the most concurrent construction‑worker trainings in a province. The company aims to expand the program to over 100 additional locations, targeting more than 5,000 trainees, and introduced the Jago Bangunan app, which already hosts 14,941 members.

title: Edwin Soeryadjaya increases stake in PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk
body: On February 2 and 4, 2026, Edwin Soeryadjaya purchased a total of 1,533,700 shares of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk at Rp1,629 and Rp1,608 per share, raising his holding to 4,867,505,690 shares. This boosted his voting rights to 35,8833% from 35,8719%.

title: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk completes Rp106.3 billion acquisition of majority stake in PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk
body: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk completed a crossing acquisition of 53.57% of PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk from Koperasi Pegawai PT Indosat Tbk, involving 1,687 455 000 shares at Rp63 per share for a total of about Rp106.3 billion, with KJPP Iwan Bachron dan Rekan deeming the transaction fair. The deal is intended to broaden INET’s digital‑infrastructure and managed‑service offerings and create an integrated “human‑tech” ecosystem by leveraging PADA’s large outsourcing workforce.

title: PT Gozco Capital raises its stake in PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk to 10.53%
body: PT Gozco Capital increased its ownership in PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk to 10.53% by purchasing an additional 164 million shares at Rp364 per share, a transaction worth about Rp59.7 billion. The bank reported a profit of Rp517.2 billion in October 2025, a 73‑fold rise from the previous year, and is launching a new corporate identity focused on innovative digital financial services.

title: PT Kereta Api Indonesia transports 4.03 million tonnes of coal in January 2026, emphasizing efficiency and sustainability upgrades
body: PT Kereta Api Indonesia moved 4,025,975 tonnes of coal in January 2026, handling over 59,000 tonnes daily through five main terminals, with Kertapati featuring a modern conveyor‑belt and shiploader system. Its subsidiary KAI Logistik introduced RFID tracking and switched all locomotives and generators to 40% bio‑fuel (Biosolar B40) to boost operational efficiency and cut emissions.

title: SKK Migas and PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia sign tie‑in agreement to commence WNTS‑Pemping gas pipeline construction in February 2026
body: SKK Migas confirmed that the West Natuna Transportation System (WNTS)‑Pulau Pemping gas pipeline will move to the construction phase after a Tie‑in Agreement was signed by PT Medco E&P Natuna Ltd, PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia and SKK Migas. The agreement gives PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia certainty of access to the WNTS pipeline, allowing construction to start in early February 2026 and supporting domestic gas supply from Natuna.

title: Indonesia's 2025 iron and steel trade surplus reaches $18.44 billion, lifting the country to fifth place globally
body: Trade Minister Budi Santoso reported that Indonesia's iron and steel trade balance will show a $18.44 billion surplus in 2025, driven by exports of $27.97 billion against imports of $9.53 billion. The surge has moved Indonesia from the 17th largest exporter in 2019 to the fifth largest, behind China, Germany, Japan and South Korea, and is supported by recent trade regulation updates.

title: Bank Mandiri reports execution of 1,174 CSR programs across 12 regions in 2025, allocating over IDR 250 billion to social, environmental, economic and governance pillars
body: In 2025 Bank Mandiri implemented 1,174 Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) programs covering 12 Indonesian regions, distributing more than 371,000 social aid packages. The initiatives were funded with Rp142.5 billion for the social pillar, Rp79.2 billion for the environmental pillar, Rp28 billion for the economic pillar and Rp1.2 billion for governance, earning national awards and highlighting the bank’s commitment to sustainable development.

title: PT Aplikasi Bitumen Indonesia secures double chipseal contract for RMK Group mining road upgrade
body: PT Aplikasi Bitumen Indonesia, a subsidiary of PT Xolare RCR Energy, Tbk, won a contract from PT Royaltama Mulia Konstruksi to supply material and supervise double chipseal work on a 10‑km segment of a 30‑km mining haul road for RMK Group in South Sumatra, starting February 2026. The four‑month project will use PT Royaltama Mulia Konstruksi equipment and labor, with ABI providing material, technical supervision, a 180‑day material warranty, and aims to strengthen its mining‑road portfolio.

title: Sinjo Jefry Sumendap buy Shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk
body: On 30 Jan 2026, Sinjo Jefry Sumendap purchased 1,129,000 shares of PT Sinar Terang Mandiri Tbk (MINE.JK) at IDR 441 per share, increasing his holding from 171,770,000 to 172,899,000 shares (+1,129,000). The transaction is classified as an investment and raises his ownership stake in the company.

title: Irsyad Hanif sell Shares of PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk
body: On 30 Jan 2026, shareholder Irsyad Hanif sold 7,000,000 PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 300 per share as a divestment. His holding fell from 181,806,200 to 174,806,200 shares, a reduction of 7,000,000 shares (approximately 3.85% of total). The transaction lowers his stake in the company and signals a strategic exit, potentially affecting market perception of the stock.

title: Null buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Bayan Resources Tbk reported that the shareholder identified as Null purchased 4,000 shares on 3 Feb 2026 at a price of IDR 15,273 per share. The stake increased from 13,406,912,370 to 13,406,916,370 shares, a net addition of 4,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment and represents a marginal change in ownership given the large existing holding.

title: Sentra Amanah Ventura buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Sentra Amanah Ventura executed purchases of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk shares on 26 Jan 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 157 to IDR 160 per share, with a representative price of IDR 158 per share for a total transaction value of IDR 735,095,000. The holder’s share balance fell from 735,150,000 shares before the transaction to 55,000 shares after, a decrease of 735,095,000 shares. The transaction is classified under an investment strategy.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 2 Feb 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased 782,500 PT Logisticsplus International Tbk shares at prices ranging from IDR 152 to IDR 160 per share, with a representative price of IDR 155 per share, for a total outlay of approximately IDR 120,164,900,000. The acquisition raised his holding from 1,523,760 to 2,306,260 shares, a 51% increase, reflecting an investment‑strategy driven expansion of his stake in the listed logistics company.

title: Sentra Amanah Ventura buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Sentra Amanah Ventura purchased an additional 1,559,500 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) as part of its investment strategy. The transaction, executed on 3 Feb 2026 at a representative price of IDR 155 per share, raised the shareholder’s holding from 736,593,200 to 738,152,700 shares, a modest increase in ownership. The buy reflects confidence in the company's prospects and may influence future market perception.

title: Djauhar Maulidi buy Shares of Rukun Raharja Tbk
body: Djauhar Maulidi purchased 400,000 shares of Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA.JK) on 2026-01-27 at IDR 4,999 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 4,900,000 to 5,300,000 shares, a 8.2% increase in stake. The transaction reflects confidence in the company's outlook and may influence market perception of RAJA.JK.

title: Ogi Rulino buy Shares of Rukun Raharja Tbk
body: On 27 Jan 2026, shareholder Ogi Rulino purchased 300,000 Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA.JK) shares at IDR 4,999 per share, investing roughly IDR 1,499,700,000. His holding increased from 1,950,000 to 2,250,000 shares, a net gain of 300,000 shares, reflecting a strategic investment and a notable rise in his ownership stake.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 15 Jan 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK) at IDR 65 per share. His holding decreased from 2,958,954,200 to 2,948,954,200 shares, a reduction of 10,000,000 shares. The filing reports no stated purpose for the sale. The transaction represents a notable insider divestment that may be monitored by investors.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 2 January 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK) shares at IDR 60 per share. His holding decreased from 2,983,954,200 to 2,973,954,200 shares, a reduction of 0.34% of total equity. The transaction reflects a modest divestment by a major insider while retaining a substantial stake in the company.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 19 Jan 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 20,000,000 PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK) shares at IDR 65 per share. His holding fell from 2,948,954,200 to 2,928,954,200 shares, a reduction of 20,000,000 shares (≈0.68% of total). No stated purpose was provided. The sale modestly decreases his voting power but does not signal a material change in control.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 6 Jan 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 60 per share. His holding decreased from 2,973,954,200 to 2,963,954,200 shares, a reduction of roughly 0.34% of the company's outstanding equity. The transaction reflects a modest divestment by a significant insider, potentially indicating portfolio rebalancing.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 15 Jan 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 5,000,000 ATLA.JK shares at IDR 66 per share. His holding decreased from 2,963,954,200 to 2,958,954,200 shares, a reduction of 5,000,000 shares. The transaction does not specify a purpose and represents a modest adjustment to his overall stake in PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk, signaling a slight divestment but leaving him with a substantial ownership position.

title: Takushi Ishimoto sell Shares of PT Multi Spunindo Jaya Tbk
body: Takushi Ishimoto sold 100,000 shares of PT Multi Spunindo Jaya Tbk (MSJA.JK) at approximately IDR 404 per share on 4 Feb 2026. His holding fell from 30,809,256 to 30,709,256 shares, a reduction of 0.32%. The sale, recorded on 5 Feb 2026, reflects a straightforward divestment without disclosed strategic motive, and marginally decreases his ownership stake.

title: Junichiro Waide sell Shares of PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk
body: Junichiro Waide sold a total of 9,360,000 VTNY.JK shares between 14 Jan and 30 Jan 2026, at prices ranging from IDR 92 to IDR 97 per share (representative price IDR 95). His holding fell from 1,269,806,974 to 1,260,446,974 shares, a reduction of 9,360,000 shares. The transaction is classified as a portfolio adjustment, indicating a strategic rebalancing of his stake in PT Venteny Fortuna International Tbk.

title: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. buy Shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk
body: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. purchased a total of 724,173,400 shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA.JK) between 27 Jan and 5 Feb 2026 for investment purposes. The transaction was executed at prices ranging from IDR 846 to IDR 1,038 per share, with a representative price of IDR 927 per share. The shareholder’s holding rose from 3,761,399,095 to 4,485,572,495 shares, a delta of 724,173,400 shares (approximately a 19% increase in its stake). The sizable acquisition signals a strengthening of A5-Db’s investment position in the bank.

title: PT Bhumi Jati Power wins Platinum CSR award and its president named Best Sustainability Leader at Indonesia Green Awards 2026
body: PT Bhumi Jati Power, a subsidiary of PT United Tractors Tbk, received the Platinum award for its OMBAK HIJAU coastal waste and seaweed cultivation CSR program at the Indonesia Green Awards La Tofi 2026, earning a score of 87.36. President Director Taichi Ichise was also named Best Sustainability Leader with a score of 85.46, highlighting the company’s commitment to sustainable governance and community empowerment.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk school partners with West Sumbawa government and PT Amman Mineral Nusa Tenggara to launch a year‑long heavy‑equipment training program
body: United Tractors School, the training arm of PT United Tractors Tbk, signed a cooperation agreement with the West Sumbawa Regency government and PT Amman Mineral Nusa Tenggara to develop a Balai Latihan Kerja program that will provide a one‑year heavy‑equipment mechanic and operator training, including certification by LSP ABI. The initiative aims to reduce the region’s reliance on mining‑related GDP by creating a skilled, certified local workforce for non‑mining sectors.

title: Jakarta and Banten governments partner with Paramount Land to launch a 30‑km east‑west MRT corridor
body: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung announced a cooperation with Banten Governor Andra Soni and Paramount Land to develop a 30‑km east‑west MRT corridor from Kembangan to Balaraja, featuring 14 stations and an elevated depot, aimed at strengthening the regional economic ecosystem and Jakarta’s status as a global city. PT MRT Jakarta will work with developers, including Paramount Land, on institutional, financial and technical studies to accelerate interconnectivity with other public transport modes.

title: Jakarta sets goal of 10,000 electric TransJakarta buses by 2029 amid funding cut
body: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung Wibowo announced a target to expand the TransJakarta fleet to 10,000 buses, all electric, by 2029, with a plan to reach 10,047 electric buses by 2030 and half the fleet electrified by 2027. The city aims to fund the expansion despite a planned Rp15 trillion reduction in central government revenue‑sharing, while TransJakarta intends to add 200 electric buses by 2025, bringing the total to 500 in service.

title: Indonesia and Algeria pledge stronger cooperation to expand Muslim tourism and tap the North African market
body: Indonesia's Deputy Minister of Tourism Ni Luh Puspa and Algeria's National People's Assembly delegation agreed to boost Muslim travel through skills transfer, legislative support and sustainable investment, noting a post‑pandemic 25% rise in Algerian arrivals to Indonesia. Both sides aim to share expertise in religious and nature‑based tourism and develop cultural tourism offerings to increase visitor numbers.

title: Indonesia's Ministry of Agriculture expands rice crop insurance to safeguard production amid shifting rainfall patterns
body: The Ministry of Agriculture announced enhancements to the Rice Crop Insurance (AUTP) program, covering 94,036.67 hectares and backed by regional budgets in 13 provinces, to protect farmers from floods, droughts and pest infestations as early‑2026 rainfall patterns shift. Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman stressed that farmer protection is fundamental to maintaining national food self‑sufficiency.

title: Indonesia to invest $6 billion in a new textile SOE to revive midstream sector and boost exports
body: The government will create a state‑owned enterprise for textiles, funded with $6 billion from investment fund BPI Danantara, to strengthen fabric production, yarn manufacturing, printing, dyeing and finishing. The plan aims to raise textile exports from $4 billion to $40 billion over the next ten years, leveraging expected tariff eliminations in Europe by 2027.

title: Indonesia warns import restrictions could trigger trade retaliation and stresses coordinated diplomacy
body: Deputy Minister Helvi Yuni Moraza said any import restrictions on ten commodities must be coordinated with the Trade, Finance and other ministries and backed by balanced trade diplomacy to avoid foreign retaliation, noting the measures would apply to all imports that can be produced domestically, not just China. The warning follows MSME Minister Maman Abdurrahman's warning that low‑cost Chinese imports threaten the survival of Indonesia's micro, small and medium enterprises.

title: Indonesia defends used‑clothing import ban on health, MSME and environmental grounds
body: Trade Minister Budi Santoso said the ban on used clothing (HS code 6309.00.00) protects public health, supports domestic micro, small and medium enterprises and prevents textile waste buildup, citing Law No. 7 of 2014. He detailed recent enforcement actions that seized thousands of bales worth over Rp210 billion between 2022 and 2025, followed by administrative sanctions and destruction of the goods.

title: Samuel Sekuritas nets a sale of 979.42 million Sentul City BKSL shares valued at roughly IDR 146.9 billion.
body: Between 29 January and 3 February 2026, Samuel Sekuritas executed a three‑stage buy‑sell program for Sentul City BKSL, selling 1.69 billion shares for IDR 250.24 billion and buying back 712.71 million shares for IDR 103.34 billion, resulting in a net disposal of 979.42 million shares worth about IDR 146.9 billion. After the transactions, its stake fell to 7.68 billion shares (4.58% of total), down 0.43 percentage points from the pre‑transaction holding of 8.39 billion shares (5.01%).

title: Medco Energi secures Rp800 billion loan from Bank ICBC Indonesia, shares rise 2.4%
body: Medco Energi obtained an Rp800 billion 60‑month loan from Bank ICBC Indonesia on 4 February 2026 to fund capital expenditures and general corporate needs, with the company stating the facility has no material impact on operations or financial condition. The news lifted the stock by 35 points, or about 2.41%, to Rp1,490 per share.

title: Chandra Asri TPIA launches IDR 2.25 trillion sustainable bond tranche in three series
body: Chandra Asri TPIA will issue a second tranche of sustainable bonds worth IDR 2.25 trillion, split into three series (A: IDR 635.39 bn at 6.5% for 3 years, B: IDR 885.35 bn at 7% for 5 years, C: IDR 729.22 bn at 7.5% for 7 years) with quarterly interest payments starting May 25 2026. The proceeds, after costs, will be used for working capital, and the bonds carry an idAA‑ rating from Pefindo, with underwriting by BCA Sekuritas, BNI Sekuritas, BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, DBS Vickers Sekuritas, Henan Putihrai Sekuritas, Mandiri Sekuritas, and Trimegah Sekuritas.

title: Summarecon Agung signs MoU with PT MRT Jakarta to explore MRT East‑West corridor stations in Kembangan‑Balaraja
body: Summarecon Agung, through its western Jakarta units Summarecon Serpong and Summarecon Tangerang, signed a non‑binding MoU with PT MRT Jakarta to study potential MRT East‑West corridor stations (Kembangan‑Balaraja) and will form a joint working group for a two‑year feasibility study. The partnership aims to integrate the townships with public transport, supporting sustainable city development and the government’s mass‑transit agenda.

title: Pefindo downgrades Wijaya Karya’s sustainable bond and sukuk ratings after missed coupon payments
body: Pefindo downgraded Wijaya Karya’s Sustainable Bond III Stage I and its Sustainable Sukuk Mudharabah III Stage I series B and C to idD (from idCCC) after the instruments missed their coupon payments due on 3 February 2026. The agency kept Wijaya Karya’s corporate rating at idSD and maintained its Sustainable Bond II Stage II at idCC and Sukuk II Stage II at idCCC(sy), citing weak financial and liquidity profiles and prior expansion risks, and said ratings could be reviewed if the company meets principal and coupon obligations.

title: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk reports sold‑out Westlife concerts in Jakarta and Surabaya, generating tens of billions of rupiah in revenue
body: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk, through its FolagoPro unit, staged Westlife concerts in Jakarta on 10 February 2026 (sold out) and Surabaya on 8 February 2026, with Surabaya tickets rapidly nearing sell‑out after only three weeks on sale. Management said the events yielded tens of billions of rupiah in revenue from ticket sales and sponsorships, positioning the concerts as a scalable monetisation model for future live‑entertainment projects.

title: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk's subsidiary PT Guna Darma Integra breaks ground on a $600 million 680 MW power plant in North Maluku
body: PT Guna Darma Integra, a subsidiary of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk through PT Volta Daya Energi Indonesia, held a groundbreaking ceremony for a 680 MW power plant in the Feni Haltim Industrial Park, Halmahera Timur, North Maluku, with an estimated cost of USD 600 million (≈Rp 10 trillion). The project, financed by several banks, is intended to support Indonesia’s electric‑vehicle battery ecosystem and the nickel industry.

title: Indonesia Supreme Court rejects PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk's cassation request, confirming appellate ruling
body: PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk announced that the Supreme Court of Indonesia rejected its cassation request, rendering the appellate judgment final. The airline said the rejection does not materially affect its operations, financial condition, or ongoing legal matters in other jurisdictions.

title: PT Hino Finance Indonesia launches Rp800 billion sustainable bond issuance in three series
body: PT Hino Finance Indonesia plans to raise Rp800 billion through a three‑series Sustainable Bond I (Phase II) 2026, with Series A (Rp313 bn, 4.75% for 370 days), Series B (Rp255 bn, 5.75% for 3 years) and Series C (Rp232 bn, 6.15% for 5 years); the issue is rated AA+ by PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia, underwritten by PT CIMB Niaga Sekuritas, PT DBS Vickers Sekuritas Indonesia, PT Indo Premier Sekuritas and PT Aldiracita Sekuritas Indonesia, with PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk as trustee. As of 30 June 2025, Hino Finance reported total assets of Rp6.59 trillion, revenue of Rp314.13 billion and net profit of Rp36.74 billion.

title: PT Jinlong Resources Investment launches a mandatory tender offer for PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk shares
body: PT Jinlong Resources Investment announced a mandatory tender offer for up to 271.9 million shares (about 20.84% of the capital) of PT Hotel Fitra International Tbk, priced at Rp296 per share, with the tender running from 5 February to 6 March 2026 and a maximum transaction value of Rp80.47 billion. The offer follows JRI’s acquisition of a combined 79.15% stake in FITT earlier in December 2025 and the company states it has sufficient funds and no intention to delist or go private.

title: PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara increases its stake in PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk INET through a share purchase
body: PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara bought 124.4 million shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk INET at Rp364 per share on 3 January 2026, raising its holding to 12.63 billion shares (56.46% of the company). After the deal, INET’s price rose to Rp380, up 4 points, remaining down 20.06% YTD but up about 11.18% over the last five days following news of its acquisition of PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk PADA.

title: Edwin Soeryadjaya increases stake in PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk to 35.88% after Feb 2‑4 share purchases
body: Edwin Soeryadjaya bought a total of 1.53 million shares of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk in two transactions on 2 February (488,700 shares at Rp1,629) and 4 February (1,045,000 shares at Rp1,608), spending roughly Rp2.48 billion and raising his ownership to 35.88% of the issued capital. Following the purchases, SRTG’s share price rose 4.01% to Rp1,685, though it remains down 8.35% year‑to‑date.

title: PT Aplikasi Bitumen Indonesia to supply chipseal materials and supervise 10‑km haul road for RMK Group, contract worth Rp14.72 billion
body: PT Aplikasi Bitumen Indonesia, a subsidiary of PT Xolare RCR Energy, has started a four‑month contract with PT Royaltama Mulia Konstruksi to provide chipseal material, technical supervision and quality control for a 10‑km segment of a 30‑km haul road in Gunung Megang, Muara Enim, valued at Rp14.72 billion. The project begins in February 2026, uses ROKT equipment and labor, and includes a 180‑day material warranty.

title: Barito Renewables Energy announces up to IDR 2 trillion share buyback program
body: Barito Renewables Energy will repurchase shares worth up to IDR 2 trillion using internal cash from 4 February to 3 May 2026, with PT BNI Sekuritas acting as broker and no daily volume cap. The treasury shares will be held for up to three years and the company says the buyback will not materially affect its operations or liquidity.

title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk clarifies material disclosures and confirms three‑month share buyback amid price volatility
body: The company told the Indonesia Stock Exchange that it has disclosed all material information and that no undisclosed events could affect its share price. It also confirmed a share buyback program from 6 February to 5 May 2026 and that its main shareholder intends to keep its stake.

title: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk announces up to Rp1 trillion share buyback program
body: PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk will allocate a maximum of Rp1 trillion for a share buyback that runs from 6 February 2026 to 5 May 2026, financed entirely from internal cash and executed through PT Henan Putihrai Sekuritas on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The repurchased shares will be held as treasury shares for up to three years, with the company retaining flexibility to sell, cancel capital, or use them for employee ownership programs.

title: Bank Mandiri expands support for creative MSMEs through financing, mentorship and the Inacraft 2026 trade fair
body: Bank Mandiri said it has assisted more than 15,000 creative MSMEs, with over 7,000 moving up a class, and disbursed Rp74.9 trillion in MSME loans from January to November 2025 while its Livin Merchant app serves over 3 million merchants. The bank also partnered with the Asosiasi Eksportir dan Produsen Handicraft Indonesia to host the Inacraft 2026 trade fair, featuring 2,500 MSME tenants and attracting more than 140,000 visitors.

title: Takushi Ishimoto sell Shares of PT Multi Spunindo Jaya Tbk
body: Shareholder Takushi Ishimoto sold 100,000 shares of PT Multi Spunindo Jaya Tbk on Feb 4, 2026 at approximately IDR 410 per share. His holding decreased from 30,809,256 to 30,709,256 shares, a reduction of 100,000 shares. The transaction, recorded on Feb 5, 2026, reflects a straightforward divestment without disclosed strategic purpose, marginally lowering his ownership stake in the company.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher Buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher bought 100,100 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) on 4 February 2026 at IDR 1,620.00 per share for investment purposes, increasing his holding from 203,885,322 to 203,985,422 shares (+100,100). The transaction was reported on 5 February 2026, reflecting a modest ownership increment that may signal continued confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 4 February 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko bought 66,500 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) at an average price of IDR 152.0 per share, raising his holding from 2,306,260 to 2,372,760 shares.
