The purchase, disclosed under the Investment Strategy category, strengthens his position in the logistics firm and signals confidence in its growth prospects. The transaction adds approximately 2.9% to his stake, potentially influencing future corporate decisions.

title: Magnus Jaya sell Shares of Metropolitan Land Tbk
body: Magnus Jaya sold 157,143,000 shares of Metropolitan Land Tbk (MTLA.JK) at IDR 560 per share, reducing his stake from 405,835,851 to 248,692,851 shares, a decline of 157,143,000 shares. The transaction, recorded on 13 Jan 2026, was executed for capital‑gain purposes. The sale represents a significant divestment, decreasing the shareholder’s ownership proportion in the company.

title: Yacobus Jemmy Hartanto buy Shares of PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk
body: Yacobus Jemmy Hartanto executed a net purchase of 391,100 shares of PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk, increasing his stake from 254,315,200 to 254,706,300 shares. The transaction, conducted at IDR 199.0 per share, was reported to facilitate a change in ownership structure. While the purchase represents a modest 0.15% increase in holdings, it reflects ongoing investor interest in the company and maintains the current ownership distribution without triggering significant dilution or control shifts.

title: Sentra Investa Maksima sell Shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk
body: On 30 Jan 2026, Sentra Investa Maksima sold 700,000 shares of PT Lavender Bina Cendikia Tbk at IDR 63 per share, reducing its holding from 98,770,600 to 98,070,600 shares (a decline of 0.71%). The sale is classified as liquid, indicating a move to free up cash. The transaction modestly lowers the shareholder's stake without affecting control, and signals a routine portfolio adjustment for the investor.

title: PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk buy Shares of Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk
body: On 28 January 2026, PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk purchased 900 ordinary shares of Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk (GMTD.JK) at a price of IDR 2,450 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised the shareholder's stake from zero to 900 shares, marking the initial acquisition and expanding its equity position in the company.

title: Null buy Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) reported that the shareholder identified as Null purchased 5,500 shares on 2026-02-04 at IDR 14,979 per share for investment purposes. The stake increased from 13,406,916,370 to 13,406,921,870 shares, a net addition of 5,500 shares, reflecting a marginal ownership change.

title: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd buy Shares of PT Lovina Beach Brewery Tbk
body: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd purchased 5,077,200 shares of PT Lovina Beach Brewery Tbk (STRK.JK) on 3 February 2026 at IDR 179 per share. The transaction raised the shareholder's holding from 1,713,654,600 to 1,718,731,800 shares, a net increase of 5,077,200 shares. No specific purpose was disclosed. The buy adds a modest incremental stake for the investor, reflecting continued interest in the brewery's equity.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold 15,600 Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN.JK) shares on 5 Feb 2026 at IDR 14,949 per share, reducing his stake from 617,600 to 602,000 shares (a decline of 15,600 shares). The divestment reflects a strategic reduction of his holding in the coal mining company, potentially affecting shareholder composition but not the company's operational outlook.

title: Neil Russell John sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Neil Russell John sold a total of 73,500 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk between 3‑5 Feb 2026 at a representative price of IDR 15,024 per share, reducing his holding from 6,000,000 to 5,926,500 shares (a decline of 73,500 shares). The divestment purpose signals a strategic exit of a portion of his stake, marginally lowering his ownership percentage and adding modest supply to the market, which may affect short‑term liquidity but is unlikely to alter control of the company.

title: Dharma Polimetal unveils Dharma Connect EV ecosystem at IIMS 2026
body: At the Indonesia International Motor Show 2026, Dharma Polimetal presented its new Dharma Connect platform, a five‑segment ecosystem covering batteries, charging stations, motors, solar solutions, and vehicle conversion to support Indonesia's electric‑vehicle growth. The company said the initiative will expand its business scope, add value across the EV supply chain, and strengthen its long‑term competitiveness in the evolving automotive industry.

title: Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara sell Shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk
body: Shareholder Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara sold 4,800 shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk (DRMA.JK) at IDR 1,030 per share on 3 Feb 2026, reducing his stake from 71,854,100 to 71,849,300 shares (a decrease of 4,800). The transaction is classified as a divestment, representing a minor adjustment to his position without altering overall control of the company.

title: Jap Astrid Patricia buy Shares of PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk
body: On 2 February 2026, shareholder Jap Astrid Patricia purchased a total of 1,954,200 PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk shares at approximately IDR 113 per share, increasing her holding from 58,130,265 to 60,084,465 shares—a rise of 1,954,200 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment, reflecting a strategic increase in her equity stake in the listed company.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko Buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 5 Feb 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased 65,700 PT Logisticsplus International Tbk shares at IDR 152 per share, raising his holding from 2,372,760 to 2,438,460 shares (an increase of 2.8%). The buy aligns with his stated investment strategy and modestly expands his equity stake in the logistics firm.

title: Indonesia to fully cover 11% VAT on Eid 2026 airfares and cut transport fees
body: Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto announced the government will subsidize the entire 11% VAT on airline tickets for the 2026 Eid al‑Fitr homecoming, a larger stimulus than the 5% VAT support provided for the 2025‑2026 Christmas period. Transportation Minister Dudy Purwagandhi also said price cuts for trains, ferries, road tickets and toll rebates will accompany the airline relief.

title: Indonesia adds $400 million to its Just Energy Transition Partnership, raising total funding to $21.8 billion
body: Indonesia’s Just Energy Transition Partnership received an extra US$400 million, bringing total pledged financing to US$21.8 billion, with KfW committing to two projects including the Saguling Floating Solar Power Plant. Of the total, US$11 billion comes from International Partners Group, US$10 billion from Glasgow Financial Alliance for Net Zero, and about US$3.1 billion has already been spent on more than 20 pipeline projects.

title: Indonesia plans PT PAL Indonesia to become holding company for state-owned shipyards
body: The government’s Danantara agency is moving to make PT PAL Indonesia the parent of four state-owned shipyards—PT PAL Indonesia, PT Dok & Perkapalan Kodja Bahari, PT Dok & Perkapalan Surabaya and PT Industri Kapal Indonesia—to consolidate naval, commercial and offshore vessel production, while private yards will continue to operate. Under the new framework, state-owned shipping firms such as Pertamina International Shipping, Pelni and ASDP will be required to procure new vessels through PT PAL Indonesia.

title: Indonesia's Finance Ministry targets 40 steel firms over alleged Rp5 trillion annual VAT losses
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa announced that 40 steel companies, including some in the hebel sector, are suspected of evading VAT between 2016 and 2019, potentially costing the state up to Rp5 trillion per year. The ministry will summon owners and may escalate investigations to involve shareholders.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange raises free‑float thresholds for IPO listings
body: The IDX announced new free‑float requirements—25% for firms under Rp5 trillion, 20% for those between Rp5 trillion and Rp50 trillion, and 15% for larger companies—plus minimum share counts, SID holder numbers and operational track‑record criteria for Main and Development Boards. The measures aim to boost market liquidity and investor confidence after recent volatility linked to an MSCI index review and OJK leadership resignations.

title: Indonesia's trade minister calls for increased second-brand cooking oil production ahead of Ramadan
body: Trade Minister Budi Santoso urged producers, including PT Mikie Oleo Nabati Industri, to boost output of affordable second-brand cooking oil to complement the Minyakita program and ensure supply and price stability before Ramadan and Eid. He noted Minyakita has reached about 33% of its 35% DMO target, with the national average price around Rp16,200 per liter, and warned the government will monitor the market and intervene if prices rise.

title: Indonesia targets completion of 30,000 Red and White Village Cooperative facilities by May‑June 2026
body: Coordinating Minister for Food Affairs Zulkifli Hasan announced that the government aims to finish construction of 30,000 village cooperative facilities by May‑June 2026, enabling them to supply fertilizers, groceries and subsidized LPG to rural areas. State‑run food company PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara said 680 buildings are already completed, 29,424 are under construction, and it plans to finish the 30,000‑facility target by April 2026 and reach 60,000‑80,000 cooperatives by July.

title: PT United Tractors confirms PT Agincourt Resources’ Rp200.99 bn environmental lawsuit is not material to its finances
body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) disclosed that its subsidiary PT Agincourt Resources (PTAR) received a civil lawsuit from the Ministry of Environment/Badan Pengendalian Lingkungan Hidup in South Jakarta Court on 23 January 2026, seeking roughly Rp200.99 billion for alleged environmental damage. UNTR said PTAR has paused operations since 6 December 2025, that the claim is not material to the group’s financial or operational standing, and that no special disclosure is required.

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk denies any involvement with alleged capital market crime suspects
body: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk issued a clarification stating it has no direct or indirect relationship with Edy Suwarno, Eveline Listijosuputro, or PT Minna Padi Aset Manajemen, and that its controlling shareholder changed to PT Nusantara Utama Investama in June 2023 along with board restructuring. The company reaffirmed its compliance with legal requirements, good corporate governance, and commitment to accurate disclosure and measured investment opportunities.

title: PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk resumes trading after month-long suspension, shares plunge to auto‑rejection floor
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange lifted the suspension on PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk shares on 6 February 2026, placing the stock under a Full Call Auction for the next week. At the open, the shares fell 9.40% to the lower auto‑rejection limit of Rp270 per share.

title: Magnus Jaya sells 157.1 million Metropolitan Land shares, cutting its stake to 3.25%
body: Magnus Jaya divested 157,143 million shares of Metropolitan Land (MTLA) at a price of Rp560 per share, generating about Rp88 billion in proceeds. After the transaction, its holding fell to 248.69 million shares (3.25% of the company), down from 5.30% before the sale, while the stock remained near Rp600.

title: Bukit Uluwatu Villa denies any link to market‑manipulation suspects and reports modest share rebound
body: Bukit Uluwatu Villa clarified that it has no relationship with suspects Edy Suwarno, Eveline Listijosuputro, and Minna Padi Aset Manajemen, noting that PT Nusantara Utama Investama became its new controlling shareholder in June 2023 and that the board and directors have been restructured. The stock rose 0.49% to Rp1,020 per share after having fallen about 31.8% to around Rp1,495 since early January 2026.

title: Wijaya Karya Bangunan Gedung faces PKU lawsuits totaling roughly Rp28.25 billion
body: Wijaya Karya Bangunan Gedung WEGE is currently subject to PKU proceedings with claims amounting to about Rp28.25 billion from five creditors—Dinamikaprakarsa Mukti, Interdesign Cipta Optima, PT Berkat Putera Pratama, SCG Readymi Indonesia and Edo Fernando Putra. The firm is reviewing the claims, negotiating settlements and states the applications do not directly impact its operations, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: United Tractors subsidiary Agincourt Resources sued for Rp200.99 billion over alleged environmental damage
body: United Tractors' subsidiary Agincourt Resources faces a civil lawsuit of Rp200.99 billion filed by the Ministry of Environment in South Jakarta court, with the first hearing on 3 February 2026 and mediation pending. United Tractors says the claim is not material to its financials or operations and the subsidiary has not made provisions yet, though it has set aside reclamation and post‑mining guarantees.

title: Sanurhasta Mitra MINA denies links to market‑crime suspects amid 15% share drop
body: Sanurhasta Mitra MINA refuted any connection to Edy Suwarno ESO, Eveline Listijosuputro EL or Minna Padi Aset Management MPAM, noting that after a February 2025 Mandatory Tender Offer transferred its main shareholding to PT Tirta Orisa Yasa, the firm has not been party to any capital‑market criminal investigations. Nevertheless, the stock dropped 44 points (14.86%) to Rp252, a total decline of 204 points (44.74%) since early January 2026, while Bareskrim Polri has identified suspects in the MPAM case.

title: PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk targets Rp5.1 trillion revenue and over Rp700 billion net profit for 2026 while launching a share buyback program
body: PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk aims to generate Rp5.1 trillion in revenue and net profit above Rp700 billion in 2026, following a 2025 outlook of Rp4.2 trillion revenue and net profit exceeding Rp600 billion. The firm raised Rp586.1 billion through a capital increase in the second half of 2025 and announced a share buyback of up to Rp500 billion (about 0.30% of its capital) from 3 February to 2 May 2026, stating the buyback will not materially affect its financial performance.

title: PT Green Power Group Tbk conducts board overhaul after An Shaohong resigns at extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: At the extraordinary general meeting of PT Green Power Group Tbk held on 3 February 2026, former President Director An Shaohong and Director Hu Yanging resigned, and the shareholders approved Chen Xiao Xiao as the new President Director along with a reshuffle of other directors and commissioners. The meeting achieved quorum with shareholders representing 425,511,500 shares (38.56% of voting rights) and also accepted the resignation of independent commissioner Dedy Bernandus Simanjuntak.

title: PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk posts modest profit growth in 2025 amid strong credit expansion and robust funding
body: PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk reported a consolidated net profit of Rp56.3 trillion for 2025, a 0.93% increase YoY, driven by a 13.4% rise in total credit to Rp1,895 trillion and a 23.9% jump in third‑party funds to Rp2,106 trillion, including CASA of Rp1,431 trillion. The bank’s asset quality remained strong with an NPL ratio of 0.96% and a capital adequacy ratio of 20.4%, while net interest income grew 4.38% to Rp106 trillion and non‑interest income rose 14.5% to Rp48.5 trillion.

title: PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk clarifies IPO investigation to BEI, cites no prior knowledge and no material impact
body: PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk submitted a letter to the Indonesia Stock Exchange stating that it first learned of the IPO manipulation allegations, including the raid on PT Shinhan Sekuritas, through media reports, that former director Junaedi is no longer a director or controlling shareholder, and that no current directors or commissioners are involved; the company reports no material effect on its financial performance and is reviewing legal implications, with no lawsuits filed yet.

title: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk directors buy 700,000 shares, increasing their holdings to 5.3 million and 2.25 million shares
body: Directors Djauhar Maulidi and Ogi Rulino purchased 400,000 and 300,000 shares of PT Rukun Raharja Tbk respectively on 27 January 2026 at Rp4,999 per share, amounting to roughly Rp3.5 billion. After the transactions, Djauhar's stake rose to 5.3 million shares (0.13%) and Ogi's to 2.25 million shares (about 0.05%), and the stock fell 1.78% to Rp3,860 on 5 February 2026.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia lifts trading suspension of PT Asia Pacific Investama Tbk after free‑float compliance
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia lifted the temporary trading suspension of PT Asia Pacific Investama Tbk effective 5 February 2026 after the company satisfied the 7.5% free‑float requirement. The stock, which had been under special monitoring and subject to a written warning and a Rp50 million fine, may now resume trading on the regular and cash markets via periodic call auction.

title: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk prepares to repay its 2025 Sustainable Bond due March 2, 2026
body: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk announced that it has secured funds to repay the principal of its 2025 Sustainable Bond Series A, amounting to Rp856 billion, together with the fourth interest payment at a 7.25% rate before the March 2, 2026 maturity. The payment will be made to PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) as part of the company’s commitment to meet its obligations to bond investors.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia outline market reforms after meeting with Morgan Stanley Capital International
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia and PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia held an online meeting with Morgan Stanley Capital International, discussing three key initiatives: expanding share‑ownership disclosure to holdings above 1% on a monthly basis, adding 27 sub‑categories to the Single Investor Identification classification, and raising the minimum free‑float requirement from 7.5% to 15% in phases. The exchanges aim to complete all measures by the end of April 2026 and maintain proactive engagement with MSCI under OJK guidance.

title: PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk posts Rp1.895 trillion consolidated credit by end‑2025, outpacing industry growth
body: PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk reported consolidated credit of Rp1,895 trillion through December 2025, a 13.4% year‑on‑year increase, with bank‑only credit reaching Rp1,497 trillion (up 14.2% YoY) and asset quality metrics improving (NPL 0.96%, LAR 6.05%, CoC 0.34%, NPL coverage 253%). The bank attributes the strong growth to credit to state‑owned enterprises and the government (≈40% YoY) and plans to sustain above‑industry credit expansion in 2026 by focusing on productive UMKM, manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and trade services.

title: Moody's maintains Indonesia's Baa2 sovereign rating but shifts outlook to negative
body: Moody's Investors Service kept Indonesia's credit rating at Baa2, one level above investment grade, while changing the outlook from stable to negative, citing the need for predictable policy, stronger revenue and better inter‑agency coordination; the agency projects stable medium‑term real GDP growth supported by natural resources and demographics, and notes a Q4‑2025 growth of 5.39% that exceeded market expectations. The statement also highlighted the role of Danantara Indonesia in energizing fiscal policy and the government's focus on programs such as free nutritious meals, people’s schools and housing to boost inclusive growth.

title: Bank Mandiri reports 16.6% asset growth and double‑digit credit expansion in 2025 amid solid Indonesian economic performance
body: Bank Mandiri’s audited 2025 results show total assets rising 16.6% YoY to Rp2,829.9 trillion and credit disbursements increasing 13.4% YoY to Rp1,895.0 trillion, supported by strong UMKM lending (4.88% YoY) and a low Gross NPL of 0.96%. The bank posted net profit of Rp56.3 trillion, driven by higher interest income and a 14.5% rise in non‑interest revenue, while maintaining robust liquidity through a 23.9% increase in DPK to Rp2,105.8 trillion.

title: PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk buy Shares of Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk purchased 900 shares of Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk at IDR 2,450 per share, increasing its stake from 0 to 900 shares (a +900 share delta). The transaction is classified as an investment and revises earlier reporting. This acquisition raises the shareholder's direct ownership in the listed entity, potentially enhancing its influence and signaling confidence in the tourism development business.

title: Tanrise Property accelerates premium lifestyle expansion with new golf and villa projects targeting Rp 28 billion recurring income
body: PT Jaya Sukses Makmur Sentosa Tbk RISE (Tanrise Property) will launch three premium lifestyle projects—a PGA‑Tour‑standard driving range in Taman Dayu, and Solaris Villas in Malang and Bali—targeting a combined recurring income of about Rp 28 billion annually. The driving range, costing Rp 37 billion, is expected to generate Rp 20 billion per year, while the Malang and Bali villas, funded with Rp 6.5 billion and Rp 12.5 billion respectively, aim for Rp 3 billion and Rp 5 billion in annual revenue.

title: PT Pegadaian pays Rp3.12 billion coupon on 2024 Series B bond
body: PT Pegadaian transferred Rp3,118,445,000 to the KSEI account to settle the 6.20% coupon on its 2024 Series B bond (03557704) on February 5, 2026, using its Bank Rakyat Indonesia account. The payment underscores the company's commitment to timely fulfillment of bond obligations.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange Issues New Free‑Float Requirements for IPO Applicants
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) released Regulation No. I‑A setting minimum free‑float ratios of 15‑25% for IPO candidates, with a minimum of 300 million shares on the main board and 150 million on the development board, and requiring 36‑month or 24‑month commercial operations respectively. The rules also mandate at least 10,000 (main board) or 5,000 (development board) single‑investor identification holders after the offering, as explained by interim BEI director Jeffrey Hendrik.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk reinforces agricultural growth through expanded KUR financing
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, known as BRI, continues to back Indonesia’s agricultural sector through its Kredit Usaha Rakyat (KUR) program, exemplified by farmer Syiro Judin Abbas who grew his 2.5‑hectare rice farm with loans rising from Rp8 million to Rp20 million; in 2025 BRI disbursed Rp178.08 trillion in KUR to about 3.8 million borrowers, with agriculture receiving Rp80.09 trillion (44.97% of total) and cumulative disbursements since 2015 reaching Rp1,435 trillion to 46.4 million recipients, supporting food security and farmer welfare.

title: PT Hanjaya Sampoerna Tbk schedules extraordinary shareholders meeting to appoint three new directors
body: PT Hanjaya Sampoerna Tbk will hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 27 February 2026 to appoint Reno Bontemps, Houria Raselma and Rianto Probo Hartono as new directors, with their terms running until the 2030 annual meeting. Bontemps and Raselma come from senior roles at Philip Morris International and Philip Morris Management Services, while Hartono brings more than 18 years of experience within the PT HM Sampoerna Tbk group.

title: Dicky Yordan buy Shares of PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk
body: On 2 Feb 2026, shareholder Dicky Yordan purchased 150,000 shares of PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk at IDR 615 per share, increasing his stake from 125,651,321 to 125,801,321 shares (a net gain of 150,000). The acquisition, reported on 6 Feb 2026, is stated to diversify his personal investment portfolio. The modest increase does not materially affect overall ownership distribution but signals continued confidence in the company.

title: Takushi Ishimoto sell Shares of PT Multi Spunindo Jaya Tbk
body: On 5‑6 February 2026, shareholder Takushi Ishimoto sold a total of 40,100 shares of PT Multi Spunindo Jaya Tbk (MSJA.JK) at a representative price of IDR 398 per share. The sale reduced his holding from 30,709,256 to 30,669,156 shares, a decline of 40,100 shares. The transaction, recorded as a sell for cash, marginally lowers his ownership percentage but is not expected to materially affect the company’s share structure.

title: Amir Sunarko sell Shares of PT SLJ Global Tbk
body: Amir Sunarko sold a total of 25,641,026 PT SLJ Global Tbk shares on 30 January 2026 at a representative price of IDR 111 per share. His holding decreased from 321,734,107 to 296,093,081 shares, a reduction of 25,641,026 shares, reflecting a deliberate share sale purpose. The transaction lowers Sunarko's ownership stake in the listed company, which may affect his voting power and signal portfolio rebalancing to investors.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Shareholder Jemmy Kurniawan sold a total of 21,289,500 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk shares at approximately IDR 86 per share on 4‑5 February 2026, reducing his holding from 954,288,500 to 932,999,000 shares (a decline of 21,289,500 shares, about 2.2% of his prior stake). The transaction is a reduction of the number of shares held.

title: Gema Buana Indonesia, PT sell Shares of Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk
body: On 13 Jan 2026, PT Gema Buana Indonesia sold 31,250,000 shares of Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk at IDR 3,200 per share. The transaction reduced its holding from 209,464,304 to 178,214,304 shares, a decline of about 15%. Recorded on 6 Feb 2026, the sale represents a divestment and lowers the shareholder’s ownership percentage, potentially affecting voting power and market perception of the stock.

title: Granada Global Industri sell Shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk
body: Granada Global Industri sold a total of 38,300,000 shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk at a representative price of IDR 100 per share as part of a divestment strategy. The holding fell from 126,440,000 shares to 88,140,000 shares, a reduction of 38,300,000 shares (approximately 30% of the prior stake). The transaction, executed on 3-4 February 2026, signals a significant reallocation of capital by the shareholder.

title: Sabrina Evelyn Elian sell Shares of Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk
body: On 28 Jan 2026, shareholder Sabrina Evelyn Elian sold 13,397,300 YULÉ shares at IDR 3,000 per share, reducing her holding from 92,436,866 to 79,039,566 shares (a decline of 13,397,300). The transaction, classified as a share sale, lowers her ownership stake in Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and may affect voting power and market perception of the company's share structure.

title: Bank Negara Indonesia projects lower 2026 net interest margin amid tighter liquidity and loan yield pressures
body: Bank Negara Indonesia expects its full-year net interest margin to fall to 3.5%‑3.8% in 2026, citing lower loan yields, tighter first-half liquidity and uncertainty over government liquidity placements. The bank targets 8%‑10% loan growth, driven by momentum in the MSME segment, and anticipates clearer guidance on government liquidity by late February or early March, according to UOB Kay Hian.

title: Indonesia's OJK to create task force to accelerate capital market reforms
body: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) announced it will form a Capital Market Integrity Reform Task Force, involving the Indonesia Stock Exchange, KSEI, KPEI and other market participants, to speed up implementation of eight reform measures. The reforms include raising the minimum free‑float requirement to 15 % (from 7.5 %), tightening ultimate beneficial‑owner disclosure and lowering the investor‑shareholding reporting threshold to just above 1 %, alongside demutualisation, stricter enforcement and coordination with Morgan Stanley Capital International.

title: Moody's outlook cut to negative triggers market sell‑off in Indonesia
body: Moody's lowered Indonesia's sovereign outlook to negative and placed a negative outlook on state‑owned firms Telkom Indonesia, Telkomsel, Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur, United Tractors, Pertamina and MIND ID, while also trimming outlooks for five major banks. The Jakarta Composite Index dropped 2.5% and the rupiah fell to 16,888 per dollar, its lowest since Jan 22, amid concerns over fiscal health and central‑bank independence under President Prabowo Subianto’s growth agenda.

title: Bangun Kosambi Sukses records Rp430 billion pre‑sale in 2025, nearing its target
body: Bangun Kosambi Sukses (CBDK) reported pre‑sale revenue of Rp430 billion in 2025, about 85 % of its Rp508 billion target, driven mainly by commercial land parcels in the CBD PIK2 area (Rp343 billion, 80 % of total). The firm saw a 309 % QoQ jump to Rp109 billion in Q4, launched the Nusantara International Convention and Exhibition platform with 16 events, and expects the Hilton Jakarta PIK2 hotel to open in mid‑2027 to further support sustainable growth.

title: PTBA to Supply Reliable Energy for Integrated Aluminium Smelter Project in West Kalimantan
body: PT Bukit Asam (PTBA) will provide stable, large‑scale power to the new bauxite‑alumina‑aluminium integrated smelter in Mempawah, West Kalimantan, which aims to process 3 million tonnes of bauxite into 1 million tonnes of alumina and 600,000 tonnes of aluminium annually and create over 65,000 jobs. The project is supported by Danantara Indonesia, MIND ID and PTBA’s commitment to domestic mineral value‑addition and energy security.

title: PT Indospring Tbk targets Middle East expansion as net sales hit Rp2.46 trillion in Q3 2025
body: PT Indospring Tbk said it will focus on exporting automotive components to the Middle East and Central Asia, while strengthening its domestic fastener line, after reporting net sales of Rp2.46 trillion in the third quarter of 2025. The company expects continued growth in Indonesia’s vehicle‑spare‑parts market, supported by a projected 5.4% rise in 2026 car sales to 850,000 units.

title: PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk projects 2026 revenue of about Rp2.3 trillion with 10‑15% annual growth amid rising health‑sector demand
body: PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk (OMED) expects 2026 revenue of roughly Rp2.3 trillion, a 10‑15% yearly increase, while keeping gross margin around 30% and export sales of USD 1.0‑1.5 million. The firm will allocate about Rp62 billion to new production equipment and a National Distribution Center, backed by a 16% rise in the national health budget to Rp244 trillion.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sells over 713 million shares of PT Sentul City Tbk after a prior purchase
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold 713,758,700 shares of PT Sentul City Tbk (BKSL) on 3 February 2026 at Rp145 per share, lowering its holding to 7.68 billion shares (4.58%) from 8.39 billion (5.01%). The transaction, valued at roughly Rp103.5 billion, follows a purchase of 712,715,000 shares at the same price on 30 January, and the stock dropped 4.32% to Rp133 on 6 February.

title: PT Solusi Environtment Asia Tbk launches energy subsidiary PT Ananta Energi Asia after control shift to PT Asia Investment Capital
body: PT Solusi Environtment Asia Tbk, formerly PT Boston Furniture Asia Tbk, announced the formation of PT Ananta Energi Asia on 5 February 2026, with 99% ownership by SOFA and 1% by PT Asia Investment Capital, to pursue energy and renewable projects. The new entity is awaiting ministry approval and has entered a Waste-to-Energy tender organized by PT Danantara Investment Management through its subsidiary PT Parivarta Energi Nusantara, part of a consortium with Hunan Construction Engineering Group Co and Kintan Usahasama Sdn Bhd.

title: Calculus Investment Pte Ltd launches a mandatory tender offer for up to 67.81% of PT Buana Artha Anugerah Tbk shares at Rp88 per share
body: Calculus Investment Pte Ltd announced a mandatory tender offer for up to 3,255,075,602 shares (67.81% of the capital) of PT Buana Artha Anugerah Tbk at Rp88 per share, with the offer running from 9 February to 10 March 2026 and a maximum value of about Rp286.45 billion. The tender follows Calculus’s acquisition of 32.19% of the company from PT Kencana Selaras Sejahtera on 20 November 2025 for Rp135.95 billion, making it the new controlling shareholder.

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk readies Rp434.35 billion for repayment of 2023 Series A bond due March 2026
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk has secured Rp434.35 billion, comprising Rp425 billion principal and Rp9.35 billion interest, to settle the 12th interest payment and principal of its 2023 Series A bond maturing on 3 March 2026. The funds, sourced from the 2025 and 2026 Sustainable Bond issuances and internal cash, will be transferred to PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia by 2 March 2026, with the bond originally rated idA by PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia and PT Bank Mega Tbk acting as trustee.

title: PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk signs Rp79.596 billion finance lease with PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia for new trucks
body: On 4 February 2026, PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk secured a finance lease of Rp79,596 billion from PT Indomobil Finance Indonesia to purchase new trucks for its logistics operations. The company said the financing will not materially affect its operations, financial condition, legal aspects, or business continuity and will help strengthen capacity and support future growth.

title: PT Bukalapakcom Tbk launches additional share buyback using remaining IDR 280.99 billion
body: PT Bukalapakcom Tbk announced it will use the remaining IDR 280.99 billion from its Oct 30 2025‑Jan 29 2026 share‑buyback program to conduct an additional buyback between 9 Feb and 8 May 2026, without needing prior shareholder approval. The company said the buyback reflects strong liquidity and noted its share price has fallen 12.66% year‑to‑date, trading at IDR 138, down 2.13% at 11:29 WIB.

title: PT Sanurhasta Mitra Tbk denies any involvement with individuals under capital market crime investigations after shareholder change to PT Tirta Orisa Yasa
body: PT Sanurhasta Mitra Tbk stated it is not involved, directly or indirectly, with Edy Suwarno, Eveline Listijosuputro, or the director of PT Minna Padi Aset Management. The company confirmed that after a February 2025 mandatory tender offer transferred main control to PT Tirta Orisa Yasa, it operates independently and complies with all applicable regulations and good corporate governance.

title: Indonesia's Finance Minister speeds up bioethanol tax exemption rule revisions after Pertamina cites licensing hurdles
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa pledged to finalize revisions to PMK No. 82/2024 and Customs Regulation No. PER 13/BC/2024 within a week to simplify bioethanol tax exemption requirements raised by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga. PT Pertamina highlighted that lengthy IUI and AMDAL licensing, which can take up to three years per site, limits the tax exemption—currently Rp20,000 per litre—to a single location in Surabaya, undermining bioethanol's economic viability.

title: Indonesia's Energy Ministry forecasts domestic coal market obligation could reach 30% as production quota falls
body: Deputy Energy Minister Yuliot said the domestic market obligation (DMO) for coal may exceed 30% after the government plans to cut the national production quota to roughly 600 million tonnes in 2026, down from 800 million tonnes in 2025. The DMO framework is outlined in Ministerial Decree No. 399.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2023.

title: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority outlines three 2026 priority policies to boost sector resilience, ecosystem contribution, and sustainable finance
body: OJK announced three priority policies for 2026—strengthening financial sector resilience, developing a contributive financial ecosystem, and deepening markets while promoting sustainable finance—detailing actions such as minimum capital requirements, AI‑based supervision, deregulation, and support for government programs including Rp149 trillion financing for village cooperatives and Rp1.02 trillion for nutrition initiatives. The regulator also outlined market‑integrity reforms, expanded gold‑related instruments and a carbon‑registry framework to align with Indonesia’s net‑zero goals.

title: BRI Finance pledges financing support to help Kudus become an industrial and trade hub
body: PT BRI Multifinance Indonesia (BRI Finance) announced it will expand financing services and open a branch in Kudus to support the local government's plan to develop the regency into an industrial and trade city, aiming to improve access to formal capital for companies and UMKM. The article notes Kudus contributed 8.10% of Central Java’s GDP in 2021, ranking second among the province's economic drivers, and BRI Finance expects its presence to strengthen synergy with BRI Group, dealers, insurers and other partners.

title: Indonesia's private fuel stations will source diesel from Pertamina starting April 2026, ending solar imports
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) announced that private fuel stations must purchase domestically produced diesel (solar) from Pertamina beginning in April 2026, ending further solar imports. The shift will be backed by the new Refinery Unit V Balikpapan under the Refinery Development Master Plan, which can process 360,000 barrels per day, potentially saving up to Rp68 trillion in fuel imports annually and adding roughly Rp514 trillion to GDP.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange to lift suspension of PT Dua Putra Utama Makmur Tbk shares on 9 February 2026
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange announced that trading of PT Dua Putra Utama Makmur Tbk will resume on series I starting 9 February 2026. The shares had been suspended since 23 December 2025 after a significant price surge.

title: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Persero Tbk focuses on human‑resource quality and digitalisation to drive productivity and strategic gas infrastructure investment
body: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Persero Tbk said it is boosting human‑resource quality to create a competitive, productive workplace, citing 2025 results such as 87.74% employee engagement, turnover below 3%, vacancy rate under 10% and a workforce of 2,752. The firm also highlighted digitalisation across its gas‑value chain, achieving 100% cyber‑security by 2026 and planning USD 353 million of CAPEX in 2026, about 62% of which will fund mid‑stream and downstream infrastructure to strengthen national gas distribution.

title: Jap Astrid Patricia Buy Shares of PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk
body: On 2 February 2026, Jap Astrid Patricia purchased a total of 1,954,200 shares of PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk at approximately IDR 112 per share, raising her holding from 58,130,265 to 60,084,465 shares, a net increase of 1,954,200 shares. The purchase, recorded as a revision, expands her ownership stake in the listed transport company, potentially affecting voting power and indicating confidence in the firm.

title: PT Astra Sedaya Finance prepares funds to repay its 2025 Sustainable Bond VI Phase V Series A
body: PT Astra Sedaya Finance said it has set aside Rp1.52 trillion to settle principal and interest on its 2025 Sustainable Bond VI Phase V Series A, which matures on 24 March 2026. The repayment will not affect the company's operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Granada Global Industri sells 38.3 million shares of Raja Roti Cemerlang, retaining a 9.07% stake
body: Granada Global Industri divested 38.3 million shares of Raja Roti Cemerlang between 3‑4 February 2026, selling 800 million shares at Rp110 each and 37.5 million shares at Rp100 each, generating approximately Rp3.83 billion in proceeds. After the transaction, its holding fell to 88.14 million shares (9.07% of the company), down from 126.44 million shares (13.01%).

title: PT PLN (Persero) to Deploy 4,655 EV Charging Stations across Indonesia in 2025
body: PT PLN (Persero) plans to install 4,655 SPKLU charging units in 2025, a 44% rise from 2024’s 3,223 units, expanding coverage to 3,007 locations nationwide. The rollout includes 633 ultra‑fast, 482 fast, 2,681 medium and 859 standard chargers, underscoring the company’s commitment to supporting Indonesia’s EV transition.

title: President Prabowo cites fertilizer access and record rice stocks as milestones toward Indonesia’s food self‑sufficiency
body: President Prabowo announced that Indonesia has reached food self‑sufficiency as of Dec 31 2025, citing nationwide fertilizer availability and a record‑high national rice reserve, and pledged to achieve total self‑sufficiency within three years. He also highlighted the Free Nutritious Meals program, which has fed over 60 million people and aims to reach 82.3 million by the end of 2026.

title: Jayamas Medica Industri targets Rp2.3 trillion revenue in 2026 amid expanding Indonesian health sector
body: Jayamas Medica Industri OMED, also known as PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk, projects 2026 revenue of Rp2.3 trillion, a 10–15% YoY increase, with gross margin near 30% and Rp62 billion capex for capacity expansion and a new National Distribution Center. The outlook is supported by a 16% rise in Indonesia’s health budget to Rp244 trillion and resilient demand from both public and private health segments.

title: Harta Djaya Karya MEJA targets 1.5 Mt coal output in 2026 as Trimata Coal Perkasa TCP secures contractor and 45% stake acquisition by Triple Berkah Bersama Triple B
body: Harta Djaya Karya MEJA plans to produce 1.5 million tonnes of coal in 2026 through its subsidiary Trimata Coal Perkasa TCP, which has hired Mitra Abadi Mahakam to exploit the Tungkal LIR mine in Banyuasin, Sumatra Selatan, and secured Agro Energy Trading Pte Ltd as a standby buyer. Triple Berkah Bersama Triple B agreed to acquire a 45% stake in TCP for Rp1.6 trillion via a share‑swap, with TCP estimating pre‑tax profit of USD7‑10 per tonne and an enterprise value of about Rp2.49 trillion.

title: Indonesia's regulator scrutinizes Samuel Sekuritas research after volatile moves in Abadi Lestari Indonesia shares
body: The Bursa Efek Indonesia questioned a research report by Samuel Sekuritas that projected a Rp80,000 target for Abadi Lestari Indonesia, noting the broker also acted as the IPO underwriter. Despite a recent 10% drop to Rp6,750, the stock has risen over 247% year‑to‑date to Rp1,940 and more than 3,900% from its IPO price of Rp168, with potential inclusion in Morgan Stanley Capital International cited as a catalyst.

title: PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk announces board reshuffle and ownership change after a Rp393.45 billion share acquisition
body: After PT Mercury Strategic Indonesia acquired 2,150 billion NATO shares from PT Karunia Berkah Jayasejahtera for Rp393.45 billion, PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk held an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 4 February 2026 that appointed Mauritz Nainggolan as President Director, reinstated Gede Putu Adnawa, named Hasan as President Commissioner and retained Benedictus Calvin Ardisa as Independent Commissioner, while approving amendments to its Articles of Association and the use of offering proceeds, with the new board serving until 28 June 2028.

title: OJK and BEI plan to raise the free‑float requirement for listed banks to 15% within three years
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) and the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) are drafting a revision to mandate a minimum free‑float of 15% for listed companies, up from the current 7.5%, with a phased implementation over three years ending in 2025. Under the proposal, 24 banks such as Bank OCBC NISP, Bank Raya AGRO, Bank MNC BABP and others are below the target and must increase their float, while banks like Bank Neo BBYB, Bank BRI BBRI, Bank BCA BBCA and several digital banks already meet or exceed the 15% threshold.

title: Two investors sell a total of 44.64 million Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia shares, raising about Rp140.2 billion
body: Gema Buana Indonesia sold 31.25 million shares at Rp3,200 each on 13 January 2026, reducing its holding to 9.98 % (178.21 million shares), while Sabrina Evelyn Elian sold 13.39 million shares at Rp3,000 each on 28 January 2026, leaving her stake at 4.43 % (79.03 million shares). The combined transactions generated approximately Rp140.19 billion in proceeds and were described by Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia management as internal matters.

title: Jaya Sukses Makmur announces Rp525.36 billion stock bonus and new theoretical share price
body: Jaya Sukses Makmur will issue a 5.25 billion‑share bonus (ratio 25:12) valued at Rp525.36 billion, with cum‑dividend on 19 January 2026 and distribution on 9 February 2026; the theoretical post‑bonus price is set at Rp6,550 and the new index base at 110,067.

title: Turniady Widjaja stabilizes PT Roda Vivatex Tbk shares with multi‑day purchases after price decline from ATH
body: After PT Roda Vivatex Tbk's stock fell from its all‑time high of Rp17,975, investor Turniady Widjaja bought a total of 18,300 shares between Rp16,400 and Rp17,500, amounting to roughly Rp319.9 million. The share price then rose 3.86% to Rp15,475 on 6 February 2026, and Widjaja's ownership increased marginally to 18.76% of the company.

title: PT Bank Woori Saudara Indonesia Tbk appoints new President Director and restructures its board following a shareholders' meeting
body: PT Bank Woori Saudara Indonesia Tbk held a shareholders' meeting that appointed Han Chang Sik as the new President Director, promoted Moon Sungwon to director pending OJK approval, and named Kim Ki Joo as a new commissioner, while dismissing Kim Eungchul, Benny Sudarsono Tan and Edwin Suleman (the latter two to serve until the 2025 and 2026 annual meetings). The meeting also terminated the terms of all directors and commissioners appointed at the 2025 annual meeting, effective by the 2026 meeting.

title: PT Indomobil Sukses Internasional Tbk signs MoU with Leapmotor partners to assemble and distribute Leapmotor cars in Indonesia
body: PT Indomobil Sukses Internasional Tbk, through its subsidiaries PT National Assemblers and PT Indomobil National Distributor, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Leapmotor International Business S p A and Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co, Ltd to develop, assemble and distribute Leapmotor four‑wheel vehicles in Indonesia. The agreement, disclosed on 5 February 2026, designates PT National Assemblers to manage vehicle assembly and PT Indomobil National Distributor to handle nationwide distribution.

title: PT SMR Utama Tbk clarifies ultimate beneficial owner as PT Trada Alam Minera Tbk in response to BEI request
body: PT SMR Utama Tbk responded to Bursa Efek Indonesia, stating that its ultimate beneficial owner is PT Trada Alam Minera Tbk based on the latest shareholder register. Because PT Trada Alam Minera Tbk is owned 47.14% by Kejaksaan Agung Republik Indonesia, 5.09% by PT Asabri Persero and 47.77% by the public, SMRU said it cannot disclose individual UBO details but its operations remain unaffected.

title: PT Indosat Tbk reports 2025 revenue of Rp56.518 trillion and net profit of Rp5.509 trillion, marking modest year‑over‑year growth
body: For 2025, PT Indosat Tbk recorded revenue of Rp56,518 trillion, a 1.1% increase from 2024, with net profit rising to Rp5,509 trillion driven by higher revenue and lower employee and marketing expenses. Total assets grew to Rp118,626 trillion while short‑term liabilities fell 1.6% to Rp30,499 trillion, and long‑term liabilities rose 4.1% to Rp48.62 trillion.

title: OJK imposes multi‑million‑rupiah fines and bans on PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk, PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk and PT UOB Kay Hian Sekuritas for capital‑market violations
body: OJK fined PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk Rp1.85 billion for material misstatement of its 2023 financials, imposed a joint director fine of Rp3.36 billion and a five‑year market ban on its CEO, and fined PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk Rp925 million for improper use of IPO proceeds, with its CEO also fined Rp240 million. OJK also penalised PT UOB Kay Hian Sekuritas with a Rp250 million fine, a one‑year suspension of its securities‑underwriting licence, a three‑year market ban, and additional director fines of Rp30 million and Rp125 million for CDD and mis‑information violations.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange to Hold Follow-up Meeting with MSCI on Feb 11 to Discuss Investor Classification, Disclosure and Free-Float Reforms
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia will hold a technical follow-up meeting with Morgan Stanley Capital International on 11 February 2026 after submitting a proposal on 5 February. The proposal includes expanding investor categories at PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia to 28 sub‑categories, widening shareholding disclosure to holdings above 1%, and gradually raising the minimum free‑float requirement from 7.5% to 15% for listed companies.

title: Pertamina Drilling Receives 2025 HSSE Partner Award from Pertamina Hulu Indonesia for High‑Risk Safety
body: PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia was awarded the 2025 HSSE Partner Award for High‑Risk safety by Pertamina Hulu Indonesia Regional 3, recognizing its disciplined health, safety, security and environment practices in high‑risk operations. CEO Avep Disasmita said the accolade reflects the company's commitment to safety as a core value and its ongoing efforts to strengthen HSSE culture across its drilling activities.

title: Moody's shifts outlook to negative for Indonesia and major banks, but PT Bank Tabungan Negara Tbk keeps investment‑grade fundamentals intact
body: Moody's Ratings kept Indonesia’s sovereign rating at Baa2 but changed the outlook from stable to negative, which also lowered the outlook for the five largest Indonesian banks—including PT Bank Tabungan Negara Tbk—to negative. PT Bank Tabungan Negara Tbk’s corporate secretary Ramon Armando said the bank’s capital, liquidity and asset quality remain strong and it will continue selective credit lending and strict risk management, while Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo noted the outlook change does not reflect weakening economic fundamentals.

title: Bank Mandiri launches Mandiri Sahabatku 2026 program and digital initiatives for Indonesian migrant workers and diaspora in Hong Kong
body: Bank Mandiri held the Appreciation and Kick‑Off event for the Mandiri Sahabatku 2026 program in Hong Kong, celebrating the training of more than 2,400 Indonesian migrant workers and diaspora in 2025 and presenting awards to top participants. The bank also introduced the LATW digital banking service and a new AI‑driven content‑creator curriculum in partnership with Zando AI Agency, aiming to expand financial inclusion and digital entrepreneurship for its 22,000‑plus PMI and diaspora beneficiaries worldwide.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 97,626,800 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk at IDR 140 per share on 6 Feb 2026. The holder's stake fell from 6,304,013,000 to 6,206,386,200 shares, a reduction of about 1.55%. The transaction is classified as an investment‑related divestment, indicating the shareholder is reallocating capital. The sale modestly trims insider ownership but is unlikely to affect control or market perception significantly.

title: Bani Maulana Mulia Buy Shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk
body: On 6 Feb 2026, shareholder Bani Maulana Mulia purchased 1,070,000 Samudera Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 366 per share, raising his holding from 56,372,800 to 57,442,800 shares (a +1.9% increase). The transaction, classified as an investment, expands his equity stake in the listed shipping company, indicating confidence in its future performance.

title: Edwin Widjaja buy Shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
body: On 2026-02-06, shareholder Edwin Widjaja purchased 15,000 PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk (HELI.JK) shares at IDR 200 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 309,300 to 324,300 shares, a net increase of 15,000 shares, strengthening his equity stake in the company.

title: Matra Tri Abadi buys Shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk
body: Matra Tri Abadi increased its stake in PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX.JK) by purchasing 129,673,000 shares at IDR 500 per share on 9 Feb 2026. The holding rose from 3,400,000,000 to 3,529,673,000 shares, a net increase of 129,673,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an addition of IRSX share ownership, further consolidating Matra Tri Abadi's position in the company.

title: PT Adhi Kartiko Pratama Tbk secures two IDR 100 billion loan facilities for working capital
body: PT Adhi Kartiko Pratama Tbk obtained two separate IDR 100 billion loan facilities—one from PT Bank UOB Indonesia and another from PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk—both at an interest rate of COF plus 1% per annum for a 12‑month term to fund working capital. Management indicated the loans have no material impact on the company’s financial condition and are not considered affiliated transactions under relevant regulations.

title: PT Anugrah Energi Kalimantan advances mine electrification for PT Borneo Indobara, supporting Indonesia’s green energy goals
body: PT Anugrah Energi Kalimantan is supplying electric and hybrid mining equipment to PT Borneo Indobara, aligning with the government’s 2060 Net Zero Emission target and reducing operational costs. The rollout, which began in late 2024, is being supported by PLN’s development of the necessary power grid infrastructure.

title: Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources says Domestic Coal Obligation may exceed 30% as 2026 production quota drops to 600 million tons
body: The ministry estimates the Domestic Market Obligation (DMO) for coal could rise above 30% after cutting the 2026 production quota to 600 Mt, down 200 Mt from 2025's 800 Mt, while maintaining a Domestic Price Obligation of $70 per ton for PT PLN Persero. Previously the DMO was set at 25% of actual production, roughly 23‑24% in practice.

title: Harta Djaya Karya accelerates Trimata Coal Perkasa’s coal production and secures a 45% stake acquisition by Triple Berkah Bersama
body: Harta Djaya Karya is boosting Trimata Coal Perkasa’s coal output to 1.5 million tons, appointing Mitra Abadi Mahakam as miner and securing Agro Energy Trading Pte Ltd as a standby buyer, with expected pre‑tax profit of USD 7‑10 per ton and an estimated enterprise value of IDR 2.49 trillion. Triple Berkah Bersama, the controlling shareholder, has agreed to acquire a 45 % stake in Trimata Coal Perkasa for IDR 1.6 trillion via a share‑swap, pending EGMS approval, while the mine holds roughly 693.7 million tons of JORC‑reported resources.

title: Indonesia's Mempawah bauxite downstream project aims for 2028 aluminum smelter launch with a coal‑powered 1.2 GW electricity supply
body: BPI Danantara plans to complete all energy infrastructure for the Mempawah downstreaming project by 2028, targeting a 1.2 GW power supply from PT Bukit Asam Tbk at USD 0.04‑0.05 per kWh to support a new aluminum smelter and a Smelter Grade Alumina Refinery Phase II, with total investment of IDR 104.55 trillion; the electricity scheme involves PT Indonesia Asahan Aluminium, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 6 Feb 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 13,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk at IDR 54 per share. His holding decreased from 2,857,254,200 to 2,844,254,200 shares, a reduction of approximately 0.45% of the company's equity. The transaction reflects a modest divestment by a significant insider, potentially signaling portfolio rebalancing.

title: Indonesia invites Australian investment in critical mineral downstreaming and seeks CEPA to boost trade
body: President Prabowo Subianto invited Australian firms to invest in Indonesia’s downstream processing of nickel, copper, bauxite and gold, and said state‑owned BPI Danantara is ready to partner on co‑investment projects, while Indonesia is also looking to buy more Australian lithium concentrate (about 80,000 t/year) to support its EV battery ecosystem. Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto said critical minerals will be included in the upcoming CEPA with Australia, aiming for a 100% rise in trade volume despite a 2025 trade deficit of US$5.65 billion.

title: Bank Indonesia launches biochar-based climate‑smart agriculture guide to raise rice yields and cut emissions
body: Indonesia’s central bank, together with the Coordinating Ministry for Food, the Agriculture Ministry and Diponegoro University, released a handbook on biochar technology to improve soil quality, increase rice productivity and reduce greenhouse‑gas emissions. Pilot projects in Grobogan, Central Java in 2025 showed a 6.3% rise in rice yields and more efficient use of inputs.

title: Indonesia to introduce sugar-content labeling and set up a food-safety task force
body: The government announced plans to develop a mandatory sugar-content labeling scheme for foods and beverages and to create a cross-ministerial food-safety task force to improve monitoring and response to contamination and other risks. The initiative, led by Coordinating Minister Zulkifli Hasan, will involve agencies such as BPOM, the Ministry of Health and the National Police and will be based on Codex, WHO and FAO guidelines.

title: Indonesia designates West Nusa Tenggara as hub for garlic and corn to strengthen food security
body: Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman announced that West Nusa Tenggara will develop roughly 7,750 hectares for garlic cultivation, with free seeds and technical assistance provided to farmers. The government will also promote corn production and build animal‑feed factories to absorb local harvests, aiming to cut imports and achieve self‑sufficiency by 2030.

title: FTSE Russell postpones its Indonesia index review after MSCI freezes updates, following a $120 bn drop in the Jakarta Composite
body: FTSE Russell announced on Feb. 9 that it will delay its planned March review of Indonesian securities, citing advisory‑committee feedback and uncertainty over free‑float calculations, while MSCI has also frozen updates to its Indonesia‑related products. The moves come after the Jakarta Composite lost about US$120 billion after MSCI warned the market could be downgraded to frontier status.

title: PT Indointernet Tbk seeks voluntary delisting from Bursa Efek Indonesia after five years
body: PT Indointernet Tbk has applied to the Bursa Efek Indonesia for voluntary delisting, leading to a suspension of its shares on 10 February 2026 and a required buy‑back of its roughly 159.6 million public shares, which represent a 7.9% free float valued at about Rp764 billion. The action coincides with OJK and BEI’s review of raising the minimum free‑float threshold from 7.5% to 15%.

title: PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara raises its stake in PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk to 57.28% through a third February 2026 share purchase
body: On 9 February 2026, PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara bought 45.5 million shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk at Rp330 per share, investing Rp15.01 billion and increasing its ownership to 57.28%. The transaction follows earlier purchases on 3 and 4 February, bringing the total outlay to about Rp110.28 billion for three acquisitions in the month.

title: Repower Asia Indonesia commits to stronger corporate governance to restore investor confidence
body: Repower Asia Indonesia said it will comply with the OJK’s decisions and meet all regulatory obligations, emphasizing a comprehensive internal overhaul focused on good corporate governance. The company expects the governance improvements to lower its risk premium, aid perception recovery and support a potential re‑rating of its share valuation while maintaining its growth strategy.

title: Puradelta Lestari achieves 88% of its 2025 marketing‑sales target, driven by industrial land sales
body: Puradelta Lestari reported pre‑sales of Rp1.6 trillion in 2025, about 88 % of its Rp1.81 trillion marketing‑sales target, primarily from the sale of 46 ha of industrial land, with data‑center projects accounting for roughly 60 % of that volume. The company also highlighted operational advances such as a Security, Fire and Command Center, an in‑house water‑treatment plant and integrated waste‑management to support its zero‑run‑off and zero‑waste goals while developing the Delta Mas City project.

title: Daya Intiguna launches Rp35.12 billion MESOP with 21.28 million shares at Rp1,650 exercise price
body: Daya Intiguna announced a Management and Employee Stock Option Plan (MESOP) valued at Rp35.12 billion, issuing 21.28 million shares at an exercise price of Rp1,650 per share, roughly 75.5% above the recent market price of Rp940. The option exercise window runs from 18 February 2026 to 10 March 2026, and any unexercised options may be carried forward to the next period.

title: Energi Mega Persada issues IDR 1.15 trillion sustainable bond in two series
body: Energi Mega Persada (ENRG), part of the Bakrie Group, offered a IDR 1.15 trillion sustainable bond split into Series A (IDR 280.40 bn at 7.50% for three years) and Series B (IDR 869.80 bn at 8.60% for five years). Proceeds will mainly fund loans to Imbang Tata Alam and EMA for repayment of Bank Mandiri debt, with the remainder supporting working‑capital needs.

title: Elnusa shares reach all‑time high of around Rp770, up over 40% YTD on strong operational performance
body: Elnusa's stock surged to an all‑time high near Rp770 per share, reflecting a YTD gain of more than 40% as investors reward the company's solid operational results and diversified energy services. The firm highlighted successful project execution across upstream services, oil field services, EPC, logistics and international expansion, and outlined a 2026 strategy focused on technology, cost leadership and deeper integration with Pertamina Group.

title: PT Indospring Tbk targets Middle East and Central Asia to expand automotive component exports
body: PT Indospring Tbk plans to grow its export business by entering the Middle East and Central Asian markets, leveraging similarities with Indonesia's commercial truck segment. The company reported net sales of Rp2.46 trillion in Q3‑2025 and expects domestic vehicle sales to reach 850,000 units in 2026, supporting its sustainable growth strategy.

title: Bank Tabungan Negara posts 12.4% asset growth and 16.4% profit rise in 2025
body: Bank Tabungan Negara BBTN reported 2025 consolidated assets of Rp527.8 trillion (+12.4% YoY), net profit of Rp3.5 trillion (+16.4% YoY), a net interest margin of 4.2% (up 133 bps), a credit portfolio of Rp400.6 trillion (+11.9% YoY) and deposits of Rp437.4 trillion (+14.6% YoY), while reducing gross NPL to 3.1% and raising its CAR to 20.9%. The bank also expanded its Bale super‑app, grew users by 66.1%, and completed the spin‑off of Bank Syariah Nasional BSN, which ended 2025 with Rp73 trillion in assets, Rp55 trillion in financing and Rp59 trillion in deposits.

title: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk clarifies UMA status and trading suspension while confirming compliance and stable ownership
body: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk explained the Unusual Market Activity status and the February 2, 2026 trading suspension imposed by Bursa Efek Indonesia, detailing its public expose process held on February 5, 2026. The company said the recent stock rise reflects market dynamics linked to a disclosed Rp2.39 trillion mega‑contract, confirmed that share ownership remains at 15 % public and 85 % founders, and asserted full compliance with disclosure regulations.

title: AM Best reaffirmed PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk's top ratings and upgraded its outlook to stable
body: AM Best reaffirmed PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk’s A‑ (Excellent) Financial Strength Rating and a‑ (Excellent) Long‑Term Issuer Credit Rating for a tenth consecutive year, assigned the highest Indonesia National Scale Rating aaa.ID with a stable outlook, and upgraded its international outlook to stable, citing strong capital adequacy, consistent underwriting and investment results, and prudent risk management. The insurer, a subsidiary of PT Pertamina, highlighted its solid balance sheet, diversified moderate‑risk investment portfolio and ongoing retail expansion as part of its long‑term strategy.

title: PT Wira Global Solusi Tbk announces 1:1 bonus share issuance of up to 1.0425 billion shares
body: The company will distribute bonus shares equal to one new share for each existing share, using up to Rp20.85 billion of additional paid‑in capital to potentially issue 1,042,500,000 new shares, raising total issued shares to a maximum of 2,085,000,000. The record date is 7 April 2026, with Cum‑Bonus trading ending on 2 April (regular) and 7 April (cash), Ex‑Bonus starting on 6 April (regular) and 8 April (cash), and distribution scheduled for 24 April 2026.

title: PT Pakuwon Jati Tbk sees sharp rise in shareholders and modest stock gain in January 2026
body: The number of PT Pakuwon Jati Tbk shareholders jumped from 51,659 in December 2025 to 92,829 by the end of January 2026, an increase of 41,170 investors after a Telegram discussion highlighted the company’s projects. Despite the surge in retail participation and related volatility, the stock rose 0.56% to Rp356 (up 5.88% YTD), with the controlling shareholder holding 68.68% and the public float at about 30.92% of total shares.

title: PT Indosat Tbk reports solid 2025 performance with 12.2% profit growth and higher revenue
body: PT Indosat Tbk posted 2025 net profit attributable to the parent of Rp5.51 trillion (Rp170.84 per share), a 12.2% increase from 2024, while revenue rose 1.18% to Rp58.52 trillion, driven mainly by its cellular segment. The company’s assets grew to Rp118.63 trillion, operating cash flow reached Rp21.55 trillion and cash and cash equivalents ended the year at Rp5.07 trillion.

title: PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk achieves 88% of 2025 marketing‑sales target, led by industrial land and data‑center demand
body: PT Puradelta Lestari Tbk reported marketing sales of Rp1.6 trillion in 2025, about 88 % of its Rp1.81 trillion target, driven mainly by industrial land sales of 46 ha with data centers contributing roughly 60 % of that volume. Despite global economic uncertainty and reduced foreign investor interest, the company continued to operate a Security, Fire and Command Center, a self‑managed water‑treatment plant and an integrated waste‑disposal facility as it pursues further development of industrial, commercial and residential zones in Kota Deltamas.

title: PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk Schedules Extraordinary Meeting to Approve Full Sale of PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk
body: PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk announced an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on 4 March 2026 to seek approval for the divestiture of its entire stake in subsidiary PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk. Shareholders recorded on 9 February 2026 can vote electronically via e‑Proxy or submit physical proxies by 2 March, with a Q&A window open until the meeting’s close.

title: Pefindo affirms idBBB rating for PT Perkebunan Nusantara I and related MTN, citing stable outlook but limited by aggressive financial profile and commodity risks
body: Pefindo reaffirmed the idBBB rating for PT Perkebunan Nusantara I and its MTN/2018, and the idA(cg) rating for MTN VIII Series A and B guaranteed by PT Perkebunan Nusantara III Persero, noting a stable outlook supported by extensive land holdings (496,204 ha) and group backing but constrained by limited financial flexibility and exposure to global commodity price and weather volatility. The rating could be upgraded if PT Perkebunan Nusantara I substantially improves EBITDA and reduces debt, or downgraded if earnings fall short or debt exceeds projections, with any change to the guarantor PT Perkebunan Nusantara III Persero triggering similar adjustments to the MTN ratings.

title: FTSE Russell postpones its review of Indonesia’s market classification amid MSCI concerns over free‑float transparency
body: FTSE Russell said it will delay the planned March review of Indonesia’s classification as a secondary emerging market, citing similar concerns to MSCI about free‑float data and market transparency, and will not add new Indonesian stocks to its products until the issues are addressed. The pause follows MSCI’s warning that $120 billion has been withdrawn from the Jakarta Composite benchmark and Moody’s downgrade, while Indonesia pledges to double free‑float requirements and tighten disclosure, with IDX officials meeting FTSE Russell and SGMC Capital manager Mohit Mirpuri welcoming the extra time for reforms.

title: OJK Holds 2026 PVML Fit‑and‑Proper Assessor Summit to Boost Integrity and Competence in Financing, Venture Capital and Microfinance Sectors
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) convened the PVML Fit and Proper Test Assessor Summit 2026 in Jakarta, training 122 assessors and signing a Code of Ethics and Integrity to strengthen the evaluation of prospective main parties in the financing, venture capital and micro‑finance industry; OJK reported that PVML assets grew 7.48% YoY to IDR 1,115 trillion and financing disbursements rose 7.26% YoY to IDR 1,003 trillion in 2025, supporting 756 entities and the broader MSME sector. PT Xynexis International participated in a cyber‑security governance briefing during the event.

title: Matra Tri Abadi buy Shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk
body: Matra Tri Abadi purchased 129,673,000 shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX.JK) at IDR 500 per share on 2026-02-09, increasing its stake from 3,400,000,000 to 3,529,673,000 shares, a net addition of 129,673,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an addition of IRSX share ownership, raising the shareholder’s total holding to approximately 3.53 billion shares.

title: Robin Sunyoto buy Shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk
body: Robin Sunyoto purchased a total of 95,000 shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk at IDR 144 per share on 4‑5 February 2026, increasing his holding from 13,505,000 to 13,600,000 shares (an addition of 95,000). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises his ownership stake and signals continued confidence in the company.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold a total of 311,000 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk between 6‑10 Feb 2026 at prices around IDR 14,247 per share. His holding fell from 602,600 to 291,600 shares, a reduction of roughly 52 %. The divestment purpose is listed as “Divestment,” indicating a strategic exit of a significant stake.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi buys Shares of Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk
body: Elang Mahkota Teknologi purchased a total of 979,611,500 Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk shares on 6–9 February 2026 at IDR 308 per share for investment purposes. The holding increased from 13,553,866,945 to 14,533,478,445 shares, representing a net addition of 979,611,500 shares and a total outlay of roughly IDR 301.7 billion, indicating a significant stake expansion.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com Buy Shares of PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk
body: On 9 February 2026, shareholder 1 Inti Dot Com purchased 672,100 shares of PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk at IDR 140 per share for investment purposes. The holding rose from 312,828,200 to 313,500,300 shares, a net increase of 672,100 shares, marginally expanding its stake in the listed company.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 6 February 2026, shareholder Jemmy Kurniawan sold a total of 4,274,700 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk shares at a representative price of IDR 80 per share, reducing his holding from 932,999,000 to 928,724,300 shares (a decrease of 4,274,700 shares). The transaction is classified as a reduction of the number of shares held, reflecting a modest divestment by the insider.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan Buy Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 10 Feb 2026, shareholder Jemmy Kurniawan purchased 25,000,000 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 40 per share, raising his holding from 928,724,300 to 953,724,300 shares (an increase of 25,000,000). The transaction is classified as a buy with the purpose of increasing the number of shares owned, signalling a stronger equity position in the company.

title: Peter Djatmiko buys Shares of PT Communication Cable Systems Indonesia Tbk.
body: On 9 Feb 2026, shareholder Peter Djatmiko purchased 1,181,300 shares of PT Communication Cable Systems Indonesia Tbk. (CCSI.JK) at IDR 595 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 110,443,700 to 111,625,000 shares, increasing his stake by about 1.07%. The transaction reflects a modest but notable addition to his ownership position.

title: Fancy Marsiana sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 10 Feb 2026, shareholder Fancy Marsiana sold 25,000,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK) at IDR 40 per share. The sale reduces her stake from 62,500,000 to 37,500,000 shares, a decline of 25,000,000 shares (40%). The transaction is recorded as a divestment, indicating a strategic reduction of her ownership in the company.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey buys Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: On 9 Feb 2026, investor Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 150,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk at IDR 3,060 per share for investment purposes. His holding increased from 3,281,700 to 3,431,700 shares, a net gain of 150,000 shares, reflecting a modest stake expansion in the copper‑gold miner.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold a total of 167,100 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) on 10 February 2026 at prices up to IDR 620 per share. His holding fell from 15,322,259 shares to 15,155,159 shares, a reduction of 167,100 shares. The sale, reported on 11 February 2026, reflects a direct divestment by the shareholder without disclosed strategic purpose beyond the transaction itself.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On 10 February 2026, shareholder Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold 29,800 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk at a price of IDR 14,247 per share. The transaction reduced his holding from 589,600 to 559,800 shares, a decrease of 29,800 shares. The sale is classified as a divestment, indicating a strategic reduction of his stake in the company. This change modestly lowers his ownership percentage and may signal a reallocation of capital, which is noteworthy for investors monitoring shareholding patterns in BYAN.JK.

title: PT Mandiri Terang Harapan cuts stake in PT Panca Global Kapital Tbk after selling 128 million shares
body: PT Mandiri Terang Harapan divested 128.18 million shares of PT Panca Global Kapital Tbk, selling 113.19 million shares at Rp190 each on 29 January and 14.99 million shares at Rp110 each on 9 February, reducing its ownership from 18 % (510,015,100 shares) to 13.48 % (381,833,500 shares) for total proceeds of about Rp23.15 billion. On 11 February, PT Panca Global Kapital Tbk shares edged up 0.92 % to Rp220.

title: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk reports rise in shareholders and outlines Rp700 billion asset acquisition plan
body: By end‑January 2026 PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk had 4,921 shareholders, with 51.05% of its 666.74 million shares classified as free float and the controlling 48.95% held by PIMSF Pulogadung. The company announced a conditional sale and purchase agreement to acquire assets worth Rp700 billion from PT Morita Tjokro Gearindo, PT Jaya Indah Casting, PT Pulogadung Tempajaya, PT Tjokro Bersaudara Komponenindo and PT Jakarta Marten Logamindo, which is expected to raise total assets to about Rp900 billion and equity to Rp750 billion, with financing to be explored via share‑swap or debt while complying with OJK and IDX regulations.

title: PT Pertamina Hulu Indonesia’s Zona 9 exceeds 2025 oil and gas production targets
body: PT Pertamina Hulu Indonesia, through its subsidiaries PT Pertamina Hulu Sanga Sanga and PT Pertamina EP, reported Zona 9 production of 22.6 k barrels of oil per day and 105,369 million standard cubic feet of gas per day, surpassing the 2025 targets. Senior Manager Supriady attributed the results to innovative technology and strong cross‑functional collaboration.

title: PT Kereta Api Indonesia conducts inspection to ensure readiness for 2026 Lebaran train services in Daop 6
body: PT Kereta Api Indonesia carried out an inspection using inspection trains in Daop 6 (Yogyakarta, DIY) led by directors Awan Hermawan Purwadinata and Rafli Yandra to verify operational readiness for the 22‑day Lebaran 2026 period from 11 March to 1 April. The company emphasized safety, especially against forecasted heavy rain, urging staff to maintain vigilance, coordination and quality work.

title: PT Exploitasi Energi Indonesia Tbk announces a Rp32.7 billion capital increase in subsidiary PT Sekti Rahayu Indah
body: On 10 February 2026, PT Energi Batubara Indonesia completed a capital increase of Rp32.7 billion for its subsidiary PT Sekti Rahayu Indah, raising the subsidiary’s authorized and paid‑up capital to Rp35.7 billion and its ownership to 99.16%. The transaction is not considered material under POJK No. 17/POJK.04/2020 and has no material impact on PT Exploitasi Energi Indonesia Tbk’s operations or financial condition.

title: PT PELNI launches 30% discounted Lebaran 2026 tickets for economy class
body: PT PELNI (PT Pelayaran Nasional Indonesia) announced a 30% discount on economy‑class ferry tickets for the Lebaran 2026 travel period, covering departures from 11 March to 5 April 2026 and excluding insurance and port fees. The program, expected to serve about 445,000 passengers, is part of the government’s stimulus to boost consumer spending during the holiday.

title: PT Bio Farma participates in OIC Vaccine Manufacturers Group meeting to promote vaccine self‑reliance in Islamic countries
body: At the 4th OIC Vaccine Manufacturers Group meeting in Islamabad, PT Bio Farma and other stakeholders discussed strengthening vaccine production capacity across OIC member states, noting that only about 10 of the 57 countries have manufacturing facilities and only Senegal and Indonesia have WHO‑recognized vaccines. Bio Farma pledged to act as a strategic partner by providing technology transfer, quality‑standard harmonisation and human‑resource development to build a sustainable, internationally‑compliant vaccine ecosystem in the region.

title: PT Samindo Resources Tbk injects Rp270 billion into its subsidiary PT Sentra Terra Indonesia
body: PT Samindo Resources Tbk deposited Rp270 billion as capital into PT Sentra Terra Indonesia on 11 February 2026, a transaction representing less than 20% of the parent’s equity and therefore not material under OJK regulations. The funding strengthens PT Sentra Terra Indonesia’s capital structure, supporting its operations and future growth, which is expected to positively impact PT Samindo Resources Tbk’s consolidated financial performance.

title: Director Budi Tjahjadi sells all PT Wijaya Cahaya Timber Tbk shares, ending 0.63% stake
