body: On 11 February 2026, Budi Tjahjadi, chief director of PT Wijaya Cahaya Timber Tbk, sold his entire holding of 12,450,000 shares at Rp170 per share, reducing his ownership to zero from a previous 0.63% stake. The transaction was described as an investment move for direct stock ownership.

title: Esta Dana Ventura Buys Shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk
body: Esta Dana Ventura purchased 130,000,000 shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk on 22 Dec 2025 at IDR 346 per share, increasing its holding from 58,762,050 to 188,762,050 shares. The investment raises the shareholder’s stake to roughly 19% of the company’s issued capital, reflecting confidence in the firm’s growth prospects and potentially affecting future governance.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased a total of 210,600 PT Logisticsplus International Tbk shares on 10 Feb 2026 at a representative price of IDR 142 per share, citing an investment strategy. His holding rose from 2,438,460 to 2,649,060 shares, a net increase of 210,600 shares (≈8.6%). The buy augments his stake in the listed logistics firm, indicating confidence in its outlook.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 98,146,500 PT Hillcon Tbk shares on 10 Feb 2026 at IDR 140 per share, reducing its holding from 6,205,118,700 to 6,106,972,200 shares (‑98,146,500). The transaction, classified as an investment‑related sale, represents a modest (~1.6%) decline in the shareholder’s stake in the listed construction firm.

title: Bio Permai sell Shares of PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk
body: Bio Permai sold 65,661,100 shares of PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk (PSSI.JK) at IDR 352 per share on 10 Feb 2026, reducing its stake from 398,267,200 to 332,606,100 shares. The divestment, cited as part of its investment strategy, represents a notable decrease in ownership for the shareholder.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko Buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 11 February 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased a total of 68,300 PT Logisticsplus International Tbk shares at a representative price of IDR 146 per share, raising his holding from 2,649,060 to 2,717,360 shares (an increase of 68,300). The transaction, classified as a buy for investment strategy, expands his equity stake in the listed logistics firm, indicating continued confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara Buy Shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk
body: On 11 February 2026, Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara purchased 158,115,000 INET shares at IDR 364 per share, raising its stake in PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET.JK). Holdings rose from 12,816,338,266 to 12,974,453,266 shares, a net increase of 158,115,000 shares. The transaction is classified as a buy and is aimed at increasing ownership of INET shares, signaling confidence in the company's prospects and modestly expanding the shareholder’s percentage interest.

title: Indonesia's Q4 2025 growth hits 5.39%, the highest among G20, while Moody's shifts outlook to negative for major banks
body: Indonesia’s economy expanded 5.39% year‑on‑year in Q4 2025, the fastest growth among G20 members, supported by a manufacturing PMI of 52.6, rising consumer confidence (CCI 127) and a 7.9% jump in real domestic sales. However, Moody’s kept the sovereign rating at Baa2 and moved its outlook to negative, also applying a negative outlook to five major banks – Bank Mandiri, Bank Rakyat Indonesia, Bank Negara Indonesia, Bank Central Asia and Bank Tabungan Negara.

title: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto to visit US for tariff agreement and Board of Peace summit
body: President Prabowo Subianto arrived in Jakarta on a Garuda Indonesia-1 aircraft before departing for a mid‑February state visit to the United States to sign a reciprocal tariff agreement that would reduce the current 19 % US import tariff on Indonesia and broaden market access for American products. The trip also includes attending the inaugural Board of Peace summit on Feb 19, with the deal granting US tariff exemptions for Indonesian palm oil, cocoa, coffee and tea.

title: Indonesia's SKK Migas launches “Triple 100” plan to drill 100 exploration and 100 fracturing wells in 2026
body: Indonesia's upstream oil and gas regulator SKK Migas announced its “Triple 100” program to drill 100 exploration wells and 100 multi‑stage fracturing wells in 2026, and signed a memorandum of understanding with Schlumberger Geophysics Nusantara to provide fracturing units and technology support. The agency has already added 13 exploration and six fracturing wells and must secure 48 additional exploration wells and 77 fracturing wells by December to meet the target.

title: Indonesia’s Industry Ministry pushes food‑and‑beverage downstreaming to raise agro‑based value added, highlighted by a visit to PT Haldin Pacific Semesta
body: Deputy Minister of Industry Faizol Riza, accompanied by Acting Director General Putu Juli Ardika, visited PT Haldin Pacific Semesta in Bekasi to inspect natural extract production as part of the ministry’s push for integrated downstreaming in the food and beverage sector. The ministry reports the IPNM sector is projected to grow 5.30% in 2025 (ahead of the 5.01% national rate), with the food‑beverage sub‑sector accounting for 80.27% of exports Jan‑Nov 2025, growing 6.23% in Q1‑Q3, and realized investment reaching Rp80.49 trillion (≈US$4.7 bn) and employing 6.67 million people.

title: Indonesia's Energy Minister says Martabe gold mine permit revocation not yet finalized pending review
body: Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said the administrative revocation of the Martabe gold mine permit in North Sumatra has not been finalized as the ministry conducts an in‑depth review following President Prabowo’s guidance. The president has already ordered the revocation of permits for 28 firms, including Agincourt Resources, for forest‑utilisation violations, while the government says any environmental breaches at Martabe will trigger proportionate sanctions.

title: J Resources Asia completes USD540 million divestment of Arafura Surya Alam to Danusa Tambang Nusantara
body: J Resources Asia has completed the sale of its Arafura Surya Alam stake and the Doup gold project to Danusa Tambang Nusantara, a United Tractors subsidiary, for USD540 million (approximately Rp8.8 trillion) on 11 February 2026. The transaction, executed through J Resources Nusantara, closed about 1.5 months after the original 23 December 2025 deadline.

title: PT Danantara Investment Management signs MoU with Rua Al Madinah Holding to improve Indonesian Hajj and Umrah services
body: During the PIF Private Sector Forum 2025 in Riyadh, PT Danantara Investment Management and Rua Al Madinah Holding signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a dedicated Hajj complex and enhance pilgrimage infrastructure and services for Indonesia's large pilgrim population. The partnership aims to create an integrated, transparent ecosystem for health, protection, and operational support across generations.

title: PT Capitol Nusantara Indonesia Tbk announces resignation of its Chief Commissioner Richie Limson
body: PT Capitol Nusantara Indonesia Tbk received Richie Limson’s resignation as Chief Commissioner on 11 February 2026, and the decision will be presented for approval at the forthcoming shareholders’ meeting. The company confirmed that its business activities and operations will continue uninterrupted pending formal approval.

title: PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk announces winners of the “Pesta Raya” digital transaction incentive program
body: PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk announced the winners of its “Pesta Raya” program, awarding a BYD Seal electric car, two Alva Cervo electric motorcycles, three Samsung S25 Ultra phones and cash prizes after 2.1 million digital transactions recorded between August 2025 and January 2026. The campaign attracted over 113 000 new customers and generated billions of points, with QRIS payments accounting for the majority of activity.

title: President Prabowo meets five national conglomerates, triggering mixed reactions in their listed stocks
body: President Prabowo Subianto held an audience with five major Indonesian conglomerates—Barito Pacific, Salim, Sinar Mas, Adaro and Agung Sedayu—on 10 February 2026, prompting market participants to watch the reaction of their listed affiliates. On 11 February, shares linked to Barito Pacific surged (PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk +7.11%, PT Barito Pacific Tbk +12.32%, PT Petrosea Tbk +19.25%, PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk +17.38%) while PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk fell 2.9%, PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk rose 0.62%, PT Adaro Energy Indonesia Tbk +2.3%, PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk +6.57%, PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk +3.02%, PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk +2.67%, PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk +0.46% and PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk +1.61%.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk and PT Bina Karya sign strategic ICT infrastructure partnership for Indonesia’s new capital
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk, known as SURGE, announced a strategic collaboration with PT Bina Karya to plan, build and operate ICT infrastructure, including fiber‑optic and broadband networks, in the upcoming Ibu Kota Nusantara. The partnership aims to strengthen digital connectivity for government services, businesses and residents, supporting Indonesia’s long‑term digital transformation agenda.

title: Bukalapak reports 79.9% IPO fund utilization and extends deadline for remaining capital to end-2026
body: Bukalapak has drawn Rp17.04 trillion of its Rp21.32 trillion IPO proceeds, representing 79.91% of the total, leaving Rp4.28 trillion unspent as of 31 December 2025. The company said it will postpone the use of the remaining funds until suitable growth opportunities arise, resetting the completion target to 31 December 2026 in line with OJK Regulation No. 40/2025.

title: Fuji Finance posts 24% profit decline for 2025 despite modest revenue growth
body: Fuji Finance reported net profit of Rp8.35 billion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 24.29% drop from the prior year and reducing earnings per share to Rp6.42. Revenue rose 4.5% to Rp15.3 billion, while total assets, equity and liabilities increased to Rp188.89 billion, Rp180.99 billion and Rp7.9 billion respectively.

title: Unilever Indonesia posts 127% jump in 2025 net profit to Rp7.64 trillion
body: Unilever Indonesia reported a 2025 net profit of Rp7.64 trillion, up 127.38% from the prior year, with net sales of Rp31.94 trillion and earnings per share of Rp93. The company’s balance sheet grew to Rp20.02 trillion in assets, Rp4.47 trillion in equity and Rp15.54 trillion in liabilities, while operating profit increased to Rp4.59 trillion.

title: Provident Investasi PALM to Issue Rp939.03 Billion Sustainable Bond in Three Series
body: Provident Investasi PALM announced it will issue a total of Rp939.03 billion of sustainable bonds in three series (Series A Rp50 billion at 5.70% for 367 days, Series B Rp325.11 billion at 7% for three years, and Series C Rp563.91 billion at 7.85% for five years) with quarterly interest payments starting 3 June 2026. Proceeds of about Rp482 billion will be used to retire the remaining principal of its Sustainable Bond I Phase I and to accelerate repayment of a USD 75 million revolving facility to United Overseas Bank Limited Bank UOB, leaving a residual loan of roughly USD 1.9 million (≈Rp31.3 billion).

title: Pelayaran Ekalya posts 2025 net profit of Rp213.3 billion, 15.5% lower than 2024
body: Pelayaran Ekalya reported a 2025 net profit of Rp213.3 billion, a 15.48% decline from the prior year, with earnings per share falling to Rp28.78. Revenue dropped 15.83% to Rp1.01 trillion, while total assets rose to Rp3.36 trillion and equity increased to Rp2.7 trillion.

title: Bank BTPN Syariah posts 13% profit growth in 2025 driven by inclusive financing and community support
body: Bank BTPN Syariah reported a net profit of Rp1.2 trillion in 2025, up 13% year‑on‑year, with financing disbursements of Rp10.35 trillion, a RoA of 7.2% and a CAR of 57.7%. The bank attributes the results to its inclusive financing model, community officer‑led ultra‑micro assistance, and disaster relief programs in Sumatra.

title: Samuel Sekuritas purchases 800 million MD Entertainment shares in two transactions, raising its stake to 5.64%
body: Samuel Sekuritas bought a total of 800.24 million MD Entertainment shares for about Rp5.06 trillion, acquiring 751.88 million shares at Rp6,400 each on Feb 6 and 48.36 million at Rp5,200 each on Feb 9, boosting its holding to 614.44 million shares (5.64% of the company). Following the repurchase‑agreement trades, MD Entertainment’s stock rose 100 points to Rp7,000 (+1.45%) but remains down 5,325 points (‑43.20%) year‑to‑date after a strong six‑month gain of 3,230 points (85.68%).

title: Bank Permata (BNLI) posts modest 0.56% net profit growth to Rp3.58 trillion in 2025
body: Bank Permata (BNLI) reported a net profit of Rp3.58 trillion for 2025, a 0.56% increase from the prior year, with basic earnings per share remaining around Rp99. Total assets rose to Rp268.34 trillion and equity to Rp45.84 trillion, while interest income fell slightly and operating expenses increased.

title: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk shares rebound 16.6% after OJK sanction eases, driven by foreign net buying
body: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk closed up 16.63% at 63 after its shares recovered from a correction triggered by an OJK administrative sanction, following a constructive response from management. Foreign investors posted a net purchase of about Rp 1.23 billion, which was the main catalyst for the rally.

title: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk confirms readiness of funds to repay Rp23.92 billion bond principal due March 2026
body: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk said it has secured the Rp23.92 billion needed to settle the principal of its Phase II Series A Bond due 6 March 2026, with payment to be transferred to PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia on schedule. The company previously issued a sustainable bond offering up to Rp210 billion and a sukuk up to Rp290 billion, both receiving idA‑ ratings (idA‑ for bonds, idA‑(Sy) for sukuk) from Pefindo.

title: PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk grants up to Rp800 billion loan to PT Sinar Mas Multifinance and reports strong nine‑month earnings
body: PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk disclosed a loan agreement with its subsidiary PT Sinar Mas Multifinance for up to Rp800 billion at an effective 8.25% annual rate, a five‑year facility that does not exceed 20% of its equity and is therefore not material. For the nine months ended 30 September 2025, the company reported revenue of Rp20.39 trillion, operating expenses of Rp17.53 trillion, resulting in a pre‑tax profit of Rp2.85 trillion and net profit attributable to the parent of Rp2.74 trillion, with earnings per share rising to Rp430 from Rp91 a year earlier.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 1,853,500 PT Hillcon Tbk shares at IDR 140 per share on 11 Feb 2026. The transaction reduced its stake from 6,106,972,200 shares to 6,105,118,700 shares, a decline of 1,853,500 shares. The sale is classified as an investment‑related divestment and does not signal a strategic shift for the company. The modest reduction is unlikely to affect PT Hillcon Tbk’s market dynamics.

title: Anggara Suryawan buy Shares of PT Futura Energi Global Tbk
body: On 11 February 2026, shareholder Anggara Suryawan purchased 266,800 shares of PT Futura Energi Global Tbk at IDR 374 per share, increasing his holding from 604,900 to 871,700 shares (a rise of 266,800). The transaction is classified as an investment and raises his ownership stake in the listed company, potentially signalling confidence in the firm's prospects.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi buy Shares of Surya Citra Media Tbk
body: Elang Mahkota Teknologi purchased additional shares of Surya Citra Media Tbk for investment, acquiring 2,682,371,500 shares at a representative price of IDR 258 per share. The holding increased from 52,068,319,840 shares to 54,750,691,340 shares, raising its stake by roughly 5.2%. The total transaction value was IDR 2,682,371,500. This acquisition strengthens the shareholder's position in the media company.

title: Kreatif Media Karya buy Shares of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk
body: Kreatif Media Karya purchased an additional 6,703,857,638 shares of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk at IDR 139 per share for investment purposes. The holding rose from 35,122,243,214 to 41,826,100,852 shares, a net increase of 6,703,857,638 shares, representing a total outlay of approximately IDR 931,836,211,682. The transaction strengthens Kreatif Media Karya’s equity position in the e‑commerce firm.

title: Asia Intrainvesta sell Shares of PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera Tbk
body: Asia Intrainvesta sold a total of 125,000,000 shares of PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera Tbk at a representative price of IDR 23 per share on 11 Feb 2026, reducing its stake from 1,706,000,000 to 1,581,000,000 shares (a decrease of 125,000,000 shares). The divestment purpose signals a strategic portfolio reallocation and may modestly affect the company’s free float and liquidity.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buys Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 14,411,400 shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk on 11 Feb 2026 under a Repurchase Agreement at a representative price of IDR 5,100 per share. The holding rose from 722,125,700 to 736,537,100 shares, increasing the shareholder's stake by roughly 2.0%. The transaction reflects a strategic buy‑back that strengthens the shareholder’s position and may signal confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold 525,905,900 Sentul City Tbk shares on 6 Feb 2026 at IDR 130 per share under a Repurchase Agreement. The holder’s stake decreased from 8,802,049,900 shares to 8,276,144,000 shares, a reduction of 525,905,900 shares. The transaction reflects a strategic divestment by the shareholder and may affect the company’s free‑float and liquidity.

title: Kendilo Pte. Ltd Buy Shares of PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk
body: Kendilo Pte. Ltd purchased 65,661,100 shares of PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk (ticker PSSI.JK) on 10 Feb 2026 at IDR 352 per share, raising its holding from 1,457,529,846 to 1,523,190,946 shares, a net increase of 4.5%. The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding Kendilo’s ownership stake in the logistics firm and potentially signaling confidence in the company’s growth prospects.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buys Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 523,633,200 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 130 per share under a Repurchase Agreement on 11 Feb 2026. The holding rose from 7,893,831,100 to 8,417,464,300 shares, a net increase of 523,633,200 shares, strengthening the shareholder’s stake in the listed property developer.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buy Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 279,110,900 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 130 per share on 5 Feb 2026 under a Repurchase Agreement, raising its holding from 8,522,939,000 to 8,802,049,900 shares (an increase of 279,110,900 shares). The transaction expands the shareholder's stake in the listed property developer, indicating confidence in the company's outlook and potentially supporting share price stability.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Buy Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 837,409,500 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 103 per share under a Repurchase Agreement on 4 Feb 2026. The transaction raised its holding from 7,658,529,500 to 8,522,939,000 shares, a net increase of 864,409,500 shares. This acquisition expands the shareholder’s stake and signals confidence in the company’s outlook.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buys Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 107,274,900 shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk under a Repurchase Agreement (REPO) at a representative price of IDR 6,400 per share. The holding rose from 458,809,600 to 566,084,500 shares, reflecting the full transaction amount. This buy increases the shareholder's stake and demonstrates active repo activity in the company's equity.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold 382,312,900 Sentul City Tbk shares on 10 Feb 2026 under a Repurchase Agreement at IDR 130 per share. The holding fell from 8,276,144,000 to 7,893,831,100 shares, a reduction of 382,312,900 shares. The sale reduces the shareholder’s stake and may support the company’s liquidity or financing needs, signalling a short‑term strategic move.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buy Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 107,683,800 shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk under a Repurchase Agreement (REPO) at a representative price of IDR 4,500 per share, amounting to IDR 107,683,800. The shareholder's holding increased from 614,441,900 to 722,125,700 shares, a rise of 107,683,800 shares, indicating a significant boost in its stake in the company.

title: Wilton Resources Holding Pte Ltd sell Shares of Wilton Makmur Indonesia Tbk
body: Wilton Resources Holding Pte Ltd sold a total of 87,500,000 shares of Wilton Makmur Indonesia Tbk under a Sale and Purchase Agreement at IDR 40 per share. The holder's stake fell from 8,342,712,719 shares to 8,255,212,719 shares, a reduction of 87,500,000 shares. The transaction, executed on 10‑11 February 2026, represents a material divestment by the shareholder and may affect the company's shareholding structure and market liquidity.

title: PT Argo Pantes Tbk secures Rp220.7 billion 10‑year land‑lease deal with PT Global Yimi Cargo
body: PT Argo Pantes Tbk signed a 10‑year land‑lease agreement with PT Global Yimi Cargo valued at approximately Rp220.7 billion, intended to increase recurring property income and land occupancy. The company stated the contract has no affiliate ties and will not adversely affect its legal, financial or operational standing.

title: PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk faces potential control shift as Nagita Slavina negotiates to acquire up to 51% stake
body: PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk disclosed that negotiations are underway with Nagita Slavina, who aims to acquire up to 51% of the company, though the process has not yet impacted operations or financial condition. Despite the news, the stock fell 9.89% intraday to Rp820 after previously rallying, having risen 321.3% over the past month to around Rp910.

title: Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara Sell Shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk
body: Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara sold 300,000 shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk at an average price of IDR 1,030.0 per share, reducing his holding from 71,849,300 to 71,549,300 shares (Δ -300,000). The sale was part of a divestment strategy and reflects a modest reduction in the shareholder’s stake in the company.

title: Agus Susanto sell Shares of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk
body: On 11 Feb 2026, shareholder Agus Susanto sold 8,465,800 shares of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk (GRPM.JK) at IDR 450 per share, reducing his holding from 152,614,100 to 144,148,300 shares (a decrease of 5.5%). The transaction is classified as a divestment, indicating a strategic reduction of his stake in the company.

title: Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia shares surge 4.7% in early 2026 on strong earnings, cheap valuation and robust capital
body: Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia (TUGU) stock rose to IDR 1,340 on 11 February 2026, a 4.7% gain that lifted its YTD return to about 15% while the IHSG and financial sector indexes fell. Analysts from Trimegah Sekuritas point to solid profit (IDR 595 bn in nine months, targeting IDR 700 bn FY2025), an ultra‑low PBV of 0.4×, strong equity (IDR 6.2 trn parent, IDR 11 trn consolidated) and a 404% RBC ratio, supporting a dividend yield of roughly 6.3% and readiness for new POJK capital requirements.

title: Esta Dana Ventura buys 130 million shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk, raising its stake above 5%
body: Esta Dana Ventura purchased 130,000,000 shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk at Rp346 per share on 22 December 2025, increasing its holding from 2.42% (58,762,050 shares) to 7.78% (188,762,050 shares, valued at about Rp44.98 billion). Following the transaction, PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk’s stock rose 6% intraday to Rp212, though the purchase did not affect control.

title: President Prabowo directs development of fisher villages within PT Agrinas Jaladri Nusantara ecosystem and shipyard consolidation under PT PAL Indonesia
body: President Prabowo held a limited meeting to approve the integration of new fisher villages into a maritime business ecosystem to be managed by PT Agrinas Jaladri Nusantara, emphasizing production absorption and shipyard development. BP BUMN head Dony Oskaria said the shipyard consolidation will be carried out under PT PAL Indonesia and is expected to be completed soon.

title: PT Tunas Binatama Lestari signs non‑binding termsheet to acquire 80% of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk
body: PT Tunas Binatama Lestari has signed a non‑binding agreement to purchase 1,236,000,000 shares, representing about 80% of PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk, with 70.67% of the shares coming from PT Prima Multi Usaha Indonesia Tbk and 9.33% from Agus Susanto. The transaction remains subject to due diligence, internal approvals, definitive agreements and regulatory clearances from Bursa Efek Indonesia and Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, and the company states it has no material impact on its operations or financial condition.

title: Palm oil industry urges supply assurance before Indonesia moves to B50 biodiesel program
body: At a journalist workshop organized by Majalah Sawit Indonesia with support from the Plantation Fund Management Board (BPDP), GAPKI highlighted that while the sector backs the biodiesel push, a shortage of palm oil could impede the shift from B40 to B50, prompting the government to delay implementation. GAPKI said it will boost upstream productivity through Tanzanian pollinating insects, new palm varieties, and accelerated replanting to secure raw‑material availability.

title: President Prabowo directs HR and infrastructure push for Indonesia's fisheries sector
body: President Prabowo Subianto ordered Minister Brian Yuliarto to develop human resources for the expanding fisheries industry and accelerate the Red and White Fishing Villages, integrating them with state‑run PT Agrinas Jaladri Nusantara. The plan also includes consolidating shipyards under PT PAL Indonesia to create new jobs, especially for naval architecture graduates.

title: Indonesia exports 11.5 metric tons of organic palm sugar from Pacitan to global markets
body: Indonesia shipped 11.5 metric tons of organic palm sugar from Pacitan, East Java to Malaysia, the Netherlands and Australia, valued at Rp535 million (US$34,300). The export, part of Astra’s Desa Sejahtera program which has supported 1,280 villages and generated Rp411 billion in exports over five years, highlights efforts to raise rural incomes and build a sustainable export ecosystem.

title: Indonesia targets 2027 salt self‑sufficiency by developing a private‑backed hub in Rote Ndao
body: The Marine Affairs and Fisheries Ministry will create a national salt industry hub on Rote Ndao, with state funding covering only two of ten production zones and private investors expected to develop the remaining eight. The project aims to meet roughly five million tonnes of annual industrial salt demand and achieve self‑sufficiency by 2027.

title: Indonesia to ban over‑dimension and overloaded trucks from January 2027, allocating Rp43 trillion for road preservation
body: Coordinating Minister for Infrastructure and Regional Development Agus Harimurti Yudhoyono announced the Zero ODOL policy will take effect in January 2027, aiming to curb infrastructure damage and emissions caused by overloaded vehicles. The Ministry of Public Works has earmarked Rp43 trillion (about US$2.55 billion) for road repair and maintenance linked to the crackdown.

title: Indonesia plans to curb coal output to support international prices, says Energy Minister
body: Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia announced that Indonesia will continue reducing coal production to help lift falling export prices, noting the HBA fell to US$106.11 per ton in February 2026 from US$124.24 a year earlier. He also rejected the mining association’s request to raise 2026 coal and nickel quotas, arguing production should match market prices and be preserved for future generations.

title: Indonesia's finance minister says no new talks on Whoosh high‑speed rail debt, state budget may be used for partial repayment
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa confirmed he has not been summoned for fresh negotiations on the $7 billion debt owed by PT Kereta Cepat Indonesia-China to China Development Bank, while the government is considering allocating part of the State Budget for a partial repayment. CEO Rosan Roeslani of the sovereign wealth fund Danantara has been tasked to lead negotiations, and officials are reviewing options such as extending the loan period.

title: PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk announces potential 80% share acquisition by Rimau Group affiliate
body: PT Graha Prima Mentari Tbk disclosed a non‑binding term sheet for the acquisition of about 80% of its shares (1,236 billion shares) by PT Tunas Binatama Lestari, an affiliate of Rimau Group, with PT Prima Multi Usaha Indonesia Tbk as the selling shareholder. The transaction remains subject to due diligence, internal approvals and regulator clearance, while the stock has risen 670.49% to Rp466 in the latest quarter.

title: XLSmart Telecom EXCL reports a Rp4.41 trillion net loss for 2025 despite 23.4% revenue growth
body: XLSmart Telecom EXCL posted a net loss of Rp4.41 trillion for 2025, a sharp swing from a Rp1.84 trillion profit the previous year, while revenue rose 23.4% to Rp42.44 trillion. The company’s total assets grew to Rp115.31 trillion, equity to Rp30 trillion, and liabilities increased to Rp85.3 trillion.

title: PT Charlie Hospital Semarang Tbk targets expansion in Batang industrial zone with new hospitals and acquisitions
body: PT Charlie Hospital Semarang Tbk plans to expand its network by building a new hospital in the Batang Integrated Industrial Zone and aims to add two to three hospitals this year, while also pursuing acquisitions funded through strategic investors. The move aligns with a Rp364 trillion investment in the Batang area and a partnership with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, and Semesta Indovest Sekuritas analyst Michael Lee sees structural demand boosting long‑term revenue despite near‑term profit pressure.

title: Jakarta International Hotels and Bank Artha Graha shares rally sharply amid ownership influence
body: Jakarta International Hotels surged 25% to IDR 675 per share and Bank Artha Graha rose 9.29% to IDR 200, with the moves linked to the controlling stakes of Tomy Winata and Sugianto Kusuma (Aguan). Free‑float data as of 31 January 2026 show Bank Artha Graha at 39.42% (7.97 billion shares) and Jakarta International Hotels at 23.63% (550.44 million shares).

title: Kreatif Media Karya increases its Bukalapak stake to 40.55% after a Rp931.8 billion share purchase
body: Kreatif Media Karya purchased a total of 6.7 billion Bukalapak shares at Rp139 per share on 9‑10 February 2026, spending about Rp931.83 billion. The acquisition raised its holding to 41.82 billion shares, representing 40.55 % of Bukalapak, while the company's share price slipped to Rp148, down 1.33 %.

title: Jababeka’s subsidiary PT LNG launches Indonesia’s first private mini‑LNG plant in East Java
body: Jababeka (KIJA) through its subsidiary Likuid Nusantara Gas and the joint‑venture PT LNG inaugurated a USD16.9 million mini‑LNG plant in Pasuruan, East Java, with an initial capacity of 2.5 MMSCFD and a planned expansion to 4 MMSCFD by late 2027. The facility, 60% owned by Jababeka Infrastruktur and partnered with Fortius Development Asia, now supplies low‑emission gas to industrial customers such as PGN Gagas, supporting Indonesia’s clean‑energy transition.

title: Soraya Berjaya Indonesia partners with RedDoorz to support operations and expand market reach
body: Soraya Berjaya Indonesia announced a collaboration with RedDoorz to provide sustainable product and service support for RedDoorz's operational needs and network development, aiming to boost sales volume, broaden marketing coverage, and strengthen business stability. The partnership is positioned as a strategic move to enhance Soraya Berjaya Indonesia's market presence and create long‑term value for stakeholders.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi alias Emtek EMTK increases stake in Surya Citra Media SCMA to 74% after multi‑day share purchase
body: Elang Mahkota Teknologi alias Emtek EMTK bought a total of 2.68 billion Surya Citra Media SCMA shares on 10‑11 February 2026 at Rp258‑284 per share, spending about Rp752.66 billion and raising its holding to 54.75 billion shares (74.02%). The transaction had little impact on SCMA’s stock, which traded flat around Rp308 per share.

title: Indonesia's OJK hands over another suspect in PT Sriwahana Adityakarta Tbk share‑price manipulation case
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) transferred a fourth suspect, identified as SAS, to the Boyolali District Prosecutor on 28 January 2026, continuing its staged prosecution of a market‑manipulation scheme involving PT Sriwahana Adityakarta Tbk shares in June‑July 2018. The scheme, orchestrated through nominee accounts across nine brokerage firms, generated 60,121 matched trades (≈10 % of transactions), 639.8 million shares (≈14.7 %) and a transaction value of about Rp230.9 billion (≈13.3 %).

title: PT Bank Victoria International Tbk confirms funding to redeem Sustainable Bond III Phase I 2023 Series A due March 2026
body: PT Bank Victoria International Tbk said its Sustainable Bond III Phase I 2023 Series A will mature on 9 March 2026 and that it has set aside Rp300 billion for principal repayment and Rp6,937 billion for coupon payments, currently invested in government securities. The bank previously issued Sustainable Bond IV Phase II 2025 with a principal of Rp750 billion at an 8.25% annual rate, a three‑year term, first coupon on 26 December 2025, underwritten by PT Victoria Sekuritas, PT Sinarmas Sekuritas and PT Evergreen Sekuritas Indonesia, with PT Bank Mega Tbk as trustee and rated idA‑ by PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia.

title: PT Intiland Development Tbk forms joint venture with ION Network to develop a data center
body: PT Intiland Development Tbk announced a strategic partnership with ION Network through the creation of the joint venture PT Inti Arunika Persada, using its wholly‑owned subsidiary PT Intiland Alfa Rendita. The venture, aimed at expanding and optimizing property assets into data‑center services, is considered non‑material and will not affect the company's long‑term operations.

title: Harita Jayaraya sell Shares of Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk
body: Harita Jayaraya disposed 24,357,600 Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk shares between 9‑12 Feb 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 615 to IDR 699 per share, with a representative price of IDR 665 per share. The sale reduced his holding from 744,029,910 to 719,672,310 shares, a decline of 24,357,600 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment‑related sell, indicating a strategic reduction of his stake in the company.

title: Director Budi Tjahjadi sells all shares in PT Wijaya Cahaya Timber Tbk
body: Budi Tjahjadi sold 12.45 million shares of PT Wijaya Cahaya Timber Tbk at Rp170 per share, generating a total proceeds of approximately Rp2.12 billion and reducing his ownership to zero from 0.63% of the outstanding shares. The stock was observed trading flat the next day at around Rp139 per share.

title: Tjandra Karya Hermanto buy Shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk
body: On 12 February 2026, shareholder Tjandra Karya Hermanto purchased 1,056,100 shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG.JK) at IDR 1,490 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 48,443,900 to 49,500,000 shares, reflecting an increase of 1,056,100 shares. This acquisition expands his stake in the company, indicating confidence in its prospects.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk completes $540 million gold mining acquisition through subsidiaries
body: PT United Tractors Tbk announced the completion of a US$540 million transaction to acquire PT Arafura Surya Alam, buying 99,99996% of its shares from PT J Resources Nusantara and the remaining 0,00004% from Jimmy Budiarto, as well as 0.2% of PT Mulia Bumi Persada, through its subsidiaries PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara and PT Energia Prima Nusantara. The deal, which includes the assumption of related debt, is intended to expand the company’s mineral business.

title: PT Idea Asia Investama divests 50 million shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk, cutting its stake to 35.66%
body: PT Idea Asia Investama sold 50 million shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk at Rp51 per share, a transaction worth Rp2.55 billion that reduced its ownership from 40.37% to 35.66%. Despite the divestment, IDEA’s stock jumped 9.52% intraday to Rp138, reflecting a 283.33% year‑on‑year gain.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey buy Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: On 12 Feb 2026, shareholder Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 300,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA.JK) at IDR 3,113 per share, investing approximately IDR 933,900,000. His holding increased from 3,431,700 to 3,731,700 shares, a rise of 300,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment and expands his ownership stake in the copper‑gold producer.

title: PLN reports 30% YoY growth in Electrifying Agriculture and Marine program customers by 2025
body: By 2025, PLN’s Electrifying Agriculture (EA) and Electrifying Marine (EM) programs served 390,034 customers, a 30% year‑on‑year increase from 2024. Installed capacity grew to 5,240 MVA and electricity consumption rose to 7.1 TWh, up 16% from the previous year.

title: PT PP Persero Tbk completes UIN Malang Phase II project, earning Indonesia’s MURI record
body: PT PP Persero Tbk, a national construction and investment firm under Danantara Indonesia, completed the Phase II development of UIN Maulana Malik Ibrahim in Malang, a Rp674.66 billion contract funded by the Saudi Fund for Development and featuring the first ‘Ar‑Rahim’ building design to earn a MURI record. The project includes new faculty buildings, student housing, a religious centre, infrastructure and solar panels, aiming to boost higher‑education quality and generate local economic multiplier effects.

title: PT Bukit Asam Tbk hands over social and public facilities to the Bara Lestari community in Muara Enim
body: PT Bukit Asam Tbk transferred a village hall, housing roads with lighting, a borehole, water‑tank land, two shop houses for UMKM and a community house to residents of RT 40, Perumahan Bara Lestari, Lawang Kidul. Local officials praised the contribution and emphasized continued cooperation between the company, government and the community.

title: Samuel Sekuritas increases stake in PT Sentul City Tbk to 5.02%
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia bought 523,633,200 shares of PT Sentul City Tbk at Rp130 per share, raising its holding to 8.41 billion shares (5.02%). The purchase lifts its ownership from 7.89 billion shares (4.71%) to the new level.

title: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk boosts 4G/5G capacity ahead of Ramadan and Lebaran 2026
body: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk said it will expand its 4G and 5G network, adding over 100 MBTS (including about 60 5G sites) and deploying AI‑ready traffic management to handle an anticipated 20‑30% surge in data traffic during Ramadan and the subsequent Lebaran holiday. The company also set up a 24/7 Network Operations Center and standby maintenance teams to ensure service continuity across key migration routes and tourist areas.

title: Masyita Crystallin moves from Ministry of Finance to head Economic & ESG role at PT Danantara Investment Management
body: Masyita Crystallin, former Director General of Financial Stability and Development at Indonesia's Ministry of Finance, has transferred to PT Danantara Investment Management as Head of Economic & ESG Strategic Positioning effective 11 February 2026. The appointment is described as a step to strengthen policy‑investment synergy and accelerate the transformation of Indonesia's financial sector.

title: Arthavest sell Shares of Arthavest Tbk
body: Arthavest sold 8,000,000 shares of Arthavest Tbk on 12 Feb 2026 at an aggregate price of IDR 24,000,000,000 (approximately IDR 3,000 per share). The holding decreased from 376,173,600 to 368,173,600 shares, a reduction of 8,000,000 shares. The transaction is recorded under the purpose "Buy and sell" and represents a notable divestment by the shareholder.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Investor Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased a total of 597,300 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares on 12 Feb 2026 for investment purposes, at a representative price of IDR 1,515 per share. His holding increased from 203,985,422 to 204,582,722 shares, a net gain of 597,300 shares, modestly raising his ownership stake in the cybersecurity firm.

title: Wilton Resources Holding Pte Ltd sell Shares of Wilton Makmur Indonesia Tbk
body: Wilton Resources Holding Pte Ltd sold 37,500,000 shares of Wilton Makmur Indonesia Tbk (SQMI.JK) under a Sale and Purchase Agreement at IDR 40 per share, totaling IDR 1,500,000,000,000. The shareholder's stake decreased from 8,255,212,719 to 8,217,712,719 shares, a reduction of 37,500,000 shares. The transaction reflects a modest divestment by the holding company, potentially adjusting its exposure to the listed entity.

title: Indonesia’s deregulation slashes fertilizer costs by 20% and boosts food self‑sufficiency
body: Indonesian Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman said deregulation and a streamlined fertilizer distribution system cut fertilizer costs by about 20% and added 700,000 tons of volume, while rice production reached 34.7 million tons in 2025 and national food stocks hit record levels. The reforms generated up to Rp132 trillion (≈US$7.8 billion) in farmer‑level turnover and involve state‑owned firms Pupuk Indonesia and Perum Bulog.

title: Indonesian Vice President Gibran urges subsidies to stabilize prices in traditional markets
body: During a visit to Badung Market in Denpasar, Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka directed the municipal government to provide subsidies for staple commodities facing price volatility and to accelerate market digitalisation. He also instructed local authorities to improve distribution mechanisms to ensure equitable support for merchants and consumers and to help curb inflation.

title: Indonesia declares 2026 the year of industrial acceleration
body: Industry Minister Agus Gumiwang Kartasasmita announced that 2026 will be a fast‑track year for Indonesia's industrialisation, setting higher self‑reliance targets and requiring clear outputs, measurable indicators and weekly dashboards across agro‑downstream, chemicals, textiles, petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, metal‑machinery, electronics, automotive and semiconductor sectors. The plan calls for traceability systems for palm oil, import‑substitution projects, a domestic market protection "war room" for textiles, and a priority components roadmap for electric‑vehicle parts, all overseen by designated persons‑in‑charge and performance milestones.

title: Indonesia to announce decision on Martabe gold mine next week, says Energy Minister
body: Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said the government will announce the fate of the Martabe gold mine in North Sumatra within a week, after reviewing alleged environmental and safety violations linked to the November 2025 floods. The mine, currently operated by PT Agincourt Resources, could be returned to the owner or taken over by the state‑owned Perminas depending on the investigation’s outcome.

title: Indonesia anticipates US reciprocal tariff agreement as Luhut says Trump respects President Prabowo
body: National Economic Council chairman Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan expressed confidence that the pending Indonesia‑US reciprocal tariff deal will be finalized, noting President Trump’s respect for President Prabowo Subianto. The agreement, to be signed during Prabowo’s US visit, would lower Indonesia’s tariff from 32% to 19% and grant US exemptions for key Indonesian exports such as palm oil, cocoa, coffee and tea.

title: Danantara Indonesia announces $13.1 billion investment plan for four priority projects in 2026
body: Danantara Indonesia will allocate Rp202.4 trillion (US$13.1 billion) in 2026 to four priority projects—Wamena (waste‑to‑energy), Cordova (caustic soda), Fukuoka (data centre) and Johor (agriculture)—each targeting multiplier effects ranging from two‑ to ten‑fold. The sovereign wealth manager also broke ground on six downstream projects worth US$7 billion across 13 regions, including bauxite processing, bio‑fuels and poultry farming.

title: Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meals Program Aims to Create 1.5 Million Jobs, President Prabowo Says
body: President Prabowo Subianto announced that the Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program, which currently operates more than 23,000 SPPG kitchens serving over 82 million beneficiaries, is projected to expand to more than 30,000 kitchens and generate 1.5 million jobs nationwide. The initiative also links local food suppliers and farmers to the kitchens, boosting agricultural income while providing nutrition to children, pregnant women, the elderly and people with disabilities.

title: Indonesia plans digital tax reforms to widen the base and gradually lower rates, says National Economic Council chair
body: National Economic Council Chairman Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan announced a technology‑driven tax reform aimed at expanding the tax base, reducing manual processes and eventually allowing gradual tax‑rate cuts. Government revenue reached Rp172.7 trillion in January 2026, a 9.8 % YoY rise, with tax receipts up 30.8 % to Rp116.2 trillion.

title: Indonesia’s Vice President Gibran promotes digital payments and price stability in Bali’s Badung Market
body: During a visit to Badung Market in Denpasar, Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka highlighted the benefits of non‑cash transactions for vendors and shoppers and affirmed government support for subsidies to keep staple prices stable. The initiative aligns with President Prabowo Subianto’s directive to modernize the trade ecosystem and protect purchasing power for MSMEs.

title: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk expands local fast‑charging infrastructure and EV conversion services to support Indonesia’s energy transition
body: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk announced the development of high‑local‑content fast‑charging stations for electric two‑wheelers and a Battery Energy Storage System integrated at IIMS 2026, aiming to boost domestic component use and reduce import reliance. The company targets sales of Rp5.8–6 trillion for the full year 2025, driven by two‑ and four‑wheel EV segments and its expanding non‑automotive businesses.

title: PT Magna Investama Mandiri Tbk's subsidiary PT Grha Swahita refinances loan with PT Bank Ina Perdana Tbk for Rp55.2 billion
body: PT Magna Investama Mandiri Tbk disclosed that its subsidiary PT Grha Swahita has repaid a credit facility from PT Bank Panin Dubai Syariah and secured a new Rp55.2 billion loan from PT Bank Ina Perdana Tbk through a refinancing takeover. The transaction is part of a funding‑structure strategy aimed at preserving financing continuity, lowering funding costs and improving the operational cash‑flow profile, with no adverse impact on the group's overall operations.

title: PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk posts lower 2025 revenue but higher profit and expands fleet and FLF business
body: PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk reported 2025 revenue of Rp880.58 billion (down 13.5% YoY) and net profit of Rp87.12 billion, while cargo volume fell 12.6% to 10.57 million metric tons. The company added 23 tug‑boat/barge sets, raising total assets 27.9% to Rp1.53 trillion, and is launching a floating loading facilities joint venture, PT Hasnur Multi Sinergi, with PT Multi Guna Maritim through its subsidiary PT Hasnur Resources Terminal, slated to start operations in 2027.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk lists Astra International directors as UBO to satisfy regulatory filing despite corporate ownership
body: In its January 31, 2026 shareholder registration report, PT United Tractors Tbk identified ten PT Astra International Tbk directors as ultimate beneficial owners solely to comply with Presidential Regulation No.13/2018, even though Astra International holds 59.5% of UNTR’s shares through its legal entity. The free‑float fell to 30.83% from 35.15% in December 2025 while the number of shareholders rose to 35,716.

title: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk approves a rights issue, board changes and an acquisition of PT Emway Globalindo via Blooming Years Pte Ltd
body: At its extraordinary shareholders meeting on 12 February 2026, PT Multitrend Indo Tbk approved a rights issue of 238.59 million new shares (8.36% of capital) at Rp590 per share with a 57‑for‑625 ratio, and appointed new commissioners after the resignation of Alptekin Diler. The independent meeting also approved the acquisition of PT Emway Globalindo, to be executed through an in‑kind contribution and a direct share purchase from Blooming Years Pte Ltd.

title: PT Sejahteraraya Anugrahjaya Tbk appoints Jeffrey Holman Staples as independent commissioner following extraordinary shareholders meeting
body: PT Sejahteraraya Anugrahjaya Tbk held an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 10 February 2026, where shareholders representing 68.09% of voting rights approved the appointment of Jeffrey Holman Staples as an independent commissioner, effective immediately with a term aligned to the remaining tenure of current commissioners. Management said the change strengthens the company’s governance structure.

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk backs green hydrogen pilot for low‑carbon power at Tanjung Sekong LPG terminal
body: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk announced its participation in the ESG Initiative Kick‑Off for the Green Terminal Tanjung Sekong, supplying green hydrogen produced from its Ulubelu geothermal field to help the LPG terminal achieve up to 25 % low‑carbon electricity in its operations. The project, attended by senior Pertamina Group executives including directors of business transformation, energy terminal and international shipping, aims to demonstrate an end‑to‑end geothermal‑based value chain that could be replicated at other strategic energy facilities.

title: PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk restructures management after PT Nextier Datamate Center acquires controlling stake
body: PT Nextier Datamate Center took over 1,499,999,500 shares, representing 78.74% of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk's paid‑up capital, from PT Trijaya Wisesa Makmur, effecting a change of control on 9 February 2026. An extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 10 February 2026, attended by holders of 86,5438% of voting shares, approved the resignation of the incumbent board and the appointment of a new five‑year management team.

title: Bank Tabungan Negara opens its latest BTN Digital Store in Central Park, Jakarta as part of a 100‑store digital expansion plan
body: Bank Tabungan Negara inaugurated a new BTN Digital Store at Central Park, Jakarta, featuring paperless, self‑service banking that lets customers open accounts in under five minutes and replace cards in under two minutes, and announced the goal of reaching 100 digital stores by 2027, bringing its total to 24 across Indonesia, including six in public malls. The launch, timed with BTN's 76th anniversary, included partnerships with Golden Black Coffee and SelfieTime and offered promotional perks such as free coffee, instant photos, shopping vouchers and exclusive merchandise.

title: PT PP Persero Tbk completes UIN Maulana Malik Ibrahim Malang Phase II project worth Rp674.66 billion
body: PT PP Persero Tbk, under Danantara Indonesia, finished the Phase II construction of UIN Maulana Malik Ibrahim in Batu, East Java, a Rp674.66 billion contract funded partly by the Saudi Fund for Development and built to international standards. The project earned a MURI record as Indonesia’s first university with an “Ar‑Rahim” building design and is expected to boost local employment, energy efficiency with solar panels, and support national education and sustainability goals.

title: PT Matra Tri Abadi raises its stake in PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk to 58.8% after February 2026 share purchases
body: On 12 February 2026 PT Matra Tri Abadi purchased 113.19 million shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk at Rp570 per share, an investment of about Rp64.5 billion, following an earlier acquisition of 129,673 million shares at Rp500 per share. The transactions increased Matra’s ownership from 54.88% to 58.80% of voting rights, and the company’s shares rose to around Rp610, having peaked at Rp789 earlier in 2026.

title: PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk schedules extraordinary shareholders meeting to appoint new President Director
body: PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk will hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 11 March 2026 to obtain approval for a board change following the resignation of President Director Khairuddin Simatupang. The company plans to appoint Jonet Budiarto, currently Senior Vice President Partnership Management at PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk, as the new President Director.

title: halocoko sets Indonesian MURI record by distributing over 1.1 million ice creams in 2025
body: halocoko achieved a Museum Rekor-Dunia Indonesia (MURI) record for the largest serial distribution of ice cream in a year, handing out more than 1.1 million chocolate ice creams to children across 50 regions through its "Berbagi Kebahagiaan di Setiap Sudut Negeri" and related programs in 2025. The initiative, which reached over 2.5 million people via more than 16 000 activities, is positioned by the company as a strategic component of its long‑term growth plan and will be expanded to additional cities in 2026.

title: Harita Jayaraya cuts stake in PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk to 71.13%
body: Harita Jayaraya sold 24.36 million shares of PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk between 9‑12 February 2026 at Rp615‑Rp699 per share, reducing its holding to 719.6 million shares (71.13%). The sale lowered its ownership from 73.54% to 71.13%.

title: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk develops locally sourced fast‑charging stations and EV conversion services, targeting Rp6 trillion sales in 2025
body: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk announced the rollout of high‑local‑content fast‑charging stations for two‑wheel electric vehicles, showcased with an integrated Battery Energy Storage System at IIMS 2026, and expanded its EV conversion service under the Dharma Connect ecosystem. The company expects these initiatives to help achieve its Rp6 trillion sales target for 2025, driven by growth in both two‑ and four‑wheel segments and expanding non‑automotive businesses.

title: PT Logindo Samudramakmur Tbk Secures One-Year Extension of USD12.5 Million and USD4 Million Loan Facilities
body: On 11 February 2026, PT Logindo Samudramakmur Tbk confirmed that GLAS Agency Hong Kong Limited had accepted its request to extend loan Facility A (USD 12,528 million) and Facility B1 (USD 4 million) for one year, from 24 April 2026 to 24 April 2027. The extension does not create new borrowing, nor does it materially affect the company’s operations, financial condition, or legal standing.

title: Affordable Hybrid Cars Debut at IIMS 2026 with Prices Below Rp500 Million
body: At the Indonesia International Motor Show 2026, several manufacturers introduced low‑priced hybrid models priced under Rp500 million. Suzuki launched the Ertiga Hybrid (Rp274‑300 million) and XL7 Hybrid (Rp286‑314.2 million), Daihatsu offered the Rocky Hybrid at Rp299.8 million, Toyota presented the Veloz Hybrid from Rp299‑390 million, and Chery unveiled the C5 CSH at Rp399.9 million.

title: PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk posts lower 2025 revenue and cargo volumes but boosts assets and fleet capacity
body: For 2025 PT Hasnur Internasional Shipping Tbk reported revenue of Rp880.58 billion (down 13.5% YoY) and net profit of Rp87.12 billion, with cargo volume falling 12.6% to 10.57 million MT, while assets rose 27.9% to Rp1.53 trillion after adding 23 new tugboats and barges; the group also expanded its floating loading facilities business through a joint venture between its subsidiary PT Hasnur Resources Terminal and PT Multi Guna Maritim (PT Hasnur Multi Sinergi) targeting operations from 2027 and outlined a cautious 2026 outlook amid coal policy and market volatility.

title: Singapore investor Kendilo Pte Ltd raises stake in PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk to 28.12%
body: Kendilo Pte Ltd purchased 65,661,100 shares of PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk at Rp352 per share, a transaction worth about Rp23.11 billion, raising its ownership to 28.12% (1.52 billion shares). After the cash deal, PT IMC Pelita Logistik Tbk shares closed at Rp350, down 0.57%.

title: PT Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia expands stake in PT Sentul City Tbk through a repo purchase
body: PT Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia bought 523,633,200 shares of PT Sentul City Tbk at Rp130 per share, a transaction valued at roughly Rp68.07 billion under a repurchase agreement. The deal increased its holding to 8.41 billion shares (5.02% of PT Sentul City Tbk) from 7.89 billion shares (4.71%), while the latter’s stock closed 3.97% lower at Rp145.

title: Wilton Resources Holding Pte Ltd sells 200 million Wilton Makmur Indonesia shares at Rp40 each, cutting its stake to 52.89%
body: Between 9 and 12 February 2026, Wilton Resources Holding Pte Ltd sold a total of 200 million Wilton Makmur Indonesia shares at Rp40 per share, generating approximately Rp8 billion in proceeds. The sale reduced Wilton Holding’s ownership from 54.41% to 52.89% (8.21 billion shares).

title: DEWA completes near-full share buyback program, spending Rp949.99 billion
body: DEWA completed a share buyback of roughly Rp949.99 billion, representing 99,999997 % of its planned Rp950 billion program, repurchasing 1,163 billion shares at an average price of Rp583.1 per share across ten transactions between 10 December 2025 and 13 February 2026. After the buyback, DEWA’s stock rose 55 points (9.73 %) to Rp620, though it remains 130 points (17 %) below the Rp750 level on 2 January 2026.

title: Pertamina Geothermal Energy launches Rp165.9 billion employee stock option program as shares fall 2 percent
body: Pertamina Geothermal Energy announced a management and employee stock option program (MESOP) of 210.77 million shares valued at roughly Rp165.9 billion, to be carried out in three stages starting on 24 February 2025. On 13 February 2026 the company's shares slipped 25 points (2.07%) to Rp1,180, a 23.38% drop from the 14 August 2025 level of Rp1,540.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey accumulates 1.1 million Merdeka Copper Gold shares, pushing MDKA stock to Rp3,220
body: Andrew Phillip Starkey bought 1.1 million shares of Merdeka Copper Gold (MDKA) through Wilton Holding at an average price of Rp3,168.25, raising his total holding to 3.73 million shares (0.015%). On 13 February 2026 MDKA shares jumped 0.94% to Rp3,220, up 38.2% since the start of the year.

title: Indonesia plans to expand mining export bans to boost downstream investment
body: Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia said the government will review additional mining commodities for export bans after last year's bauxite ban, aiming to replicate the nickel model that lifted processed nickel exports from US$3.3 billion in 2017 to US$33.9 billion by 2024. He also noted that 18 priority downstream projects have been submitted to state asset manager Danantara, with six already breaking ground.

title: KB Bank provides structured trade‑finance facilities to PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk for early 5G FWA Surge rollout
body: PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama, is extending non‑cash loan facilities (Letter of Credit and SKBDN in Rupiah) to PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk to fund the initial deployment of the 5G Fixed Wireless Access Surge network on the 1.4 GHz spectrum, supporting the affordable “Internet Rakyat” project. The financing aims to accelerate equipment procurement and enhance digital inclusion across densely populated areas in Indonesia.

title: Wijaya Karya's PKPU lawsuit withdrawn after PT Abacurra Indonesia rescinds Rp794.49 million claim
body: Wijaya Karya announced that PT Abacurra Indonesia withdrew its PKPU petition for Rp794.49 million on 13 February 2026, ending the legal proceedings (case No. 406/Pdt.Sus-PKPU/2025/PN.Jkt.Pst). The company said the dispute, which involved a remaining unpaid invoice of Rp794.49 million after paying Rp718.82 million, has no impact on its operations, legal standing, or financial condition.

title: Bank Mandiri posts strong 2025 financial growth and expands support for SMEs and government programs
body: Bank Mandiri reported that its 2025 audited consolidated assets grew 16.6% YoY to Rp2,829.9 trillion and credit expanded 13.4% YoY to Rp1,895.0 trillion, backed by a 23.9% rise in third‑party funds to Rp2,105.8 trillion and a 12.6% increase in CASA to Rp1,431.4 trillion, while UMKM lending rose 4.88% and KUR disbursements reached Rp41 trillion for 360,000 businesses; the bank also paid a record dividend of Rp52.5 trillion and Rp27 trillion in taxes in 2025, highlighting its role as a strategic partner for the Indonesian government’s development agenda.

title: PT Woori Finance Indonesia Tbk announces resignation of Chief Commissioner Jeong Hyuk Lee
body: PT Woori Finance Indonesia Tbk disclosed that Jeong Hyuk Lee has submitted his resignation as Chief Commissioner, which will become effective after approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting. The company stated that the resignation has no material impact on its operations, legal matters, financial condition, or business continuity.

title: Andaru Surya Gautama sell Shares of PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk
body: Shareholder Andaru Surya Gautama sold his entire holding of 22,100 PT Esta Multi Usaha Tbk (ESTA.JK) shares on 19 Dec 2025 at IDR 404 per share, totaling IDR 8,928,400. His stake fell from 22,100 shares to zero, reflecting a full divestment.

title: PT Berkah Prima Perkasa Tbk posts lower 2025 revenue and profit as shares dip despite strong YTD gain
body: PT Berkah Prima Perkasa Tbk reported a 11.9% YoY decline in revenue to Rp141,126 billion and an 11.5% drop in net profit to Rp14.49 billion for 2025, with earnings per share falling to Rp34.67. Its shares fell 5.51% to Rp6,452 at the close on 13 Feb 2026, although the price is up 117.06% year‑to‑date.

title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas postpones IPO listings to early 2026 as market rule reforms are finalized
body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas has received IPO mandates from 5‑6 potential issuers across sectors but will wait until the first half of 2026 to list them on the Bursa Efek Indonesia, pending new regulations on free‑float, UBO disclosure and investor data expected by May 2026. The firm said it will adjust IPO structures to meet the anticipated 15% minimum free‑float requirement once the rules are officially issued.

title: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk reviews possible adjustments to IPO fund usage after deploying 77.81% of proceeds
body: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk said it is reviewing possible adjustments to its IPO fund deployment, noting that as of 31 Dec 2025 it had utilized 77.81% (IDR 17.04 trillion) of the IDR 21.9 trillion raised, with the remaining IDR 4.28 trillion placed in low‑risk deposits, giro and bonds. The spent funds were allocated to working capital of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk (IDR 7.61 trillion), PT Buka Mitra Indonesia (IDR 1.22 trillion), PT Buka Usaha Indonesia (IDR 16.96 billion), PT Buka Pengadaan Indonesia (IDR 35.61 billion), Bukalapak Pte Ltd (IDR 1.05 billion), PT Five Jack (IDR 26.2 billion) and additional growth and subsidiary working capital of IDR 8.09 trillion.

title: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk reports 78% IPO proceeds used, with remaining Rp4.28 trillion held in low‑risk instruments
body: As of 31 December 2025, PT Bukalapak.com Tbk has realized Rp17.04 trillion (77.81%) of its Rp21.9 trillion IPO proceeds, allocating the remainder of Rp4.28 trillion (19.56%) to low‑risk deposits, giro and bonds. The company disclosed that the funds have been used for working capital across its subsidiaries—including PT Buka Mitra Indonesia, PT Buka Usaha Indonesia, PT Buka Pengadaan Indonesia, Bukalapak Pte Ltd and PT Five Jack—and is evaluating the schedule for the remaining capital deployment.

title: Ramadan drives consumer, retail and telecom stocks while the Jakarta Composite Index slides 0.64% amid global pressures
body: After the Lunar New Year holiday, analysts expect consumer, retail and telecom stocks such as PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk, PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk and PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk to benefit from higher household spending and data traffic during Ramadan, while the market remains cautious amid global commodity trends and capital outflows. The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 0.64% to 8,212 on Feb 13, with transaction volume of Rp24.41 trillion, 408 stocks declining, 267 gaining and 148 unchanged.

title: S&P Dow Jones Indices proceeds with March 2026 Indonesia index rebalance while MSCI and FTSE Russell pause their reviews
body: S&P Dow Jones Indices will carry out its standard quarterly rebalance of Indonesian stocks in March 2026, even as MSCI and FTSE Russell have suspended their own reviews over concerns about ownership transparency and free‑float levels. The decision follows regulator promises to double the minimum free‑float requirement to 15% and tighten disclosure, a move analysts at Aletheia Capital say may signal progress toward meeting index provider standards.

title: Consumer, retail and telecom stocks expected to lift Indonesia's IHSG after Chinese New Year amid Ramadan demand
body: Mirae Asset research head Rully Wisnubroto said retail firms PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk and PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, along with telecoms, could boost the IHSG in Q1 2026 as Ramadan drives household consumption and data traffic, while banking stocks typically lag after the year‑end peak. The index fell 0.64% to 8,212 on Feb 13, with outflows and risk‑off sentiment weighing on PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia persero Tbk and PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk, and trading volume reached Rp24.41 trillion.

title: Prajogo Pangestu remains Indonesia's richest with $29.9 bn net worth as his listed firms see strong stock gains and he expands his stake in PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk
body: Prajogo Pangestu topped Forbes' list of Indonesia's richest with a US$29.9 billion net worth, placing him 75th worldwide. Following a meeting with President Prabowo, shares of his firms PT Barito Pacific Tbk, PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk, PT Petrosea Tbk and PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk rose between about 10% and 30%, and he increased his holding in PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk to 94.53 billion shares (84.088% of the company) by the end of January 2026.

title: Antam gold buyback price rises over 15% in early 2026 while staying below its all‑time high
body: Antam's buyback price fell 13,000 IDR to 2,728,000 IDR on 16 Feb 2026, marking a 15.59% increase year‑to‑date but remaining below the record 2,989,000 IDR level; global spot gold rose 2.2% to $5,031.52 per ounce and analysts at Doo Financial Futures project next‑week prices between $4,900 and $5,100 per ounce. The buyback scheme is subject to a 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) PPh 22 tax on transactions above 10 million IDR.

title: PT Ecocare Indo Pasifik Tbk launches up to Rp5 billion share buyback to support market stability
body: PT Ecocare Indo Pasifik Tbk announced a share buyback program of up to Rp5 billion, to be executed between 13 February and 13 May 2026, with purchases limited to 20% of its paid‑in capital and a post‑buyback free‑float of at least 15%. The buyback is expected to reduce total assets to about Rp214 billion, equity to Rp156 billion and shares outstanding to roughly 2,486 billion, while net profit stays at Rp10.59 billion and earnings per share rise from Rp4.2 to Rp4.3.

title: PT Astra International Tbk expects a more vibrant Indonesian auto market in 2026 as sales rebound and analysts raise outlooks
body: PT Astra International Tbk reported January 2026 wholesale sales of 34,867 units, a 0.97% YoY increase that lifted its market share to 52% despite a decline in Toyota and Lexus volumes, while Daihatsu sales surged 25.34%; Ciptadana Sekuritas and Maybank Sekuritas forecast a sector recovery to about 900,000 units in 2026, raising Astra's market‑share target to 55% and noting the stock trades near Rp6,650.

title: Indonesia’s equity market enters consolidation phase with potential foreign inflows later in 2026
body: Chief Economist Helmy Kristanto of BRI Danareksa Sekuritas said Indonesia’s stock market is in a consolidation phase after recent global sentiment pressure, with foreign investors net‑selling Rp9.2 trillion in early February and Rp16.48 trillion on 13 Feb, but potential inflows could resume after May as OJK and SRO reforms take effect and dividend yields attract buyers. He also noted Indonesia’s economy is projected to grow 5.1‑5.3% this year, consumer confidence sits at 127 and money supply expands 9.6%, supporting a longer‑term market upside despite external risks.

title: PT Darma Henwa Tbk completes Rp950 billion share buyback ahead of schedule, reports strong Q3 2025 earnings
body: PT Darma Henwa Tbk repurchased 1.64 billion shares (4.03% of capital) for Rp949.99 billion, finishing the buyback on 13 Feb 2026 and lifting the stock 9.73% to Rp620. In Q3 2025 the company posted a net profit of Rp239.14 billion (up 519% YoY) on revenue of Rp4.65 trillion, mainly from services to PT Kaltim Prima Coal and PT Arutmin Indonesia, with total assets reaching Rp10.83 trillion.

title: 2026 ‘Fire Horse’ Year Expected to Bring Market Volatility but Opportunities for Select Sectors and Stocks in Indonesia
body: Analysts warn that the 2026 Year of the Fire Horse will bring volatility to Indonesia’s stock market, with Yulius Fang highlighting pressure on metal‑related sectors (automotive, electronics) and better prospects for water, wood and earth sectors, while Mirae Asset projects the IHSG could rise to 10,500 supported by 5.3% GDP growth, credit expansion and potential rate cuts. Mirae Asset also flags PT Darma Henwa Tbk and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk as top EPS growth picks, PT Barito Pacific Tbk as higher‑risk, PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk as defensive, and PT XL Axiata Tbk as a cheap recovery candidate.

title: PT Astra International Tbk projects a stronger Indonesian automotive market in 2026 amid rising sales targets and electrification growth
body: PT Astra International Tbk expects a more vibrant Indonesian automotive market in 2026, aligning with Gaikindo’s 850,000‑unit sales target and anticipating improved consumer sentiment and macro conditions. While internal‑combustion models remain dominant, Astra highlighted rapid growth in BEV and HEV segments supported by government incentives, reported a 52% market share with 66,446 wholesale units sold in January 2026 (34,867 from Astra, up 0.97% YoY), and introduced new hybrid models such as Toyota Veloz HEV, New Alphard, New Yaris Cross and New Vios.

title: State‑owned enterprise IPOs delayed to 2027 may lower fundraising but not impair market liquidity, analysts say
body: The lack of state‑owned enterprise IPOs in 2026 is expected to reduce total capital raised but will not materially hurt secondary‑market liquidity, which is driven more by free‑float levels, foreign fund flows and existing stock trading, said Liza Camelia of Kiwoom Sekuritas. Danantara Indonesia’s COO Dony Oskaria said the government will postpone BUMN listings until after mergers, restructurings and a four‑stage evaluation are completed, targeting IPOs in 2027.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk plants 500 trees in Samarinda in partnership with local government
body: PT United Tractors Tbk’s Samarinda branch and its Loa Janan Sanga site partnered with the Samarinda city government to plant 500 trees in the Makroman biodiversity park, featuring species such as Ulin, Gaharu, Mahoni and others. The effort is framed as part of the company’s ESG strategy and includes a one‑year maintenance program to support Samarinda’s net‑zero and climate‑resilience objectives.

title: PT Asia Intrainvesta sells 125 million shares of PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera Tbk, cutting its stake to 62%
body: On February 11, 2026, PT Asia Intrainvesta sold 125,000,000 shares of PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera Tbk at Rp23 and Rp24 per share, amounting to roughly Rp2.94 billion and reducing its ownership from 66.90% to 62%. The next day, PT Hassana Boga Sejahtera Tbk's stock closed at Rp86, down 1.15%.

title: PT Daimler Commercial Vehicles Indonesia launches the Mercedes-Benz Axor 1626 C at Construction Indonesia 2025 and highlights new Cikarang plant and after‑sales programs
body: PT Daimler Commercial Vehicles Indonesia officially launched the Mercedes-Benz Axor 1626 C, equipped with a 256 PS OM 906 LA engine and G85 IGR transmission, at Construction Indonesia 2025 in Jakarta and will also showcase it at Mining Indonesia 2025. The company highlighted its new Daimler Truck plant in Cikarang, expanded dealer network, CSP after‑sales services and partnerships with eight local bodybuilders, as part of its 55‑year presence in Indonesia.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk clarifies sealing of concession and outlines production expansion plans
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk's management clarified that the recent sealing of a concession area in Poboya, Palu involved only a zone under PT Citra Palu Minerals where illegal land clearing was found, and did not affect the ongoing open‑pit River Reef gold mine operations. The company also announced that CPM's processing plant capacity will be expanded to 2,000 t of ore per day by October 2026 and that underground mining, targeting 3.5‑4.9 g/t gold, is slated to start in the second half of 2027, which should raise gold output in 2026‑2028.

title: Berkah Prima BLUE posts 2025 profit decline amid lower revenue and reduced liabilities
body: Berkah Prima BLUE reported a 2025 net profit of Rp14.49 billion, a decline of 11.48% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share falling to Rp34.67 and revenue dropping 11.91% to Rp141.12 billion. The company’s equity rose to Rp101.36 billion while liabilities fell to Rp7.64 billion and total assets slightly decreased to Rp109 billion.

title: Samuel Sekuritas expands stake in MD Entertainment through February 2026 share purchases
body: Samuel Sekuritas bought a total of 229.37 million shares of MD Entertainment at an average price of Rp5,333 per share, spending roughly Rp1.24 trillion across three transactions on 6, 10 and 11 February 2026. The purchases raised its holding to 736.53 million shares, representing about 6.76% of the company.

title: Adhi Kartiko Pratama secures Rp200 billion credit facility from Bank UOB and Bank KB Indonesia
body: Adhi Kartiko Pratama obtained a total Rp200 billion loan, with Rp100 billion each from Bank UOB (12‑month term, COF + 1% per annum) and Bank KB Indonesia (maturing 6 Jan 2027, interest compounded quarterly plus 1.8%). The funding is for capital strengthening, is exempt from certain POJK 17/2020 requirements, and the company says it will not materially affect its financial condition or operations.

title: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara raises its stake in Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima to 57.99% after February share purchase
body: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara bought an additional 158,115 million shares of Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima on 11 February 2026 at an execution price of Rp364 per share, spending Rp57.55 billion and increasing its holding to 12.97 billion shares (57.99% of the company). The purchase was 4.71% below the closing price of Rp382, while INET’s share price has risen 2.13% to Rp384 and 15.66% over the past five days.

title: PT Logindo Samudramakmur Tbk extends USD16.5 million loan facilities for one year without affecting debt or operations
body: The company confirmed that loan facilities A (USD12,528 million) and B1 (USD4.0 million) have been officially extended from 24 April 2026 to 24 April 2027, adding no new debt or changing its capital structure. Its shares closed 3.5% higher on 13 February, reflecting a 25% gain over the past month and a 130% rise in the last quarter.

title: Cashlez reports a 101.9% increase in net loss for 2025, totaling Rp68.12 billion
body: Cashlez posted a net loss of Rp68.12 billion in 2025, more than double the Rp33.73 billion loss recorded in 2024, with earnings per share falling to Rp47.60. Revenue declined 20.35% to Rp110.18 billion while assets rose to Rp271.63 billion and equity fell sharply to Rp62.03 billion.

title: IHSG likely to consolidate post-Lunar New Year amid rate decision and 2025 earnings releases
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is expected to trade sideways after the Lunar New Year, with sentiment driven by the BI rate decision on 19 February, 2025 earnings reports, and technical resistance at 8,300 and support around 8,120. Indo Premier Sekuritas advises investors to focus on strong‑fundamental stocks such as BBTN (target price Rp1,555), LPPF (target price Rp1,945) and HRUM (target price Rp1,285).

title: Antam gold prices drop across all sizes on Chinese New Year, with buyback price also falling
body: On Tuesday, Feb 17 2026, Antam’s gold prices fell, with the 1‑gram spot price sliding to IDR 2,918 million (down IDR 22 000) and the 1,000‑gram bar priced at IDR 2.85 billion. The buyback price also fell to IDR 2,706 million, and transactions are subject to PPh 22 withholding of 1.5%/3% on sales above IDR 10 million and 0.45%/0.9% on purchases for NPWP and non‑NPWP holders respectively.

title: Moody’s negative outlook on Indonesia raises caution but Mandiri Sekuritas sees continued IPO activity
body: Moody’s has shifted Indonesia’s outlook to negative, raising concerns that early‑year market volatility may tighten IPO conditions, but Mandiri Sekuritas CEO Oki Ramadhana says reforms are underway and the firm is still preparing several IPOs for the second half of 2025. Analyst Ekky Topan adds that while the outlook signals higher risk, capital‑raising through the stock market remains possible though companies will act more cautiously.

title: Indonesia launches a Rp33 trillion Rupiah-denominated sovereign bond auction amid declining foreign demand
body: The government opened an open, multiple-price auction on 18 Feb 2026 for nine Rupiah-denominated sovereign bond series with coupons ranging from 5.87% to 6.875%, aiming to raise up to Rp33 trillion, administered by Bank Indonesia.
