The previous 3 Feb auction attracted Rp76.5 trillion of bids but only Rp36 trillion was absorbed, with a weighted-average yield of 6.32% and analysts from Anugerah Sekuritas Indonesia noting that heightened geopolitical tensions have dampened foreign investor appetite, prompting more short-term issuances.

title: PT Indonesia Paradise Property Tbk subsidiary secures Rp265 billion loan from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and outlines 2026 growth plan
body: PT Indonesia Paradise Property Tbk’s subsidiary PT Mitra Gemilang Mahacipta secured a Rp265 billion credit facility from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, comprising a Rp255 billion investment loan and a Rp10 billion local loan, backed by a corporate guarantee and a pledge of 13,888 INPP shares. The group announced a 2026 capex of Rp400 billion, targeting 5‑10% consolidated revenue growth and 75% recurring income after reporting Q3 2025 revenue of Rp1.31 trillion (up 49.8% YoY) and net profit of Rp493.9 billion.

title: Geopolitical tensions and domestic macro risks curb demand for Indonesia's 2026 sovereign bond auctions
body: Rising US‑Iran geopolitical tension and weaker domestic macro fundamentals have slashed demand for Indonesia’s 2026 sovereign bond (SUN) auctions, with the first three auctions seeing incoming bids fall from Rp90.96 trillion to Rp76.58 trillion. Anugerah Sekuritas Indonesia’s Ramdhan Ario Maruto noted foreign outflows are dragging domestic investors, while Valbury Sekuritas’ Fikri C Permana cited higher risk premiums and a larger share of short‑term SPN—absorbing Rp11.98 trillion versus Rp8.56 trillion in 2025—though sukuk auctions remain steady around Rp40‑50 trillion.

title: Antam's gold buyback price falls to Rp2.72 million per gram ahead of Chinese New Year 2026
body: On 16 February 2026, Antam reduced its gold buyback price by Rp13,000 to Rp2.72 million per gram, while the sell price at its Logam Mulia outlets was Rp2.94 million per gram. The announcement also detailed net proceeds after 0.25% PPh22 and a Rp10,000 stamp duty for various gold bar sizes, ranging from 1 gram to 1,000 grams.

title: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk advances local fast‑charging infrastructure and two‑wheel EV conversion ahead of 2025 sales target
body: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk announced the development of high‑local‑content fast‑charging stations and an integrated Battery Energy Storage System showcased at IIMS 2026, alongside a conversion service for two‑wheel ICE motorcycles to electric vehicles as part of its Dharma Connect ecosystem. The company said the initiatives support Indonesia’s EV policy and it remains confident of achieving its Rp6 trillion sales target for 2025.

title: PT Bumi Recources Minerals Tbk expands gold production and secures financing amid strong 2025 earnings
body: PT Bumi Recources Minerals Tbk, together with its subsidiaries PT Citra Palu Mineral and PT Gorontalo Minerals, is scaling gold output to about 80,000 ounces by 2026, increasing Palu processing capacity from 500 to 2,000 tons per day and preparing an underground mine in Poboya for 2027, while 9‑month 2025 sales jumped to US$183.58 million (≈Rp3.09 trillion) and net profit to US$37.91 million (≈Rp637.74 billion). Astronacci Sekuritas forecasts 2025 net profit of Rp843 billion and sales of Rp4.08 trillion, recommends a buy with a target price of Rp1,400, and notes the company has secured a US$625 million syndicated loan to fund the expansion.

title: PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk targets positive Lebaran 2026 performance with government VAT incentive and fare adjustments, while Citilink expands routes
body: PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk, backed by a 100% government‑covered VAT incentive and adjustments to passenger service charges and fuel surcharges, projects a 17‑18% ticket‑price increase for the 2026 Lebaran season and has lowered economy fares for domestic routes from 10 Feb to 29 Mar 2026; its subsidiary Citilink applied similar fare changes, opened new Jakarta‑Halim‑Padang and Jakarta‑Halim‑Pekanbaru routes, and together the group carried 1.56 million passengers (about 80% seat‑load), a 12.15% rise over the 2024 peak season.

title: Indonesia's ORI029 retail bond issuance lags target amid Moody’s outlook downgrade and geopolitical risks
body: ORI029 still has about Rp13 trillion unsold, representing only 53.36% of the Rp25 trillion target, with the 3‑year tranche at Rp6.13 trillion (40.9% of its goal) and the 6‑year tranche at Rp7.21 trillion (72.2%). Analysts from PT Bibit Tumbuh Bersama, KB Valbury Sekuritas, Anugerah Sekuritas Indonesia and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas cite Moody’s Ratings downgrade, rising geopolitical tensions and a widening fiscal deficit as reasons investors demand higher yields, while the 10‑year benchmark yield has slipped to 6.39% and the offering is expected to finish about 10% below target.

title: Indonesia's energy sector index jumps 11.9% in a week, driven by strong domestic buying and upbeat DBS Sekuritas outlook
body: Indonesia’s energy sector index (IDXENERGY) surged 11.94% in the week of 9‑13 Feb 2026, outpacing the broader market, led by DEWA, INPS, ENRG, CANI, BUMI and RATU, whose gains were driven mainly by strong domestic buying. DBS Sekuritas expects the rally to continue through 2026 on geopolitical tensions, oil price dynamics and low correlation with tech, recommending large‑cap energy stocks such as PetroChina, PTTEP, Medco and ADRO.

title: S&P Dow Jones Indices to Proceed with March 2026 Index Rebalancing While MSCI and FTSE Russell Pause Their Reviews of Indonesia
body: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced it will carry out its standard March 2026 index rebalancing for Indonesia despite MSCI Inc and FTSE Russell suspending their reviews over concerns about free‑float methodology, ownership transparency and market liquidity. Indonesian regulators have pledged reforms, including raising the minimum free‑float to 15% and tightening universal beneficial owner disclosure, to restore market credibility.

title: President Prabowo sets 7% ROA target for Danantara, analysts deem it unlikely
body: President Prabowo demanded that Danantara achieve a 7% return on assets (ROA) soon, while analysts from NEXT Indonesia Center note the current ROA is about 1.88% based on a Rp285 trillion net profit and US$900 billion in assets, making the goal hard to meet. Danantara’s leadership, including CEO Rosan P Roeslani, CIO Pandu Sjahrir and COO Dony Oskaria, say they will pursue efficiency gains, credit expansion and high‑return public‑equity investments as part of a broader consolidation that aims to lift BUMN profits to roughly Rp350 trillion by 2026.

title: PT Bukalapakcom Tbk sets 2026 gaming growth strategy as Q3 2025 revenue jumps 39%
body: PT Bukalapakcom Tbk outlined a strategy to boost its gaming segment through 2026 by enhancing monetisation, expanding the user base and strengthening strategic partnerships. In Q3 2025 the company posted revenue of Rp4.72 trillion, up 39.03% YoY, with gaming revenue reaching Rp1.4 trillion, a 2% increase from the prior quarter.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals clarifies seal on Palu gold concession and outlines production expansion plans
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk said the sealing of a portion of its Palu gold concession by the Satgas PKH was due to illegal land clearing by rogue miners, not by its subsidiary PT Citra Palu Minerals, and that the River Reef open‑pit mine continues operating normally. PT Citra Palu Minerals is expanding its processing plant capacity from 500 to 2,000 tons of ore per day by October 2026 and plans to start underground mining in the second half of 2027, which are expected to boost BRMS gold output through 2028.

title: Perusahaan Listrik Negara and Pertamina Geothermal Energy deepen cooperation on geothermal development in Sulawesi and Sumatra
body: Perusahaan Listrik Negara visited Pertamina Geothermal Energy’s Lahendong geothermal field in Tomohon on 12 February 2026 to discuss optimisation of existing plants, greenfield and brownfield projects and strategic partnership agreements, including technical documents for PLTP Lahendong units 7‑8 and steam‑sale contracts for PLTP Kotamobagu units I‑IV. Pertamina Geothermal Energy currently operates 1,932 MW of installed geothermal capacity – about 70 % of Indonesia’s total – and produced 4,827 GWh in 2024, supplying clean power to more than 2 million households and supporting the nation’s net‑zero emission target.

title: Sarana Mitra Luas absorbs Rp229.7bn bond proceeds, allocating most to electric forklift and battery purchases
body: Sarana Mitra Luas absorbed Rp229.7 billion of bond proceeds, representing about 78 % of the net bond collection of Rp294.04 billion. Of the absorbed amount, Rp212.67 billion was used to buy electric forklifts, lithium‑battery packs and chargers (72.33 % of the initial allocation) and the remaining Rp64.33 billion was deposited with Bank OCBC earning a 5.25 % annual return.

title: Link Net reports 22% rise in net loss to Rp1.44 trillion for 2025
body: Link Net posted a net loss of Rp1.44 trillion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 22% increase from the prior year, while revenue grew 22.22% to Rp3.08 trillion. The company's equity fell to Rp3.54 trillion, assets decreased to Rp13.23 trillion and liabilities rose to Rp9.68 trillion.

title: Samuel Sekuritas net purchases 731.9 million Sentul City BKSL shares, boosting its stake to 5.02%
body: Samuel Sekuritas bought and sold a total of 2.54 billion Sentul City BKSL shares in February 2026, resulting in a net acquisition of 731.9 million shares worth about Rp54.5 billion at an average price of Rp124.6 per share and raising its holding to 5.02% (8.41 billion shares). The stock fell 3.97% to Rp145 per share, down 2.68% since the start of 2026.

title: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk provides corporate guarantee and pledges shares for PT Mitra Gemilang Mahacipta's BCA loan
body: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk issued a corporate guarantee and pledged 13,888 of its shares in PT Mitra Gemilang Mahacipta to secure a BCA loan of Rp255 billion plus a Rp10 billion local credit facility. The guarantee amount is proportional to PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk's ownership stake in PT Mitra Gemilang Mahacipta and was given solely to meet BCA's credit requirements.

title: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk announces AGM and extraordinary meeting to approve a right issue of up to 2.03 billion new shares
body: The company will hold its Annual General Meeting and an Extraordinary General Meeting on 9 March 2026 to approve the 2025 annual report, profit use, and to authorize it as guarantor for credit facilities. It also seeks shareholder approval for a right issue of up to 2.03 billion new shares, representing a maximum of 27.39% of post‑issue capital, with proceeds earmarked for liquidity, capital expenditures, working capital, diversification and expansion.

title: PT Lion Metal Works Tbk faces sales pressure and asset reduction while planning land sales and a digitalisation‑focused capex to meet 2026 targets
body: PT Lion Metal Works Tbk is in a consolidation phase as sales fall and competition from Chinese imports intensifies, but management says liquidity and cash flow remain sound despite a decline in total assets driven by lower liabilities and dividend payments, and the company plans to sell about 100 ha of industrial land through its subsidiary PT Singa Purwakarta Jaya to fund operations. For 2026 the firm targets revenue of roughly Rp468 billion and net profit of Rp20.8 billion, supported by a Rp2‑5 billion capex program focused on digitalising production (laser‑cutting and robotic welding) and optimizing its cable ladder, fire‑door and racking divisions.

title: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk to Hold Extraordinary General Meeting to Approve 1‑for‑25 Stock Split
body: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk announced an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 11 March 2026 to seek approval for a 1:25 stock split and related amendment to its articles of association. The split aims to increase the number of shares outstanding and lower the trading price, with the stock closing at Rp94,325 on 13 February 2026, down 0.71% day‑over‑day, a 4.19% decline year‑to‑date but up 155% over the past year.

title: Commissioner Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara sells 300,000 shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk, cutting his stake to 1.52%
body: Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara, a commissioner of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk, sold 100,000 shares at Rp1,025 and 200,000 shares at Rp1,030 on 10‑11 February 2026, amounting to roughly Rp308.5 million. The transaction reduced his holding to 71.5 million shares (1.52% of the company) and the stock closed 0.48% lower at Rp1,030 on 13 February.

title: Commissioner Tjandra Karya Hermanto expands stake in PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk with Rp1.57 billion share purchase
body: Commissioner Tjandra Karya Hermanto of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk purchased 1,056,100 shares at Rp1,490 each, costing about Rp1.57 billion and increasing his stake to 49.5 million shares (0.25%). The company's shares fell 2.03% to Rp1,445 in trading on Friday.

title: Hillcon Equity Management buy Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management purchased 5,988,600 PT Hillcon Tbk shares at IDR 120 per share on 12 Feb 2026. The holding rose from 6,105,118,700 to 6,111,107,300 shares, a net increase of 5,988,600 shares. The buy is classified as an investment, modestly expanding the shareholder’s stake in the listed construction firm.

title: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara buy Shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk
body: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara purchased an additional 125,925,399 shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET.JK) at IDR 377 per share on 13 Feb 2026, raising its holding from 12,974,453,266 to 13,100,378,665 shares. The transaction aims to increase its ownership stake in the company, indicating a stronger commitment to INET's equity.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 13 Feb 2026, shareholder Henry Liem sold 14,500 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 550 per share. His holding decreased from 15,155,159 to 15,140,659 shares, a reduction of 14,500 shares. The transaction is recorded as a sell with the purpose of selling shares.

title: Rejuve Global Investment Pte Ltd buy Shares of PT Pyridam Farma Tbk
body: Rejuve Global Investment Pte Ltd purchased an additional 400,653,771 shares of PT Pyridam Farma Tbk at IDR 405 per share on 12 Feb 2026, raising its holding from 6,793,427,177 to 7,194,080,948 shares. The transaction aims to increase its ownership percentage and reflects a notable expansion of the investor's stake in the company.

title: Lioe Cu Ling Se sell Shares of Indospring Tbk
body: Shareholder Lioe Cu Ling Se sold a total of 90,000 Indospring Tbk shares on 12-13 Feb 2026 at a representative price of IDR 2,210 per share, citing a divestment purpose. The holding decreased from 164,500 shares to 74,500 shares, a reduction of 90,000 shares (approximately 55% of the prior stake). The transaction reflects a significant stake reduction and may affect the shareholder composition and voting power within the company.

title: PT Link Net Tbk reports higher net loss but revenue growth in 2025
body: PT Link Net Tbk recorded a net loss of Rp1.44 trillion in 2025, 22.24% higher than 2024, while revenue rose 22.25% to Rp3.08 trillion. The company added 545,000 home passes to reach 4.61 million, with assets falling to Rp13.23 trillion, liabilities rising to Rp9.68 trillion and equity dropping to Rp3.54 trillion.

title: Jalinankasih Sesama sell Shares of PT Palma Serasih Tbk
body: Jalinankasih Sesama sold 300,000,000 PT Palma Serasih Tbk shares on 12 Feb 2026 at IDR 200 per share, generating IDR 60,000,000,000,000 in proceeds. The shareholder's holding fell from 8,482,713,200 to 8,182,713,200 shares, a reduction of 300,000,000 shares. The transaction is classified as a stock sale and reflects a notable decrease in the insider's ownership stake, potentially impacting market perception of the company's valuation.

title: PT Nextier Datamate Center Buys Shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk
body: On 9 Feb 2026, PT Nextier Datamate Center purchased 1,499,999,500 shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk at IDR 92 per share, increasing its stake from 0 to 1,499,999,500 shares. The acquisition, classified as a public company takeover, represents a full ownership move and signals a strategic intent to control the listed entity.

title: Sensasi Istana Warna buy Shares of PT Avia Avian Tbk
body: Sensasi Istana Warna purchased 6,500,000 shares of PT Avia Avian Tbk at IDR 450 per share on 12 Feb 2026, raising its holding from 153,251,300 to 159,751,300 shares (an increase of 6,500,000 shares). The acquisition, classified as an investment, expands the shareholder’s stake in the airline and may influence future corporate actions.

title: Fitradityo Harjuno sell Shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk
body: On 12 February 2026, shareholder Fitradityo Harjuno sold 25,000,000 PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk (NTBK.JK) shares at IDR 94 per share for personal use. His holding fell from 252,922,100 to 227,922,100 shares, a decline of 25,000,000 shares (approximately 9.9% of the prior stake). The transaction reduces insider ownership and may be noted by investors monitoring shareholding changes.

title: Jalinankasih Sesama Sell Shares of PT Palma Serasih Tbk
body: Jalinankasih Sesama, a major shareholder of PT Palma Serasih Tbk, sold shares on 12 February 2026, reducing its stake from 8,482,713,200 to 8,182,713,200 shares (a drop of 300,000,000 shares). The transaction involved a sale at IDR 200 per share, totaling IDR 300,000,000. The sale was part of a routine stock sales activity and may indicate a strategy to liquidate positions or adjust portfolio exposure, affecting the company’s shareholder structure.

title: Hillcon Equity Management buy Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management, a major shareholder of PT Hillcon Tbk (HILL.JK), executed a buy transaction on 13 February 2026, acquiring 5,988,600 shares at IDR 110.0 per share for investment purposes. The transaction reduced the holder’s stake from 6,111,107,300 to 6,105,118,700 shares, reflecting a net decrease of 5,988,600 shares. This move signals the investor’s continued commitment to the company while adjusting its portfolio allocation.

title: Stephen Sardjono sell Shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk
body: Stephen Sardjono sold 1,000,000 shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk, reducing his holding from 1,000,000 to zero shares. The sale was conducted at a price of IDR 62.0 per share, totaling IDR 62,000,000. This transaction eliminates his stake in the company, potentially impacting shareholder structure and liquidity. The move is straightforward, with no additional disclosures required.

title: Sri Rahayu Sell Shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk
body: Sri Rahayu sold 83,200,000 shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk at IDR 47.0 per share on 2026‑02‑09, reducing her holding from 83,200,000 to zero shares. The transaction was executed for the purpose of selling shares and represents a complete divestment by the shareholder, leaving the company without this shareholder’s stake. This move may impact the shareholder structure and could signal a strategic shift or liquidity need.

title: Dennis Rahardja Sell Shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk
body: Dennis Rahardja sold all 51,300,100 shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk (MGLV.JK) at IDR 47.0 per share on 2026-02-09, reducing his stake from 51,300,100 to zero. The transaction, filed on 2026-02-18, reflects a complete divestment and may impact shareholder composition and liquidity of the company.

title: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk receives A+ stable rating from PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia
body: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk was assigned an id A+ rating with a stable outlook by PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia, reflecting its strong market position, secured contract scheme and solid financial profile. As of 30 September 2025, the company reported adjusted assets of US$407.7 million, adjusted debt of US$162.1 million and adjusted equity of US$208.4 million, while Pefindo warned that higher debt or loss of end‑to‑end contracts could trigger a downgrade.

title: Emtek raises stake in Surya Citra Media to 74% after February 2026 share purchases
body: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk increased its direct ownership of PT Surya Citra Media Tbk to 54.75 billion shares (74.02%) after buying 2.68 billion shares for about Rp752.66 billion in two transactions on 10‑11 February 2026. On 18 February 2026 SCMA shares opened at Rp312, traded between Rp306‑Rp318 and closed at Rp318, reflecting a YTD decline of 8.09% but a six‑month gain of 11.97% with a market capitalization of Rp23.62 trillion.

title: Analysts raise profit forecasts and target prices for PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk (Harita Nickel) amid capacity expansion and higher nickel prices
body: Analysts from BRI Danareksa Sekuritas and KISI Sekuritas remain bullish on PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk Harita Nickel, projecting a capacity increase to about 305,000 tons by 2026, a 3‑4% annual cash‑cost reduction and a 43.7‑67.3% rise in net profit, and raising target prices to IDR 1,800 and IDR 2,100 respectively. The stock is trading around IDR 1,450, up roughly 29% year‑to‑date, as higher global nickel prices and the company's fully integrated supply chain are expected to improve margins.

title: Antam gold buy‑back price drops 11% from record high as spot gold retreats
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buy‑back price fell Rp334,000 from its all‑time high to Rp2,655 million per gram on 18 Feb 2026, while global spot gold slipped 2.3% to $4,877.87 per ounce. Doo Financial Futures analyst Lukman Leong expects spot gold to trade between $4,900 and $5,100 per troy ounce next week, citing a rebound after lower‑than‑expected US inflation data.

title: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk reports ninth consecutive year of net losses and a negative equity position despite modest revenue growth in 2025
body: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk posted a net loss of Rp152.21 billion in 2025, extending a nine‑year streak of losses since 2017 and leaving the company with an accumulated deficit of Rp2.95 trillion and negative equity of Rp2.24 billion. Revenue rose 1.9% to Rp7.25 trillion, while operating profit fell 23.1% to Rp26 billion, and the firm plans to focus on customer‑oriented expansion and digital engagement.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk achieves first gold pour at Pani mine ahead of schedule and raises first‑year production target
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk completed its first gold pour at the open‑pit Pani mine in Pohuwato, Gorontalo on 14 February 2026, ahead of the originally projected Q1 2026 schedule, and projects first‑year heap‑leach output of 110‑115 k ounces of gold, above the earlier 80 k‑ounce target. The project, run through a subsidiary of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk, has accelerated construction of a 12 Mt/yr carbon‑in‑leach plant to 2028, aiming for roughly 500 k ounces annual production by 2029, backed by 4.8 million‑ounce ore reserves and over 7 million‑ounce inferred resources.

title: PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk announces acquisition of 99.96% of PT Traya Multi Investama and prepares a private placement of up to 394.8 million shares.
body: The company will acquire 2,499 of PT Traya Multi Investama’s 2,500 shares, giving PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk a 99.96% controlling stake, and says the deal will not materially affect operations or finances. Earlier, PT Multi Garam Utama Tbk also announced a December 2025 extraordinary shareholders meeting to approve a private placement of up to 394.8 million new shares (max 10% of capital) and board changes, following its 2023 IPO that raised Rp57 billion.

title: MSCI imposes interim freeze on Indonesia index inclusion, citing free‑float transparency and market microstructure concerns
body: MSCI announced an interim freeze that halts the increase of the Foreign Inclusion Factor and number of shares, postpones adding Indonesian stocks to certain investable indices, and will reassess market accessibility in May 2026; the move underscores concerns that limited effective free float and high market‑microstructure noise, as shown by research indicating a 10‑minute optimal sampling interval and a positive link between noise, bid‑ask spreads, and information asymmetry, can distort price discovery and raise capital costs.

title: IHSG projected to stay pressured amid government bond auction and mixed technical outlook
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is expected to remain under pressure on Feb 18, 2026, as the government plans to auction Rp33 trillion of sovereign bonds to fund a projected Rp689.1 trillion budget deficit, with technical resistance at 8,265 and support near 8,115‑8,170. OCBC Sekuritas recommends buy‑on‑weakness for Bank Tabungan Negara, Harum Energy and speculative buys for Energi Mega Persada, Indika Energy and Transcoal Pacific, while Sinarmas Sekuritas sees the index testing support levels amid domestic growth optimism and heightened US‑Iran geopolitical tensions.

title: Indonesia's IHSG Expected to Trade in 8,150‑8,300 Range Amid Mixed Global and Domestic Signals
body: The Phintraco Sekuritas research team projects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to consolidate between 8,150 and 8,300 after closing at 8,212.27, as lower‑than‑expected US CPI and strong labor data temper expectations ahead of the PCE release and the FOMC minutes. Domestically, attention shifts to President Prabowo’s upcoming Indonesia‑US reciprocal trade agreement—imposing a 19% tariff on most Indonesian products and a US$15 billion oil import plan—while the rupiah hovers around Rp16,825 per dollar, prompting a strategy of selective accumulation in stocks showing technical rebound and solid sector fundamentals.

title: Mandiri Sekuritas remains upbeat on IPO pipeline despite market volatility and Moody's negative outlook
body: Mandiri Sekuritas is continuing to process several IPOs for the first quarter of 2026, citing positive market reaction and recent regulatory reforms by Otoritas Jasa Keuangan and Bursa Efek Indonesia, even as MSCI warns of potential reclassification if transparency issues persist. Analyst Ekky Topan of Infovesta notes that while Moody's negative outlook raises risk, the capital market remains a viable funding source, though companies may act more cautiously.

title: Indonesia's IHSG likely to consolidate ahead of BI rate decision and 2025 earnings releases
body: Indonesia's composite index (IHSG) is expected to trade sideways around 8,120‑8,300 after a 3.49% weekly gain, as investors await the Bank Indonesia rate decision on Feb 19 and 2025 earnings releases. Analysts highlighted Bank Tabungan Negara, Matahari Department Store and Harum Energy as top picks, citing strong fundamentals and stable commodity demand.

title: Pegadaian reports uniform decline in Galeri 24 and UBS gold buyback prices on Feb 18, 2026
body: On Wednesday 18 February 2026, Pegadaian listed buyback prices for Galeri 24 and UBS gold that were identical across all weight categories and slightly lower than the previous day; 1‑gram gold was priced at Rp2,758,000, 10‑gram at Rp27,583,000, and 1‑kilogram at Rp1,365,667,000. All other sizes from 0.5 gram to 100 grams followed the same pricing pattern for both brands.

title: Pegadaian reports lower Antam gold buyback prices on 18 February 2026
body: On Wednesday 18 February 2026, Pegadaian posted lower buyback rates for Antam gold across all sizes, with the 1‑gram price at Rp2,758,000 and the 1‑kilogram price at Rp2,731,335,000. Prices for other denominations also declined, ranging from Rp1,379,000 for 0.5 gram to Rp137,242,000 for 50 gram.

title: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk completes third share buyback phase and begins fund correction review
body: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk announced the completion of the third phase of its share buyback program, but is currently re‑verifying the total funds used after receiving a correction from its broker and will submit a separate report to the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The company affirmed no affiliate participation, will continue using the remaining buyback ceiling as mandated by POJK 13 and OJK, and still holds Rp4.28 trillion of IPO proceeds in liquid assets as of 31 December 2025.

title: Adi Sarana Armada injects Rp54 billion into subsidiary Adi Sarana Properti, raising its capital to Rp200 billion
body: On 11 February 2026, Adi Sarana Armada injected Rp54 billion into its subsidiary Adi Sarana Properti, increasing the subsidiary’s authorized capital to Rp200 billion and paid‑in capital to Rp120 billion. The post‑capitalization shareholding now stands at 51.67% for Adi Sarana Armada, 31.67% for Prodjo Sunarjanto Sekar Pantjawati, 3.33% for Judianto and 13.33% for Hasan Hardjono.

title: Anabatic Technologies plans 600‑million‑share right issue to fund bond repayment and operations
body: Anabatic Technologies intends to launch a 600 million‑share right issue, representing up to 25.91 % of its capital at a nominal value of Rp100 per share, with proceeds after costs earmarked to repay a Rp559.99 billion bond due on 11 July 2026 (held by TIS Inc) and to support cash, facilities and working‑capital needs. Investors who do not participate may experience up to 7.68 % dilution, and the proposal will be submitted for shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 27 March 2026, with eligibility to vote requiring registration as of 26 February 2026.

title: Multi Garam to acquire 99.96% of Traya Multi Investama
body: Multi Garam will acquire 2,499 shares, representing 99.96% of Traya Multi Investama, making it the controlling shareholder after the transaction signed on 13 February 2026. The company said the acquisition is part of its multi‑sector expansion strategy and will not adversely affect Traya Multi Investama’s operations, finances or continuity.

title: Multitrend BABY plans Rp269.98 billion acquisition of Emway Globalindo EGI funded by a Rp140.77 billion right issue
body: Multitrend BABY announced a Rp269.98 billion transaction that includes acquiring 274.69 million shares of Emway Globalindo EGI for Rp139.98 billion and an in‑breng from Blooming Years Pte Ltd of Rp120 billion. The deal will be financed through a Rp140.77 billion rights issue of 238,599,876 new shares at Rp590 each, with Blooming Years Pte Ltd exercising all 220,346,305 rights to become the controlling shareholder of EGI.

title: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd trims stake in Lovina Beach Brewery after selling 5.07 million shares
body: Phillip Securities Pte Ltd sold 5,077,200 shares of Lovina Beach Brewery (STRK) at Rp158 per share on 9 February 2026, generating Rp802.19 million for shareholder Tan Lay Kian and reducing its holding to 1.71 billion shares (15.96% of the company, down 0.05% from before). The previous transaction on 3 February 2026 involved buying the same number of shares at Rp179 each.

title: Telecom stocks hold gains amid IDXINFRA dip as 2026 fire‑horse year fuels ARPU optimism and 5G auction prospects
body: IDXINFRA rose 5.52% to 2,269.08 between 9–13 February but fell 1.23% on 13 February, while telecom constituents INET (+2.13% to Rp384), MTEL (+0.92% to Rp550) and ISAT (+0.45% to Rp2,230) kept their advances. Samuel Sekuritas expects higher ARPU and a 5G spectrum auction, naming PT Indosat Tbk as its top pick with a target of Rp2,700, and Yulius Fang cautions investors about volatility and sector rotation based on elemental analysis.

title: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk posts modest sales growth but deeper net loss in FY 2025
body: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk reported FY 2025 net sales of Rp7.25 trillion, a 1.9% increase YoY, with gross profit rising 2.8% to Rp1.26 trillion, while operating profit fell 23.1% to Rp26 billion and the company posted a net loss of Rp152.19 billion, larger than the Rp118.11 billion loss in 2024. Management said the loss stemmed from non‑operational charges and outlined a 2026 strategy focused on customer‑oriented initiatives, selective store expansion into underserved areas, and stronger digital engagement.

title: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT Bumi Recources Minerals Tbk accelerate gold expansion amid divergent market reactions
body: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT Bumi Recources Minerals Tbk are both expanding gold production, with MDKA shares gaining 0.94% to Rp3,220 (YTD +41.23%) and BRMS shares up 0.93% to Rp1,080 (YTD -1.82%); foreign investors have net bought Rp12.77 bn in MDKA and Rp949.68 bn YTD in BRMS. Analysts note BRMS’s underground Poboya Palu mine and a US$625 m loan to raise processing capacity to 2,000 t/day by Q4 2026, targeting 80,000 oz in 2026, while MDKA is accelerating its CIL plant at Pani to operate by 2028, aiming for a 500,000 oz peak production supported by gold prices near US$5,000/oz.

title: PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk raises 2025 capex to Rp11.2 trillion and plans Rp15 trillion spend for 2026 amid a net loss and revenue growth
body: PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk reported capex of about Rp11.2 trillion in 2025, a 52% YoY increase, and set a 2026 capex budget of Rp15 trillion while targeting EBITDA growth twice the revenue growth and merger synergies of US$250‑300 million. The company posted a net loss of Rp4.42 trillion in 2025 versus a profit of Rp1.81 trillion in 2024, with revenue rising 23.4% to Rp42.4 trillion, driven mainly by GSM mobile and data services.

title: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol posts slight net profit increase to Rp180.19 billion in FY2025
body: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol reported a net profit of Rp180.19 billion for the year, up 1.34% from the prior period and raising earnings per share to Rp113. Revenue declined 11.11% to Rp1.12 trillion, while other income jumped 866.65% to Rp224.65 billion and total assets rose to Rp3.63 trillion.

title: PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk posts widened 2025 net loss amid revenue decline and higher loan losses
body: PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk reported a net loss attributable to the parent of Rp68.12 billion in 2025, a 102% increase from the prior year, with earnings per share falling to -Rp47.6. The loss was driven by a 20.35% revenue decline to Rp110.18 billion, a sharp rise in net loan loss to Rp11.16 billion and higher financial and tax expenses, while gross profit modestly improved to Rp20.17 billion.

title: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk posts larger 2025 net loss despite modest sales growth
body: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk reported a net loss of Rp152.21 billion for 2025, a 28.9% increase from the prior year, while net sales rose 1.9% to Rp7.25 trillion and operating profit fell 23.1% to Rp26.08 billion. The loss reflects heavy investment in new retail formats and product refreshes, but CEO Adrian Suherman remains optimistic about long‑term margins as the stock slipped 1.89% to Rp52.

title: Kiwoom Sekuritas calls for aggressive stock picking in 2026, spotlighting digital, AI, and energy sectors with specific buy recommendations
body: Kiwoum Sekuritas' Outlook 2026 warns that passive strategies will lag in a fast‑moving market and recommends active rebalancing and momentum play, focusing on high‑growth sectors such as digital ecosystems, AI, and energy transition. The report highlights buy targets including PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk, PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk and PT Trinitan Land Tbk.

title: Indonesia's stock exchange to disclose UBO and shareholder concentration data, analysts weigh benefits and risks
body: The Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) will publish Ultimate Beneficial Owner information and a shareholders concentration list, which analysts say can improve market transparency but may also trigger herding, panic selling and new manipulation risks; they advise using the data as a risk filter rather than a buying signal. BEI’s move comes as the market reaches 21.0 million single investor identifications and nearly 9.0 million stock investors, supporting its proposal to MSCI for higher index classification.

title: Moody's shifts Indonesia's outlook to negative, raising cost of capital and dampening corporate fundraising
body: Moody's downgrade to a negative outlook is expected to increase risk premiums, lower market valuations and push up bond yields in Indonesia. Analysts Ekky Topan of Infovesta and Maximilianus Nico Demus of Pilarmas Investindo Sekuritas warn that IPOs, rights issues and other corporate actions may slow as companies face higher financing costs and may seek alternative funding sources.

title: PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk posts 40% Q4 profit surge and beats consensus, outlook positive for 2026
body: PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk reported net profit of Rp18.6 trillion in Q4 2025, up 40% quarter‑on‑quarter and 35% year‑on‑year, delivering 101%‑110% of market consensus and posting a full‑year profit of Rp56.3 trillion, while net interest margin fell to 4.9% and asset quality remained strong with NPL at 1.1%. Analysts at MNC Sekuritas and Indo Premier Sekuritas expect 2026 profit to rise to around Rp58.7 trillion, driven by non‑interest income growth and stable cost‑to‑income ratios.

title: Hillcon Tbk shares plunge 15% to auto‑rejection level as Indonesia Stock Exchange flags Unusual Market Activity
body: Hillcon Tbk’s stock opened at Rp68, down 15% (12 points) and hit the auto‑rejection bottom after the Indonesia Stock Exchange imposed an Unusual Market Activity status. The exchange warned investors to review the company’s performance and disclosures, noting the stock has fallen 84.33% year‑on‑year.

title: PT RMK Energy Tbk reports early progress in its three‑month share buyback program
body: PT RMK Energy Tbk has spent Rp9.89 billion to repurchase 2.37 million shares at an average price of Rp4,160, representing 4.95% of its Rp200 billion buyback budget. The company still has about Rp190.10 billion remaining and its shares closed up 2.34% at Rp4,370 on February 13.

title: Controlling shareholder Harita Jayaraya sells 24.36 million PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk shares amid sharp stock rally
body: Harita Jayaraya disposed of 24,357,600 PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk shares between 9 and 12 February 2026 at prices ranging from Rp615 to Rp699 per share, valuing the transaction at approximately Rp16.43 billion. The sales occurred as PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk’s stock surged 147.9% in the past month, reaching a premium level of Rp600 per share.

title: RMK Energy posts strong early-2026 performance driven by new hauling road and coal trading growth
body: RMK Energy reported a sharp rise in coal hauling volume in January 2026, with road-haul tonnage increasing 9.26‑fold to 167.5 k tons and total barge shipments reaching 703 k tons, supported by new clients PT Wiraduta Sejahtera Langgeng, PT Duta Bara Utama and PT Menambang Muara Enim. Coal sales jumped four‑fold to 513.6 k tons and the company’s Q4 2025 results showed revenue of about Rp1.1 trillion and net profit of Rp105 billion, prompting optimism for continued operational and financial improvement.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk reports conversion of 318 million Series I warrants, increasing total shares to 2.2355 billion
body: The conversion period for PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk's Series I warrants ended on 11 February 2026, with 318,002,042 of the 480 million issued warrants exercised and the remaining 161,997,958 lapsing. Following the conversion, the company's share count on the Indonesia Stock Exchange rose to 2,235,502,042 shares, as confirmed by PT Bima Registra, the securities administration bureau.

title: PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk reports resignation of two commissioners and plans EV charging expansion funded by Rp75.55 billion investment
body: PT Teknologi Karya Digital Nusa Tbk (TRON) announced the resignation of independent commissioner Noerman Taufik and commissioner Thomson E Batubara and will convene an extraordinary shareholders meeting to appoint new commissioners. The company also intends to add electric‑vehicle charging services (KBLI 35132 and 35133) with an estimated Rp75.55 billion investment financed by internal cash and other lawful sources, projected to generate a positive NPV and an IRR above the discount rate.

title: PT Mercury Strategic Indonesia launches mandatory tender offer for PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk shares worth up to Rp1.07 trillion
body: PT Mercury Strategic Indonesia announced a mandatory tender offer for up to 5,811 billion PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk shares (73.129% of capital) at Rp183.63 per share, representing a maximum consideration of about Rp1.07 trillion. The offer runs from 19 February to 20 March 2026, with payment on 30 March, and the new controlling shareholder may later pursue delisting.

title: Indonesian DPR VI backs PT TIMAH Tbk's cooperative partnership for tin mining
body: The House of Representatives' Commission VI, represented by Deputy Chair Nurdin Halid, expressed support for PT TIMAH Tbk's strategy of involving cooperatives as mining partners, citing alignment with the constitutional economy principle in Article 33 of the 1945 Constitution. The cooperative model is presented as a way to improve financing access, reduce price differentials, and distribute surplus earnings to miners, thereby enhancing community welfare.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On 12 Feb 2026, shareholder Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold 28,900 Bayan Resources Tbk shares at IDR 14,194 per share, reducing his holding from 559,800 to 530,900 shares (a decline of 28,900 shares). The divestment purpose indicates a strategic reduction of exposure, and the transaction modestly adjusts the shareholder composition without materially affecting market control.

title: Granada Global Industri Sell Shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk
body: Granada Global Industri sold 4,666,700 shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk, reducing its stake from 88,136,008 to 83,469,308 shares. The sale was executed on 5 February 2026 and 9 February 2026 at an average price of IDR 100.0 per share, generating proceeds used for payment of obligations. The transaction lowers the shareholder’s ownership by about 5.3% and provides liquidity for the company’s financial commitments.

title: Eddy sell Shares of Resource Alam Indonesia Tbk
body: Eddy sold all 271,934 shares of Resource Alam Indonesia Tbk on 18 February 2026 at IDR 324.0 per share, reducing his holding from 271,934 to zero for personal use. The transaction removes his stake entirely, potentially increasing the proportion of remaining shareholders and affecting ownership concentration. This liquidation may signal a shift in his investment strategy and could influence liquidity and market perception of the stock.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey buy Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 150,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk on 18 February 2026 at IDR 3,200.0 per share, increasing his stake from 3,731,700 to 3,881,700 shares. The transaction, recorded on 19 February 2026, reflects an investment move aimed at expanding his position in the copper and gold sector. The purchase raises the company's shareholder base and may signal confidence in its resource projects.

title: PT Hillcon Tbk Shareholder Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia entered a repurchase agreement with PT Hillcon Tbk on 18 Feb 2026, selling 133,965,800 shares at IDR 80 per share. The holding fell from 3,134,339,500 shares to 3,000,373,700 shares, a reduction of 133,965,800 shares. The transaction reflects a temporary share buy‑back arrangement and reduces the shareholder's stake in the company.

title: Charnic Capital reports net profit of Rp108.26 billion, a 1,195% increase from the previous year
body: Charnic Capital posted a net profit of Rp108.26 billion for the year, up from Rp8.36 billion, with earnings per share rising to Rp166.27. Revenue jumped to Rp110.13 billion, equity to Rp311.51 billion and total assets to Rp3,144.3 billion.

title: Samuel Sekuritas sees consumer and retail stocks poised for Ramadan 2026 despite 2025 profit corrections
body: Samuel Sekuritas says consumer and retail issuers such as PT Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk and PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk are positioned to benefit from Ramadan 2026 despite net‑profit corrections in the first nine months of 2025 (AMRT profit down 3.49% YoY to Rp2.31 trillion, ICBP down 12.77% to Rp7.11 trillion, INDF down 10.03% to Rp7.88 trillion). The firm maintains buy recommendations with target prices of Rp2,400 for AMRT, Rp11,000 for ICBP and Rp9,100 for INDF, noting AMRT’s attractive price‑to‑sales of 0.5 and ROE of 23.8% versus peers.

title: KISI Sekuritas expects Chinese New Year and Ramadan to boost energy, consumer and telecom stocks while warning of overvalued banks
body: KISI Sekuritas head Muhammad Wafi says the combined effect of Chinese New Year and Ramadan will act as a catalyst for energy (fire) and consumer/infrastructure (earth) stocks, favoring companies such as ICBP and MYOR in consumer, AMRT and ACES in retail, and TLKM and ISAT in telecom, while big banks face valuation pressure. He advises swing‑trading the trending sectors and notes that domestic inflation and global rate moves could influence the IHSG, with controlled inflation supporting a breakout but rupiah volatility risking foreign outflows.

title: VKTR confirms Gilarsi W. Setijono remains CEO despite also leading state-owned PT Perusahaan Mineral Nasional
body: PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk said Gilarsi W. Setijono continues as President Director and there is no change in its management structure, even though he also chairs PT Perusahaan Mineral Nasional. He recently attended the signing of an MoU between Danantara Indonesia and New Energy Metals Holdings Ltd on rare‑earth projects in Gabon and Indonesia, while VKTR declined to comment on his Perminas role.

title: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk acquires six assets worth Rp780 billion amid continuing losses
body: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk acquired six land and building assets—including Plaza Gresik, Sinar Matahari Bogor, Mega M Kedung Badak, Gedoeng Merah ex Matahari Malioboro, a residential complex in Gayungan, and land in Balaraja—from sellers PT Panca Megah Utama, PT Surya Asri Lestari, PT Nusa Malioboro Indah, PT Citra Cito Perkasa and PT Balaraja Sentosa for a total of about Rp780 billion. The deal follows the retailer’s 2025 financial results showing a net loss of Rp152.21 billion, higher than the Rp118.1 billion loss in 2024, extending a nine‑year streak of losses and leaving equity in deficit.

title: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk partners with iForte Energi Nusantara to launch Java’s largest hybrid rooftop solar plant for manufacturing
body: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk (Spindo) has signed a strategic partnership with iForte Energi Nusantara, an entity of Djarum Grup, to install the largest rooftop hybrid solar power plant in Java, covering Plant 5 (904 kWp) and Plant 7 (5.4 MWp) with a 1 MWh battery storage system, expected to generate 9,431.31 MWh annually and cut carbon emissions by 8,488 tons per year. The project uses iForte’s Solar OPEX model with zero upfront capex and adds to existing rooftop PV at Plants 1‑3 (2.1 MWp) that already saves 2,806 tons of CO₂ annually.

title: PT Blue Bird Tbk plans phased electric vehicle fleet expansion in 2026, reporting 10.6% profit rise in Q3 2025
body: PT Blue Bird Tbk will increase its low‑emission fleet with more electric taxis, rentals and buses, adding vehicles gradually through 2026 based on each city’s charging infrastructure and market demand, while also optimizing its CNG fleet. For the quarter ended 30 September 2025, the company posted a net profit of Rp482.59 billion, up 10.60%, and revenue of Rp4.11 trillion, up 12.29% year‑on‑year.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk raises Antam gold buyback price to Rp2,694,000 per gram on Feb 19, 2026
body: On Thursday, Feb 19 2026, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's Antam gold buyback price rose by Rp5,000 to Rp2,694,000 per gram, with the LBMA‑certified bullion priced in line with global gold movements. Transactions above Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) PPh 22 tax, and buyers must provide NIK as their NPWP per the latest finance ministry regulation.

title: OJK and Bursa Efek Indonesia launch reforms to boost market credibility after MSCI freezes Indonesia rebalancing
body: Following MSCI's decision to freeze rebalancing of Indonesian stocks, Otoritas Jasa Keuangan and Bursa Efek Indonesia are introducing four key measures—including raising the minimum free float to 15% by March 2026, publishing shareholdings above 1%, expanding investor classifications in the Single Investor Identification system, and mandating governance training for listed companies—while Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia supports the changes. The regulator aims to improve market depth, transparency, and investor confidence both domestically and internationally.

title: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk signs Rp54.5 billion land purchase agreement with PT Balaraja Sentosa
body: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk signed a land sale and purchase agreement with PT Balaraja Sentosa to acquire 38,169 m² in Balaraja for Rp54.5 billion, pending fulfillment of contractual conditions. For FY2025 the company posted net sales of Rp7.25 trillion (up 1.9%), gross profit of Rp1.26 trillion (up 2.8%), operating profit of Rp26 billion (down 23.1%) and a net loss of Rp152.19 billion, widening from the prior year.

title: Indonesia’s February SUN auction records lowest demand in 2026 as incoming bids drop to Rp63 trillion
body: The February 18, 2026 auction of nine series of Indonesian government bonds attracted Rp63.06 trillion in incoming bids, the lowest level of the year and down from Rp76.6 trillion in early February, with the government awarding Rp40 trillion of bonds, led by series FR0109 and FR0108. Analysts from KB Valbury Sekuritas and BNI Sekuritas pointed to domestic macro‑economic pressures and Moody's Ratings shifting its outlook to negative as factors behind the weaker appetite, while non‑resident investors have bought a net Rp4.21 trillion since the start of the year.

title: Indonesia's IHSG poised to test 8,360 resistance amid global risk‑on sentiment and upcoming BI rate decision
body: The Jakarta Stock Exchange Composite Index (IHSG) is expected to push toward the 8,360 resistance level on Thursday, supported by positive global market sentiment, a narrowing Japan trade deficit and anticipation of Bank Indonesia’s rate‑setting meeting. Meanwhile, Indonesia’s external debt rose to US$431.7 billion in Q4 2025 and Sinarmas Sekuritas recommends PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk launches world's first commercial 1.4 GHz 5G Fixed Wireless Access service in Indonesia
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) through its subsidiary PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama began commercial operations of the IRA 5G Fixed Wireless Access service on 19 Feb 2026, aiming to deploy 5,500 sites across Java, Maluku and Papua and reach more than 5 million customers with unlimited 100 Mbps broadband priced at Rp100,000 per month and free installation. The service leverages the 1.4 GHz spectrum for superior indoor penetration, integrating with Surge’s national fiber backbone for robust backhaul.

title: Lebaran 2026 consumer stocks poised for growth on fiscal stimulus and rising consumer confidence
body: Consumer stocks such as PT Mayora Indah Tbk, PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk and PT Ultra Jaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk are expected to benefit from a surge in household spending during the Lebaran 2026 period, supported by a government fiscal stimulus of Rp13 trillion and a rise in the Consumer Confidence Index to 127 in January. Analysts forecast a 15‑20% boost in household consumption, translating to an average 8.6% YoY EPS increase for the consumer sector in 2026.

title: Jakarta Composite Index climbs 1.19% to 8,310.23 as large‑cap stocks lead gains and analysts flag wave targets
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) rose 1.19% to 8,310.23 on Feb 18, 2026, driven by gains in PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk (+12%), PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk (+3.94%), PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk (+2.81%) and other large‑cap stocks such as PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk and PT Astra International Tbk. MNC Securities noted that if IHSG holds above 8,172 it could advance toward the 8,377‑8,440 wave target, while warning of a possible correction to 8,098‑8,155, and highlighted recommended picks for the day including BUVA (+8.61%), COIN (+4.52%), INET (+11.98%) and PANI (+0.93%).

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk plans to acquire 45% of PT Trimitra Coal Perkasa for Rp1.6 trillion in Q3 2026
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk announced it will acquire a 45% stake in PT Trimitra Coal Perkasa for approximately Rp1.6 trillion, using a share‑swap inbreng mechanism and a DCF valuation based on a conservative US$26 per ton coal price. The deal, slated for Q3 2026, does not change the controlling shareholders and follows an independent resource estimate of 693.7 million tons and a standby buyer Argo Energy Pte Ltd of the Banpu Group.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk launches world’s first 1.4 GHz 5G Fixed Wireless Access service, Internet Rakyat, targeting 5,500 sites and 5 million users by 2026
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk, operating as Surge, and its subsidiary PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama, launched the commercial phase of Internet Rakyat (IRA), the world’s first 1.4 GHz 5G Fixed Wireless Access service, with a target of 5,500 active sites and over 5 million customers in Java, Maluku and Papua by 2026. IRA offers up to 100 Mbps download at a flat monthly price of Rp100,000 with free installation and modem rental, meeting the government’s 100 Mbps, max‑price Rp147,000 guideline.

title: Lebaran 2026 and government stimulus are expected to lift Indonesia's consumer sector and drive EPS growth
body: The upcoming Lebaran 2026, backed by a government fiscal stimulus of Rp13 trillion and a January Consumer Confidence Index of 127, is projected to raise household consumption by 15‑20% and lift consumer‑sector EPS by about 8.6% YoY, according to analysts from KISI and Sinarmas Sekuritas. Analysts recommend buying PT Ultra Jaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk, PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk, PT Mayora Indah Tbk, PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Indosat Tbk and also assign target prices of Rp2,440 for PT Mayora Indah Tbk, Rp550 for PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk and Rp2,050 for PT Matahari Department Store Tbk.

title: Indonesia palm‑oil stocks surge ahead of Ramadan as CPO reference price rises
body: Indonesia’s palm‑oil stocks rallied on Feb 18, 2026 as strong demand ahead of Ramadan lifted CPO prices, with PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk jumping 20.81% to Rp1,045, PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk up 10.61% to Rp146 and PT Bakrie Sumatera Plantations Tbk gaining 9.70% to Rp362, while PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk fell 9.24% to Rp7,125. The Ministry of Trade raised the CPO reference price for 1‑28 Feb 2026 to US$918.47 per metric ton, a 0.31% increase driven by higher demand and lower production.

title: PT Estika Tata Tiara Tbk imports 250 dairy cows and launches new dairy, buffalo and cold‑storage ventures to support Indonesia’s free nutritious meals program
body: PT Estika Tata Tiara Tbk received 250 imported dairy cows through a partnership with PT Lunar Chemplast to help meet the government’s Makan Bergizi Gratis target, and announced new dairy, buffalo‑fattening and commercial cold‑storage activities that are projected to generate sales of Rp83.33 billion in 2026 and Rp180.76 billion in 2027. The expansion will cost Rp319.37 billion, financed with 60% bank loans and 40% equity.

title: Danantara Indonesia restores state-owned status to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk under new BUMN law
body: Danantara Indonesia, following Law No 16/2025, transferred 99% of the shares of PT Aneka Tambang Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk to its holding MIND ID while the state retains a 1% dual‑class Seri A Dwiwarna stake to keep them classified as BUMN, COO Dony Oskaria said. He added that the change secures mining licences and other rights and is unrelated to the formation of PT Perusahaan Mineral Nasional.

title: Indonesia's IHSG targets 9,000 as analysts cite earnings growth and macro catalysts
body: IHSG regained strength after a late‑January dip, and analysts from KISI Sekuritas and Pilarmas Investindo Sekuritas say the 9,000 target is ambitious but attainable with 8% EPS growth and stable macro conditions, citing fiscal absorption, Lebaran momentum and cost‑of‑fund normalization; they also note strong resistance at 8,350 and potential support from MSCI, government actions and expected Fed rate cuts. The firms recommend buying BBNI, BMRI, ICBP, AMRT and TLKM.

title: Indonesia launches Rp33 trillion sovereign bond auction as rising risk premiums prompt calls for tenor and currency diversification
body: On Feb 18 2026, the Indonesian government offered nine new SUN series totaling Rp33 trillion with coupon rates from 5.87% to 6.875% amid higher bond‑market risk and a recent Moody’s outlook downgrade. Analysts from KB Valbury Sekuritas and PT Anugerah Sekuritas Indonesia said investors now demand higher yields, urging diversification of tenor and non‑rupiah issuances to manage currency risk, while market sentiment has begun to stabilize after an initial outflow.

title: Jakarta Court Declares Bankruptcy of PT Dos Ni Roha, ZBRA Pursues Settlement Plan
body: The Jakarta Central Commercial Court issued a bankruptcy ruling for PT Dos Ni Roha on 14 January 2026 after the company failed to obtain creditor approval for a permanent PKPU extension. ZBRA and PT Dosni Roha Indonesia Tbk are focusing on a debt‑restructuring proposal supported by the appointed curators, noting that the ruling does not automatically render ZBRA insolvent or halt its operations, and the matter also involves PT Zebra Nusantara Tbk as the former name of ZBRA.

title: Fitch projects resilient credit ratings for Indonesian BUMNs despite higher dividend payouts and shift to shareholder‑loan financing
body: Fitch Ratings says Indonesia’s state‑owned enterprises will keep a strong credit profile despite an expected rise in dividend payout ratios to the sovereign wealth fund Danantara, with total BUMN dividend receipts projected at over Rp140 trillion in 2025. The agency notes a shift toward selective shareholder‑loan financing through PT Danantara Investment Management, affecting firms such as PT Hutama Karya Persero, PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Krakatau Steel Persero Tbk, while President Prabowo targets a 7% ROA for Danantara.

title: PT Mercury Strategic Indonesia launches a mandatory tender offer for up to 73% of PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk shares, valuing the deal at up to Rp1.07 trillion
body: PT Mercury Strategic Indonesia announced a mandatory tender offer to acquire up to 5,851 billion shares (73.13%) of PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk at Rp183 per share, representing a maximum commitment of about Rp1.07 trillion. The offer, covering the period 19 February to 20 March 2026, follows its recent purchase of a 26.87% stake from PT Karunia Berkah Jayasejahtera and aims to strengthen control and support future business development.

title: PT Modern Internasional Tbk partners with PT Dirgantara Indonesia and Genertec to develop advanced smart-factory CNC system
body: PT Modern Internasional Tbk announced a strategic partnership with PT Dirgantara Indonesia and Genertec to design and implement an advanced smart factory CNC system aimed at boosting precision, operational efficiency, and digital integration for PT Dirgantara Indonesia's aerospace manufacturing. Modern Internasional will handle implementation, optimization, training, and long‑term after‑sales support while Genertec supplies the cutting‑edge CNC technology.

title: RMK Energy posts strong early‑2026 growth in coal hauling and trading, boosting volumes and profits
body: In January 2026 RMK Energy’s coal hauling services surged 9.26‑times to 167.5 k tons and barge loading reached 703 k tons, while coal sales rose fourfold to 513.6 k tons, driven by new clients PT Wiraduta Sejahtera Langgeng, PT Duta Bara Utama and PT Menambang Muara Enim. The company also reported Q4 2025 revenue of about IDR 1.1 trillion and net profit of IDR 105 billion, indicating continued financial improvement.

title: PT Bukit Asam Tbk advances coal transport capacity with 80.81% completed CHF and TLS projects financed by IDR 3.56 trillion
body: PT Bukit Asam Tbk, which produces 43 million tons of coal annually and aims for 100 million tons within three to four years, is constructing a Coal Handling Facility and Train Loading Stations 6‑7 on the Tanjung Enim–Kramasan route, now 80.81% complete and adding up to 20 million tons of transport capacity. The project is funded by IDR 3.56 trillion from three state‑owned banks (HIMBARA) and supported by MIND ID to bolster Indonesia’s national energy security.

title: PT Dizamatra Powerindo breaks ground on 120‑meter flyover to separate coal traffic from public roads in Muara Enim
body: PT Dizamatra Powerindo began construction of a 120‑meter flyover over the Palembang–Prabumulih highway in Talang Taling Village, aiming to divert coal logistics away from public roads. The groundbreaking was attended by Muara Enim Regent H. Edison and South Sumatra provincial officials, who highlighted the project’s alignment with government policy to protect community road use.

title: PT Darma Henwa Tbk plans IDR 450 bn gold expansion and reports strong 2025 earnings, maintaining a Buy rating
body: PT Darma Henwa Tbk announced a IDR 450 billion capex to expand into gold, with exploration at the Gayo mine scheduled through 2026 and a processing plant slated for 2028, while reporting Q3‑2025 revenue of IDR 4.7 trillion and net profit of IDR 239 billion. The company also secured a IDR 5 trillion syndicated loan from Bank Mandiri and BCA, extended its contract with Arutmin, and retains a Buy recommendation from Henan Putihrai Sekuritas with a target price of IDR 750 per share.

title: PT United Tractors acquires Doup gold mine from PT J Resources for $540 million
body: PT United Tractors Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara, purchased the Doup gold mine from PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk’s subsidiary PT J Resources Nusantara for USD 540 million (about IDR 8.85 trillion). PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk said the proceeds will be used to strengthen liquidity, reduce debt and fund other gold mining assets.

title: PT Borneo Indobara launches large‑scale mining electrification and green mining program on its 20th anniversary
body: PT Borneo Indobara held a “Ceremonial Electrification and Green Mining Realization” event unveiling over 150 electric and hybrid mining units and set targets to electrify 25% of its fleet by 2026, 75% by 2028 and achieve net‑zero emissions by 2028‑2029; the rollout, backed by PLN’s power supply expansion to up to 240 MVA, PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk, PT Anugrah Energi Kalimantan and BMKG weather‑modification projects, aims to cut fuel‑oil imports costing hundreds of trillions of rupiah and improve operational efficiency.

title: Abadi Kreasi Unggul boosts stake in Sinergi Inti Andalan to 58.55% after buying 125.9 million shares
body: Abadi Kreasi Unggul purchased an additional 125,925 million shares of Sinergi Inti Andalan at 377 IDR per share, spending about 47.47 billion IDR and raising its holding to 13.1 billion shares (58.55% of the company). Following the transaction, Sinergi Inti Andalan’s stock rose 11.98% to 430 IDR on 18 February 2026, up roughly 30.3% over the previous five trading days.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas to Issue Rp250 Billion Sustainable Bonds with Mixed Guarantees and Quarterly Interest Payments
body: Trimegah Sekuritas (TRIM) announced a Rp250 billion sustainable bond issuance, comprising Rp50 billion fully guaranteed and Rp200 billion best‑effort, split into Series A (Rp31 billion at 7.75% for 5 years and Rp153 billion at 7.75% for 5 years) and Series B (Rp19 billion at 8.5% for 7 years and Rp47 billion at 8.5% for 7 years) with quarterly interest payments starting 6 June 2026. The proceeds, after issuance costs, will be used for working‑capital to finance the company’s repo activities, with the public offering scheduled for 2‑3 March 2026 and bullet repayment at maturity in March 2031 (Series A) and March 2033 (Series B).

title: FKS Food posts 28% rise in 2025 net profit to Rp89.13 billion
body: FKS Food reported net profit of Rp89.13 billion for 2025, up 28.3% from Rp69.47 billion a year earlier, with earnings per share increasing to Rp9.57. Net sales reached Rp1.95 trillion, while total assets grew to Rp2.08 trillion and equity to Rp1.14 trillion.

title: Meta Epsi reports 2025 net loss of Rp2.59 billion with zero revenue
body: Meta Epsi posted a net loss of Rp2.59 billion for 2025, widening the loss per share to Rp1.24 from Rp2.38 previously, while revenue fell to zero. The company’s total assets declined to Rp72.21 billion and equity to Rp41.11 billion, reflecting a deteriorating financial position.

title: Estika Tata Tiara BEEF imports 250 dairy cows to support Indonesia's free nutritious meal program
body: On 2 February 2026, Estika Tata Tiara BEEF, in partnership with PT Lunar Chemplast, received 250 imported dairy cows at Tanjung Intan Port, Cilacap, as part of the government’s Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) program that targets 20 million beneficiaries and requires about 4 million tonnes of milk annually. The cows underwent a two‑week quarantine before being moved to the BBPTU Manggala facility in Baturaden, where the company plans to expand fresh‑milk production and secure feed supply through a 178,214 m² forage farm.

title: PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama launches world's first 1.4 GHz 5G Fixed Wireless Access service in Indonesia
body: PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama, a subsidiary of PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk, began commercial activation on 19 February 2026 of the IRA – Internet Rakyat 5G Fixed Wireless Access service operating on 1.4 GHz, offering up to 100 Mbps at a maximum price of Rp147,000 as mandated by the Ministry of Communication and Digital. The rollout targets more than 5,500 active sites in Region‑1 (Java, Maluku and Papua) and aims to reach over 5 million customers in 2026, using SURGE’s national fiber backbone for backhaul.

title: Matra Tri Abadi buy Shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk
body: Matra Tri Abadi purchased an additional 102,514,000 shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX.JK) at IDR 610 per share on 19 Feb 2026, raising its holding from 3,642,863,000 to 3,745,377,000 shares. The transaction, aimed at increasing its IRSX share ownership, represents a modest stake expansion for the shareholder.

title: Fitradityo Harjuno sell Shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk
body: Fitradityo Harjuno sold 25,000,000 shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk on 19 February 2026 at IDR 90.0 per share for personal use, reducing his holding from 227,922,100 to 202,922,100 shares. The transaction lowers his stake by 25,000,000 shares, potentially impacting his influence on the company’s governance.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sold 14,176,170 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk (HILL.JK) in a reverse repo transaction on 13‑Feb‑26 and 18‑Feb‑26, selling shares at IDR 80.0 and IDR 68.0 respectively. The sale reduced its stake from 1,390,000,000 to 1,248,238,300 shares, a decline of 141,761,700 shares. The reverse repo allows the holder to obtain liquidity while temporarily relinquishing voting rights, and it signals a tactical adjustment in the shareholder’s portfolio rather than a permanent divestiture.

title: Triputra Investindo Arya sell Shares of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk
body: Triputra Investindo Arya divested 3,841,900 shares of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI.JK) at IDR 8,789 per share on 18 February 2026, reducing its stake from 38,570,700 to 34,728,800 shares. The transaction, filed on 20 February 2026, reflects a divestment strategy and may signal a shift in the shareholder’s investment focus.

title: Aulia sell Shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk
body: Shareholder Aulia conducted transactions in PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk on 13 Feb 2026, buying 10,400,250 shares at IDR 100 per share and selling 5,450,300 shares at IDR 600 per share, resulting in a net acquisition of 4,949,950 shares. Aulia’s holding rose from 7,250,250 to 12,200,200 shares, reflecting an investment diversification motive and a material increase in ownership.

title: Elang Mahkota Teknologi buy Shares of Surya Citra Media Tbk
body: Elang Mahkota Teknologi purchased an additional 300,000,000 shares of Surya Citra Media Tbk at IDR 320 per share on 19 February 2026 for investment purposes. The stake increased from 54,750,691,340 to 55,050,691,340 shares, raising its ownership proportion in the listed company.

title: Lioe Cu Ling Se sell Shares of Indospring Tbk
body: On 18 Feb 2026, shareholder Lioe Cu Ling Se sold 30,000 Indospring Tbk (INDS.JK) shares at IDR 2,760 per share, reducing his stake from 74,500 to 44,500 shares (a decrease of 30,000 shares). The divestment lowers his ownership percentage and signals a potential reallocation of capital, but no further corporate impact is indicated.

title: Fitradityo Harjuno Sell Shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk
body: Fitradityo Harjuno sold 25,000,000 shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk (NTBK.JK) at IDR 90.0 per share on 19 February 2026 for personal use. The transaction reduced his stake from 227,922,100 to 202,922,100 shares, a net decrease of 25,000,000 shares. This sale may alter the shareholder composition and could influence voting power or dividend entitlement, though the impact on overall control remains limited given the large remaining holding.

title: Tunas Mekar Jaya Sell Shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk
body: Tunas Mekar Jaya sold 25,000,000 shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk (CBDK.JK) at IDR 6,300 per share, generating about IDR 157,500,000,000. The sale, executed on 12 February and 18 February 2026, reduced the shareholder’s holding from 77,519,380 to 52,519,380 shares, a 32.3% decrease. The divestment is aimed at realizing investment value, allowing the investor to redeploy capital. The transaction may affect liquidity and shareholder composition, but the company retains a substantial minority stake.

title: Antam gold prices rise across all sizes on Feb 20 2026
body: Antam's gold prices increased on Friday, Feb 20, 2026, with the 1,000‑gram bar reaching Rp2.88 billion and smaller sizes also up by Rp14,000‑Rp56,000, while the buyback price rose to Rp2,725 million. Transactions are subject to PPh 22 tax of 1.5%‑3% on sell‑backs above Rp10 million and 0.45%‑0.9% on purchases, with tax withheld at source.

title: Aninditha Anestya Bakrie buy Shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk
body: Aninditha Anestya Bakrie, a controlling shareholder of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk (ALII.JK), executed a net sell of 9,883,450 shares on 13 Feb 2026, reducing her stake from 318,495,900 to 308,612,450 shares (a decline of about 3.1%). The transaction included a purchase of 7,450,300 shares at IDR 600 per share and a sale of 17,333,750 shares at IDR 100 per share, representing a performance‑based incentive allocation from controlling shareholders to the board and senior management after the recent IDX listing. The allocation is not funded by the company and reflects a redistribution of insider ownership.

title: PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk reports 68.8% increase in 2025 net profit
body: PT Panin Sekuritas Tbk posted a net profit attributable to the parent of Rp191.05 billion in 2025, up 68.80% from the prior year, with revenue rising 27.07% to Rp469.09 billion and EPS climbing to Rp268.55. The firm’s total assets grew 31.80% to Rp2.63 trillion, liabilities surged 122.20% to Rp990.02 billion, equity rose 5.81% to Rp1.64 trillion, and its shares gained 6.9% to Rp1,705.

title: Indonesia's composite index slips 0.16% as most conglomerate stocks fall and Djarum‑linked shares lead modest gains
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) slipped 0.16% to 8,261.15 in the first session on Friday, with 425 stocks down, 261 up and 272 unchanged, while most conglomerate‑linked shares such as PT Darma Henwa Tbk, PT Bumi Resources Tbk and PT Bakrieland Development Tbk fell, and only PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (+9.65%) and PT Bakrie Sumatera Plantations Tbk (+4.44%) among the Bakrie group managed to rise. Gains were led by Djarum‑affiliated stocks including PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Remala Abadi Tbk, PT Supra Boga Lestari Tbk and PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk, as Bank Indonesia held the policy rate at 4.75% and Indonesia and the United States signed 11 strategic agreements worth $38.4 billion.

title: Bank Indonesia Holds Rate at 4.75% Boosting Fixed‑Income Fund Outlook, Manulife Aset Manajemen Indonesia Says Demand Remains Strong
body: Bank Indonesia kept the BI Rate at 4.75%, which the CIO of Manulife Aset Manajemen Indonesia, Ezra Nazula, says supports market sentiment and a solid growth outlook for fixed‑income mutual funds in 2026. He notes strong demand for such funds, the possibility of future rate cuts, a temporary Moody’s outlook downgrade, and cites industry assets under management reaching Rp706.37 billion in January 2026, up 3.99% from the previous month.

title: PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk partners with Bank Central Asia to integrate Ultra Voucher digital services into myBCA for BCA Expoversary 2026
body: PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk (UVCR) announced a collaboration with Bank Central Asia to embed its Ultra Voucher digital voucher platform into the myBCA app for the BCA Expoversary 2026, aiming to provide seamless, flexible and cost‑effective transactions. The firm also outlined its 2026 strategy to expand the Ultra Voucher Gift Card across more than 30 merchant brands and achieve full integration with national bank EDC networks, including BCA’s.

title: Bob Budiono Buy Shares of Indospring Tbk
body: Bob Budiono purchased 100,000 shares of Indospring Tbk (INDS.JK) at IDR 2,440 per share, totaling IDR 244,000,000. His holding rose from 2,020 to 102,020 shares, a net increase of 100,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding his ownership stake in the company.

title: Indonesia's Bisnis-27 index opens higher as rate hold and trade deal lift market sentiment
body: On Friday the Bisnis-27 index rose 0.76% to 544.95, supported by gains in PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Astra International Tbk and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, while the broader IHSG climbed 0.59% to 8,322 as Bank Indonesia kept the BI Rate at 4.75% and Indonesia‑US trade talks reduced tariffs on Indonesian products. Phintraco Securities expects the market to trade sideways between 8,200 and 8,350, and the agreement includes 11 MoUs worth $38.4 billion covering minerals, energy, agribusiness, textiles and semiconductors.

title: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk reports CA-EDC plant construction at 50% with commercial start targeted for Q1 2027
body: The company said its Chlor-Alkali/Ethylene Dichloride (CA-EDC) facility, built by subsidiary PT Chandra Asri Alkali in Cilegon, has reached 50% of construction and entered the peak‑construction phase, aiming for commercial operation in the first quarter of 2027. Upon full operation, the plant will produce about 827,000 t of caustic soda and 500,000 t of EDC annually, potentially substituting imports worth US$293 million and generating export earnings of roughly US$300 million, while creating up to 250 new jobs.

title: Phintraco Sekuritas Initiates Coverage of PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk with Buy Rating and Rp8,700 Target
body: Phintraco Sekuritas launched coverage of PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk, issuing a buy rating with a target price of Rp8,700 per share (implying P/E 9.39x and P/BV 5.12x) based on discounted cash flow and relative valuation, citing expected revenue growth from the start of Phase 8 mining at Batu Hijau, which adds 460 million tonnes of reserves and extends the mine life to 2030. The stock rose 1.99% to Rp7,675, up 19.46% YTD, while Bloomberg’s consensus of eight analysts gives a target of Rp8,080, suggesting a potential 5.3% upside, with risks including Phase 8 execution delays, commodity price volatility, and downstream project costs.

title: Weak ORI029 retail bond sales prompt calls for coupon and schedule adjustments
body: The ORI029 retail government bond fell short of its sales target, achieving only 57.96% of the planned Rp24.5 trillion, with about Rp10.51 trillion still unsold ten minutes before the deadline (ORI029‑T3 27% and ORI029‑T6 65.1% of their targets). Analysts, including Pefindo’s Suhindarto, urged the Ministry of Finance’s DJPPR to align issuance timing with maturing bonds and offer more competitive floating‑coupon rates, noting that AAA‑rated three‑year corporate bonds yield 5.87%, only 42 bps above ORI029‑T3, and that PT Bibit Tumbuh Bersama reported the distribution data.

title: Ramadan 2026 expected to boost inflows to Indonesia's sharia market amid sector rotation and modest index declines
body: Ramadan 2026 is projected to act as a positive catalyst for capital inflows into Indonesia’s sharia equity market, with investors rotating into high‑compliance consumer, infrastructure, commodity and energy stocks, while the ISSI has fallen 3.85% YTD to 296.73 versus a 3.89% drop in the broader IHSG. KISI Sekuritas recommends PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk and PT Mayora Indah Tbk in the consumer segment and also highlights PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, TLKM, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT DCI Indonesia Tbk as attractive despite premium valuations.

title: Bank Indonesia Holds Policy Rate at 4.75% as Market Anticipates Stable Outlook
body: Bank Indonesia kept the BI Rate at 4.75% and maintained the Deposit Facility at 3.75% and Lending Facility at 5.5% in its February 18‑19 meeting, providing certainty for the IDX. Analysts at KISI Sekuritas highlighted that large banks such as PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, property developers PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk, PT Ciputra Development Tbk, PT Astra International Tbk, and consumer firms PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk and PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk remain attractive, supporting a potential move of the index toward 9,000.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased a total of 1,912,500 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares between 13 and 19 February 2026 for investment purposes, at prices ranging from IDR 1,460 to IDR 1,550 per share (representative price IDR 1,500). His holding rose from 204,582,722 to 206,495,222 shares, increasing his stake by 0.94%. The sizeable buy underscores confidence in the cybersecurity firm and may support the stock’s liquidity and price.

title: IHSG expected to test 8,227 support as Indonesia‑US strategic deals boost market outlook
