body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is projected to test the 8,227 support level, trading within 8,227‑8,170 support and 8,352‑8,408 resistance, while Bank Indonesia kept its policy rate at 4.75%. Indonesia and the United States signed 11 strategic agreements worth $38.4 billion across mining, energy, textiles and technology, which Sinarmas Sekuritas sees as a medium‑term catalyst, and the firm recommends a hold on PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange suspends trading of PT Hillcon Tbk shares due to significant price drop
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) halted trading of PT Hillcon Tbk shares on February 20, 2026, after the stock fell 14.71% to Rp58, reflecting a 62.09% decline year‑to‑date. The suspension, applied to both the regular and cash markets, is intended to give investors time to evaluate information amid unusual market activity.

title: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk plans up to 24 billion-share rights issue and Rp780 billion asset acquisitions
body: PT Matahari Putra Prima Tbk announced a rights issue (PMHMETD VIII) of up to 24 billion new shares at a nominal Rp50 each, with controlling shareholder PT Multipolar Tbk committing to fully exercise its rights and act as standby buyer for up to 7.56 billion shares, aiming to raise capital for expansion. The acquisitions, valued at about Rp780 billion, involve purchases from PT Panca Megah Utama, PT Surya Asri Lestari, PT Nusa Malioboro Indah, PT Citra Cito Perkasa and PT Balaraja Sentosa across several cities.

title: Indonesia’s exchange and regulator push free‑float boost and UBO disclosure amid MSCI freeze
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia and Otoritas Jasa Keuangan are drafting rules to raise the free‑float minimum to 15% and require public disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners holding more than 1% after MSCI placed an interim freeze on Indonesian stocks; Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia will expand investor classifications and BEI will mandate good‑corporate‑governance training for listed‑company directors and committees.

title: Mirae Asset recommends JPFA as Indonesian poultry stocks show mixed performance during Ramadan
body: On Feb 19, 2026, PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk fell 3.12% to Rp2,480 (down 5.34% YTD), PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk was unchanged, PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk rose 1.29%, PT Widodo Makmur Unggas Tbk gained 4.29% (up 19.67% YTD) and PT Sreeya Sewu Indonesia Tbk edged up 0.31% (up 42.22% YTD). Mirae Asset analyst M Nafan Aji Gusta reiterated a buy recommendation on JPFA with a target price of Rp3,100, citing expected Ramadan-driven domestic demand and continued smart‑money interest.

title: Indonesia's Sharia Stock Index shows modest recovery potential ahead of Ramadan, with select undervalued stocks recommended
body: The Indonesia Sharia Stock Index (ISSI) has fallen 3.85% year‑to‑date to 296.73, slightly outperforming the broader IHSG which is down 3.89% to 8,310.22, and analysts expect Ramadan‑driven seasonal sentiment to boost retail buying of discounted sharia stocks. Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia recommends buying PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk with a target price of 10,125 IDR, PT Adaro Energy Indonesia Tbk with a target price of 2,550 IDR, and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk with a target price of 7,625 IDR as undervalued opportunities.

title: Bank Indonesia Holds BI Rate at 4.75% as IHSG Falls and Market Watches Fed Minutes
body: Bank Indonesia kept its benchmark BI Rate unchanged at 4.75%, and the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed down 0.44% at 8,274 with 384 stocks losing ground and 341 gaining. Analyst Maximilianus Nico Demus of Pilarmas Investindo Sekuritas said the move is neutral for equities, noted Fed minutes hint at possible rate hikes but also point to easing US inflation and a stabilising labour market that could allow a 50‑basis‑point Fed cut this year, and recommended consumer, energy, infrastructure and property stocks ahead of Idulfitri.

title: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk says its Cilegon chlor‑alkali/ethylene dichloride plant reaches 50% completion and targets Q1 2027 commercial start‑up
body: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk reported that its subsidiary PT Chandra Asri Alkali’s chlor‑alkali/ethylene dichloride plant in Cilegon is 50% complete, now in peak‑progress phase and slated for commercial operation in the first quarter of 2027 as part of Chandra Asri Group’s long‑term strategy. The plant will produce 827,000 t of soda caustic and 500,000 t of EDC per year, potentially substituting imports worth about USD 293 million and generating export earnings of roughly USD 300 million, while creating around 3,000 construction jobs and about 250 permanent positions.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange suspends trading of PT Hillcon Tbk and PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk amid extreme volatility
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia temporarily halted trading of PT Hillcon Tbk and PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk on 20 February 2026, citing a need to cool down markets and protect investors. PT Hillcon Tbk’s shares have fallen about 66% in the past month and 86% year‑on‑year after Hillcon Equity Management cut its stake, while PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk’s price surged 174% in a month and 1,596% year‑on‑year, leading to four suspensions and a transition to the Full Call Auction board.

title: Pefindo downgrades Wijaya Karya’s bond rating to idD after coupon default, maintains corporate rating at idSD
body: Indonesia’s rating agency Pefindo lowered the rating of Wijaya Karya’s bonds to idD from idCCC following a missed coupon payment due on 18 February 2026, while keeping the company’s overall rating at idSD and retaining other bond and sukuk ratings at idD. The downgrade reflects the firm’s weak financial and liquidity profile, and Pefindo said it could reassess the rating if Wijaya Karya fulfills its principal, interest and sukuk obligations.

title: Ultra Voucher and Bank Central Asia expand digital voucher integration for BCA Expoversary 2026
body: Ultra Voucher, part of Trimegah Karya Pratama, deepened its strategic partnership with Bank Central Asia (BCA) by integrating its digital voucher service into the myBCA app for the BCA Expoversary 2026 event, enabling seamless F&B purchases for attendees. The collaboration highlights Ultra Voucher’s role as a B2B voucher solution provider supporting large‑scale digital payment ecosystems.

title: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia reduces its Hillcon stake by 133.96 million shares
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia sold 133.96 million Hillcon shares at Rp80 per share, spending roughly Rp10.71 billion and cutting its holding to 3.0 billion shares (20.35% of the company). After the transaction Hillcon traded at Rp58 per share, down 14.71% on the day and about 62.09% since the start of 2026 when it was Rp153.

title: PT Exploitasi Energi Indonesia Tbk strengthens group capital with a Rp212.5 billion injection into PT Sekti Rahayu Indah
body: PT Energi Batubara Indonesia completed a capital increase of Rp212,520,000,000 in its subsidiary PT Sekti Rahayu Indah, raising the subsidiary’s total paid‑in capital to Rp248.22 billion. The transaction gives PT Energi Batubara Indonesia a 99.88% stake (495,840 shares) in PT Sekti Rahayu Indah.

title: Indonesia's composite index falls 0.44% as Bank Indonesia holds rate at 4.75%
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed down 0.44% at 8,274, with 384 stocks declining, as Bank Indonesia kept the BI Rate at 4.75% and investors awaited credit growth data. Major weighted losers included PT Astra International Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk and PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk.

title: PT Timah changes name to PT Timah Persero Tbk after BUMN law amendment
body: PT Timah Persero Tbk announced that its legal name changed from PT Timah Tbk to PT Timah Persero Tbk effective 13 February 2026, following a special shareholders meeting that amended its articles to comply with Indonesia’s new Law No 16/2025 on State‑Owned Enterprises. The restructuring mirrors similar changes at PT Aneka Tambang Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk, where Danantara Indonesia now holds 99 % of shares while the state retains a 1 % dual‑color share, keeping the firms within the MIND ID holding.

title: Indonesia's stock exchange estimates Rp187 trillion needed to lift free‑float to 15% for 267 issuers amid phased regulatory rollout
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia estimates that about Rp187 trillion of market capitalisation from 267 listed issuers must be absorbed to raise the free‑float from the current 7.5% to the new minimum of 15%, with the regulator OJK planning a phased implementation over at least three years and a rule expected by March 2026. The exchange's average free‑float is 23.9%, lower than regional peers, and OJK officials said a 10% target would need roughly Rp21 trillion while a 15% target would require about Rp203 trillion.

title: Pefindo upgrades PP Properti rating to idB, covering its Sustainable Bonds
body: Pefindo raised PP Properti's rating from idCCC to idB with a stable outlook, and the upgrade also applies to its Sustainable Bonds II Stage I, III and IV following the homologation decision and registration with the Indonesian Central Securities Depository on 10 February 2026. The agency highlighted the company's weak financial profile and macro‑economic sensitivity, noting that the rating could improve with successful operational restructuring, significant EBITDA growth and cash from asset sales, while a downgrade would occur if obligations are not met; PT PP holds 64.96% of PP Properti, the public 34.97%, and Yayasan Kesejahteraan Karyawan Pembangunan Perumahan 0.07%.

title: Adira Finance ADMF posts 2025 profit of Rp1.54 trillion, down 15% year‑on‑year
body: Adira Finance ADMF reported 2025 profit of Rp1.54 trillion, a 14.91% decline from 2024’s Rp1.81 trillion, with earnings per share falling to Rp1,253 from Rp1,538. Revenue rose 2.88% to Rp12.12 trillion, total assets grew to Rp38.52 trillion, equity increased to Rp15.03 trillion, and liabilities decreased to Rp23.49 trillion.

title: Matahari Putra Prima to launch 24 billion‑share right issue with Multipolar as standby buyer
body: Matahari Putra Prima will issue 24 billion new shares at a nominal Rp50, with Multipolar acting as the main shareholder and standby buyer and able to absorb up to 7,5664 billion unsold shares. The proceeds will fund acquisitions of properties from Citra Cito Perkasa, Panca Megah Utama, Surya Asri Lestari, Nusa Malioboro Indah and Balaraja Sentosa, as well as working capital and subsidiary financing, pending approval at the extraordinary shareholders meeting on 30 March 2026.

title: Dragonmine Mining Hong Kong Limited signs conditional agreement to acquire 80% of Berkah Prima Perkasa BLUE
body: Dragonmine Mining Hong Kong Limited signed a conditional share purchase agreement on 18 February 2026 to acquire 334.4 million shares (80%) of Berkah Prima Perkasa BLUE from existing shareholders including Herman Tansri, Siek Agung Guntoro, Fajar Tasrif, Rudy Tasrif and PT Cetak Biru Kapital. The deal, subject to due‑diligence and a mandatory tender under POJK 9/2018, has not impacted operations and the stock rose to Rp6,700, up 0.74% after a six‑month gain of over 2,000%.

title: PT Autopedia Sukses Lestari Tbk projects strong used‑car demand and double‑digit sales growth ahead of 2026 Mudik Lebaran
body: PT Autopedia Sukses Lestari Tbk expects a surge in used‑car demand before the 2026 Mudik Lebaran season and is expanding stock and digital channels to capture the market. The company reported a 15% year‑on‑year revenue rise to Rp713 billion and net profit of Rp33.9 billion through Q3 2025, and targets double‑digit sales growth in 2026.

title: Foreign investors buy net Rp15.1bn of PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk as stock rises 25.5% in February 2026
body: Foreign investors accumulated a net purchase of about Rp15.1 billion in PT Asuransi Tugu Pratama Indonesia Tbk during February 2026, driving the stock up 25.5% to around Rp1,450 per share. Analysts from Phillip Sekuritas Indonesia highlighted solid earnings expectations, an attractive 5‑6% dividend yield, high liquidity and a low 0.5× price‑to‑book valuation, noting the backing of parent PT Pertamina as a further catalyst.

title: Rejuve Global Investment raises its stake in PT Pyridam Farma Tbk to 64.02% after buying 430 million shares
body: Rejuve Global Investment Pte Ltd purchased 430,083,171 shares of PT Pyridam Farma Tbk at Rp405 per share, valuing the transaction at roughly Rp174.18 billion and increasing its ownership from 60.45% to 64.02%. On the following trading day, PT Pyridam Farma Tbk shares rose 6.64% to about Rp450.

title: Indonesia Secures Zero‑Tariff Access for 1,819 Product Lines to the United States
body: Minister Airlangga Hartarto announced that 1,819 Indonesian product tariff lines, including palm oil, coffee, cocoa, spices, rubber, electronics and aircraft components, will receive 0% import duty in the US under the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade. A separate zero‑tariff scheme for textiles and apparel will apply through a tariff‑rate‑quota linked to Indonesia’s imports of cotton and man‑made fibers, benefiting millions of workers.

title: Indonesia launches 2025‑2030 National Blue Carbon Action Plan to protect mangroves and seagrass, covering 17% of global blue carbon
body: The government unveiled the National Blue Carbon Action Plan (RENAKSI) 2025‑2030, aiming to safeguard 3.45 million hectares of mangroves and 660 000 hectares of seagrass, which together hold about 17% of the world’s blue‑carbon reserves. The plan, coordinated by the Ministry of Food and the National Blue Carbon Action Partnership with a GEDSI‑focused financing framework, will be implemented through cross‑sector coordination of 21 action items into priority programs.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk pays Rp11.5 billion down payment for 45% stake in PT Trimata Coal Perkasa
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk announced it has paid a down‑payment of Rp11.5 billion to PT Trimata Coal Perkasa on 12 February 2026, bringing total funds transferred to Rp12 billion after a prior Rp500 million contribution from its controlling shareholders. The amount will be deducted from the final acquisition price to be set by a public appraisal office, and a guarantee ensures the funds will be returned if the transaction is not completed.

title: Indonesian hotel group NATO rebrands as PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk after share takeover and board reshuffle
body: Following a crossing share transaction of 2.15 billion NATO shares worth Rp393.45 billion that transferred ownership from PT Karunia Berkah Jayasejahtera to PT Mercury Strategic Indonesia, the hotel operator formerly known as PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk officially renamed itself PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk. The extraordinary shareholders’ meeting also approved a board reshuffle, appointing Mauritz Nainggolan as President Director, reinstating former President Director Gede Putu Adnawa as a director, while Sayid Anwar Hasan remains Chief Commissioner and Benedictus Calvin Ardisa replaces Hotrin Tua Situmorang as independent commissioner.

title: PT Indospring Tbk targets fastener market expansion and export growth amid automotive sector outlook
body: PT Indospring Tbk has begun commercial production of U‑Bolt fasteners in 2025, aiming to make the line a core growth pillar by focusing on the automotive aftermarket, expanding into non‑automotive fasteners and seeking a top‑three domestic market position. The company is concentrating on exports to the UAE, Uzbekistan and the United States, reported net sales of Rp 2.46 trillion in Q3‑2025 and expects the rising Indonesian car market (projected 850,000 units in 2026) to boost demand.

title: Director Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sells 73,700 PT Bayan Resources Tbk shares for about Rp1.06 billion in February 2026
body: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng, director of PT Bayan Resources Tbk, sold a total of 73,700 shares in three transactions during February 2026 for approximately Rp1.06 billion, reducing his stake from 617,600 to 530,900 shares. BYAN shares edged up 0.53% to Rp14,300 on 19 February.

title: Indonesia and the United States Agree to Zero‑Tariff Quota for Selected Indonesian Textiles and Garments
body: The two governments signed an Agreement on Reciprocal Trade that grants a 0 % tariff on a quota‑based volume of Indonesian textile and apparel imports, linked to the amount of cotton and man‑made fiber Indonesia purchases from the U.S. The deal also exempts 1,819 Indonesian product lines—including palm oil, coffee, cocoa, spices, rubber, electronics and aircraft components—from the standard 19 % U.S. tariff, and will take effect 90 days after legislative approval in both countries.

title: Indonesia and Freeport-McMoRan sign $20 billion MoU to extend Grasberg mining contract through 2061
body: Indonesia's Investment Minister Rosan Roeslani said a MoU with US miner Freeport-McMoRan commits $20 billion in investment to extend the Grasberg IUPK from 2041 to 2061. The agreement is projected to generate $10 billion of annual revenue and is tied to broader US‑Indonesia deals for $15 billion in energy purchases, $13.5 billion in Boeing aircraft, and over $4.5 billion in agricultural products.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 12 Feb 2026, shareholder Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased 166,900 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares at IDR 1,512 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 206,495,222 to 206,662,122 shares, a net increase of 166,900 shares, reflecting a modest stake expansion and confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan sold a total of 5,853,400 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK) at approximately IDR 76 per share, reducing his holding from 953,724,300 to 947,870,900 shares. The transaction, reported on 20 Feb 2026, is a reduction of the number of shares and represents a modest decrease in the shareholder’s stake without immediate impact on control.

title: Jakarta Stock Index Gains 0.72% as Large‑Cap Stocks Lead Weekly Rise
body: The IHSG rose 0.72% to 8,271.76 on Friday, boosted by strong weekly gains from PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (+4.64%), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (+4.64% implied), and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, which together contributed over 30 points to the index. Trading activity increased, with daily transaction frequency up 11.99% to 3.06 million and foreign investors turning to a net weekly purchase of Rp2.07 trillion after a prior net sell.

title: MSCI warning triggers broad market sell‑off in Indonesia, exposing liquidity strains in both conventional and Islamic equities
body: The MSCI signal of a possible downgrade over Indonesia’s transparency, ownership concentration and price‑discovery issues sparked a market‑wide sell‑off in early 2026, with the broader Indonesia Sharia Index (ISSI) falling more sharply than the Jakarta Islamic Index (JII) and the overall IDX. Regulators are drafting rules to raise free‑float, improve governance and data quality, which are seen as essential for restoring investor confidence and deepening the Islamic market.

title: Indonesia's composite index rises 0.72% as small‑cap stocks post strong weekly gains
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) climbed 0.72% over the week to close at 8,271.76, with market capitalization increasing 0.35% to roughly Rp14,941 trillion. Gains were led by PT Merdeka Battery Minerals Tbk (+17.93%), PT MD Pictures Tbk (+12.78%) and PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (+8.22%), while the ten top‑gainer list was dominated by PT Sekar Bumi Tbk (+52.68%), PT Samator Indo Gas Tbk (+44.44%) and PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk (+36.15%).

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange reports 2026 corporate bond and sukuk issuance of Rp15.71 trillion, highlighted by PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk's new sustainable bond
body: Indonesia Stock Exchange recorded that corporate bond and sukuk issuance in 2026 has reached Rp15.71 trillion across 20 issues from 13 issuers, highlighted by the listing of PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk’s Sustainable Bond I Phase II worth Rp1.15 trillion. Overall, the exchange hosts 672 issuances with Rp549.76 trillion outstanding, while rating agency Pefindo received mandates for Rp71.35 trillion of new corporate bonds from 43 companies, led by private multifinance firms (Rp17.65 trillion) and pulp‑and‑paper firms (Rp8.9 trillion).

title: Indonesia's OJK fines stock influencer BVN 5.35 billion rupiah for market manipulation of AYLS, FILM and BSML shares
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed an administrative fine of Rp5.35 billion on influencer BVN, suspected to be Belvin Tannadi, for manipulating PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk, PT MD Entertainment Tbk and PT Bintang Samudera Mandiri Lines Tbk by issuing false buy/sell recommendations while executing opposite trades through nominee accounts. The sanction is part of a broader enforcement effort that totals Rp11.05 billion in penalties against four parties for violations of market‑capital regulations.

title: Jakarta Composite Index gains 0.72% as foreign investors net buy Rp2.07 trillion, with several stocks posting double‑digit weekly rises
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 8,271.76 on Feb 20, up 0.72% for the week, supported by foreign investors' net purchase of Rp2.07 trillion after a prior net sell, and market capitalization rose 0.35% to Rp14,941 trillion. Weekly gainers included PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (+4.64%), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (+11.49%), PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk (+1.59%), PT Merdeka Battery Minerals Tbk (+17.93%), PT MD Pictures Tbk (+12.78%) and PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (+8.22%), while average daily transaction frequency, volume and value also rose about 12%, 4% and 3% respectively.

title: Indonesia’s OJK fines stock‑market influencer BVN Rp5.35 billion for manipulative buy‑sell recommendations
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed a Rp5.35 billion administrative fine on influencer BVN (Belvin Tannadi) for recommending buy or sell positions while simultaneously executing opposite trades. The misconduct involved massive buy‑sell orders in PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk, PT MD Entertainment Tbk and PT Bintang Samudera Mandiri Lines Tbk and is part of a broader Rp11.05 billion una via sanction against four parties.

title: Indonesia's OJK fines influencer Belvin Tannadi 5.35 billion rupiah for stock‑price manipulation and opens investigations into 32 other influencers
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed a Rp5.35 billion administrative fine on influencer Belvin Tannadi after finding he manipulated shares of PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk, PT MD Pictures Tbk and PT Bintang Samudera Mandiri Lines Tbk by coordinating buy‑sell orders across multiple accounts and using social‑media recommendations to influence followers. OJK is also reviewing 32 additional influencers for similar violations while noting no investigation has been launched against the finance minister’s son.

title: PT Krakatau Steel Tbk secures Rp4.1 trillion pipe supply contract for the Dumai‑Sei Mangkei gas pipeline project
body: PT Krakatau Steel Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Krakatau Pipe Industries, won an estimated Rp4.1 trillion contract to supply about 83,000 tonnes of steel pipe for the 541‑km Dumai‑Sei Mangkei gas transmission project, part of the national strategic pipeline slated for completion in 2027 and operation in 2028. The company also expects to maintain positive financial performance this year, having posted a net profit of US$24 million in Q3 2025 after restructuring and aiming to support downstream steel initiatives under the Danantara mandate.

title: OJK orders BEI and KSEI to enhance share‑ownership transparency and implement 15% free‑float rule
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) issued a decree requiring the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) and the Central Securities Depository (KSEI) to publish more granular share‑ownership data, including holdings above 1%, on the BEI website. The regulator also announced a phased introduction of a minimum 15% free‑float requirement with an exit policy for issuers that fail to comply.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia proposes market reforms to satisfy MSCI Inc and FTSE Russell requirements
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia has submitted final‑stage proposals to enhance shareholder disclosure, raise the free float minimum to 15%, and establish a shareholders concentration list, aiming to address concerns raised by MSCI Inc and FTSE Russell. The reforms will be sent to Otoritas Jasa Keuangan for approval after MSCI Inc announced a temporary freeze on rebalancing Indonesian stocks.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange Confirms Free Float 15% and UBO Transparency Reforms Stay on Schedule
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) said the rule to raise the minimum free float to 15% and the disclosure of shareholders above 1% and ultimate beneficial owners will be finalized and submitted to Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) by early March 2026, with a three‑year phased implementation. The agency also noted that the Shareholder Concentration List methodology is in its final internal review stage and will involve a cross‑division committee and the Self‑Regulatory Organization.

title: Indonesia aims to attract foreign equity inflows with MSCI‑aligned market reforms slated for March 2026
body: Foreign investors are expected to resume net buying of Indonesian equities as the Jakarta Stock Exchange, together with OJK and KSEI, push reforms to meet MSCI standards, including higher shareholder‑transparency, expanded investor classifications, and raising the minimum free‑float to 15% by March 2026. Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia’s Rully Arya Wisnubroto says the reforms could trigger a turnaround as early as April if MSCI criteria are met, but global yield, Fed rate moves and rupiah stability remain key, while the IHSG is down about 5% YTD after a net foreign outflow of Rp14.65 trillion.

title: PT Pertamina launches Phase‑2 biorefinery at Cilacap refinery to convert used cooking oil into sustainable aviation fuel
body: PT Pertamina broke ground on the Phase‑2 biorefinery at its Cilacap refinery, a $1.1 billion project that will convert used cooking oil into sustainable aviation fuel, create about 5,900 jobs, cut emissions by up to 600,000 t of CO₂ annually and is projected to add IDR 199 trillion to GDP. The facility will raise SAF output from 27 kl/day to 887 kl/day by 2029, making Cilacap the largest SAF producer in Southeast Asia and supporting national energy self‑sufficiency.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange finalizes draft revisions to Regulation I‑A on free‑float requirements and ticker‑code changes
body: The Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) has completed the rule‑making process for revising Regulation I‑A, introducing tiered free‑float minimums of 25%, 20% and 15% based on market capitalization and new shareholder‑count thresholds, with the draft to be submitted to the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) for approval by March 2026. The revision also outlines a two‑phase service for changing listed companies' ticker codes, starting in January 2028 and expanding later that year.

title: Indonesia's OJK launches task force with ministries and SROs to oversee eight capital market integrity reforms
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) announced the creation of the Satgas Reformasi Integritas Pasar Modal Indonesia, comprising OJK, the Ministry of Coordinating Economic Affairs and self‑regulatory organisations such as BEI, KSEI and KPEI, to monitor the implementation of eight market‑integrity actions and provide regular transparent updates. Research head Muhammad Wafi of KISI Sekuritas described the reforms – covering free‑float rules, UBO data transparency, ownership data strengthening, BEI demutualisation, enforcement, corporate governance, market deepening and stakeholder collaboration – as a necessary ‘bitter pill’ to restore investor confidence.

title: OJK fines PT Dana Mitra Kencana and two individuals for manipulating PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk shares
body: The Financial Services Authority imposed a 2.1 billion‑rupiah fine on PT Dana Mitra Kencana and 1.8 billion‑rupiah fines on individuals MLN and UPT for coordinating fake trades of PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk that amounted to roughly 92.85 billion rupiah between January and April 2016. The scheme involved structured funding to 17 clients, generating 43.72 billion rupiah in transactions, while the two individuals used 12 client accounts to create an additional 49.12 billion rupiah of artificial trading volume.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange to Phase in 15% Free Float Requirement, Offering Exit Policy for Non‑Compliant Issuers
body: The Indonesia Financial Services Authority (OJK) and the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) plan to raise the free‑float minimum from 7.5% to 15% over three years, with 267 issuers currently below the threshold. OJK commissioner Hasan Fawzi and BEI chief executive Jeffrey Hendrik said an exit policy—including counseling, possible extensions, and ultimately delisting—will be applied case‑by‑case for issuers that cannot meet the new requirement.

title: Indonesia's OJK fines stock influencer BVN 5.35 billion rupiah for market manipulation
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed a 5.35 billion rupiah administrative fine on influencer BVN (believed to be Belvin Tannadi) after confirming he spread false information and executed opposite trades using nominee accounts to fabricate market activity. The manipulation involved massive buy‑sell orders in shares of PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk, PT MD Entertainment Tbk and PT Bintang Samudera Mandiri Lines Tbk, and the fine is part of a total 11.05 billion rupiah sanction against four parties.

title: Indonesia's OJK sets 15% free‑float rule for listed firms with two‑year transition and delisting risk
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) will require all listed companies to achieve a minimum 15% public ownership within two years, flagging non‑compliant stocks with a special notation and threatening delisting for firms that do not meet the threshold. The move, prompted by MSCI’s liquidity concerns, is expected to add roughly Rp 187 trillion ($11 billion) of shares to the market.

title: Indonesia to import $15 billion of U.S. energy while reallocating existing imports to maintain trade balance
body: Indonesia signed a tariff deal with the United States to purchase $15 billion of energy—$3.5 billion of LPG, $4.5 billion of crude oil and $7 billion of refined gasoline—and will shift purchases away from ASEAN, the Middle East and Africa to keep its overall energy trade balance unchanged. State oil firm Pertamina, led by Simon Aloysius Mantiri, will conduct a transparent tender, raising U.S. LPG supplies to 70% of its mix and has MoUs with ExxonMobil, Chevron, KDT Global Resources, Halliburton, Hartree Partners LP and Phillips 66.

title: Freeport-McMoRan signs MoU with Indonesia to extend Grasberg mine rights and transfer majority ownership by 2042
body: Freeport-McMoRan and the Indonesian government signed a memorandum of understanding to extend Freeport Indonesia’s operating license at the Grasberg district until the mine’s reserves are exhausted, with the government amending the IUPK and the company agreeing to divest an additional 12% stake at no cost in 2041, reducing FCX’s ownership to about 37% by 2042. The deal also commits PTFI to increased community development, higher exploration spending and greater downstream sales of copper, gold and sulfuric acid.

title: Indonesia advances negotiations to purchase 50 Boeing aircraft amid broader US‑Indonesia trade pact
body: Indonesia continues talks to buy 50 Boeing aircraft, which Garuda Indonesia is expected to operate, under a reciprocal trade agreement, though transaction value and delivery timeline remain undisclosed. The pact also commits Indonesia to purchase roughly $15 billion of U.S. oil and energy products annually and grants zero tariffs on thousands of Indonesian exports while the U.S. receives tariff‑free access to Indonesian soy‑ and wheat‑based foods and textiles.

title: Indonesian rupiah edges higher as US‑Indonesia trade tariff deal and cautious Fed minutes boost sentiment
body: The rupiah closed at Rp 16,888 per US dollar, up 6 points after briefly gaining 25 points, following news of a reciprocal trade tariff agreement between Indonesia and the United States. Traze Andalan Futures director Ibrahim Assuaibi said the move was supported by the Fed’s hawkish minutes and stronger US jobless‑claims data, despite ongoing geopolitical risks.

title: Indonesia and US finalize trade deal focused solely on economics, dropping defense and security clauses
body: Indonesia’s chief economic minister Airlangga Hartarto said the newly signed reciprocal trade agreement with the United States removes non‑economic clauses such as defense, nuclear and South China Sea provisions, and accepts about 90% of Indonesia’s demands. The deal reduces U.S. tariffs on most Indonesian goods to 19% (down from 32%) and grants exemptions on 1,819 tariff lines, while Indonesia eliminates tariffs on 99% of U.S. products.

title: Permata Bank warns that Indonesia‑US reciprocal tariff could curb growth but offers export and FDI opportunities
body: Permata Bank said the newly signed 19% US‑Indonesia reciprocal tariff, covering about 1,800 products and tied to a $38.4 billion investment pledge, could dampen growth in 2026 by weakening external demand, disrupting supply chains and raising uncertainty, while also creating limited upside if used to negotiate market access and diversify exports beyond China. The bank highlighted that any US FDI into manufacturing and logistics will remain conditional on reforms such as regulatory certainty, streamlined licensing, energy supply and logistics connectivity, and noted that preferential tariff treatment for textiles under a quota could boost those sectors if Indonesia receives special treatment compared with rivals.

title: Antam gold price spikes to near‑record levels as global gold rallies on geopolitical and Fed uncertainty
body: Antam’s gold price jumped to Rp 2,944,000 per gram on Feb. 20, up about 18% since the start of 2026 and close to its all‑time high, while the buyback price rose to Rp 2,725,000 per gram. Globally, spot gold rose to $4,996.53 per ounce as US‑Iran tensions and mixed Federal Reserve policy signals supported the safe‑haven metal, with markets expecting the first Fed rate cut in June 2026.

title: Elang Mahkota alias Emtek raises its Surya Citra Media stake to 74.42% after buying 300 million shares
body: Elang Mahkota alias Emtek purchased 300 million Surya Citra Media shares at Rp320 each, costing about Rp96 billion and pushing its ownership to 74.42% (up from 74.02%). The price paid was 14 points above the Feb 20 2026 closing price of Rp306 per share.

title: Indonesia signs US trade pact containing a ‘poison‑pill’ clause seen as a tool to curb China’s influence
body: Indonesia signed a 45‑page US‑Indonesia reciprocal trade agreement that includes a termination/communication clause allowing the United States to re‑impose tariffs or end the deal if Jakarta signs a trade pact deemed to jeopardize essential US interests, a provision analysts say targets China and grants US access to Indonesian critical minerals. The deal reduces US tariffs on Indonesian goods to 19% from 32%, grants exemptions for thousands of products, and comes as Indonesia’s trade with China reached $154.6 billion in 2025.

title: Indonesia faces criticism over $1.6 bn plan to import 105,000 commercial vehicles from India amid domestic capacity concerns
body: The government’s plan to procure 105,000 commercial vehicles worth Rp 24.66 trillion ($1.6 bn) from Indian makers Mahindra & Mahindra and Tata Motors has drawn opposition from the Association of Indonesian Automotive Industries (Gaikindo) and parliamentarians, who argue that local manufacturers such as Suzuki, Isuzu, Mitsubishi, Toyota, Daihatsu, Wuling and DFSK have sufficient capacity—over 400,000 pickup trucks per year—to meet demand and that large‑scale imports could jeopardise up to 1.5 million automotive jobs and breach the 40 % local‑content rule.

title: IDX says Indonesian market must absorb Rp187 trillion of shares to meet 15% free‑float rule, with 49 firms still non‑compliant
body: IDX estimates the market needs to absorb about Rp187 trillion ($11 billion) of shares from 267 listed companies to reach the 15% free‑float requirement. It also notes that 49 companies remain non‑compliant, including Alumindo Light Metal Industry, Cahaya Bintang Medan, Cowell Development, Dewata Freightinternational and Saraswati Griya Lestari, which faced trading suspensions.

title: U.S. and Indonesia sign trade pact lowering tariffs on textiles and expanding cotton imports
body: The United States agreed to keep a 19% tariff on most Indonesian goods but will grant a 0% tariff rate quota on textiles and apparel under the new reciprocal trade agreement signed during President Prabowo Subianto’s Washington visit, while Indonesia commits to import at least 163,000 metric tons of U.S. cotton each year for five years. The deal, which also eliminates tariffs on over 99% of U.S. products, was accompanied by a U.S. cotton purchase commitment of up to $244 million involving the US National Cotton Council, Busana Apparel Group, Daehan Global, garment exporter Pan Brothers and recycling startup Ravel.

title: Jakarta Composite Index rises 0.31% as Bank Indonesia holds rates and Indonesia signs US tariff deal
body: The Jakarta Composite Index opened higher on Friday, gaining 26 points (0.31%) to 8,300 amid strong early‑session volume of 2 billion shares, while Phintraco Sekuritas noted that Bank Indonesia kept the benchmark BI Rate at 4.75% for a fifth straight meeting and credit growth accelerated to 9.96% YoY in January 2026. Investors are watching the upcoming Q4‑2025 current‑account data and Indonesia’s new reciprocal tariff agreement with the United States, which cuts US tariffs on Indonesian goods to 19% and grants 0% duty on Indonesian palm oil, alongside 11 private‑sector MoUs worth $38.4 billion, as global markets saw US indices slip and Asian peers mixed.

title: Indonesia and U.S. firms sign $38.4 billion of MoUs as President Prabowo seeks long‑term partnership and tariff relief
body: President Prabowo Subianto announced that 11 memoranda of understanding totalling $38.4 billion were signed in Washington, covering sectors from critical minerals to furniture, including Freeport-McMoRan’s 12% divestment to the Indonesian government, a Pertamina‑Halliburton oil‑field recovery partnership, and Galang Bumi Industri’s $4.9 billion semiconductor venture with Essence and Tynergy Technology Group (potentially expanding to $26.7 billion), as well as a cooperation between HIMKI and the American Hardwood Export Council. The agreements are positioned as a prelude to a broader U.S.–Indonesia trade deal that could lower the current 19% tariff on Indonesian goods, though economists caution that implementation and value capture remain uncertain.

title: Indonesia extends Freeport Indonesia's mining permit to 2041, boosting state ownership and revenues
body: The Indonesian government signed an MoU in Washington to extend Freeport Indonesia’s special mining business permit through 2041 and raise Indonesia’s ownership in the company by 12%, securing estimated annual state revenues of about $6 billion (Rp 90 trillion). The agreement, involving Freeport-McMoRan Inc, is projected to support roughly 30,000 jobs, deliver Rp 14 trillion per year to regional governments and allocate Rp 2 trillion annually for community development.

title: Abadi Lestari establishes PT Marinova Protein Internasional as a new subsidiary via Realfood Winta Asia
body: Abadi Lestari, through its subsidiary Realfood Winta Asia, founded PT Marinova Protein Internasional in Bojonegoro, East Java on 19 January 2026, with Realfood Winta Asia holding 99.9% of the capital (Rp999 million) and Edwin Pranata holding 0.1% (Rp1 million). The new entity will engage in fish and other aquatic product processing and wholesale, and is not expected to impact Abadi Lestari's operations, legal status, financial condition, or continuity.

title: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan and Bursa Efek Indonesia accelerate market reforms with granular share‑ownership disclosure and raise minimum free float to 15%
body: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan has ordered KSEI and Bursa Efek Indonesia to publish granular share‑ownership data for holdings above 1 % across 28 investor sub‑types, with readiness over 82 % and public disclosure around 90 %. The regulators also increased the minimum free‑float to 15 %, will apply a special notation to non‑compliant issuers during a 1‑2‑year transition, and are reviewing the Full Call Auction policy with a decision expected by Q2 2026.

title: PT Saranacentral Bajatama Tbk plans a rights issue to settle USD 20.6 million debt with affiliate PT Sarana Steel
body: PT Saranacentral Bajatama Tbk announced a rights issue of up to 1 billion new shares (PMHMETD I) to raise funds for settling its USD 20.6 million debt to affiliate PT Sarana Steel, which equals roughly Rp445.34 billion (principal Rp317.57 billion and interest Rp127.77 billion). The principal will be converted into new shares for PT Sarana Steel, interest will be paid from the proceeds, and an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting is scheduled for 31 March 2026 with OJK filing on 11 June and expected effectiveness on 7 August 2026.

title: PT Sentul City Tbk restores Spring City access after flood and reports strong financial position following Rp1.6 trillion land sale
body: PT Sentul City Tbk said it quickly cleared a partial water overflow at the Spring City access on 11 Feb, restored normal operations and is auditing drainage with local authorities to avoid recurrence. The company also highlighted accelerated settlement of its PKU debt and a Rp1.6 trillion land sale to Grup Genting that strengthens its cash position and profitability.

title: PT Graha Andrasentra Propertindo Tbk plans a rights issue to fund the acquisition of a majority stake in PT Jungleland Asia
body: PT Graha Andrasentra Propertindo Tbk intends to issue 8.28 billion new Series B shares at Rp50 each, targeting Rp414 billion in fresh capital, with about Rp413.9 billion earmarked to acquire a 61.86% stake in PT Jungleland Asia from PT Adiprotek Envirodunia. The deal, expected to generate up to Rp570.8 billion in gain on bargain purchase and fair‑value remeasurement, will restore control of Jungleland Adventure Theme Park and add 35 ha of strategic land for future residential projects, pending shareholder approval.

title: Seasonal Lebaran demand may boost Indonesian airline revenues but cost pressures limit profit gains
body: Analysts expect quarterly revenue for PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk and PT AirAsia Indonesia Tbk to rise 10‑15% during the Ramadan‑Lebaran travel peak, with a stronger impact on PT AirAsia Indonesia Tbk, while higher jet fuel, leasing and currency costs could constrain earnings. They recommend speculative buys with price targets of Rp 90‑94 for PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk and Rp 95‑98 for PT AirAsia Indonesia Tbk.

title: PT Hillcon Tbk reports PKU lawsuit against PT Hillconjaya Sakti over Rp46.01 billion debt with limited impact on group revenue
body: PT Hillcon Tbk disclosed that its subsidiary PT Hillconjaya Sakti faces a PKU lawsuit over a restructured debt of Rp46.01 billion to PT Tri Nusantara Petromine, which it estimates will affect consolidated revenue by only about 1.73% as of 30 September 2025. The subsidiary contributes 99.86% of the group’s Rp2.79 trillion revenue, operations remain normal, and the stock has fallen 60.81% YTD to around Rp58 from its IPO price of Rp1,250.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk completes approved share buyback program
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk announced that it has completed the share buyback program approved at the 26 March 2025 shareholders meeting, repurchasing 16,377,700 shares within the Rp1.5 trillion limit. The buyback coincided with a rise in its price‑to‑book ratio to 1.01 and its share price to Rp4,630, and the treasury shares will be allocated to employee and director ownership programs without affecting operations or financial condition.

title: IHSG slips 0.02% as foreign investors net sell Rp 2.21 trillion weekly, led by major offloads in PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and peers
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 8,271.76, down 0.02% on Friday, with a weekly cumulative loss of 0.23% and trading volume of 45.82 billion shares worth Rp 20.39 trillion. Foreign investors recorded a net buy of Rp 240.52 billion on the day but a net sell of Rp 2.21 trillion for the week, driven by large sales of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bumi Resources Tbk and PT Darma Henwa Tbk.

title: PT Jasa Marga Persero Tbk launches Rp2.06 trillion sustainable bond to fund capital injections into toll road subsidiaries
body: PT Jasa Marga Persero Tbk issued a Rp2.06 trillion sustainable bond (Series A‑D, 3‑10 year tenors, coupons 5.70‑6.75%) to finance capital injections into its subsidiaries PT Jasamarga Japek Selatan JJS and PT Jasamarga Jogja Bawen. The proceeds will provide Rp1.3 trillion for a 92.32% stake in JJS to advance the Jakarta‑Cikampek II South toll project and 767.65 million shares for a 70.38% stake in JJB to support the Yogyakarta‑Bawen toll, with underwriting by PT BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, PT Mandiri Sekuritas and PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk and rating idAA from Pefindo.

title: Indonesian business groups urge President Prabowo to scrap $1.5 billion plan to import 105,000 pickup trucks
body: Business leaders, including Saleh Husin of the Indonesian Chamber of Commerce and Industry, warned that the proposed Rp 25 trillion import of 105,000 fully built‑up pickup trucks—planned by state‑owned Agrinas Pangan Nusantara and to be sourced from Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd and Tata Motors—could undermine the domestic automotive sector. They urged President Prabowo to cancel the imports and instead rely on local manufacturers such as Gaikindo members, which have capacity to meet the demand with higher local content.

title: Indonesia seeks to keep zero tariffs on palm oil and electronics amid US’s new 10% global tariffs
body: Indonesia is urging the United States to maintain the zero‑percent tariffs on palm oil, electronic and aircraft components granted under a recent bilateral trade pact, after the Supreme Court blocked Trump’s use of a 1977 emergency law and he imposed a 10% global tariff on all countries. Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto and President Prabowo Subianto said negotiations continue and the lower tariffs—now set at 19% versus an earlier 32% target—should benefit Indonesian exporters.

title: Indonesia Says New US Trade Deal Remains Unratified After Supreme Court Blocks Blanket Tariffs
body: Indonesia's Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs confirmed that the recently signed US‑Indonesia trade agreement is not yet effective, as the US Supreme Court struck down the blanket tariffs and President Trump imposed a 10% global tariff. The deal, which would lower tariffs on Indonesian goods from 32% to 19% pending ratification by both governments, also contains a “poison‑pill” clause threatening termination if Indonesia trades with nations contrary to US interests.

title: Indonesia to import US ethanol for E10 program as trade talks face uncertainty after US Supreme Court ruling
body: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia announced that Indonesia will import ethanol from the United States to support the mandatory 10% blend (E10) and prepare for a 20% blend (E20) by 2028, addressing a domestic production shortfall of 14.27 million kiloliters against a gasoline consumption of 37.3 million kiloliters in 2025 and expected demand of around 40 million kiloliters. The import plan is linked to the stalled US‑Indonesia reciprocal trade agreement following the US Supreme Court's decision striking down former President Donald Trump's global tariff authority.

title: US Supreme Court blocks Trump’s global tariff authority, prompting Indonesia to reconsider its reciprocal trade agreement
body: The Court ruled 6‑3 that former President Donald Trump lacked authority under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act to impose sweeping global tariffs, effectively nullifying the threatened reciprocal duties on Indonesia. The ruling arrives after Indonesia secured a US trade deal that reduced tariffs to 19% on most Indonesian goods, leading economists to argue the country can drop the pending Agreement on Reciprocal Trade and may seek renegotiation, despite Trump’s hints at alternative tariff measures.

title: PT Saranacentral Bajatama Tbk announces rights issue to settle $20.6 million loan from PT Sarana Steel
body: PT Saranacentral Bajatama Tbk will conduct a rights issue (PMHMETD I) of up to 1 billion new shares to raise funds for repaying a US$20.6 million principal loan to its affiliate PT Sarana Steel and for working‑capital needs. The conversion of PT Sarana Steel’s receivable into shares will be approved at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 31 March 2026, with the OJK filing scheduled for 11 June 2026 and expected effectiveness on 7 August 2026.

title: Triputra Investindo Arya sells 3.84 million PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk shares, reducing its stake to 0.45%
body: Triputra Investindo Arya sold 3,841,900 shares of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk at Rp 8,789 per share on 18 February 2026, generating about Rp 33.77 billion and lowering its holding from 0.50% (38,570,700 shares) to 0.45% (34,728,800 shares). At the close on 20 February 2026, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk’s stock rose 2.36% to Rp 9,325 per share.

title: Indonesia’s OJK imposes multi‑billion‑rupiah fines for IMPC share‑price manipulation
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) determined that PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk shares were manipulated between January and April 2016 and levied a total of Rp 5.7 billion in administrative fines on PT Dana Mitra Kencana (Rp 2.1 billion) and individuals UPT and MLN (Rp 1.8 billion each). OJK also fined social‑media actor BVN Rp 5.35 billion for disseminating false information that affected stock prices in 2021‑2022.

title: PT Saranacentral Bajatama Tbk plans rights issue to settle $20.6 million debt to PT Sarana Steel
body: PT Saranacentral Bajatama Tbk will issue up to 1 billion new shares through a rights issue to repay a US$20.6 million (Rp445.34 billion) loan to PT Sarana Steel and to support working capital. PT Sarana Steel and controlling shareholder Ibnu Susanto are slated as major participants, a detailed RUPSLB and rights‑issue schedule was disclosed, and the stock rose 13.51% to Rp168.

title: PT Hillcon Tbk faces PKU lawsuit over subsidiary debt as shares plunge and hit auto‑rejection band
body: PT Hillcon Tbk (HILL) disclosed that a PKU filing by PT Tri Nusantara Petromine seeks IDR 46.01 billion from its subsidiary PT Hillconjaya Sakti, which generates about 99.86% of the group’s revenue (IDR 2.79 trillion). The filing triggered a sharp sell‑off, with HILL shares repeatedly hitting the auto‑rejection band (down roughly 15% daily), leading to a one‑day trading suspension, while Hillcon Equity Management reduced its stake to 41.41%.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia sells 105.76 million Hillcon shares, cutting its stake to 8.71% as the stock plunges and faces suspension
body: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia disposed of 105,761,700 Hillcon shares in two trades on 13 and 18 February 2026 at Rp80 and Rp68 per share, generating roughly Rp7.32 billion and reducing its holding to 8.71% (down from 9.43%). Hillcon’s share price fell 27.5% to Rp58 and the Bursa Efek Indonesia suspended trading on 20 February 2026.

title: Bank Mega to Issue Rp5.87 Trillion Bonus Shares in 1:1 Split Pending Shareholder Approval
body: Bank Mega announced a bonus share issue worth Rp5.87 trillion, issuing 11.74 billion new shares at a 1:1 ratio based on additional paid‑in capital of Rp6.34 trillion and total equity of Rp25.07 trillion as of 31 December 2025. The plan, which will reduce share premium to Rp477 billion and raise paid‑up capital to 23.48 billion shares, requires approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 31 March 2026, with key dates for dividend and bonus distribution in April 2026.

title: Nusantara Sejahtera Raya CNMA Ends Cinema XXI Share Buyback Early After Using 77% of Budget
body: Nusantara Sejahtera Raya CNMA, the operator of Cinema XXI, completed a share buyback of 1.69 billion shares at an average price of Rp136.47, spending Rp231.72 billion (77 % of the Rp300 billion allocation) and ending the program early on 18 February 2026 to preserve free‑float levels. The company said the early termination has no material effect on its operations or financial condition.

title: Triputra Investindo Arya sells 3.84 million AADI shares, raising 33.76 billion IDR and cutting its stake to 0.45%
body: Triputra Investindo Arya divested 3.84 million shares of Adaro Andalan Indonesia at an execution price of Rp8,789, generating Rp33.76 billion and reducing its holding to 34.72 million shares (0.45% ownership). Following the sale, AADI’s share price slipped 225 points to Rp9,325, though it remains up about 32% year‑to‑date from the Jan 2 2026 level of Rp7,050.

title: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sell Shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk
body: On 20 Feb 2026, Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sold 306,400 shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk (YOII.JK) at IDR 110 per share for investment purposes. The holding decreased from 246,486,000 to 246,179,600 shares, a reduction of 306,400 shares, indicating a modest divestment but no material impact on overall ownership structure.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey buys Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: On 20 Feb 2026, investor Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 150,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk at IDR 3,213 per share for investment purposes. His holding increased from 3,881,700 to 4,031,700 shares, a net gain of 150,000 shares. The transaction raises his ownership stake and reflects confidence in the company's copper and gold mining prospects, potentially influencing market perception of MDKA.JK.

title: Infiniti Wahana Buy Shares of Steady Safe Tbk
body: On 2026-02-11, Infiniti Wahana purchased 100,200 shares of Steady Safe Tbk at IDR 380 per share. The holding rose from 464,495,713 to 464,595,913, reflecting a net increase of 100,200 shares. The transaction is recorded as a purchase and marginally raises the shareholder's stake in the company.

title: Kreatif Media Karya buy Shares of PT Bukalapak.com Tbk
body: Kreatif Media Karya purchased a total of 4,495,645,533 PT Bukalapak.com Tbk shares at IDR 150 per share on 19‑20 February 2026, raising its holding from 41,826,100,852 to 46,321,746,385 shares (an increase of 4,495,645,533 shares). The transaction is classified as a buy for investment purposes, expanding the shareholder's stake in the e‑commerce platform and potentially influencing future voting power and market perception.

title: Analysts see IHSG rebound potential and recommend buying PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk, PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk while selling PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 8,271 with a net foreign sell of Rp360.91 billion and is expected to rebound toward the 8,400 resistance level, supported by OJK and BEI communications and upcoming money‑supply data. Analysts recommend buying PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (target Rp2,550‑Rp2,800), PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (target Rp1,955‑Rp2,070) and PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (target Rp1,140‑Rp1,295) while advising a sell on PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange reports eight firms in IPO pipeline and ongoing bond and rights‑issue activity
body: As of 22 February 2026, the BEI has eight companies awaiting IPOs—five large‑asset firms and three medium‑asset firms across sectors such as basic materials, consumer non‑cyclicals, energy, financials, industrials, and transport & logistics—while no IPOs have been completed this year. The exchange also notes 20 bond issuances raising Rp15.71 trillion, 30 bond issuances in the pipeline, and three rights issues totaling Rp3.75 trillion, with one additional rights‑issue candidate in the property sector.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange lists major sustainable bonds from PT Jasa Marga Persero Tbk and PT Bumi Resources Tbk amid a 30‑issue corporate bond pipeline
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange reported a pipeline of 30 corporate bonds and sukuk, with 20 issuances already raising Rp15.71 trillion, and today listed PT Jasa Marga Persero Tbk’s Rp2.06 trillion Sustainable Bond III (5.70‑6.75% coupons, 3‑10‑year tenor) to fund capital injections into PT Jasamarga Japek Selatan and PT Jasamarga Jogja Bawen for toll‑road projects. PT Bumi Resources Tbk’s Rp612.75 billion Sustainable Bond I (7.25% coupon, 3‑year tenor) was also listed to refinance a US$20.45 million loan and support working capital.

title: Kreatif Media Karya raises its Bukalapak ownership to 44.9% after purchasing 4.5 billion shares
body: Kreatif Media Karya bought 4,495645533 billion Bukalapak shares at an exercise price of Rp150 per share, spending roughly Rp674.34 billion and increasing its stake to 56.32 billion shares (44.91%). Bukalapak’s stock remained near Rp148, down about 19.13% over the past six months from Rp183 on 25 August 2025.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama wins long‑term mining services contract with PT Adaro Indonesia
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama has secured a long‑term mining services contract with PT Adaro Indonesia for the Tambang Tutupan Selatan area in South Kalimantan, covering overburden removal of about 239 million bcm and coal production of roughly 44 million tonnes from 1 April 2026 to 31 December 2030. Management expects the contract to strengthen the company’s fundamentals and positively affect its going‑concern status.

title: Indonesia's Finance Minister Extends Rp200 Trillion Government Fund Placement Until September 2026
body: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa announced the extension of a Rp200 trillion government fund placement in banks until September 2026 to support liquidity and sustain credit growth, noting that deposit and loan rates have fallen and credit growth reached 9.96% year‑on‑year in January 2026. By February 2026, third‑party deposits (DPK) rose 13.5% and primary money (M0) increased 11.7%.

title: Fancy Marsiana sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 20 Feb 2026, shareholder Fancy Marsiana sold her entire holding of 37,500,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk (MEDS.JK) at IDR 40 per share, totaling IDR 1,500,000,000. The divestment reduces her stake from 37,500,000 to zero, representing a complete exit from the company. This transaction signals a full divestment by the shareholder and may affect the company's free float and shareholder composition.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan buy Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: On 20 February 2026, shareholder Jemmy Kurniawan executed a net purchase of 34,500,000 PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk shares at a representative price of IDR 40 per share, after selling 3,000,000 shares at IDR 78. The transaction raised his holding from 947,870,900 to 982,370,900 shares, reflecting an increase of 34,500,000 shares. The stated purpose is to increase the number of shares owned, expanding his stake in the company.

title: Eco Energi Perkasa Raises Stake in Abadi Nusantara Hijau to 50.77% Through 4.5 Billion‑Share Purchase
body: Eco Energi Perkasa, with assistance from BCA Sekuritas, acquired an additional 4.5 billion shares of Abadi Nusantara Hijau on 19 February 2026, bringing its total holding to 7.15 billion shares (50.77% of the company). The undisclosed‑price transaction is estimated at roughly Rp981 billion based on the closing price of Rp218 per share, while Eco Energi’s overall ownership rose from 13.32% to 50.77% as of 31 January 2026.

title: Henry Liem Sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem, a major shareholder of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK), sold 154,200 shares on 20 February 2026 at IDR 540.0 per share. The transaction reduced his stake from 15,140,659 shares to 14,986,459, a decrease of 154,200 shares. The sale was undertaken for portfolio rebalancing and liquidity purposes, potentially impacting the company’s shareholding structure but not altering control dynamics. Investors should monitor subsequent trading activity for any market reaction.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama extends mining contract with PT Adaro Indonesia to 2030 amid PT Buma Internasional Grup Tbk's Q3 2025 earnings decline
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama extended its mining services contract with PT Adaro Indonesia until 31 December 2030, targeting 239 million cubic meters of overburden removal and 44 million tonnes of coal production, with average annual volumes of 50.5 million bcm and 9.3 million tonnes. Meanwhile, PT Buma Internasional Grup Tbk reported a Q3 2025 net loss of US$72.66 million, revenue of US$1.13 billion (down 16.2% YoY) and a 79.19% YoY drop in gross profit to US$27.22 million.

title: Investor Himawan Sutanto reduces stake in PT Bhakti Agung Propertindo Tbk after selling 26.38 million shares
body: Himawan Sutanto sold 1.8 million shares on 18 February 2026 and 24.58 million shares on 19 February 2026 of PT Bhakti Agung Propertindo Tbk, lowering his holding to 673.65 million shares (12.05%). Simultaneously, PT Nugraha Prima Griyatama divested 700 million shares, decreasing its ownership from 29.75% to 17.23%, with both transactions executed via PT KB Valbury Sekuritas.

title: Indonesia's composite index (IHSG) rises 1.17% to 8,368.61, buoyed by big‑cap and gold stocks
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) opened higher on Monday, gaining 1.17% (96.84 points) to 8,368.61, with 351 stocks advancing, notable gains from PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (2.97%), PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk (2.23%), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (6.01%) and PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk (29.86%). Analysts from Phintraco Sekuritas project the index to test the 8,400 psychological level, citing supportive global sentiment, MSCI approval of BEI reforms and a technical range of 8,250‑8,380.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange to apply special notation to over 300 stocks that fail to meet the new 15% free‑float requirement
body: BEI will mark more than 300 listed companies whose public float remains below the newly introduced 15% minimum, with data as of 31 Dec 2025 showing 312 stocks under the threshold, including PT Delta Giri Wacana Tbk, PT Esta Indonesia Tbk, PT Brigit Biofarmaka Teknologi Tbk, PT Surya Citra Media Tbk, PT Temas Tbk, PT Mayora Indah Tbk, PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk, PT Puri Global Sukses Tbk, PT Victoria Care Indonesia Tbk, PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk, PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk, PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk, PT Wijaya Karya (Persero) Tbk, PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk and PT Kimia Farma (Persero) Tbk. The OJK and BEI plan to introduce the notation without a separate board, give issuers up to three years to raise free float through rights issues, ESOP, MSOP and other corporate actions, and have an exit policy that may lead to delisting if targets are not met.

title: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk faces mixed analyst recommendations and a free‑float shortfall ahead of new BEI rules
body: Analysts covering PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk have a mixed outlook, with 13 buy, 12 hold and 5 sell recommendations and a consensus 12‑month target price of IDR 2,455.83, implying about 9.6% upside, while Sinarmas Sekuritas recently downgraded the stock to neutral with a target of IDR 2,400 as the share price sits at IDR 2,240, down 14.5% YTD. The company also noted that its free‑float ratio is 14.06%, below the upcoming Bursa Efek Indonesia minimum of 15% due to a prior buyback, and it is awaiting final regulations from BEI and Otoritas Jasa Keuangan while working with Unilever Plc to identify an ultimate beneficial owner.

title: Two major shareholders hold over 5% of PT Bumi Resources Tbk as its Q3 2025 results show mixed performance
body: As of 19 February 2026, Mach Energy Hongkong Limited, controlled by the Bakrie and Salim groups, owned 45.78% of PT Bumi Resources Tbk and UBS SWITZERLAND AG held 5.10%. The company reported Q3 2025 revenue of $1,037 billion, operating profit of $84.4 million (up 231.9% YoY) but net profit fell 76.1% to $29.4 million, and it reaffirmed its 2026 coal sales target of 77‑78 million tonnes.

title: Indonesia to Double Minimum Free‑Float Requirement, Potentially Triggering Rp187 trillion of Share Sales and Raising Market‑Depth Concerns
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (Bursa Efek Indonesia) plans to raise the minimum free‑float requirement from 7.5% to 15% for 267 listed companies, which could trigger about Rp187 trillion (US$11.1 billion) of share sales—four times the average annual issuance over the past two decades—prompting concerns from Bloomberg and MSCI about market depth and a possible downgrade to frontier status. Regulators will tighten significant‑ownership reporting to 1% and involve the state wealth fund Danantara, while analysts such as Nirgunan Tiruchelvam of Aletheia Capital argue that Indonesia’s domestic and foreign investor base can absorb the additional supply.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk launches world’s first commercial 5G 1.4 GHz Fixed Wireless Access service, prompting Kiwoom Sekuritas to raise its price target
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk through its subsidiary PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama launched the IRA 5G Fixed Wireless Access service on the 1.4 GHz band, targeting 5,500 sites and over 5 million customers in 2026 with a Rp100,000 per month unlimited broadband package. Kiwoom Sekuritas kept a buy rating and lifted its target price to Rp4,000 per share, while warning of risks from weaker consumer purchasing power, intense competition, rising operating costs and a softer Indonesian economic outlook.

title: Dividend‑rich Indonesian stocks such as PT Bank Mandiri Tbk and peers offer attractive yields amid market volatility
body: Despite the Jakarta Composite Index falling 6.73% over the past month and 3.01% year‑to‑date, analysts say dividend yields from issuers like PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (≈9.2% yield), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk and PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk remain more appealing than deposit or SBN rates. Recommendations include speculative buys on PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (target IDR 5,750) and PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk (target IDR 2,500), a buy‑on‑weakness for PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (target IDR 7,750) and a trading buy for PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk (target IDR 3,000).

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price up 18.34% YTD to Rp2.79 million per gram
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rose 18.34% year‑to‑date to Rp2,793,000 per gram, unchanged from the previous week, while global spot gold hovered around $4,999 per ounce and April 2026 Comex futures at $5,018.7 per ounce. Buybacks above Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% PPh 22 tax for NPWP holders (3% for non‑NPWP), deducted at source.

title: Indonesia extends ExxonMobil’s Cepu Block contract to 2055 with $10 billion investment pledge
body: Indonesia’s government will extend ExxonMobil’s operating license for the Cepu Block in Central Java to 2055, adding a $10 billion investment commitment and negotiating a new cost‑and‑revenue sharing scheme, while the field remains one of the largest oil producers alongside state‑owned Pertamina. The Cepu Block contributes up to 30% of national oil output (about 170,000‑185,000 barrels per day) and is part of a broader trade deal that includes $15 billion of U.S. energy imports.

title: Indonesia to import at least 1,000 tons of US rice under reciprocal trade pact despite president's self‑sufficiency claims
body: Indonesia will import a minimum of 1,000 tons of U.S. rice under a new reciprocal trade agreement, a volume equal to about 0,00003% of its projected 2025 rice production, despite President Prabowo Subianto’s public opposition to rice imports. The pact also obliges Indonesia to purchase $4.5 billion of U.S. food products and grants zero tariffs on 172 Indonesian exports such as tropical fruits, coffee and palm oil.

title: PT Kreatif Media Karya increases its stake in PT Bukalapakcom with a Rp674.35 billion share purchase
body: On 19 and 20 February 2026 PT Kreatif Media Karya bought a total of 4,495,465,533 PT Bukalapakcom shares at Rp150 each, investing Rp674,346 billion and raising its ownership from 40.55% to 44.91%. Following the disclosure, PT Bukalapakcom’s intraday price rose 0.68% to Rp149 per share.

title: PT Bank Mega Tbk to Issue 1:1 Bonus Shares Ahead of March 31 2026 Shareholder Meeting
body: PT Bank Mega Tbk plans to distribute bonus shares at a 1:1 ratio, creating 11.74 billion new shares with a nominal price of Rp 500 each, pending approval at its shareholders’ meeting on 31 March 2026. The stock, which closed at Rp 3,310 on 20 February 2026, has fallen about 8.3% over the past year, and investors must be recorded as shareholders by 13 April 2026 to receive the bonus.

title: Several Indonesian state-owned enterprises, including ANTM, PTBA, TINS, PGAS, KAEF and SMBR, officially became Persero entities in early 2026
body: In early 2026, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk ANTM, PT Bukit Asam Tbk PTBA, PT Timah Tbk TINS, PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk PGAS, PT Kimia Farma Tbk KAEF and PT Semen Baturaja Tbk SMBR obtained Persero status, a change described by analysts as mainly administrative to align governance with public‑company standards. Analysts advise investors to focus on earnings, cash‑flow, efficiency and commodity price trends rather than expecting a short‑term catalyst from the status shift.

title: Bitcoin slump drives Crypto Fear & Greed index to extreme low amid massive trader liquidations
body: Bitcoin fell more than 4% to around $64,300, sending the Crypto Fear & Greed index to 5 (extreme fear) and causing over 136,000 traders to liquidate roughly $458 million, with 92% of those positions being leveraged longs, while Glassnode reported daily net losses near $500 million. Analyst Michaël van de Poppe highlighted a Sharpe Ratio of –38.4, a historically low level that could signal a low‑risk accumulation zone, and the article also noted that DOID secured a long‑term contract with Adaro Indonesia.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama signs five-year contract with PT Adaro Indonesia for overburden removal and coal supply
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama announced a long‑term contract with PT Adaro Indonesia effective 1 April 2026 to 31 December 2030, under which it will deliver about 239 million cubic metres of overburden and 44 million tonnes of coal, averaging 50.5 million m³ and 9.3 million tonnes per year. The agreement reinforces a partnership of more than 20 years and enhances BUMA’s contracted revenue visibility.

title: Triputra Investindo Arya sells 3.84 million shares of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk
body: Triputra Investindo Arya sold 3,841,900 shares of PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk on 18 February 2026 at Rp 8,789 per share, raising about Rp 33.77 billion and reducing its stake from 0.5% to 0.45%. PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, a subsidiary of PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk listed on the Bursa Efek Indonesia since 5 December 2024, saw its share price slip 2.36% to Rp 9,325 on 20 February while up 32.27% year‑to‑date.

title: Antam gold prices rise to IDR 3.028 million per gram on Feb 23, 2026
body: Certified Antam gold bars from PT Aneka Tambang Tbk increased to IDR 3,028,000 per gram on Monday, up IDR 16,000 from Saturday, while the buyback price rose to IDR 2,813,000 per gram, a gain of IDR 20,000. The price changes were reported by the Logam Mulia website.

title: Indonesia's OJK fines influencer BVN 5.25 billion rupiah and probes 32 other social media personalities over alleged stock‑price manipulation
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed an administrative fine of Rp 5.25 billion on influencer BVN for manipulating shares of PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk, PT MD Pictures Tbk and PT Bintang Samudera Mandiri Lines Tbk. OJK is now examining 32 additional influencers for possible violations of Article 90 of the Capital Market Law, emphasizing due process while tightening oversight of stock promotion on social platforms.

title: Indonesia’s dividend season approaches as high‑yield stocks like PT Bank Mandiri Tbk attract investor interest
body: The final dividend distribution period in Indonesia, typically March‑June, is underway, with the IDX High Dividend20 index up 2.38% year‑to‑date to 522.03 points, indicating strong dividend‑focused sentiment. Analysts highlight PT Bank Mandiri Tbk, which posted a 2025 net profit of Rp 56.3 trillion, a 78% payout ratio and an estimated dividend yield of about 9.2% on a PER of 8.5x, as a particularly attractive high‑yield opportunity.

title: Analysts Recommend High‑Dividend Stocks such as BMRI, PTBA and PGAS as IHSG Slides Near 8,271
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 8,271 on Feb 20, 2026, marking an 8.20% monthly correction and a 4.34% year‑to‑date decline, leading analysts to favor high‑dividend stocks like BMRI, PTBA, PGAS and TLKM, which offer yields up to about 12% (BMRI DPR 78%, PTBA DPR 75.04% with 12.69% yield, PGAS DPR 80.57% with 8.31% yield). Analysts from Mirae Asset, Kiwoom and KISI suggest accumulating these dividend‑rich banks and commodity firms through the March‑May 2026 payout window to stabilize portfolios.

title: Harta Djaya Karya pays Rp12 billion down‑payment for 45 % stake in Trimata Coal Perkasa
body: Harta Djaya Karya has paid a total down‑payment of Rp12 billion for its planned acquisition of a 45 % stake in Trimata Coal Perkasa, a deal valued at Rp1.6 trillion, with the amount to be deducted from the final purchase price pending KJPP valuation. Trimata Coal Perkasa holds about 11,640 ha of coal concessions in South Sumatra with an estimated 693.7 million tonnes of mineable resources, supporting a long‑term open‑pit mining outlook.

title: Bank Mandiri posts strong January 2026 growth in credit, assets and digital transactions
body: Bank Mandiri reported a 15.62% year‑on‑year increase in credit to Rp1,511.4 trillion and a 13.96% rise in total assets to Rp2,191.9 trillion in January 2026, supported by a 17.29% jump in third‑party funds and improved cost efficiency. The bank also highlighted double‑digit gains in net interest income, fee‑based income, and digital transaction volumes through Livin’ by Mandiri, Kopra by Mandiri and Livin’ Merchant, while keeping the non‑performing loan ratio at 0.97%.

title: PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk sees positive outlook as it expands land bank and refinery capacity, prompting BUY recommendations
body: PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana Tbk acquired 63.4% of PT Sawit Mandiri Lestari for Rp1.6 trillion, raising its land bank to about 136 000 ha and adding young high‑yield palm trees and two 135 MT/h palm oil mills, while its second refinery is 70% complete and will bring total refining capacity to 4 000 MT/day. Analysts at Mirae Asset Sekuritas and MNC Sekuritas project structural profit growth to 2028, citing higher fresh fruit bunch yields, improved oil extraction rates, lower net gearing and stronger interest‑coverage, and both issue BUY recommendations with target prices of 2 300 and 2 000 respectively.

title: Buma Internasional Grup secures long‑term mining services contract with Adaro Indonesia
body: Buma Internasional Grup, through its subsidiary Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama, signed a long‑term mining services contract with Adaro Indonesia on 20 February 2026 for the South Cover Mine area in Tanjung Tabalong, South Kalimantan. The contract runs from 1 April 2026 to 31 December 2030, covering approximately 239 million bcm of overburden removal and 44 million tonnes of coal, and is expected to boost Buma Internasional's financial and operational performance.

title: Matra Tri Abadi expands its stake in Folago Global Nusantara to 60.46% after a Rp62.53 billion share purchase
body: Matra Tri Abadi purchased 102,514 million Folago Global Nusantara shares at Rp610 each, spending Rp62.53 billion and raising its holding to 3.74 billion shares (60.46%). Following the transaction, Folago shares rose 0.82% to Rp615, up 7.89% over the past five days.

title: Prima Globalindo to divest 45.79% of Armada Berjaya for roughly Rp44.6 billion
body: Prima Globalindo announced the divestiture of its 45.79% stake (365.6 million shares) in Armada Berjaya for an expected proceeds of about Rp44.6 billion, with a payment schedule of 40% by July 2026 and the remainder by December 2026. The sale, subject to OJK regulations and a shareholders vote on 4 March 2026, is intended to refocus on core operations and improve cash flow amid declining freight rates and rising costs.

title: Jimmy Budiarto sells 622.8 million J Resources Asia shares, reducing his stake to 87.65%
body: Jimmy Budiarto disposed of 622,844,400 J Resources Asia shares, a transaction valued at roughly Rp384.79 billion based on the Rp560 closing price on 19 February 2026, with the assistance of Ciptadana Sekuritas Asia, Artha Sekuritas Indonesia and Shinhan Sekuritas Indonesia. After the sale, his holding fell to 23.19 billion shares, representing 87.65 % of the company, down from about 90 % previously.

title: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. buy Shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk
body: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. purchased an additional 357,070,000 shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (SUPA.JK) for investment, raising its holding from 4,485,572,495 to 4,842,642,495 shares. The buys were executed on 6 Feb at IDR 899 per share, and on 18 and 23 Feb at IDR 1,100 per share. The transaction increases the shareholder’s stake and signals confidence in the bank’s outlook.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 20 February 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased 91,600 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) at IDR 154 per share as part of an investment strategy. The transaction raised his holding from 2,717,360 to 2,808,960 shares, a net increase of 91,600 shares. The purchase reflects a direct increase in insider ownership, signaling confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Yessie Dianty Yosetya buy Shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: Shareholder Yessie Dianty Yosetya purchased 140,000 shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk at approximately IDR 3,280 per share on 23 Feb 2026, increasing her stake from 2,241,900 to 2,381,900 shares (+140,000). The buy, recorded as a purchase purpose, reflects confidence in the telecom firm and modestly raises the insider holding.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Investor Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased 1,182,600 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) for investment purposes. The transaction, executed at a representative price of IDR 1,540 per share, raised his holding from 206,662,122 to 207,844,722 shares, a net increase of 1,182,600 shares.
