This addition signals confidence in the cybersecurity firm and may influence market perception among Indonesian investors.

title: BNI Sekuritas projects IHSG breakout above 8,450 amid foreign buying and recommends select stocks
body: BNI Sekuritas expects the Indonesian composite index (IHSG) to attempt a breakout above the 8,450‑8,500 resistance, with support around 8,320‑8,350, after a 1.5% gain and net foreign buying of Rp1.1 trillion that favored PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT Aneka Tambang Persero Tbk and PT Timah Tbk. The firm also recommends PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (target Rp1,080‑1,130), PT Aneka Tambang Persero Tbk (target Rp4,420‑4,500) and speculative buys on PT Petrosea Tbk and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk, while warning of short‑term volatility and limited correction risk.

title: Foreign investors shift to selective Indonesian stocks as net buying resumes in February 2026
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) rose 0.7% last week, ending four consecutive weeks of net foreign selling, as foreign investors posted a net buy of Rp343 billion in the third week of February 2026 but still recorded an outflow of Rp6.5 trillion for the month to 20 Feb. Their buying was concentrated in BMRI (Rp1.9 trillion), UNTR (Rp449.3 billion), BBTN, BRMS and AMRT, while BBCA and BUMI were the top net‑sell stocks.

title: Grab's investment arm A5-DB Holdings purchases 357.07 million shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia, raising its stake to 14.29%
body: A5-DB Holdings bought 357.07 million PT Super Bank Indonesia shares in three transactions in February 2026 for a total of Rp361 billion, increasing its ownership from 13.23% to 14.29%. The bank’s other shareholders include PT Kudo Teknologi Indonesia, Grup Emtek via PT Elang Media Visitama, Singtel Alpha Investment Pte Ltd, KakaoBank Corp and GXS Bank Pte Ltd.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold 14,900 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) on 23 February 2026 at IDR 545.0 per share, reducing his holding from 14,986,459 to 14,971,559 shares. The transaction was a routine share sale, not part of a larger restructuring, and reflects a modest divestment by the shareholder. The change slightly lowers Liem’s stake but does not materially affect the company’s ownership structure.

title: Indonesia's OJK finalizes gold‑backed ETF regulations pending Ministry of Law approval
body: The OJK announced that the draft POJK governing gold Exchange Traded Funds is in its final stage and awaits harmonisation approval from the Ministry of Law, after which it will become effective. The proposed rules require at least 95% of the fund’s net asset value to be invested in gold (physical or electronic) meeting 99% SNI or 99.5% LBMA purity standards, limit cash holdings to 5%, and introduce Electronic Gold Certificates as the non‑physical ownership proof.

title: Sutiadi Widjaja buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: On 23 February 2026, shareholder Sutiadi Widjaja purchased 100,100 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK) at an average price of IDR 16,000 per share, increasing his stake from 114,159,200 to 114,259,300 shares. The transaction was made for investment purposes and represents a modest 0.09% increase in holdings, underscoring continued confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange lifts trading suspension on PT PP Properti Tbk after bond interest payment
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) lifted the trading suspension on PT PP Properti Tbk, a subsidiary of PT PP Persero Tbk, after the company satisfied its February 17 2026 bond‑interest obligation. The shares, which had been locked since October 15 2024 due to a delayed Rp4.33 billion interest payment and a temporary PKPU filing, rose about 9.5% to Rp23 in the first session after the suspension was removed.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspends trading of PT Wanteg Sekuritas following a voluntary request
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) announced a voluntary suspension of trading activities for PT Wanteg Sekuritas effective from the opening session on 24 February 2026. The broker, whose net working capital fell to Rp27.14 billion and posted a cumulative loss of Rp8.04 billion in Q3 2025, will remain inactive until further notice.

title: PT Soho Global Health Tbk appoints former PT Kereta Api Indonesia chief Ignasius Jonan as President Commissioner
body: PT Soho Global Health Tbk announced the appointment of former PT Kereta Api Indonesia chief Ignasius Jonan as President Commissioner and independent commissioner, replacing Eng Liang Tan, with a five‑year term ending 23 February 2031. The shareholders also approved five new retail business activities, including traditional medicine, food, tobacco, pharmaceutical and laboratory equipment, and other mixed‑goods trading.

title: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk posts 8.4% net profit rise in 2025 and targets diversification into medical and heavy‑equipment sectors for 2026
body: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk reported a 8.43% YoY increase in net profit to IDR 2.2 trillion in 2025, with revenue of IDR 19.90 trillion, EPS of IDR 457, cash of IDR 4.53 trillion and a stronger balance sheet, while PT Astra International Tbk noted a 7.1% drop in domestic car sales prompting the group to accelerate diversification into medical devices, heavy‑equipment and mining components in 2026.

title: Bisnis-27 Index Opens Slightly Higher as Leading Stocks Gain, While BNI Sekuritas Forecasts IHSG Breakout Amid Global Market Weakness
body: The Bisnis-27 index opened higher on Tuesday, rising 0.12% to 551.17 with 13 of its 27 constituents gaining, led by PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk up 3.31% to 2,500, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk up 1.82% to 4,470 and PT Barito Pacific Tbk up 1.40% to 2,170, while several banks such as PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk showed modest moves. BNI Sekuritas expects the broader IHSG to attempt a breakout above the 8,450‑8,500 resistance zone, noting support around 8,320‑8,350 and warning of short‑term volatility, as global markets slipped with the Dow down 1.66% on AI‑related concerns and US tariff policy uncertainty.

title: Antam gold buyback price jumps 20.93% YTD amid global gold rally
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rose 20.93% year‑to‑date to Rp2,854 million, still below its all‑time high of Rp2,989 million, mirroring a 2.3‑2.9% increase in global spot and futures gold prices. Buybacks exceeding Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) withholding tax under PMK No 34/PMK.10/2017.

title: Indonesia's composite index rises 1.5% and analysts recommend PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk, PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk and PT Soechi Lines Tbk
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) gained 1.5% to 8,396 on Tuesday, supported by net foreign buying of Rp1.1 trillion and a 10% January M2 growth, while BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analysts issued buy ratings for PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (target Rp945‑1,035), PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk (target Rp290‑316) and PT Soechi Lines Tbk (target Rp800‑920) and a sell rating for PT MNC Tourism Indonesia Tbk.

title: PT Mega Manunggal Property Tbk reports revenue growth but sharp net profit decline in 2025
body: PT Mega Manunggal Property Tbk posted revenue of Rp355.65 billion in 2025, up 3.6% YoY, driven by warehouse and office rentals, with major tenants PT Lastana Express Indonesia and PT DHL Supply Chain Indonesia contributing Rp80 billion and Rp55.3 billion respectively. However, net profit fell to Rp63.2 billion, a 73.9% drop from Rp241.83 billion in 2024, after the prior year's Rp200.25 billion fair‑value gain on investment properties, and the company now reports assets of Rp6.61 trillion, liabilities of Rp1.83 trillion and equity of Rp4.78 trillion under its new parent PT Saka Industrial Arjaya, controlled by PT Astra International Tbk of Jardine Matheson Holdings Limited.

title: Indonesia's IHSG jumps 1.5% to 8,396 as foreign inflows resume and US tariff outlook shifts
body: The Indonesian composite index (IHSG) closed up 1.5% at 8,396.08 on Feb 23 2026, its highest level since Jan 28, while foreign investors logged four consecutive days of net buying totaling roughly Rp3.16 trillion, despite a YTD net sell of Rp13.27 trillion, amid mixed reactions to the US Supreme Court’s partial rollback of Trump tariffs. Analysts from Kiwoom Sekuritas, Pilarmas Investindo Sekuritas and Phintraco Sekuritas see short‑term upside but warn of policy uncertainty, recommending consumer non‑cyclical, energy, property and basic materials stocks such as PT Mayora Indah Tbk, PT Elnusa Tbk, PT AKR Corporindo Tbk, PT Semen Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Pyridam Farma Tbk and PT Semen Baturaja Persero Tbk.

title: Analysts project stronger earnings for PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Persero Tbk as it expands midstream and downstream operations
body: Ajaib Sekuritas and RHB Sekuritas both see PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Persero Tbk benefiting from a higher LNG share (18‑20% by 2026) and 3‑4% annual volume growth, giving buy and neutral ratings with price targets of IDR 2,500 and IDR 2,100 respectively, while Danantara directs the firm toward midstream and downstream activities to support national energy security.

title: Bone Regency and Tiran Nusantara Group discuss IDR 1.7 trillion Tonra Container Port project
body: Vice Regent of Bone Andi Akmal Pasluddin met with Tiran Nusantara Group, whose President Director Rahman Arif presented a IDR 1.7 trillion plan to build a public port in Bone Pute Village, to be constructed by PT AAS Gemilang Mandiri as a logistics hub for the nickel industry. Officials emphasized the need for road access, job creation, environmental safeguards and received technical input from regional and national transport agencies.

title: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama signs long‑term contract with PT Adaro Indonesia to deliver overburden and coal at South Tutupan Mine
body: PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama, the principal subsidiary of PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk, signed a five‑year contract with PT Adaro Indonesia effective 1 April 2026 to deliver about 239 million bank cubic metres of overburden and 44 Mt of coal at the South Tutupan Mine, averaging 50.5 million bcm and 9.3 Mt per year. The agreement reinforces a 20‑year partnership, strengthens BUMA’s contracted revenue base and includes community development programs in Tabalong.

title: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk to acquire 45% of PT Trimitra Coal Perkasa in IDR 1.6 trillion deal
body: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk announced plans to acquire a 45% stake in PT Trimitra Coal Perkasa for an estimated IDR 1.6 trillion—about 15 times its June 2025 total assets of IDR 107.08 billion—through a staged share‑swap that aims to begin in Q3 2026, with valuation based on a DCF model using a $26 per ton coal price. The transaction will not change the controlling shareholders, and TCP holds 11,640 ha of coal concessions in South Sumatra with an estimated 693.7 million tons of mineable resources and a standby buyer Argo Energy Pte Ltd of the Banpu Group.

title: Indonesia and the United States sign a tariff pact to lift export limits on processed critical minerals while keeping raw‑ore bans in place
body: The reciprocal tariff agreement signed by President Prabowo Subianto and President Donald Trump removes Indonesia's export restrictions on processed industrial commodities, including critical minerals, and pledges accelerated downstream cooperation and US investment in rare‑earth and other strategic minerals. Indonesian officials, including Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto and ESDM leaders Tri Winarno and Dadan Kusdiana, stressed that the raw‑ore export ban under Law No. 3/2020 will remain unchanged and that the partnership will focus on processing, technology transfer and investment.

title: Freeport-McMoran and Indonesia sign MOU to extend Freeport Indonesia’s mining permit beyond 2041
body: Freeport-McMoran and its Indonesian unit Freeport Indonesia signed a memorandum of understanding to extend the latter’s mining permit past 2041, announced by chairman Richard Adkerson at a US Chamber of Commerce event in Washington attended by President Prabowo Subianto. Prabowo used the occasion to emphasize stronger US‑Indonesia ties and to pursue a lower tariff in a prospective trade deal.

title: PT Soho Global Health Tbk appoints former minister Ignasius Jonan as President Commissioner
body: At its extraordinary shareholders meeting on 23 February 2026, PT Soho Global Health Tbk appointed former transport and energy minister Ignasius Jonan as President Commissioner and Independent Commissioner, while Eng Liang Tan was removed from the President Commissioner role. Jonan previously led PT KAI, PT Bahana Pembinaan Usaha Indonesia and serves on the boards of PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk and PT United Tractors Tbk.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange flags three stocks for Unusual Market Activity amid volatile price swings
body: Indonesia's Stock Exchange placed PT Kota Satu Properti Tbk, PT Sekar Bumi Tbk and PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk under Unusual Market Activity status on 24 February, urging investors to review each issuer's performance and disclosures. After the announcement, PT Sekar Bumi Tbk rose 6.10% to Rp1,130, PT Kota Satu Properti Tbk edged up 2.38% to Rp258, while PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk fell 9.44% to Rp1,630, hitting an Auto Rejection Bottom after recent strong gains.

title: Astra Otoparts AUTO posts 8.4% profit growth in 2025
body: Astra Otoparts AUTO reported a 2025 net profit of Rp2.2 trillion, an 8.37% increase from the prior year, with earnings per share rising to Rp457 and net revenue reaching Rp19.9 trillion, up 4.35%. Total assets grew to Rp22.61 trillion and equity to Rp16.96 trillion, while liabilities rose to Rp5.65 trillion.

title: Adira Finance plans Rp2.5 trillion of sustainable bonds and sukuk issuance in 2026
body: Adira Finance announced a Rp2.5 trillion sustainable financing program for 2026, comprising a Rp2 trillion conventional bond (Series A, B, C) and a Rp500 billion sukuk mudharabah (Series A and B). The bonds carry coupons of 4.8%–5.95% with maturities from 370 days to 60 months, while the sukuk offer profit‑sharing equivalents of 4.8% and 5.75% and will be used for consumer financing and motor‑vehicle financing under murabahah, with issuance and listing slated for late February 2026.

title: Widodo Unggas plans 6.1 billion-share rights issue pending approval at an extraordinary meeting on April 2, 2026
body: Widodo Unggas WMUU will issue 6.1 billion new shares with a nominal value of Rp50, subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 2 April 2026. Part of the proceeds will come from converting receivable rights of Widodo Makmur Perkasa WMPP, with the remainder earmarked for working capital to improve leverage and competitiveness, while Widodo Perkasa is expected to participate in the issue.

title: BTN emphasizes service expansion and profit growth ahead of 2026
body: BTN highlighted the strengthening of its BTN Private and BTN Prioritas services under an "investment with purpose" strategy, citing 2025 profit of Rp3.5 trillion—a 16.4% year‑on‑year increase—as a key foundation for 2026. The "Kuda Api" philosophy, linking hard work and burning spirit, is presented as aligned with BTN's ongoing transformation.

title: PT Summit Oto Finance reports revenue of Rp4.27 trillion but posts a loss for 2025
body: PT Summit Oto Finance posted revenue of Rp4.27 trillion for the year ended 31 December 2025, up from Rp3.98 trillion a year earlier, while its expenses rose to Rp4.92 trillion, resulting in a pre‑tax loss of Rp640.85 billion and a net loss of Rp505.28 billion. Total assets increased to Rp16.58 trillion and liabilities to Rp13.24 trillion.

title: PT PP Persero Tbk launches five CSR projects to restore flood‑hit infrastructure in Aceh
body: PT PP Persero Tbk (PTPP) and its parent Danantara Indonesia carried out five strategic CSR programs in Aceh from 4-14 February 2026, focusing on mosque renovation, clean‑water installation, public toilets and other flood‑damaged facilities in Bireuen, Pidie Jaya and Peusangan. The initiative follows earlier emergency bridge installations and temporary housing projects undertaken with the Ministry of Public Works.

title: PT Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa Tbk expands RFID offerings and global market focus, backs plan with Rp100 billion capex
body: PT Jasuindo Tiga Perkasa Tbk is accelerating diversification by expanding its RFID product line, adding security packaging capacity and forming a joint venture with a Hong Kong partner for RFID components to capture higher‑margin brand‑protection demand. The company allocated Rp100 billion in capex for machine maintenance and new equipment to sustain solid sales growth and broaden its export market.

title: Director Fancy Marsiana sells all of her shares in PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Fancy Marsiana sold her entire holding of 37.5 million shares in PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk on 20 February 2026 at Rp40 per share, cutting her stake from 2.4% to zero. MEDS management said the transaction was a direct divestment.

title: PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk Shareholder Kuantum Akselerasi Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Kuantum Akselerasi Indonesia reduced its stake in PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk on 4 Feb 2026, disposing 16,544,200 shares. The holding fell from 2,265,649,800 to 2,249,105,600 shares, a decrease of 0.73%. No transaction price was disclosed. The adjustment reflects a modest shift in the shareholder's ownership level, which may slightly affect voting power but is unlikely to materially impact the company's capital structure.

title: Andrew Phillip Starkey buy Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: Investor Andrew Phillip Starkey purchased 100,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk at IDR 3,340 per share on 23 Feb 2026, increasing his stake from 4,031,700 to 4,131,700 shares (a net gain of 100,000 shares). The transaction, recorded as an investment, raises his ownership percentage marginally and signals confidence in the mining firm’s prospects.

title: Turniady Widjaja buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja purchased an additional 300 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK) for investment purposes, at a representative price of IDR 16,250 per share. The holding increased from 50,430,300 to 50,430,600 shares, a net gain of 300 shares. The transaction represents a marginal change in ownership and is unlikely to affect the company's control or market perception.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Buy Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia executed a REPO purchase of 123,511,600 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 130 per share on 13 Feb 2026. The holding rose from 7,937,223,000 to 8,060,734,600 shares, reflecting a net increase of 123,511,600 shares. The transaction expands the shareholder's stake and adds liquidity to the market, which may be noteworthy for investors tracking ownership changes in Sentul City Tbk.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buy Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 36,878,300 PT MD Entertainment Tbk shares at IDR 6,300 per share on 12 Feb 2026 under a REPO arrangement, raising its holding from 736,537,100 to 773,415,400 shares (an increase of 36,878,300 shares). The transaction expands the shareholder's stake in the listed entertainment company, signaling confidence in the firm's valuation and potentially supporting liquidity in the market.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buy Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 88,119,900 shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk on 13 Feb 2026 at IDR 6,300 per share under a REPO arrangement. The holding rose from 773,415,400 to 861,535,300 shares, increasing the shareholder’s stake by 11.4%. The transaction reflects a strategic liquidity move and raises the investor’s influence in the listed entertainment firm.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of Sentul City Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold 480,241,300 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 130 per share on 12 Feb 2026 as part of a REPO transaction. The shareholder's stake fell from 8,417,464,300 shares to 7,937,223,000 shares, a decline of 480,241,300 shares, indicating a modest reduction in its holding and providing liquidity to the market.

title: Yacobus Jemmy Hartanto buy Shares of PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk
body: Yacobus Jemmy Hartanto purchased a net 610,300 shares of PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk at a representative price of IDR 202 per share on 23 Feb 2026, increasing his holding from 254,606,300 to 255,216,600 shares (+0.24%). The transaction, recorded as a change of ownership, reflects a modest stake increase by the shareholder.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold a total of 120,300 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk on 24 Feb 2026, at a representative price of IDR 540 per share. His holding decreased from 14,971,559 to 14,851,259 shares, a reduction of 120,300 shares. The purpose is listed as a share sale. The transaction represents a modest dilution of his stake and may signal portfolio rebalancing, but does not affect the company's capital structure.

title: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. buy Shares of PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk
body: A5-Db Holdings Pte. Ltd. purchased an additional 253,914,400 PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk shares for investment, raising its holding from 4,842,642,495 to 5,096,556,895 shares. The transactions were executed on 24‑25 Feb 2026 at prices of IDR 1,100 and IDR 1,150 per share, respectively, with a representative price of IDR 1,150 per share. The acquisition increases the shareholder’s stake and reflects confidence in the bank’s growth prospects.

title: Bakrie Capital Indonesia buy Shares of PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk.
body: Bakrie Capital Indonesia purchased 3,822,619,800 shares of PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk. at IDR 248.0 per share on 24 February 2026, raising its stake from 0 to 3,822,619,800 shares. The transaction, recorded as an investment, signals the group’s entry into the infrastructure sector and may improve liquidity and market visibility for the company.

title: PT Visi Media Asia Tbk Shareholder Credit Suisse Trust Limited Sebagai Wali Amanat Dari Great Lotus Trust Reports New Transaction
body: Credit Suisse Trust Limited Sebagai Wali Amanat Dari Great Lotus Trust has divested its entire indirect holding in PT Visi Media Asia Tbk. The transaction, a diversion/divestment, removed 864,197,000 shares from the shareholder’s portfolio, reducing its stake from 864,197,000 to zero. The sale was executed on 16 January 2026 and finalized in the filing dated 25 February 2026. This full divestment reduces the shareholder’s exposure to VIVA.JK and may influence liquidity and market perception, though the company’s overall ownership structure remains unchanged.

title: PT PP Properti Tbk shares surge 8.7% after suspension lifted, reporting sharp reduction in net loss and improved equity
body: PT PP Properti Tbk's shares jumped 8.70% to Rp25 on Feb 25 after the Indonesia Stock Exchange lifted a trading suspension that had been in place since October 2024. The company posted a net loss of Rp37.02 billion for Q3 2025, a 94.86% decline from the prior year, with financial expenses falling 79.71% YoY and equity rising 436.53% to Rp11.78 trillion.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk acquires majority stakes in PT Vista Maritim Asia and PT Nusantara Arung Samudera
body: PT Petrosea Tbk, through its indirect subsidiaries PT Petrosindo Sinergi Alur and PT Petrosindo Sinergi Samudera, bought 55% of PT Vista Maritim Asia and 55% of PT Nusantara Arung Samudera for Rp550 million each. The transactions give PT Petrosea a 55% holding in each company, with the remaining shares held by PT Adamas Indonesia Energi (31.5%) and PT Wisesa Maritim Nusantara (13.5%).

title: Leadership vacuum widens at Indonesia Investment Authority amid ongoing investment commitments
body: Indonesia Investment Authority (INA) faces a deepening leadership gap after CIO Andry Setiawan resigned, leaving the CEO post vacant and CFO Eddy Porwanto serving as interim CEO and CRO, while other board seats remain temporarily filled. Despite the turmoil, INA has deployed more than US$4.5 billion across sectors, secured US$2.75 billion in joint‑venture commitments from Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and APG Asset Management NV, and participated in financing deals including a US$2 billion DayOne Data Centers round, a US$250 million loan to Chandra Asri Pacific, and a US$300 million funding for Traveloka Indonesia, as the state wealth fund Danantara expands its cash pool to about Rp16 trillion.

title: IHSG may correct to 8,230‑8,150 amid external risks as BRI Danareksa Sekuritas issues mixed stock recommendations
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is expected to test minor support at 8,230‑8,150 after a 1.37% drop to 8,280, with foreign investors net buying Rp621.89 billion and external factors such as the US‑Iran talks and Fed rate uncertainty influencing sentiment. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analysts recommend buying PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk at Rp830‑870 (target Rp945‑1,035), PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk above Rp1,590 (target Rp1,630‑1,685), PT WIR Asia Tbk at Rp90‑93 (target Rp97‑102) and advise selling PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk.

title: Danantara celebrates one year and sets aggressive BUMN restructuring and investment targets
body: BPI Danantara marked its first anniversary by outlining a restructuring plan for Indonesia’s state‑owned enterprises that aims to reduce the BUMN count from about 1,000 to 300, raise consolidated net profit to roughly Rp350 trillion in 2026 and invest US$25.1 billion in downstream mineral and energy projects, with a 7% ROA target. The plan highlights recent cost‑cutting at PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk, operational revival at PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk and debt reduction at PT Krakatau Steel Persero Tbk, while analysts note the 7% ROA goal is far above the current 1.88% average.

title: PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk establishes PT Tradisi Baru Bakeri with Rp60 billion authorized capital
body: PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk created a new subsidiary, PT Tradisi Baru Bakeri, on 20 February 2026 with an authorized capital of Rp60 billion divided into 60,000 shares, of which 25% (15,000 shares) have been fully paid. PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk holds 55.5% of PT Tradisi Baru Bakeri, while PT Jumi Sarikencono (20%), PT Sriboga Raturaya (10%), PT Yummyfoo Dutama (1%) and other individual shareholders own the remainder.

title: Wahana Multiartha WOMF reports 45.8% drop in 2025 net profit amid flat revenue
body: Wahana Multiartha WOMF recorded a 2025 net profit of Rp142.55 billion, down 45.77% year‑on‑year, and earnings per share fell to Rp40.95 from Rp75.52. Total revenue was Rp2.16 trillion, up only 0.13%, while total assets rose to Rp7.36 trillion and liabilities increased to Rp5.38 trillion.

title: Kuantum Akselerasi Indonesia sells 16.5 million VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas shares, reducing its stake to 5.14%
body: Kuantum Akselerasi Indonesia disposed of 16.54 million shares of VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas on 4 February 2026, a transaction that, based on the closing price of Rp790, is valued at roughly Rp13.07 billion and cuts its holding to 2.24 billion shares (5.14% of the company). VKTR’s share price fell 75 points (7.18%) to Rp970, marking a 160‑point (14.16%) decline from the 26 January 2026 level of Rp1,130.

title: Pelayaran Ekalya secures Rp395.2 billion loan from Bank Mandiri Kota Balikpapan for new offshore vessels
body: Pelayaran Ekalya received a Rp395.2 billion credit facility from Bank Mandiri Kota Balikpapan, comprising an investment credit IX of Rp280 billion for six vessels supporting the Layar Nusantara Gas contract and an investment credit X of Rp115.2 billion for four additional offshore support vessels or crew boats. The loan, secured by the financed vessels and backed by an 18‑year FLNG contract in Teluk Bintuni, will raise the company's liabilities but provides long‑term revenue certainty.

title: Palma Serasih suspends CEO Budiono Tanbun amid personal legal proceedings, appoints interim director
body: Palma Serasih announced that its chief executive, Budiono Tanbun, has been temporarily removed while he faces a personal criminal or civil case, and the board has appointed an interim CEO pending a shareholders’ meeting. The company assured that operations, production, sales, and payments to creditors and employees remain unaffected.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia expands its stake in MD Entertainment with a 124.99 million‑share purchase
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia bought a total of 124.99 million shares of MD Entertainment (FILM) on 12‑13 Feb 2026 at 6,300 IDR per share, spending about 787.5 billion IDR and raising its stake to 861.53 million shares (7.91% of the company). After the purchases, MD Entertainment’s share price was 7,425 IDR, down 2.62% on the day and about 39.8% lower year‑to‑date from early February.

title: Bukit Uluwatu Villa announces a 50 billion‑share right issue representing 203.11% of its capital
body: Bukit Uluwatu Villa announced a right issue of 50 billion shares, equal to 203.11 % of its current share capital and fully paid at a nominal Rp50 per share, with proceeds earmarked for land purchases, asset development, acquisitions, organic growth and debt repayment. Management warned that shareholders who do not exercise their rights could face dilution of up to 67.01 % and the proposal will be submitted for approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 26 February 2026 (record date 3 February 2026).

title: Indonesia launches second foreign‑yuan bond issue amid fiscal concerns, targeting up to $4 billion
body: Indonesia began marketing its second foreign‑yuan bond offering, a three‑tranche (3‑, 5‑ and 10‑year) issue that could be complemented by a euro‑denominated tranche, targeting $3‑$4 billion to refinance maturing debt. Mega Capital strategist Lionel Priyadi noted the fiscal‑risk backdrop, citing a rare January budget deficit and Moody's downgrade of the country's credit outlook to negative.

title: PT Visi Media Asia Tbk Shareholder Credit Suisse Trust Limited Sebagai Wali Amanat Dari Great Lotus Trust Reports New Transaction
body: Credit Suisse Trust Limited, acting as trustee for Great Lotus Trust, disposed its entire holding of PT Visi Media Asia Tbk (VIVA.JK) shares on 16 Jan 2026, transferring 864,197,000 shares (IDR 864,197,000) and reducing its stake from 864,197,000 shares to zero. The divestment is classified as a diversion/divestment of an indirect investment in the Indonesian capital market, indicating a complete exit by the shareholder.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher increased his stake in PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) by buying 5,714,100 shares for investment. The purchases were executed on 20 Feb 2026 at IDR 1,503 per share and on 23 Feb 2026 at IDR 1,505 per share, raising his holding from 207,844,722 to 213,558,822 shares, a net increase of 5,714,100 shares.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: On 23 Feb 2026, Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sold 468,187,300 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk at IDR 51 per share as part of a reverse REPO transaction. The holding decreased from 1,230,187,300 to 762,000,000 shares, reducing the shareholder's stake by approximately 38%. The sale reflects a liquidity‑recycling operation rather than a strategic divestment, and its size may modestly impact the free‑float but is unlikely to alter control dynamics.

title: Bahana Sekuritas forecasts stronger Ramadan demand for poultry, recommending overweight positions in PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk and PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk
body: Bahana Sekuritas expects Ramadan‑driven demand to lift poultry prices, citing 2025 livestock subsector GDP growth of 12.4% YoY and stronger fiscal spending, and therefore recommends overweight positions in PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk and PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk. The firm sets target prices of Rp2,590 for PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk and Rp4,490 for PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk, while Bloomberg Terminal and other analysts issue buy ratings implying potential returns of roughly 26‑29%.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price climbs 18.72% YTD but stays below its recent all‑time high
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rose 18.72% year‑to‑date to Rp2,802,000 per gram on Feb 25, 2026, still below its all‑time high of Rp2,989,000 reached in late January. The increase aligns with modest gains in global spot and COMEX gold prices (around US$5,150‑5,205 per ounce) as the Federal Reserve signals steady interest rates and geopolitical tensions rise.

title: Kiwoom and Indo Premier analysts highlight strong fundamentals and target prices for major Indonesian state‑owned banks amid Danantara's transformation
body: Kiwoom Securities analyst Miftahul Khaer recommends accumulating PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk with a 12‑month target of Rp4,500 and PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk with a target of Rp6,250, citing Danantara’s asset‑restructuring and the banking sector’s role in the government’s downstream programs. Indo Premier analyst David Kurniawan adds that major state‑owned banks such as PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk, PT Bank Tabungan Negara Persero Tbk and others are expected to post moderate profit growth, while PT Aneka Tambang Persero Tbk could see a valuation re‑rating from nickel downstream projects.

title: Pegadaian lists buyback prices for Galeri 24 and UBS gold on May 25, 2026
body: Pegadaian posted buyback rates for Galeri 24 and UBS gold on Wednesday, May 25, 2026, ranging from Rp1,445,000 for 0.5‑gram UBS to Rp2,865,367,000 for 1,000‑gram Galeri 24. The prices are available for purchase both at physical outlets and via the Pegadaian Digital app, which requires opening a gold savings account.

title: Moody's assigns Baa2 with negative outlook to Indonesia's planned offshore yuan and euro bond issuance
body: Moody's rated Indonesia's upcoming offshore global bonds in Chinese renminbi and euro Baa2 with a negative outlook, part of a $10 billion sovereign debt program, and appointed Bank of China Hong Kong Limited, Deutsche Bank AG London Branch and The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited as joint lead managers. Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia analyst Jessica Tasijawa noted the rating confirms investment‑grade status but highlights rising policy‑risk and market volatility that could lift sovereign risk premiums and funding costs.

title: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk obtains a Rp395.2 billion investment credit facility from PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk
body: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk secured a total Rp395.2 billion investment credit facility from PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, comprising Rp280 billion for six vessels (OSV/OSB, harbour tug, crew boat, pilot boat) for a PT Layar Nusantara Gas contract and Rp115.2 billion for four additional offshore support or crew boats. The facility is backed by an 18‑year FLNG contract in Teluk Bintuni, providing assured revenue and strengthening the company's going‑concern position.

title: Indonesia's composite index faces further correction as major banks show mixed performance
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) slipped 1.37% to 8,280, prompting MNC Sekuritas to warn of potential downside to the 8,149‑8,217 range, while 596 stocks closed lower and only 163 stayed in the green zone. PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk fell, whereas PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT Bank Permata Tbk and PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk rose, and MNC Sekuritas recommended buying ERAA and MBMA while noting selling pressure on RAJA and RATU.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk expands maritime business by acquiring majority stakes in PT Vista Maritim Asia and PT Nusantara Arung Samudera
body: On 24 February 2026, PT Petrosea Tbk, through its subsidiaries PT Petrosindo Sinergi Alur and PT Petrosindo Sinergi Samudera, acquired 55% of PT Vista Maritim Asia and PT Nusantara Arung Samudera for a nominal price of Rp550 million each. The transactions support the group’s pit‑to‑port integration strategy and are expected to enhance operational synergies.

title: PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk outlines response to government coal quota cuts and confirms extended contract with PT Adaro Indonesia
body: PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk said it will coordinate early with clients as the government plans to reduce coal production quotas for 2026, but it has not received any directive to change its plans and will monitor the situation. The company also extended its mining services contract with PT Adaro Indonesia through 2030, targeting 239 million cubic meters of overburden removal and 44 million tonnes of coal production, averaging 50.5 million bcm and 9.3 million tonnes annually.

title: Bahana Sekuritas forecasts Ramadan-driven demand boost for Indonesian poultry stocks and issues overweight recommendations
body: Bahana Sekuritas expects Ramadan-driven demand to lift Indonesian poultry stocks, recommending an overweight stance on PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk (target Rp2,590) and PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (target Rp4,490) supported by strong seasonal demand and fiscal stimulus. Bloomberg analysts also rate CPIN a buy with a Rp5,711 target (28.9% upside) and JPFA with a Rp3,029 target (25.2% upside), while the shares closed at Rp4,360 and Rp2,420 respectively on 24 Feb 2026.

title: President Commissioner Ignasius Jonan resigns from PT Anabatic Technologies Tbk
body: Ignasius Jonan has submitted his resignation as President Commissioner of PT Anabatic Technologies Tbk, with the resignation to be decided at a shareholders meeting within 60 days of the 23 February 2026 letter. He was originally appointed to the role at the annual shareholders meeting on 1 July 2021.

title: PT Sarana Multigriya Finansial Persero launches IDR 2 trillion sustainable bond and IDR 808 billion sukuk in February 2026
body: PT Sarana Multigriya Finansial Persero announced the issuance of a IDR 2.0 trillion sustainable bond (Series A: IDR 995 billion at 4.75% for 370 days; Series B: IDR 1.01 trillion at 5.25% for two years) and a IDR 808 billion sustainable sukuk with a 4.75% equivalent yield for 370 days. The offering was open on 23‑24 February 2026, allocation on 25 February, listing on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on 2 March 2026, and is underwritten by Aldiracita Sekuritas, CIMB Niaga Sekuritas, DBS Vickers Sekuritas, Indopremier Sekuritas, Maybank Sekuritas, OCBC NISP Sekuritas and RHB Sekuritas.

title: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk reports 2025 earnings slump as average coal price falls 21%
body: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk said its 2025 revenue fell 18.35% YoY to US$1.88 billion and net profit dropped 48.96% YoY to US$190.94 million, driven by a 20.83% decline in average selling price to US$76 per ton. The company still increased coal production by 5% and sales volume by 3%, but domestic sales fell 25% and total assets stood at US$2.4 billion as of 31 December 2025.

title: Indonesia pushes downstream palm‑oil development to gain pricing power and boost export earnings
body: The government plans to divert up to 5 million tonnes of crude palm oil to domestic biofuel and other processing, using a flexible “open‑and‑close” strategy to manage supply and influence global prices, with projected export revenues of Rp 1,500 trillion from biofuel alone and up to Rp 5,000 trillion from processed palm‑oil products. Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman said the move aims to give Indonesia pricing power in the CPO market and create jobs while supporting President Prabowo’s target of 8% economic growth.

title: PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk posts 48.5% rise in 2025 net profit to Rp1.66 trillion
body: PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk reported 2025 after‑tax profit of Rp1.66 trillion, up 48.5% YoY, with pre‑tax profit of Rp2.22 trillion (↑38.9%) and improvements across interest and non‑interest income, operating efficiency and credit quality. Net interest income rose 1.6% to a 4.3% NIM, non‑interest income grew 8.1%, gross operating income reached Rp9.55 trillion (↑3.1%), provisioning fell 28.7%, NPL ratios improved to 2.2%/1.3%, and capital and liquidity ratios remained strong (CAR 27.3%, CET1 26.1%, LCR 175.8%).

title: PT Hillcon Tbk Shareholder Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia entered into a Repurchase Agreement (REPO) for PT Hillcon Tbk, selling 283,069,700 shares at IDR 41 per share on 25 Feb 2026. The holder's stake fell from 3,000,373,700 shares to 2,717,304,000 shares, a reduction of 283,069,700 shares. The transaction reflects a temporary transfer of shares under the REPO purpose and reduces the shareholder's direct ownership in the company.

title: Turniady Widjaja buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja purchased 600 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk on 25 February 2026 as an investment, raising his stake from 50,430,600 to 50,431,200 shares. The transaction was executed at a representative price of IDR 16,125 per share, resulting in a net increase of 600 shares. This modest buy adds a marginal percentage to the shareholder’s holding and does not materially affect control or market perception.

title: PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur signs MoU with PT Indogas Kriya Dwiguna for gas sales and Mini LNG plant development
body: On 24 February 2026, PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk signed a one‑year MoU with PT Indogas Kriya Dwiguna to purchase natural gas for delivery through its subsidiary PT Para Amartha LNG and to support a Mini LNG plant. The agreement, which does not affect PT Astrindo’s current financial statements, is intended to strengthen its energy portfolio and contribute to Indonesia’s gas infrastructure.

title: Jakarta Stock Index Rises 0.5% to 8,322.22 as Select Stocks Surge and Liquidity Support Extends
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed up 0.5% at 8,322.22 points, trading within a 8,259‑8,373 range and bringing total market capitalization to about Rp14,940 trillion. Top gainers included PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk up 17.78% to Rp318, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk up 2.58% to Rp3,970, PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk up 16.5% to Rp12,000, as well as PTRO, ANTM and TINS, while the finance minister announced a six‑month extension of a Rp200 trillion liquidity facility to support banks ahead of Ramadan.

title: PT Tamaris Hidro posts 28% revenue growth and 52% net profit increase in 2025, driven by acquisitions
body: PT Tamaris Hidro reported 2025 net revenue of Rp576.07 billion, a 28.2% increase from 2024, and net profit of Rp31.84 billion, up 52.12% year‑on‑year. The growth was supported by acquisitions, including a Rp73 billion purchase of a 16 MW mini‑hydro plant in North Sumatra where PT Patria Bakti Abadi and PT Grahaenergi Mitra Bersama acquired 100% of PT Thong Langkat Energi, and the group’s portfolio now includes subsidiaries such as PT Sanagan Energi, PT Patria Bakti Abadi, and PT Partogi Hidro Energi.

title: Several Indonesian listed companies announce multi‑billion‑rupiah acquisitions in early 2026
body: PT Petrosea Tbk acquired 55% stakes in PT Vista Maritim Asia and PT Nusantara Arung Samudera for Rp550 million each through its subsidiaries. PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk, PT Multitrend Indo Tbk and PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk also disclosed plans to buy 45% of PT Trimitra Coal Perkasa for Rp1.6 trillion, acquire PT Emway Globalindo for Rp269.98 billion via a rights issue and loan, and purchase 53.57% of PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk for Rp106.39 billion, respectively.

title: PT Soechi Lines Tbk reports 55% drop in 2025 net profit and announces five new shipping subsidiaries
body: PT Soechi Lines Tbk posted a 2025 net profit of US$7.66 million, down 55.28% YoY from US$17.13 million, with net revenue falling 6.64% to US$155.32 million and total assets of US$603.52 million. The firm also launched five wholly‑owned subsidiaries—PT Sejahtera Mega Armada, Great Sea International Ltd, Great Ocean Marine Ltd, Soechi Eternity Maritime - FZCO and Eternity Ocean Maritime Ltd—to target new markets, while its main 2025 customers were PT Pertamina International Shipping (US$42.89 million) and Pertamina International Shipping Pte Ltd (US$18.65 million).

title: IHSG Tests Support as Analyst Issues Buy Recommendations for PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk, PT Asuransi Harta Aman Pratama Tbk, PT Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk and Sell Signal for PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is testing support at 8,230‑8,150 with resistance near 8,430 after closing 0.5% higher at 8,322 on net foreign buying of roughly Rp1.18 trillion in PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, while investors await US‑Iran negotiations. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Reza Diofanda recommends buying PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (2,100‑2,150 target 2,220‑2,300), PT Asuransi Harta Aman Pratama Tbk (155‑165 target 174‑188) and PT Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk (150‑160 target 179‑199), and selling PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk due to a potential reversal.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange lifts suspensions on POLI, SKBM and MYTX, allowing trading to resume on 26 February 2026
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange lifted the one‑day trading suspensions on PT Pollux Hotels Group Tbk, PT Sekar Bumi Tbk and PT Asia Pacific Investama Tbk, allowing them to resume trading on 26 February 2026. The three stocks had surged sharply, with POLI up about 40% in five days (150.6% year‑to‑date), SKBM up 120% in five days (108.6% in the past month) and MYTX up 42.4% in five days (161.1% in the past month).

title: BNI Sekuritas forecasts continued IHSG gains and highlights buy ideas in PANI, JPFA, BULL, EMAS, ENRG and RAJA
body: BNI Sekuritas expects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to attempt further gains, citing a 0.5% rise to 8,322 on Feb 25 and net foreign buying of about Rp1.18 trillion, while noting that a break above 8,450 is needed to avoid a correction. The broker recommends buying PANI, JPFA, BULL, EMAS, ENRG and RAJA at specified levels, with foreign investors previously favoring BBRI, BBCA, UNTR, ADRO and ASII.

title: Indonesia's composite index expected to trade flat as investors await US‑Iran talks, buoyed by net foreign buying in major banks
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed up 0.5% at 8,322, supported by net foreign purchases of about Rp1.18 trillion focused on PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, while external sentiment was aided by a rebound in US equities and a modestly stronger rupiah. Analysts see the index confined between support at 8,230 and resistance near 8,430, recommend buying ADMR, AHAP and PADI and selling VISI, and note that safe‑haven gold remains above $5,150 per ounce as markets adopt a wait‑and‑see stance ahead of the US‑Iran Geneva talks.

title: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk reports 2025 revenue and profit decline amid lower global coal prices
body: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk posted 2025 net revenue of US$1.88 billion, an 18.35% YoY drop, and net profit of US$190.94 million, down 48.96% from the prior year, as coal prices weakened. Revenue came mainly from third‑party coal sales, with China Bai Gui International Trade Ltd and Marubeni Corporation among its top customers, while the company held assets of US$2.4 billion, liabilities of US$497.73 million and equity of US$1.9 billion at year‑end.

title: PT Fore Kopi Indonesia Tbk targets 100 new stores in 2026 amid strong Q3 revenue growth
body: PT Fore Kopi Indonesia Tbk plans to add 70 new Fore Coffee outlets and up to 30 Fore Donut stores in 2026, allocating about Rp2 billion per outlet and funding the expansion through internal cash flow and remaining IPO proceeds. The company reported Q3 2025 revenue of Rp1.04 trillion, a 43.22% YoY increase, and net profit of Rp60.10 billion, up 41.94% YoY, while operating 250 stores in Indonesia and Singapore.

title: Indonesia sees no IPOs in early 2026 as companies turn to overseas listings amid tightening liquidity
body: Indonesia recorded no IPOs through the end of February 2026, with the Indonesia Stock Exchange reporting eight firms in a listing pipeline – five large‑asset and three mid‑size companies spanning basic materials, consumer non‑cyclicals, energy, financials, industrials and transport‑logistics – while foreign investors continued net selling, tightening market liquidity. Facing weak domestic capital markets, firms such as Jollibee Foods Corp, Maya, PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk, a unit of MNC Group and Minor International Pcl are exploring listings in the United States or Hong Kong, and Indonesia risks a downgrade from MSCI’s frontier‑market classification as regulators prepare to meet stricter free‑float rules.

title: Bank Central Asia posts 5.8% profit rise in Jan 2026 on higher non‑interest income and lower provisions
body: Bank Central Asia reported a 5.8% year‑on‑year increase in net profit after tax to about $287.65 million (IDR5 trillion) in January 2026, driven by an 11% rise in non‑interest income and a 54% drop in provision expenses. Its net interest margin fell 56 basis points to 5.4%, within the 5.4‑5.6% guidance, and analysts at CGS International note the bank’s low loan‑to‑deposit ratio of 77.4% reduces funding‑cost risk.

title: PT Telkomsel wins two Asian Telecom Awards as AI and SIM‑based verification drive operational gains and digital trust in Indonesia
body: PT Telkomsel was named Technology Innovation of the Year – Indonesia and Telecom Company of the Year – Indonesia at the Asian Telecom Awards 2026, highlighting its AI‑led transformation across more than 100 use cases in network operations, customer service, sales and IT automation. The initiatives delivered a 31.6% rise in average revenue per site, cut downtime threefold, reduced incident response time by over 40%, lowered customer resolution costs by 78%, improved low‑performing sales areas by 79.1% and cut cost per customer visit by 8.2%, while its AI Innovation Hub and SIM‑based Number Verification API (integrated with Google Firebase) support a 158‑million‑subscriber base and have trained over 96,000 people.

title: Telin wins Asian Telecom Awards 2026 for Cybersecurity Initiative and Submarine Telecom Company in Indonesia
body: Telin was honoured with the Cybersecurity Initiative of the Year – Indonesia and Submarine Telecom Company of the Year – Indonesia awards, highlighting its end‑to‑end security services that generated 75% of its cybersecurity revenue in 2025 and helped a major bank achieve 38% transaction growth and 29% user growth while blocking about 10,000 attacks per minute, and its submarine cable strategy that delivered a 21% year‑on‑year rise in cable system sales. The recognitions underscore Telin’s focus on secure digital services and resilient international connectivity across the Asia‑Pacific region.

title: Emiten Grup Lippo’s PT Multi Prima Sejahtera Tbk posts slight profit decline despite higher revenue and asset growth in 2025
body: PT Multi Prima Sejahtera Tbk recorded net profit attributable to owners of Rp33.04 billion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 3.36% decrease from the prior year, while net revenue rose 7.75% to Rp165.68 billion and total assets grew 1.97% to Rp379.57 billion; operating profit jumped 30.37% to Rp27.56 billion and liabilities fell 20.29% to Rp24.44 billion. On 26 February, the company’s shares gained 1.33% to Rp458.

title: PT Clipan Finance Indonesia Tbk reports slight decline in net profit for 2025 despite lower liabilities
body: PT Clipan Finance Indonesia Tbk posted a net profit of Rp212.21 billion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 1.21% drop from the previous year, with revenue falling 9.5% to Rp1.62 trillion and expenses decreasing 11.18% to Rp1.35 trillion. Liabilities fell 14.02% to Rp3.74 trillion and total assets declined 5.84% to Rp9.52 trillion, while the stock rose about 3% to Rp342.

title: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk acquires PT Trans Hybrid Communication to expand digital infrastructure services
body: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk announced the acquisition of PT Trans Hybrid Communication, adding THC’s international connectivity, fiber‑optic backbone, data‑center and cloud solutions to its digital infrastructure portfolio. The deal is positioned to strengthen INET’s role in Indonesia’s digital backbone and support regional expansion.

title: Astra International uses Rp684.97 billion of its Rp2 trillion share‑buyback program, leaving Rp1.31 trillion remaining
body: Astra International absorbed Rp684.97 billion of its Rp2 trillion share‑buyback allocation between 19 January and 25 February 2026, representing 34.2% of the total program and purchasing 104,850,800 shares at an average price of Rp6,532 per share. The company retains Rp1.31 trillion for future buybacks, which will be conducted under OJK Regulation No. 13/2023 and will not exceed 20% of its paid‑up capital, with a minimum free‑float of 7.5% after repurchases.

title: Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur BIPI signs MoU with Indogas Kriya Dwiguna IKD for gas supply to Mini LNG plant
body: Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur BIPI signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Indogas Kriya Dwiguna IKD, which is linked to Kangean Energy Indonesia Ltd, a subsidiary of Energi Mega Persada ENRG, to explore the sale of natural gas for a Mini LNG Plant operated by Para Amartha LNG PAL. The MoU outlines discussions on supply sources, indicative volumes, gas quality, delivery schemes and technical feasibility, marking an initial step toward a longer‑term gas and LNG partnership.

title: Bank Panin posts 2025 profit of Rp2.75 trillion, modest year‑over‑year growth
body: Bank Panin reported a 2025 net profit of Rp2.75 trillion, up 0.73 % from the prior year, with basic diluted earnings per share rising to Rp114.24 and net interest income reaching Rp8.94 trillion. Total equity increased to Rp58.77 trillion, liabilities fell to Rp164.11 trillion and assets decreased to Rp237.32 trillion, while operational income and other line items showed mixed changes.

title: Private investment in Indonesia's new capital reaches Rp72 trillion by early 2026
body: By early 2026, private investment in the new capital Ibu Kota Nusantara (IKN) is projected to total about Rp72 trillion, with 57 companies having committed funds. Projects led by PT Panca Karya Sentosa, PT Maxi Nusantara Raya and PT Borneo Berkah Abadi are underway in development zones WP 1A and 1C, covering commercial, culinary and sports facilities.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk reports net profit of Rp57.13 trillion for 2025
body: The bank posted a net profit of Rp57.13 trillion in 2025, driven by a 7.1% year‑on‑year increase in total assets to Rp2,135 trillion and a 12.3% rise in loan disbursements to Rp1,521 trillion, primarily to the MSME segment. Deposits grew 7.4% to Rp1,467 trillion, with CASA reaching 70.6% and cost of funds falling to 2.9%, while liquidity ratios (LDR 91.4%, LCR 136.9%, NSFR 117.7%) remained well above regulatory thresholds.

title: Catur Dermawan buy Shares of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk
body: On 13 February 2026, shareholder Catur Dermawan purchased 1,000 shares of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS.JK) at a price of IDR 2,190 per share for price‑monitoring purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 0 to 1,000 shares, establishing a new equity position in the company.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk Wins Best New Revenue Stream Award in Pertamina Group Cost Optimization 2025
body: PT Elnusa Tbk received the Best New Revenue Stream award at Pertamina Group’s Cost Optimization 2025, recognizing its Optimus program that delivered USD 9.9 million in cost optimization, 157 % of the target. The award reflects incremental profit from expanded seismic, vessel, fuel transport and chemical supply projects beyond Pertamina Group.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sell Shares of PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk
body: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sold 130,000,000 shares of PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk at IDR 310 per share on 23 Feb 2026 as part of a reverse REPO transaction. The sale reduced its holding from 504,580,000 to 374,580,000 shares, a decrease of 130,000,000 shares (≈25.8%). The transaction reflects a temporary liquidity move rather than a strategic divestment, but it lowers the shareholder’s ownership percentage in the company.

title: PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk Shareholder Kuantum Akselerasi Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Kuantum Akselerasi Indonesia decreased its stake in PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk by 18,750,000 shares, lowering its holding from 2,284,399,800 to 2,265,649,800 shares. Reported on 26 Feb 2026, the transaction had no disclosed price and is treated as a non‑trading adjustment. The reduction equals roughly 0.8% of the company's outstanding shares, representing a modest ownership shift without immediate impact on control.

title: Ida Ayu Somawati buys Shares of PT Hatten Bali Tbk
body: On 26 Feb 2026, shareholder Ida Ayu Somawati purchased 50,000 shares of PT Hatten Bali Tbk at IDR 202 per share for investment purposes. Her holding rose from 1,727,600 to 1,777,600 shares, a net increase of 50,000 shares, reflecting a modest boost in insider ownership.

title: Aulia sells shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk
body: Aulia, an insider, sold shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk, resulting in a holding change from 7,250,250 to 12,200,200. The transaction type was sell, with a purpose of investment diversification. The shares were sold at a price of IDR 600 per share.

title: Antam gold prices rise to Rp3.045 million per gram on Feb 27, 2026
body: Antam's spot gold price increased to Rp3,045 000 per gram on Friday, February 27, 2026, with the 0.5‑gram bar at Rp1 572 500 and the 1‑gram bar at Rp3 045 000, while the buy‑back price rose to Rp2 824 000 per gram. The article also notes applicable PPh 22 taxes on sales and purchases and is reported by Bisniscom.

title: Danantara Indonesia outlines medium‑term strengthening plan for PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk
body: Danantara Indonesia, as the majority shareholder, said it will focus on phased fleet readiness, prudent network planning and disciplined aircraft maintenance to support PT Garuda Indonesia Persero Tbk’s measured capacity optimisation in 2026 after a 2025 fundamentals‑strengthening phase. The group also reinforced the airline’s capital structure through a corporate scheme to improve balance‑sheet stability and financial flexibility, targeting sustainable profitability rather than short‑term aggressive expansion.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 27,887,100 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk (HILL.JK) at IDR 50 per share on 26 Feb 2026 for investment purposes. The shareholder's holding fell from 6,134,246,100 to 6,106,359,000 shares, a reduction of 27,887,100 shares. The transaction reflects a modest divestment by the equity management arm, potentially signalling portfolio rebalancing without altering overall control of the company.

title: Fitradityo Harjuno sell Shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk
body: Fitradityo Harjuno sold 35,000,000 shares of PT Nusatama Berkah Tbk at IDR 88.0 per share for personal use, reducing his holding from 202,922,100 to 167,922,100 shares. This transaction lowers his ownership stake by 17.3% and may affect the shareholder structure of the company.

title: Haryanto Sofian buy Shares of Perdana Karya Perkasa Tbk
body: Shareholder Haryanto Sofian purchased an additional 38,600 shares of Perdana Karya Perkasa Tbk at a representative price of IDR 2,020 per share, increasing his holding from 2,201,800 to 2,240,400 shares. The total outlay was approximately IDR 77,972,000. The transaction is classified as an investment, reflecting a modest expansion of his stake in the company.

title: Agro Jaya Mandiri Sell Shares of PT Delta Giri Wacana Tbk
body: Agro Jaya Mandiri sold 736,843 shares of PT Delta Giri Wacana Tbk at IDR 136.0 per share on 22 December 2025, a total of IDR 736,843,000. The sale was part of a repo transaction, reducing the shareholder’s holding from 750,000,000 to 13,157,000 shares, a decline of 736,843,000 shares. This move lowers Agro Jaya Mandiri’s stake and may impact liquidity and voting power in the company.

title: Aulia Buys Shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia
body: Aulia, an insider, bought 10,400,250 shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk, increasing holdings from 7,250,250 to 17,650,500. The transaction, valued at IDR 1,040,025,000, was made at IDR 100 per share for incentive purposes.

title: Aninditha Anestya Bakrie buys shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk
body: Aninditha Anestya Bakrie, an insider, bought 17,333,750 shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk, increasing her holding from 318,495,900 to 335,829,650. The transaction was made at IDR 100 per share as a performance-based incentive for the successful listing of shares on the IDX.

title: Hillcon Equity Management buy Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management purchased 29,127,400 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk at IDR 50.0 per share, increasing its stake from 6,105,118,700 to 6,134,246,100 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, reflects a modest expansion of the shareholder’s holdings and may signal confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Anggara Suryawan buy Shares of PT Futura Energi Global Tbk
body: Anggara Suryawan bought 302,400 shares of PT Futura Energi Global Tbk at IDR 330.0 per share for investment purposes, raising his stake from 871,700 to 1,174,100 shares. This purchase increases his ownership by 302,400 shares, strengthening his position in the company and signaling confidence in its future prospects.

title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk posts 21% profit rise and strong sales growth in FY 2025
body: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk reported FY 2025 net profit of US$91.53 million (Rp1.54 trillion), a 21.4% YoY increase, with net sales of US$498.13 million up 6.6% driven by a 10.5% rise in gas sales and a 449.8% jump in under‑lifting/DMO revenue. The company’s gross profit grew 22.6% to US$181.48 million, EBITDA rose 11% to US$309.71 million, assets reached US$1.82 billion, equity rose 25.2% to US$822.74 million, and it invested over US$250 million in exploration while targeting lower funding costs after a successful bond issuance.

title: Indonesia stock exchange suspends PT Wanteg Sekuritas amid director’s legal investigations and financial losses
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia has temporarily suspended trading of PT Wanteg Sekuritas after the director was placed under police investigation for alleged asset embezzlement, illegal fund collection, and failure to hold an annual shareholders meeting since 2022. The broker reported a Q3 2025 loss of Rp8.04 billion, up from a Rp5.16 billion loss in the same period of 2024, and Otoritas Jasa Keuangan confirmed it is monitoring the case and will coordinate with the exchange.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk posts 24% profit decline to Rp14.81 trillion in 2025 despite modest revenue growth across mining and construction segments
body: PT United Tractors Tbk reported a net profit of Rp14.81 trillion for 2025, a 24.17% YoY decline from Rp19.53 trillion, while total revenue fell 2.32% to Rp131.3 trillion. The contractor mining segment contributed the most revenue at Rp54.1 trillion, and the construction machinery segment saw a 2% rise in Komatsu sales to 4,515 units, with Scania sales increasing and UD Trucks sales decreasing.

title: Indonesia’s High‑Dividend Index climbs 4.9% YTD as investors rotate into dividend‑paying stocks ahead of the payout season
body: The IDX High Dividend 20 index rose 4.93% year‑to‑date on Feb 25, 2026 while the broader LQ45 and IHSG fell, reflecting a front‑running shift toward high‑yield stocks before upcoming RUPS and dividend payouts; top gainers included PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk (+8.47%), PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk (+6.02%) and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (+41.59%). Analysts recommend selective buying on weakness of PT Bukit Asam Tbk, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Astra International Tbk and also cite strong fundamentals in ANTM, ASII, BBCA, INDF and JPFA.

title: IHSG eyes 8,200 support amid foreign selling and weak global tech sentiment
body: Indonesia's composite index (IHSG) was expected to test the psychological support level of 8,200, with a potential short‑term technical rebound if it held, while a net foreign sell of Rp409 billion pressured the market. Foreign investors sold shares in PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk, and global sentiment was dampened by a >5% drop in Nvidia and weak Salesforce results, prompting BNI Sekuritas to recommend buy‑on‑weakness positions in mining and energy, including PT Bumi Resources Tbk.

title: Several Indonesian issuers secure multi‑billion rupiah bank credit facilities in early 2026
body: In early 2026, PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk secured a Rp395.2 billion investment loan from PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk for new vessels, PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk obtained an Rp800 billion 60‑month loan from PT Bank ICBC Indonesia for capital expenditures, and PT Nusa Palapa Gemilang Tbk received a Rp54.02 billion facility from PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk for working‑capital needs; a subsidiary, PT Mitra Gemilang Mahacipta, also obtained a Rp265 billion credit from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk.

title: Indonesia's IHSG drops 1.04% amid broad declines, with analysts forecasting a possible rebound later this week
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed down 1.04% at 8,235.26 on February 27, with market capitalization at Rp154.77 trillion and notable declines in PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk, PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk, BBCA, BULL and PTRO. MNC Sekuritas sees a potential rebound to 8,440‑8,650 while warning of further correction to 8,081‑8,149, and recommends BBRI, BKSL, ENRG and MDKA based on their recent price moves and wave analysis.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk reports 24% drop in net profit for 2025 amid lower coal prices and announces share buyback and gold miner acquisition
body: PT United Tractors Tbk posted a net profit of Rp14.81 trillion in 2025, down 24.2% YoY from Rp19.53 trillion, with net revenue of Rp131.3 trillion and declines in its mining contractor and coal segments while gold and other minerals revenue rose 41% YoY. The company completed a Rp2 trillion share‑buyback program in January 2026, launched a second Rp2 trillion buyback phase from February to April 2026, and through its subsidiaries PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara and PT Energia Prima Nusantara acquired 100% of PT Arafura Surya Alam, a gold miner in North Sulawesi.

title: Alfamart's parent PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk sticks to 800‑store expansion plan despite government push to curb rural growth
body: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk said it will not revise its 2026 target of opening 800 new Alfamart stores and will continue expansion in line with local regulations, focusing on regions outside Jakarta. The company also plans a cautious rollout of Lawson stores acquired from PT Midi Utama Indonesia Tbk.

title: PT Astra International Tbk proposes lower FY2025 dividend amid modest profit decline
body: PT Astra International Tbk proposed a final dividend of Rp292 per share for FY2025, bringing total dividend to Rp390 per share (48% payout) after an interim payout of Rp98, as the company reported a 3.34% YoY decline in net profit to Rp32.76 trillion and a 1.54% drop in revenue to Rp323.39 trillion. The firm also completed share‑buyback programmes worth Rp2 trillion in January and Rp685 billion in February 2026, while citing lower coal prices and weak new‑car demand as drivers of the earnings contraction.

title: PT Astra International Tbk posts modest revenue and profit declines in 2025 amid lower coal prices and weak new‑car demand
body: PT Astra International Tbk reported a 1.54% decline in net revenue to Rp323.39 trillion and a 3.34% drop in net profit to Rp32.76 trillion in 2025, citing lower coal prices and a weak new‑car market as the main drivers. Despite the contraction, stronger performance in gold mining, financial services and motorcycle businesses helped offset the weakness.

title: GOTO clarifies Google investment history and share transactions ahead of IPO
body: PT Goto Gojek Tokopedia Tbk said Google’s investments, made from 2017 to before 2019, were always part of joint funding rounds and never gave Google majority or controlling ownership, and that founder Nadiem Makarim resigned in 2019. The company also disclosed two 2021 share purchases—acquiring Tokopedia shares from Google and buying PT Dompet Karya Anak Bangsa shares from Google and other investors—as part of its restructuring before the IPO.

title: Indonesia’s High‑Dividend Index Gains as Investors Position Ahead of Dividend Season
body: Investors are rotating into Indonesia’s high‑dividend stocks, lifting the IDX High Dividend 20 index 4.93% YTD while broader indices lag, with PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk up 8.47%, PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk up 6.02% and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk soaring 41.59% on strong earnings and dividend expectations. Research analysts from KISI Sekuritas and Sinarmas Sekuritas advise a selective, buy‑on‑weakness approach for PT Bukit Asam Tbk, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Astra International Tbk, warning of potential dividend traps despite the attractive yields.

title: PT Arkora Hydro Tbk's Kukusan 2 hydro plant reaches commercial operation, boosting renewable generation and ESG performance
body: PT Arkora Hydro Tbk announced that its 5.4 MW run‑of‑river Kukusan 2 hydro plant in Tanggamus, Lampung achieved Commercial Operation Date on 6 February 2026 and will supply 35.02 GWh annually under a 25‑year PPA with PT PLN, covering the electricity needs of roughly 5,000‑7,000 households and contributing about 17.8% of the company’s projected 2026 generation of 197.28 GWh. The project, built with zero‑fatality safety standards, supports PT Arkora Hydro Tbk’s ESG goals, having helped reduce CO₂ emissions by 277,241 ton CO₂eq since 2017 and, together with upcoming Tomoni (10 MW) and Pongbembe (20 MW) projects, is expected to lower emissions by an additional 170,809 ton CO₂eq per year while strengthening the firm’s long‑term cash flow.

title: Indonesia's villages minister says new permits for modern minimarkets will be halted, not existing stores
body: Villages Minister Yandri Susanto clarified that the government will not close existing Alfamart and Indomaret outlets in rural areas, but will stop issuing new expansion permits to protect village cooperatives under the Red and White Village Cooperatives program. Trade Minister Budi Santoso and Cooperatives Minister Ferry Juliantono stressed collaboration with modern retailers, while the Indonesian Retailers Association said its members comply with local licensing rules.

title: Indonesia's Antam gold price rises to near record amid global profit‑taking and geopolitical tensions
body: Antam gold price increased by Rp 6,000 to Rp 3,045,000 per gram on Friday, near its all‑time high of Rp 3,168,000 and up about 22% since the start of 2026, while its buyback price rose to Rp 2,824,000 per gram. Meanwhile, global spot gold slipped to $5,187.16 per ounce as traders took profits, with Kitco Metals analyst Jim Wyckoff attributing the decline to short‑term profit‑taking, and Bloomberg noted that the move coincided with heightened US‑Iran nuclear talks and renewed Russian attacks on Ukraine.

title: Indonesia’s President Prabowo secures UAE investment pledge and US business commitments while courting UK chip designer Arm
body: President Prabowo Subianto ended his overseas tour with a meeting in Abu Dhabi where UAE leader MBZ pledged to increase investment, raising UAE stakes to about $170 million in 2025 and boosting bilateral trade to $6.4 billion. The trip also yielded US business commitments of up to $38.4 billion and a partnership between Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund Danantara and UK chip designer Arm to train 15,000 engineers.

title: Jakarta Composite Index drops 1.35% amid US solar tariffs, fiscal worries and geopolitical risk
body: The JCI fell 111 points to 8,211 as investors reacted to US tariffs of up to 125.87% on solar panels from Indonesia and other countries, and to domestic concerns over a new 15% minimum free‑float rule and rising fiscal pressures flagged by S&P Global Ratings. Company‑specific tariffs hit Blue Sky Solar (143.3%) and REC Solar Energy (85.99%), while Phintraco Sekuritas, BRI Danareksa Sekuritas and Nvidia were also cited in the market commentary.

title: Indonesia imports 105,000 pickup trucks for new village cooperatives, sparking debate over local manufacturing and retail expansion
body: The government’s plan to set up 80,000 “Merah Putih” village cooperatives has led state‑owned Agrinas Pangan Nusantara to import 105,000 pickup trucks and light‑duty vehicles from India, a $1.5 billion order that Gaikindo says underutilises domestic capacity. Critics argue the 4‑WD trucks are unnecessary for cooperative transport and the move coincides with the minister’s call to halt new modern‑retail permits for chains such as Indomaret and Alfamart to protect rural businesses.

title: Indonesia’s Danantara sovereign wealth fund celebrates one year, targets $2.7 trillion AUM and SOE consolidation
body: Danantara marked its first anniversary, outlining a plan to grow assets under management from about $900 billion to $2.7 trillion by 2030 and to cut the number of state‑owned enterprises from roughly 1,000 to 200 through mergers such as a possible tie‑up of Pelita Air with Garuda Indonesia and consolidation of construction firms. It is also launching a $5 billion waste‑to‑energy program, a $500 million Hajj Village in Mecca, downstream processing projects worth $7 billion, a potential 30 % stake in the Indonesia Stock Exchange, and a partnership with UK chip designer Arm to train 15,000 engineers, while critics point to modest profit growth at Bank Mandiri, earnings contraction at BNI and limited turnaround at Garuda Indonesia and Krakatau Steel.

title: Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund Danantara aims to finalize a state airline holding combining Garuda Indonesia, Citilink and Pelita Air Service by H1 2026
body: Danantara plans to create a holding company that merges Garuda Indonesia, its low‑cost arm Citilink and Pertamina‑owned Pelita Air Service, targeting completion in the first half of 2026 to unify booking systems, loyalty programs and fleet operations. The integration is intended to boost efficiency and generate additional revenue for Garuda without acquiring new aircraft.

title: Indonesian lawmakers summon state-owned Agrinas Pangan Nusantara over a $1.5 billion plan to import 105,000 trucks from India
body: The DPR’s Commission VI called Agrinas Pangan Nusantara to explain a Rp 24.66 trillion ($1.5 billion) budget to import 105,000 completely built‑up pickup and light trucks from India, questioning the lack of disclosed vehicle specifications and transparency. Agrinas said Indian manufacturers Mahindra & Mahindra and Tata Motors were selected for their 4‑wheel‑drive capability, ability to meet the order volume and competitive pricing.

title: Indonesia insists US imports meet halal certification, using Mutual Recognition Agreement for streamlined registration
body: Indonesia reaffirmed that all US‑origin products must comply with its halal rules, allowing certification to be performed by five US‑based halal bodies recognized by the Halal Product Assurance Agency and then registered locally under the Mutual Recognition Agreement. The government also requires non‑halal food items to be clearly labeled and continues to apply quality and safety standards to cosmetics, medical devices and other goods.

title: Gold prices rally in Indonesia and globally as J.P. Morgan forecasts further gains
body: Antam gold rose to Rp 3,039,000 per gram on Thursday, up Rp 16,000 after a brief dip, marking a roughly 22% gain since the start of 2026, while spot gold held at $5,185.49 per ounce. J.P. Morgan projects global gold could climb up to 22% by year‑end 2026, targeting around $6,300 per ounce, citing a weaker US dollar, lower US interest rates and ongoing geopolitical uncertainty.

title: China warns Indonesia‑US trade pact must not target third parties amid US tariff disputes
body: Indonesia concluded a trade agreement with the United States, but Beijing warned the pact must not impose restrictions on a “third country,” echoing concerns over US provisions that could be used to economically pressure China. The deal faces uncertainty after a US Supreme Court decision limiting emergency‑power tariffs and analysts warn of possible Chinese non‑tariff retaliation, while China remains Indonesia’s top trading partner with $154.6 billion in 2025 trade.

title: Investor Lo Kheng Hong increases stake in PT Gajah Tunggal Tbk with 1.4 million-share purchase
body: Lo Kheng Hong bought 1,398,400 shares of PT Gajah Tunggal Tbk on 25 February 2026, raising his ownership to 6,0233% and valuing the transaction at roughly Rp1.54 billion. The stock closed at Rp1,105 on that day and was trading around Rp1,115 on 27 February 2026.

title: Indonesia's Manpower Ministry to enforce Eid bonuses for ride‑hailing drivers and private‑sector workers
body: The ministry confirmed that ride‑hailing platforms have agreed to pay the customary Eid bonus of up to one month's wage, with a draft circular outlining distribution and sanctions for firms that miss the seven‑day deadline before Eid. Trade union KSPI warned that many drivers received only Rp 50,000 of the promised Rp 1 million and urged a minimum of 75% of annual earnings as the bonus.

title: Indonesia’s Ministry of Communication and Digital and Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison launch Sahabat‑AI platform
body: The Ministry of Communication and Digital together with Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison unveiled Sahabat‑AI, an open‑access AI application for Android and iOS that provides multi‑model features such as text‑to‑image, video generation, smart search and coding assistance. Officials said the platform advances Indonesia’s sovereign, culturally‑aligned AI agenda and analysts expect it could boost customer experience, lower churn and positively impact mid‑term revenue and profitability.

title: Rising oil prices boost upstream sector, analyst sets target prices for key Indonesian oil‑gas stocks
body: Global oil prices rose in February, with WTI reaching $66.48 per barrel and Brent $70.88, marking roughly 5% gains over the past month. Analyst Muhammad Wafi advises investors to watch PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, PT Rukun Raharja Tbk and PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk, setting target prices of Rp 1,700, Rp 4,800 and Rp 1,680 respectively, while recommending a wait‑and‑see stance on PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk.
