title: PT Astra International Tbk and PT United Tractors Tbk shares drop after 2025 earnings reveal revenue and profit declines
body: Following the release of 2025 financial results, PT Astra International Tbk shares slipped 1.49% to Rp 6,625 and PT United Tractors Tbk fell 3.78% to Rp 29,250 on Friday. The companies reported year‑on‑year revenue declines of 1.54% to Rp 323.39 trillion and 2% to Rp 131.3 trillion respectively, with net profit falling 3.33% to Rp 32.76 trillion for Astra and 24% to Rp 14.8 trillion for United Tractors.

title: PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk says U.S. palm oil tariff uncertainty will not affect operations and sets 2026 production growth targets
body: PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk said the uncertainty surrounding the U.S. tariff on crude palm oil does not directly affect its operations and it will continue to focus on the domestic market, while targeting a 3‑5% increase in CPO and TBS production and about 3% sales growth in 2026. The company also highlighted plans to boost productivity through intensification, mechanization, infrastructure upgrades and digitalization.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange flags unusual market activity for five listed firms, with sharp price drops observed
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange announced that PT Bhuwanatala Indah Permai Tbk, PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk, PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia Tbk, PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk and PT Mahkota Group Tbk are under Unusual Market Activity monitoring, and on Friday their shares fell sharply—BIPP down 14.42% to Rp 89, JAYA down 6.42% to Rp 204, KAQI down 14.52% to Rp 106, TAMA unchanged at Rp 86, and MGRO down 1.42% to Rp 695. BEI cautioned investors to review company disclosures and corporate actions before making investment decisions.

title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk reports strong 2025 financial growth and outlines $250 million investment plan
body: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk reported a 7% year‑on‑year increase in net sales to US$498.13 million, an 11% rise in EBITDA to US$309.71 million, and a 21% jump in net profit to US$91.53 million for 2025. The company invested over US$250 million in exploration and development and said its Q1 2026 bond issuance will help lower future financing costs.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk reports 2025 revenue decline and 24% drop in net profit
body: PT United Tractors Tbk posted a 2% year‑on‑year decline in total revenue to Rp 131.3 trillion for 2025, with net profit falling 24% to Rp 14.8 trillion as mining‑contractor and construction‑machinery segments dropped 7% and 2% respectively, while gold‑mineral revenue rose 41%. Komatsu heavy‑equipment sales rose 2% to 4,515 units (20% market share), Scania up 7% to 466 units, UD Trucks down 34% to 155 units, and PT Pamapersada Nusantara saw overburden‑removal volume fall 10% to 1,100 million bcm.

title: PT Astra International Tbk proposes Rp390 per share dividend for 2025 as 2025 earnings dip modestly
body: PT Astra International Tbk announced a proposed final dividend of Rp292 per share, bringing the total 2025 dividend to Rp390 per share (48% payout ratio) pending shareholder approval at the April 2026 AGM; the company reported 2025 net profit of Rp32.76 trillion (down 3.33% YoY) on revenue of Rp323.39 trillion (down 1.54%), with assets rising to Rp507.36 trillion.

title: Merdeka Gold Resources ships first 44.04 kg of doré to Antam for refining, targeting 110,000‑115,000 oz production in 2026
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk completed its first shipment of 44.04 kg of doré to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk for refining, following its inaugural gold pour on 14 February 2026. The company targets 110,000‑115,000 ounces of gold from the Pani mine in 2026 and is accelerating construction of a Carbon‑in‑Leach plant to eventually reach around 500,000 ounces annually.

title: PT Astra International Tbk posts modest profit and revenue declines in 2025 amid weaker car market and lower coal prices
body: PT Astra International Tbk reported a 3.33% decline in 2025 net profit to Rp 32.76 trillion and a 1.54% drop in consolidated revenue to Rp 323.39 trillion, with the automotive & mobility segment profit remaining stable at Rp 11.4 trillion despite a 7% fall in national car sales; growth was driven by PT Astra Otoparts Tbk, PT Federal International Finance, PT Asuransi Astra Buana, PT Asuransi Jiwa Astra, Serasi Autoraya and OLXmobbi, and CEO Djony Bunarto Tjondro said lower coal prices and weak car demand pressured earnings while the group stays resilient and expects consumer sentiment to improve.

title: PT Astra International Tbk reports declining profit and revenue for 2025 amid higher expenses
body: PT Astra International Tbk reported a weak 2025 performance with net profit falling 3.33% to Rp 32.76 trillion and revenue slipping 1.54% to Rp 323.39 trillion, while earnings per share declined to Rp 810. Despite higher assets, liabilities and cash balances, the group posted a post‑tax loss of Rp 540 billion, driven by lower gross profit and higher selling and administrative expenses.

title: Indonesia's IHSG drops 1.04% as foreign investors net buy Rp 341.26 billion, led by PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk
body: The Jakarta Composite Index fell 86.96 points (1.04%) to 8,235.26 on Thursday, with a trading volume of 56.52 billion shares worth Rp 28.14 trillion and 568 stocks declining. Despite the decline, foreign investors continued net buying Rp 341.26 billion, led by PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk (Rp 648.2 billion), PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (Rp 274.41 billion) and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (Rp 172.28 billion).

title: Blue‑chip earnings to dip in 2025 but projected 15% rebound in 2026, says Mandiri Sekuritas
body: Mandiri Sekuritas forecasts that EPS of 80 blue‑chip issuers will fall about 12% in 2025 and then recover around 15% in 2026, driven by cost normalization and a 150‑bps BI rate cut. United Tractors posted a 24% profit decline to Rp 14.81 trillion, while PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk saw net profit jump 127% to Rp 7.46 trillion, and analysts highlight PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, PT Bukit Asam Tbk, PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk and PT MAP Aktif Adiperkasa Tbk as attractive for 2026.

title: Emiten EV Bakrie Group's PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk posts a net loss of Rp11.37 billion in 2025 after a profit in 2024
body: Emiten EV Bakrie Group's PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk reported a consolidated net loss attributable to the parent of Rp11.37 billion in 2025, reversing the Rp7.56 billion profit recorded in 2024, while net sales rose 8.6% to Rp1,089 trillion. Total assets grew 11.8% to Rp1.79 trillion, liabilities increased 22.2% to Rp553.02 billion, equity rose 7.8% to Rp1.24 trillion, and the stock edged up 1.11% to Rp910.

title: PT Arwana Citramulia Tbk posts lower 2025 net profit despite sales growth
body: PT Arwana Citramulia Tbk reported a 5.99% decline in net profit to Rp400.47 billion for 2025, while net sales rose 10.65% to Rp2.91 trillion. The rise in cost of goods sold of 18.02% reduced gross profit to Rp883.91 billion and operating profit fell 4.68% to Rp523.32 billion, with total assets at Rp2.88 trillion and liabilities at Rp949.18 billion.

title: Pangayoman Adi Soenjoto buy Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: On 24 February 2026, shareholder Pangayoman Adi Soenjoto purchased 61,586,600 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk at IDR 357 per share, increasing its stake from 3,497,823,771 to 3,559,410,371 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, raises the shareholder's ownership by approximately 1.76% and signals confidence in the company's prospects, which may be viewed positively by investors in the Indonesian market.

title: Hartono Atmadja buy Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: On 24 February 2026, shareholder Hartono Atmadja purchased 2,544,600 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk (GOOD.JK) at IDR 357 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 510,173,030 to 512,717,630 shares, a net increase of 0.5%. The acquisition modestly strengthens his stake in the food and beverage producer, signalling confidence in the company's growth prospects.

title: Kusumo Dewiningrum Sunjoto buy Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: On 24 February 2026, shareholder Kusumo Dewiningrum Sunjoto purchased 61,188,800 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk at IDR 357 per share, increasing his stake from 3,572,194,700 to 3,633,383,500 shares (a rise of about 1.7%). The transaction, classified as an investment, reflects a strategic accumulation of equity in the listed food company, potentially signaling confidence in its growth prospects.

title: Rahajoe Dewiningroem Soenjoto buy Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: On 24 February 2026, shareholder Rahajoe Dewiningroem Soenjoto purchased 59,148,500 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk at IDR 357 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 2,761,732,296 to 2,820,880,796 shares, a net increase of 59,148,500 shares, strengthening his stake in the company. The acquisition signals confidence in the company's prospects and modestly expands the insider ownership base.

title: Eka Susanto W Sunarso buy Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: On 24 Feb 2026, shareholder Eka Susanto W Sunarso purchased 85,900 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk (GOOD.JK) at IDR 357 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 573,872,650 to 573,958,550 shares, a net increase of 85,900 shares. This modest acquisition marginally boosts his ownership stake and reflects continued confidence in the company's growth prospects.

title: Jemmy Kurniawan sell Shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk
body: Jemmy Kurniawan sold 50,000,000 shares of PT Hetzer Medical Indonesia Tbk at IDR 65 per share on 26 Feb 2026, reducing his holding from 982,370,900 to 932,370,900 shares (a decrease of 50,000,000). The transaction is recorded as a reduction of the number of shares owned.

title: Hardianto Atmadja buys Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: Shareholder Hardianto Atmadja purchased 5,089,200 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk (GOOD.JK) at IDR 357 per share on 24 Feb 2026 for investment purposes. His holding rose from 403,283,122 to 408,372,322 shares, increasing his stake by about 1.26%.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased an additional 484,200 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) on 25‑26 February 2026 at prices around IDR 1,480 per share, raising his holding from 213,558,822 to 214,043,022 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, increases his stake by approximately 0.23% and signals confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Sudhamek Agoeng Waspodo S buy Shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
body: On 24 February 2026, shareholder Sudhamek Agoeng Waspodo S purchased 43,594,400 shares of PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk at IDR 357 per share for investment purposes. The holding rose from 3,196,042,250 to 3,239,636,650 shares, increasing the shareholder's stake by approximately 1.36%. The transaction reflects a strategic addition to the investor's portfolio and marginally raises the company's free‑float ownership distribution.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk approves up to 90 billion-share rights issue to raise up to Rp6.5 trillion and improve leverage
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk approved a rights issue of up to 90 billion new shares targeting a raise of roughly Rp4‑6.5 trillion, with proceeds intended to repay debt, support working capital and fund development including the recent acquisition of PT Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways, which should cut its total loan‑to‑equity ratio from about 536% to 212% after the issue. The company’s 2025 audited results showed a 49.6% YoY increase in net profit to Rp502.74 billion, revenue of Rp3.74 trillion (down 3.28%), and a 547.6% surge in liabilities to Rp18.89 trillion, while its shares jumped 32.92% to Rp214 following the announcement.

title: Bakrie & Brothers Holding says no immediate IPO plans, focusing on expanding its six subsidiaries
body: BNBR CEO Anindya N Bakrie said the group has no immediate plans to list subsidiaries, focusing on expanding its six direct units—including PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk, PT Vktr Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk, PT Bakrie Metal Industries, PT Bakrie Building Industries, PT Bakrie Indo Infrastructure, PT Bakrie Harper and PT Kreasindo Jaya Utama—while outlining that an IPO would require business readiness, corporate need and market strength. He highlighted the recent VKTR IPO, the 26‑km Cimanggis‑Cibitung toll generating about Rp3 billion daily, and growth targets in pipe manufacturing, renewable energy, 3D printing via PT Modula Tiga Dimensi and gas commodities.

title: Bakrie & Brothers' acquisition of PT Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways pushes 2025 liabilities up 548%
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Bakrie Toll Indonesia, completed a 100% acquisition of PT Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways in 2025, causing total liabilities to jump to Rp18.89 trillion—a 547.6% year‑on‑year increase. The rise stems from new short‑ and long‑term loans from Mayapada International, PT Bank Nasional Nobu Tbk, PT Bank Mayapada International, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank MNC Internasional Tbk and other lenders, as well as accrued project costs and trade payables linked to the acquisition.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk and PT Bank Mega Tbk post strong weekly gains amid rights issue and bonus share plans
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk saw its shares jump 76.86% to Rp214 after approving a rights issue that could raise up to Rp6.5 trillion to refinance debt from its PT Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways acquisition, while PT Bank Mega Tbk rallied 40.28% to Rp4,650 before closing down 4.32% as it prepared a 1‑for‑1 bonus share issuance that will double its share count and bolster capital.

title: MNC Sekuritas forecasts continued IHSG rally and highlights buy‑on‑weakness picks in INDY, TAPG, TLKM and UNVR
body: The Jakarta Composite Index is expected to advance toward 8,440‑8,650 as buying volume supports the market above its 20‑day moving average. MNC Sekuritas recommends buy‑on‑weakness positions for PT Indika Energy Tbk (target 3,910‑4,200), PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (target 1,670‑1,745), PT Telkom Indonesia Persero Tbk (target 3,660‑3,810) and PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk (target 2,490‑2,590), citing recent price gains and volume spikes.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk gold buyback price jumps 21.35% YTD amid global gold rally and geopolitical tension
body: On 28 February 2026 PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rose 21.35% year‑to‑date to Rp2,864 000 per gram, still shy of the all‑time high of Rp2,989 000 reached in late January, reflecting movements in global spot and futures gold markets. The increase is bolstered by heightened US‑Iran nuclear‑talk uncertainty and expectations of further Federal Reserve rate cuts later in 2026.

title: Antam gold prices rise and buy‑back rate climbs on Feb 28 2026
body: On Feb 28 2026, Antam’s gold prices rose, with the 1‑gram bar reaching Rp3,085 million per gram (up Rp40 000) and the 0.5‑gram bar at Rp1,592.5 million (up Rp20 000), while the buy‑back price climbed to Rp2,864 million per gram. According to PMK No.34/PMK.10/2017, resale of bars above Rp10 million incurs a 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) PPh 22, and purchases are subject to 0.45%/0.9% PPh 22, which is deducted at source.

title: Astra International reports slight profit decline in 2025 while its palm oil unit posts strong growth
body: PT Astra International Tbk posted 2025 net revenue of Rp323.39 trillion, down 1.54% YoY, and attributable net profit of Rp32.76 trillion, a 3.34% decline, driven by lower coal prices and weak automotive demand, with its heavy equipment and mining division profit falling 24% YoY. However, PT United Tractors Tbk saw a 24.17% drop in net profit to Rp14.81 trillion and a 2.32% revenue dip, while PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk recorded a 31.35% revenue increase to Rp28.6 trillion and a 28.25% profit rise to Rp1.47 trillion, boosted by higher CPO sales.

title: Indonesia‑US trade pact adds US poultry imports and prompts BRI Danareksa to keep overweight on local poultry stocks
body: The Indonesian government and the United States signed a reciprocal trade agreement that will see Indonesia import 580,000 live Grand Parent Stock chickens worth about US$17‑20 million and 120,000‑150,000 tonnes of mechanically deboned meat (MDM) for domestic processing, while BRI Danareksa Sekuritas maintains an overweight view on the poultry sector, naming PT Charoen Pokhpand Indonesia Tbk as its top pick with a target price of Rp5,600 and recommending buy ratings for PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk (target Rp3,100) and PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk (target Rp1,500).

title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk posts 21.4% profit increase in 2025
body: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk reported a 21.4% rise in net profit to USD91.53 million for 2025, driven by a 6.57% increase in net sales to USD498.12 million and a 22.57% jump in gross profit, while total assets grew 15.19% to USD1.82 billion. The company's liabilities rose 7.93% to USD999.58 million and its shares gained 1.54% to Rp1,650 on the day the results were released.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk signals possible FY2025 dividend after financial turnaround
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk announced that, after a financial restructuring that eliminated a historic deficit, it now has sufficient retained earnings and a net profit of Rp493.85 billion in 2025 (up from Rp327.59 billion in 2024) and plans to consider a dividend for FY2025 pending approval at the 2026 shareholders’ meeting. The company’s total assets rose to Rp23.56 trillion in 2025, and the last dividend was reportedly paid in 2007 (or 1996) according to different sources.

title: PT Avia Avian Tbk sets 2026 sales growth targets and outlines strategic initiatives after strong 2025 performance
body: PT Avia Avian Tbk aims for 6‑10% sales‑value and 4‑8% volume growth by 2026, backed by new product launches, wider tinting‑machine distribution, expanded logistics, enhanced marketing and IT/AI upgrades. In 2025 the company recorded an 8.7% YoY sales increase to Rp8.1 trillion and net profit of Rp1.74 trillion, up 21.5% YoY, after two price adjustments to mitigate cost and currency pressures.

title: S&P Global warns of rising credit‑risk profile for Indonesia, raising concerns of IHSG correction and higher bond yields
body: S&P Global warned that Indonesia's credit risk has increased after the government debt‑service ratio surpassed 15% of revenue, prompting expectations of capital outflows, higher 10‑year bond yields and a possible correction in the Jakarta Composite Index; Maximilianus Nico Demus of Pilarmas Investindo Sekuritas advises investors to target fundamentally strong stocks, use the dip as an entry point, and avoid highly volatile shares.

title: PT Central Finansial X cuts crypto transaction fees to boost domestic market liquidity
body: PT Central Finansial X will reduce its transaction fee from 0.04% to 0.02% on 1 March 2026 and to 0.01% on 1 October 2026 to encourage higher trading volume and strengthen Indonesia's crypto ecosystem. CEOs William Sutanto of Indodax and Adrian Sudirgo of PT Kagum Teknologi Indonesia said the lower fees aim to draw users back from unlicensed foreign platforms, which currently handle 2.6 times the volume of licensed domestic platforms, as the market recorded Rp482.23 trillion in transactions and 12.92 million users in 2025.

title: Indonesian Rupiah Weakens as U.S.-Iran Geopolitical Tensions and New Solar Panel Tariffs Pressure Markets
body: The rupiah fell 0.17% to 16,787 per dollar on Friday, driven by heightened U.S.-Iran geopolitical uncertainty, a U.S. Supreme Court ruling that nullified most Trump tariffs and the prospect of new tariffs on solar panels and cells from Indonesia, India and Laos. Analysts expect further weakening early next week, with the currency likely trading between 16,790 and 16,820 per dollar.

title: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk reports 33.8% net profit increase in 2025
body: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk posted a 2025 net profit of Rp2.03 trillion, a 33.8% increase from 2024, with net sales rising 18.8% to Rp10.72 trillion driven by growth in dairy and food segments. The company also improved operating cash flow to Rp1.91 trillion, boosted cash reserves to Rp947.9 billion, and was added to the IDX80, Kompas100 and several IDX ESG indexes.

title: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk plans phase‑2 extension of the Serpong‑Balaraja toll road and reports 2025 financial results
body: The developer said construction of the 11.5‑km phase‑2 of the Serpong‑Balaraja toll road, in which PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk holds a 50% stake alongside PT Astratel Nusantara and PT Transindo Karya, could start in the second half of 2026, while its MRT Lebak Bulus‑Serpong project moves into a feasibility‑study stage. For 2025, PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk recorded pre‑sales of Rp10.04 trillion (up 3% YoY), net profit of Rp1.36 trillion in Q3 and revenue of Rp8.76 trillion, a 12.96% decline from the prior year.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk reports Q4 2025 revenue dip, profit fall and launches second share‑buyback while acquiring PT Arafura Surya Alam
body: PT United Tractors Tbk posted Q4 2025 consolidated net revenue of Rp131.3 trillion, down 2% year‑on‑year, and net profit of Rp14.8 trillion, a 24% drop, as mining contractor revenue (run by PT Pamapersada Nusantara and PT Kalimantan Prima Persada) fell 7% and coal segment revenue fell 7% while gold segment revenue rose 41% on higher gold prices. The group completed a Rp2 trillion share‑buyback program, announced a second Rp2 trillion buyback phase, and acquired 100 % of PT Arafura Surya Alam through PT Danusa Tambang Nusantara and PT Energia Prima Nusantara.

title: GAPKI Chairman Eddy Martono Highlights Palm Oil’s Role in Regional Development and Economic Impact, Citing Employment and Export Figures
body: At a national seminar in Yogyakarta, GAPKI Chairman Eddy Martono said palm oil plantations have opened remote areas such as West Sulawesi and Central Kalimantan, creating roads and identity‑card services, and now support over 16 million Indonesians, employing about 5.5 million workers directly and generating US$39 billion in foreign‑exchange earnings during the Covid‑19 pandemic; he recalled working with Astra during his early field assignments. He warned that production has been stagnant for five years because many smallholders face legal and financing hurdles to replanting, and cautioned that mandatory biodiesel blends like B35 and B40 must be balanced to avoid hurting exports.

title: China's palm oil imports set to fall as cheaper canola and soybean alternatives gain traction
body: Analysts say China's recent trade deal with Canada and increased Australian canola purchases, along with higher soybean imports and crushing, will curb palm oil demand, causing exports to China to drop 35.7% last year according to the Malaysian Palm Oil Board. Sunvin Group's Anilkumar Bagani noted that competitive Indonesian palm oil prices and a planned Indonesian levy hike could further shape the market, while palm oil prices are expected to slip modestly this year.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk launches Rp5 trillion Sustainable Social Bond Phase II offering
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk issued a Rp5 trillion Sustainable Social Bond Phase II in March 2026, comprising three series (A: Rp1,236 trillion at 4.85% for 370 days, B: Rp2,666 trillion at 5.70% for three years, C: Rp1,097 trillion at 5.95% for five years) with quarterly interest payments and bullet principal repayment. The bond, rated idAAA by PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia and aligned with S&P Global Ratings’ Social Bond Principles, is underwritten by PT BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, PT CIMB Niaga Sekuritas, PT DBS Vickers Sekuritas Indonesia, PT Indo Premier Sekuritas, PT Mandiri Sekuritas, PT Mega Capital Sekuritas and PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk, with PT Bank Tabungan Negara Persero Tbk as trustee, and proceeds will fund job‑creation projects, especially MSME financing, and broader socio‑economic empowerment.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk approves rights issue to fund PT Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways acquisition and strengthen capital structure
body: The shareholders of PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk approved a rights issue of up to 90 billion new Series E shares to finance the acquisition of PT Cimanggis Cibitung Tollways, reduce its total‑loan‑to‑asset ratio from 84.28 % to 67.9 % and debt‑to‑equity from 536.02 % to 211.57 %, with non‑participating shareholders facing up to 33.33 % dilution. For 2025, the company reported net revenue of Rp 3.74 trillion (down 3.28 % YoY) and net profit of Rp 502.74 billion, a 49.6 % increase, driven mainly by PT Bakrie Metal Industries Group, PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk Group and PT Bakrie Indo Infrastructure Group.

title: PT PP Persero Tbk PTPP reports 120.8% jump in new contract wins to Rp2.76 trillion in January 2026
body: PT PP Persero Tbk PTPP, a state‑owned construction firm under Danantara Indonesia, secured Rp2.76 trillion of new contracts in January 2026, a 120.8% increase YoY, with 73.31% funded by the government and the building segment contributing 43.28% of the portfolio. Key projects include the Prosecutor General’s Office building (Rp820.7 billion), Medan BRT Metropolitan (Rp538.5 billion), Mempawah bauxite mining (Rp478.6 billion) and Aceh disaster relief (Rp341.7 billion).

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk posts 50% profit rise in 2025 despite revenue dip and shares surge 28%
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk reported consolidated net profit of Rp493.8 billion in 2025, up 50.78% YoY, while revenue fell 3.11% to Rp3.74 trillion and operating profit dropped 58.69% to Rp116.86 billion. Total assets surged 245.45% to Rp23.56 trillion, liabilities rose 548.80% to Rp18.89 trillion, equity increased 19.44% to Rp4.67 trillion, and the BNBR share price jumped about 28% to Rp206 on the day of the report.

title: PT Berlian Laju Tanker Tbk reports Director A Yulian Hery Ernanto's resignation effective February 27, 2026
body: PT Berlian Laju Tanker Tbk announced the resignation of Director A Yulian Hery Ernanto, received on February 27, 2026, which will be submitted for approval at the next shareholders' meeting. The company affirmed that the departure will not impact its operations, legal standing, financial condition, or business continuity, noting Yulian's prior experience as an independent consultant and at PT Deloitte Consulting.

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara Persero Tbk removes M. Dwi Ary Purnomo as Vice Chairman effective February 25, 2025
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara Persero Tbk announced that M. Dwi Ary Purnomo ceased to serve as Vice Chairman of its Board of Commissioners on 25 February 2025 to comply with regulations on dual positions in state-owned enterprises and the financial services sector. The move also ends his roles at the Ministry of State-Owned Enterprises and PT Pertamina EP, and the bank said it will not affect its operations, legal standing, or financial performance.

title: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk posts 33.8% profit rise and strong cash flow in 2025
body: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk, also known as Cimory, reported a 2025 net profit of Rp2.03 trillion, up 33.8% from the prior year, with net sales increasing 18.8% to Rp10.72 trillion driven by its dairy (Rp4.07 trillion) and consumer‑foods (Rp6.65 trillion) segments. The balance sheet showed total assets of Rp8.74 trillion, liabilities of Rp1.96 trillion and equity of Rp6.78 trillion, while operating cash flow rose 10.3% to a surplus of Rp1.91 trillion, supported by a 17.6% jump in cash receipts to Rp10.58 trillion.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk launches Rp5 trillion sustainable social bond series with rates up to 5.95%
body: The bank issued a Rp5 trillion Sustainable Social Bond I Phase II for 2026 in three series—Series A (Rp1,236 trillion, 4.85% for 370 days), Series B (Rp2,666 trillion, 5.70% for three years) and Series C (Rp1,097 trillion, 5.95% for five years)—earning an idAAA rating from PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia Pefindo. Proceeds, after issuance costs, will be allocated to social projects, with about half directed to MSME job creation, and the bond will be listed on the IDX on 25 March 2026.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk expands wireline services capability through partnership with PT Schlumberger Geophysics Nusantara
body: PT Elnusa Tbk has launched the Technology Access Enablement and Delivery to Elnusa program with PT Schlumberger Geophysics Nusantara, giving it access to advanced open‑hole and cased‑hole wireline logging tools and a structured capacity‑building roadmap. The initiative supports the company's 2026 transformation theme “Rediscover Technology & Innovation Edge” and aims to broaden its service portfolio and operational excellence.

title: PT PP Persero Tbk’s January 2026 contract wins rise 120.8% to Rp2.76 trillion
body: PT PP Persero Tbk reported that it secured new contracts worth Rp2.76 trillion in January 2026, a 120.8% increase year‑on‑year, with the majority funded by the government (73.31%) and state‑owned enterprises (25.20%). The contracts are dominated by building projects (43.28% of value) and include major assignments such as the Office Building for the Supreme Court (Rp820.7 billion) and the Medan BRT Metropolitan project (Rp538.5 billion).

title: Indonesia to auction nine series of government bonds on March 3, targeting up to Rp33 trillion
body: The Ministry of Finance’s Directorate General of Funding and Risk will conduct a SUN auction on 3 March 2026, aiming to raise an indicative Rp33 trillion (up to 150 % of target) by issuing three short‑term SPN series and six long‑term government bond series with yields ranging from 5.87 % to 7.12% and maturities up to 38 years. The open auction will be run by Bank Indonesia and participants must submit bids through primary dealers including PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Persero Tbk and PT Bank Permata Tbk.

title: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk reports 39% year‑on‑year increase in net profit for FY2025
body: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk posted a net profit of Rp361.72 billion for the full year 2025, up 39.01% from 2024, driven by a 33.95% rise in revenue to Rp5.76 trillion and a 15% increase in sales volume. The company’s EPS grew to Rp11.62, total assets reached Rp10.17 trillion, equity rose 15.10% to Rp2.82 trillion, and its shares closed flat at Rp136 on 27 Feb 2026.

title: Gold prices could hit $6,000 per ounce amid escalating US‑Iran tensions, pushing Indonesian Antam gold to around Rp3.5 million per gram
body: Gold futures analyst Ibrahim Assuaibi expects world gold to reach $6,000 per ounce in March as the US‑Iran conflict intensifies, with the current price at $5,278.51 per ounce and a 22.01% gain year‑to‑date in 2026. The surge could lift Indonesia's Antam gold price from Rp3.08 million to roughly Rp3.5 million per gram, an increase of about 13.6%.

title: VKTR posts higher 2025 sales but swings to a net loss as EV growth is offset by rising costs
body: VKTR reported 2025 net sales of Rp1.09 trillion, up 8.5% YoY, driven by a 60% jump in electric‑vehicle sales, but net profit plunged 96.6% to a loss of Rp11.37 billion after higher operating and financial costs. Total assets rose 11.8% to Rp1.79 trillion while liabilities increased 22.2% to Rp553.02 billion, mainly from a new long‑term loan from Bank MNC Internasional Tbk, and the company delivered 50 electric buses to Transjakarta and other EV units to various clients.

title: PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk reports 2025 revenue and net profit growth
body: PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk recorded 2025 revenue of Rp21.06 trillion, up 32% year‑on‑year, and net profit of Rp2.07 trillion, a 33% increase. Despite a 2% decline in core fresh fruit bunch production, crude palm oil output rose 4% and net gearing improved to 0.04×.

title: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk posts higher 2025 sales and net profit despite declining assets
body: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk reported 2025 sales of Rp4.07 trillion, a 4.10% year‑on‑year increase, with net profit of Rp1.22 trillion, up 4.97% and earnings per share rising to Rp41.36. Total assets fell to Rp3.68 trillion, liabilities rose to Rp561.44 trillion and equity declined to Rp3.12 trillion by year‑end.

title: OJK imposes billions of rupiah in fines on PT Indo Pureco Pratama Tbk, PT Tianrong Chemical Industry Tbk, PT KGI Sekuritas Indonesia and related parties for capital‑market violations
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) levied administrative sanctions and fines totaling billions of rupiah on PT Indo Pureco Pratama Tbk (4,625 billion), PT KGI Sekuritas Indonesia (3.4 billion) and on directors, auditors and a public accounting firm, while also penalising PT Tianrong Chemical Industry Tbk and its executives with fines that sum to about 6.21 billion rupiah for financial‑statement misstatements, undisclosed beneficial owners and failure to hold annual general meetings; additional penalties include a 650 million rupiah fine and an 18‑month market ban for the KGI Sekuritas chief executive.

title: PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk reports 21% revenue growth and 28% net profit increase in FY 2025
body: PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk, also known as Lonsum, posted revenue of Rp5.51 trillion in FY 2025, up 21% YoY, and net profit of Rp1.88 trillion, up 28% YoY, while crude palm oil production rose 2% to 292,000 tons despite a 3% decline in fresh fruit bunch output. The company ended the year debt‑free, emphasizing cost control, operational efficiency and sustainable agribusiness investments.

title: Indonesia confirms US tariff on its exports will be 15% after Supreme Court ruling, while broader trade deal remains intact
body: Indonesia's Coordinating Economic Affairs Minister Airlangga Hartarto said the US will apply a 15% global tariff on Indonesian exports, not the 19% agreed in Washington, following a US Supreme Court decision that voided the reciprocal tariff policy. The bilateral agreement still grants 0% tariff access for 1,819 product categories, including palm oil, coffee and semiconductors, pending parliamentary ratification.

title: Indonesia pledges to protect its solar panel industry amid US provisional countervailing duties
body: The United States announced provisional countervailing duties of 85.99% to 143.30% on Indonesian solar panel products, prompting Indonesia’s Trade Ministry to cooperate fully and prepare for on‑site verification in April 2026 to avoid harsher penalties. Indonesia’s duties remain lower than those imposed on regional rivals such as Vietnam (up to 542%), Thailand (263%) and Cambodia (over 3,400%), with a final US ruling expected in July 2026.

title: US‑Indonesia trade agreement, criticized as one‑sided, includes labor‑protective clauses on outsourcing and minimum wages
body: While the deal has faced backlash for favoring Washington, economist Riandy Laksono highlighted that it obliges Indonesia to end minimum‑wage exemptions, restrict core‑business outsourcing and limit fixed‑term contracts, aligning with recent labor‑union demands. These provisions are described as the agreement’s “hidden gems” for Indonesian workers.

title: Astra International reports modest 2025 earnings decline as coal and new‑car sales weaken, offset by gains in other divisions
body: Astra International posted 2025 consolidated net revenue of Rp 323.4 trillion, a 2% drop from 2024, and net profit of Rp 32.8 trillion, down 3%, mainly due to lower coal prices and weaker new‑car sales. Gains in gold mining, financial services, motorcycles and other segments helped cushion the decline, and the share price fell to Rp 6,650, down 1.12%.

title: Indonesia’s traditional warung shops decline as modern retailers expand, prompting a government cooperative push
body: The street vendor association APKLI reports that Indonesia’s warung kelontong fell from 6.1 million in 2007 to about 3.9 million, a loss of roughly 2.2 million stores, due to simplified licensing that spurred rapid growth of modern retailers. The government plans to launch 83,000 community cooperatives and tighten supervision of modern retail to support the rural economy.

title: Analysts Expect Telecom Sector Gains During Ramadan as Indosat, EXCL, SMARTFREN and Telkom Outline 2025 Results and Strategic Moves
body: Telecom stocks are seen benefiting from higher data usage during Ramadan and Lebaran, with analysts highlighting Indosat’s modest revenue growth to IDR 56.52 trillion and 12.2% profit increase in 2025, its 2026 mid‑to‑high single‑digit growth target and expansion into FWA via Indosat HiFi. Meanwhile EXCL posted a 23.44% revenue rise to IDR 42.45 trillion but a net loss of IDR 4.43 trillion, SMARTFREN rolled out Ramadan promos and a quota‑accumulation feature, and Telkom is weighing a $1‑1.5 billion sale of its data‑center business while prioritising a $4‑7 billion fiber‑optic divestiture.

title: Indonesia's Basic Materials Index Jumps 19.79% YTD on Commodity Rebound, Led by Gold and Nickel Stocks
body: The IDX Basic Materials index rose 19.79% year‑to‑date to 2,465,343, becoming the sole sector with double‑digit growth as global commodity prices and a fund rotation into resource‑based equities boosted performance. Analysts pointed to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk as the main drivers, noting a target price of Rp 4,420 for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk and emphasizing that valuation and commodity‑price trends will shape medium‑term outlooks.

title: Analysts see positive 2026 outlook for PT Bundamedik Tbk as it shifts to complex medical services
body: Research heads at KISI Sekuritas and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas consider PT Bundamedik Tbk's 2026 prospects positive, citing a realistic double‑digit revenue growth target, a strategic shift toward high‑margin complex medical services, and asset‑utilisation improvements. Both analysts maintain a buy rating, with KISI Sekuritas setting a target price of Rp 250 per share, while noting medical inflation and cost efficiency as key challenges.

title: Middle East conflict spurs risk‑off trading, lifts gold and oil and pressures Indonesia's stock market
body: Escalating tensions between Iran, Israel and the United States are driving a risk‑off shift, with gold gaining over 1% and WTI/Brent crude rising close to 3% as investors brace for possible energy supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz. Analyst Hendra Wardana sees Indonesia's IHSG testing support at 8,133 and recommends buying MDKA (target 3,900), ANTM (target 4,500), ELSA (target 900), ENRG (target 1,900), AKRA (target 1,400) and SOCI (target 750) as commodity‑linked stocks could benefit.

title: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk reports 28.7% drop in 2025 net profit amid declining sales and tighter margins
body: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk posted net profit attributable to owners of Rp258.51 billion for 2025, down 28.70% YoY from Rp362.56 billion in 2024, as revenue fell 4.58% to Rp3.75 trillion and operating profit slipped 25.82% to Rp386.71 billion. Total assets contracted 5.61% to Rp3.53 trillion while liabilities rose 4.20% to Rp1.49 trillion, and the shares closed up 0.65% at Rp770.

title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk reports USD13.1 million affiliate contract for long‑lead items, shares jump 8.6%
body: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk disclosed an affiliate transaction with Energy Equity Epic Pty Ltd and a consortium of PT Mitra Raya Energi and PT Energi Drilling Utama for the supply of long‑lead items, with a maximum contract value of USD13.08 million over 17 months. The announcement coincided with an 8.64% rise in ENRG shares to Rp 1,760 per share.

title: Jaya Real Property JRPT posts 15% rise in 2025 net profit to Rp1.3 trillion
body: Jaya Real Property JRPT reported a 2025 net profit of Rp1.3 trillion, up 15% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share increasing to Rp101.14. Revenue grew 11.2% to Rp3.27 trillion and total assets rose to Rp15.23 trillion, while equity and liabilities also expanded.

title: Sariguna Primatirta CLEO reports solid Q3 sales growth and launches three new factories to support massive expansion
body: Sariguna Primatirta CLEO posted a 5.8% rise in Q3 2025 sales to Rp2.09 trillion and a 9% increase in EBITDA, reflecting a strong capital structure and robust internal cash flow. The company completed three new plants in Palu, Pontianak and Pekanbaru, raising its total Indonesian factories to 35 and underpinning its aggressive expansion strategy for 2026.

title: Seven controlling shareholders buy 233.2 million Garudafood GOOD shares for Rp83.26 billion
body: Seven controlling shareholders collectively purchased 233,238 million shares of Garudafood GOOD at Rp357 per share, resulting in a total cash outlay of approximately Rp83.26 billion. The transactions gave the participants ownership stakes ranging from about 1.11% to 9.85% of the company.

title: Salim Ivomas Pratama posts 33% rise in net profit to Rp2.07 trillion for 2025
body: Salim Ivomas Pratama reported net profit of Rp2.07 trillion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 33% increase from the prior year, with earnings per share climbing to Rp133. Revenue rose 32% to Rp21.06 trillion, driven by higher average selling prices, greater palm oil volumes, and a net gearing ratio that fell to 0.04x.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased 111,600 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk at a representative price of IDR 145 per share on 25 Feb 2026, raising his holding from 2,808,960 to 2,920,560 shares (+111,600). The buy aligns with his stated investment strategy, expanding his equity stake and signaling confidence in the logistics firm’s prospects.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 1,240,300 PT Hillcon Tbk shares on 27 Feb 2026 at IDR 50 per share, reducing its stake from 6,106,359,000 to 6,105,118,700 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment move, marginally lowers its ownership by about 0.02%, indicating a modest portfolio adjustment.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange reports 3,040 sanctions on 453 listed companies in 2025, with mixed trends across compliance categories
body: The BEI imposed 3,040 sanctions on 453 listed issuers in 2025, the majority for delayed financial reporting (1,223 sanctions) while penalties for free‑float compliance fell 14% to 386. In January 2026 the exchange had already issued 294 sanctions to 142 companies, 57% of which related to financial reporting and public expose obligations.

title: PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk reports 8.8% revenue growth and 32.6% profit increase in 2025
body: In 2025 PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk posted net sales of Rp60.71 trillion, an 8.8% YoY rise, and net profit of Rp4 trillion, up 32.63% YoY, raising earnings per share to Rp344. The company’s total assets reached Rp40.06 trillion with liabilities of Rp20.04 trillion and equity of Rp20.01 trillion.

title: Panca Mitra PMMP posts USD15.1 million loss for 2025, net sales plunge 98%
body: Panca Mitra PMMP reported a net loss of USD15.1 million for 2025, a 1,009% swing from a USD1.66 million profit in the prior year, with loss per share of USD0,0058 versus a prior surplus of USD0,0006. Net sales fell 97.8% to USD7.09 million, assets declined to USD208.3 million while liabilities rose to USD259.81 million, widening the capital deficit to USD51.5 million and total deficit to USD94.33 million.

title: R. Djoko Prayitno Se Buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: On 26 Feb 2026, shareholder R. Djoko Prayitno Se purchased 63,900 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (BCIC.JK) at IDR 156 per share for investment purposes. The holding increased from 2,774,000 to 2,837,900 shares, a net gain of 63,900 shares, raising the shareholder’s stake in the bank.

title: Hendrianto Thamrin buy Shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk
body: Shareholder Hendrianto Thamrin purchased 110,500,000 shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk at IDR 200 per share on 27 Feb 2026, investing IDR 22,100,000,000. His holding rose from 1,179,750,000 to 1,290,250,000 shares, a net increase of 9.4%. The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding his stake in the listed company and potentially influencing future voting power.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: On 26 February 2026, shareholder Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold 4,600 Bayan Resources Tbk shares at IDR 14,104 per share, reducing his holding from 511,000 to 506,400 shares (a decline of 0.9%). The divestment purpose is listed as "Divestment," indicating a strategic reduction of his stake in the coal mining firm. The transaction modestly lowers his ownership percentage but does not materially affect overall share float.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Hillcon Equity Management sold 1,240,300 PT Hillcon Tbk shares at IDR 50 per share on 27 Feb 2026. The holding fell from 6,106,359,000 to 6,105,118,700 shares, a reduction of 1,240,300 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment‑related sale, reflecting a modest adjustment in the shareholder's stake without altering control of the company.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko Buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 27 February 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased a total of 262,800 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) at prices ranging from IDR 143 to IDR 150 per share, with a representative price of IDR 145 per share. His holding increased from 2,920,560 to 3,183,360 shares, adding 262,800 shares to his portfolio. The transaction is classified under an Investment Strategy, signaling a deliberate expansion of his stake in the logistics company, which may enhance his voting power and influence on corporate decisions.

title: Middle‑East tensions and a possible Hormuz closure could boost VLCC rates and benefit Indonesian energy‑logistics stocks
body: Research head Muhammad Wafi warns that heightened Middle‑East conflict and the risk of the Strait of Hormuz being closed may sharply raise VLCC charter rates, creating a direct upside for domestic energy‑logistics firms. Companies such as PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk, PT Soechi Lines Tbk, PT Humpuss Intermoda Transportasi Tbk, PT GTS Internasional Tbk and PT Elnusa Tbk could benefit, especially if Brent oil stays above $90 and PT Pertamina increases capex for domestic production.

title: Middle‑East tensions push Indonesia's benchmark lower while oil‑gas and gold stocks rally
body: Escalating US‑Israel‑Iran tensions in the Middle East caused the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to fall 1.82% to 8,086, yet Brent crude surged about 13% to roughly $82 per barrel, lifting energy and precious‑metal shares; PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk rose 8.12%, PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk 14.77%, PT AKR Corporindo Tbk 2.32%, PT Elnusa Tbk 7.65%, PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk 6.20%, PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk 3.35%, PT Rukun Raharja Tbk 7.11%, PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk 3.12% and gold miners PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (+3.68%), PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (+2.66%), PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (+4.12%), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (+3.60%), PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk (+0.31%) and PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk (+1.82%) also posted gains, with analysts flagging energy and gold as defensive sectors amid geopolitical volatility.

title: PT Matahari Department Store Tbk reports 12.4% drop in net profit for 2025 amid declining revenues
body: PT Matahari Department Store Tbk recorded net profit of Rp725.4 billion for 2025, down 12.4% year‑on‑year, as net revenue fell 9.6% to Rp5.78 trillion driven by lower sales across retail, consignment and services segments. Despite reduced cost of goods sold and operating expenses, other income rose sharply to Rp103.37 billion, while total assets slipped slightly to Rp5.13 trillion and equity fell to Rp272.9 billion.

title: Ritsuo Fukadai buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: On 26 February 2026, shareholder Ritsuo Fukadai purchased 3,100 common shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. (ticker: BCIC.JK) at IDR 156 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 132,100 to 135,200 shares, a net increase of 3,100 shares. The buy reflects an incremental stake in the bank, potentially indicating confidence in its future performance.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange urges rational investing as geopolitical tensions push the composite index lower
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia warned investors to stay rational as the Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.41% to 8,119.10 amid heightened US‑Iran geopolitical tension, while energy stocks MEDC and ENRG surged 8.70% and 13.64% respectively. CGS International Sekuritas noted the Middle East conflict could raise inflation and dampen sentiment, though higher commodity prices, especially gold, may provide support, and reported the death of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in a US‑Israel strike.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buy‑back price climbs near its all‑time high amid rising global gold prices
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk’s gold buy‑back price rose by Rp50,000 to Rp2,914,000 per gram on 2 March 2026, closing in on its all‑time high of Rp2,989,000 reached on 29 January 2026. The rise mirrors a 1.9% increase in global spot gold to US$5,380.91 per ounce, driven by heightened geopolitical tensions and strong central‑bank buying, according to analyst Ahmad Assiri of Pepperstone Group Ltd.

title: Geopolitical tensions prompt risk-off sentiment and sector-specific stock recommendations in Indonesia
body: Escalating US‑Israel and Iran tensions have driven global markets into a risk-off stance, with the Nikkei falling 1.55%, the SSE Composite down 0.46% and Indonesia's IHSG opening over 1% lower. Analysts at Kiwoom Sekuritas and OCBC Sekuritas recommend trimming high‑beta exposure and favoring defensive or commodity‑linked stocks such as PT AKR Corporindo Tbk, PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk, PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, PT Timah Tbk and solid‑fundamental names like BBCA, BBRI, BMRI, ANTM, among others.

title: IHSG slides amid heightened Middle East tensions as energy stocks rise and analysts recommend select commodity and mining shares
body: On March 2, 2026 the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 1.42% to 8,118.46 as geopolitical risk from the Iran‑US‑Israel conflict lifted global risk premiums, strengthened the dollar and pressured emerging‑market capital flows. Despite broad weakness, the energy sector gained 1.92% and BRI Danareksa and Sinarmas Sekuritas recommended buying PT Medco Energi International Tbk, PT Elnusa Tbk and PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk while advising a sell on PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk.

title: Antam gold prices rise on March 2, 2026, with higher spot and buyback rates
body: On Monday, March 2, 2026, Antam’s 0.5‑gram gold bar price increased to Rp1,617,500 (up Rp25,000) and the 1‑gram bar to Rp3,135,000 (up Rp50,000). The buyback price was set at Rp2,914,000 per gram, a Rp50,000 rise, and transactions above Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% PPh 22 tax under PMK No 81/2024.

title: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk reports 28.7% drop in net profit for 2025 amid weaker sales
body: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk recorded revenue of Rp3.75 trillion in 2025, but net profit fell 28.69% year‑on‑year to Rp258.51 billion, lowering earnings per share to Rp45.81. Total assets declined to Rp3.53 trillion while liabilities rose to Rp1.49 trillion and equity fell to Rp2.04 trillion.

title: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk projects 34% revenue growth to Rp5.8 trillion in 2025
body: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk reported 2025 revenue of Rp5.8 trillion, a 34% year‑on‑year increase driven by a 15% rise in sales volume and higher crude palm oil prices, while net profit is expected to reach Rp379 billion, up 39% from 2024. The company also completed an extension mill, plans new biogas and kernel‑crushing facilities, and improved its sustainability credentials with RSPO and ISPO certifications and a SPOTT score of 85.67.

title: Indonesia's IHSG faces pressure amid Middle East conflict and upcoming US and domestic data
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is expected to stay under pressure on Monday as the escalation of the US‑Iran conflict lifts oil prices above $72 per barrel and fuels a global risk‑off mood, while key US and Indonesian data (manufacturing PMI, trade balance, February inflation and foreign‑exchange reserves) are slated for release this week. Phintrana Sekuritas advises buying shares of Harum Energy, Trimegah Bangun Persada, Samudera Indonesia, Amman Mineral Internasional and Erajaya Swasembada, whereas Mirae Asset warns that the geopolitical tension could trigger capital outflows and prompt Bank Indonesia to intervene.

title: Indonesia's composite index eyed at 8,200 support as BNI Sekuritas flags buying opportunities in MEDC, ANTM and other stocks
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is projected to test the 8,200 support level on March 2, 2026, with a potential drop to 8,050 if the support fails, while resistance lies between 8,280 and 8,320. BNI Sekuritas recommends buying MEDC, ANTM, ARCI, HRTA, ITMG and SOCI, and notes a foreign net sell of about Rp802 billion, with the most sold stocks being BBCA, INDF, BBNI, BBRI and PTRO.

title: IHSG likely to weaken on risk-off sentiment as US‑Israel strike on Iran fuels foreign outflows
body: Analyst Reza Diofanda of BRI Danareksa Sekuritas expects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to trade volatile but lower amid heightened global risk-off sentiment after the US‑Israel strike on Iran, noting a net foreign sell of Rp694.22 billion and support at 8,150‑8,100. He recommends buying PT Medco Energi International Tbk, PT Elnusa Tbk and PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk with specific price targets, while advising a sell on PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk.

title: PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk posts 2025 revenue and profit growth with strong margins and dividend payout
body: PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk reported 2025 sales of Rp4.07 trillion (up 4.1% YoY) and net profit of Rp1.23 trillion (up 4.97%), with EPS rising to Rp41.36, gross margin at 58%, operating margin 38% and net margin 30%, and ROE/ROA of 39%/33%. The company held cash of Rp463 billion, paid a dividend of Rp1.28 trillion, executed a Rp300 billion share buyback, remained debt‑free, and aims to expand export and digital distribution in 2026.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange suspends PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk shares for fourth time amid sharp price surge
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) imposed a fourth temporary trading suspension on PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk on 2 March 2026, citing an unjustified price jump that saw the stock rise from Rp44 to Rp1,000—a 2,172.27% increase over five months and a 114.59% gain in the past month. The suspension aims to cool down the market and protect investors after the stock recorded six consecutive auto‑rejection alerts and a 6.95% rise on 27 February.

title: Ramayana Makmursentosa to Absorb 203.5 Million Ramayana Lestari Shares in Off‑Exchange Transfer
body: Ramayana Makmursentosa will acquire 203,513,800 shares of Ramayana Lestari (RALS) through an off‑exchange transfer between 27 March and 7 April 2026, following a buy‑back approved on 24 August 2025 at an average price of Rp651.28 per share (approximately Rp132.54 billion). The company had already transferred 27 million shares by 31 December 2025, generating tactical funds of Rp39.77 billion.

title: London Sumatra alias Lonsum reports 27.9% profit rise in 2025
body: London Sumatra alias Lonsum posted a 2025 net profit of Rp1.88 trillion, up 27.9% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share rising to Rp277 and revenue reaching Rp5.51 trillion, a 20.8% increase. The company reported no bank debt, a 30% jump in operating profit to Rp2.01 trillion, and a modest rise in total CPO production to 292 thousand tonnes despite a 3% drop in core fresh fruit bunch output.

title: Mulia Boga KEJU reports 22.2% increase in 2025 net profit to Rp179.44 billion
body: Mulia Boga KEJU posted a 2025 net profit of Rp179.44 billion, up 22.16% from the prior year, with earnings per share rising to Rp31.90. Net sales reached Rp1.5 trillion, while total assets grew to Rp1.25 trillion.

title: Cikarang Listrindo POWR posts 2025 profit of $72.05 million, down 4.4% year‑over‑year
body: Cikarang Listrindo POWR reported a 2025 net profit of $72.05 million (EPS $0,0046), a 4.36% decline from the prior year, with net sales of $553.49 million, up 1.18% driven by higher industrial customer sales. Sales to PLN dropped 27.07% to $55.33 million, while fuel and depreciation expenses rose; equity rose to $714.98 million, liabilities fell to $476.47 million and total assets decreased to $1.19 billion.

title: Bank Banten reports 33.5% increase in 2025 net profit to Rp52.5 billion
body: Bank Banten reported a net profit of Rp52.52 billion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 33.53% rise from the prior year and lifting earnings per share to Rp1.01. The bank’s interest income grew 16% to Rp570.49 billion, while total assets reached Rp10 trillion and equity rose to Rp1.9 trillion.

title: PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia Tbk KAQI aims for 25‑30% sales growth by 2026 while expanding its car‑foot specialist network
body: PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia Tbk KAQI, a newly listed IDX car‑foot specialist with 22 branches in Java and Bali, announced a 2026 sales and bottom‑line growth target of 25‑30% supported by aggressive opening of new branches in Bogor and Gianyar and a free‑service guarantee. The firm also plans to distribute dividends this year, has earned ISO 9001:2025, ISO 45001:2018 and a Top Brand Award, and is running a BYD‑car raffle to motivate staff.

title: SKK Migas backs first chemical injection field trial at Meruap field in Jambi
body: SKK Migas welcomed the inauguration of a chemical‑injection field trial at the Meruap field in Sarolangun, Jambi, carried out by Pertamina EP in partnership with Samudera Energy Bandar Wijaya Property under the KSO BWP Meruap arrangement. The trial, using domestically produced Starborn SeMAR and RCT A‑127 chemicals, targets improved oil recovery in the mature field, which previously peaked at about 5,000 bbl/day in the primary phase and 2,500 bbl/day in the secondary phase.

title: Teddy Thamrin Chandra Ong buy Shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk
body: On 27 February 2026, Teddy Thamrin Chandra Ong purchased 110,500,000 shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk (HGII.JK) at IDR 200 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from zero to 110,500,000 shares, establishing a new significant equity position in the company.

title: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Persero Tbk launches virtual account payment option on Lazada as part of BYOND expansion
body: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Persero Tbk introduced a new feature allowing customers to use its virtual account (VA) as a payment method on Lazada, extending its BYOND digital ecosystem which already includes Shopee, Tokopedia and Blibli. The move follows a 122% year‑on‑year increase in BSI e‑commerce transactions in January 2026 and includes a limited‑time 10% discount up to Rp50,000 for VA users on Lazada from 15‑28 February 2026.

title: True Land signs MoU with Perumdam Tirta Tarum to supply clean water for District East Karawang
body: True Land announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding with Perumdam Tirta Tarum to provide and distribute clean water to the District East integrated residential‑commercial development in Karawang. The partnership aims to establish a sustainable water‑supply infrastructure that supports the project’s growth and improves residents’ quality of life.

title: Commissioner Ida Ayu Somawati increases stake in PT Hatten Bali Tbk
body: Ida Ayu Somawati, a commissioner of PT Hatten Bali Tbk, purchased 100,000 common shares at Rp202 per share on 2 March 2026, raising her holding to 1,877,600 shares (0.069%). The transaction, disclosed as an investment, increased her ownership from 0.065% to 0.069%.

title: Herrijanto Widjaja sell Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Herrijanto Widjaja sold a total of 150,400 shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk as a divestment, with a representative price of IDR 16,200 per share. The transaction reduced his holding from 7,509,900 to 7,359,500 shares, a decrease of 150,400 shares. This sale lowers his ownership stake in the company, reflecting a strategic divestment decision.

title: PT Harita Jayaraya sell Shares of PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk
body: PT Harita Jayaraya sold PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk shares for IDR 991,134,000, representing a representative price of about IDR 1,277 per share. The holding fell from IDR 51,335,566,000 to IDR 50,344,432,000, a decline of roughly 2% of its stake. The transaction is classified as an investment‑related sale and reduces the shareholder's ownership proportion in the company.

title: Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara sell Shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk
body: Shareholder Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara sold a total of 100,000 shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk on 25 February 2026, at a representative price of IDR 1,070 per share. The divestment reduces his holding from 71,512,700 to 71,412,700 shares, a decrease of 100,000 shares. This transaction reflects a strategic divestment by the shareholder and marginally lowers his ownership stake in the company.

title: Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: On 26 Feb 2026, shareholder Felix Istyono Hartadi T, Sh purchased 31,900 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. at IDR 156 per share, increasing his holding from 1,353,500 to 1,385,400 shares (+31,900). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises his ownership stake in the bank, reflecting confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko Buy Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: On 27 February 2026, shareholder Wahyu Dwi Jatmiko purchased a total of 262,800 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk (LOPI.JK) at a representative price of IDR 147 per share as part of an investment strategy. The acquisition raised his holding from 2,920,560 to 3,183,360 shares, a net increase of 262,800 shares, strengthening his position in the company.

title: Helmi Arif Hidayat buy Shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk.
body: Helmi Arif Hidayat purchased 63,900 shares of PT Bank JTrust Indonesia Tbk. at IDR 156 per share on 26 Feb 2026, increasing his stake from 2,778,300 to 2,842,200 shares (a net gain of 63,900 shares). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises his ownership modestly and signals confidence in the bank’s outlook.

title: Vembu Suresh sell Shares of PT AKR Corporindo Tbk.
body: Shareholder Vembu Suresh sold a total of 2,114,700 PT AKR Corporindo Tbk. (AKRA.JK) shares between 26 Feb and 2 Mar 2026, at a representative price of IDR 1,349 per share. His holding decreased from 4,927,500 to 2,812,800 shares, a reduction of roughly 43% of his stake. The transaction is classified as an investment‑related divestment, reflecting a strategic reallocation of his portfolio. The sizable sell‑off may influence market perception of the stock’s valuation and liquidity.

title: PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk achieves 100% sales target in 2025 with strong residential demand and record revenue growth
body: PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk reported marketing sales of Rp 1.65 trillion in 2025, meeting its 100% target, with residential units contributing 58% and commercial units 38% of sales and a total of 1,486 units sold, including new projects The Allegra @Casa De Lago and Neo Top. The company’s revenue rose 133% to Rp 4.52 trillion, gross profit reached Rp 783 billion (17% margin) and EBITDA was Rp 381.3 billion (8% margin), driven by hand‑over of houses, apartments, commercial units and industrial land.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 2 March 2026, investor Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased a total of 338,500 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares for investment purposes, with transactions recorded at prices around IDR 1,415 per share. His holding increased from 214,043,022 to 214,381,522 shares, adding 338,500 shares to his stake. The acquisition reflects a modest expansion of his position in the cybersecurity firm, signaling confidence in the company's growth prospects.

title: PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk Shareholder Kemal Mawira Reports New Transaction
body: Kemal Mawira increased his stake in PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk (MPMX.JK) by 327,600 shares, raising his holding from 342,600 to 670,200 shares. The shares were issued at IDR 1,030 per share on 2 March 2026 as part of the company’s Long Term Incentive Programs. The transaction expands the insider’s ownership and aligns his interests with shareholders.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold 17,400 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 530 per share on 27 Feb 2026. His holding decreased from 14,851,259 to 14,833,859 shares, a reduction of about 0.12% of his stake. The transaction is recorded as a simple share sale without additional strategic context, but it slightly lowers his ownership in the company.

title: Turniady Widjaja Buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja, a shareholder of Roda Vivatex Tbk (RDTX.JK), executed a buy transaction on 2 March 2026, purchasing 200 shares at an average price of IDR 16.200 per share. The holding increased from 50,431,200 to 50,431,400 shares, a delta of +200 shares. The purchase was made for investment purposes, reinforcing the shareholder’s stake in the company. The transaction represents a modest addition to an already substantial holding, indicating confidence in Roda Vivatex’s prospects.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com buy Shares of PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk
body: On 2026-03-03, 1 Inti Dot Com bought 3,695,000 shares of PT Distribusi Voucher Nusantara Tbk (DIVA.JK) for an investment purpose, paying an average price of IDR 164.00 per share. The transaction increased the shareholder’s holding from 313,500,300 to 317,195,300 shares, a net gain of 3,695,000 shares. This move modestly enlarges 1 Inti Dot Com’s stake and signals confidence in DIVA’s growth prospects.

title: Ir Fxl Kesuma Msc Buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Ir Fxl Kesuma Msc purchased 1,600,000 shares of Astra International Tbk at an average price of IDR 6.600 per share. The transaction, classified as an investment, increased the shareholder’s holding from 2,200,000 to 3,800,000 shares, a net gain of 1,600,000 shares. This move strengthens the investor’s position in the company and signals confidence in Astra International’s prospects, potentially influencing market sentiment and the company’s capital structure.

title: Gidion Hasan buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Gidion Hasan purchased 700,000 shares of Astra International Tbk on 27 February 2026 at IDR 6,631.0 per share, increasing his holding from 6,065,000 to 6,765,000 shares (a 700,000‑share jump). The purchase was made for investment purposes. The transaction raises the shareholder’s stake by 10.9% of the company’s issued shares, signaling confidence in Astra’s prospects and potentially influencing its capital structure.

title: PT Jasa Marga Tbk posts lower revenue and net profit in 2025 despite higher assets
body: PT Jasa Marga Tbk reported a 5.88% drop in 2025 revenue to Rp29.89 trillion, with toll, other business and construction segments contributing Rp18.15 trillion, Rp1.65 trillion and Rp10.07 trillion respectively. While gross profit rose 4.21% to Rp11.78 trillion, net profit attributable to the parent fell 19.27% to Rp3.65 trillion, and total assets, liabilities and equity increased to Rp159.9 trillion, Rp97.6 trillion and Rp62.3 trillion.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk gold buyback price climbs 22.9% YTD as global gold strengthens
body: The buyback price for gold at PT Aneka Tambang Tbk rose 22.92% year‑to‑date to Rp2,901,000 per gram, still below its all‑time high of Rp2,989,000, while spot gold reached US$5,329 per ounce driven by heightened Middle East tensions and Fed policy expectations.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk says domestic focus and mitigation measures limit immediate impact of a potential Hormuz Strait closure
body: PT Elnusa Tbk reported that despite geopolitical tensions around the Hormuz Strait, its upstream‑domestic operations remain on schedule and it has put in place vendor management, strategic partner coordination and prudent operational adjustments to safeguard service continuity, while highlighting solid 2025 results across oilfield services, EPC, petro‑fuel distribution and data management; OCBC Sekuritas warned that a Hormuz closure could disrupt about 20% of global oil shipments, lift crude prices and insurance premiums, and create market volatility that may favor energy, shipping and gold‑related stocks.

title: Southeast Asian exchanges echo Indonesia’s capital‑market reforms as OJK unveils expanded free‑float and transparency measures
body: OJK’s interim chair Friderica Widyasari Dewi said that other regional bourses, including Bursa Malaysia and Bursa Filipina, are adopting similar reforms such as higher free‑float thresholds, stricter nominee‑account transparency and a reversal of a planned free‑float cut. OJK’s own eight‑action plan groups reforms into four clusters, notably raising the minimum public float from 7.5% to 15%, mandating UBO disclosure and lowering the public‑ownership reporting trigger to 1%, while pursuing demutualisation of the IDX, tighter enforcement and greater inter‑authority coordination.

title: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology Tbk posts doubled profit in 2025 despite slight output decline
body: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology Tbk reported a 2025 net profit of Rp2.58 trillion, a 102% YoY increase, while its TBS and CPO outputs fell modestly (1% and 1% respectively) to 2.21 million tons and 525 000 tons. Sales rose 10% to Rp86.94 trillion (53% domestic, 47% export) and the company plans to spend about Rp3 trillion in 2026 on plantation renewal, added processing capacity and carbon‑reduction initiatives, keeping plantation production stable.

title: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk sells Sariwangi tea business to PT Savoria Kreasi Rasa for Rp1.5 trillion
body: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk completed the divestiture of its Sariwangi tea brand to PT Savoria Kreasi Rasa, an entity of Grup Djarum, receiving full payment of Rp1.5 trillion, which equals roughly 45 % of Unilever’s equity, 2.5 % of total assets, 3.1 % of net profit and 2.7 % of revenue. The company said the deal has no material impact on operations and will enable it to focus on core businesses and return value to shareholders.

title: Antam gold buyback price falls to Rp2.901 million per gram on March 3, 2026
body: On Tuesday, March 3, 2026, Antam set its 1‑gram gold buyback price at Rp2,901,000, down Rp13,000 from the previous level, while the selling price was Rp3,122,000 per gram. Transactions above Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% income tax (PPh Pasal 22) deducted at the time of buyback, and buyers must provide identity documents as required by the 2022 tax regulation.

title: Antam gold prices slip 13,000 rupiah per gram, buyback rate drops to 2.901 million rupiah
body: On March 3, 2026, Antam’s spot gold price fell to 3,122 million rupiah per gram, with the cheapest 0.5‑gram bar priced at 1,611 million rupiah, while the buyback price declined to 2,901 million rupiah per gram. The transaction is subject to PPh 22 tax of 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) on sales above 10 million rupiah and 0.45%/0.9% on purchases, deducted at source.

title: Danantara Indonesia and Indonesia Investment Authority commit $200 million to PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk’s CA‑EDC plant project
body: Danantara Indonesia and Indonesia Investment Authority will jointly invest US$200 million (≈Rp3.37 trillion) in PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk’s US$800 million Chlor‑Alkali–Ethylene Dichloride (CA‑EDC) plant in Cilegon, slated to start operating in 2027 with annual capacities of 400,000 t caustic soda and 500,000 t ethylene dichloride. The project, part of the National Strategic Projects, is expected to create about 3,000 construction jobs and 250 permanent positions, reducing import dependence and boosting domestic chemical value‑add.

title: PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk reports strong 2025 pre‑sale revenue and earnings while exiting control of PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk
body: PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk recorded 2025 marketing sales of Rp5.32 trillion, representing 85% of its annual target and 72% from the house‑type segment, and posted total revenue of Rp9.03 trillion, EBITDA of Rp1.37 trillion and net profit of Rp469.53 billion. The company also sold 10.4% of PT Siloam International Hospitals Tbk (through PT Megapratama Karya Persada) to Sight Investment Company PTE LTD for Rp3.85 trillion, reducing its stake to 47.67% and removing consolidation, which lowered net profit by Rp21.12 trillion.

title: IHSG expected to stay weak amid geopolitical tension, with buy recommendations for PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, PT Apexindo Pratama Duta Tbk and PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is projected to remain under pressure on March 3, 2026, after slipping 2.66% to 8,106.8 amid heightened US‑Israel‑Iran tensions, with support around 7,940‑7,820 and resistance near 8,200‑8,350. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Reza Diofanda recommends buying PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, PT Apexindo Pratama Duta Tbk and PT BUMA Internasional Grup Tbk on bullish technical patterns with targets up to Rp2,130, Rp306 and Rp348 respectively, while advising a sell on PT Wir Asia Tbk.

title: US‑Iran tensions lift global oil prices and boost Indonesian energy stocks
body: Escalating US‑Iran tensions and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz pushed WTI crude up 5.39% to $70.63 per barrel and Brent to $77.32, lifting Indonesia’s IDX Energy index 1.54% as PT AKR Corporindo Tbk rose 5.79% to Rp1,370, PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk jumped 25% to Rp2,200 and PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk gained 15.65% to Rp1,995. Analysts at Kiwoom, Mirae Asset and BRI Danareksa advised momentum‑based buying with price targets of Rp2,300 for ENRG, Rp2,070 for MEDC, Rp1,456 for PT AKR Corporindo Tbk and Rp9,575 for PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk, while warning of short‑term volatility and the need to monitor oil‑price sensitivity.

title: Pegadaian raises Galeri 24 and UBS gold prices on March 3, 2026
body: On March 3, 2026, Pegadaian posted higher selling prices for Galeri 24 and UBS gold across all weights, with the 1‑gram Galeri 24 price rising to Rp3,173 million and the 1‑gram UBS price to Rp3,195 million. The corresponding buy‑back rates also increased, ranging from about Rp1.48 million for 0.5 gram up to Rp2.95 million for 1 kg for Galeri 24 and similar levels for UBS.

title: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology Tbk reports 10% sales growth and 102% profit surge in 2025
body: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology Tbk posted net sales of Rp86.94 trillion in 2025, up 10.28% YoY, with domestic and export palm oil sales of Rp46.04 trillion and Rp40.9 trillion respectively, and a major 33.28% sale to Golden Agri International Pte Ltd. The company's net profit more than doubled to Rp2.58 trillion, while total assets reached Rp45.2 trillion and equity Rp22.43 trillion at year‑end.

title: Indonesia's stock exchange imposes over 3,000 sanctions in 2025, with financial reporting violations leading the increase
body: Indonesia’s Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) issued 3,040 sanctions against 453 issuers in 2025, with financial‑reporting non‑compliance accounting for 1,223 cases (up 2%) and other violations rising 33% to 189 cases, while January 2026 saw 294 sanctions on 142 companies, 57% of which related to reporting and public exposure. The Financial Services Authority (OJK) also imposed administrative fines on PT Indo Pureco Pratama Tbk and PT Tianrong Chemical Industry Tbk for capital‑market violations.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk nears completion of HPAL smelters in Pomalaa and Morowali with major investments and EV‑related partnerships
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk said its High‑Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) smelters in Pomalaa and Morowali are near completion, with the Pomalaa plant slated for the end of this year and the Morowali plant expected by 2027, part of the Indonesia Growth Project investing US$4.43 billion and US$2 billion respectively and partnered with Chinese battery maker Huayou and US automaker Ford. The Pomalaa project is 65.76% built, targets 300,000 tonnes of limonite per month (≈9,677 tonnes per day) and began ore sales in February 2026, while Morowali is 98.85% complete, has sold 2.2 million tonnes of ore in early 2026 and is undertaking reclamation activities such as hydroseeding 26 ha and establishing a 400,000‑seedling nursery.

title: Indonesian oil and gas stocks rally on higher global oil prices and geopolitical tension
body: On Monday, shares of PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk surged 25% to Rp2,200, PT Elnusa Tbk rose 17.65% to Rp1,000, PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk jumped 15.65% to Rp1,995, while PT AKR Corporindo Tbk and PT Rukun Raharja Tbk gained 5.79% and 4.44% respectively, lifting the IDXENERGY index as the broader IHSG slipped. Mirae Asset analyst M Nafan Aji Gusta said the rally is driven by higher global oil prices amid the US‑Iran conflict and a stronger US dollar, though high production costs and potential diplomatic resolution could later trigger corrections.

title: Indonesia and United States finalize trade agreement cutting U.S. tariffs to 19% and granting palm‑oil exemption
body: Indonesia and the United States signed a reciprocal trade deal that reduces U.S. tariffs on Indonesian goods to 19% (down from 32%) and exempts key exports such as palm oil, coffee, cocoa, rubber and spices, while Indonesia will remove barriers for most U.S. products and cooperate on critical mineral standards. The agreement, signed by Economic Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto and U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, also includes a 0% textile tariff under a quota mechanism and is set to take effect 90 days after legal completion, with $38.4 billion of related company deals announced.

title: PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk wins two Asian Telecom Awards for its GFRP Tower Initiative
body: PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk Mitratel secured the Infrastructure Initiative of the Year – Indonesia and Wholesale Company Initiative of the Year – Indonesia at the Asian Telecom Awards 2026, recognizing its Glass Fibre Reinforced Polymer (GFRP) tower design that is 75% lighter, 27% stronger and reduces installation time by up to four days. The initiative also cuts carbon emissions by 47% and fuel use by 60% and targets deployment at 198 sites between 2025 and 2030.

title: PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk and PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk post strong 2025 sales and profit growth amid higher CPO prices
