body: PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk reported 2025 sales of Rp5.51 trillion (+21% YoY) and net profit of Rp1.89 trillion (+28% YoY), while PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk posted sales of Rp21.06 trillion (+32% YoY) and net profit of Rp2.07 trillion (+33% YoY) despite modest declines in fresh fruit bunch output, with both firms benefiting from rising CPO prices and robust domestic demand; Mirae Asset Sekuritas maintains a buy rating on both stocks, targeting Rp1,475 per share for LSIP and Rp720 per share for SIMP.

title: PT Jasa Marga Tbk reports lower 2025 revenue and a 19% decline in net profit despite higher toll earnings
body: PT Jasa Marga Tbk posted total revenue of IDR 29.89 trillion in 2025, a 5.9% YoY drop, with toll revenue rising 5.4% but construction revenue falling 22.6%; net profit fell 19.3% to IDR 3.65 trillion, reducing earnings per share to IDR 504. The company’s assets, liabilities, equity and cash balances all increased year‑on‑year, and it plans a IDR 12 trillion capex in 2026.

title: Danantara Indonesia, Indonesia Investment Authority and Chandra Asri Group commit $200 million to a new caustic soda and EDC plant in Cilegon
body: Danantara Indonesia, Indonesia Investment Authority and Chandra Asri Group signed a Conditional Share Subscription Agreement to invest US$200 million in a CA‑EDC facility to be operated by PT Chandra Asri Alkali, with commercial start‑up expected in 2027. The US$800 million project will produce 400,000 t of caustic soda and 500,000 t of ethylene dichloride per year, aiming to reduce imports, expand exports and generate about 3,000 construction jobs and 250 permanent positions.

title: PT Provident Investasi Bersama Tbk readies funds to settle principal and interest on its 2023 Sustainable Bond Series B maturing in March 2026
body: PT Provident Investasi Bersama Tbk announced it has set aside funds to repay the principal and 8.50% annual interest on its Sustainable Bond I Provident Investasi Bersama Phase I 2023 Series B, which has a nominal value of Rp 482 billion and matures on 28 March 2026. The payment will be made to PT Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia, the bond holds an idA (single A) rating from PT Pemeringkat Efek Indonesia and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Persero Tbk acts as the trustee.

title: Middle East tensions drive >7% rise in oil prices and lift Indonesian energy stocks
body: West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude prices jumped over 7% on March 2, 2026, spurring sharp gains in Indonesia’s energy sector, with PT Medco Energi International Tbk up 15.6%, PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk up 25%, PT Bukit Asam Tbk up 5.8% and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk up 7% among others. Analysts note the rally reflects short‑term earnings upside but warn that easing geopolitical risk could trigger profit‑taking and a correction.

title: PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk and PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk post strong 2025 sales and profit growth amid higher CPO prices
body: PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk posted 2025 sales of Rp5.51 trillion (+21% YoY) and net profit of Rp1.89 trillion (+28% YoY), while PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk recorded sales of Rp21.06 trillion (+32% YoY) and net profit of Rp2.07 trillion (+33% YoY), with both firms increasing CPO output despite slight declines in fresh fruit bunch production. Analysts from MNC Sekuritas, Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia and Panin Sekuritas highlighted higher average selling prices, improved margins and strong balance sheets, issuing buy recommendations with target prices of roughly Rp1,500‑1,765 for LSIP and Rp680 for SIMP, while warning that future results depend on global CPO price movements and weather conditions.

title: PT AKR Corporindo Tbk projects 7-10% revenue growth by 2026 amid coal production cuts and mixed analyst outlooks
body: PT AKR Corporindo Tbk targets 7-10% revenue growth to 2026, with the trading and distribution segment expected to drive performance, while JP Morgan Sekuritas Indonesia forecasts a 9% increase and notes potential downside from reduced domestic coal output and slower land-sale monetization at JIIPE. Analysts at CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia and UBS Sekuritas Indonesia project 2026 revenue of about Rp 44.5 trillion and net profit of Rp 2.79 trillion, recommending buy, add, or neutral positions with target prices ranging from Rp 1,330 to Rp 1,680.

title: Surjati Tanril buy Shares of Catur Sentosa Adiprana Tbk
body: On 2 March 2026, shareholder Surjati Tanril purchased 200,000 CSAP.JK shares at IDR 286 per share, raising his holding from 271,300 to 471,300 shares (an increase of 73.7%). The transaction, classified as an investment, expands Tanril's ownership stake in Catur Sentosa Adiprana Tbk and reflects confidence in the company's prospects.

title: PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk Shareholder Suwito Mawarwati Reports New Transaction
body: On 2 March 2026, shareholder Suwito Mawarwati was granted 2,432,300 shares of PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk at IDR 1,030 per share as part of the company's Long Term Incentive Programs. The grant raised the shareholder's holding from 18,434,270 to 20,866,570 shares, a net increase of 2,432,300 shares, representing an approximate value of IDR 2,505,269,000. The transaction expands the insider's equity stake and aligns management interests with long‑term shareholder value.

title: PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk Shareholder Beatrice Kartika Reports New Transaction
body: On 2 March 2026, PT Mitra Pinasthika Mustika Tbk (MPMX.JK) granted 1,411,700 shares to shareholder Beatrice Kartika at IDR 1,030 per share as part of its Long‑Term Incentive Program. Kartika’s holding increased from 7,277,100 to 8,688,800 shares, a net rise of 1,411,700 shares, enhancing insider ownership and aligning management interests with shareholders.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com Buys Shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
body: On 2026-03-02, shareholder 1 Inti Dot Com purchased 9,100 shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk at IDR 1,850 per share for investment purposes. The holding increased from 78,978,300 to 78,987,400 shares, a net gain of 9,100 shares, reflecting a modest stake expansion.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 2 March 2026, shareholder Henry Liem sold 151,700 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk at IDR 525 per share. His holding fell from 14,833,859 to 14,682,159 shares, a decrease of 151,700 shares, reflecting a modest reduction in his stake. The transaction was executed solely to sell shares, with no disclosed strategic rationale, and represents a minor change in ownership for the listed company.

title: Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sell Shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk
body: On 3 March 2026, Dana Pensiun Bank Pembangunan Daerah Jateng sold 243,900 shares of PT Asuransi Digital Bersama Tbk (YOII.JK) at IDR 106 per share as an investment transaction. The sale reduced its holding from 241,179,600 to 240,935,700 shares, a decline of 243,900 shares. The move represents a modest adjustment to the pension fund’s exposure to the insurer without indicating a strategic shift.

title: Matra Tri Abadi buy Shares of PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk
body: Matra Tri Abadi increased its stake in PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX.JK) by buying 31,220,100 shares at IDR 540 per share on 2026-03-03. The holding rose from 3,930,307,000 to 3,961,527,100 shares, a net increase of 31,220,100 shares, reflecting the stated purpose of adding IRSX share ownership.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 24 Feb 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK) at IDR 55 per share, reducing his holding from 2,844,254,200 to 2,834,254,200 shares (a decrease of 10,000,000 shares, roughly 0.35%). The transaction valued at approximately IDR 550,000,000 reflects a modest divestment without disclosed purpose.

title: Port Fraser International Ltd sell Shares of Bakrie & Brothers Tbk
body: Port Fraser International Ltd sold 2,952,448,980 shares of Bakrie & Brothers Tbk at IDR 147 per share on 26 Feb 2026 as a divestment. Its holding fell from 45,102,744,597 to 42,150,295,617 shares, a reduction of 2,952,448,980 shares, lowering its ownership percentage in the listed company. The transaction reflects a strategic exit by the foreign investor and may affect the stock's supply dynamics.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 24 Feb 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk (ATLA.JK) at IDR 55 per share. His holding fell from 2,844,254,200 to 2,834,254,200 shares, a reduction of 10,000,000 shares. No stated purpose was disclosed. The transaction represents a modest change in ownership given the company’s large free‑float and is unlikely to materially affect control.

title: Indonesia's stock market braces for short‑term volatility as BEI expands shareholder disclosure and raises free‑float threshold
body: The Jakarta Stock Exchange (Bursa Efek Indonesia) will now disclose shareholders holding more than 1% and increase the minimum public float requirement from 7.5% to 15%, measures aimed at improving transparency for global index providers such as MSCI and FTSE. Maybank Sekuritas warns that these changes could trigger heightened short‑term volatility, especially for stocks in the MSCI and LQ45 indices whose free‑float ratios may fall sharply.

title: Indonesia to cut 2026 coal output to about 600 Mt and raise domestic allocation to 30% amid power‑plant stock shortages
body: Indonesia will lower its 2026 coal production target to roughly 600 million tonnes and increase the Domestic Market Obligation to about 30% of output, as outlined in a draft decree from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources. Despite the higher DMO share, power‑plant operators such as PLN Nusantara Power Services, PLN Indonesia Power and PT Cirebon Electric Power report coal inventories of only 10‑15 days and say the low $70‑per‑ton DMO price for plants leads producers to favor cement and smelter sales, prompting APLSI to request policies that give power plants priority allocation.

title: Indonesia sets copper concentrate export benchmark at $6,684.18 per wet metric ton for early March, a slight decline from February
body: The Trade Ministry, via Decree No. 375/2026, set the export benchmark price for copper concentrate (≥15% Cu) at USD 6,684.18 per wet metric ton for March 1‑14, 2026, a 0.12% drop from the previous period. The decline was attributed to profit‑taking and a stronger US dollar, while LME copper prices fluctuated between $12,500 and $13,300 per ton during February.

title: Bayan Resources BYAN posts 16.9% profit decline in 2025 amid modest revenue drop and balance‑sheet changes
body: Bayan Resources BYAN reported 2025 net profit of USD784.05 million, a 16.88 % decline from the prior year, with earnings per share falling to USD0,023 and revenue slipping 0.58 % to USD3.2 billion. The company’s cost of revenue rose to USD2.32 billion, gross profit fell to USD1.1 billion, while equity increased to USD2.69 billion, liabilities dropped sharply to USD680.46 million and total assets decreased to USD3.37 billion.

title: Port Fraser International Ltd sell Shares of Bakrie & Brothers Tbk
body: Port Fraser International Ltd sold 2,486,063,700 Bakrie & Brothers Tbk shares on 2026-03-03 at IDR 184 per share, generating approximately IDR 457,435,720,800. The holding decreased from 42,150,295,617 to 39,664,231,917 shares, a reduction of about 5.9% of its stake. The transaction is classified as a divestment, indicating the shareholder is reducing its exposure to the company.

title: Mnc Asia Holding Tbk sell Shares of PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk
body: Mnc Asia Holding Tbk sold 200,000,000 shares of PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk at IDR 80 per share on 3 March 2026. The sale reduced its stake from 3,632,110,566 shares to 3,432,110,566 shares, a decrease of 200,000,000 shares. The transaction is part of the company's strategic plan and may impact the shareholder's voting power.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 3 March 2026, shareholder Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased a total of 387,200 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares for investment purposes, with a representative price of IDR 1,450 per share. The transaction raised his holding from 214,381,522 to 214,768,722 shares, an increase of 0.18%. The sizable buy signals confidence in the cybersecurity firm’s growth prospects.

title: Rd Adi Wardhana Sariaatmadja Buy Shares of Surya Citra Media Tbk
body: Rd Adi Wardhana Sariaatmadja purchased 241,812,100 shares of Surya Citra Media Tbk (SCMA.JK) for an investment purpose at IDR 276.0 per share. This transaction increased his holding from 100 shares to 241,812,200 shares, a net addition of 241,812,100 shares. The move signals a substantial commitment to the company and may influence shareholder dynamics and market perception.

title: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk reports 2025 revenue decline and 43% drop in net profit
body: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk recorded a 10.77% year‑on‑year revenue decline to US$2.41 billion in 2025, with net profit falling 43.39% to US$268.23 million. The company's gross profit fell 30.18% to US$771.24 million and assets decreased to US$1.19 billion.

title: Indonesia's Composite Index Slides Below MA200 as Geopolitical Tensions Spur Further Weakness and Trading Suspensions
body: The IHSG fell 0.96% to 7,939, breaking below its 200‑day moving average, with MNC Sekuritas expecting a continued downtrend, targeting support at 7,861 and 7,712 and resistance at 8,154 and 8,306, while recommending stocks such as BRPT, DSNG, MDKA and UNTR. BEI linked the decline to global geopolitical tension, noted trading halts in Korea and Iran’s Hormuz closure, and announced ongoing suspensions of PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk and PT Wijaya Karya Persero Tbk, as other heavily traded names including PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Persero Tbk, PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, PT Harum Energy Tbk, PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk and PT Indika Energy Tbk moved lower.

title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk sets 2026 capex range of $200‑300 million and revenue target up to $3.8 billion
body: PT Bayan Resources Tbk plans 2026 capital expenditures of US$200‑300 million (Rp3.38‑5.07 trillion) and targets revenue of US$1.8‑3.8 billion with coal production of 39‑76 million tons and an average selling price of US$46‑48 per ton. In 2025 the company spent US$181.7 million on capex, recorded revenue of US$3.42 billion, sold 70.8 million tons of coal at an ASP of US$48.4 per ton, and its main markets were China (32%) and Indonesia (26%).

title: PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk files objection to Rp2.33 trillion forestry fine after full payment
body: PT Salim Ivomas Pratama Tbk paid the Rp2.33 trillion administrative forestry fine to the Satgas PKH escrow account by 30 December 2025 and recorded it as a non‑current asset. The company has submitted a formal objection but, as of 26 February 2026, has not received a decision from the Satgas PKH.

title: Indonesia's IHSG projected to test 7,863 support as global energy tensions and domestic inflation pressures persist
body: Sinarmas Sekuritas expects the Jakarta Composite Index to dip to the 7,863 support level, with a neutral market rating and a potential technical rebound if the level holds; meanwhile, OJK aims for 75% of BEI issuers to meet a 15% free‑float minimum, Eurozone inflation rose to 1.9% in February and coal prices jumped to US$128 per ton, supporting mining stocks. Domestic inflation is expected to stay high in March due to Ramadan and Lebaran before easing in April, possibly turning deflationary.

title: IHSG expected to stay pressured by Middle East tensions as analysts issue mixed stock recommendations
body: BRI Danareksa analyst Reza Diofanda projects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to remain under pressure around the 7,885‑7,715 support zone amid escalating Iran‑US‑Israel tensions, with resistance near 8,000‑8,060. He recommends buying PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk at Rp1,600‑1,650 (target Rp1,685‑1,740), PT Indosat Tbk at Rp2,200‑2,290 (target Rp2,340‑2,430), PT Newport Marine Services Tbk above Rp192 (target Rp210‑226), and selling PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk as it tests the Rp4,700‑4,470 support.

title: Surge partners with Baicells to expand 5G FWA 1.4 GHz services in Indonesia
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (Surge) has entered a strategic partnership with global telecom equipment maker Baicells to accelerate the rollout of 5G Fixed Wireless Access on the 1.4 GHz band in Indonesia’s Region‑1 (Java, Maluku and Papua). The company previously launched the world’s first commercial 5G FWA 1.4 GHz service through its subsidiary PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama under the IRA brand, offering up to 100 Mbps at Rp100,000 per month with unlimited data and a free modem.

title: PT Matahari Department Store Tbk proposes Rp250 per share dividend for 2026 despite 2025 profit decline
body: PT Matahari Department Store Tbk reported a 9.6% drop in net revenue to Rp5.78 trillion and a 12.4% decline in net profit to Rp725.4 billion for FY 2025, and proposed a dividend of Rp250 per share (about Rp564.6 billion, 77.8% of profit) to be paid in 2026. The company outlined four 2026 strategies: accelerating exclusive brand penetration, expanding SUKO, ZES and MU+KU stores, improving space productivity and GMROS, and strengthening omnichannel integration.

title: Danantara Indonesia and Indonesia Investment Authority commit US$200 million to Chandra Asri Group’s CA‑EDC plant in Cilegon
body: Danantara Indonesia and Indonesia Investment Authority have signed a Conditional Share Subscription Agreement to invest US$200 million (about Rp3.37 trillion) in PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk’s CA‑EDC petrochemical project in Cilegon, Banten. The US$800 million plant, to be built by PT Chandra Asri Alkali, will produce 400,000 tonnes of caustic soda and 500,000 tonnes of ethylene dichloride annually, creating roughly 3,000 construction jobs and 250 permanent jobs.

title: PT Bayan Resources Tbk reports 16.8% drop in net profit for 2025 despite higher coal volumes
body: PT Bayan Resources Tbk reported net profit of US$767.9 million for 2025, a 16.8% YoY decline, while revenue fell 0.55% to US$3.42 billion as average coal selling price dropped to $48.4 per ton. Despite the price pressure, coal sales volume rose 26% to 70.8 million tons, and total assets stood at US$3.37 billion at year‑end.

title: OJK grants licenses to 29 crypto‑related entities and approves four sandbox projects, reporting extensive ITSK activity by early 2026
body: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (OJK) approved licensing for 29 entities in the crypto asset ecosystem through early 2026, including one crypto exchange, one clearing and settlement institution, two custodians and 25 digital asset traders, as well as eight supporting institutions such as six payment service providers and two consumer fund banks. Four regulatory‑sandbox participants—PT Indonesia Blockchain Persada, PT Sejahtera Bersama Nano, PT Teknologi Gotong Royong and PT Properti Gotong Royong—completed trials and were declared “passed,” while 25 official ITSK providers reported over 1.33 billion collaborations and Rp2.01 trillion of approved transactions involving 16.95 million users as of January 2026.

title: Indonesia’s KSEI begins publishing shareholder data for holdings above 1% as part of market‑transparency reforms
body: KSEI, acting on an OJK decision and proposals to MSCI and FTSE, started publishing on the IDX website the list of shareholders holding more than 1% of a listed company, expanding the previous 5% threshold and targeting full data granularity by March 2026. The first release shows veteran investor Lo Kheng Hong holding over 1% in 13 issuers—including PT Intiland Development Tbk (6.71%), PT Global Mediacom Tbk (6.44%), PT Gajah Tunggal Tbk (6.02%), PT ABM Investama Tbk (5.62%), PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk (2.16%) and PT Sri Rejeki Isman Tbk (1.02%)—and highlights sizable stakes by conglomerates such as Anthoni Salim and Prajogo Pangestu.

title: PT Pyridam Farma expands sterile injectable production with new Line 3 and plans for Lines 4‑6
body: PT Pyridam Farma Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Ethica Industri Farmasi, completed construction of a new Line 3 for sterile injectable production, slated for inauguration in April 2026 and expected to triple output. The firm is accelerating development of Lines 4‑6 with advanced cGMP, EU GMP and TGA‑compliant technology to meet rising global demand, as the sterile injectable market is projected to grow from $4.9 billion in 2026 to $9.9 billion by 2035 at an 8% CAGR.

title: OJK evaluates crypto‑asset fund product in regulatory sandbox while exploring custodians, stablecoins and future ETF innovations
body: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (OJK) said it is assessing a new crypto‑asset fund product—similar to a mutual fund but distinct from a crypto ETF—within its regulatory sandbox, testing investor protection, governance, risk management, valuation transparency and supporting infrastructure. The regulator is also piloting digital‑asset custodians, stablecoin use cases and encourages tokenized assets, citing BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF as a benchmark for potential crypto ETFs.

title: Surge and Wuhan FiberHome partner to launch world’s first 5G 1.4 GHz Fixed Wireless Access service in Indonesia
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (Surge) and Wuhan FiberHome International Technologies Co Ltd signed a partnership at Mobile World Congress 2026 in Barcelona to roll out the first global 5G FWA 1.4 GHz service, operated by PT Telemedia Komunikasi Pratama. The IRA – Internet Rakyat service offers up to 100 Mbps broadband at Rp100,000 (about US$6) per month with unlimited data and a free modem, supported by PT FiberHome Technologies Indonesia’s technology.

title: OJK says demutualisation of the Indonesia Stock Exchange will boost transparency, funding and IPO quality
body: OJK Commissioner Hasan Fawzi explained that demutualising the Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) will bring external ownership, reduce conflicts of interest, and expand funding for infrastructure, product development and investor education. He added that the reform is expected to attract higher‑quality IPOs and help meet the target of 50 new listings in 2026.

title: Indonesia's Stock Exchange Plans Demutualisation to Strengthen Regional Competitiveness
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia is drafting a government regulation to demutualise, a change that KISI Sekuritas head Muhammad Wafi says will allow profit‑oriented operations, external funding, low‑latency trading infrastructure and new instruments such as derivatives and structured warrants. The exchange targets a top‑10 global ranking within 4‑5 years, with parliamentary support and an expected rollout in Q2 2026.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk expands community resilience program in Gunung Arjuno area with waste, health, and economic initiatives
body: PT United Tractors Tbk is implementing its Desa UniTy program in the Gunung Arjuno foothills of Batu, East Java, reaching 819 residents across four villages with integrated waste‑to‑compost facilities, health Posyandu services, parental and senior education, and support for local UMKM such as coffee growers who saw a 50% income increase. The initiative also includes 567 ha of forest revegetation, livestock and avocado farming development, greenhouse construction, and aims to strengthen environmental, economic and disaster‑resilience capacity while generating new village revenue.

title: Indonesia urges EU to comply with WTO ruling to restore palm oil market access
body: Indonesia’s trade minister Budi Santoso said the EU’s 12‑month adjustment period after the WTO panel ruling on Jan. 10, 2025 has ended and urged immediate compliance to restore market access for Indonesian palm oil. He added that Indonesia is prepared to dialogue with the EU and will monitor the EU’s ILUC measures under the Renewable Energy Directive II.

title: Uni-Charm UCID reports 2025 net loss of Rp1.19 trillion after prior year profit
body: Uni-Charm UCID posted a net loss of Rp1.19 trillion for 2025, a sharp reversal from a Rp350.44 billion profit in 2024, with earnings per share turning negative to Rp288. Revenue fell 17.5% to Rp7.98 trillion, while equity and total assets also contracted.

title: Baru Gold Corp advances fabrication of modular gold processing plant as it nears production approval in Indonesia
body: Baru Gold Corp and its 70%-owned subsidiary PT Tambang Mas Sangihe said they expect approval for production operations from Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources and have begun fabricating a three‑month modular electrowinning elution column plant in Surabaya. Parallel site‑preparation work on Sangihe Island is underway to minimise idle time and accelerate the first gold pour after approval.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk posts 24% profit decline in 2025 amid weaker mining contracting and coal prices
body: PT United Tractors Tbk reported 2025 net profit of IDR 14.8 trillion, a 24 % drop from 2024, with net revenue falling 2 % to IDR 131.3 trillion as mining contracting and coal sales weakened. Revenue fell in mining contracting (IDR 54.1 trillion, –7 %) and coal mining (IDR 24.2 trillion, –7 %) while construction machinery remained stable and gold/mineral mining rose 41 % to IDR 14.0 trillion, supported by a 2 % increase in Komatsu unit sales.

title: Golden Energy reports 45% decline in net profit for the year ended 31 December 2025
body: Golden Energy posted a net profit of USD 258.23 million for 2025, a 45.49% drop from the prior year and reducing earnings per share to USD 0,044. Revenue fell 10.74% to USD 2.41 billion while total assets decreased to USD 1.19 billion and equity rose to USD 708.58 million.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk ships first dore batch to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk for refining, targeting 110‑115k ounces in 2026
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk shipped 44.04 kg of dore to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk’s refinery, marking the first refining step after the February 14 gold pour and signalling progress toward commercial production at the Pani Gold Mine. The company, a subsidiary of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk, aims to produce 110,000‑115,000 ounces of gold in 2026 and is accelerating construction of Carbon-in-Leach facilities to eventually reach about 500,000 ounces annually.

title: PT Timah Tbk reports over 100% profit growth in January 2026 as tin prices surge
body: PT Timah Tbk said its January 2026 net profit more than doubled, driven by a 6.75% daily (15.33% weekly) rise in tin prices to $53,698 per ton. The company expects tin to trade between $45,000‑$48,000 per ton through Q1 2026, targets 30,000 metric tons production, and cites strong demand from AI, semiconductor and data‑center sectors as a key performance catalyst.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange lifts one‑day suspension on PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk after rapid price surge
body: The IDX removed the temporary trading halt on PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk on March 4, 2026, after the stock had jumped 9.57% to Rp103 on March 2, triggering six consecutive auto‑rejects and a one‑day suspension. Upon reopening, the shares surged another 9.71% to Rp113, reaching the upper auto‑reject limit for the seventh consecutive session.

title: Indonesia Stock Exchange lifts FCA on PT Estee Gold Feet Tbk, shares surge 461% in the last quarter
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange ended the Full Call Auction (FCA) monitoring of PT Estee Gold Feet Tbk on 4 March 2026 after the seven‑day period elapsed. After the FCA removal, the stock rose to Rp1,560, representing a 59.18% gain in the past week, 136.36% in the past month and a 461.15% increase over the last quarter from Rp278.

title: Two Astra International executives increase their shareholdings through purchases totaling about Rp15.14 billion
body: Frans Kesuma bought 1.6 million shares at Rp6,600‑6,550 per share, raising his stake to 0,0094 % (3.8 million shares), while Gidion Hasan acquired 700,000 shares at Rp6,631, bringing his holding to 0,0167 % (6.76 million shares), for a combined outlay of roughly Rp15.14 billion. Over the same period Astra International’s stock fell 0.40 % to Rp6,275, down 7.72 % year‑to‑date from the start of 2026.

title: Bank BNI plans a Rp905.48 billion share buyback after its 2026 AGM
body: Bank BNI announced a share repurchase program of up to Rp905.48 billion, representing no more than 10 % of its paid‑up capital, to be executed over 12 months from 9 March 2026 to 8 March 2027 pending shareholder approval. The buyback aims to support the stock, which had risen only 0.5 % year‑on‑year in 2025 amid broader pressure on Indonesian banking shares from global geopolitical and tariff uncertainties.

title: PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk and AALTO HAPS Limited Extend MoU to Develop Stratospace HAPS Infrastructure in Indonesia through 2027
body: PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk and AALTO HAPS Limited signed a memorandum of understanding at Mobile World Congress to continue developing the Stratospace high‑altitude platform system and related telecom tower infrastructure in Indonesia, with the agreement extended through October 2027. The partnership aims to improve connectivity in underserved 3T regions and provide rapid service restoration after disasters, leveraging Mitratel’s tower assets and AALTO’s HAPS connectivity services.

title: Indonesia’s Economy Minister Reaffirms Halal Product Guarantees in US Trade Agreement
body: Minister Airlangga Hartarto confirmed that Indonesia will uphold halal safeguards in the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade with the United States, relying on existing Mutual Recognition Agreements that recognize halal certificates from five US bodies and 38 partner countries, allowing certified products to enter without duplicate certification. He emphasized continued coordination with the Majelis Ulama Indonesia to protect national and consumer interests.

title: PT PLN Nusantara Power and PT Geo Dipa Energi sign joint development study agreement for retrofit of PLTP Dieng 1
body: PT PLN Nusantara Power has signed a Joint Development Study Agreement with PT Geo Dipa Energi to conduct a comprehensive retrofit study of the PLTP Dieng 1 geothermal plant, aiming to improve reliability and efficiency. The agreement also covers exploration of additional geothermal sites, green hydrogen initiatives and other electricity‑related business collaborations.

title: Sanjay Kumar Gordhan A Vaghasia buy Shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: On 2026-03-04, shareholder Sanjay Kumar Gordhan A Vaghasia purchased 3,000 shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk at IDR 2,790 per share, increasing his stake from 300,000 to 303,000 shares (+3,000). The transaction, recorded as a purchase, reflects a direct investment purpose and marginally raises the insider's ownership, signaling continued confidence in the telecom firm.

title: Idea Asia Investama sell Shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk
body: Idea Asia Investama sold 50,000,000 shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk (IDEA.JK) at IDR 51 per share on 3 March 2026 as a divestment. The shareholder's holding decreased from 378,873,700 to 328,873,700 shares, a reduction of 50,000,000 shares. The transaction reduces the investor's stake in the listed education services firm, potentially affecting voting power and signaling a strategic reallocation of capital.

title: Mnc Asia Holding Tbk sell Shares of PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk
body: Mnc Asia Holding Tbk sold a total of 459,250,000 shares of PT MNC Energy Investments Tbk (IATA.JK) at a representative price of IDR 109 per share. The holding fell from 5,207,170,566 to 4,747,920,566 shares, a reduction of about 8.8% of its stake, aligned with the company’s strategic plan.

title: Thomas Junaidi Alim W buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Individual shareholder Thomas Junaidi Alim W purchased 462,400 Astra International Tbk (ASII.JK) shares at IDR 6,475 per share on 2 March 2026, raising his holding from 745,400 to 1,207,800 shares, a net increase of 462,400. The buy‑in, recorded as an investment, expands his equity position and may reflect confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Gita Tiffani buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Shareholder Gita Tiffani purchased 500,000 Astra International Tbk (ASII.JK) shares on 27 Feb 2026 at IDR 6,613 per share, raising her holding from 2,319,100 to 2,819,100 shares (an increase of 500,000). The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding her stake in the diversified conglomerate and signaling continued confidence in its market outlook.

title: Hady Kuswanto S Kom buy Shares of PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk
body: On 27 February 2026, shareholder Hady Kuswanto S Kom purchased 4,700 shares of PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk (UVCR.JK) at IDR 158 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 46,321,400 to 46,326,100 shares, a net increase of 4,700 shares, indicating a modest reinforcement of his position in the company.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 2026-03-04, shareholder Henry Liem sold 4,000 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk at IDR 530 per share. His holding decreased from 14,682,159 to 14,678,159 shares, a reduction of 4,000 shares. The transaction, recorded on 2026-03-05, is a straightforward share disposal with no disclosed strategic rationale beyond the stated purpose of selling shares, and it marginally adjusts his ownership stake in the company.

title: Uob Kay Hian Private Limited Buy Shares of PT Jasnita Telekomindo Tbk
body: Uob Kay Hian Private Limited purchased a total of 36,254,700 shares of PT Jasnita Telekomindo Tbk (JAST.JK) between 2 Feb and 3 Mar 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 98 to IDR 107 per share, with a representative price of about IDR 105. The acquisition raises its stake from 241,216,920 to 277,471,620 shares, an increase of 36,254,700 shares (≈15 %). The transaction is classified as an investment, indicating confidence in the telecom operator’s growth prospects and potentially enhancing liquidity in the market.

title: Uob Kay Hian Private Limited sell Shares of PT Jasnita Telekomindo Tbk
body: Uob Kay Hian Private Limited sold a total of 28,000,000 shares of PT Jasnita Telekomindo Tbk for portfolio rebalancing. The transactions occurred on 5 Feb 2026 at IDR 113 per share (8,000,000 shares) and on 20 Feb 2026 at IDR 122 per share (20,000,000 shares). The shareholder's holding decreased from 97,036,466 shares to 69,036,466 shares, a reduction of 28,000,000 shares (approximately 28.9% of its stake). The sale adds significant supply to the market and reflects a strategic shift in the investor's allocation.

title: Sentosa Bersama Mitra sell Shares of Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk
body: On 2 March 2026, Sentosa Bersama Mitra sold 121,501,800 shares of Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk at IDR 132 per share, representing a share divestment. The holder's stake fell from 650,000,000 shares to 528,498,200 shares, a reduction of 121,501,800 shares. The transaction decreases Sentosa Bersama Mitra's ownership proportion and signals a strategic reallocation of capital by the shareholder.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 2026-03-04, shareholder Henry Liem sold 4,000 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk at IDR 530 per share. His holding decreased from 14,682,159 to 14,678,159 shares, a reduction of 4,000 shares. The transaction was executed for the purpose of selling shares and reflects a marginal change in his ownership stake, with limited impact on the company’s overall share distribution.

title: Sentosa Bersama Mitra sell Shares of Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk
body: Sentosa Bersama Mitra sold 121,501,800 shares of Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk on 2026‑03‑02 for IDR 132.0 per share, totaling IDR 121,501,800. The sale reduced its holding from 650,000,000 to 528,498,200 shares, a decrease of 121,501,800 shares. The transaction was reported as a Share Divestment, likely to adjust portfolio exposure or raise liquidity. The reduction in stake may influence shareholder influence and could affect market perception of the company.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk reports 8.29% revenue growth and modest net profit increase in 2025
body: In 2025 PT Elnusa Tbk's revenue rose 8.29% year‑on‑year to Rp 14.50 trillion, driven mainly by its energy distribution and logistics segment, while gross profit grew 9.85% to Rp 1.45 trillion. Net profit attributable to the parent increased marginally 0.66% to Rp 718.41 billion, and total assets reached Rp 10.96 trillion.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia, Tbk sold 39,187,100 shares of PT Hillcon Tbk (HILL.JK) for a total of IDR 39,187,100, at a representative price of IDR 26.0 per share. The sale reduced the shareholder’s holding from 759,559,900 to 720,372,800 shares, a net decrease of 39,187,100 shares. The transaction was executed as a reverse REPO, providing liquidity for the issuer while maintaining market stability. This move is significant for investors as it reflects a strategic short‑term financing decision without altering long‑term ownership structure.

title: Rudi R Sutantra Sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk at IDR 55.0 per share, reducing his stake from 2,834,254,200 to 2,824,254,200 shares. The transaction, filed on 2026‑03‑05, reflects a 0.353% drop in ownership and may impact the company’s shareholder structure but has no disclosed strategic intent.

title: Kalon Holdings completes takeover of 71.69% of Mandom Corporation, shifting indirect control of PT Mandom Indonesia Tbk
body: Kalon Holdings Co, Ltd completed a tender offer on 4 March 2026, acquiring 32.35 million shares (71.69%) of Mandom Corporation and becoming the indirect controlling shareholder of PT Mandom Indonesia Tbk, which was previously controlled by Mandom Corporation (65.23%). The company said the ownership change will not have a material impact on its operations, legal status, financial condition or business continuity.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk reports 8.25% revenue growth in 2025 with modest net profit rise and stronger balance sheet
body: PT Elnusa Tbk posted 2025 revenue of Rp14.5 trillion, up 8.25% year‑on‑year, while net profit edged 0.7% to Rp718.4 billion. The company’s total assets grew 3.1% to Rp10.96 trillion, liabilities fell 1.36% to Rp5.65 trillion, and equity rose 8.38% to Rp5.31 trillion.

title: OJK freezes PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk shares and imposes fines on several firms over alleged stock‑price manipulation linked to Asep Sulaeman Sabanda
body: OJK froze trading of PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk shares, estimating illegal gains of about Rp14.5 trillion from insider trading and sham transactions involving dozens of nominee accounts between 2021‑2023. The regulator also fined PT Indo Pureco Pratama Tbk (Rp4.62 billion), its directors, the audit firm KAP Jamaludin, Ardi, Sukimto dan Rekan, PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia (which cooperated with investigators) and PT KGI Sekuritas Indonesia (Rp3.4 billion fine and one‑year suspension) for reporting and IPO‑related violations.

title: Indonesia's Composite Index Faces Further Correction Amid Regional Sell‑off, Analysts Highlight Key Stock Recommendations
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 4.57% to 7,577.06 on March 4, 2026, extending a regional sell‑off, but recovered in early trade on March 5 to around 7,704, with support near 7,311‑7,391 and resistance around 7,934‑8,154. MNC Sekuritas suggested speculative buys on ASII and BRIS and buy‑on‑weakness on EMAS and TINS, while BNI Sekuritas and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas added picks such as ARCI, PTBA, NCKL, INET, TPIA, HRTA, AADI, ESSA and a sell on SSIA, noting strong gains in BBCA, BUMI, BMRI, BUVA, BIPI and ANTM.

title: Antam gold prices rise across all sizes on March 5, 2026, with higher buyback rates and updated tax details
body: On March 5, 2026, Antam’s gold prices increased, with the 1‑kg bar reaching Rp2.98 billion and smaller sizes such as 0.5 g, 1 g, 5 g, 10 g, 25 g, 100 g, 500 g and 1 000 g all posting higher rates. The buyback price rose to Rp2,819 million per gram, and tax rates under PMK No 34/PMK.10/2017 were outlined: 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) on resale above Rp10 million, and 0.45% (NPWP) or 0.9% (non‑NPWP) on purchases, with PPh 22 deducted at source.

title: Two Indonesian ministers hold over 1% stakes in listed companies, with overlapping holdings alongside businessman Garibaldi Thohir
body: Data from KSEI as of 27 February 2026 shows that Ministers Maruarar Sirait and Sakti Wahyu Trenggono each own more than 1% of listed firms, with Sirait holding stakes in PT Bali Bintang Sejahtera Tbk (1.91%), PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk (3.31%) and PT Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (1.1%), and Trenggono holding 1.03% of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk. Both ministers share co‑ownership of these companies with conglomerate Garibaldi Thohir, whose direct holdings include AADI, ESSA, MBMA, MDKA, PALM and TRIM, and President Prabowo highlighted the ministers’ stock investments in a cabinet meeting on 21 March 2025.

title: PT Ifishdeco Tbk reports 2025 sales of Rp1 trillion and a stronger balance sheet
body: PT Ifishdeco Tbk recorded consolidated net sales of Rp1.00 trillion in 2025, up 2.9% from the prior year, driven by higher nickel and silica sales from its subsidiary PT Hangtian Nur Cahaya, while gross profit fell 3.46% to Rp291.25 billion but net profit rose 6.4% to Rp106.52 billion. The firm also cut total liabilities by 13.1% to Rp147.62 billion, lifted equity to Rp913.16 billion and reaffirmed optimism for robust global nickel demand in 2026.

title: Indonesian Stock Index May Rebound Amid Geopolitical Tensions as Analysts Recommend Select Stocks
body: Analysts forecast that the Jakarta Composite Index could rebound from its recent 4.57% drop to around 7,693, supported by global market recovery despite ongoing Iran‑related tensions and a Fitch downgrade, while recommending buy positions in PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk and PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk and a sell on PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk.

title: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk reports 40% revenue growth and 25% net profit increase in 2025
body: For the year ended 31 December 2025, PT DCI Indonesia Tbk posted revenue of Rp2.54 trillion, a 40.17% YoY rise, and net profit of Rp1 trillion, up 25.67% from 2024, lifting earnings per share to Rp420. The company’s total assets reached Rp6.64 trillion, with liabilities of Rp2.64 trillion and equity of Rp4 trillion.

title: OJK issues detailed rules for gold‑backed ETFs as major asset managers prepare launches in 2026
body: OJK released POJK No 2/2026 governing gold‑backed ETFs, mandating at least 95% of net asset value be invested in gold of 99.9% SNI or 99.5% LBMA purity, specifying pricing benchmarks, storage requirements and penalties for violations. In response, PT BRI Manajemen Investasi, Mandiri Manajemen Investasi and Sinarmas Asset Management are gearing up to launch gold ETFs, with BRI targeting an April 2026 debut together with PT Pegadaian, PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk and PT Mandiri Sekuritas, while Mandiri aims for Rp1 trillion AUM.

title: US and Israel strikes on Iranian oil fields boost oil and coal prices, lifting Indonesian energy stocks
body: Geopolitical tensions after US and Israel attacks on Iranian oil fields lifted global oil and coal prices, prompting energy and coal stocks to rise, with Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia targeting PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk at Rp2,300, PT Rukun Raharja Tbk at Rp7,000, PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk at Rp2,000 and PT Bukit Asam Persero Tbk at Rp2,800. At the March 4 close, ENRG edged up 0.47% to Rp2,140, while MEDC, RAJA and PTBA fell 4.21% to Rp1,820, 11.74% to Rp4,060 and 2.05% to Rp2,860 respectively.

title: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk partners with Madinah Group Indonesia to launch telecom‑device retail outlets on its property assets
body: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Madinah Group Indonesia to develop telecom‑device and service retail outlets, beginning with a Real MFlash store in Pejaten Office Park, Jakarta. The collaboration targets recurring income and Repower confirmed it has settled all administrative fines with Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, reinforcing its compliance and good corporate governance.

title: Four PT Astra International Tbk directors increase their shareholdings while the company completes a large buyback program
body: Directors FXL Kesuma, Gidion Hasan, Thomas Junaidi Alim and Gita Tiffani collectively purchased 3.26 million PT Astra International Tbk shares for about Rp21.44 billion between 27 February and 2 March 2026, raising their individual stakes. During the same period, PT Astra International Tbk bought back 104.85 million shares worth Rp684.97 billion, representing 34.24% of its Rp2 trillion buyback allocation.

title: PT Merdeka Copper Gold signs two-year gold off-take agreement with PT Aneka Tambang for up to 3 metric tons annually
body: PT Merdeka Copper Gold secured a two-year Gold Sales & Purchase Agreement with PT Aneka Tambang, under which its subsidiaries PT Bumi Suksesindo and PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera will sell up to 3 metric tons (about 100,000 ounces) of domestically refined gold to Antam each year, with an option to add another 3 metric tons annually. The supply will come from Merdeka’s Tambang Emas Tujuh Bukit and the newly commissioned Tambang Emas Pani, which completed its first gold pour in February 2026 and aims to deliver the first refined gold to Antam by the end of March 2026.

title: CIO advises investors to use the IHSG correction as a buying opportunity amid Middle East tensions and Fitch downgrade
body: Chief Investment Officer Barkah Supriadi of Korea Investment Management Indonesia recommends short‑term investors focus on defensive, dividend‑paying stocks and long‑term investors accumulate solid fundamentals, especially in commodities, consumer, health and telecom sectors, while VP Equity Retail Oktavianus Audi of Kiwoom Sekuritas highlights ongoing geopolitical risks and Fitch’s negative outlook; speculative‑buy targets include PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk with resistance at Rp2,220 and PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk with resistance at Rp3,310.

title: OJK freezes 2 billion shares of PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk amid alleged insider trading that generated Rp14.5 trillion in illegal gains
body: The Otoritas Jasa Keuangan has suspended trading of roughly 2 billion shares (about 25% of public float) of PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk after uncovering insider‑trading activity from 2021‑2023 that produced illegal profits of around Rp14.5 trillion. The regulator also found suspected fake transactions involving multiple corporate entities and individuals, including Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia, and is forwarding the case to the prosecutor’s office.

title: Indonesia’s Antam gold prices rebound amid Middle East tensions and a weaker US dollar
body: Antam gold bars rose to Rp 3,049,000 per gram on Thursday, a Rp 4,000 increase after a prior drop, while the buyback price reached Rp 2,819,000 per gram and the metal has gained about 22% since the start of the year; spot gold also rose 1.51% to $5,189.73 per ounce as geopolitical risks and a softer dollar boosted safe‑haven demand. Zaner Metals’ vice‑president Peter Grant noted the weaker dollar and ongoing Iran‑US tensions as supportive factors for further price gains.

title: Indonesia’s regulator freezes Rp 14.5 trillion in shares of Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia amid insider‑trading probe
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) and the National Police have frozen about 2 billion shares worth Rp 14.5 trillion (≈$859 million) of Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia as part of an investigation into alleged insider trading and manipulation of the IPO of Berkah Beton Sedaya, whose price allegedly jumped 7,150% from 2020 to 2022. OJK investigators have questioned 25 witnesses and continue to gather evidence, while Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia says it is cooperating and its operations remain normal.

title: Bank SMBC Indonesia posts 82% profit plunge in 2025 despite loan growth
body: Bank SMBC Indonesia reported consolidated net profit of Rp506 billion in 2025, an 82% drop from the prior year, while net interest income rose to Rp15.99 trillion. Despite a 3.3% loan increase to Rp185.4 trillion and a 16.7% rise in CASA to Rp53.2 trillion, higher operating expenses, a larger CKPN and modest profit growth at its subsidiary Bank BTPN Syariah weighed on earnings.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk posts modest profit growth and revenue increase in FY2025
body: PT Elnusa Tbk reported FY2025 net profit of Rp718.40 bn, a 0.66% year‑on‑year rise, with revenue up 8.21% to Rp14.49 tn and EBITDA reaching Rp888.37 bn. The company’s assets grew to Rp10.96 tn, equity to Rp5.31 tn, and its shares gained 0.57% to Rp880 on the day of the report.

title: Indonesia moves to demutualise the Stock Exchange, targeting private placement and eventual IPO by early 2026
body: The government and House of Representatives are accelerating the demutualisation of the Indonesia Stock Exchange, requiring a private placement before a future IPO, with implementation regulations to be completed by the end of February 2026. Lawmakers emphasise rapid progress alongside broader market reforms such as free‑float rules and UBO transparency.

title: PT Telkom Indonesia's subsidiary PT Nuon Digital Indonesia targets growth in Indonesia's digital entertainment market by 2026
body: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk has tasked its subsidiary PT Nuon Digital Indonesia with building a digital entertainment ecosystem covering games, music and video, aiming to become a primary driver of the national digital lifestyle industry by 2026. Nuon plans to boost user engagement and average revenue per user through direct carrier billing and expansion into tier‑2 and tier‑3 cities, leveraging Telkom’s 158 million mobile and 11 million broadband users as the Indonesian digital media market is projected to reach $4 billion in 2026 (with online media overall $10‑12 billion by 2026‑27).

title: Antam gold prices slide as a stronger US dollar drags global bullion
body: Indonesia's Antam gold bars fell to Rp 3,045,000 per gram, down Rp 77,000, and the buyback price slipped to Rp 2,794,000 per gram, though the metal remains up roughly 22% year‑to‑date. Global spot gold dropped 2.49% to $5,164.97 per ounce amid a stronger US dollar and higher Treasury yields, but analysts at RJO Futures say geopolitical safe‑haven flows could keep gold supported.

title: Jakarta Composite Index slides 0.5% as Middle East tensions and energy concerns weigh on markets
body: Indonesia's Jakarta Composite Index opened lower, slipping 43 points (0.54%) to 7,896 amid heightened US‑Israel‑Iran tensions, declining energy and mining stocks, and a revised 2026 nickel output target of 209.08 million tons. Phintraco Sekuritas and Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia warned that threats to close the Strait of Hormuz could push oil prices higher and drive inflation, while the Indonesia Central Securities Depository and Indonesia Stock Exchange began filing >1% shareholder reports to improve market transparency, as global indices fell and regional markets dropped sharply.

title: Indonesia turns to US crude as two Pertamina tankers remain stuck in the Persian Gulf
body: Pertamina International Shipping reported that its tankers Pertamina Pride and Gamsunoro are trapped in the Persian Gulf amid the Iran‑Israel conflict, prompting Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia to seek diplomatic release and consider alternatives. Indonesia has secured a plan B to import US crude under a newly signed $4.5 billion deal to offset the loss of Middle‑East supplies.

title: Grup Merdeka Copper Gold signs gold off‑take deal with Aneka Tambang for up to 3 metric tons per year
body: Grup Merdeka Copper Gold, through PT Bumi Suksesindo and Merdeka Gold Resources via PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera, signed a Gold Sales & Purchase Agreement with Aneka Tambang to supply up to 3 metric tons (≈100,000 oz) of refined gold annually for two years, with an optional additional 3 metric tons per year. The gold will be refined by Antam, sourced from the Tujuh Bukit and Pani mines, and the first refined delivery is targeted before the end of March 2026 after a 44.04 kg doré shipment from the Pani mine.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk’s outlook improves with HPAL projects and higher nickel quota prospects
body: Analysts see PT Vale Indonesia Tbk’s prospects as attractive as it nears completion of the Pomalaa and Morowali HPAL smelter projects and a potential 30% rise in its 2026 nickel production quota, with the stock up over 20% YTD and a target price of Rp8,000 set by both Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia (hold) and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas (buy). Valuation remains appealing with a projected FY2026 net profit of US$259 million and an estimated 2027 P/E of about 15, well below the five‑year average of 24.

title: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk sign two‑year gold off‑take agreement with PT Aneka Tambang Tbk
body: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk, through its subsidiaries PT Bumi Suksesindo and PT Puncak Emas Tani Sejahtera, and PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk signed a two‑year Gold Sales & Purchase Agreement with PT Aneka Tambang Tbk for up to 3 metric tons (about 100,000 ounces) of refined gold per year, with an option to add another 3 metric tons annually. The deal covers gold from the Tujuh Bukit and Pani mines, with the first refined gold delivery expected by the end of March 2026.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk shares dip 4% amid market slump, analysts see buying opportunity on commercial gold production start
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk shares fell 4.14% to Rp 8,100 as the IHSG slipped, but analysts consider the correction a chance to accumulate the stock given its recent commercial production at Tambang Emas Pani, the first gold pour and first shipment of 44.04 kg dore to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, and a 2026 output target of 110‑115 k ounces. Korea Investment & Sekuritas Indonesia recommends a buy with a Rp 9,200 price target, citing the upcoming Carbon‑in‑Leach facility, long‑term capacity of up to 500 k ounces, while noting risks such as gold price volatility and operational disruptions.

title: Indonesia stock market slides 4.6% as broad sector sell‑off prompts technical buying opportunities in ASII, GOTO and TINS
body: On March 4, 2026 the Jakarta Stock Exchange Composite Index fell 362.70 points (4.57%) to 7,577.06 amid sharp declines across raw materials, transportation and other sectors, with total turnover reaching 53.04 billion shares worth IDR 29.56 trillion. Analysts highlighted potential short‑term buying setups for ASII around Rp 5,900‑5,975, speculative buy for GOTO near Rp 54‑57, and a rebound outlook for TINS after its 8.47% drop to Rp 3,890.

title: Sigmantara Alfindo boosts stake in Sumber Alfaria Trijaya AMRT to over 50% through a silent purchase of 6.35 billion shares
body: On 3 March 2026, Sigmantara Alfindo quietly acquired 6.35 billion Sumber Alfaria Trijaya AMRT shares, raising its holding to 20.83 billion shares (50.19% of the company) and valuing the deal at roughly Rp10.26 trillion based on the closing price of Rp1,615. The transaction was executed through brokers such as BNC Sekuritas Indonesia, Korea Investment and Sekuritas Indonesia, Deutsche Bank AG, CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia, Bank HSBC Indonesia and Standard Chartered Bank, while the AMRT share price fell 3.13% to Rp1,550 and has dropped about 25.5% over the past six months.

title: Jecky Salindeho sell Shares of PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk
body: On 9 February 2026, shareholder Jecky Salindeho sold his entire holding of 1,499,999,500 PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk (MGLV.JK) shares at IDR 92 per share, amounting to a total proceeds of IDR 137,999,954,000. The transaction reduced his stake from 1,499,999,500 shares to zero, representing a full divestment. The purpose was a straightforward share sale, indicating an exit from the company without further implications disclosed.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 4 March 2026, investor Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased a total of 344,300 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares for investment purposes. The transactions were executed at prices ranging from IDR 1,335 to IDR 1,470 per share, with a representative price of approximately IDR 1,350 per share. His holding increased from 214,768,722 to 215,113,022 shares, a net addition of 344,300 shares. The purchase modestly raises his ownership stake and signals continued confidence in the company's outlook.

title: Munawir buy Shares of PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk
body: Munawir increased his stake in PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk (ALII.JK) by purchasing an additional 20,000 shares for investment purposes. The transaction, executed at a representative price of IDR 1,030 per share, raised his holdings from 2,500,050 to 2,520,050 shares, a net increase of 0.8%. This modest acquisition signals continued confidence in the logistics firm and marginally strengthens Munawir's ownership position.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 5 March 2026, shareholder Henry Liem sold 5,200 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk at IDR 535 per share. The transaction reduced his holding from 14,682,159 to 14,676,959 shares, a net decrease of 5,200 shares. The purpose is recorded as a simple share sale, with no disclosed strategic rationale. The change represents a marginal adjustment to Liem's stake and is unlikely to affect the company's control structure or market perception.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com buy Shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
body: Shareholder 1 Inti Dot Com purchased 1,061,000 PT NFC Indonesia Tbk shares on 3 March 2026 at IDR 1,890 per share, raising its holding from 78,987,400 to 80,048,400 shares. The transaction, valued at approximately IDR 2.01 billion, is classified as an investment and expands the shareholder’s stake in the listed company.

title: Agpa Pte. Ltd. Buy Shares of PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk
body: Agpa Pte. Ltd. purchased 599,671,657 shares of PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk (SGRO.JK) on 3 March 2026 under a share purchase mandate, paying approximately IDR 7,905 per share (total IDR 4,739,205,105,271). Its holding increased from 1,195,217,500 to 1,794,889,157 shares, a rise of 599,671,657 shares, strengthening its stake in the agribusiness firm and potentially influencing future corporate decisions.

title: Irsyad Hanif buy Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
body: Irsyad Hanif purchased an additional 18,000,000 PT Aman Agrindo Tbk (GULA.JK) shares on 4 March 2026 at a representative price of IDR 308 per share, citing investment purposes. His holding rose from 57,478,400 to 75,478,400 shares, a net increase of 18,000,000 shares, strengthening his stake in the company.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk launches world’s first 5G 1.4 GHz Fixed Wireless Access service with ZTE Corporation
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (Surge) announced the commercial launch of the world’s first 5G 1.4 GHz Fixed Wireless Access service, IRA – Internet Rakyat, in partnership with ZTE Corporation. The service provides up to 100 Mbps broadband for Rp100,000 (≈US$6) per month with unlimited data, aiming for mass‑market adoption across Indonesia.

title: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk and PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk report strong 2025 earnings growth
body: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk posted a net profit of Rp1.14 trillion for 2025, up 83.9% YoY, with revenue of Rp4.31 trillion, EPS of Rp67.69 and achieved 100% of its Rp4.3 trillion pre‑sales target. PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk recorded a net profit of Rp1.36 trillion, up 47.5% YoY, with revenue of Rp2.5 trillion and EPS of Rp241.45.

title: PT Trikomsel Oke Tbk reports ongoing debt restructuring talks for Rp1.26 trillion loan
body: PT Trikomsel Oke Tbk said it is still negotiating a restructuring of its Rp1.26 trillion jumbo loan with Bank Mandiri and BNI, with no approval yet. The firm currently owes Rp1.05 trillion to BNI and Rp210.17 billion to Bank Mandiri and is seeking additional working‑capital funding from new investors.

title: PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk projects earnings recovery in FY2026 after 2025 profit pressure
body: PT Jasa Marga (Persero) Tbk reported 2025 revenue of Rp29.89 trillion, a 5.88% YoY decline, with toll revenue rising 5.41% to Rp18.15 trillion and EBITDA of Rp13.3 trillion (67% margin); net profit fell 19.27% to Rp3.65 trillion but financing costs dropped 10.5%, improving ICR to 3.7× and DER to 1.2×. Analysts expect a 2026 recovery, forecasting revenue growth of about 8% YoY and net profit expansion of roughly 12% as new toll sections become operational and tariff adjustments lift margins.

title: Indonesia launches SR024 retail sukuk with 5.55% and 5.90% coupons
body: Indonesia's Ministry of Finance will sell the SR024 retail sukuk in two tenors—3‑year at 5.55% and 5‑year at 5.90%—with orders opening on 6 March 2026 and closing on 15 April 2026. The sukuk can be purchased online through 32 distributors, including PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and PT Bank Permata Tbk, with a minimum purchase of Rp1 million and maximum per‑investor limits of Rp5 billion (3‑year) and Rp10 billion (5‑year).

title: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk reports 84% YoY net profit surge in 2025
body: PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk posted a net profit of Rp1.14 trillion for 2025, up 83.9% YoY, on revenue of Rp4.31 trillion (52.4% growth), EPS of Rp67.69, total assets of Rp50.58 trillion (8.6% rise) and equity of Rp31.66 trillion (19.1% rise), while liabilities fell 5.3% to Rp18.92 trillion and cash decreased 10.3% to Rp3.84 trillion. The stock closed at Rp8,600, gaining 1.78% on the day but remaining 31.75% below its start‑of‑year level.

title: PT Mandiri Manajemen Investasi targets Rp1 trillion AUM for new gold ETF
body: PT Mandiri Manajemen Investasi said it aims to raise Rp1 trillion in assets under management for a domestically‑listed gold Exchange Traded Fund. The fund, custodied by Deutsche Bank, traded by Mandiri Sekuritas and backed by Pegadaian, is pending OJK registration with a 20‑day review and a 30‑day listing window after approval.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia plans demutualization to boost independence and global ranking
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (Bursa Efek Indonesia) will undergo demutualization this year, aiming to reduce conflicts of interest, strengthen governance, and attract more foreign investors. Executives target a top‑10 position among world exchanges within the next four to five years.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia plans demutualization to boost independence and global ranking
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia announced on 3 March 2026 that it will undergo demutualization under the UU P2SK mandate, aiming to reduce conflicts of interest and strengthen market governance. The exchange targets a top‑10 global ranking within the next four to five years, expecting improved liquidity and greater foreign investor participation.

title: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk reports higher 2025 coal production but lower revenue and profit
body: PT Golden Energy Mines Tbk produced 54.9 million tons of coal in 2025, an 8 % increase from 2024, and sold 54.2 million tons, up 4 % year‑on‑year, with 65 % of sales exported. Despite the volume gains, revenue fell 10.8 % to US$2.41 billion and net profit dropped 43.4 % to US$268.2 million.

title: Coal stocks PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk rise on US‑Iran conflict expectations
body: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk closed up 0.24% at Rp10,325, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk rose 1.25% to Rp2,430, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk jumped 3.90% to Rp25,975, and PT Bukit Asam Tbk surged 3.85% to Rp2,970 as analysts expect short‑term coal price gains. Kiwoom Sekuritas projects coal prices could climb to US$150 per ton if the conflict persists, creating a potential buying opportunity.

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk raises its stake in PT Culina Global Utama to 99% and reports food‑and‑beverage sales of Rp90.42 billion in the first nine months of 2025
body: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk completed a share purchase that increased its ownership of subsidiary PT Culina Global Utama from 50.24% to 99%, with the transaction valued at Rp2.25 billion for 6,839 shares. In the first nine months of 2025, BUVA’s food‑and‑beverage segment generated sales of Rp90.42 billion, accounting for 31% of total sales of Rp288.71 billion, while the hotel‑room segment contributed Rp176.93 billion (61%).

title: Bisnis-27 index jumps 2.2% as PT Bank Central Asia Tbk leads gains among constituents
body: The Bisnis-27 index closed up 2.20% at 519.39 points, driven by gains in PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk, PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk, PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk, PT Kalbe Farma Tbk, PT Mitra Keluarga Karyasehat Tbk, PT Bukit Asam Tbk, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk and PT United Tractors Tbk. Trading volume reached 4.98 billion shares worth Rp6.42 trillion, while the broader IHSG rose 1.76% to 7,710.54.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com Buy Shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
body: On March 3, 2026, shareholder 1 Inti Dot Com purchased 1,061,000 shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk at IDR 1,890 per share, raising its holding from 78,987,400 to 80,048,400 shares (an increase of 1,061,000). The transaction, classified as an investment, expands the investor’s stake in the listed company and reflects confidence in NFC’s prospects, modestly boosting the shareholder’s ownership percentage.

title: PT Ifishdeco Tbk shares suspended after 25% price jump; 2025 results show modest profit growth
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia suspended trading of PT Ifishdeco Tbk shares on 5 March 2026 after the stock rose 25% to Rp 3,250 and was up 311.39% year‑to‑date. The nickel miner reported 2025 net sales of Rp 1 trillion (up 2.9%) and a net profit of Rp 106.52 billion, a 6.4% increase from the prior year.

title: Foreign investors net bought Rp 148.2 billion of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk shares on Thursday
body: Foreign investors recorded a net purchase of Rp 148.2 billion in PT Bank Central Asia Tbk shares on Thursday, with additional buying of Rp 90.8 billion in PT Astra International Tbk, Rp 81.6 billion in PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, and Rp 42.3 billion in PT Bumi Resources Tbk. Despite the buying, foreign investors posted a net sell of Rp 210 billion across the market, and the IDX composite index closed up 133.47 points (1.76%) at 7,710.5.

title: Foreign fund managers accumulate shares of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, driving price rise
body: On 5 March 2026 PT Bank Central Asia Tbk closed up 3.27% at Rp 7,100 after a 12% correction, as foreign fund managers added sizable stakes. Vanguard now holds 2.16% (2.66 billion shares) and BlackRock 1.53% (1.88 billion shares), with other managers such as St. James's Place, Capital Group and Principal Financial Group also increasing their holdings.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk eyes upper price range after CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia sets a target of Rp 7,167‑7,233
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia identifies a technical trading area of Rp 6,883‑6,992 for PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and sets a near‑term price target of Rp 7,167‑7,233. The stock rose 3.27% to Rp 7,100 on 5 Mar 2026, after a weekly decline of 2.7%, a monthly drop of 8.9% and a YTD fall of 12.07%, with foreign investors buying Rp 148.2 billion.

title: PT Semen Indonesia Tbk shares jump 6.8% as Mandiri Sekuritas reiterates buy recommendation
body: PT Semen Indonesia Tbk (SMGR) shares rose 6.8% to Rp 2,670 on Thursday, trading 29.8 million shares with a transaction value of Rp 77.41 billion. The stock, trading at a PBV of 0.42 and valued at roughly half its book value, was recommended as a buy by Mandiri Sekuritas with a target price of Rp 2,780 and a support level of Rp 2,640, while the company reported 2025 revenue of Rp 25.3 trillion and net profit of Rp 114.83 billion.

title: PT Darma Henwa Tbk forecast solid revenue growth and a 70.9% upside target price
body: Samuel Sekuritas expects PT Darma Henwa Tbk to achieve a 20% CAGR in revenue through 2027, driven by a >50% YoY volume increase to 163 mbcm in 2026 and a new target price offering a potential 70.9% upside. The company secured a Rp 5 trillion loan at 2.68% (effective 6.75%) from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and PT Bank Mandiri Tbk to fund capital expenditures and working capital.

title: MNC Sekuritas sets price targets for PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk as company pursues up to Rp 1 trillion share buyback
body: MNC Sekuritas noted PT Chandra Daya Investasi Tbk closed at Rp 895 on 5 Mar 2026, sees potential downside to Rp 725‑865 and sets target prices of Rp 975 and Rp 1,245 with a stop‑loss below Rp 690. The firm also announced a share‑repurchase program of up to Rp 1 trillion to be executed from 6 Feb to 5 May 2026, managed by PT Henan Putihrai Sekuritas.

title: Indonesia seeks stronger palm oil trade diplomacy amid rising global barriers
body: The Indonesian Palm Oil Association urged the government to prioritize trade diplomacy to counter increasing tariff and non‑tariff barriers that threaten the country's palm oil exports. Recent agreements, such as a zero‑tariff deal with the United States covering 173 agricultural tariff lines, aim to protect market share and support the sector’s contribution to foreign‑exchange earnings.

title: Irsyad Hanif buy Shares of PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
body: Shareholder Irsyad Hanif purchased an additional 18,000,000 PT Aman Agrindo Tbk shares on 2026-03-04 at a representative price of IDR 304 per share, raising his holding from 57,478,400 to 75,478,400 shares (a +31% increase). The transaction, classified as an investment, expands his ownership stake and may signal confidence in the company's future performance.

title: Agung Sedayu sell Shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk
body: Agung Sedayu sold a total of 52,930,020 shares of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk (CBDK.JK) at an average price of approximately IDR 5,300 per share, reducing his holding from 77,519,380 to 24,589,360 shares—a decline of about 68%. The divestment, aimed at realizing investment value, represents a significant stake reduction and may impact the company's shareholder composition and market perception.

title: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sell Shares of Bayan Resources Tbk
body: Oliver Khaw Kar Heng sold 9,200 shares of Bayan Resources Tbk on 2026-03-04 at IDR 14,060 per share as a divestment. His holding fell from 506,400 to 497,200 shares, a reduction of 9,200 shares, indicating a modest decrease in his stake in the coal mining company.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sell Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia sold 48,357,400 shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk on 2 March 2026 under a Repurchase Agreement at IDR 6,300 per share. The holder's stake fell from 861,535,300 shares to 813,177,900 shares, reducing its ownership by roughly 5.6%. The transaction reflects a significant divestment by the shareholder, potentially affecting the company's free float and liquidity.

title: Gita Tiffani buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: On 2026-03-03, individual shareholder Gita Tiffani purchased 270,000 Astra International Tbk shares at IDR 6,375 per share, increasing her holding from 2,819,100 to 3,089,100 shares (a +270,000 share increase). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises her ownership stake in the listed conglomerate, potentially signaling confidence in the company's outlook and may attract attention from other investors in the Indonesian market.

title: Samuel Tumbuh Bersama sell Shares of PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk
body: On March 5, 2026, shareholder Samuel Tumbuh Bersama sold 11,045,000 shares of PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk at IDR 960 per share, reducing its stake from 9,291,412,000 to 9,280,367,000 shares (a decline of 11,045,000 shares). The transaction, recorded as a sale of shares, reflects a modest divestment and does not alter the company's control structure, but signals a minor liquidity move by the shareholder.

title: Sentul City Tbk Shareholder Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia entered a repurchase agreement with Sentul City Tbk on 23 Feb 2026, acquiring 548,582,700 shares at IDR 137 per share. Its holding rose from 8,143,375,200 to 8,691,957,900 shares, a net increase of 548,582,700 shares. The transaction expands the shareholder’s stake in the company, reflecting active participation in the market under the repurchase arrangement.

title: Sentul City Tbk Shareholder Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia entered a repurchase agreement on 24 Feb 2026, acquiring 549,293,600 Sentul City Tbk shares at IDR 137 per share. The transaction raised its stake from 8,691,957,900 to 9,241,251,500 shares, a net increase of 549,293,600 shares. The purpose is a repurchase agreement, indicating a strategic move to expand its ownership in Sentul City Tbk.

title: PT MD Entertainment Tbk Shareholder Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia executed a repo transaction for PT MD Entertainment Tbk on 6 March 2026, purchasing 43,106,900 shares at IDR 5,200 per share. The shareholder's stake rose from 838,964,800 to 882,071,700 shares, reflecting a net increase of 5.1% in holdings. The repo arrangement provides short‑term financing for the company while expanding the investor's position, a notable development for FILM.JK investors.

title: Sentul City Tbk Shareholder Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia entered a share repurchase agreement with Sentul City Tbk, acquiring 581,089,800 shares at IDR 130 per share on 19 Feb 2026. The holder's stake rose from 7,562,285,400 to 8,143,375,200 shares, an increase of 581,089,800 shares. The transaction reflects a direct purchase under a repurchase agreement, expanding the shareholder's ownership in the company.

title: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia buys Shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk
body: On 5 March 2026, Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia purchased 25,786,900 shares of PT MD Entertainment Tbk at an indicative price of IDR 4,925 per share as part of a repo transaction. The acquisition raised its holding from 813,177,900 to 838,964,800 shares, a net increase of 25,786,900 shares, strengthening its position in the company. The repo purpose suggests a short‑term financing arrangement, but the sizable stake boost may affect voting power and market perception of PT MD Entertainment Tbk.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On March 5, 2026, investor Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased a total of 1,224,500 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares for investment purposes, with transaction prices ranging from IDR 1,375 to IDR 1,430 per share (representative price IDR 1,390). His holding increased from 215,113,022 to 216,337,522 shares, a net gain of 1,224,500 shares, indicating a modest but notable increase in ownership.

title: Sentul City Tbk Shareholder Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia entered into a repurchase agreement with Sentul City Tbk, selling 498,449,200 shares at IDR 130 per share on 18 Feb 2026. The shareholder’s holding fell from 8,060,734,600 shares to 7,562,285,400 shares, a reduction of 498,449,200 shares. The transaction, executed under a repurchase agreement, reflects the shareholder’s intent to reduce its stake, potentially improving the company’s free float and liquidity. No other parties were disclosed.

title: Henry Tanoto buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Henry Tanoto purchased a total of 700,000 Astra International Tbk shares on March 2 and March 4, 2026 at prices of IDR 6,314 and IDR 6,089 per share, respectively (representative price IDR 6,314 per share). His holding rose from 3,803,000 to 4,503,000 shares, a net increase of 700,000 shares, reflecting an investment-driven stake expansion.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk reports 67.6% profit drop in 2025 as JP Morgan upgrades rating
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk posted a net profit of US$447.69 million for 2025, a 67.6% decline from the prior year, with revenue down 9.9% to US$1.87 billion, gross profit falling 27.2% to US$636.6 million, liabilities rising 36.2% and cash falling 25.7%. JP Morgan raised its recommendation to overweight and lifted the target price to Rp2,540, while the stock traded around Rp2,400, up 32.6% year‑to‑date.

title: Export levy hike prompts analysts to favor integrated CPO producers such as TAPG, DSNG, SMAR, SIMP, AALI and LSIP
body: The government raised the CPO export levy to 12.5% (up from 10%) effective 1 Mar 2026, prompting KISI Sekuritas and Phintraco Sekuritas to advise investors to avoid pure exporters and rotate into integrated upstream‑downstream players. They highlighted TAPG, DSNG, SMAR, SIMP, AALI and LSIP as stocks likely to withstand the margin squeeze.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia sees 7.9% weekly IHSG decline and records three new bond listings
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia reported that the composite index (IHSG) fell 7.89% to 7,585.68 during the week of 2‑6 March 2026, with market capitalisation down 7.85% to Rp13,627 trillion and average daily volume dropping 17% to 42.34 billion shares. The exchange also listed new bonds from PT Wahana Ottomitra Multiartha Tbk (Rp1.5 trillion), PT Provident Investasi Bersama Tbk (Rp940 billion) and PT RMK Energy Tbk (Rp560 billion).

title: PT Petrosea Tbk Reports 28% Revenue Growth and 197% Net Profit Surge in 2025
body: PT Petrosea Tbk (PTRO) posted revenue of US$886.45 million in 2025, up 28.32% year‑on‑year, while net profit jumped 197% to US$28.8 million. The company’s assets rose to US$1.58 billion, liabilities to US$1.27 billion, and equity to US$307.4 million, driven largely by contracts with BP Berau Ltd, PT Kideco Jaya Agung and PT Freeport Indonesia.

title: PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia denies Rp14.5 trillion profit claim as OJK investigation proceeds
body: PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia (MASI) refuted media reports that it earned, held, or generated assets of about Rp14.5 trillion, stating the figure is not profit, asset, or revenue, following an OJK‑led raid on its Jakarta office on 4 March 2026. The probe also uncovered alleged manipulation that drove PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk shares up roughly 7,150 % and involved multiple entities and nominee accounts.

title: PT Bundamedik Tbk plans new medical robot purchase and hospital expansion
body: PT Bundamedik Tbk said it will acquire a new medical‑robot system after completing 100 robot‑assisted procedures and 300 minimally invasive surgeries last year, with robot use representing 20‑30% of its cases. The hospital also aims to expand its Palembang facility from 30 to at least 100 beds, targeting revenue contribution from the site by April 2027 and pursuing further hospital acquisitions under its five‑year roadmap.
