title: PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk reports Skytrax rating downgrade but says no material impact on operations
body: PT Garuda Indonesia Tbk disclosed that Skytrax lowered its airline rating from five to four stars on 6 March 2026. Management said the downgrade has no material effect on its financial condition and outlined a comprehensive service transformation program to regain five‑star status.

title: PT KISI Asset Management and Panin AM Revise Fund Strategies as Indonesian Market Faces Mid‑Term Volatility
body: PT KISI Asset Management said it is rebalancing equity funds toward defensive sectors such as consumer, infrastructure, renewable energy and large‑cap banks, expecting a cyclical, not permanent, slowdown in the Indonesian market. Panin AM reported its equity fund outperformed the IHSG through early March 2026, while maintaining stable mixed‑fund allocations (20‑50% equities) and favoring short‑tenor bonds in its fixed‑income portfolio.

title: PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk experiences large share sell‑offs by Agung Sedayu and PT Tunas Mekar Jaya
body: Agung Sedayu sold 52.93 million CBDK shares in three transactions between 27 Feb and 5 Mar 2026, generating Rp281.84 billion and reducing its stake to 0.43 % of PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk. PT Tunas Mekar Jaya also divested 25 million shares on 12 Feb and 18 Feb 2026 at Rp6,300 each, raising Rp157.5 billion and cutting its holding from 1.37 % of the same company.

title: PT Jababeka Tbk reports solid 2025 property sales and sets 2026 marketing sales target of Rp3.75 trillion
body: PT Jababeka Tbk, via its Jababeka Residence unit, posted marketing sales of Rp1.3 trillion in 2025, representing 36.11% of the group’s total Rp3.6 trillion. The company now targets Rp3.75 trillion of marketing sales in 2026, with Rp1.25 trillion expected from Cikarang projects and Rp2.5 trillion from the Kendal industrial zone, while noting that Iran‑US tensions are not expected to affect its performance.

title: Danantara Indonesia selects Wangneng Environment Co., Ltd and Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection Co., Ltd as operators for waste‑to‑energy plants in Bekasi and Denpasar
body: Danantara Indonesia announced that it has appointed Wangneng Environment Co., Ltd to operate the waste‑to‑energy facility in Bekasi and Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection Co., Ltd to run the plant in Denpasar, under President Regulation No. 109/2025. The partnerships require the operators to form consortia with local BUMDs and aim to transfer technology while ensuring operational reliability and compliance with environmental regulations.

title: PT Aman Agrindo Tbk sees insider Irsyad Hanif raise stake to 7.05% after March 4 share purchases
body: Komisaris Utama PT Aman Agrindo Tbk, Irsyad Hanif, bought a total of 18 million shares on 4 March 2026, raising his ownership from 5.37% to 7.05%. The transactions increased the company's free‑float to 427.98 million shares (39.98%) and the number of shareholders to 3,693.

title: PT Jababeka Tbk declares Jababeka an industrial tourism city and launches Jababeka Harmony Festival 2026
body: PT Jababeka Tbk announced the conversion of its Cikarang estate into an industrial tourism city, integrating manufacturing, education and tourism, and unveiled the Jababeka Harmony Festival 2026 scheduled for 6–8 March 2026. The move, supported by over 2,000 resident companies and a planned Jababeka Factory Outlet, aims to strengthen competitiveness and attract investment amid early deindustrialisation concerns in Indonesia.

title: Bank Raya partners with Lala Market Vol.10 to boost digital banking for UMKM during Ramadan 2026
body: Bank Raya announced its role as Bank Partner for Lala Market Vol.10, held March 6‑8, 2026 at Pondok Indah Mall, to promote its digital banking app and QRIS payments among UMKM. The event offers cash‑back of up to Rp35,000 for QRIS transactions of at least Rp150,000 and exclusive merchandise for new account openings.

title: PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk sees shareholder Agung Sedayu sell 52.9 million shares, raising Rp281.84 billion
body: Agung Sedayu sold a total of 52,930,020 PT Bangun Kosambi Sukses Tbk shares between 27 Feb and 5 Mar 2026 at prices of Rp5,300, Rp5,350 and Rp5,200, generating approximately Rp281.84 billion in proceeds and reducing its stake from 1.37% to 0.43%. The stock closed down 75 points (1.48%) at Rp5,000, extending a month‑long decline of 950 points (15.97%) and a YTD drop of 3,500 points (41.18%).

title: PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk sees AGPA Pte. Ltd increase stake to 98.7% after mandatory tender offer
body: AGPA Pte. Ltd bought 599.7 million PT Prime Agri Resources Tbk shares (32.9% of the company) at an average price of Rp7,903, valuing the transaction at roughly Rp4.7 trillion and raising its ownership to 98.695% of issued capital. The near‑total acquisition triggers a regulatory requirement for SGRO to restore public float to at least 20% within two years.

title: PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka Tbk declares Indonesia's first eco‑industrial tourism city and reports 2025 property sales of Rp1.3 trillion
body: PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka Tbk announced the Jababeka industrial zone in Cikarang as Indonesia's first eco‑industrial tourism city and highlighted solid 2025 property marketing sales of Rp1.3 trillion, representing 36.11% of its total Rp3.6 trillion sales. The company targets Rp3.75 trillion in marketing sales for 2026, driven by industrial land demand in Cikarang (Rp1.25 trillion) and Kendal (Rp2.5 trillion).

title: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk discloses affiliate loan agreements totaling Rp80 billion, deemed non‑material
body: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk reported that its subsidiary PT Suryalaya Anindita International granted a Rp50 billion loan to PT Sitiagung Makmur at 7.75% annual interest and a Rp30 billion loan to PT Surya Internusa Hotels at 7.5% annual interest, each for one year and extendable. The transactions, effective 6 March 2026, involve less than 20% of SSIA’s equity and are considered non‑material under OJK POJ 42/2020.

title: PT Pelindo Terminal Petikemas prepares for 80% surge in container traffic ahead of Lebaran
body: PT Pelindo Terminal Petikemas said it will operate its terminals 24 hours a day for seven days and extend container dwell time to about 16 days to handle an expected 80% increase in logistics volume before the Lebaran holiday. The company will use early berth and yard occupancy monitoring and a terminal booking system to mitigate congestion.

title: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk signs AI joint‑venture partnership, shares dip 1.3%
body: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk, through its subsidiary PT DSST Mas Gemilang, entered a strategic AI partnership with China’s iFLYTEK to create joint venture PT Brilian Teknologi Sejahtera, targeting education and health sectors. The announcement coincided with DSSA’s shares falling 1.32% (about 1,000 points) to Rp74,800 on March 6 2026.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk posts 197% YoY net profit surge in 2025 despite share decline
body: PT Petrosea Tbk reported net profit of USD28.80 million for 2025, a 197.21% YoY increase, with revenue rising 28.32% to USD886.45 million and EBITDA climbing 399.62% to USD39.27 million. The company’s total assets grew 82.19% to USD1.58 billion, but its shares fell 5.65% to Rp4,930 on the day the results were released.

title: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk prepares Rp352.4 billion for 2026 bond and sukuk repayment
body: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk disclosed that it has set aside about Rp352.4 billion to settle the Obligasi Berkelanjutan II Tahap I 2023 Seri B (Rp211.3 billion) and Sukuk Ijarah I Tahap I 2023 Seri B (Rp141.1 billion) due on 4 April 2026. The company also reported a record net profit of Rp534.2 billion for 2025, with a gross margin of 19.1%, net margin of 9.0%, revenue of Rp5.9 trillion, liquidity ratio of 309% and debt‑to‑equity of 0.55x.

title: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk reports revenue of $4.91 billion for year ended Dec 31 2025, down from prior year
body: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk posted revenue of $4.91 billion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a decline from $5.31 billion a year earlier. Net profit attributable to the parent fell to $760.2 million from $1.21 billion, while total assets and liabilities decreased to $5.70 billion and $2.05 billion respectively.

title: Coal producers AADI, ADRO, ITMG, UNTR and PT Bukit Asam Tbk report 2025 earnings decline amid lower coal prices
body: In 2025 PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, PT Alamtri Resources Tbk, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk and PT United Tractors Tbk posted revenue drops of 7.7% to 2.3% YoY and net‑profit declines of 24.2% to 67.6%, while PT Bukit Asam Tbk saw a modest 2.2% revenue rise but a 39.3% profit fall; DERs ranged from 0.26x (ITMG) to 1.06x (PT Bukit Asam Tbk) with UNTR the highest among the group at 0.72x. BRI Danareksa projects 2026 ROE of 20.9% for AADI and issues buy recommendations with target prices of Rp12,100‑15,840 for AADI, Rp2,630 for ADRO, Rp26,500 for ITMG, Rp3,100 for PT Bukit Asam Tbk and Rp32,000 for UNTR.

title: PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk reports 11% decline in net profit to US$40 million for FY 2025
body: PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk posted a net profit of US$40 million for FY 2025, an 11% decline from US$45 million in 2024, while revenue fell 2% to US$295 million amid lower global LPG and ammonia prices. Despite the price weakness, the company maintained earnings through a 3% rise in ammonia shipment volume, reduced financing costs, and its shares rose 27.27% YTD to around Rp770.

title: Idea Asia Investama reduces stake in PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk to 30.95%
body: Idea Asia Investama sold 50 million shares of PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk at Rp51 per share, generating about Rp2.55 billion and lowering its ownership from 35.66% to 30.95%. PT Idea Indonesia Akademi Tbk's stock is trading around Rp126, down 6.67% intraday, after a year‑to‑date gain of 231.58% from roughly Rp38 to Rp128.

title: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk advances Rp1.4 trillion export terminal project in Tuban
body: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, via its subsidiary PT Solusi Bangun Indonesia Tbk, is 99% complete on a Rp1.4 trillion export terminal and production facility that will boost terminal capacity from 15,000 to 50,000 DWT and allow up to 1 million tonnes of cement shipments per year, with an initial 450,000‑tonne throughput expected in 2026. The project is targeted for full operation by mid‑2026.

title: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk discloses affiliate loan facilities totaling Rp80 billion
body: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Suryalaya Anindita International, provided a Rp50 billion loan to PT Sitiagung Makmur at 7.75% per annum and a Rp30 billion loan to PT Surya Internusa Hotels at 7.5% per annum. Management stated the combined Rp80 billion exposure is not material, representing less than 20% of the company's equity.

title: PT Mitra Keluarga Karyasehat Tbk announces up to Rp1 trillion share buyback program
body: PT Mitra Keluarga Karyasehat Tbk said it will repurchase its shares using up to Rp1 trillion of internal cash, with the program running for three months until 7 June 2026. The buyback aims to stabilise the stock, which has fallen about 9.7% this year to roughly Rp2,150 per share.

title: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk reports 37% drop in 2025 net profit
body: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk posted a 37.2% YoY decline in 2025 net profit to USD760.2 million, with revenue falling 7.5% to USD4.91 billion and operating profit down 29.7% to USD1.04 billion. Total assets slipped to USD5.70 billion while equity rose 8.3% to USD3.64 billion, and the shares closed marginally lower at Rp10,300.

title: PT Exploitasi Energi Indonesia Tbk reports 166% increase in 2025 profit attributable to parent
body: PT Exploitasi Energi Indonesia Tbk reported a 166.45% year‑on‑year rise in profit attributable to its parent in 2025, reaching Rp194.59 billion on revenue of Rp1.86 trillion, while gross profit climbed 55.31% to Rp380.30 billion. Earnings per share rose to Rp21.73 and the shares closed up 9.84% at the auto‑rejection upper limit of Rp67 after the results were released.

title: Lautan Luas posts 32% drop in net profit for 2025 despite revenue growth
body: Lautan Luas reported net profit of Rp149.45 billion for 2025, a 32.17% decline from the prior year, with earnings per share falling to Rp99. Revenue rose 13.86% year‑on‑year to Rp8.79 trillion, while operating profit slipped to Rp412.69 billion and total assets increased to Rp6.68 trillion.

title: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk posts 41% profit decline in 2025 and sets Rp10 trillion sales target for 2026
body: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk reported 2025 net profit of Rp2.54 trillion, a 41.6% drop from 2024, with earnings per share falling to Rp121.71 and revenue decreasing 7.3% to Rp12.78 trillion. The company set a 2026 marketing‑sales target of Rp10 trillion, matching its 2025 realization, with residential projects expected to contribute half of the goal.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk reports 5.5% YoY profit decline but quarterly rebound and higher NIM
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk posted a 5.5% year‑on‑year profit drop for 2025, yet quarterly profit rose 9.5% and net interest margin improved to 8% in Q4‑2025, up 30 basis points from the prior quarter. Total deposits grew 7.4% YoY and total credit expanded faster than the industry, keeping results in line with analyst projections (98.8% of estimate).

title: MNC Sekuritas sets target of IDR 7,275‑7,575 for PT Bank Central Asia Tbk
body: MNC Sekuritas recommends buying PT Bank Central Asia Tbk on weakness with a buying range of IDR 6,600‑6,700, a stop‑loss below IDR 6,375, and a target of IDR 7,275‑7,575. The stock closed at IDR 7,000 on Friday, down 1.41% for the day, 2.4% over the week, 10.2% for the month and 13.3% year‑to‑date after foreign investors sold about IDR 91.6 billion.

title: PT Samator Indo Gas Tbk shares suspended by BEI amid sharp price surge
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange suspended trading of PT Samator Indo Gas Tbk effective 5 March 2026 after the stock jumped 365.7% to Rp 3,330, a 114.15% rise over three months and a PBV increase to 2.74x. BEI has sought an explanation from management, which said it has no knowledge of the price move and no corporate actions planned.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk buyback gold price falls to Rp2.757.000 per gram
body: On Monday 9 March 2026, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk announced its gold buyback price at Rp2,757,000 per gram, Rp65,000 lower than the previous level. Transactions above Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% (NPWP) or 3% (non‑NPWP) PPh 22 tax.

title: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara receives 31.3‑ha land donation worth Rp6.2 trillion for 126,000‑unit subsidized housing project
body: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara was granted a 31.3‑hectare parcel in Meikarta valued at roughly Rp6.2 trillion to develop 126,000 subsidized housing units across 52 towers, with the first 18 towers slated for construction at a cost of Rp14‑16 trillion and completion targeted for 17 August 2028. PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk, part of the Lippo Group, participated in the ceremony, highlighting private‑sector involvement in Indonesia’s national 3‑million‑unit housing program.

title: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk reports 19% rise in 2025 net profit despite lower sales
body: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk posted a net profit of Rp1.35 trillion in 2025, up 19.06% from Rp1.13 trillion a year earlier. Revenue fell 1.2% to Rp8.76 trillion, while gross profit declined 5.05% to Rp2.86 trillion; EPS rose to Rp130 per share, cash reached Rp3.16 trillion and total assets grew to Rp9.25 trillion.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk plans to revise 2026 production quota after government limits output to 30%
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk said it will seek a revision of its 2026 production quota after the government approved only 30% of its planned nickel ore output. The company aims to secure sufficient ore supply for its new HPAL smelter in Pomalaa, slated to start operations in August 2026.

title: PT Permodalan Nasional Madani launches Ramadan Madani, Maknai Harmoni program across Indonesia
body: PT Permodalan Nasional Madani (PNM) rolled out its Ramadan Madani, Maknai Harmoni initiative, delivering daily iftar, religious talks, and charitable aid through its network of 4,655 offices, 58 branches in 36 provinces. The program targets the firm’s 22.9 million customers, focusing on orphaned and low‑income families.

title: Mandiri, BNI, BRI, BTN, BSI and Bank Jakarta to receive additional Rp100 trillion government funds via Himbara
body: Indonesia's Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa plans to place an extra Rp100 trillion of government cash with banks Mandiri, BNI, BRI, BTN, BSI and Bank Jakarta under the Himbara scheme, supplementing the Rp200 trillion already deposited since September 2025. The initial allocation was Rp55 trillion each to Mandiri, BNI and BRI, Rp25 trillion to BTN and Rp10 trillion to BSI, with a later Rp76 trillion added to the same banks and Bank Jakarta.

title: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk reports 41.6% drop in net profit for 2025
body: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk posted a net profit of Rp2.54 trillion for 2025, a 41.6% decline from the prior year, while revenue fell 7.3% to Rp12.78 trillion. The company’s total assets rose 4.3% to Rp79.26 trillion and cash balances increased 14.8% to Rp10.28 trillion.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk reports 67% drop in net profit for 2025
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk posted a 67.6% plunge in 2025 net profit to US$447.7 million (Rp7.46 trillion) as revenue fell 9.7% to US$1.87 billion. The decline was accompanied by a 27.2% drop in gross profit, higher cost of goods sold, and total liabilities rising to US$1.81 billion.

title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk sells 49 million shares, cutting ownership to 2.92% and receives buy recommendation with Rp 1,650 target
body: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk (TRIN) sold 49 million shares at an average price of Rp 1,093, reducing Rahayu Saraswati Djojohadikusumo’s stake via PT Satya Devya from 4% to 2.92% and generating roughly Rp 53.5 billion in proceeds. Despite an 8.98% slide to Rp 760 and a 28.3% decline over the past month, Kiwoom Sekuritas maintains a buy rating with a target price of Rp 1,650.

title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas issues buy recommendation for PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk as stock jumps 19% weekly
body: PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk saw its shares surge 19.38% over the past week, closing at Rp 770 on 6 Mar 2026 and attracting a net foreign purchase of Rp 40.14 bn. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas, citing a 31% quarterly rise in ammonia prices and a Q4‑2025 revenue increase of 51% QoQ with net profit soaring 194% to Rp 316 bn, recommends buying the stock in the Rp 720‑750 range with a stop‑loss below Rp 700.

title: PT Bukit Asam Tbk shares surge 14.6% as foreign investors net buy Rp308.5 billion in early March
body: PT Bukit Asam Tbk’s shares jumped 14.62% to Rp2,980 after foreign investors recorded a net purchase of Rp308.5 billion during the week of 2‑6 March 2026, with daily volume of 94.31 million shares worth Rp280.47 billion. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends buying the stock between Rp2,940‑2,980, targeting Rp3,010 and Rp3,150 and setting a stop‑loss at Rp2,900, citing 2025‑9‑month revenue of Rp31.3 trillion and net profit of Rp1.39 trillion.

title: PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk shares surge amid alleged manipulation involving PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia
body: Regulators allege that PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk’s shares rose about 7,150 % after a suspected manipulation scheme involving undisclosed fixed‑allotment allocations and false IPO fund use, generating an illegal gain estimated at Rp14.5 trillion. The investigation also implicates PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia, whose former investment‑banking director and the firm itself are named as suspects.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk reports 2025 revenue of $886.45 million, net profit jumps 197% YoY
body: PT Petrosea Tbk posted 2025 revenue of $886.45 million, a 28.3% increase from 2024, with gross profit of $112.22 million and net profit soaring 197% to $28.8 million. Total assets rose to $1.58 billion while liabilities reached $1.27 billion, lifting equity to $307.4 million.

title: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara Buy Shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk
body: Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara purchased 40,964,400 shares of PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (INET.JK) at IDR 304 per share on 6 March 2026, increasing its holding from 13,286,121,131 to 13,327,085,531 shares (+0.31%). The transaction is classified as an additional ownership acquisition, expanding the shareholder's stake in the company. This incremental purchase may enhance Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara's influence in corporate decisions and reflects confidence in INET's prospects.

title: Jason Laurence Greive sell Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: Jason Laurence Greive sold 95,000 PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk shares at IDR 3,850 per share on 2026-03-05, reducing his holding from 578,200 to 483,200 shares. The divestment purpose is listed as a strategic divestment, representing a notable decrease in his stake in the copper‑gold producer.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk leads foreign buying while PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk tops foreign selling on IDX
body: Foreign investors posted a net purchase of 264.30 million shares on the IDX on 6 March, with PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk leading the buy side with a net gain of 117.12 million shares (162.12 million bought vs 44.99 million sold). PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk topped the sell list, recording a net outflow of 76.29 million shares as foreigners sold 110.81 million versus buying 34.51 million.

title: Indonesia regulator OJK to raise free‑float requirement to 15% over three years
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) plans to increase the minimum free‑float threshold from 7.5% to 15% gradually, aiming for 75% of the 956 listed issuers—about 717 companies—to comply within the first year and full compliance within three years. Currently 60% of issuers meet the rule, and the change could trigger roughly IDR 187 trillion of share sales.

title: Indonesia to Facilitate US$4.5 bn of Private B2B Agricultural Imports Under ART Agreement
body: The Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs confirmed that US$4.5 bn of agricultural imports from the United States will be conducted entirely through private B2B transactions, with the government providing only regulatory oversight. Imports of US agricultural products reached US$1.21 bn in 2025, representing 9.2% of Indonesia’s total agricultural imports and supporting the domestic processed‑food value chain.

title: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk eyes animal‑feed business as 2025 profit drops 28.7%
body: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk said a feasibility study confirmed a new animal‑feed line using bread leftovers, pending approval at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 7 April 2026. The company posted 2025 net profit of IDR 258.5 billion, down 28.7% YoY, with revenue of IDR 3.8 trillion, a 4.4% decline, and its shares rose 0.65% to IDR 770, trading at roughly 18.4× earnings.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk postpones subsidiary IPO and targets a 90 billion‑share rights issue while dividend decision moves to 2026 AGM
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk confirmed it will not list any subsidiaries on the IDX this year and is prioritising a rights issue of 90 billion shares to strengthen its fundamentals. The company also said the 2025 dividend will be decided at the 2026 AGM and it is exploring data‑centre projects through its MKN group entity.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk secures shareholder approval for up to IDR 6.5 trillion rights issue
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk received EGMS approval to raise up to IDR 6.5 trillion by issuing 90 billion new Series E shares, with the final amount to be set on 9 March. The capital increase is expected to cut the total‑borrowings‑to‑assets ratio from 84.28% to 67.9% and the borrowings‑to‑equity ratio from 536.02% to 211.57%, while potentially diluting existing shareholders by up to 33.33%.

title: Essa Industries Indonesia Tbk shares rise as insider TP Rachmat sells 8.95 million shares; 2025 net profit falls 11%
body: Essa Industries Indonesia Tbk (ESSA) saw its share price climb to Rp795, up 29.27% year‑to‑date, after insider TP Rachmat sold 8.95 million shares, reducing his stake to 7.11% (1.22 billion shares). The company reported 2025 net profit of US$40 million (≈Rp676.8 billion), an 11% decline from 2024, with revenue of US$295 million down 2% YoY.

title: Indonesia's composite index falls over 4% amid geopolitical tension and rising oil prices
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) dropped 4.05% to 7,278.16 on March 9, 2026, driven by heightened risk‑off sentiment from the Iran‑U.S./Israel conflict and a 26.79% surge in WTI crude to $115.25 per barrel. Fitch Ratings also cut Indonesia’s credit outlook to negative, adding to investor concerns over fiscal policy and macro stability.

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk reports 2025 revenue rise to $432.7 million but net profit falls 14%
body: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk posted 2025 revenue of $432.72 million, up 6.29% YoY, while net profit slipped to $137.69 million, a 14.2% decline from 2024. Gross profit fell 3.05% to $233.06 million as COGS rose 19.76%, cash rose 9.66% to $718.49 million, and the stock traded at Rp990, down 12.44% YTD.

title: Indonesia's composite index falls as Fitch revises debt outlook to negative and fiscal deficit widens
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) opened down 4.38% at 7,253, reflecting a 7.89% weekly correction after Fitch Ratings shifted Indonesia’s sovereign debt outlook to negative despite maintaining a BBB rating. Fiscal data showed a February deficit of Rp135.7 trillion (0.53% of GDP) and a 41.9% YoY rise in government spending, fueling concerns over fiscal discipline and prompting foreign outflows.

title: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk to Issue Rp98.065bn Sustainable Bonds in March 2026
body: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk will issue Rp98,065bn of Sustainable Bond I, Stage IV 2026, comprising three series—Rp7.70bn at 8.25% for 370 days, Rp85.78bn at 9.75% for 3 years, and Rp4.57bn at 11% for 5 years—on 9 March 2026, with proceeds earmarked for working‑capital needs. The offering is part of a broader Rp400bn sustainable bond program.

title: MyRepublic Indonesia launches MyRepublic Air 5G fixed wireless broadband service
body: MyRepublic Indonesia introduced MyRepublic Air, a 5G fixed wireless access service, on 19 February in Jakarta, expanding its broadband reach beyond its fibre‑to‑the‑home network that already covers 162 cities and regencies. The service uses 1.4 GHz spectrum from a recent government auction to target mid‑ to low‑density suburban and semi‑rural areas, enabling faster deployment than new fibre.

title: Indo Premier Sekuritas targets DAAZ, ELSA and SIMP with specific price goals as IHSG slides
body: The broker expects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to fluctuate between 7,400 and 7,900 after falling 3.47% to 7,322.19 on March 9, 2026. It recommends buying DAAZ with a target of Rp 4,200, ELSA with a target of Rp 900, and SIMP with a target of Rp 685.

title: PT Barito Pacific Tbk Falls 12.86% as Indonesia's IHSG Slides 4.94%
body: Indonesia's benchmark index fell 4.94% to 7,210,736, with the raw material sector weakest at 8.55%. PT Barito Pacific Tbk, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT Bumi Resources Tbk fell 12.86%, 11.78% and 11.3% respectively, while PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk and PT AKR Corporindo Tbk rose 1.7%, 0.46% and 0.4%.

title: Foreign Investors Dump PT Bank Central Asia Shares, Driving a 12.77% Decline in 2025
body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 17.5 trillion in PT Bank Central Asia shares, contributing to a 12.77% decline in the stock during 2025. The same sell pressure hit PT Bumi Resources (Rp 7.7 trillion, 45.24% YTD drop), PT Bank Mandiri (Rp 1.9 trillion, 1.87% YTD decline) and PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Rp 1.9 trillion, 0.23% YTD rise), with broker targets of Rp 9,750 for BBCA, Rp 6,200 for BMRI, Rp 336 for BUMI and Rp 4,770 for BBNI.

title: Turniady Widjaja buys Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: On March 6, 2026, shareholder Turniady Widjaja purchased 3,100 RDTX.JK shares at approximately IDR 16,125 per share, raising his holding from 50,431,400 to 50,434,500 shares (+3,100). The buy, classified as an investment, marginally increases his stake in Roda Vivatex Tbk and signals continued confidence in the company.

title: Ir.T. Permadi Rachmat Sell Shares of ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk
body: On March 5, 2026, Ir.T. Permadi Rachmat sold a total of 42,239,200 ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk shares at prices ranging from IDR 765 to IDR 795 per share, with a representative price of about IDR 780 per share. The sale reduced his holding from 1,224,349,556 shares to 1,182,110,356, a decrease of 42,239,200 shares. The transaction is classified as a divestment. The reduction lowers the shareholder’s ownership proportion in ESSA, potentially increasing free‑float and affecting market liquidity.

title: Robin Sunyoto buys Shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk
body: Investor Robin Sunyoto purchased a total of 150,000 shares of PT Hero Global Investment Tbk for investment purposes, using a representative price of IDR 139 per share. The holding increased from 13,600,000 to 13,750,000 shares, reflecting a net addition of 150,000 shares. This transaction raises his stake in the company and signals confidence in its future performance.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: Henry Liem sold 193,200 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk at IDR 530 per share on 2026-03-06. His holding decreased from 14,676,959 to 14,483,759 shares, a reduction of 193,200 shares. The transaction, recorded on 2026-03-09, reflects a straightforward share disposal without additional strategic context.

title: Turniady Widjaja buy Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: Turniady Widjaja purchased a total of 3,100 Roda Vivatex Tbk shares on 6 March 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 16,125 to IDR 17,000, with a representative price of about IDR 16,500 per share. The transaction raises his holding from 50,431,400 to 50,434,500 shares, a net increase of 3,100 shares, and is classified as an investment. The buy adds to his existing stake, indicating continued confidence in the company.

title: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Mb Investment Management Pte.Ltd. purchased an additional 300,000 shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) on 6 March 2026 at a representative price of IDR 1,315 per share, raising its holding from 1,710,200,057 to 1,710,500,057 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment and marginally increases the shareholder’s stake, indicating continued confidence in the company’s outlook.

title: Verah Wahyudi S Wong buy Shares of PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk
body: On 5 March 2026, shareholder Verah Wahyudi S Wong purchased a total of 11,050,700 PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk shares at an indicative price of IDR 112 per share, increasing his holding from 59,578,300 to 70,629,000 shares (a rise of 11,050,700 shares). The transaction is classified as an investment, expanding the shareholder's stake and potentially enhancing voting power in the company.

title: Rmk Investama sell Shares of PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk
body: Rmk Investama sold 36,250,000 shares of PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk (RMKO.JK) on 9 March 2026 at IDR 590 per share. The holding fell from 879,980,000 to 843,730,000 shares, a decline of 36,250,000 shares. The sale was executed to realise profits from the share price rise and to boost public ownership. The reduction in insider stake may increase free float and affect market liquidity.

title: Bani Maulana Mulia buys Shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk
body: On 2026-03-09, shareholder Bani Maulana Mulia purchased 1,100,000 Samudera Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 360 per share for investment purposes. The holding rose from 58,262,800 to 59,362,800 shares, marking a 1.9% increase in his stake.

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk reports 2025 net loss of $162 million as revenue falls 15% and waste‑management share rises
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk posted a 2025 net loss of US$162.26 million (Rp2.7 trillion) on revenue of US$380.22 million, down 14.7% from 2024, with waste‑management contributing US$155.4 million (41% of revenue) and coal mining revenue falling to US$194.6 million (51%). The company recorded positive adjusted EBITDA of US$47.2 million, cash of US$102.3 million (up 15%), and completed the acquisition of Sembcorp Environment (now Cora Environment) to strengthen its waste‑management position.

title: Sanjay Kumar Gordhan A Vaghasia Buy Shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk
body: On 2026-03-09, shareholder Sanjay Kumar Gordhan A Vaghasia purchased 1,500 shares of PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk at IDR 2,580 per share, raising his holding from 303,000 to 304,500 shares (+1,500). The transaction, recorded on 2026-03-10, is classified as a purchase and reflects a modest increase in ownership without altering control, indicating a routine investment rather than a strategic shift.

title: Granada Global Industri sell Shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk
body: Granada Global Industri sold a total of 33,555,600 shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk (BRRC.JK) to meet payment of obligations. The sales, executed at a representative price of IDR 100 per share on 23‑27 February 2026, reduced its holding from 82,669,308 to 49,113,708 shares, a decline of 33,555,600 shares. The transaction lowers the shareholder's stake in the company, potentially affecting voting power and signaling a liquidity need.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 9 March 2026, shareholder Henry Liem sold 21,800 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk (AKPI.JK) at IDR 535 per share, reducing his stake from 14,483,759 to 14,461,959 shares, a net decrease of 21,800 shares. The transaction, recorded on 10 March 2026, was executed for the purpose of selling shares and does not indicate any change in corporate control. The sale represents a minor adjustment to Liem's holdings and is unlikely to materially affect the company's share price or governance.

title: George Oetomo sell Shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk
body: George Oetomo, a major shareholder of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG.JK), sold a total of 525,000 shares on March 5‑6, 2026 at prices of IDR 1,650 and IDR 1,725 per share, representing a divestment of approximately 0.96% of his holding. His stake fell from 54,956,100 shares to 54,431,100 shares, a decrease of 525,000 shares. The sale is classified as a divestment, indicating a strategic reduction of exposure to the palm‑oil producer. The transaction modestly lowers Oetomo’s ownership percentage but is unlikely to affect the company’s control or market dynamics.

title: George Oetomo buy Shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk
body: On 4 March 2026, shareholder George Oetomo purchased 300,000 shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG.JK) at IDR 1,580 per share, increasing his stake from 54,656,100 to 54,956,100 shares (a net gain of 300,000 shares). The transaction is classified as an investment, reflecting confidence in the company's agribusiness operations and potentially enhancing shareholder value for Indonesian investors.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 6 March 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 52 per share, amounting to approximately IDR 520,000,000. His holding decreased from 2,824,254,200 to 2,814,254,200 shares, a reduction of 10,000,000 shares. The filing reports no stated purpose, and the transaction reflects a modest change in ownership for the listed company.

title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk shares sold by President Commissioner cut stake to 2.92%
body: President Commissioner Rahayu Saraswati D. Djojohadikusumo, through PT Satya Devya, sold about 48.97 million shares of PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk between December 2025 and February 2026, lowering her holding from 4% to roughly 2.92% and generating roughly IDR 53.5 billion in proceeds. The company's stock has since fallen about 48% to IDR 650.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rises to Rp2.802.000 per gram
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk reported its Antam gold buyback price increased by Rp14,000 to Rp2,802,000 per gram on 10 March 2026. Transactions above Rp10 million are subject to a 1.5% PPh 22 tax for NPWP holders and 3% for non‑NPWP holders.

title: PT Humpuss Maritim Internasional Tbk posts modest revenue growth but lower profit as it eyes fleet expansion
body: PT Humpuss Maritim Internasional Tbk reported third‑quarter 2026 revenue of US$96.48 million, up 5.27% year‑on‑year, while net profit fell to US$7.64 million amid aggressive expansion. The company said it will leverage lower global vessel prices to add ships and diversify into downstream and infrastructure businesses, noting no direct impact from the Iran‑US geopolitical tension.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia says its infrastructure and revised trading‑halt rules can handle market stress as IHSG drops 3.27%
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (Bursa Efek Indonesia) affirmed that its systems and updated trading‑halt thresholds are prepared for heightened volatility after the IHSG fell 3.27% to 7,337.37 on March 9, 2026. The new rules trigger a 30‑minute halt if the index slides more than 8% and a trading suspend if it falls over 20%, replacing the previous 5%/10% halt thresholds.

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk projects return to profit in 2‑3 years as waste‑management revenue reaches 41% despite 2025 loss
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk posted a 2025 net loss of US$162.26 million on revenue of US$365.86 million, a 5.2% decline from 2024, as coal and steam‑plant divestments hurt EBITDA. The company says waste‑management now contributes about 41% of revenue and expects the clean‑energy and waste‑management businesses to replace coal‑related earnings within the next 2–3 years.

title: Analysts Maintain Buy Rating on PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk with 30% Upside Potential Amid High Dividend Payout
body: Analysts overwhelmingly recommend buying PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, with 69% issuing buy ratings and a consensus 12‑month target price of Rp4,041, implying roughly 30% upside from the current Rp3,100 level. The company confirmed an 89% dividend payout for FY2025, distributing Rp21.04 trillion (Rp212.5 per share), while Q3‑2025 net profit fell 10.7% to Rp15.78 trillion and revenue slipped 2.3% to Rp109.61 trillion.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk announces 8.2% dividend yield and receives strong analyst buy consensus
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk announced a cash dividend of Rp13.03 trillion, equal to 65% of its 2025 net profit of Rp20.04 trillion, or about Rp350 per share representing an 8.2% yield based on the last price of Rp4,290. Bloomberg consensus shows 85.7% of analysts rating the stock as buy with an average 12‑month target of Rp5,035, implying roughly 17% upside, while the share fell about 5.3% over the past month.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk gold price rises to Rp 3.047.000 per gram on March 9, 2026
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's Antam gold bars traded at Rp 3,047,000 per gram on Tuesday, March 9, 2026, up Rp 8,000 from the prior session. The company's buyback price was set at Rp 2,802,000 per gram, a rise of Rp 14,000, while global spot gold fell 0.38% to $5,129.5 per ounce amid Middle‑East tensions and higher Brent crude.

title: PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk plans rights issue after PT RMK Investama reduces stake
body: PT RMK Investama sold 36.25 million shares of PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk at Rp 590 each, cutting its ownership to 843.73 million shares (67.5%) from 879.98 million (70.4%) and raising roughly Rp 21.38 billion. PT Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo Tbk, whose stock has dropped 9.65% to Rp 515 and 29% over the past week, aims to issue up to 512 million new shares (up to 29.06% of capital) via a rights issue pending shareholder approval on 8 April 2026.

title: PT Bank Mandiri Tbk reports solid early‑2026 growth in credit, deposits and net profit
body: PT Bank Mandiri Tbk posted a 15.7% year‑on‑year increase in credit disbursement to Rp1,513.1 trillion and a 16.3% rise in third‑party deposits to Rp1,644.8 trillion through February 2026. Net profit grew 16.7% to Rp8.9 trillion, driven by a 28% YoY jump in digital transactions on its Livin’ by Mandiri platform, which recorded over 738.7 million transactions.

title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends buy for PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk targeting 1.355‑1.430
body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas (BRIDS) notes that PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk broke out above 1,230 and recommends buying between 1,250 and 1,300 with a stop‑loss at 1,220, aiming for a rally to 1,355‑1,430. The stock trades at a PBV of 0.64, PER of 4.77 and reported 2025 revenue of Rp 5.51 trillion, net profit Rp 1.88 trillion and EPS Rp 277.

title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas recommends buying PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk as stock breaks 27,000 level
body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas sees PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) breaking the psychological 27,000 level with rising volume and recommends buying in the 27,500‑28,000 range, targeting 28,950‑30,175 and setting a stop‑loss below 27,000. The company posted 2025 net profit of US$190.94 million (≈Rp 3.2 trillion) with EPS US$0.17, paid interim dividends of US$50.04 million (≈Rp 738 per share) for 2025, and total 2024 dividends equal to 65% of profit, and will hold its annual shareholders meeting on 17 April 2026.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) slides 2.08% to Rp2,350, broker MNC Sekuritas advises buy on weakness
body: ADRO fell 2.08% to Rp2,350 on 9 March 2026 with foreign investors net buying Rp81.77 billion and valuation metrics of PBV 0.92 and PER 9.26. MNC Sekuritas expects the stock could test Rp2,220‑2,280, sets target prices of Rp2,420 and Rp2,540 with a stop‑loss below Rp2,170, and reports FY profit of US$447.69 million (≈Rp7.4 trillion).

title: Foreign investors net buy PT Bumi Resources Tbk and nine other Indonesian stocks on March 9, 2026
body: On March 9, 2026, foreign investors posted a net buy of Rp 1.1 trillion in the regular market, with the largest inflows into PT Bumi Resources Tbk (Rp 137.8 billion), PT Petrosea Tbk (Rp 134.5 billion), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (Rp 121.1 billion), PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (Rp 91.7 billion), PT Darma Henwa Tbk (Rp 89.5 billion), PT Goto Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (Rp 88.3 billion), PT Barito Pacific Tbk (Rp 83.6 billion), PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (Rp 81.7 billion), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (Rp 69.5 billion) and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (Rp 64.9 billion). Despite the buying, the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed down 248.32 points, or 3.27%, at 7,337.3.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk targets Rp 231‑241 with support at Rp 189‑205
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia projects PT Bumi Resources Tbk's near‑term price to rise to Rp 231‑241, citing a support zone of Rp 189‑205. The stock fell 4.35% to Rp 220 on March 9, 2026, after an 11.2% weekly decline and a YTD loss of 39.8%, while foreign investors bought a net Rp 137.8 billion.

title: BNI Sekuritas recommends spec‑buy positions in PTBA, BIPI, HRUM, DEWA, BULL and INET
body: Head of Retail Research Fanny Suherman said the IHSG could rebound toward 7,500 after a 1.5% rise to 7,447 and foreign net buying of roughly Rp 750 bn, and highlighted several stocks. The broker issued spec‑buy calls on PTBA (buy Rp 2,930‑2,950, target Rp 2,980‑3,030), BIPI (buy Rp 242‑244, target Rp 250‑256), HRUM (buy Rp 985‑1,000, target Rp 1,020‑1,050), DEWA (buy Rp 404‑410, target Rp 418‑430), BULL (buy Rp 376‑380, target Rp 390‑402) and INET (buy Rp 264‑272, target Rp 280‑286).

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk posts 2025 revenue decline and $162.27 million net loss
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk reported a 5.16% drop in total revenue to US$365.86 million in 2025, driven by a 45.99% fall in coal sales, while waste‑management revenue surged 1,084.6%. The company posted a net loss attributable to owners of US$162.27 million, reversing a US$25.36 million profit from the prior year, and its total assets fell 11.26% to US$793.09 million.

title: MNC Sekuritas issues buy‑on‑weakness recommendations for PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk, PT Sentul City Tbk and PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk amid market correction
body: The broker notes that ADRO fell 2.08% to Rp 2,350, BBRI slipped 2.72% to Rp 3,570, BKSL dropped 9.40% to Rp 106 and ENRG declined 9.04% to Rp 1,660. It recommends buying each on weakness within narrow price bands (ADRO Rp 2,220‑2,280, BBRI Rp 3,540‑3,570, BKSL Rp 104‑106, ENRG Rp 1,545‑1,630) with target prices up to Rp 2,540, Rp 3,760, Rp 125 and Rp 1,975 respectively.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk approves Rp13.03 trillion dividend and up to Rp905.48 billion share buyback
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) approved a cash dividend of Rp13.03 trillion, equal to 65% of its 2025 net profit of Rp20.04 trillion, yielding an estimated Rp349 per share and an 8.2% dividend yield. Shareholders also authorized a buyback program of up to Rp905.48 billion and retained 35% of earnings (about Rp7.01 trillion) for capital strengthening.

title: Bank Mandiri posts solid early‑2026 growth driven by digital transactions
body: Bank Mandiri reported a 16.7% year‑on‑year rise in net profit to Rp8.9 trillion for the period ending February 2026, supported by a 15.7% increase in credit disbursement to Rp1,513.1 trillion and a 16.3% jump in DPK to Rp1,644.8 trillion. Digital channels such as Livin’ by Mandiri drove a 28% rise in transaction volume to 738.7 million, boosting fee‑based income by 45.3% to Rp625 billion while the bank’s cost‑to‑income ratio fell to 37.21%.

title: Mega Manunggal receives resignations of its president director and commissioners ahead of AGM
body: Mega Manunggal announced that the resignations of President Director Ashwin Bhat, President Commissioner Wibowo Muljono and Commissioner Frans Surjadi were received on 5 March 2026. The company’s annual general meeting is scheduled for 31 March 2026, where replacements will be appointed and agenda items such as profit allocation, remuneration and conversion to a domestic‑capital entity will be approved.

title: Bank National Nobu announces up to Rp50 billion share buyback program
body: Bank National Nobu (NOBU) will allocate up to Rp50 billion for a share repurchase, targeting no more than 20% of its paid‑up capital and maintaining a free‑float of at least 7.5% after the buyback. The program runs from 9 March 2026 to 8 June 2026 and is expected to have no material effect on the bank’s financial performance, capital structure, or liquidity.

title: Minna Padi Investama Reports 2025 Earnings Surge to Rp1.81 billion Net Profit
body: Minna Padi Investama posted a 113.19% jump in net profit to Rp1.81 billion for 2025, up from a loss of Rp13.79 billion in the same period last year, while revenue climbed 3,807.59% to Rp61.74 billion. Net profit per share rose to Rp0.16 from a loss of Rp1.22, reflecting a strong turnaround in the company’s financial performance.

title: Sumber Tani Agung posts 25% rise in net profit to Rp1.6 trillion for 2025
body: Sumber Tani Agung reported net profit of Rp1.6 trillion for the year ended 31 December 2025, a 25 % increase from Rp1.28 trillion a year earlier, with basic earnings per share climbing to Rp147. Revenue jumped 50.2 % to Rp9.66 trillion, while total assets grew to Rp9.56 trillion and equity to Rp7 trillion.

title: Astra International shares increase as Gita Tiffani adds 250,000 shares
body: On 4 March 2026, Gita Tiffani completed the purchase of 250,000 Astra International shares at Rp6,075 per share, investing Rp1.51 billion and raising her holding to 3.33 million shares (0,0082% of the company). The transaction follows a prior purchase of 500,000 shares on 27 February 2026 at Rp6,613 per share, and Astra International closed at Rp5,850, down 4.49% from the previous level.

title: Global Sukses Solusi appointed digital partner for Indonesia’s Merah Putih Village Cooperative program
body: Global Sukses Solusi was officially designated by the Ministry of Cooperatives as the technology partner for the Merah Putih Village/Urban Cooperative program, which targets the creation of 80,000 new cooperatives. The appointment supports the company’s 2026 strategy to grow its subscription‑based SaaS product Accounting+ and generate recurring revenue from digitalizing cooperative finance and reporting.

title: Kirana Megatara posts 4.99% decline in 2025 net profit to Rp185.1 billion
body: Kirana Megatara reported a 4.99% YoY decline in 2025 net profit to Rp185.1 billion, with earnings per share falling to Rp22.53 and net sales rising 13.95% to Rp12.82 trillion. The company’s gross profit fell 6.16% to Rp989.99 billion, while total assets decreased to Rp4.52 trillion and equity grew to Rp2.18 trillion.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk signs one‑year strategic partnership with Nokia Corporation to explore 6G technology
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk and Nokia Corporation announced a one‑year Strategic Partnership Agreement at Mobile World Congress 2026 to jointly study and assess the feasibility of 6G network architecture and next‑generation digital infrastructure. The collaboration aims to position Indonesia in the early development of 6G standards and support future ultra‑low‑latency, high‑capacity applications.

title: Indonesian Ministry of Industry says textile and footwear sectors ready to meet Ramadan and Eid demand
body: The Ministry of Industry reported that national textile, apparel and footwear production capacity is optimal to satisfy the seasonal surge in demand, with the sector contributing 0.97% to GDP and employing about 3.96 million workers as of August 2025. It also noted tighter monitoring of illegal imported second‑hand clothing to protect domestic manufacturers.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 6 March 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 52 per share. His holding decreased from 2,824,254,200 to 2,814,254,200 shares, a reduction of 10,000,000 shares. The transaction reflects a modest divestment by a major insider, marginally lowering his ownership stake in the listed company.

title: Arfindi A Batubara buys Shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk
body: Arfindi A Batubara purchased 70,200 shares of PT Logisticsplus International Tbk at IDR 112 per share on 2026-03-09, raising his holding from 190,800 to 261,000 shares (a net increase of 70,200). The buy is driven by his investment strategy, expands his stake significantly, and may be viewed as a vote of confidence in the company's logistics operations, potentially affecting market sentiment.

title: Sarana Meditama Metropolitan, Tbk. sell Shares of PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk
body: On 6 March 2026, Sarana Meditama Metropolitan, Tbk. sold 9,200,000 shares of PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk at IDR 880 per share. The holder's stake fell from 742,242,200 shares to 733,042,200 shares, a reduction of 9,200,000 shares, to increase public share ownership. The transaction expands the free float, potentially enhancing market liquidity and broadening the shareholder base.

title: Haiyanto sell Shares of Elnusa Tbk
body: Shareholder Haiyanto sold a total of 19,105,600 Elnusa Tbk shares between 2 March and 6 March 2026 as a divestment, at representative prices around IDR 985 per share. His holding fell from 454,538,400 shares to 435,432,800 shares, a reduction of roughly 4.2% of the total sharebase. The transaction, disclosed on 10 March 2026, signals a notable decrease in Haiyanto's stake, which may influence investor sentiment and liquidity for ELSA.JK.

title: Ny Farida Helianti buy Shares of Samudera Indonesia Tbk
body: Ny Farida Helianti purchased 500,000 Samudera Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 358 per share on 10 March 2026, increasing her holding from 800,000 to 1,300,000 shares (a +62.5% increase). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises her ownership stake and may signal confidence in the company's prospects, which could be noted by investors monitoring shareholder activity.

title: Herrijanto Widjaja sell Shares of Roda Vivatex Tbk
body: On 6 March 2026, shareholder Herrijanto Widjaja sold 50,000 Roda Vivatex Tbk shares at IDR 16,250 per share as a divestment. His holding decreased from 7,359,500 to 7,309,500 shares, a reduction of 50,000 shares. The transaction reflects a modest stake reduction and may signal portfolio rebalancing.

title: Granada Global Industri sell Shares of PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk
body: Granada Global Industri sold a total of 21,358,150 PT Raja Roti Cemerlang Tbk shares on 2 March 2026 at a representative price of IDR 100 per share, generating approximately IDR 2,135,815,000. The holding fell from 49,113,708 shares to 27,755,558 shares, a reduction of 21,358,150 shares, to meet payment of obligations. The transaction significantly lowers the shareholder’s stake in the company.

title: Drs Lo Kheng Hong buy Shares of Gajah Tunggal Tbk
body: On 23 Feb 2026, shareholder Drs Lo Kheng Hong bought 1,398,400 shares of Gajah Tunggal Tbk at IDR 1,095 per share for investment purposes. The purchase raised his holding from 208,500,100 to 209,898,500 shares, a net increase of 1,398,400 shares, reflecting a modest expansion of his stake in the company.

title: Property developers PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk and Summarecon Serpong seen as resilient amid weakening rupiah and higher rates
body: Analysts note that a weaker rupiah and limited scope for Bank Indonesia to cut rates are pressuring Indonesia’s property sector, with the IDXPROPRT index down 17.42% year‑to‑date to 969.31. Despite the macro headwinds, PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk and Summarecon Serpong are considered capable of delivering resilient performance because of strong land banks and solid balance sheets.

title: Henry Liem sell Shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk
body: On 10 March 2026, shareholder Henry Liem sold 500 shares of Argha Karya Prima Ind. Tbk at IDR 520 per share. His holding decreased from 14,461,959 to 14,461,459 shares, a reduction of 500 shares (approximately 0.0035% of total holdings). The transaction was executed solely to sell shares, representing a marginal change in ownership without broader strategic implications.

title: UOB Kay Hian lifts stake in PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk as multiple Indonesian firms record >5% shareholder changes on March 6
body: On March 6, UOB Kay Hian Private Limited increased its holding in PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk to 5.08% after buying 5 million shares, while PT Samuel Sekuritas Indonesia raised its stake in PT MD Entertainment Tbk to 8.1% with a purchase of 43.10 million shares (Morgan Stanley sold 175,300 shares, retaining 10.5%). Other notable moves included PT Henan Putihrai Asset Management lifting its stake in PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk to 10.18% (>4 million shares), Lo Kheng Hong boosting PT Intiland Development Tbk to 6.74% (2.90 million shares), PT United Tractors Tbk buying back 2.74 million shares to a 5.25% treasury holding, PT Samuel Tumbuh Bersama cutting its PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk stake to 39.06% after selling 5.15 million shares, PT Sinar Mas Cakrawala offloading 2.60 million PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk shares while keeping 49.03%, and individual Haiyanto reducing PT Elnusa Tbk to 5.98% after selling 1.75 million shares.

title: PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk shares suspended after Verah Wahyudi S. Wong acquires 5.89% stake
body: Verah Wahyudi S. Wong bought 70.62 million PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk shares, raising his holding to 5.89% as of 9 March 2026. The Indonesia Stock Exchange suspended trading of PT Lancartama Sejati Tbk on 5 March 2026, citing an abnormal price surge, while the company’s top shareholders remain PT Lancartama (50.33%) and Katrin Widjaja (12.27%).

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk posts 1,073% jump in 2025 net profit
body: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk (BUVA) reported a 2025 net profit of Rp99.19 billion, a 1,073% YoY increase from Rp8.45 billion, with revenue rising 5.72% to Rp375.58 billion and EPS climbing to Rp4.03. The company also cut liabilities by 27.45% to Rp556.12 billion, lifted equity by 51.91% to Rp2.05 trillion, and its shares traded at Rp1,075, down 22.66% YTD.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia under DPR scrutiny for its Special Monitoring Board rules
body: On March 10, 2026, DPR Commission XI chair Mukhamad Misbakhun questioned the Bursa Efek Indonesia’s Special Monitoring Board, which applies to stocks with average prices below Rp51, free‑float under 5 % or daily turnover under Rp5 million. The exchange also announced that, from June 2026, OJK‑mandated separate accounts will be required for IPO proceeds to improve transparency.

title: Phintraco Sekuritas names INKP, ASII, INDY, MBMA, and TINS as top picks as IHSG expected to trade sideways
body: Phintraco Sekuritas highlighted INKP, ASII, INDY, MBMA and TINS as its top picks, noting that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) is projected to move sideways between 7,400 and 7,550, with a potential rebound above 7,500 toward 7,600. The outlook follows a recent rebound from a sharp correction driven by lower crude prices, Wall Street gains, and technical indicators showing an oversold Stochastic RSI and a still‑negative MACD histogram.

title: PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur launches ORIS retail infrastructure bonds with up to Rp300 billion issuance
body: PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur announced the ORIS retail infrastructure bond offering, targeting up to Rp300 billion with 1‑year and 3‑year tenors and coupons of 5.60% and 6.05% per annum. The bonds, rated idAAA by Pefindo, have a minimum purchase of Rp5 million and will fund green and social projects under the company’s Sustainable Funding Framework.

title: PT Krakatau Steel Tbk sets US$1.6 billion revenue target as part of KRAS Reborn transformation
body: PT Krakatau Steel Tbk announced a consolidated revenue target of US$1.6 billion (approximately Rp26.98 trillion) for its 2026 plan, emphasizing a ‘KRAS Reborn’ transformation that expands into industrial zones, logistics and power generation. The company reported a Q3 2025 net profit of US$24 million, supported by restructuring, operational efficiency and accelerated debt repayment.

title: Sinarmas Asset Management targets Rp70 trillion AUM with launch of new mutual funds and gold ETF
body: Sinarmas Asset Management said its assets under management reached Rp65 trillion and it aims to hit Rp70 trillion in 2026 by adding three new funds – the Global Simas S&P 500 ESG Syariah (launched March 5), a gold‑ETF slated for June, and a China‑focused fund expected in the second half of the year. The gold‑ETF is projected to generate Rp500 billion‑Rp1 trillion and the China fund Rp200 billion‑Rp500 billion in AUM.

title: PT Sinarmas Asset Management targets Rp70 trillion AUM by 2026
body: PT Sinarmas Asset Management said its assets under management have risen to Rp65 trillion and it aims to reach Rp70 trillion by 2026 through new investment products and AI‑driven portfolio management. The firm highlighted a 53% one‑year and 64% three‑year return record and launched a global S&P 500 ESG Shariah Index fund.

title: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk faces $130.4 million LNG arbitration claim and records 36.5% profit decline in 2025
body: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk is being sued by Gunvor Singapore Pte Ltd for $130.4 million over delayed LNG deliveries, with arbitration set for May‑June 2026 and a $72.02 million provision recorded. The company reported 2025 net profit of $215.36 million, a 36.55% YoY drop, revenue of $3.97 billion (up 4.94%), and its shares slipped 0.25% to Rp1,965, down 16.03% over the week.

title: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk posts 2025 profit turnaround and near‑doubling of assets after IPO
body: PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk reported a net profit of Rp99.68 billion in 2025, reversing a Rp366.37 billion loss in 2024, driven by net interest income of Rp1.58 trillion. The bank’s total assets rose to Rp21.28 trillion, liabilities to Rp13.12 trillion and equity to Rp8.16 trillion, supported by an IPO that raised about Rp2.79 trillion.

title: PT Indospring Tbk shares plunge 14.4% to auto‑reject bottom of Rp 625
body: PT Indospring Tbk (INDS) fell 14.38% to the auto‑reject bottom of Rp 625 on March 11, 2026, after a 14.62% drop the previous session, with 12.67 million shares traded (Rp 8.01 billion). The decline follows a rapid 925% rally earlier in the year and recent insider sales by director Lioe Cu Ling Se, who reduced his holding to 44,500 shares.

title: Alamtri Resources Indonesia (ADRO) shares rise 1.28% to Rp 2,380 as Phintraco Sekuritas maintains buy recommendation
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) closed up 1.28% at Rp 2,380 on Tuesday, with Phintraco Sekuritas recommending a buy entry around Rp 2,320 and a target of Rp 2,470‑2,500. The company posted 2025 net profit of US$447.7 million (≈Rp 7.4 trillion), down from US$1.38 billion in 2024, with a price‑to‑book ratio of 0.93× and a PER of 9.48×.

title: MNC Sekuritas recommends buying PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk after 6.7% price gain
body: MNC Sekuritas highlighted PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk's shares rising 6.69% to Rp 1,355 and noted foreign buying of Rp 5.78 billion, while recommending a buy‑on‑weakness entry around Rp 1,295‑1,330 with target prices of Rp 1,400 and Rp 1,445 and a stop‑loss below Rp 1,280. The broker also cited a nine‑month 2025 net profit of Rp 6.4 trillion and a recent divestment by Harita Jayaraya that raised Rp 1.38 trillion, reducing the group's voting stake to 79.79%.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk shares slip as foreign investors sell, despite strong January profit
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk fell 0.28% to Rp 3,560 on March 10, 2026, as foreign investors sold 175.35 million shares worth Rp 628.73 billion, resulting in a net foreign outflow of Rp 434.43 billion and a 5.57% decline over the past week. The bank posted a net profit of Rp 3.72 trillion in January 2026, an 85.40% year‑on‑year rise from January 2025 but a 24.87% drop from the previous month’s Rp 4.95 trillion.

title: Foreign investors net buy PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk and other top Indonesian stocks on March 10, 2026
body: On March 10, 2026 foreign investors recorded net purchases of PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (Rp 80.2 bn), PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (Rp 72.8 bn), PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (Rp 47.8 bn), PT Bukit Asam Tbk (Rp 25.9 bn), PT Abadi Lestari Indonesia Tbk (Rp 19.1 bn), PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk (Rp 15.7 bn), PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk (Rp 15.3 bn), PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (Rp 15.2 bn), PT Elnusa Tbk (Rp 14.8 bn) and PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (Rp 12.4 bn). The broader market saw the IHSG rise 103.5 points (1.41%) to 7,440.9 despite a net sell of Rp 2.63 trillion across all stocks.

title: KB Valbury Sekuritas recommends buying PT Timah Tbk as stock jumps 12.28%
body: PT Timah Tbk (TINS) surged 12.28% to Rp 3,840 and KB Valbury Sekuritas issued a buy recommendation with a daily target of Rp 4,010. The broker suggests entering between Rp 3,610‑3,840 and setting a stop‑loss at Rp 3,210, noting the stock is up 21.5% month‑to‑date and 23.4% year‑to‑date.

title: Phintraco Sekuritas recommends INKP as a top pick amid predicted IHSG range
body: Phintraco Sekuritas forecasts the Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) to trade sideways between 7,400 and 7,550 on March 11, 2026, with upside potential if it stays above 7,500. The broker lists INKP among five stocks it expects to generate gains in this market context.

title: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk reports $512 million Q4‑2025 revenue as coal sales rise to 6.8 million tons
body: Mirae Asset Sekuritas highlighted that PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk posted Q4‑2025 revenue of US$512 million, driven by a 6.8 million‑ton sales volume and an average price of US$75 per ton. The broker sees the coal sector remaining relatively defensive amid volatile global oil prices and seasonal domestic demand.

title: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia targets Rp 244‑248 for PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI)
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia sees PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) trading near Rp 240 and sets a near‑term target range of Rp 244‑248, with technical support at Rp 224‑232. The stock jumped 9.09% on March 10, yet remains down 34.4% YTD and recorded foreign sell‑offs of about Rp 90.41 billion.

title: Indonesia requests WTO authorization to suspend trade concessions against EU over palm oil dispute
body: Indonesia has asked the WTO Dispute Settlement Body for permission to suspend trade concessions on the EU after the bloc failed to comply with a WTO ruling on palm‑oil‑based biofuels. The move, backed by industry groups such as GAPKI and Aprobi, seeks to mitigate what officials describe as “enormous” annual export losses for Indonesian palm oil producers.

title: Petrosea reports 28% revenue growth and nearly 200% net profit surge in 2025
body: Petrosea posted 2025 revenue of USD 886.45 million, a 28.3% year‑on‑year increase, driven by mining and construction‑engineering services. Net profit jumped 197% to USD 28.8 million and total assets rose to USD 1.58 billion.

title: Vale Indonesia Maintains Nickel Matte Production Amid RKAB Cuts, Targets Pomalaa HPAL Completion in 2026
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk says its nickel matte production at the Sorowako smelter remains on track despite recent RKAB cuts, with the government granting 100% approval for its RKAB. The company is shifting focus to the Pomalaa HPAL smelter, which is expected to reach mechanical completion in August 2026 and ramp up production in the second half of that year, requiring ore supply 2‑3 months earlier.

title: MIND ID Leads IDR 104.5 Trillion Integrated Bauxite-Aluminum Downstreaming Project with Inalum and Antam
body: MIND ID, in collaboration with Inalum and Antam, has commenced construction on an integrated bauxite-aluminum downstream project in Mempawah, West Kalimantan, marked by the groundbreaking of the Smelter Grade Alumina Refinery (SGAR) Phase 2 and PT Inalum's second aluminum smelter. This strategic initiative, with a total investment estimated at IDR 104.5 trillion (USD 6.23 billion), aims to establish a complete industrial supply chain and reduce Indonesia's aluminum imports.

title: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk Sign Gold Sales & Purchase Agreement for 6 Metric Tons Over Two Years
body: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk, through its operational entities, has entered into a Gold Sales & Purchase Agreement (GSPA) with PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, securing market absorption for approximately 3 metric tons of gold annually, totaling 6 metric tons over the two-year contract with an option for an additional 3 metric tons per year. This collaboration ensures production continuity for Merdeka Group's gold from the Tujuh Bukit and Pani Gold Mines, with initial pure gold sales targeted before the end of March 2026, while strengthening PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's domestic gold supply chain.

title: Bank Mandiri Reports Rp 8.9 Trillion Net Profit, Up 16.7% YoY, Driven by Digital Banking Growth
body: Bank Mandiri posted a net profit of Rp 8.9 trillion ($527.18 million) in February 2026, up 16.7% year‑on‑year, fueled by a 28% rise in Livin’ by Mandiri transactions and a 45.3% jump in revenue from the platform. The bank also improved its cost‑to‑income ratio to 37.21% and saw total loans grow 15.7% to Rp 1,513.1 trillion.

title: Bank Indonesia Suspends Multiple Payment Systems During Eid al-Fitr Holiday
body: Bank Indonesia will suspend several payment and monetary operation systems from March 18 to March 24 during the Eid al-Fitr holiday, while keeping its instant payment service BI-FAST running to ensure real‑time fund transfers. The suspension includes BI-RTGS, BI-SSSS, BI-ETP, and the National Clearing System, with normal operations resuming on March 25.

title: Indonesia Allocates Rp381.3 Trillion to Energy Subsidies for Pertamina and PLN Amid Rising Oil Prices
body: Indonesia’s 2026 state budget earmarks Rp381.3 trillion ($22.5 billion) for energy subsidies and compensation payments to state‑owned energy companies Pertamina and PLN, as the government monitors rising global oil prices. The allocation is based on an assumed $70 per barrel crude price and a Rp16,500 per dollar exchange rate, with reserves covering about 20 days of supply.

title: Indonesia to Accelerate Bioethanol Blending in Gasoline Amid Rising Oil Prices
body: Indonesia will introduce mandatory E20 gasoline blending by 2028, potentially earlier, and may accelerate a B50 biodiesel mandate to reduce fossil fuel dependence as oil prices climb above $118 per barrel.

title: Indonesia Keeps Subsidized Fuel Prices Steady Amid Global Oil Surge
body: Indonesia will not raise subsidized fuel prices through the Eid holiday period despite crude prices exceeding $100 per barrel, as the government monitors geopolitical tensions and plans measures to shield consumers.

title: Sentratama Niaga Indonesia, PT sell Shares of PT Wilmar Cahaya Indonesia Tbk.
body: Sentratama Niaga Indonesia, PT sold 3,000 shares of PT Wilmar Cahaya Indonesia Tbk. on 10 March 2026 for IDR 2,370 per share, reducing its holding from 511,821,000 to 511,818,000 shares. The transaction was a sale of a small portion of shares, indicating a minor portfolio adjustment without affecting overall ownership control.

title: PT Lintas Benua sell Shares of PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk
body: PT Lintas Benua sold 3,220,000 shares of PT Mora Telematika Indonesia Tbk at IDR 473.0 per share. The transaction reduced its holding from 568,252,587 to 565,032,587 shares, a decrease of 3,220,000 shares. The sale was conducted to meet cash requirements, allowing the shareholder to raise liquidity while maintaining a substantial stake in the company.

title: OJK Tightens Supervision on IPO Fund Usage and Plans Further Strengthening for Securities and Investment Management Companies
body: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) will require companies conducting Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) to place proceeds in a special account for monitoring, as part of new governance strengthening measures. OJK also plans to issue additional provisions to strengthen securities companies and Manajer Investasi.

title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia Urges Review of Special Monitoring Board Rules
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) has called for a reassessment of its Special Monitoring Board (PPK) regulations, arguing that the current rules are overly rigid and restrict investor activity. BEI seeks to modify the PPK to prevent unfair price formation while maintaining market oversight.

title: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk Reports Stronger Q4 2025 Performance Amidst Market Volatility
body: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk recorded stronger performance in Q4 2025, with revenue reaching $512 million, sales volume increasing to 6.8 million tons, and an average selling price of $75 per ton. Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia noted the company's cost discipline and operational efficiency helped maintain profitability despite declining commodity prices, positioning commodity stocks like PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, PT Bukit Asam Tbk, and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk as potential market supports amidst ongoing domestic stock market volatility.

title: PT Astra International Tbk's 2026 Performance Expected to Remain Moderate but Solid Amidst Diversified Business Model
body: PT Astra International Tbk is projected to have moderate but relatively solid performance in 2026, supported by its diversified business model spanning automotive, financial services, heavy equipment, mining, and infrastructure sectors. The company reported a 2025 revenue of Rp 323.39 trillion and a net profit of Rp 32.76 trillion, with an analyst recommending a "wait and see" stance despite attractive valuation metrics.

title: Pefindo Revises PT Adhi Karya Tbk Rating to CreditWatch Negative Amid Liquidity Risks
body: Pefindo downgraded PT Adhi Karya Tbk’s idA- rating to CreditWatch with a negative outlook, citing rising liquidity risk and the company’s failure to secure approval from PUB III bondholders to waive financial covenant limits. The rating agency expects the company to undergo a remediation period until the end of June 2026, with the possibility of accelerated bond repayments if covenant breaches persist.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk Projects 2026 Revenue of US$379 Million Amid Gold Price Upswing
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) is forecast to generate US$379 million in revenue and US$127 million in net income in 2026, driven by a strong global gold price and a planned expansion of its processing capacity to 2,000 ton per day by October 2026. Analysts recommend a neutral stance with a target price of Rp 1,200 per share, while another broker suggests a buy with a target of Rp 1,300 per share.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk, and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk report 2025 earnings decline amid falling commodity prices
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk, and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk all reported 2025 earnings declines, with revenues falling 10.10%, 15.70%, and 7.71% respectively and net incomes dropping 67.56%, 37.89%, and 37.22% YoY to US$447.69 million, US$271.21 million, and US$760.18 million. Analysts say a rebound in global coal prices could lift margins in 2026, while PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk’s aluminium downstream projects may also boost profitability if aluminium prices rise.

title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) Launches 5G FWA, Sees Strong Revenue Growth and Receives Buy Recommendation
body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) has launched its 5G Fixed Wireless Access service IRA – Internet Rakyat, and reported net revenue of Rp 1.01 trillion for Q3 2025, up 100.99% YoY, with net profit of Rp 260.09 billion, up 71.03% YoY. Analysts recommend buying WIFI shares with a target price of Rp 5,200 per share.

title: Broker Target Prices Announced for AMMN, BBYBR, NCKL, BRMS, INDY, and ARCI as Market Strengthens
body: Broker analysts at MNC Sekuritas and BRI Danareksa have issued buy recommendations for AMMN, BBYBR, NCKL, BRMS, INDY, and ARCI, setting target prices of Rp 6,125–6,425; Rp 326–356; Rp 1,400–1,445; Rp 820–850; Rp 4,200–4,350; and Rp 1,845–2,000 respectively. The recommendations come as the Indonesian composite index (IHSG) is poised to test a resistance level of 7,500 after a recent rally, amid optimism from falling oil prices and easing Middle East tensions.

title: Analysts Review Sido Muncul, Telkom Indonesia, and Jasa Marga Stocks
body: Sido Muncul (SIDO) closed 0.98% lower at Rp 505, with analysts targeting a rebound to Rp 540. Telkom Indonesia (TLKM) fell 4.52% to Rp 2,960, eyeing support at Rp 2,850 before a potential rally to Rp 3,260, while Jasa Marga (JSMR) gained 2.91% to Rp 3,180, remaining in a bearish trend with short‑term support at Rp 3,060–3,090 and resistance at Rp 3,280–3,340.

title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) Posts 2025 Revenue of Rp 323.39 Trillion and Net Profit of Rp 32.76 Trillion; Analysts Forecast 2026 Recovery
body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reported revenue of Rp 323.39 trillion and net profit of Rp 32.76 trillion in 2025, a decline of 1.5% and 3.33% YoY, respectively. Analysts anticipate a 2026 rebound driven by commodity price recovery and automotive diversification, with a fair‑value estimate of Rp 6,850 per share and a "wait and see" recommendation.

title: PT Astra International Tbk's 2026 Outlook Boosted by EV Incentive Cut and Mining Sector Recovery
body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) is expected to improve in 2026 as the stop of EV incentives is likely to lift demand for its ICE and hybrid vehicles, while a rebound in the mining sector could boost earnings from its subsidiaries PT United Tractors Tbk and PT Astra Agro Lestari Tbk. ASII posted a 1.5% revenue decline to 323.39 trillion IDR and a 3.33% net profit decline to 32.76 trillion IDR in 2025, and the broker recommends buying the stock at a target price of 7,200 IDR.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk Sees Stock Recovery and Production Expansion Amid Rising Gold Prices
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk shares rebounded 13.25% to Rp 855 after a month of weakness, driven by a 13% jump in gold prices and expectations of higher production from its Poboya mine and planned expansion of its processing plant. Analysts project 2026 revenue of US$ 379 million and net income of US$ 127 million, with 2026 gold output of 80 000 oz and 2028 output of 161 000 oz, while a US$ 150 million capex supports the growth and target prices range from Rp 965 to Rp 1,300.

title: Granada Global Industri Divests 54.91 Million Shares of Raja Roti Cemerlang for Rp5.55 Billion
body: Granada Global Industri sold 54,913,750 shares of Raja Roti Cemerlang across three transactions between February 23 and March 2, 2026, generating approximately Rp5.55 billion. This divestment reduced Granada Global Industri's stake in Raja Roti Cemerlang from 8.31 percent (82.66 million shares) to 2.81 percent (27.75 million shares) to fulfill obligations.

title: Arini Saraswaty Subianto Buy Shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk
body: Arini Saraswaty Subianto purchased a total of 650,000 shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk, increasing her stake from zero to 650,000 shares (an addition of 650,000). The purchases were made on 23 Feb 2026 (330,000 shares at IDR 1,510 per share) and 2 Mar 2026 (320,000 shares at IDR 1,565 per share), reflecting an investment purpose. This transaction marks her initial entry into the company’s shareholder register.

title: George Oetomo buy Shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk
body: On 10 March 2026, shareholder George Oetomo purchased 500,000 shares of PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk at IDR 1,640 per share for investment purposes. His holding increased from 54,431,100 to 54,931,100 shares, a net rise of 500,000 shares, indicating a modest boost in insider confidence and potential support for the company's growth strategy.

title: Jason Laurence Greive sell Shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
body: On 9 March 2026, shareholder Jason Laurence Greive sold 37,000 shares of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk at IDR 3,620 per share, a divestment transaction. His holding decreased from 483,200 to 446,200 shares, a reduction of 37,000 shares, reflecting a lower ownership stake in the company.

title: Gema Lintas Benua sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: Gema Lintas Benua sold 7,352,000 shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk on 10 March 2026 at IDR 413 per share, citing cash requirements. The shareholder's holding decreased from 562,321,087 to 554,969,087 shares, a reduction of 7,352,000 shares. The transaction represents a modest dilution of Gema Lintas Benua's stake in the company, potentially affecting its voting power and signaling a need for liquidity.
