No other parties were involved, and the sale was executed through the regular market.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 9 March 2026, shareholder Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased 604,300 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares for investment, with transactions recorded at prices around IDR 1,260 per share. His holding rose from 217,694,622 to 218,298,922 shares, a net increase of 604,300 shares. The filing, timestamped 11 March 2026, reflects a direct buy that modestly expands his stake in the company.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 6 March 2026, investor Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased 1,357,100 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares at a representative price of IDR 1,360 per share for investment purposes. The transaction raised his holding from 216,337,522 to 217,694,622 shares, a net increase of 1,357,100 shares, reflecting a modest but notable stake expansion and signaling confidence in the company's prospects.

title: Gema Lintas Benua sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: Gema Lintas Benua sold 2,711,500 shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR.JK) on 2026-03-09 at IDR 414 per share to meet cash requirements. The shareholder's holding decreased from 565,032,587 to 562,321,087 shares, a reduction of 2,711,500 shares, representing a modest change in ownership while providing liquidity for the seller.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Shareholder Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased an additional 1,341,800 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares on 10 March 2026, raising his holding from 218,298,922 to 219,640,722 shares. The buy, executed at roughly IDR 1,440 per share for an investment purpose, represents a modest but notable increase in his stake, signaling confidence in the cybersecurity firm.

title: Catur Dermawan buy Shares of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk
body: Individual investor Catur Dermawan purchased a total of 19,000 shares of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS.JK) on 11 March 2026 at approximately IDR 1,960 per share, raising his holding from 1,000 to 20,000 shares, a net increase of 19,000 shares. The transaction is a buy for investment purposes, substantially expanding his stake in the company and indicating confidence in its future performance.

title: PT MNC Tourism Indonesia Tbk experiences largest share sell‑off as PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk sees biggest stake increase
body: On March 9, PT MNC Sekuritas sold 543.80 million shares of PT MNC Tourism Indonesia Tbk, reducing its holding to 6.91%. Meanwhile, PT Henan Putihrai Asset Management bought 24.14 million shares of PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk, raising its stake to 10.7%.

title: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk advances end of IDR 750 billion share buyback to 11 March 2026
body: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) announced that its share buyback programme, originally set to run until 3 May 2026, will now conclude on 11 March 2026, with up to IDR 750 billion allocated from internal cash. The stock rose 0.78% to IDR 1,285 after the disclosure, though it remains down 3.38% over the past five days and 43.89% year‑to‑date.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk reports $27.5 million net loss for 2025 as revenue plunges 92%
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk posted a net loss of US$27.49 million in 2025, with revenue falling 92.46% year‑on‑year to US$131.96 million. Total assets grew 39.82% to US$740.63 million while cash and bank at its subsidiary PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk declined 32.71% to US$45.30 million.

title: TikTok, Tokopedia and TikTok Shop report multi‑fold transaction growth during Ramadan 2026 campaign
body: TikTok, Tokopedia and TikTok Shop launched the Ramadan Ekstra Seru 2026 campaign, generating over 13 million short videos in the first week and more than 3.4 million live‑shopping views. The collaboration lifted average transaction volumes on Tokopedia and TikTok Shop by more than five times, with brands such as Mukena Wisanggeni seeing a >2× increase and Gwenza a 7× rise, while Tokopedia’s zakat collection topped Rp5.6 billion.

title: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk reports 2025 net profit of Rp6.61 trillion, down 0.55% YoY
body: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk posted a 2025 net profit of Rp6.61 trillion, a 0.55% decline from the prior year, as net sales fell 4.84% to Rp112.17 trillion. Despite the sales drop, gross profit rose 11.24% to Rp20.62 trillion, while total assets slipped 5.03% to Rp51.56 trillion and liabilities fell 10.5% to Rp23.21 trillion.

title: PT Permodalan Nasional Madani expands ultra‑micro women’s financing, reaching 22.9 million clients
body: PT Permodalan Nasional Madani reported that its PNM Mekaar program now serves over 22.9 million women borrowers across 909 thousand groups in 36 provinces, 451 regencies and 6,165 districts. The initiative, integrated with BRI and Pegadaian, aims to generate a multiplier effect on family and community economies.

title: PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk plans up to 10.68 billion-share rights issue
body: PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk announced a third rights issue (PMHMETD III) to issue up to 10,678,365,882 new shares, with warrants up to 35% of the issue, pending shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 17 April 2026. Proceeds are earmarked for acquisitions and capital expenditures to expand its premium chocolate and cocoa business.

title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk sees Gojek ODS unit's 2025 operating profit surge 1,180% to Rp888.62 bn
body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk reported that its Gojek on‑demand services unit generated operating profit of Rp888.62 billion in 2025, a 1,180% increase from 2024, with net revenue of Rp12.60 trillion, up 16% YoY. Adjusted EBITDA rose to Rp1.39 trillion (105% YoY) and Q4 adjusted EBITDA to Rp415 billion (55% YoY), while delivery and mobility revenues reached Rp9.46 trillion and Rp3.13 trillion respectively.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk announces up to Rp4 trillion share buyback
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk plans a share repurchase program of up to Rp4 trillion, to be approved at its annual shareholders meeting on 17 April 2026 and executed within 12 months starting 20 April 2026. The buyback could reduce the company’s assets and equity by the same amount and would represent roughly 2 % of its total paid‑up capital, following previous repurchases of 33 million shares in 2025 and 556.19 million shares through February 2026.

title: BBCA, BBRI, BUMI, DEWA, and TINS face selling pressure as IHSG eyes further correction
body: BNI Sekuritas reported that foreign investors sold roughly Rp730 billion of Indonesian equities on March 12, 2026, with the biggest‑cap stocks BBCA, BBRI, BUMI, DEWA and TINS among the primary sell‑off targets. The broker warned the Jakarta Composite Index could continue correcting, with support expected between 7,180 and 7,300 and resistance near 7,450‑7,500.

title: BBCA and ASII trade at discount valuations amid foreign outflows
body: Amid a market correction driven by foreign fund outflows of Rp8.80 trillion YTD, large‑cap Indonesian stocks such as BBCA (PE 14.73 vs 5‑year avg 20.68) and ASII (PE 7.23, ROE >7%) are considered discounted, while analysts also flag UNVR and MNCN as value traps. The recommended accumulation picks are BMRI, BBRI, BBCA, INDF and ASII, with trading ideas for ADRO, UNTR, LSIP, AKRA and CTRA, and a wait‑and‑see stance on UNVR and MNCN.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia unveils eight‑action integrity reform roadmap following MSCI’s temporary freeze
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia announced an eight‑action plan grouped into five clusters—integration, granular data, liquidity, transparency, and accountability—to strengthen market integrity after MSCI Inc. froze Indonesia’s rebalancing. The plan includes raising the minimum free‑float requirement to 15% and mandating disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners for shareholders above 1%.

title: PT Bareksa Portal Investasi plans to add up to five US‑dollar‑denominated mutual funds this year
body: PT Bareksa Portal Investasi said it will introduce as many as five new US‑dollar‑denominated mutual fund products in 2026, focusing on both equity and mixed‑asset funds. It cited the Eastspring Syariah Equity Islamic Asia Pacific USD fund, up 5.82% YTD at US$1.71 per unit, and the Syariah Mandiri Global Sharia Equity Dollar fund, up 1.22% YTD at the same price, as examples of the dollar‑based offerings it intends to expand.

title: Port Fraser International Ltd Sell Shares of Bakrie & Brothers Tbk
body: Port Fraser International Ltd sold 806,454,000 shares of Bakrie & Brothers Tbk on 2026-03-10 for IDR 155.0 per share, reducing its holding from 39,664,231,917 to 38,857,777,917 shares (a decrease of 806,454,000). The divestment, part of a portfolio adjustment, generated about IDR 125,000,370,000 in proceeds. This transaction lessens Port Fraser’s influence and may affect the company’s ownership structure.

title: PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk flagged for Unusual Market Activity as shares fall 38.6% in a month
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange placed PT Paperocks Indonesia Tbk under Unusual Market Activity monitoring on 12 March 2026 after the stock dropped 38.6% over the past month and is down 42.3% year‑to‑date. BEI warned investors to watch the company's disclosures and any pending corporate actions.

title: PT Blue Bird Tbk Shares Rise 1.49% to Rp 1,700 on March 11, 2026
body: PT Blue Bird Tbk shares climbed 1.49% to Rp 1,700 on March 11, 2026, after reporting 9‑month net sales of Rp 4.11 trillion and net profit of Rp 482.59 billion, up from Rp 3.66 trillion and Rp 436.3 billion respectively. The company’s market cap stands at Rp 4.35 trillion with a PBV of 0.70 and a PER of 6.61, and CGS International Sekuritas recommends a buy with support at Rp 1,670 and potential upside to Rp 1,730‑1,760.

title: Broker CGS International recommends trading in INCO, SCMA, UNVR, TLKM, GOTO, and BIRD amid market weakness
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia recommends trading in INCO, SCMA, UNVR, TLKM, GOTO, and BIRD as the IHSG is expected to weaken with support at 7,300‑7,210 and resistance at 7,480‑7,570, while WTI crude rose over 4% to $87.25 and Brent to $91.98 per barrel.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk Experiences Foreign Net Sell Amidst Stock Fluctuations, Prepares for RUPST and Dividend Announcement
body: Shares of PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk closed up 0.56% to Rp 3,580 on March 11, 2026, but foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 80.38 billion, contributing to a Rp 1.28 trillion net sell from March 3-11, 2026, and a 5.29% decline over the last month. The company will hold its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders on April 10, 2026, with a predicted final dividend of Rp 187 per share, an 85% ratio, and a 5.1% yield.

title: Foreign Investors Net Sell Shares of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bumi Resources Tbk, and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk on March 11, 2026
body: On March 11, 2026, foreign investors net sold shares of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (Rp 261.9 billion), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (Rp 137.2 billion), PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (Rp 80.3 billion), PT Darma Henwa Tbk (Rp 73.2 billion), PT Timah Tbk (Rp 60.1 billion), PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (Rp 59.3 billion), PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (Rp 46.2 billion), PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (Rp 44.5 billion), PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper bk (Rp 37.2 billion), and PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk (Rp 27.1 billion), contributing to a 0.69% decline in the IHSG to 7,389.4.

title: Foreign Investors Net Buy PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, Leading the Top 10 Net Buy List on 11 March 2026
body: Foreign investors net bought shares of PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (Rp 160.5 billion), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (Rp 39.6 billion), PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (Rp 30.9 billion), PT MD Entertainment Tbk (Rp 22.6 billion), PT United Tractors Tbk (Rp 19.6 billion), PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (Rp 19.1 billion), PT Bukit Asam Tbk (Rp 19.05 billion), PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (Rp 17.6 billion), PT Barito Pacific Tbk (Rp 16.3 billion), and PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk (Rp 15.7 billion). The net purchases totaled Rp 938.6 billion in the regulated market, while the IHSG fell 51.51 points to 7,389.4 and total market turnover reached Rp 15.05 trillion.

title: KB Valbury Sekuritas Targets PT Bank Central Asia Tbk at Rp 6,950
body: KB Valbury Sekuritas recommends buying PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, setting a target price of Rp 6,950 with an entry range of Rp 6,775‑6,825 and a stop‑loss at Rp 6,600. The stock closed at Rp 6,825, down 2.1% on the day, 0.7% over the week, 8.7% over the month, and 15.4% YTD.

title: Pertamina to Expand Refinery Capacity Under Indonesia’s B50 Biodiesel Policy
body: Pertamina’s Refinery Development Master Plan in East Kalimantan aims to boost diesel‑biodiesel blending capacity as Indonesia’s B50 program is projected to raise CPO demand to about 16 million tons per year, up from 12 million tons under B40. The move is part of a broader effort to strengthen energy resilience while managing the impact on palm‑oil exports and state revenue.

title: US Launches Trade Probe into Indonesia Over Structural Excess Capacity
body: The U.S. Trade Representative has opened a Section 301 investigation into Indonesia, citing the country’s $31 billion global goods trade surplus in 2024 and a $56.15 billion surplus with the U.S. by November 2025. The probe focuses on Indonesia’s cement industry, which faces permanent oversupply due to a significant imbalance between production and capacity.

title: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority Targets Rp 25 Quadrillion Capital Market by 2031
body: Indonesia’s Financial Services Authority (OJK) aims to expand the country's capital markets, targeting a total market capitalization of Rp 25 quadrillion ($1.5 trillion) by 2031, equivalent to 80% of national GDP. This plan includes raising the minimum free float requirement to at least 15%, increasing capital market investors to 30 million, and boosting the average daily transaction value to Rp 35 trillion ($2 billion) by 2031.

title: OJK Sets Target for Indonesia’s Market Capitalization to Reach Rp25 Trillion by 2031
body: OJK, led by Hasan Fawzi, has set a target for Indonesia’s market capitalization to reach Rp25 trillion (about 80% of GDP) by 2031, alongside a goal of 30 million investors and an average daily transaction volume of Rp35 trillion. The regulator also plans to raise the minimum free float to 15% and strengthen market integrity through eight reform initiatives.

title: Friderica Widyasari Dewi Confirmed as Chair of Financial Services Authority
body: Friderica Widyasari Dewi was confirmed as the definitive chair of the Financial Services Authority by Indonesia’s House of Representatives, following the resignation of previous officials on January 30 amid transparency concerns. She outlined priorities including strengthening integrated supervision, building an early-warning system for fraud, and enhancing risk management and cybersecurity within the regulator.

title: Indonesia Considers Raising Biodiesel Mandate to B60 Amid Palm Oil Output Concerns
body: Indonesia’s government is evaluating a move to raise the mandatory biodiesel blend from B40 to B50 or B60, citing high oil prices and the need for increased crude palm oil production. The policy shift could require an additional 16 million tons of CPO, potentially impacting export revenues and the country’s biodiesel subsidy budget.

title: GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Reports 77% Reduction in Net Loss and Strong 2025 Revenue Growth
body: GoTo Gojek Tokopedia posted net revenue of Rp 18.32 trillion in 2025, up 15.27%, while its net loss narrowed to Rp 1.18 trillion from Rp 5.15 trillion, driven by a 49% rise in core GTV and adjusted EBITDA of Rp 2 trillion. Management targets adjusted EBITDA of Rp 3.2‑3.4 trillion in 2026 and a net profit of Rp 1.2 trillion, with Macquarie maintaining an outperform rating and a target price of Rp 90.

title: Gapki Reports 50% Rise in Transport and Insurance Costs for Indonesian Palm Oil Exports Amid Iran War
body: Gapki said transport and insurance costs for Indonesian palm oil exports have risen 50% due to the Iran war, even as the country shipped 1.8 million tons last year to buyers such as Saudi Arabia (651,000 tons), the United Arab Emirates (475,000 tons) and Oman (219,000 tons). Exports to the UAE and Iran have ground to a halt, and Indonesia has maintained a positive trade balance for 69 consecutive months since May 2020.

title: Antam Gold Prices Surge to Rp 3,087,000 per Gram Amid Strong Rally
body: Antam’s gold price climbed to Rp 3,087,000 per gram, up from Rp 3,047,000 the day before, while its buyback price rose to Rp 2,847,000 per gram. The company’s gold has gained roughly 24% year‑to‑date, approaching its all‑time high of Rp 3,168,000 per gram.

title: PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk to lease solar power plants for up to Rp 1.25 trillion
body: PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk has entered into a master lease agreement with PT Akartha Energi Baru for solar power plants on its subsidiary plantations, with a total transaction value ranging from Rp 750 billion to Rp 1.25 trillion and a 10‑year operating term. The lease rate is set at Rp 1.5–2.5 per kVA per hour, and the deal is an affiliate transaction controlled by Wishnu Wardhana and family.

title: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk Reports 2025 Results: Net Sales Down 4.84% YoY
body: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk (HMSP) reported 2025 net sales of Rp 112.17 trillion, a 4.84% decline year‑on‑year, while gross profit rose to Rp 20.62 trillion and net income fell slightly to Rp 6.6 trillion, down 0.54% YoY. Total assets stood at Rp 51.56 trillion, liabilities at Rp 23.21 trillion, and equity at Rp 28.35 trillion.

title: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk Targets 4% Growth in Gas Distribution to 877 BBTUD by 2026
body: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGN) plans to grow its gas distribution by 4%, reaching approximately 877 BBTUD, by expanding infrastructure such as the Pipa Cikampek‑Plumpang pipeline and LNG Hub & Storage Arun. The company also aims to strengthen operations and broaden LNG and gas‑home‑network services across Indonesia as part of its 2026 strategy.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk Announces Up to Rp 4 Trillion Share Buyback Plan
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) plans a share buyback of up to Rp 4 trillion, not exceeding 10% of its paid‑in capital. The plan will be approved at a special shareholders meeting on 17 April 2026 and executed from 20 April 2026, with purchases made through BEI over a maximum of 12 months.

title: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk Announces 1:25 Stock Split to Increase Share Liquidity
body: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA) approved a 1:25 stock split, expanding its shares from 7,705,523,200 to 192,638,080,000, with the new shares trading from 7 April 2026. The split aims to make DSSA shares more affordable and broaden investor access without altering voting rights or economic value.

title: Bareksa Welcomes OJK's Gold ETF Regulation and Discusses Distribution Partnerships with Manajer Investasi
body: Bareksa has positively received Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK)'s new regulation, POJK Nomor 2 Tahun 2026, concerning gold-based Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs). Chief Operating Officer Ni Putu Kurniasari stated that several Manajer Investasi are already discussing distribution cooperation with Bareksa to market gold ETF products through its platform, leveraging Bareksa's existing experience in the gold investment ecosystem.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk to Pay Cash Dividend of Rp 349.41 per Share, Yielding 8.14%
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk will distribute a cash dividend of Rp 349.41 per share, translating to an estimated yield of 8.14%. The cum‑date is 17 March 2026, with payment scheduled for 7 April 2026, and the total dividend amounts to Rp 13.03 trillion, representing 65% of the 2025 consolidated net profit of Rp 20.04 trillion.

title: PT Centratama Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk. Secures USD50 Million Incremental Loan Facility
body: PT Centratama Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk. (CENT), along with its subsidiaries PT Centratama Menara Indonesia, PT Network Quality Indonesia, and PT MAC Sarana Djaya, obtained an incremental loan facility of USD50 million (Rp844,875 billion) on March 9, 2026. This funding, provided by Natixis Singapore Branch and ING Bank N.V. Singapore Branch, will be used for non-speculative capital expenditure and related facility costs, constituting a material transaction exceeding 20 percent of the company's equity.

title: Dewi Shri Farmindo Finalizes Acquisition of 15,000‑Head Chicken Slaughterhouse Facility
body: Dewi Shri Farmindo (DEWI) has entered the final stage of acquiring a 1.5‑hectare chicken slaughterhouse (RPA) in Cikarang that can process up to 15,000 chickens per day, aiming to boost its downstream integration and add 10‑20% value to its products. The move will also support the company’s plan to build a frozen‑food processing plant and expand its processed poultry portfolio.

title: Goto Group Reports 2025 Net Loss of Rp1.18 Trillion, Down 77% from 2024
body: Goto Group posted a net loss of Rp1.18 trillion for 2025, a 77% decline from the Rp5.15 trillion loss in 2024, while its net income rose 15% to Rp18.32 trillion. Operating loss fell 83% to Rp378.25 billion, and total equity dropped to Rp28.71 trillion from Rp30.4 trillion.

title: Pelayaran Ekalya to Pay Rp126 billion Dividend for 2025
body: Pelayaran Ekalya will distribute a cash dividend of Rp126 billion, representing 60.24% of its 2025 net profit of Rp209.19 billion, at Rp17 per share. The dividend will be paid on 7 April 2026 following the 9 March 2026 RUPS, with ex‑dividend dates on 25 March and 27 March.

title: Mandiri Herindo's 2025 Net Profit Decreases 18% Despite Revenue Growth
body: Mandiri Herindo recorded a net profit of Rp242.52 billion in 2025, an 18% decline from Rp296.71 billion in the previous year, leading to a drop in earnings per share to Rp14.78. This occurred despite a 14.96% increase in revenue to Rp2.92 trillion and a rise in gross profit to Rp588.81 billion.

title: Alamtri Indonesia to buy back shares worth Rp4 trillion over 12 months
body: Alamtri Indonesia announced a share buyback program of Rp4 trillion to be executed over 12 months, beginning 20 April 2026 following approval at the 17 April 2026 annual general meeting. The company will fund the buyback entirely from internal cash, with the program ending when the allocated funds are exhausted or the purchase target is met.

title: Sarana Meditama Metropolitan, Tbk sell Shares of PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk
body: Sarana Meditama Metropolitan, Tbk sold a total of 14,284,746 shares of PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk at a representative price of IDR 885 per share. The transaction reduced its holding from 733,042,200 to 718,757,454 shares, a decline of 14,284,746 shares. The sale is intended to increase public share ownership, thereby lowering insider concentration and potentially enhancing market liquidity for the listed company.

title: PT Bank MNC Internasional Tbk schedules extraordinary shareholders meeting on 12 March 2026 as Q3 2025 net profit climbs 22% YoY
body: PT Bank MNC Internasional Tbk will hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on Thursday, 12 March 2026 to approve a change in its board composition. The bank reported net profit of Rp60.39 billion for the nine months ended September 2025, up 22.09% YoY, with credit growth of 2.20% to Rp11.08 trillion and a NIM decline to 3.20%.

title: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk targets 5‑10% revenue growth and outlines Rp400 bn 2026 capex for expansion
body: PT Indonesian Paradise Property Tbk said it aims for 5%‑10% revenue growth this year, building on a 7.7% YoY increase in its property segment that contributed Rp457.1 billion in Q3 2025. The firm allocated Rp400 billion in capex for 2026, with 78% earmarked for expansion—including the Plaza 88 project in Balikpapan—and targets recurring income to represent 75% of total revenue by 2026.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk posts 105% rise in net loss for 2025 amid 92% revenue drop
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk reported a net loss of US$27.49 million for 2025, a 105% increase from the prior year, while revenue fell 92.45% to US$131,964 thousand (≈Rp2.19 billion) generated solely from equipment‑leasing to PT Merdeka Mining Servis. The company’s total liabilities rose to US$359.70 million, with equity at US$380.93 million and assets at US$740.63 million.

title: PT HM Sampoerna Tbk reports slight decline in 2025 net profit amid lower sales
body: PT HM Sampoerna Tbk posted a 0.55% drop in 2025 net profit to Rp6.60 trillion as net sales fell 4.84% to Rp112.17 trillion. Despite an 11.25% rise in gross profit to Rp20.62 trillion and higher operating cash flow of Rp7.41 trillion, higher SG&A and tax expenses limited earnings growth.

title: BPI Danantara reports 300% return on assets for 2025 and sets new investment targets
body: BPI Danantara said its return on assets jumped to 300% in 2025, far exceeding the 10% minimum target set by President Prabowo Subianto. The firm will tighten investment standards, allocating about 50% of capital to public‑equity and bond projects and aims to generate a 5% asset yield that could return roughly US$50 billion to the government.

title: Indonesia's parliament accelerates appointment of new OJK board to stabilize financial sector
body: Komisi XI DPR RI fast‑tracked the selection of the Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) board and extended the term to five years to give the market certainty amid volatility from the Middle‑East conflict. The move is intended to restore confidence in the regulator and protect investors, consumers and financial‑service firms.

title: PT Bank Jago Tbk reports 115% profit surge and strong asset growth in 2025
body: PT Bank Jago Tbk posted a net profit after tax of Rp276 billion for 2025, a 115% year‑on‑year increase, while credit disbursements rose 38% to Rp24.3 trillion and total assets grew 28% to Rp36.5 trillion. The bank’s non‑performing loan ratio fell to 0.6%, its customer base reached 18.2 million and deposits (DPK) climbed 38% to Rp25.9 trillion.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk shares rise 2.2% as analysts maintain buy rating and project earnings growth
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) climbed to Rp 6,975, up 2.20%, on strong buying and a CGS International forecast of net interest income of Rp 88.2 trillion and net profit of Rp 60.8 trillion for 2026. CGS kept a buy recommendation with a target price of Rp 10,000, implying a 46.5% upside from the current level.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk shares surge 6.38% as company announces up to Rp 4 trillion buyback
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) shares rose to Rp 2,500, up 6.38%, on Thursday after the company disclosed plans to repurchase up to Rp 4 trillion of its stock. The buyback, pending approval at the April 17, 2026 shareholders meeting, would add to the 589.2 million shares (2.0% of capital) already repurchased, with a net buy of Rp 76.3 billion reported and a transaction volume of 86.65 million shares worth Rp 213.32 billion.

title: Bumi Serpong Damai buys Shares of Duta Pertiwi Tbk
body: Bumi Serpong Damai purchased 130,061,267 shares of Duta Pertiwi Tbk at IDR 4,300 per share on 10 March 2026, raising its holding from 1,709,013,632 to 1,839,074,899 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, increases Bumi Serpong Damai’s ownership by roughly 7.6% and reflects confidence in the company’s prospects.

title: Avia Nusantara Khatulistiwa sell Shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
body: Avia Nusantara Khatulistiwa sold a total of 33,880,000 PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk shares between 24 Feb and 6 Mar 2026 at a representative price of IDR 200 per share, generating approximately IDR 6,776,000,000 in proceeds. The divestment reduced its holding from 230,015,300 shares to 196,135,300 shares, a decline of 33,880,000 shares. This sizable stake reduction may increase the free float and affect market liquidity for HELI.JK.

title: Sandra Angela buy Shares of PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Sandra Angela purchased additional shares of PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk. (CASH.JK) on 9‑10 March 2026, paying IDR 163 per share for 414,000 shares and IDR 180 per share for 2,454,300 shares, totaling an investment of IDR 36,891,000. Her holding rose from 54,392,400 shares to 91,283,400 shares, an increase of 36,891,000 shares, reflecting a significant boost in ownership for investment purposes.

title: Bunda Investama Indonesia sell Shares of PT Diagnos Laboratorium Utama Tbk
body: Bunda Investama Indonesia sold a total of 37,174,700 shares of PT Diagnos Laboratorium Utama Tbk on 9 Mar 2026 at approximately IDR 316 per share, reducing its stake from 485,000,000 to 447,825,300 shares. The divestment, executed as a series of sell orders, reflects a strategic reduction of exposure and may impact the company’s free float.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sold 1,280,800 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk at IDR 36 per share as a divestment. The shareholder's holding decreased from 3,563,995,000 to 3,562,714,200 shares, reflecting a modest reduction in its stake. The transaction, filed on 2026-03-12, signals a strategic exit of a portion of its investment in the company.

title: Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara buys Shares of PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk
body: On 9 March 2026, shareholder Noel Aelyo Laras Kusuma Negara purchased 4,863,000 PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk shares at IDR 850 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 76,275,700 to 81,138,700 shares, a net increase of 6.4% in stake. The transaction reflects a confidence in the company's prospects and modestly boosts the shareholder's influence in the listed firm.

title: Foreign investors net buy ADRO and net sell BBRI on March 12, 2026
body: On March 12, 2026 foreign investors recorded a net purchase of Rp209.72 billion in PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO), lifting the stock 6.38% to Rp2,500 per share. The same day they sold Rp153.55 billion of PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI), pushing the share down 0.28% to Rp3,570.

title: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk lifts its ownership in PT Duta Pertiwi Tbk to 99.41% as DUTI reports a 54% profit decline
body: PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk increased its stake in PT Duta Pertiwi Tbk to 99.41% by buying 130.06 billion shares for about IDR559.26 billion at IDR4,300 per share on 10 March 2026. PT Duta Pertiwi Tbk posted a 54.48% drop in 2025 profit to IDR623.59 billion, with revenue down 38.2% to IDR2.73 trillion and earnings per share falling to IDR228.14.

title: PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk announces up to Rp28.12 billion share buyback
body: PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk (KEJU) plans a share repurchase of up to Rp28.12 billion, targeting 50.68 million shares (about 0.9% of issued capital) and reducing its free‑float to roughly 9.3%. The cash‑funded buyback will lower total assets to about Rp1.22 trillion and equity to Rp816.96 billion, pending approval at a RUPSLB on 21 April 2026.

title: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk posts 2025 net profit of Rp3.14 trillion after turnaround
body: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk reported a 2025 net profit of Rp3.14 trillion, driven by a Rp2.37 trillion investment gain and a 45.96% rise in total revenue to Rp6.51 trillion. The company highlighted strong cash and liquid investments of Rp17.8 trillion, supporting its long‑term growth strategy.

title: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk posts Rp3.14 trillion net profit for 2025
body: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk recorded a net profit of Rp3.14 trillion for 2025, reversing a Rp1.54 trillion loss in 2024, on revenue of Rp6.51 trillion—a 45.96% year‑on‑year increase. The company’s cash and cash equivalents rose to Rp16.21 trillion and total assets to Rp26.03 trillion at year‑end.

title: Antam gold bar prices decline across all sizes on 13 March 2026
body: Antam’s official gold bar prices fell on 13 March 2026, with the 0.5‑gram bar priced at Rp1,560,500 (down Rp10,500) and the 1‑gram bar at Rp3,021,000 (down Rp21,000). Larger bars also dropped, reaching Rp2.96 billion for a 1,000‑gram bar, while the buyback rate slipped to Rp2,783,000 per gram.

title: PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk reports modest 2025 revenue growth and solid profitability
body: PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk posted 2025 revenue of Rp2.28 trillion, up 1.31% YoY, with net profit of Rp207 billion despite a 1.43% decline in gross profit. The company generated Rp424 billion of operating cash flow, invested over Rp165 billion in capex and expanded its network to 402 outlets across 34 provinces.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk expects profit in 2026 after first gold shipment from Pani mine
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk reported a 2025 net loss of US$27.49 million (up 116.47% YoY) with revenue of US$131 thousand, but on 27 February 2026 it delivered its first gold shipment to PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, marking the start of commercial output from the Pani mine. The company projects 2026 gold production of 100,000–115,000 ounces and expects a return to profitability in the 2026 fiscal year.

title: Antam, Galeri 24 and UBS gold buyback prices listed by Pegadaian on 13 March 2026
body: Pegadaian posted buyback rates for 0.5‑gram to 100‑gram gold from Antam, Galeri 24 and UBS on Friday, 13 March 2026, with Antam’s 0.5‑gram price at Rp1,436 000 and its 1‑gram price at Rp2,873 000, while Galeri 24’s 0.5‑gram price was Rp1,438 000 and its 1‑gram price Rp2,876 000, and UBS matched Antam’s rates at Rp1,436 000 and Rp2,873 000 respectively. The largest listed size was 1 000 grams for Antam at Rp2,845 351 000, with UBS not available at that size.

title: PT Leyand International Tbk sees shareholder base rise to 8,832 as new controller JSI Sinergi Mas launches mandatory tender offer
body: PT Leyand International Tbk reported its shareholder count rising to 8,832, an increase of 1,829 from the previous month, with the new controlling shareholder JSI Sinergi Mas now holding about 51% of the equity. The company is conducting a 30‑day mandatory tender offer at Rp51 per share for up to 1.65 billion shares (≈41.6% of total), representing a potential transaction value of roughly Rp84.2 billion, while also exploring a strategic acquisition in the mining‑contracting sector.

title: PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk plans at least 40% dividend payout after reporting 1.1 trillion rupiah profit in 2025
body: PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk said it will propose a minimum 40% payout of its 2025 net profit, which rose 3% to Rp1.1 trillion on revenue of Rp7.9 trillion, while operating cash flow jumped 70.2% to Rp1.3 trillion and gearing remained at 0.4x. The retailer also opened 272 new stores in 2025, exceeding its expansion target.

title: PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk reports 23% drop in 2025 net profit amid rising costs
body: PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk posted 2025 revenue of Rp2.28 trillion, up 1.31% YoY, while net profit fell 23.46% to Rp206.78 billion as cost of goods sold rose 5.42% to Rp948.96 billion. The company’s total assets decreased to Rp2.69 trillion and it recorded capex of Rp165 billion for infrastructure and digital upgrades.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk confirms acquisitions of Wolfarm Limited and Jubilee Metals Limited and projects production start in 2026
body: PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) completed its 100% acquisition of Wolfarm Limited for Rp698.98 billion (≈US$63.5 million) and its 64.98% stake in Jubilee Metals Limited for Rp346.93 billion (≈US$31.5 million). BUMI expects Wolfarm’s gold‑copper mine in Western Australia to begin operations within weeks with revenue contributions from 2026, while Jubilee’s Queensland gold operation is slated to start production in Q4 2026, supporting short‑term earnings despite global commodity price volatility.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) Advances Market‑Reform Agenda with 15% Free‑Float Target
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) is advancing its market‑reform agenda, setting a 15% free‑float requirement and opening >1% ownership data to the public. The exchange is coordinating with OJK and other SROs to restore market integrity after MSCI’s rebalancing freeze.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk shares drop 3.7% after unveiling new corporate logo
body: PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) shares fell 3.67% to Rp 210 in early trade on Friday, March 13, 2026, with 2.2 billion shares (Rp 467.83 billion) changing hands. The decline followed the company's launch of a new logo that signals a shift from a coal‑focused miner to a diversified natural‑resources group, while management said the rebranding does not affect its legal or corporate structure.

title: Citi raises target price for PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk on stronger nickel and gold outlook
body: Citi research upgrades PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk, citing an improving nickel business driven by subsidiary PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk and solid nickel prices, which leads to a higher target price. The firm also expects the gold segment, anchored by PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk's upcoming Pani Gold project, to help turn losses into net profit.

title: PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk shares suspended by BEI amid sharp price surge
body: BEI suspended trading of PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk on 13 March 2026 after the stock jumped 24.5% in the last session, 87.9% over the past month and 197.8% year‑to‑date. The exchange also lifted the suspension on PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk, allowing trading to resume from the opening session.

title: Maybank Sekuritas cuts PT Jasa Marga Tbk target price to Rp 4,500 amid higher capex expectations
body: Maybank Sekuritas maintains a buy rating on PT Jasa Marga Tbk but lowers its target price to Rp 4,500, citing higher FY26 capex and a higher debt profile; the stock fell 17.63% over the past month to Rp 3,130, trading at a PBV of 0.62 and a PER of 6.21. The toll operator posted FY25 revenue of Rp 19.8 trillion (+5.8% YoY) and EBITDA of Rp 13.3 trillion (+5.2% YoY) with a net profit of Rp 3.7 trillion, and Maybank projects a 5% revenue growth and a dividend yield around 4.7% for FY26.

title: Phintraco Sekuritas recommends PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk with target price 8,000
body: Phintraco Sekuritas named PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk a pick for Friday trading, setting a target price of 8,000 IDR, a sell‑on‑strength level of 8,200 IDR and a stop‑loss at 7,000 IDR. The stock closed at 7,575 IDR, up 4.48% on 9.78 million shares (72.8 billion IDR), with a 7.62% monthly decline, PBV of 1.79× and PER of 14.63×.

title: PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk suspension lifted, trading resumes on March 13, 2026
body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange announced that trading of PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk (TIRT) will resume from the start of the March 13, 2026 session after being suspended since March 2 due to a sharp price surge that saw the share climb from Rp 44 on November 25, 2025 to Rp 1,000 on February 27, 2026 (a 2,172% rise). The company, now focused on maritime transport, has fully deployed 20 tugboats and barges purchased through a 14‑asset deal signed on October 1, 2025.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk approves Rp 41.3 trillion cash dividend for 2025
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk announced a cash dividend of Rp 41.3 trillion for fiscal year 2025, equivalent to Rp 336 per share and a 72% payout ratio of its Rp 57.54 trillion net profit. The dividend comprises an interim payment of Rp 55 per share already paid on 22 December 2025 and a final payment of Rp 281 per share to be distributed to shareholders recorded at the AGM on 12 March 2026.

title: Foreign investors net buy PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk for Rp 209.7 billion on 12 March 2026
body: Foreign investors net bought PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk for Rp 209.7 billion, followed by PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (Rp 196.3 billion) and PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (Rp 194.9 billion) on 12 March 2026. Across the regulated market, foreign net purchases totaled Rp 905.2 billion, while the overall market net buy reached Rp 1 trillion, as the IHSG index closed 27.28 points lower at 7,362.1.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk Shares Decline Amid Net Sell Pressure Ahead of RUPST
body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk shares fell 0.28% to Rp 3,570 after a net sell of Rp 1.43 trillion in the period, with a 6.05% decline over the last month. The bank will hold its annual general meeting on 10 April, and Phintraco forecasts a final dividend of Rp 187 per share (85% payout, 5.1% yield) following an interim dividend of Rp 137 per share paid on 15 January.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk Targeted at Rp 225‑233 as Shares Drop 3.5% on New Logo Announcement
body: PT Bumi Resources Tbk’s shares fell 3.5% to Rp 218 on March 12, 2026, after a new logo launch, while CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia sets a near‑term target of Rp 225‑233 with support at Rp 209‑213. The stock has seen a 9.1% weekly decline, 19.8% monthly drop, and 40.4% YTD loss, yet attracted Rp 27.09 billion in foreign net buying.

title: Indonesia and Malaysia's Palm Oil Sector Sees Potential Demand Boost Amid Rising Crude Prices and B50 Biodiesel Revival
body: Rising crude oil prices have pushed palm oil prices to their highest in over a year, potentially boosting demand for Indonesia and Malaysia's output, which reached record highs in 2025. Indonesia, the world's largest user of palm oil-based biodiesel, may revive its B50 grade plan, while United Plantations Berhad is well-positioned to supply Asian buyers.

title: Indonesia's IHSG Weakens Amid Global Oil Price Volatility
body: The Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) fell 23.30 points to 7,338.82, while the LQ45 index dropped 2.74 points to 748.45, as traders anticipate a hawkish stance from the Fed amid rising oil prices triggered by the US‑Iran conflict. WTI crude traded at $95.54 and Brent at $100.41 per barrel, and Bank Indonesia has withdrawn 16 trillion rupiah from its surplus to support fiscal needs.

title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk Falls 7.69% as Indonesian Index Declines 1.81%
body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk fell 7.69% as the Indonesian Composite Index (IHSG) dropped 133,172 points to 7,228,945, marking a 1.81% decline. Meanwhile, PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk gained 4.79% and 2.21% respectively, while the transportation and logistics sector led the market’s 3.04% slide.

title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk reports 2025 adjusted EBITDA of Rp 2 trillion, beating target and posting net income growth
body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) posted adjusted EBITDA of Rp 2 trillion for 2025, exceeding its target range of Rp 1.8‑1.9 trillion, while net income rose 15.27% to Rp 18.32 trillion and operating loss fell 83.12% to Rp 378.25 billion. Analysts from OCBC Sekuritas, IndoPremier Sekuritas, Mandiri Sekuritas, Macquarie Sekuritas, Citi, Jefferies and UBS issued buy recommendations with an average target price of Rp 102 per share, and GOTO set a 2026 adjusted EBITDA target of Rp 3.2‑3.4 trillion.

title: PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk Confirms No Transfer of Meikarta Project for Low‑Income Housing, Land Valued at Rp 180 Billion
body: PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk (LPCK) clarified that it will not transfer the Meikarta project to the low‑income housing program, despite the government’s groundbreaking of 18 subsidised tower units on 30 ha of land donated by the group. The land, recorded at a book value of roughly Rp 180 billion in LPCK’s audited 2025 financials, will be developed with a target of 141,000 units, with handover scheduled for 8 Aug 2028.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's Antam Gold Prices Drop 21,000 IDR per Gram on March 13, 2026
body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's Antam gold bullion price fell 21,000 IDR per gram to Rp 3,021,000 on March 13, 2026, down from Rp 3,042,000 the day before. The buyback price also declined 21,000 IDR to Rp 2,783,000 per gram.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk Reports 2025 Net Loss of US$27.49 Million Amid Mine Construction, Eyes 2026 Production
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk recorded a net loss of US$27.49 million in 2025, after revenue fell 92.46% YoY to US$131,964 and operating loss surged 2,041% to US$9.63 million. The company expects a turnaround in 2026 with the first commercial gold production from Tambang Emas Pani and a potential recovery of profitability.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk Announces Record 72% Dividend Payout Ratio in 2026 RUPST
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) announced a 72% dividend payout ratio, paying Rp 336 per share and Rp 41.4 trillion in total, the highest ever for the bank. PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) followed with a 65% payout, Rp 349.41 per share and Rp 13.03 trillion total. Other banks—PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI), PT Bank Tabungan Negara Tbk (BBTN), and PT Bank Permata Tbk (BNLI)—also set dividend plans, with BBRI potentially exceeding Rp 49.14 trillion, BMRI around Rp 43.9 trillion, BBTN 25‑30% payout, and BNLI maintaining ~30% payout.

title: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk Plans Rights Issue to Raise Rp739.34 Billion
body: PT Pelayaran Nasional Ekalya Purnamasari Tbk has secured shareholder approval to issue 2.03 billion new shares at Rp350 each, potentially raising Rp739.34 billion. Other issuers—PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk, PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk, and PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk—are also awaiting approval for rights issues ranging from 86.7 billion to 10.67 billion shares, with proceeds earmarked for infrastructure, renewable energy, and expansion.

title: Moody's Keeps PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk at B3, Outlook Stable as 2025 Operating Cash Flow Remains Negative
body: Moody's Ratings maintains PT Lippo Karawaci Tbk’s Corporate Family Rating at B3 with a stable outlook, citing a projected negative operating cash flow of Rp 1.6 trillion in 2025 and a cash balance of Rp 1.9 trillion by year‑end. The agency expects the company’s debt‑to‑EBITDA ratio to fall to 6.5‑7.5× in 2026‑27 from 7.3× in 2025 as operating cash flow moves toward neutral in 2026 and improves to roughly Rp 500 billion in 2027.

title: Broker recommends several Indonesian stocks including PT Bank Central Asia Tbk amid market sideways
body: Phintraco Sekuritas and MNC Sekuritas recommend a basket of Indonesian stocks—PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk, PT Indosat Tbk, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk, PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk, PT Bukit Asam Tbk, and PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk—within specific price ranges (CPIN Rp 3,860–4,180, PTBA Rp 2,990–3,080, ULTJ Rp 1,665–1,720). The recommendations come as the IHSG is projected to trade sideways between 7,250 and 7,400 amid geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk Targeted for Up to Rp 850 Amid Rising Oil Prices
body: Rising WTI and Brent prices have spurred analysts to raise targets for oil‑field service firms. PT Elnusa Tbk is now a buy with a target of Rp 850–900, while PT Apexindo Pratama Duta Tbk and PT Radiant Utama Interinsco Tbk receive targets of Rp 200 and Rp 280 respectively. ELSA’s shares closed at Rp 745 on March 12, down 0.67%.

title: Foreign Investors Accumulate PT Bank Mandiri Tbk Shares Amid Market Correction
body: Foreign investors net‑bought PT Bank Mandiri Tbk shares worth Rp 1.7 trillion in the last month, the largest accumulation among blue‑chip stocks, while PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk, PT Astra International Tbk, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk and PT Indosat Tbk also saw significant net buys ranging from Rp 282 billion to Rp 955 billion. Analysts recommend buying these stocks, with target prices of Rp 6,200 for BMRI, Rp 4,000 for TLKM, Rp 7,450 for ASII, Rp 2,630 for ADRO and Rp 33,000 for UNTR.

title: ELPI Plans Rights Issue to Raise Rp739.34 Billion, While BNBR, TOBA, and COCO Also Prepare Similar Moves
body: ELPI will issue about 2.03 billion new shares at Rp350 each in a rights issue expected to raise Rp739.34 billion. PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk, PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk, and PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk are also preparing rights issues of 86.7 billion, 1.39 billion, and up to 10.67 billion shares respectively, with BNBR’s rights ratio 2:1 and COCO offering up to 35% warrants.

title: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk Reports Slight Decline in 2025 Net Profit Amid Sales Drop
body: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk’s net sales fell 4.84% to Rp 112.17 trillion in 2025, while net profit slipped 0.54% to Rp 6.6 trillion. Gross profit rose to Rp 20.62 trillion, and analysts project a two‑digit net profit growth for 2026 with a target price of Rp 850 per share, though risks include continued downtrading and higher distribution costs.

title: PT Jasnita Telekomindo Tbk Wins Contact Center Tender from Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
body: PT Jasnita Telekomindo Tbk has secured a contact center service contract with the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, beginning operations on 1 April. The deal is expected to generate revenue for the company in the first quarter of 2026, bolstering its growth trajectory.

title: PT Astra Sedaya Finance Prepares Rp1.53 Trillion Principal and Interest Payment for Obligasi Berkelanjutan VI
body: PT Astra Sedaya Finance has earmarked Rp1,526,875,005,000 for the fourth interest payment and principal repayment of its Obligasi Berkelanjutan VI, with Rp1.5 trillion due as principal and Rp26,875,005,000 as interest at a 6.45% annual rate. The company will deposit the funds to KSEI by 17 March 2026, with bondholders’ records set for 12 March and distribution on 25 March.

title: Nusantara Utama Investama sell Shares of PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk
body: Nusantara Utama Investama sold 139,250,000 shares of PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk on 11 March 2026 at IDR 1,600 per share, representing a divestment of roughly IDR 222.8 billion. The holding fell from 15,173,281,772 shares to 15,034,031,772 shares, a reduction of 0.92%. The transaction reflects the shareholder's strategic divestment and marginally alters the share distribution without affecting control of the company.

title: Pertamina Secures Energy Supply for Ramadan and Idulfitri 2026 with Expanded Distribution Network
body: Pertamina (Persero) has activated a nationwide Posko to ensure the availability of fuel and LPG during Ramadan and Idulfitri 2026, operating 125 BBM terminals, 7,885 SPBU, and 72 DPPU, while projecting gasoline demand to rise 12.0%, gasoil to fall 14.5%, avtur to increase 2.8%, and kerosene to climb 4.2%. The company also maintains LPG stock levels at 12‑15 days and deploys 40 LPG terminals, 757 SPBE, and 6,662 LPG agents to support high‑demand areas.

title: Avia Nusantara Khatulistiwa sell Shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
body: Avia Nusantara Khatulistiwa sold 133,258,000 shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk (HELI.JK) on 13 Mar 2026 at IDR 175 per share, reducing its stake from 196,135,300 to 62,877,300 shares (a decline of 133,258,000 shares). The divestment lowers the shareholder’s ownership proportion and signals a strategic exit from the company. The transaction represents a significant shift in the shareholding structure for the listed firm.

title: Hapsoro sell Shares of PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk
body: On 11 March 2026, shareholder Hapsoro sold 17,000,000 shares of PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk at IDR 1,600 per share, reducing its holding from 60,845,049 to 43,845,049 shares (a decline of 17,000,000 shares). The divestment purpose is stated as a strategic divestment, decreasing Hapsoro’s ownership stake and potentially impacting voting power and future capital structure of the listed company.

title: PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk reports 2025 revenue of Rp2.28 trillion, up 1.31% YoY
body: PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk posted 2025 revenue of Rp2.28 trillion, a 1.31% YoY increase, while net profit rose to Rp207 billion on a backdrop of Rp165 billion capex and expansion of its diagnostic network to 402 outlets. The company’s EBIT of Rp225 billion and EBT of Rp264 billion underscore its solid profitability amid rising cost of goods sold.

title: PT Bank Permata Tbk Reports Strong 2025 Performance with Net Profit of Rp3.6 Trillion
body: PT Bank Permata Tbk posted a net profit of Rp3.6 trillion for 2025, with revenue up 3.8% to Rp12.6 trillion and non‑interest income rising 34.1% to Rp2.6 trillion. The bank’s total assets grew 3.6% to Rp268.3 trillion, CASA increased 20.1% to 63.9%, and its capital ratios remained robust with a CAR of 34.6% and CET‑1 of 26.6%. The Syariah unit also recorded an 8.1% rise in operating profit to Rp785.3 billion.

title: Bumi Serpong Damai Raises Stake in Duta Pertiwi to 99.41% with Rp559.26 Billion Purchase
body: Bumi Serpong Damai increased its ownership of Duta Pertiwi to 99.41% by purchasing 130.06 million shares at Rp4,300 each, paying Rp559.26 billion—a 10.25% premium over the March 10 closing price of Rp3,900. The transaction leaves Duta Pertiwi’s free float at just 0.59% (≈9.96 million shares).

title: Lippo Cikarang Donates 30‑Ha Land to Danantara for Low‑Income Housing Project
body: Lippo Cikarang (LPCK) donated 30 ha of land, book value Rp180 billion, to Danantara for a low‑income housing program; Danantara will invest Rp14‑16 trillion to build 18 towers (141 k units) on 12.8 ha, with construction starting 17 August 2026 and handover 8 August 2028.

title: Plaza Indonesia Reports 35.9% Decline in Net Profit to Rp639.34 Billion for 2025
body: Plaza Indonesia (PLIN) posted a net profit of Rp639.34 billion for 2025, down 35.9% from Rp997.54 billion in the same period last year, while earnings per share fell to Rp180.82 from Rp282.13. Total sales reached Rp1.4 trillion, and gross profit rose to Rp959.77 billion, but operating expenses increased to Rp333.28 billion.

title: Olive Power Invest to Tender 31.06% of Oscar Mitra Sukses Sejahtera Shares at Rp35 per Share
body: Olive Power Invest has earmarked Rp20.65 billion to acquire 31.06% of Oscar Mitra Sukses Sejahtera shares, offering Rp35 per share—about 32.69% below the March 12 close of Rp52. The tender, announced March 12 and open from March 13 to April 11, aims to acquire up to 590 million shares, while OLIV shares have fallen 1.89% to Rp52 and 27.78% year‑to‑date.

title: PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia, Tbk Sees Service Volume and Revenue Surge Amid Strong Indonesian Auto Sales
body: PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia, Tbk reported a 22.1% rise in wholesales in February 2026 and a 12.2% year‑on‑year increase in February sales, reflecting robust demand for vehicle repairs. The company’s service volumes grew from 20,985 cars in 2023 to 28,336 in 2025, with revenue rising from 50 billion rupiah to 57.5 billion rupiah, and it forecasts a 30‑40% revenue jump for 2025, expecting a 10‑20% daily lift during the 2026 Lebaran period.

title: Rama Indonesia Acquires 59.24 Percent Stake in Dua Putra Utama Makmur
body: Rama Indonesia has agreed to acquire a 59.24 percent stake in Dua Putra Utama Makmur from Pandawa Putra Investama, with the binding sale and purchase agreement signed on March 10, 2026. Following the acquisition, Rama Indonesia will conduct a mandatory tender offer, and Dua Putra Utama Makmur confirmed the transaction will not negatively impact its operations or business continuity.

title: Thomas Junaidi Alim W buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Shareholder Thomas Junaidi Alim W purchased 100,000 Astra International Tbk (ASII.JK) shares at IDR 5,900 per share on 11 March 2026, raising his holding from 1,207,800 to 1,307,800 shares (an increase of 100,000). The transaction is classified as an investment, indicating confidence in the company’s outlook and modestly increasing the insider ownership percentage.

title: Bharat Shah Joshi buy Shares of PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk
body: On 11 March 2026, investor Bharat Shah Joshi purchased 4,000 shares of PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk at IDR 4,500 per share, investing approximately IDR 18,000,000. His holding increased from 0 to 4,000 shares, marking a new equity position. The transaction is classified as an investment, adding a new shareholder and potentially strengthening the company's capital base.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com sell Shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
body: On March 3, 2026, shareholder 1 Inti Dot Com sold 1,061,000 shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk at IDR 1,890 per share. The holding decreased from 78,978,300 to 77,917,300 shares, reducing its stake by roughly 1.34%. The transaction is reported as a revision of the Share Ownership Report originally filed on March 6, 2026 and is classified as an investment activity.

title: 1 Inti Dot Com sell Shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk
body: On 12 March 2026, shareholder 1 Inti Dot Com sold 275,800 shares of PT NFC Indonesia Tbk at IDR 1,550 per share, reducing its stake from 77,917,300 to 77,641,500 shares (a decline of 275,800 shares). The transaction, classified as an investment‑related sale, reflects a modest divestment by the holder and marginally lowers its ownership percentage in the listed company.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sold 65,692,400 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk on 10 March 2026 at IDR 33 per share as a divestment. The shareholder's stake decreased from 3,562,714,200 to 3,497,021,800 shares, reflecting a notable reduction in ownership and signaling a strategic exit from the company.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buy Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased 829,300 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares on March 11‑12, 2026 at prices between IDR 1,400 and IDR 1,490, using a representative price of IDR 1,460 per share, for an approximate total outlay of IDR 1,210,778,000. The transaction raised his holding from 219,640,722 to 220,470,022 shares, a net increase of 829,300 shares (about 0.38% of total shares), indicating an investment purpose and a potential vote of confidence in the company.

title: Prijono Sugiarto Buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: Indonesian investor Prijono Sugiarto purchased a total of 1,458,100 Astra International Tbk shares between 27 Feb and 11 Mar 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 5,800 to IDR 6,651 per share (representative price IDR 6,651). His holding rose from 2,665,200 to 4,123,300 shares, an increase of 1,458,100 shares (≈55%). The transaction is classified as an investment purchase, expanding his stake significantly and indicating confidence in Astra International’s outlook.

title: Sandra Angela buy Shares of PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Investor Sandra Angela purchased an additional 2,868,300 shares of PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk. (CASH.JK) at roughly IDR 198 per share, raising her holding from 91,283,400 to 94,151,700 shares. The transaction, recorded on 11‑12 March 2026, is classified as an investment and expands her ownership stake by about 3.1%, reflecting continued confidence in the company's prospects.

title: PT Bank Mandiri Tbk shares tumble 4.2% as foreign investors record net sell of 46.5 million shares
body: On 13 March 2026, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk fell 4.23% to Rp 4,760 after foreign investors sold a net 46,463,100 shares, representing a transaction volume of about 137 billion shares and a value of Rp 660.9 billion. The previous session had seen a net foreign purchase of Rp 194.9 billion.

title: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia launches Sharia mode on IDX Mobile app
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia introduced a Sharia-compliant mode on its IDX Mobile application on 9 March 2026, featuring Sharia Equity Market, Sukuk Market, virtual trading, education and regulatory resources. The rollout arrives as Sharia stocks account for 70% of listings (672 stocks) and over 219,000 investors, while IDX Mobile already serves more than 510,000 users.

title: PT Bank Mandiri Tbk shares slide 4.2% to Rp 4,750 as net profit rises 16.7% YoY
body: PT Bank Mandiri Tbk saw its shares drop 4.23% to Rp 4,750 in the second session on 13 March 2026, with 135.81 million shares traded (value Rp 656.68 billion). Despite the sell‑off, the bank reported a 16.7% year‑on‑year increase in net profit to Rp 8.9 trillion for the period to February 2026, with credit disbursement up 15.7% YoY to Rp 1,513.1 trillion and DPK rising 16.3% YoY to Rp 1,644.8 trillion.

title: PT United Tractors Tbk signs cooperation agreement with Indonesia's Ministry of Education to support vocational training
body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UT) has signed a cooperation agreement with the Ministry of Education, Basic and Secondary Education to enhance vocational, special, and special‑service education in Indonesia. The company said the partnership will help develop a skilled workforce that meets industry needs.

title: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk Divests Shares, Direct Ownership Falls to 61.07%
body: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk saw its direct ownership by PT Nusantara Utama Investama drop from 61.64% to 61.07% after selling 139.3 million shares at an average price of Rp1,600 per share, while Hapsoro reduced its stake from 0.25% to 0.18% by selling 17 million shares. The share price corrected 6.93%, closing at Rp940 on March 13, 2026.

title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk posts 2025 profit milestones and receives bullish analyst price targets
body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk reported FY 2025 results with revenue of Rp 18.3 trillion, adjusted EBITDA of Rp 2.0 trillion, a 77% reduction in net loss to Rp 1.2 trillion and positive free cash flow of Rp 966 billion. Six analysts set a consensus fair‑value target of Rp 102 per share, implying roughly 79% upside from the Rp 57 close, and the company guided 2026 adjusted EBITDA to Rp 3.2‑3.4 trillion.

title: PT Bank Permata Tbk outlines cautious 2026 outlook amid global uncertainties
body: PT Bank Permata Tbk reported 2025 net profit of Rp3.6 trillion, a credit portfolio of Rp163.3 trillion up 5.5% YoY, corporate loans rising 11.2% to Rp99.6 trillion and a CASA ratio of 63.9% of DPK. The bank said it will pursue a conservative, risk‑focused strategy in 2026, targeting 8‑10% credit growth while closely monitoring global geopolitical and economic risks.

title: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk Plans to Expand into Mining Equipment Leasing
body: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk announced plans to add a new business line of leasing and renting mining equipment under KBLI 77395. The company will seek shareholder approval at its Annual General Meeting on 21 April 2026 after completing a feasibility study by 31 December 2025.

title: PT Sona Topas Tourism Tbk. Reports 130.8% YoY Net Profit Surge to Rp89.06 Billion in 2025
body: PT Sona Topas Tourism Tbk. posted net profit of Rp89.06 billion in 2025, a 130.8% increase from Rp38.59 billion in 2024, while revenue rose 5.73% to Rp899.78 billion and operating profit jumped 184.94% to Rp104.06 billion. Total assets grew 7.44% to Rp979.80 billion, liabilities fell 9.64% to Rp249.32 billion, and the shares gained 1.75% to Rp2,320 on March 13.

title: PT Leyand International Tbk's Shareholder Count Rises Amidst New Control, Tender Offer, and Business Transformation
body: PT Leyand International Tbk experienced a significant increase in shareholders to 8,832, following JSI Sinergi Mas becoming the new controlling shareholder with approximately 51% ownership. JSI Sinergi Mas is currently conducting a Mandatory Tender Offer for up to 1.65 billion shares of PT Leyand International Tbk at Rp51 per share, running from February 28 to March 29, 2026, while PT Leyand International Tbk plans to acquire mining contractor PT Bersaudara Sinergi Sejahtera as part of its business transformation into the energy and mining sectors.

title: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk, PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk and PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk post solid 2025 earnings
body: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk posted 18.82% revenue growth to Rp10.72 trillion and a 33.80% profit increase to Rp2.03 trillion in 2025, while PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk recorded a 1.2% revenue decline to Rp8.76 trillion but net profit rose 19.06% to Rp1.35 trillion, and PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk saw revenue rise 19.13% to Rp1.50 trillion and net profit climb 22.17% to Rp179.44 billion. KISI Sekuritas recommends buying the three stocks with target prices of Rp2,000 for PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Company Tbk, Rp5,500 for PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk and Rp650 for PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk.

title: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk plans up to Rp280.99 billion share buyback under OJK policy
body: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk announced it will execute a share buyback of up to Rp280.99 billion between 9 February and 8 May 2026, using the remaining funds from its prior allocation. The buyback is allowed under OJK’s buy‑back‑without‑RUPS policy that remains in force until at least March 2026.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia to evaluate FCA trading mechanism for improved transparency
body: The Otoritas Jasa Keuangan said it will assess the full periodic call auction (FCA) system used on Bursa Efek Indonesia, aiming to add best‑bid and best‑offer indicators for greater price transparency. The regulator plans to gather market feedback and conduct a formal evaluation after the March 13 2026 statement.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk announces 72% dividend payout while PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk and PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk see key price and trading updates
body: PT Bumi Resources Tbk fell 9.1% this week and 40.4% year‑to‑date, with analysts targeting a near‑term resistance level; PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk is flagged for a potential rise to 8,200 per share with a PBV of 1.79, while PT Tirta Mahakam Resources Tbk resumed trading after a suspension, surging from Rp 44 to Rp 1,000. PT Bank Central Asia Tbk approved a 2025 dividend of Rp 281 per share, a 72% payout ratio and a 4.1% yield on a closing price of Rp 6,900.

title: PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk Plans to Expand into Sugar, Chocolate, and Food Service Businesses
body: PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk plans to add new business activities in large-scale sugar, chocolate, and confectionery trade and in fixed-restaurant food supply, aiming to broaden its customer base and market share. The company will seek approval from a special shareholders meeting on 21 April 2026 before proceeding.

title: PT Perma Plasindo Tbk Secures CNY 1.5 Million Contract with Deli Development for Custom Stationery Products
body: PT Perma Plasindo Tbk, through its subsidiary PT Batara Indah, signed a CNY 1.5 million contract with Deli Development (Thailand) Co., Ltd. for the sale and supply of custom Bantex stationery from 1 March 2026 to 1 March 2028, with payments due 120 days after departure, and the company’s director confirmed the deal has no material adverse effect on its financial condition.

title: Foreign investors net buy PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk and sell PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk on the IDX on 13 March
body: On Friday 13 March, foreign investors were net buyers of PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk (330.97 million shares), PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk (218.77 million), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (212.68 million), PT Buana Lintas Lautan Tbk (113.29 million) and PT Darma Henwa Tbk (76.91 million). They were net sellers of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (784.84 million), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (97.76 million), PT Topindo Solusi Komunika Tbk (42.31 million), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (41.91 million) and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (37.98 million).

title: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk reports 12.6% increase in net profit to Rp652.6 billion in 2025
body: PT Dharma Polimetal Tbk posted a net profit of Rp652.6 billion in 2025, up 12.6% year‑on‑year, with net sales rising 7.8% to Rp5,507 trillion and total assets reaching Rp4.2 trillion. The company set a 2026 revenue target of at least Rp6.5 trillion, higher than its 2025 target of Rp6 trillion, despite a 7.2% decline in Indonesia's wholesale car sales.

title: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk reports modest sales growth and sharp profit rise in 2025
body: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk posted 2025 sales of Rp1.96 trillion, a 1.95% increase from the prior year, while asset turnover held at 0.94 times. Gross profit rose 7.8% to Rp762.87 billion and net profit attributable to the parent jumped 28.3% to Rp89.13 billion.

title: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk subsidiary PT Suryacipta Swadaya targets 10 ha industrial land sales in Karawang
body: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk’s subsidiary PT Suryacipta Swadaya aims to sell up to 10 hectares of industrial land in Karawang this year as the park reaches its maturity phase. It also noted rising interest in its Subang Smartpolitan development from Korean, Chinese and domestic investors.

title: PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk holds on consensus with target price IDR2,025 as Q4 2025 loss and impairment pressure earnings
body: Analysts maintain a hold rating on PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk, setting a target price of IDR2,025 after the stock fell 4.9% to IDR1,940 on 13 March 2026; the broker cites a Q4 2025 net loss of US$23 million and a US$99.5 million impairment that cut full‑year profit 37% YoY to US$215 million. Sucor Sekuritas projects profit recovery to US$276 million in 2026 and US$290 million in 2027, supported by LNG growth and a US$353 million capex plan.

title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk Beats 2025 EBITDA Target and Sets 2026 Growth Outlook
body: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk recorded an adjusted EBITDA of Rp 2 trillion in 2025, surpassing its Rp 1.8‑1.9 trillion target, and is projecting adjusted EBITDA of Rp 3.2‑3.4 trillion for 2026. The company also generated Rp 966 billion in adjusted free cash flow in 2025, and analysts maintain a buy rating with a target price of Rp 95 per share.

title: Pupuk Indonesia set to expand urea exports as Hormuz closure drives global demand
body: State-owned Pupuk Indonesia, which has a total fertilizer production capacity of 14.5 million tons per year, says it can maintain domestic supply while scaling up urea exports to meet heightened international demand caused by the Strait of Hormuz closure. The surge also allows older, less efficient plants to remain operational temporarily.

title: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk, PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk and PT Bumi Recources Minerals Tbk announce 2026 production targets
body: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk projects 2026 oil and gas output of 165,000‑170,000 boepd, up from 156,000 boepd in 2025, and reports 2P reserves of 564 million boe with a reserve life index of 11.4 years. PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk expects electricity generation of about 5,255 GWh in 2026 and is investing over US$1.09 billion in four geothermal projects, while PT Bumi Recources Minerals Tbk targets 80,000 oz of gold production in 2026 after reaching 64,000 oz in 2024.

title: PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia faces OJK investigation over alleged market manipulation and insider trading
body: OJK is conducting a criminal‑law investigation into PT Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia for alleged manipulation of material information and fake transactions linked to an IPO. The probe also uncovered a scheme that drove PT Berkah Beton Sadaya Tbk shares up about 7,150% between 2020 and 2022, prompting potential sanctions for both firms.

title: Analysts set high buy targets for PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk and PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk amid oil price surge
body: All 20 analysts covering PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC) recommend a buy with a median target of Rp2,135, implying a 23.4% upside from the Thursday close of Rp1,730, while six analysts recommend a buy on PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) with a target of Rp1,992, suggesting a 36% gain from its Thursday close of Rp1,465. Both stocks fell on Friday, with MEDC closing at Rp1,700 (‑1.73%) and ENRG at Rp1,410 (‑3.75%).

title: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk partners with Riscon Group to develop subsidized housing in Bogor
body: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk announced a joint‑operation (KSO) partnership with Riscon Group on March 13, 2026 to build subsidized homes for low‑income families in Grand Riscon Darmaga, Bogor. The collaboration assigns REAL to construct infrastructure and units while Riscon provides land and handles marketing, aiming to tap Indonesia’s large affordable‑housing demand and support the government’s 3‑million‑house program.

title: PT Golden Eagle Energy Tbk reports 2025 sales more than double and net profit up 81% after coal production boost and acquisition
body: PT Golden Eagle Energy Tbk posted 2025 revenue of US$103.6 million, a 101.7% YoY increase, and net profit of US$4.06 million, up 81% from the prior year, driven by a 39% rise in coal output to 3.17 million tons and a 71% export share. The company also completed the acquisition of PT Bara Enim Sejahtera, securing full control of PT Triaryani and financing the deal with a Rp500 billion loan from PT Geo Energy Investama.

title: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk targets record 2026 production amid new Rp10.5 trn credit and UBS price upgrade
body: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk aims for a record 165,000‑170,000 boepd in 2026, supported by roughly Rp10.5 trillion of fresh credit facilities, a 2P reserve rise to 564 million boe and a 9‑month 2025 debt‑to‑equity ratio of 2.53× with net‑debt/EBITDA at 2.6×. UBS raised its target price to Rp2,570 (consensus Rp2,135) citing improving leverage—net‑debt/total equity projected to drop to 1.15× in 2026—and higher oil‑price outlook.

title: Indonesia to provide data for U.S. trade investigations into excess capacity and forced labor
body: Indonesia's Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs said it will share the information requested by the United States in two new unfair‑trade probes targeting excess industrial capacity and forced‑labor linked imports. The probes could lead to higher global tariffs on Indonesian exports such as palm oil and textiles if the U.S. decides to raise the temporary 10% levy to 15%.

title: Hotel Fitra International, Fortune Indonesia, Aesler Grup International, and Fast Food Indonesia Lead Declines as Jakarta Composite Index Plunges 3.05%
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) plunged 3.05% to 7,137 on Friday, driven by global oil price surges and Middle East tensions. This broad sell-off saw Hotel Fitra International, Fortune Indonesia, Aesler Grup International, and Fast Food Indonesia each fall approximately 14.7%, with SoftBank Group also declining 4.5%.

title: Indonesia Considers Remote Work, Four-Day Week, and Energy Strategy Shifts Amid Fuel Consumption Concerns
body: The Indonesian government is reviewing options like remote work and a four-day workweek to curb fuel consumption and improve energy efficiency, while also planning to build storage facilities for up to three months' worth of fuel reserves. Indonesia is shifting crude oil imports away from the Middle East to countries like the United States, Nigeria, Brazil, and Australia, and accelerating renewable energy transition with plans for up to 100 gigawatts of solar power plants.

title: Indonesia Faces US Unfair Trade Investigations Over Production Surpluses and Trade Balance
body: Indonesia is engaging in intensive talks with the US following investigations into its production surpluses and positive trade balance, which the US claims have displaced American production and could lead to new tariffs. The US cited Indonesia's global goods trade surplus of $31 billion in 2024 and a $56.15 billion trade balance with the US by November 2025 as evidence of structural excess capacity, while Indonesian goods currently face 10% global tariffs for 150 days.

title: Indonesia Plans to Phase Out Diesel Generators in Favor of Solar and Geothermal Power
body: Indonesia will gradually shut down diesel‑powered electricity generators as new solar and geothermal plants come online, targeting a 100 GW solar capacity and accelerating geothermal development, with foreign investors committing $1.4 billion to component manufacturing.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia to Implement 15% Minimum Free Float by March 2026
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) will raise the minimum free float requirement for listed issuers to 15% and aims to finalize the adjustment of Regulation No. I‑A before the end of March 2026, pending OJK approval. The transition period will allow listed companies to comply with the new threshold, with implementation scheduled for March 2026.

title: PT Elnusa Tbk Strengthens Business Development to Support National Oil and Gas Production Targets
body: PT Elnusa Tbk is enhancing its business development efforts to capitalize on the growing national energy industry and support the national oil and gas production target of 1 million barrels oil per day (BOPD). The company is implementing an adaptive business strategy focused on four main pillars: Routine Work Program, acceleration from Reserve to Production, Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR), and Exploration.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk Shares Slip 0.36% as Company Announces Quarterly Interim Dividends for 2026
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) closed at 6,875 on March 13, 2026, down 25 points (0.36%) from the previous day, after the bank announced plans to distribute interim dividends up to three times in 2026. The 2025 net profit of Rp57.5 trillion led to a dividend of Rp336 per share and a payout ratio of 72%, up from 67.4% in 2024.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk Announces Planned Buyback Up to Rp 4 Trillion
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) plans a share buyback of up to Rp 4 trillion—no more than 10% of its paid‑up capital—following a RUPSLB on 17 April 2026, with the program to commence on 20 April 2026 and run for up to 12 months. The stock closed at Rp 2,480 on 13 March 2026, up 36% YTD, and analysts target prices of Rp 2,800 (Muhammad Wafi) and Rp 2,550 (Nafan Aji Gusta).

title: PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk Reports Rp1.1 Trillion Net Profit in 2025, Plans Minimal 40% Dividend Payout
body: PT Daya Intiguna Yasa Tbk recorded a net profit of Rp1.1 trillion in 2025, a 4.9 percent increase year-on-year, alongside a 16.7 percent rise in revenue to Rp7.9 trillion, driven by product relevance and operational discipline. The company plans to distribute a minimal 40 percent cash dividend from its 2025 net profit and expanded its network by opening 272 new stores, supported by a 70.2 percent increase in operating cash flow to Rp1.3 trillion.

title: PT Bank Woori Saudara Indonesia 1906 Tbk Launches Property Financing Program with Sinar Mas Land for Early 2026
body: PT Bank Woori Saudara Indonesia 1906 Tbk (SDRA) has partnered with Sinar Mas Land to roll out the “Ketupat Hoki” property financing program, running from 14 February to 22 March 2026, aimed at tapping seasonal demand during the Lunar New Year and Ramadan periods. The initiative offers tailored Kredit Pemilikan Hunian (KPH) facilities and promotional incentives to boost home‑ownership in Sinar Mas Land’s projects while maintaining prudent risk management.

title: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk Expands Property Portfolio Through Strategic Collaboration with PT Ardias Bayu Pratama
body: PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk has entered into a strategic Kerja Sama Operasi (KSO) with PT Ardias Bayu Pratama to develop subsidized housing for low-income communities in Bogor, West Java.
