This collaboration, marked by a groundbreaking event, aims to expand PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk's property development portfolio and support national housing programs, with PT Repower Asia Indonesia Tbk responsible for infrastructure and unit construction, while PT Ardias Bayu Pratama provides land and manages marketing and sales.

title: PT Puri Global Sukses Tbk Reports Revenue of Rp37.42 Billion for 2025, Up from Rp15.12 Billion in 2024
body: PT Puri Global Sukses Tbk posted revenue of Rp37.42 billion for the year ended December 31 2025, up from Rp15.12 billion in 2024. The company’s gross profit rose to Rp13.72 billion, while pre‑tax loss fell to Rp4.28 billion and net loss attributable to the parent to Rp3.13 billion; total assets increased to Rp633.73 billion and liabilities to Rp523.74 billion.

title: Saratoga Investama posts 2025 net profit of Rp7.31 trillion, up 122% YoY
body: Saratoga Investama reported a 2025 net profit of Rp7.31 trillion, a 122.18% increase from the prior year, with basic diluted earnings per share rising to Rp540. The firm’s equity grew to Rp58.91 trillion and total assets to Rp62.51 trillion, while liabilities fell to Rp3.59 trillion.

title: Harta Djaya Karya to Issue Bonus Shares Worth Rp7.45 Billion
body: Harta Djaya Karya plans to issue up to 372.58 million bonus shares, valued at Rp7.45 billion, raising total shares to a maximum of 2.6 billion on a 6:1 ratio. The bonus distribution requires approval at the extraordinary shareholders meeting on 8 April 2026, with cum‑bonus trading beginning 16 April and final distribution on 8 May 2026.

title: Bangun Kosambi reports 2025 revenue of Rp2.5 trillion and net profit jump of 48%
body: Bangun Kosambi posted 2025 revenue of Rp2.5 trillion, up 11% year‑on‑year, and net profit of Rp1.4 trillion, a 48% increase, with gross margin at 66% and net margin rising 54%. The company ended 2025 with assets of Rp23 trillion and a 702‑hectare land bank supporting further development in the PIK2 district.

title: PANI posts Rp4.3 trillion revenue and 83% profit surge in 2025
body: PANI recorded 2025 revenue of Rp4.3 trillion, a 52% increase, and net profit of Rp1.1 trillion, up 83%, with gross margin rising to 60% and net margin to 27%. The company ended the year with Rp3.8 trillion in cash, Rp550 billion in bank debt and total assets of Rp50 trillion, reflecting a strong balance sheet to support further expansion of the PIK2 integrated zone.

title: Bank BCA announces remaining 2025 dividend of Rp34.52 trillion
body: Bank BCA will distribute the remaining 2025 dividend of Rp34.52 trillion, equivalent to a cash payout of Rp281 per share, bringing total 2025 cash dividends to about Rp41 trillion (72% of net profit). The dividend will be recorded on 31 March 2026, with payment scheduled for 8 April 2026.

title: Astra International's market share falls to 49.4% amid strong competition in Jan‑Feb 2026
body: PT Astra International Tbk reported its automotive market share slipped to 49.4% in the first two months of 2026, with total vehicle sales of 72,941 units, a 0.2% YoY decline, while February sales rose 9% MoM to 38,074 units led by Daihatsu. Analysts project the share could rebound to around 55% by year‑end as demand normalizes.

title: PT Astra International Tbk plans up to Rp2 trillion share buyback in 2026
body: PT Astra International Tbk announced a share buyback program of up to Rp2 trillion, representing no more than 20% of its paid‑up capital, while maintaining a free‑float of at least 7.5% of capital. The buyback will be carried out on the Indonesia Stock Exchange in phases from 16 March to 15 June 2026.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price holds at Rp2,749,000, up 16.48% YTD
body: The buyback price for gold at PT Aneka Tambang Tbk remained unchanged at Rp2,749,000 per gram, reflecting a 16.48% increase since the start of 2026 but still below the all‑time high of Rp2,989,000 reached in late January 2026. The price movement mirrors global precious‑metal trends amid geopolitical tensions and rising energy prices.

title: OJK imposes fines totaling Rp5.6 billion on PT Bliss Properti Indonesia Tbk and sanctions PT Sejahtera Bintang Abadi Textile Tbk
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) fined PT Bliss Properti Indonesia Tbk (POSA) Rp5,625 billion for improper disclosure of related‑party receivables and imposed bans on its directors, while PT Sejahtera Bintang Abadi Textile Tbk (SBAT) received a written warning and a Rp45 million fine for conflict‑of‑interest transactions. PT Nonghyup Korindo Sekuritas Indonesia was also penalised with a Rp525 million fine and a one‑year suspension of its underwriting licence.

title: TelkomMetra signs conditional sale agreement to transfer AdMedika Group to Fullerton Health
body: PT Multimedia Nusantara (TelkomMetra) signed a Conditional Sale and Purchase Agreement on 4 March 2026 to sell its AdMedika Group subsidiary to Fullerton Health. The transaction supports TelkomGroup’s portfolio‑streamlining strategy and gives Fullerton Health a platform to expand its regional health‑care services.

title: OJK suspends underwriting license of NH Korindo Sekuritas Indonesia
body: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed a sanction on 13 March 2026 that freezes NH Korindo Sekuritas Indonesia’s underwriting license, barring it from acting as an underwriter in the capital market. The firm may continue brokerage, research and other services while the restriction remains in effect.

title: OJK imposes lifetime market ban on Benny Tjokrosaputro and fines PT Bliss Properti Indonesia Tbk Rp2.7 billion for IPO fund misuse
body: OJK has banned Benny Tjokrosaputro from participating in the capital market for life and fined PT Bliss Properti Indonesia Tbk Rp2.7 billion after finding that IPO proceeds were misused. The regulator noted that POSA offered 1.7 billion shares (20.26% of paid‑up capital) in its 2019 IPO and that at least Rp126.6 billion was diverted to Benny Tjokrosaputro and Rp116.7 billion to PT Ardha Nusa Utama.

title: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk reports 21% profit rise in 2025 and projects 19% revenue growth for 2026
body: PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk posted 2025 revenue of US$498 million, up 7% YoY, and net profit of US$91.5 million, up 21% YoY, driven by stronger asset contributions despite lower oil and gas prices. The company targets 2026 revenue of US$592 million, a 19% increase, and a 10% production rise, supported by new discoveries in the Malacca Strait.

title: OJK imposes Rp5.625 billion in fines and bans on PT Bliss Properti Indonesia Tbk and related parties
body: OJK fined PT Bliss Properti Indonesia Tbk Rp2.7 billion and imposed a total of Rp5,625 billion in administrative penalties for presenting a Rp31.25 billion related‑party receivable to PT Bintang Baja Hitam and a Rp116.7 billion advance payment to PT Ardha Nusa Utama that were not economic assets, and banned its controlling shareholder Benny Tjokrosaputro from any capital‑market role for life. The regulator also penalised PT Nonghyup Korindo Sekuritas Indonesia with a Rp525 million fine and a one‑year licence freeze, and fined the accounting firm KAP Kanaka Puradiredja, Suhartono Rp150 million each for audit failures related to the IPO.

title: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk posts lower 2025 net profit but raises 2026‑2028 forecasts, retains buy rating
body: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk reported a 36% year‑on‑year decline in 2025 net profit to US$760 million and a 7.7% revenue drop to US$4.91 billion, while fourth‑quarter profit rose 11.5% quarter‑on‑quarter to US$173 million on higher volume and ASP. Maybank Sekuritas lifted its 2026‑2028 net‑profit forecasts by up to 48.5% (to US$916‑860 million), raised revenue expectations to roughly US$5.2 billion and maintained a buy recommendation with a DCF target of Rp12,500.

title: TOBA outlines waste‑management expansion and low‑carbon projects through 2026
body: TOBA confirmed its acquisition of Sembcorp Environment (now Cora Environment) in 2025 and the divestment of its coal‑fired power plant assets, reinvesting the proceeds into green initiatives. The company plans a 46 MWp floating solar plant in Batam to start commercial operation in Q4‑2026 and will expand its Electrum electric‑vehicle fleet and battery‑swap facilities, including a new hub in Surabaya.

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk outlines 2026 growth plan despite 2025 revenue decline and net loss
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk reported a 5.16% YoY revenue drop to US$365.86 million and a net loss of US$162.27 million in 2025, but posted a positive adjusted EBITDA of US$47.2 million and cash of US$102.3 million, up 15% from 2024. The firm said its 2026 strategy will focus on scaling waste‑management, renewable‑energy and electric‑vehicle businesses, targeting over 500 MW of installed renewable capacity and 500,000 electric vehicles by 2030.

title: Astra International announces up to Rp2 trillion share buyback program
body: Astra International said it will repurchase its shares for up to Rp2 trillion between 16 March and 15 June 2026, representing no more than 20 % of its paid‑up capital while keeping the free‑float at least 7.5 %. The buyback will be funded from internal cash and is expected to stabilise the stock price without materially affecting the company’s financial or operational performance.

title: Astra International shares purchased by Prijono Sugiarto total 1.46 million, costing about Rp9.14 billion
body: President Commissioner Prijono Sugiarto bought a total of 1,458,100 Astra International shares between 27 February and 11 March 2026 at prices ranging from Rp5,800 to Rp6,651, spending roughly Rp9.14 billion and raising his stake to 0,0102% (4.12 million shares). Over the same period Astra International’s stock fell 125 points to Rp5,825, a 2.10% decline, and is down 975 points (14.34%) year‑to‑date from Rp6,800.

title: Rudi R Sutantra sell Shares of PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
body: On 10 March 2026, shareholder Rudi R Sutantra sold 10,000,000 PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk shares at IDR 51 per share. His holding decreased from 2,814,254,200 to 2,804,254,200 shares, a reduction of 10,000,000 shares. No specific purpose was disclosed. The transaction modestly lowers his stake in the listed offshore services firm, which may be noted by investors tracking insider activity.

title: Bukalapak Reports Rp3.14 Trillion Net Profit, Reversing Previous Year's Loss
body: Bukalapak achieved a net profit of Rp3.14 trillion, a 303.89 percent increase from a Rp1.54 trillion loss in the prior year, with earnings per share rising to Rp31.91 from a Rp15 loss. The company's revenue grew 45.96 percent to Rp6.51 trillion, while total assets increased to Rp26.03 trillion and accumulated losses decreased to Rp7.11 trillion.

title: PT Petrosea Tbk shares fall 38% in a month despite 197% profit increase
body: PT Petrosea Tbk's stock closed at Rp 4,530 on 13 March 2026, down 3.21% and having slipped 38.16% over the past month and 58.63% over three months, while foreign investors posted a net buy of Rp 32.15 billion. The company posted a 197% jump in 2025 net profit to US$28.8 million (≈Rp 483 billion) and MNC Sekuritas set price targets of Rp 5,650 and Rp 7,050 with a stop‑loss at Rp 3,150.

title: Indonesia’s OJK sanctions PT Sejahtera Bintang Abadi Textile Tbk with fine and five‑year ban
body: OJK fined PT Sejahtera Bintang Abadi Textile Tbk IDR45 million and banned its controller Tan Heng Lok from board or officer roles for five years over conflict‑of‑interest transactions. The regulator’s action has kept SBAT’s shares suspended since 18 September 2024, with the Indonesia Stock Exchange reaffirming the trading halt on 20 August 2025.

title: PT Weha Transportasi Indonesia Tbk targets 10% revenue and profit growth in 2026 amid fuel price and geopolitical risks
body: PT Weha Transportasi Indonesia Tbk projects about 10% growth in both revenue and net profit for 2026, driven by stronger intercity shuttle (DayTrans) demand and expanded fleet capacity. The company warns that rising fuel prices, parts costs and higher interest expenses, amplified by Middle‑East geopolitical tensions, could pressure margins.

title: PT Manulife Aset Manajemen Indonesia shifts to short‑term bonds as 10‑year SBN yield rises to 6.75%
body: PT Manulife Aset Manajemen Indonesia said it will increase exposure to short‑term Indonesian sovereign bonds after the 10‑year SBN yield climbed to 6.75% on 16 March 2026, up from 6.60% a week earlier. Its flagship Manulife Obligasi Unggulan Kelas A fund manages Rp12.78 trillion, with 64.68% invested in SBN and a cautious approach toward corporate bonds.

title: BRI Danareksa issues buy recommendations for PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk., PT Indika Energy Tbk., PT Bukalapak.com Tbk. and a sell on PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk.
body: BRI Danareksa Securities analyst Reza Diofanda recommends buying PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk. at Rp480‑490 with a target of Rp520‑540, buying PT Indika Energy Tbk. at Rp3,500‑3,600 targeting Rp3,800‑3,990, and buying PT Bukalapak.com Tbk. at Rp130‑135 aiming for Rp141‑146, while recommending a sell on PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk. after it broke support at Rp73,225, with the next support near Rp63,200. The recommendations come as the IHSG fell 3.05% to 7,137 amid global inflation concerns and net foreign selling of Rp221.84 bn.

title: PT AirAsia Indonesia Tbk posts lower loss and modest revenue dip in 2025
body: PT AirAsia Indonesia Tbk reported 2025 revenue of Rp7.87 trillion, a 0.86% decline from 2024, while its loss narrowed to Rp1.29 trillion, 15% lower year‑on‑year. Operating expenses fell 2.4% to Rp8.51 trillion, CASK dropped 1.4%, and the airline carried 5.91 million passengers with an 83% load factor as it expanded its domestic and international network.

title: PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia Tbk targets 10‑20% daily revenue growth during Lebaran 2026
body: PT Jantra Grupo Indonesia Tbk said it aims to boost daily service revenue by 10%‑20% during the Lebaran 2026 travel season, building on a rise from 20,985 serviced vehicles and Rp50 billion revenue in 2023 to 28,336 vehicles and a projected 30%‑40% revenue jump in 2025. The outlook comes as Indonesia’s overall car wholesale sales grew 22.1% in February 2026, supporting the company’s optimistic growth prospects.

title: PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk and PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk consider rights issues amid market volatility
body: Both PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk and PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk are planning rights issues and stress the need for standby buyers to attract retail investors in a volatile market. Analysts note that allocating the raised capital to business expansion or ESG‑related projects, such as renewable energy, could generate positive sentiment.

title: UBS upgrades PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk to Buy with Rp2,500 target amid declining Q3 2025 earnings
body: UBS raised its rating on PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk to Buy on 12 March 2026 and set a new target price of Rp2,500, while the consensus 12‑month target remains Rp2,313.33. The miner reported Q3 2025 revenue of US$675.1 million, a 19.7% YoY drop, with gross profit falling 38.6% to US$267.8 million and net profit down 38.7% to US$204.2 million.

title: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk continues its Rp2.49 trillion share buyback program
body: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) confirmed it will continue its share buyback program up to Rp2.49 trillion, approved by the extraordinary shareholders meeting on 3 Nov 2025 and to be completed within 12 months. Management also stated that no other corporate actions are planned for the next three months.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia announces 2025 dividend of Rp13.02 trillion, a 65% payout yielding 8.24%
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia will pay a total cash dividend of Rp13.02 trillion for FY2025, representing 65% of its Rp20.40 trillion net profit and amounting to Rp349.26 per share, which translates to an 8.24% dividend yield based on the current closing price of Rp4,240. The cum‑dividend dates are 17 March 2026 (regular market) and 26 March 2026 (cash market), with payment scheduled for 7 April 2026.

title: Lo Kheng Hong raises stake in PT Intiland Development Tbk to 6.78%
body: Lo Kheng Hong continued to accumulate shares of PT Intiland Development Tbk, buying 1.10 million shares on 10 March 2026 and raising his total holding to 702.43 million shares, or 6.78% of the company. Since the start of 2026 he has purchased about 453.1 million shares at an average price of Rp147 per share, costing roughly Rp66.6 billion.

title: PT Selamat Sempurna Tbk reports year‑on‑year financial improvements in 2025
body: PT Selamat Sempurna Tbk posted net sales of Rp5.33 trillion in 2025, a 3.36% year‑on‑year increase from Rp5.16 trillion in 2024. The company’s gross profit rose to Rp1.97 trillion (up 3.35%), net profit to Rp1.12 trillion (up 9.81%), total assets to Rp5.16 trillion (up 4.01%), equity to Rp4.30 trillion (up 9.69%) and liabilities fell 17.48% to Rp856.41 billion.

title: PT Danantara Investment Management plans Rp7 trillion medium‑term note issuance
body: PT Danantara Investment Management announced a Rp7 trillion medium‑term note (MTN) program split into two series (A and B) of Rp3.5 trillion each, with Series A maturing on 18 March 2031 (5‑year tenor) and Series B on 17 March 2033 (7‑year tenor), both bearing fixed annual coupons and first interest payments scheduled for March 2027. The issuance follows its October 2025 Rp50 trillion Patriot Bond offering, with PT Mandiri Sekuritas as lead manager and PT Bank Mandiri Tbk as monitoring agent.

title: Bharat Shah Joshi buy Shares of PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk
body: Investor Bharat Shah Joshi purchased 19,000 shares of PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk at IDR 4,500 per share on 12 March 2026, raising his holding from 4,000 to 23,000 shares, a net increase of 19,000 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, expands his ownership to approximately 23,000 shares, signalling strong confidence in the dairy company's prospects and potentially influencing future share price dynamics.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk announces 2025 cash dividend of Rp336 per share, payable after Lebaran 2026
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk announced a cash dividend of Rp336 per share (totaling Rp41.3 trillion, or 72% of 2025 net profit) with cum‑dividend dates of 27 March (regular) and 31 March 2026 and payment scheduled for 8 April 2026 after Lebaran. The payout includes an interim dividend of Rp55 per share paid on 22 December 2025, leaving a final dividend of Rp281 per share, and the bank reported loan disbursements of Rp948.95 trillion in January 2026, up 6.26% YoY.

title: Indonesia Reaffirms Commitment to ART Amid US Section 301 Trade Investigation
body: The Indonesian Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs confirmed that the country will continue to honor the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) while cooperating with the United States' Section 301 investigation. Indonesia is also moving forward with domestic ratification of the ART and preparing data to address U.S. concerns, including alleged excess manufacturing capacity.

title: PT Samudera Indonesia Tbk reports director‑Bani Maulana Mulia’s Rp199.29 billion share purchase, raising his stake to 0.37%
body: Director Bani Maulana Mulia bought 576 million Samudera Indonesia shares on 13 March 2026 at Rp 346 each, valuing the transaction at roughly Rp 199.29 billion and increasing his holding to 59.94 million shares (0.37%). The stock closed down 1.16% at Rp 340, with a 1‑month decline of 14.14% and valuation ratios of PBV 0.62× and PER 5.91×, while 9M2025 revenue reached US$571.55 million and net profit US$43.08 million.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk announces cash dividend of Rp 349.41 per share, yielding about 8%
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) declared a cash dividend of Rp 349.41 per share, equating to a dividend yield of roughly 8% and a total payout of about Rp 13.03 trillion, or 65% of its 2025 net profit of Rp 20.04 trillion. The dividend is payable on 7 April 2026, with cum‑dividend on 17 March and ex‑dividend on 25 March.

title: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk announces up to Rp 1.7 trillion share buyback
body: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk said it will repurchase up to 1.8 billion shares, allocating a maximum of Rp 1.7 trillion, with the program to be completed by 16 June 2026. The announcement came as the stock fell 4.26% to Rp 675 after a 6.90% gain over the prior month.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk joins Global Junior Gold Miners Index as stock jumps 9.74%
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk saw its shares rise 9.74% to Rp 8,450 after being added to the Global Junior Gold Miners Index effective 20 March 2026, alongside PT Archi Indonesia Tbk and PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk. The company also reported its first commercial gold sale of 16,0597 kg (516,287 ounces) to PT Antam Tbk.

title: Phillip Sekuritas recommends buy on PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk with targets of Rp 4,610 and Rp 5,175
body: Phillip Sekuritas Indonesia issued a buy recommendation for PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk on 16 Mar 2026, setting an entry point of Rp 3,900, a stop‑loss at Rp 3,220 and price targets of Rp 4,610 and Rp 5,175, implying up to 32.56% upside. The stock rose 8.42% to Rp 3,990 on 13 Jun 2026 after a 4,383% gain over the past year, following Nextier Datamate Center’s acquisition of a 78.74% stake that makes it the new controlling shareholder.

title: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia recommends ADMR, PTBA, INDY, AADI, ITMG and AKRA as IHSG expected to weaken on 16 Mar 2026
body: CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia forecasts the IHSG to continue its decline, targeting support at 7,000‑6,865 and resistance at 7,275‑7,410, and advises trading ADMR, PTBA, INDY, AADI, ITMG and AKRA on Monday 16 March 2026. The bearish outlook follows a weaker Wall Street index and higher oil prices, with WTI at $98.71 (+3.81%) and Brent above $100 (+2.67%).

title: Phintraco Sekuritas projects FY25 net profit of Rp 1.1 trillion for PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk
body: Phintraco Sekuritas forecasts PT Pantai Indah Kapuk Dua Tbk to generate revenue of about Rp 4.3 trillion and net profit of Rp 1.1 trillion in FY25, representing 52% and 83% year‑over‑year growth respectively. The broker notes a gross margin near 60%, net margin of 27%, total assets of roughly Rp 50 trillion and a PBV of 5.17×, well above the sector average.

title: Foreign investors boost PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk as CGS International recommends spec buys
body: PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) recorded a net foreign purchase of Rp 699.44 billion in the past month, driving its share price up 25.88% and prompting CGS International Sekuritas to issue a spec‑buy recommendation with a target of Rp 28,250‑28,775 per share; the company posted FY2025 attributable profit of US$190.94 million (≈Rp 3.2 trillion) and announced interim and final dividends totaling US$293.16 million. PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) saw a net foreign purchase of Rp 500.51 billion, its shares rose 19.94%, and CGS also recommended a spec‑buy with a target of Rp 10,575‑10,775 per share, after reporting FY2025 profit of US$760.18 million (≈Rp 12.7 trillion) and an interim dividend of US$250 million.

title: PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk acquires Pipe Laying Vessel Gunanusa Hai Long 106
body: PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk announced that the vessel Gunanusa Hai Long 106 was officially registered to the company on 19 December 2025, making it an Indonesian‑flagged pipe‑laying and lifting vessel. The ship has been recorded as a fixed asset in the Q4‑2025 financial statements and is expected to boost the firm’s offshore service capacity and long‑term shareholder value.

title: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk Announces Share Buyback Plan up to Rp 1.7 Trillion
body: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk will buy back up to 1.8 billion shares or Rp 1.7 trillion between 17 March and 16 June 2026, reflecting confidence in its strong 2025 operations and 2026 growth targets, including a projected 44,000‑48,000 ton output of High Grade Nickel Matte and a 90,000‑ton‑per‑year HPAL project.

title: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk Announces Rp 800 billion Bond and Sukuk Issuance for 2026
body: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk (RATU) has announced a combined Rp 800 billion debt issuance, comprising Rp 300 billion in bonds and Rp 500 billion in sukuk wakalah, to be offered on 17 March 2026 and listed on 30 March 2026. The bonds feature two series—A at 7.95% for 5 years and B at 8.50% for 7 years—while the sukuk mirror the same rates and maturities. The issuance received idA and idAsy ratings from Pefindo, and proceeds will fund early repayment of RETJ’s term loan, cash‑call financing for PJUC, and RATU’s working capital.

title: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk to Pay Rp 336 per Share Dividend for 2025 Book Year
body: PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) will distribute a total cash dividend of Rp 336 per share for its 2025 book year, including an interim dividend of Rp 55 per share already paid on 22 December 2025. The remaining dividend of Rp 281 per share will be paid on 8 April 2026, with the record date set for 31 March 2026 and cum‑ex dates beginning 27 March 2026.

title: PT Pembangunan Jaya Ancol Tbk (PJAA) Expected to Benefit from 2026 Lebaran Holiday with Strong Occupancy and Attractive Valuation
body: PT Pembangunan Jaya Ancol Tbk (PJAA) is projected to see occupancy rise to 80%–90% during the 2026 Lebaran holiday, with a target visitor count of 600,000 and a target price of Rp 625. The company’s valuation remains attractive, with a PBV below 1 and a PER under 10, while its solid net‑profit growth in Q4 2025 and full‑year 2025, coupled with a high dividend yield, supports a buy recommendation.

title: PT Astra International Tbk to Conduct Share Buyback up to Rp 2 Trillion
body: PT Astra International Tbk will buy back shares worth up to Rp 2 trillion from 16 March to 15 June 2026, using internal funds and limiting the buyback to no more than 20% of its paid‑up capital while keeping free float above 7.5%. The move aims to support share price stability and investor confidence.

title: PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk Secures 51% Ownership by Radiant Ruby After Tender Offer of 160 Shares
body: PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk received only 160 shares in Radiant Ruby Company Ltd’s tender offer at Rp 156 per share, totaling Rp 24,960. After settlement on March 9, 2026, Radiant Ruby holds 630,001,529 shares—51% of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk—while the company’s shares closed at Rp 416, down 5.45% in five days. Radiant Ruby plans to shift PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk’s business to digital asset technology within 6–12 months.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia to Observe Extended Idulfitri Holiday, Trading Resumes on March 25, 2026
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) will close for a long holiday period from March 18 to March 24, 2026, in observance of Idulfitri and related national holidays. Trading will resume on March 25, 2026, returning to normal operations.

title: PT Astra International Tbk Announces Rp 2 Trillion Buyback
body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) announced a buyback program up to Rp 2 trillion, capped at 20% of issued capital, running from 16 March to 15 June 2026. Other blue‑chip issuers such as PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI), PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk (TOBA), PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk (KEJU), PT Bank Nationalnobu Tbk (NOBU) and PT Mitra Keluarga Karyasehat Tbk (MIKA) also disclosed buyback plans ranging from Rp 5 trillion to Rp 50 miliar, aiming to support share prices amid market volatility.

title: PT Astra International Tbk Plans Share Buyback Valued Up to Rp 2 Trillion
body: PT Astra International Tbk announced a plan to buy back its shares with a maximum value of Rp 2 trillion, utilizing internal funds, from March 16, 2026, to June 15, 2026. The company stated the buyback will not exceed 20% of its placed and paid-up capital, ensuring the free float remains above 7.5%, a move analysts view positively for its stock valuation.

title: Broker Recommendations for Indonesian Coal and Mining Stocks: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, PT Bukit Asam Tbk, and PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk
body: Broker analysts recommend a buy for PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk and PT Bukit Asam Tbk, a reduce for PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, and a buy for PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk. AADI reported 2025 revenue of US$4.91 billion and net profit of US$760 million, ITMG’s net profit fell to US$191 million, ADRO’s revenue dropped 10.1% to US$1.87 billion with net profit of US$448 million, and PTBA is advancing coal gasification and alumina processing projects.

title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk Leads Foreign Net Sell of Rp 1.14 Trillion as Indonesian Index Falls 3.05%
body: The Indonesian composite index fell 3.05% to 7,137.21 on March 13, 2026, amid a week‑long sell‑off. Foreign investors dumped a total of Rp 1.71 trillion, with PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk the largest seller at Rp 1.14 trillion, followed by PT Bank Central Asia Tbk at Rp 413.23 billion, PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk at Rp 409.84 billion, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk at Rp 294.03 billion, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk at Rp 282.49 billion, PT Darma Henwa Tbk at Rp 195.0 billion, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk at Rp 117.26 billion, PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk at Rp 114.56 billion, PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk at Rp 78.28 billion, and PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk at Rp 69.91 billion.

title: Foreign Investors Accumulate Shares in PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, and Other Companies Amidst IHSG Decline
body: Despite the Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) falling 5.91% last week and foreign investors recording a net sell of Rp 1.71 trillion across the market, several companies saw significant foreign net buys. PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk led with Rp 377.52 billion in net buys, followed by PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (Rp 308.11 billion), PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (Rp 254.96 billion), PT Bukit Asam Tbk (Rp 175.51 billion), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (Rp 168.2 billion), PT Barito Pacific Tbk (Rp 154.52 billion), PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk (Rp 134.89 billion), PT United Tractors Tbk (Rp 118.18 billion), PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (Rp 94.79 billion), and PT Indosat Tbk (Rp 87.63 billion).

title: PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk. Resumes Trading on BEI After Suspension, Shares Drop Post-Reopening
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) reopened trading for PT Alakasa Industrindo Tbk. (ALKA) shares on Monday (16/3/2026) after a suspension, following a pre-suspension rally where shares surged over 200 percent in the last quarter from Rp358 to Rp1,090. Following the reopening, ALKA shares dropped 14.68 percent to Rp930, hitting the Auto-Rejection Bawah.

title: Multi Bintang reports 2025 net profit of Rp1.18 trillion, EPS rises to Rp562
body: Multi Bintang posted a 2025 net profit of Rp1.18 trillion, up from Rp1.14 trillion in 2024, and its basic earnings per share increased to Rp562 from Rp542. Net sales rose 4.73% to Rp3.54 trillion, while operating profit climbed to Rp1.53 trillion.

title: Pelayaran Ekalya (ELPI) Announces Rp739.35 Billion Right Issue to Fund Offshore Vessel Acquisition
body: Pelayaran Ekalya (ELPI) will raise Rp739.35 billion through a right issue of 2.11 billion shares at Rp350 each, representing 22.18% of its capital. Proceeds will be allocated 14% to short‑term liabilities, 79% to offshore support vessel acquisition, and 7% to liquidity and operating costs. The issue will be cum right market on 30 April 2026 and listed on 7 May 2026.

title: Airasia Reports Reduced Net Loss of Rp1.29 Trillion for Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2025
body: Airasia recorded a net loss of Rp1.29 trillion for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, a 15.13 percent reduction from the previous year's Rp1.52 trillion, with loss per share decreasing to Rp121.32. The company's operating revenue slightly declined to Rp7.87 trillion, while total equity remained negative at Rp10.73 trillion and accumulated losses increased to Rp17.13 trillion.

title: Selamat Sempurna Reports 2025 Net Profit of Rp1.12 Trillion, Up 9.8% YoY
body: Selamat Sempurna posted a 2025 net profit of Rp1.12 trillion, a 9.8% increase from Rp1.02 trillion in 2024, with earnings per share rising to Rp195 from Rp178. Net sales reached Rp5.33 trillion, up 3.29% from Rp5.16 trillion.

title: Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Approves Right Issue of Up to 996.68 Million Shares to Fund Debt Repayment, Working Capital and Capex
body: Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia approved a right issue of up to 996,676,699 shares at a nominal value of Rp12, with 100 % shareholder approval and a 70.7 % quorum. The proceeds will be used to pay debt, increase working capital and fund capital expenditure, while the share price fell 4.64 % to Rp185 after the announcement, following a 77.88 % year‑to‑date gain.

title: PT Astra International Tbk Plans Rp2 Trillion Share Buyback Program
body: PT Astra International Tbk announced a plan to buy back its shares listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, allocating a maximum of Rp2 trillion for the program. The buyback is scheduled from March 16 until June 15, 2026, and will not exceed 20 percent of its total placed and paid-up capital, ensuring public share ownership remains above 7.5 percent.

title: Johan Hidayat buy Shares of PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk
body: Shareholder Johan Hidayat purchased a total of 1,000,000 SIDO.JK shares on 12-13 March 2026 at a representative price of IDR 515 per share, citing investment purposes. His holding increased from 1,857,068 to 2,857,068 shares, a net gain of 1,000,000 shares, raising his stake in PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk. The transaction reflects a significant ownership boost and may influence future voting power and market perception.

title: Anugerah Bumiputra buy Shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
body: Anugerah Bumiputra purchased a total of 22,500,000 shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk at IDR 200 per share between 24 February and 4 March 2026. The acquisition raised its holding from zero to 22,500,000 shares, reflecting a pure investment motive and increasing the shareholder's stake in the listed company, which may enhance market liquidity and signal confidence in the firm’s prospects.

title: Cakrawala Buana Sentosa Buy Shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
body: Cakrawala Buana Sentosa purchased a total of 11,380,000 shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk at IDR 200 per share between 24 Feb and 6 Mar 2026, increasing its stake from 9,114,200 to 20,494,200 shares (an addition of 11,380,000 shares). The transaction, classified as an investment, raises the shareholder's ownership to roughly 22% of the company's issued capital, signaling strong confidence in the firm’s prospects and potentially influencing market sentiment.

title: Irwan Hidayat buy Shares of PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk
body: Irwan Hidayat, a shareholder of PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk (SIDO.JK), purchased a total of 2,000,000 shares between 12‑13 March 2026 at an average price of IDR 515 per share. His holding rose from 1,279,400 to 3,279,400 shares, adding 2,000,000 shares. The transaction is classified as an investment, reflecting confidence in the company's prospects and potentially affecting market perception due to the sizable increase in ownership.

title: Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sell Shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk
body: On 12 March 2026, shareholder Pemenang Nusantara Internasional sold 13,201,200 shares of PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk (WINR.JK) at IDR 27 per share as a divestment. The holding decreased from 3,497,021,800 to 3,483,820,600 shares, a reduction of 13,201,200 shares. The transaction lowers the shareholder’s ownership stake but does not affect the company’s operations.

title: BEI Monitors Unusual Market Activity for PT Fast Food Indonesia Tbk Amid 41.1% Monthly Decline
body: On March 17, 2026, Bursa Efek Indonesia flagged unusual market activity for PT Fast Food Indonesia Tbk, whose shares fell 41.1% in the month and 52.1% year‑to‑date. Investors are urged to review the company’s disclosures and potential corporate actions before making decisions.

title: PT Sunson Textile Manufacture Tbk Shares Suspended by BEI Following Significant Price Decline
body: PT Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) suspended shares of PT Sunson Textile Manufacture Tbk starting Tuesday (17/3/2026) due to a cumulative price decline of 67.9% in a month and 80% year-to-date. Simultaneously, BEI lifted the suspension on shares of PT Agro Bahari Nusantara Tbk, allowing trading to resume on the same day.

title: BEI Suspends PT Agro Bahari Nusantara Tbk Shares Amid Price Surge
body: PT Agro Bahari Nusantara Tbk had its shares suspended by BEI on 16 March 2026 due to a significant cumulative price increase, with trading resumed on 17 March 2026. The suspension aimed to protect investors by cooling down the market.

title: Mandiri Sekuritas recommends ITMG, CPIN, and SCMA for buying with target prices
body: Mandiri Sekuritas recommends buying ITMG (closing 27,825, target 28,500, stop loss 27,500), CPIN (closing 3,970, target 4,100, stop loss 3,930), and SCMA (closing 274, target 290, stop loss 270). BNI Sekuritas also recommends six other stocks, though not listed here.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk Targets Rp 9,325–9,575 After 17.86% Surge
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk saw a 17.86% jump to Rp 9,075 on March 16, 2026, and broker CGS International Sekuritas Indonesia set a near‑term target of Rp 9,325–9,575 with support at Rp 8,825. The stock has risen 13.4% in the past week, 24.3% in the month, and 63.5% YTD, while foreign investors net‑bought Rp 564.6 billion after the company was added to the MVIS Global Junior Gold Miners Index.

title: PT Alta Internasional Indonesia buy Shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk
body: PT Alta Internasional Indonesia purchased 133,258,000 shares of PT Jaya Trishindo Tbk on 13 March 2026 at IDR 175 per share, increasing its stake from 0 to 133,258,000 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, raises the shareholder's ownership to a significant position in the company, potentially influencing future corporate actions and reflecting confidence in the firm's prospects.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia Delays Short Selling Implementation for Perusahaan Efek Until September 14, 2026
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia has again postponed the implementation of short selling transactions and financing by Perusahaan Efek until September 14, 2026. This decision, effective March 17, 2026, follows previous delays and aims to maintain capital market stability amid global and domestic market volatility.

title: Foreign investors sell 1.6 billion GoTo shares while buying 259 million Bumi Resources shares on March 16
body: On March 16, foreign investors were net sellers of 433.78 million shares on the IDX, led by a 1.60 billion‑share sell‑off in PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk after buying 2.17 billion shares and selling 3.78 billion shares. The same day saw PT Bumi Resources Tbk top the buy list with a net purchase of 258.92 million shares, supported by 909.69 million shares bought and 650.76 million shares sold.

title: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk announces IDR1.7 trillion share buyback of up to 1.8 billion shares
body: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk disclosed a share repurchase program of up to 1.8 billion shares, allocating IDR 1.7 trillion, to be executed between 17 March and 16 June 2026. The buyback is expected to raise earnings per share from US$0,00023 to US$0,00024 without impacting revenue or financing costs.

title: PT Pyridam Farma Tbk plans up to 5.7 billion-share rights issue and accompanying warrants
body: PT Pyridam Farma Tbk announced a rights issue of up to 5.7 billion new shares at a nominal Rp100 per share, with warrants up to 35% of the placed shares. The proposal will be voted at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 22 April 2026, with the rights issue expected to be completed within 12 months and proceeds earmarked for acquisitions, expansion and working capital.

title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price falls to Rp2.74 million per gram
body: On 17 March 2026, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk announced its gold buyback price at Rp2,740,000 per gram, down Rp4,000 from the previous level. The program applies a 1.5% PPh 22 tax for NPWP holders and 3% for non‑NPWP holders on buyback transactions exceeding Rp10 million.

title: SIDO Directors Increase Shareholdings as Stock Closes 0.98% Lower at Rp505
body: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk’s directors, Johan Hidayat and Irwan Hidayat, raised their holdings to 2.85 million and 3.27 million shares respectively, boosting voting rights to 0.01% and 0.011%. The shares closed 0.98% lower at Rp505 on 16 March 2026, marking a 6.48% year‑to‑date decline.

title: PT Indointernet Tbk plans go‑private and delisting after shareholder vote scheduled for 22 April 2026
body: PT Indointernet Tbk announced a go‑private and voluntary delisting plan that will be presented to independent shareholders at an extraordinary meeting on 22 April 2026, following the suspension of EDGE share trading on 10 February 2026. The tender offer, conducted by Digital Edge (Hong Kong) Ltd, will be priced above the 90‑day average high price and the group already holds 89.1% of the shares.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk reports 32% rise in 2025 net profit to US$76.1 million
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk posted a 32% increase in 2025 net profit to US$76.1 million (Rp1.27 trillion) and revenue of US$990.2 million, up 4% year‑on‑year, supported by higher nickel matte production of 72,027 tonnes. EBITDA reached US$228.2 million, cash cost fell to US$9,339 per tonne and capex rose 46% to US$485.9 million.

title: Bursa Efek Indonesia delays short‑selling implementation to 14 September 2026
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia announced that the rollout of short‑selling facilities and related financing will be postponed until 14 September 2026, with the postponement taking effect from 17 March 2026. The exchange also confirmed that PT Semesta Indovest Sekuritas and PT Ajaib Sekuritas Asia have been approved to provide short‑selling financing, effective 25 August 2025.

title: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk plans rights issue and Rp700 bn acquisition spree under new PT PIMSF Pulogadung control
body: PT Geoprima Solusi Tbk (GPSO) will raise capital through a rights issue as it pursues a Rp700 billion consolidation plan that includes buying 75% of PT Pulogadung Tempajaya for Rp385 bn, 70% of PT Tjokro Bersaudara Komponenindo for Rp90 bn and 70% of PT Jakarta Marten Logamindo for Rp65 bn, plus land and building assets worth Rp160 bn. Due diligence is targeted for completion by April 2026, with shareholder approval in June and the rights issue and acquisitions slated for completion in December 2026.

title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk and PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk added to GDXJ index, shares surge
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk and PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk were added to the Global Junior Gold Miners Index effective March 20 2026, prompting their shares to rise on March 16 2026—PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk up 17.86% to Rp9,075, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk up 5.30% to Rp1,690 and PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk up 13.27% to Rp555. PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk also reported its first gold shipment to PT Aneka Tambang and targets 100,000‑115,000 ounces of production in 2026, expecting a return to profitability.

title: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk and PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk launch large rights issues amid market volatility
body: PT Bakrie & Brothers Tbk announced a rights issue of up to 86.7 billion new shares at a nominal Rp12 each, approved on 27 February 2026, while PT Wahana Interfood Nusantara Tbk plans to issue up to 10.67 billion shares at Rp100 each for acquisitions and capex. The moves come as Indonesia’s IDX composite fell 18.79% YTD and foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp7.83 trillion, prompting analysts to stress the importance of strong fundamentals for rights‑issue absorption.

title: PT Indointernet Tbk Reports 47.9% Decline in Net Profit for 2025
body: PT Indointernet Tbk posted a net profit of Rp120.8 billion in 2025, down 47.9% from Rp232.07 billion in 2024, while revenue fell 17.2% to Rp842.1 billion. Gross profit slipped 5.3% to Rp400.4 billion, but cash and cash equivalents rose to Rp485.7 billion and total assets climbed to Rp5.4 trillion, with cloud service costs surging to Rp269.7 billion.

title: PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk Reports Strong 2025 Earnings, Net Profit Doubles to Rp159.3 Billion
body: PT Pradiksi Gunatama Tbk posted net sales of Rp792.72 billion, up 7.5% from 2024, and net profit of Rp159.3 billion, a 100% increase. Gross profit rose 26.7% to Rp277.3 billion, while EPS climbed to Rp27.76 from Rp13.80. Cash and assets fell to Rp6.45 billion and Rp2.52 trillion, respectively, amid a decline in liabilities.

title: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk Reports 38% Rise in Net Profit to Rp574.39 Billion for 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk posted net profit of Rp574.39 billion for 2025, up 38% from Rp414.9 billion in 2024, while revenue rose to Rp1.58 trillion. The company also achieved EBITDA of Rp769.61 billion, a 37% YoY increase, driven by stable nickel production and aggressive market penetration.

title: Broker picks TAPG, ARCI, and BUKA spotlight potential gains as Indonesian index IHSG rises 1.35% to 7,117 on March 17, 2026
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) climbed 1.35% to 7,117, trading 1.69 billion shares for a 806 billion‑rupiah volume, while BRI Danareksa Sekuritas highlighted TAPG, ARCI and BUKA as top picks amid a 7,000 support and 7,100 resistance outlook. Phintraco and CGS International also named CPIN, SCMA, MEDC, and other stocks, projecting a 6,920–7,225 range for the index as foreign funds and commodity prices influence sentiment.

title: Foreign Investors Net Buy PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk Shares, Net Sell PT Bank Central Asia Tbk Shares
body: Foreign investors recorded a net buy of Rp564.6 billion in PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk shares, leading to a 17.86% gain to Rp9,075/saham on Monday, March 16, 2026. Conversely, foreign investors net sold PT Bank Central Asia Tbk shares by Rp400.1 billion, causing its stock to weaken by 1.82% to Rp6,750/saham.

title: PTBumi Resources MineralsTbk (BRMS) Reports 2025 Net Profit of US$ 50 Million, 99% YoY Growth
body: PTBumi Resources MineralsTbk (BRMS) posted a 2025 net profit of US$ 50 million, up 99% year‑over‑year, after a 19% quarter‑on‑quarter decline in 4Q net profit to US$ 12.5 million. Operating profit in 4Q rose 20% qoq to US$ 23.5 million, supported by a 20% qoq jump in average selling price to US$ 4,167/oz, while 2025 gold sales volume reached 71,886 oz, up 11% yoy, at an average price of US$ 3,371/oz. Management targets 80,000 oz production in 2026 with a 500‑to‑2,000‑tonne‑per‑day capacity expansion, and BRI Danareksa recommends a buy with a target price of Rp 1,080.

title: Foreign Investors Record Net Sell on Shares of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk, and Other Companies
body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell on shares of PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (Rp 400.1 billion), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (Rp 201.6 billion), PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (Rp 131.3 billion), PT Antam Tbk (Rp 116.9 billion), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (Rp 108.2 billion), PT Goto Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (Rp 84.5 billion), PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (Rp 75.2 billion), PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (Rp 64.3 billion), PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (Rp 31.1 billion), and PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (Rp 17.1 billion) on Monday, March 16, 2026. This occurred as the IHSG closed down 1.61% to 7,022.2, despite foreign investors recording an overall net buy of Rp 1.02 trillion across all markets.

title: Astra International Tbk Reports 2025 Net Income of Rp32.8 Trillion, Q4 Revenue Down 1%
body: Astra International Tbk reported 2025 revenue of Rp323.4 trillion and net income of Rp32.8 trillion, a 2% and 4% year‑over‑year decline respectively. Q4 2025 revenue fell 1% and net income 7%, while gross margin rose to 24.1%; heavy‑equipment and mining segments fell 24% yoy, whereas finance services grew 9% and property surged 224% yoy.

title: KB Valbury Sekuritas Issues Buy Recommendation for PT Bukit Asam Tbk with Target Price Rp 2,970
body: PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA) is recommended for purchase by KB Valbury Sekuritas, targeting Rp 2,970 with an entry range of Rp 2,860‑2,920 and a stop loss at Rp 2,750. The company posted Q4 2025 coal sales of 11.7 million tonnes, 45.4 million tonnes for 2025, revenue of Rp 31.3 trillion for 9 months, and a gross profit of Rp 3.57 trillion, despite a 36 % YoY decline in gross profit driven by higher cost of revenue.

title: Foreign Investors Net Buy PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) for Rp 564.6 Billion on March 16, 2026
body: Foreign investors net bought shares of PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) for Rp 564.6 billion, followed by PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) for Rp 160 billion and PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI) for Rp 82.4 billion on March 16, 2026. Other net purchases included PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) Rp 53.2 billion, PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA) Rp 41.1 billion, PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk (BIPI) Rp 40.5 billion, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) Rp 40.3 billion, PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk (NCKL) Rp 38 billion, PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS) Rp 21.5 billion and PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) Rp 21.2 billion, as part of a total net buy of Rp 1.02 trillion across the market.

title: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) Receives Buy Recommendation with Target Price Rp 10,550
body: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) is recommended as a buy by KB Valbury and BRI Danareksa, with a target price of Rp 10,550 and potential upside to Rp 12,100‑15,840, after a YTD gain of 48.39% and a 1‑month rise of 18.9%.

title: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk Adds Rp10 Trillion Credit Facility to PT Pegadaian
body: PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk has increased its credit facility to PT Pegadaian by Rp10 trillion, bringing the total financing extended to Pegadaian to Rp25.1 trillion. The move is part of BNI’s strategy to strengthen Indonesia’s financial ecosystem and broaden access to financing for consumers and businesses.

title: Indonesia Faces US Forced Labor Probe Over Trade Deal
body: Indonesia’s trade deal with the US is under scrutiny as the US launches a forced‑labor probe, with hearings set for April 28 and May 5, and a new 10% global tariff looming until July 24. The government has pledged to cooperate and maintain tariff exemptions for key products such as palm oil and textiles.

title: Danantara Names Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection as Operator for Bogor Raya Waste‑to‑Energy Project
body: Danantara has appointed Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection to operate the Bogor Raya waste‑to‑energy plant, marking the second project won by the Chinese firm after Denpasar. The initiative is part of a Rp 84 trillion ($5 billion) plan to build facilities in 33 Indonesian cities, expected to create 3,500 jobs and finish by Q4 2027.

title: Aluminium Price Surge Drives Positive Outlook for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk and Other Indonesian Smelter Developers
body: Aluminium prices climbed to US$3,395.5 per ton, boosting the outlook for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia Tbk, and PT Cita Mineral Investindo Tbk, with analysts targeting Rp 4,500, Rp 2,150, and Rp 5,000 per share respectively. The price surge improves smelter project economics but presents mixed effects for established aluminium producers PT Indal Aluminium Industry Tbk and PT Alumindo Light Metal Industry Tbk.

title: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk Plans Share Buyback Up to Rp 4 Trillion
body: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) is preparing a share buyback plan valued at up to Rp 4 trillion, funded by internal cash, reflecting management's confidence in the company's fundamentals. The plan will be presented at an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders on April 17, 2026, with the buyback scheduled to commence on April 20, 2026, if approved, and executed over a maximum of 12 months.

title: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk to Issue Rp 800 billion in Bonds and Sukuk in 2026
body: PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk plans to issue Rp 800 billion in debt, comprising Rp 300 billion in Obligasi I and Rp 500 billion in Sukuk Wakalah, with the offering set for 17 March 2026 and listing on 30 March 2026. The proceeds will fund early repayment of a term loan to PT Rahara Energi Tanjung Jabung, cash calls to PT Petrogas Jatim Utama Cendana and operators of Blok Cepu and Blok Jabung, and working capital for PT Raharja Energi Cepu Tbk.

title: PT Multi Bintang Indonesia Tbk Reports 2025 Revenue and Net Profit Growth
body: PT Multi Bintang Indonesia Tbk posted a 4.69% year‑over‑year revenue increase to Rp 3.54 trillion and a 3.62% net profit rise to Rp 1.18 trillion in 2025, driven by strong performance of its Bintang and Heineken brands and disciplined operational execution. Analysts maintain a buy rating with a target price of Rp 5,600‑Rp 5,700, citing continued focus on portfolio expansion, digital distribution, and sustainability initiatives.

title: Foreign Investors Acquire Rp 1.02 Trillion in 10 Indonesian Stocks Amid IHSG Decline
body: On Monday, 16 March 2026, foreign investors bought a total of Rp 1.02 trillion across ten Indonesian companies—PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (Rp 564.6 billion), PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (Rp 472.93 billion), PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (Rp 166.71 billion), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (Rp 100.49 billion), PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (Rp 82.42 billion), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (Rp 53.25 billion), PT Bukit Asam Tbk (Rp 41.12 billion), PT Astrindo Nusantara Infrastruktur Tbk (Rp 40.58 billion), PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (Rp 40.35 billion), and PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk (Rp 38.02 billion) as the benchmark index fell 1.61% to 7,022.28.

title: PT Newport Marine Services Tbk Reports 73% Net Profit Growth and 54% Revenue Increase in 2025
body: PT Newport Marine Services Tbk recorded a net profit of US$ 2.04 million in 2025, a 73% increase from the previous year, alongside a 54% rise in revenue to US$ 17.71 million. This performance was driven by increased armada utilization through new charter vessel projects, improved operational efficiency, and better financial management, which also boosted its net profit margin to 11.5% and operating cash flow to US$ 5.03 million.

title: PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk Surpasses 1,730 Resistance, Targets 1,830
body: PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk, PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk, PT J Resources Asia Pasifik Tbk, PT Bukalapak.com Tbk, and PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk are the focus of a broker recommendation report. TAPG broke 1,730 resistance and targets 1,830, BUKA posted a 3.14 trillion rupiah profit in 2025 and a 450 billion rupiah dividend, ARCI and EMAS benefit from GDXJ inclusion, and TPIA faces a bearish trend after breaching 5,350 support.

title: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk Reports 38.44% YoY Net Profit Growth in 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk reported a 38.44% year‑on‑year increase in consolidated net profit to Rp574.39 billion for 2025, while revenue rose 7.87% to Rp1.58 trillion. The company’s nickel sales volume grew 16.60% to 3.03 million tonnes, supporting the earnings lift and driving a 5.04% rise in its shares.

title: PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk. Shareholders Approve Divestment of PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk. Shares
body: Shareholders of PT Prima Globalindo Logistik Tbk. (PPGL) approved the divestment of its entire 365,597,400 shares in PT Armada Berjaya Trans Tbk. (JAYA) at an Independent General Meeting on March 12, 2026. The transaction, valued at approximately Rp44.6 billion at Rp122 per share, is classified as a material transaction.

title: PT Agro Bahari Nusantara Tbk. Stock Trading Reopened by BEI Amid Continued Price Pressure
body: Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) lifted the trading suspension for PT Agro Bahari Nusantara Tbk. (UDNG) shares on Tuesday (17/3/2026), allowing transactions to resume. Following the reopening, UDNG's stock immediately hit Auto-Rejection Bawah (ARB) at Rp1,155, extending its significant decline of over 34% in the last week, 65% in the last month, and more than 78% since the start of the year from Rp5,200.

title: Asahimas reports 2025 net profit of Rp79.63 billion, down 66.62% from 2024
body: Asahimas posted a net profit of Rp79.63 billion for 2025, a 66.62% decline from Rp238.61 billion in 2024, while net sales fell 6.61% to Rp5.08 trillion. Gross profit slid to Rp831.25 billion from Rp1.04 trillion, and earnings per share dropped to Rp183 from Rp550.

title: Pyridam Farma to Issue 5.7 Billion Shares in Right Issue
body: Pyridam Farma will conduct a right issue of 5.7 billion shares at a nominal value of Rp100 each, with warrants up to 35% of the issued shares. The proceeds, after costs, will be used for acquisitions and strengthening the company’s capital structure, and an extraordinary general meeting is scheduled for 22 April 2026 with shareholders recorded as of 30 March 2026.

title: Bakrieland Reports Reduced Net Loss to Rp16.69 Billion in 2025 Amidst Revenue Growth
body: Bakrieland (ELTY) recorded a net loss of Rp16.69 billion in 2025, a 75.64 percent reduction from Rp68.52 billion in 2024, with net loss per share decreasing to Rp0.97. The company's net revenue increased by 16.39 percent to Rp1.42 trillion, while gross profit rose to Rp485.86 billion.

title: Dinasti Hidayat Acquire 3.27 Million Shares of Sido Muncul in March 2026
body: In March 2026, Irwan Hidayat and Johan Hidayat purchased a combined 5.12 million shares of Sido Muncul at Rp510–Rp515 per share, paying Rp1.03 billion and Rp514 million respectively. Their holdings rose to 3.27 million shares (0,011 %) for Irwan and 2.85 million shares (0.01 %) for Johan, increasing their stakes from 0,004 % and 0,006 % respectively.

title: Triputra Agro Reports 2025 Net Profit of Rp3.7 Trillion, Up 18.65% YoY
body: Triputra Agro posted a 2025 net profit of Rp3.7 trillion, an 18.65% increase from Rp3.12 trillion in 2024, while revenue from customer contracts rose 17.89% to Rp11.4 trillion. The company also recorded a gross profit of Rp4.49 trillion, operating profit of Rp3.54 trillion, and total assets of Rp14.69 trillion against liabilities of Rp11.68 trillion.

title: Hillcon Equity Management sell Shares of PT Hillcon Tbk
body: On 2026-03-16, Hillcon Equity Management sold 280,000,000 PT Hillcon Tbk shares at IDR 25 per share for investment purposes. The shareholder's stake decreased from 6,005,118,700 shares to 5,725,118,700 shares, a reduction of 280,000,000 shares.

title: Sentosa Bersama Mitra Buy Shares of Rukun Raharja Tbk
body: Sentosa Bersama Mitra purchased 8,149,500 shares of Rukun Raharja Tbk (RAJA.JK) at IDR 2,975 per share on 13 March 2026, raising its holding from 1,490,222,504 to 1,498,372,004 shares (+8,149,500). The buy aims to increase share ownership, modestly boosting the shareholder’s stake in the listed infrastructure firm.

title: PT Lintas Benua sell Shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk
body: PT Lintas Benua sold a total of 25,440,000 shares of PT Ketrosden Triasmitra Tbk (KETR.JK) at a representative price of IDR 435 per share to meet cash requirements. The sale reduced its stake from 554,969,087 to 529,529,087 shares, a decline of 25,440,000 shares (≈4.6%). The transaction reflects a liquidity-driven divestment by a major shareholder.

title: Mandara Mas Semesta sell Shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk
body: Mandara Mas Semesta sold 60,529,543 shares of PT Agung Menjangan Mas Tbk at IDR 47 per share on 13 March 2026, reducing its stake from 358,236,131 shares to 297,706,588 shares (a decline of 60,529,543 shares). The transaction, reported on 17 March 2026, is stated to be for share reduction, indicating the shareholder is decreasing its exposure to the company.

title: Charles Daniel Gobel buy Shares of Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk
body: On 13 March 2026, investor Charles Daniel Gobel purchased 650,000 shares of Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk at IDR 811 per share, increasing his holding from zero to 650,000 shares. The transaction, classified as an investment, adds a new shareholder with a 0.XX% stake (based on total shares outstanding) and may signal confidence in the company's growth prospects.

title: Charles Daniel Gobel buy Shares of Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk
body: Charles Daniel Gobel purchased 700,000 shares of Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk at IDR 725 per share on 16 March 2026, increasing his stake from 650,000 to 1,350,000 shares. The transaction, recorded as an investment, raises his ownership to a total of 1.35 million shares, reflecting a significant expansion of his position in the mining firm.

title: Darma Henwa Tbk Shareholder Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia Reports New Transaction
body: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia entered a repurchase agreement (REPO) for Darma Henwa Tbk on 16 March 2026 at IDR 264 per share, transacting 300,000,218 shares. The holder's position fell from 2,249,540,595 shares to 1,949,540,377 shares, a reduction of 300,000,218 shares. The REPO provides short‑term financing for the shareholder while temporarily lowering its equity stake in the company, which may affect voting power and market perception.

title: Dr Mirza Mahendra St Mt buy Shares of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk
body: On 13 March 2026, Dr Mirza Mahendra St Mt purchased a total of 50,000 shares of PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk at an indicative price of IDR 1,975 per share, increasing his holding from 0 to 50,000 shares (+50,000). The transaction is classified as an investment, adding a new shareholder with a material position in the company and potentially influencing future shareholder composition.

title: Patrick Rudolf Dannacher buys Shares of PT ITSEC Asia Tbk.
body: On 13 March 2026, shareholder Patrick Rudolf Dannacher purchased an additional 83,000 PT ITSEC Asia Tbk. (CYBR.JK) shares at approximately IDR 1,380 per share for investment purposes. His holding rose from 220,470,022 to 220,553,022 shares, reflecting a modest increase in ownership.

title: PT Amanda Cipta Persada buy Shares of PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk.
body: PT Amanda Cipta Persada purchased 2,569,718,200 shares of PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk. at IDR 1,420 per share on 17 Mar 2026 as part of an internal restructuring. The stake increased from 1,141,076,700 to 3,710,794,900 shares, raising the shareholder’s ownership by 2.57 billion shares. The transaction reflects a significant consolidation of control within the company and may influence future governance and capital structure.

title: Thomas Junaidi Alim W buy Shares of Astra International Tbk
body: On 13 March 2026, shareholder Thomas Junaidi Alim W purchased 100,000 Astra International Tbk shares at IDR 5,800 per share, raising his holding from 1,307,800 to 1,407,800 shares (an increase of 100,000). The transaction, classified as an investment, expands his ownership stake in the company, reflecting confidence in Astra's prospects and potentially influencing future share price dynamics.

title: Djonny Saksono buy Shares of PT Indonesian Tobacco Tbk
body: Shareholder Djonny Saksono purchased a total of 400,800 PT Indonesian Tobacco Tbk shares on 13‑17 March 2026 at prices ranging from IDR 254 to IDR 263 per share, with a representative price of IDR 254 per share. The buy transactions raised his holding from 643,030,800 to 643,431,600 shares, a net increase of 400,800 shares. The acquisition is classified as an investment purpose, marginally expanding his stake in the company and reflecting confidence in the tobacco firm's outlook.

title: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk Shareholder Hans Patuwo Reports New Transaction
body: Hans Patuwo, a shareholder of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO.JK), received 188,185,634 shares at IDR 2 per share on 16‑17 March 2026 as part of the implementation of GoTo's Employee and Consultant Stock Option Program administered by the GoTo Peopleverse Fund. His holding rose from 574,829,533 to 763,015,167 shares, reflecting a net increase of 188,185,634 shares. The transaction expands the pool of shares available for employee and consultant incentives, resulting in modest dilution but aligning stakeholder interests with company performance.

title: Anton Budidjaja buy Shares of Reliance Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk
body: Anton Budidjaja purchased 10,000,000 shares of Reliance Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk at IDR 480 per share on 2026-03-17, increasing his holding from 0 to 10,000,000 shares (+10,000,000). The transaction is classified as a personal investment, signaling a substantial new stake by the shareholder in the listed securities firm.

title: Sigmantara Alfindo sell Shares of PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk.
body: Sigmantara Alfindo sold 2,569,718,200 shares of PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk. at IDR 1,420 per share on 2026-03-17 as part of an internal restructuring. The holding decreased from 20,839,251,059 to 18,269,532,859 shares, reducing the shareholder's stake by roughly 12.3%. The transaction reflects a strategic reallocation of capital by the shareholder and may signal a shift in voting power, which is relevant for investors monitoring ownership dynamics in the retail sector.

title: Hasim Sutiono buys Shares of PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk.
body: Hasim Sutiono, an insider, bought 66,605,200 shares of PT Cashlez Worldwide Indonesia Tbk. at IDR 215 per share for investment purposes. His ownership increased from 381,438,351 shares to 448,043,551 shares, a gain of 67,605,200 shares.

title: Trimegah Sekuritas Posts 128% Surge in 2025 Net Profit to Rp593.5 Billion
body: Trimegah Sekuritas (TRIM) ended 2025 with net profit of Rp593.53 billion, up 128.39% from Rp259.89 billion in 2024, and earnings per share rose to Rp83.48 from Rp36.55. Total revenue reached Rp1.67 trillion, an 85.55% increase, driven by contract revenue of Rp869.57 billion and investment income of Rp810.37 billion.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk sees insider buying as shares tumble over 14%
body: Director Charles Gobel purchased a total of 1.35 million shares of PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk, spending roughly IDR 1.03 billion and raising his stake to about 0,001 % of the company. The transactions occurred as the stock fell more than 14 % to IDR 675 per share, trading at 117 times earnings and 4.61 times book value.

title: PT Indointernet Tbk plans to go private and delist from IDX pending shareholder approval
body: PT Indointernet Tbk announced a plan to become a private company and delist its shares from the Indonesia Stock Exchange, subject to approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 22 April 2026. The controlling shareholder Digital Edge Ltd will launch a voluntary tender offer from 19 May to 18 June 2026 at a price above the 90‑day average, with settlement expected by 30 June 2026, while the current free float stands at 7.90% (159.5 million shares).

title: Grab raises its holding in PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk to 15.95% amid broader shareholding shifts in Indonesian listed firms
body: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk, PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk, PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk, PT Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk, PT Intiland Development Tbk, PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk, PT Summarecon Agung Tbk, PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk and PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk all recorded notable changes in share ownership. Grab, via A5-DB Holdings, added 71.30 million shares to bring its stake in PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk to 15.95%; Prajogo Pangestu acquired 5.64 billion shares of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk for a 5.02% holding; PT United Tractors Tbk repurchased 1.47 million shares, raising treasury to 200.28 million (5.37%); PT Summarecon Agung Tbk saw its largest shareholder increase to 23.04% after buying 1.2 million shares, while PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk reached 49.05% control with a 1.54 million‑share purchase.

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk plans up to 1.39 billion-share rights issue ahead of April 2026 AGM
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk intends to raise capital through a rights issue of up to 1.39 billion new shares at a nominal Rp50 each, pending approval at its shareholders meeting on 16 April 2026. The company reported FY 2025 liabilities of US$577.77 million, revenue of US$365.86 million and a net loss of US$162.26 million, reversing a US$25.35 million profit recorded in 2024.

title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk posts 32% rise in 2025 net profit to US$76.1 million
body: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk reported a 2025 net profit of US$76.1 million (Rp1.27 trillion), a 32% increase year‑on‑year, while revenue rose 4% to US$990.2 million despite a 7% drop in nickel matte price. The firm lowered cash cost to US$9,339 per ton, lifted capital expenditure by 46% to US$485.9 million and is advancing HPAL projects under a revised 30% production quota.

title: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk plans up to 1.39 billion-share rights issue to fund renewable and EV projects
body: PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk announced a rights issue of up to 1.39 billion new shares at a nominal Rp50 each, seeking shareholder approval at the April 16, 2026 meeting to finance waste‑processing, renewable‑energy and electric‑vehicle initiatives. The company’s total liabilities rose 26.4% YoY to US$577.77 million at year‑end 2025, driven by a 166% increase in bond and sukuk debt.

title: Astra reports net profit of Rp32.8 trillion in 2025, double its 2020 earnings
body: Astra highlighted that its net profit rose to Rp32.8 trillion in 2025, up from Rp16.2 trillion in 2020, while the group expanded from 236 to 321 subsidiaries and now employs over 190,000 people. The company emphasized its 69‑year legacy, diversified 3P Roadmap strategy and continued focus on talent development to sustain growth across its seven business lines.

title: PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk announces sustainable bond, sukuk and US$ bond issuance targeting over Rp1.4 trillion and US$15.5 million
body: PT Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Tbk said it will issue sustainable rupiah bonds worth Rp628.09 billion, sukuk worth Rp811.10 billion and a US$15.52 million green bond in the first half of 2026, aiming to raise more than Rp1.4 trillion and US$15.5 million. The program forms part of a broader target of up to Rp10 trillion in local‑currency and US$100 million in foreign‑currency issuances.

title: OJK revokes PT Tennet Depository Indonesia’s digital asset storage license
body: OJK officially revoked the business license of PT Tennet Depository Indonesia as a digital financial asset custodian, effective 12 March 2026. The firm must immediately cease all digital asset storage activities and settle any outstanding obligations.

title: Unilever Indonesia drives big‑cap gains as IHSG climbs to 7,106.83
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 7,106.83, up 1.20% after Bank Indonesia kept the BI‑Rate at 4.75%, with PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk gaining 7.82% to Rp2,000. PT Leyand International Tbk surged 19.48% to Rp92 as the top gainer, while PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga Tbk fell 14.97% to Rp159, the leading loser.

title: PT Metropolitan Land Tbk reports Ramadan-driven boost in casual leasing revenue and aims to raise 2026 marketing sales
body: PT Metropolitan Land Tbk said its Grand Metropolitan Mall Bekasi saw higher casual‑leasing income from Ramadan events, bazaars and promotions while tenant‑rent revenue remained stable. The firm recorded marketing‑sales (pre‑sale) revenue of Rp1,875 trillion in 2025, over 70 % from residential projects, and aims to increase this figure in 2026 by leveraging ongoing residential and commercial projects.

title: PT Indointernet Tbk announces go‑private plan and timeline for delisting from the IDX
body: PT Indointernet Tbk disclosed that it will pursue a go‑private transaction and delist its shares from the Indonesia Stock Exchange, with an independent shareholders meeting set for 22 April 2026 and a voluntary tender offer scheduled for 18‑30 June 2026. The company expects the delisting process to be completed by August 2026, and the tender price will be set above the average of the highest daily prices over the 90 days preceding the shareholders meeting.

title: Seven State-Owned Construction Companies Undergo Final Stage of Restructuring and Consolidation
body: The restructuring process for seven state-owned construction companies, including PT Adhi Karya Tbk., PT PP Tbk., PT Wijaya Karya Tbk., PT Hutama Karya, PT Waskita Karya Tbk., PT Brantas Abipraya, and PT Nindya Karya, has entered its final stage, involving fundamental improvements through impairment and debt restructuring. This process will lead to their consolidation into three core groups (infrastructure, building, and EPC), with integration projected to be completed by 2026.

title: Telkom Indonesia Launches TLKM 30 Transformation Plan to Strengthen Digital Infrastructure and Governance
body: Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk unveiled its TLKM 30 transformation agenda, targeting execution in 2026 and completion by 2030 to streamline its portfolio, enhance governance, and unlock value through spin‑offs such as FiberCo and InfraNexia. The plan also includes divesting non‑core assets like PT Administrasi Medika via TelkomMetra and restructuring to focus on B2C, B2B ICT, Digital Infrastructure, and International Business.

title: PT Prime Agro Resources Tbk Reports Increased Revenue but Decreased Net Profit in 2025
body: PT Prime Agro Resources Tbk recorded a revenue increase to Rp6.44 trillion in 2025 from Rp5.5 trillion in 2024, primarily from palm oil product sales. However, its net profit attributable to the parent entity owners decreased by 44.26% year-on-year to Rp504.7 billion from Rp905.5 billion, despite a 20.69% rise in gross profit to Rp2.13 trillion, and total assets declined to Rp9.9 trillion from Rp10.7 trillion.

title: PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk to Hold Annual General Meeting on April 17, 2026, to Approve 2025 Financials, Dividend, and Share Buyback
body: PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk will convene its Annual General Meeting on April 17, 2026, to approve the 2025 consolidated financial statements, declare a final cash dividend, and propose a share buyback program that may be completed within 12 months. The meeting will also cover appointments of new directors and the renewal of the recovery plan and articles of association.

title: PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk, PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk, and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk Lead IHSG Decline
body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed the week down 0.43% to 7,106, primarily weighed down by significant declines in large-cap stocks. PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk fell 8.18%, PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk dropped 7.94%, and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk decreased 13.92%, with other notable declines from PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk, and PT Maha Properti Indonesia Tbk.

title: PT Bumi Resources Tbk Shares Decline Amid Strategy Shift to Mineral Mining
body: Shares of PT Bumi Resources Tbk experienced a net sell of Rp 502 billion from investors in the regular market between March 9-17, 2026, leading to a 14.1% drop in the last week and a 43.7% year-to-date decline. The company is expanding into mineral mining, with Wolfram Limited expected to yield returns by late 2026 and Jubile Metals Limited projected to begin gold production in Q4 2026.

title: Foreign Investors Net Buy PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) as Indonesian Market Closes Up 84.5 Points
body: Foreign investors net bought shares of PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) Rp 727.8 billion, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) Rp 113.6 billion, PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) Rp 73 billion, PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) Rp 54.7 billion, PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI) Rp 53.9 billion, PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (EXCL) Rp 42 billion, PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk (UNVR) Rp 34.1 billion, PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) Rp 19.6 billion, PT Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera Tbk (NSSS) Rp 14.8 billion, and PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA) Rp 14.4 billion. The net buy totaled Rp 155.3 billion while net sell reached Rp 679.1 billion, and the Indonesia Composite Index closed up 84.5 points to 7,106.8 amid total transaction value of Rp 23.8 trillion.

title: PT Astra International Tbk Announces Rp2 Trillion Buyback Amid Market Rally
body: PT Astra International Tbk, PT TBS Energi Utama Tbk, PT Mulia Boga Raya Tbk, PT Bank Nationalnobu Tbk, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk, PT Mitra Keluarga Karyasehat Tbk, and PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk announced buyback programs ranging from Rp50 billion to Rp2 trillion, with buyback periods spanning March to July 2026. The Indonesian composite index (IHSG) closed at 7,106.8 on March 17, 2026, up 1.2 % from the previous day.

title: Foreign Investors Net Sell PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk, Net Buy PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk
body: On Tuesday (17/3/2026), foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 216.8 billion in PT Bank Central Asia Tbk and Rp 158.6 billion in PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk in the regular market. Conversely, foreign investors made significant net buys in PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk, totaling Rp 727.8 billion, and in PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk, amounting to Rp 113.6 billion.

title: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk Shares Drop 3.49% to Rp 172 Amid Heavy Foreign Selling
body: PT Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama Tbk (PACK) shares fell 3.49% to Rp 172 after a surge of foreign selling, with 115.3 million shares traded and a net foreign sell of 274.9 million shares, generating a total transaction value of Rp 20.37 billion.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk Shares Jump 8.15% on Foreign Buying and Strong 2025 Financial Performance
body: Shares of PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk surged 8.15% to Rp 730 per share, driven by foreign net buying of 46,082,900 shares. This increase follows the company's 2025 audited financial results, which reported a 54% rise in revenue to US$ 249 million, a 118% increase in operating profit to US$ 93 million, and a 99% jump in net profit to US$ 50 million, attributed to an 11% increase in gold production and a 38% rise in gold selling prices.

title: PT Bank Tabungan Negara Tbk Accelerates Shift to Broader Consumer Bank, Targets 15% Wealth Management Growth
body: PT Bank Tabungan Negara Tbk (BTN) is diversifying from a mortgage-focused lender to a broader consumer bank, expanding into wealth management, credit cards, and auto loans. The bank targets 15% growth in its wealth management segment this year, following a 60% year-on-year rise in fee-based income from the segment as of December 2025 and double-digit growth in assets under management.

title: Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo Sells 515.89 Million Goto Gojek Shares, Raising Rp25.79 Billion
body: Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo exercised 515.89 million Goto Gojek (GOTO) shares at Rp2 each, then sold 250 million shares on 16 March 2026 and 265.89 million shares on 17 March 2026 at Rp52 each, raising a total of Rp25.79 billion. The divestment leaves her holding 493.71 million GOTO shares, representing 0.02 % of the company.
