title: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk Begins Commercial Production with First Gold Sale to Antam
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk announced its maiden gold sale of 516,287 ounces from the Pani Gold Mine to Antam, marking the start of commercial production. The company’s ore reserves rose to 5.2 million ounces, and it targets 100,000–115,000 ounces of gold in 2026 while expanding its drilling program to 32,000 meters.

title: PT Bukit Asam (Persero) Tbk Secures RKAB Permit Amidst Reduced 2026 Coal Production Quota
body: PT Bukit Asam (Persero) Tbk has obtained its Budget and Cost Work Plan (RKAB) permit, as the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has approved approximately 250-300 million tons of coal production for 2026, nearly 50% of the total 600 million ton quota. This 2026 quota represents a decrease from the 790 million tons set for 2025, reflecting efforts to balance supply and demand.

title: RMK Energy and Pendopo Energi Batubara Sign MoU to Expand Coal Logistics in South Sumatra
body: RMK Energy and Pendopo Energi Batubara have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop mining infrastructure and integrate coal logistics in South Sumatra. The agreement will allow PEB to sell coal to RMKE and supports RMKE’s target of 12.7 million tons of coal transportation and 3.6 million tons of sales.

title: Bank Syariah Indonesia Promotes Gold Investment for THR Funds via BYOND Platform
body: Bank Syariah Indonesia encourages individuals to allocate a portion of their Tunjangan Hari Raya (THR) to gold investment through its BYOND platform, offering a convenient and secure way to purchase and sell physical gold. The service aims to help customers use THR for long‑term financial goals such as down‑payments, Hajj preparations, or education funding.

title: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk Reports 54% Revenue Growth to USD249 Million in 2025, Eyes Production Expansion
body: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) posted a 54% jump in 2025 revenue to USD249 million, with operating profit up 118% to USD93 million and net profit rising 99% to USD50 million, driven by an 11% increase in gold production and a 38% rise in gold price. The company plans to boost production capacity from 500 to 2,000 tonnes of ore per day by Q4 2026 and target 80,000 troy ounces of gold in 2026, with high‑grade underground mining slated to begin in the second half of 2027.

title: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk Prepares Funds for Rp587.95 Billion Bond Repayment Due April 2026
body: PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk has announced its readiness to repay the principal of its Obligasi Berkelanjutan III Tahap III Tahun 2021 Seri B, totaling Rp587.95 billion, which matures on April 15, 2026. The company's director, Suryandi, stated that this repayment demonstrates its commitment to investors and market trust, also signaling sufficient liquidity.

title: Mayora Indah reports net profit decline to Rp2.86 trillion for 2025
body: Mayora Indah posted a net profit of Rp2.86 trillion for the year ended December 31, 2025, a 4.66% drop from Rp3 trillion in 2024, while basic earnings per share fell to Rp128.42 from Rp134.19. Net sales rose 7.23% to Rp38.68 trillion, but cost of sales increased to Rp30.18 trillion, contributing to the profit decline.

title: Indah Kiat reports USD453.3 million net profit for 2025, up 6.84% from 2024
body: Indah Kiat posted a net profit of USD453.3 million for 2025, a 6.84% increase over the previous year, and raised its basic earnings per share to USD0,08286 from USD0,07756. Net sales fell slightly to USD3.17 billion, while gross profit rose to USD1.02 billion.

title: PT Garuda Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Reports 5.9% Revenue Decline and Net Loss of US$319.39 Million in 2025, Targets 2026 Turnaround
body: PT Garuda Indonesia (Persero) Tbk posted revenue of US$3.22 billion, down 5.9% YoY, and a net loss of US$319.39 million in 2025, while its equity swung to a positive US$91.9 million from a negative US$1.35 billion and cash rose to US$943.4 million. The airline plans to operate 68 serviceable aircraft by the end of 2026, supported by a Rp23.7 trillion capital injection and a turnaround strategy focused on fleet restoration, cost management, and digital transformation.

title: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk Reports Strong 2025 Revenue and Net Profit Growth
body: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk posted 2025 revenue of Rp1.47 trillion, up 9.65% year‑on‑year, and net profit of Rp196.44 billion, up 17.74% yoy, driven largely by its delay‑service segment which accounted for 89.51% of total revenue. The company also increased total assets to Rp1.71 trillion and equity to Rp1.36 trillion, while outlining plans to strengthen its partnership within the Pelindo Group and expand new business opportunities.

title: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk Reports 2025 Financial Results: Revenue Up 9.65% to Rp1.47 Trillion, Net Profit 17.74% to Rp196.44 Billion
body: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk (IPCM) posted 2025 revenue of Rp1.47 trillion, up 9.65% YoY, and net profit of Rp196.44 billion, up 17.74% YoY. Total assets rose 3.91% to Rp1.71 trillion and equity increased 5.48% to Rp1.36 trillion, underscoring the company’s expanding maritime services portfolio.

title: PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk. Secures Rp70 Billion Loan from PT Bank Saqu
body: PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk. obtained a Rp70 billion loan facility from PT Bank Saqu on March 13, 2026, for a 12-month term, which is considered a material transaction representing 59.14% of its equity as of September 30, 2025. The loan is intended for repaying PT Bank DKI and for working capital to support PT Personel Alih Daya Tbk.'s outsourcing services.

title: Bank Indonesia Holds BI‑Rate at 4.75% as Digital Transaction Volume Surges 40.35% in February 2026
body: Bank Indonesia kept its BI‑Rate at 4.75% while maintaining Deposit Facility at 3.75% and Lending Facility at 5.50% in its March 2026 policy meeting. Digital payment activity in February 2026 surged 40.35% year‑over‑year to 4.67 billion transactions, with mobile app growth of 9.49% and QRIS up 133.20%, and retail transactions via BI‑FAST rose 31.49% to Rp1,092 trillion, while large‑value BI‑RTGS transactions slowed 5.33% to 0.76 million but grew 9.19% in value to Rp16,105 trillion, and UYD increased 15.78% to Rp1,287 trillion.
